title: The Unlucky Duck
text: It was a bright sunny day, so Lea and Leila decided to go to the park. Their mother allowed them to go, but they must get home before it gets dark.. When they arrived at the park, Lea wanted to go somewhere else because the park smelled so stinky! It smelled so bad! But Leila spotted a duck. It was surrounded by garbage. The duck was lying down and it looked sad. Yuck! Wait! Lea and Leila went towards the duck and tried to find out what was wrong. They noticed a plastic toy - a slinky - stuck around its beak. The poor duck felt so nervous around them, but they just wanted to help. It flapped its wings quickly and panicked but it couldn't speak. Poor duck. There, there. Lea suggested they remove the slinky, but Leila said they might hurt the duck, so she suggested to call their mother. They told her they needed her help because a plastic toy was stuck around a duck's beak. They asked her to bring a cutter. Lea and Leila's mother carefully took off the strings from its beak. Their mother felt so bad for the duck. "What a poor duck!" said Lea and Leila's mother. They all wondered how the plastic slinky toy got around its beak. Their mother told them it is because of people who didn't throw their garbage in the right place! She told them because people littered, the animals got surrounded by plastic waste! The unlucky duck ran as fast as it could away from the park. It felt so free as it quacked while its wings flapped. Lea and Leila knew they had to do something after this. Things needed to change; they knew littering must be stopped. Quack! Bye! Lea and Leila decided to raise awareness and taught people that their garbage should be thrown away in the proper place! Everyone cleaned the park so the animals came back. Lea and Leila were proud that everyone helped clean all the plastic waste!
author: Repostly Admin
illustrator: Isuri Dayaratne; Jemma Jose; Musonda  Kabwe

title: Luther the Caged Bird
text: My name is Luther. Yes - I'm the one in the cage! I hate being locked inside this thing! I want my freedom! And I will fight for it and talk about my freedom, because I deserve to be free. "We are made with wings to fly away!" so the saying goes. I have met many other birds who have no freedom like me! They tell me how they are forced to stay in a cage forever! I want to do something different. I am going to stand up for all birds and free us all. A little boy came by and I gave my opinion! I stood up for what's right with no fear. I told him that birds belong in the sky. The boy got me out of my cage and brought me to his home. At the little boy's home, I told the boy that it is wrong to keep birds in cages. We live outside in the world and live our lives flying from place to place. Inside cages, we are slaves locked up. The little boy was very moved with what I said! He and I became very good friends! The boy and his father took all of our cages from the store and released us into the sky! They decided to give us our freedom. Because I stood up for myself, I discovered my freedom both within and outside. The little boy and his father are stronger now for giving us our freedom. I have learned to not allow anyone to remove my rights. You must claim your rights for yourself. Look at the world with an open heart and decide what is right. "We are made with wings to fly away."
author: Repostly Admin

title: All I had to do was ask!
text: Toby was a friendly boy, cheerful and loved people around him. After returning from school, he would quickly freshen up and do his homework, eat his snacks and go out to play. When he went down to play, his friends would discuss the game, role play, and positions but would never complete any game for long. They would all end up sitting around and talking or end up arguing. As the days went by, Toby got bored. As the year went by, he avoided going out to play and would enjoy reading books on science, general knowledge, and comics. In his leisure time he would play ball by himself or chess and carrom with his mother. His mother started noticing a trend and one day, gently prodded him to go play football outside with the other children as physical fitness was vital for his development. Toby hesitatingly agreed. He got all dressed up to play football and went out. As he was stood in one corner, none of the children noticed him and continued playing. After some time they did notice him but neither said anything to him. The football came near him and one of the kids shouted."Hey you there, kick the ball here!" Toby gestured with his hands, "How?" All giggled and one boy came and took the ball, grinned at Toby and went back to play. Toby felt awkward and went back home. His mother was surprised. "Back so early?" Toby grumbled with dismay,"Mom, they did not call me to play with them. It was as if they did not want me at all!" Mother smiled and sat beside him,"Son, nobody will come to you to request you to play or be with them. You must be confident and show you are eager to learn and be with them. Now go and try asking them. If they still ignore you, come back." Toby smiled and went out to give it another try. As he walked towards the group playing, the football again came towards Toby. This time, however, he picked it up, smiled towards the group and said,"Hi friends, I don't know how to play football so well. Will you teach me? I would love to play with you." The children looked at each other and said together, "Why, of course! Now kick that ball towards us. We will teach you the rules." Toby felt elated and his heart felt light! That wasn't so difficult! As he learnt the game, he started enjoying the time spent with his friends. He was much more happier and that reflected in his studies too as he could concentrate better and score well. He was appreciated for football by his coach at school as well! The group met daily at the same time and played lots of interesting games together and loved each other's company. Toby was finally happy being in a group of such lovely friends! He realized what he would be missing if he had stayed back home that day and resorted to reading books and solitude. Had his mother not advised him to be confident and take the initiative, he would still be feeling lonely and sulking. He decided that whenever he would feel doubtful about a situation, lesson, instruction, conversation, or a new environment, all he had to was.........................JUST ASK!.....
author: Shruti Diggavi
illustrator: Catherine Groenewald; Iddi  Marumba; Rob Owen

title: Crabs on the Beach
text: Story Description A mother and baby crab walk the beach together, searching for items to help build their new town. Pre-Reading Vocabulary and Phonics Pincer pin-sur A crab's claw is called a pincer. Mosquito moh-ss-kee-toe Crabs were wary of any mosquito es near their home. Sheltered sh-el-t-er-d The new home site was sheltered from the wind. Excavation ex-ca-vay-sh-un Digging something up is an excavation. Soldier crabs searched the beach for shells and rock to build a new little town. They patrolled in pairs, glancing and moving sideways, feeling the land with their legs and sharp pincers. Mother and baby crab found one of the construction worker crabs near the sea. There were a few shells around, but nothing big they could use to build shelters. "With my giant tool hand, I can scoop sand and dig deeply to find hidden treasures," said the construction worker crab. "I'll help you with mine!" said baby crab, waving his little claw. Mother and baby crab dug themselves a little hole as they searched for shells and materials. Baby crab dug so deep that he got stuck, and his mother had to help him scramble out. She looked upon him with loving eyes. He was learning fast and he was brave for a tiny crab. Mother searched a new area of land and found bigger shells. There were conches and stones scattered around. She alerted the soldier crabs who came and dug, gathering materials for the new town. One of the construction worker crabs dug and found another crab under the sand. "What are you doing so far down in there?" said the worker crab. "I was sleeping," said the other crab. "I'm very old, and I've developed such a thick shell that I never heard you coming, which is why I sleep so well." Later, mother and baby crab encountered a very serious soldier crab. He was standing to attention and guarding the area from pests. "Flies, moths and mosquitoes," the soldier crab kept repeating to himself, as if he kept forgetting what he was keeping watch for. The baby crab surprised the soldier crab by climbing up his back, and his mother had to apologise. Soon mother and baby crab were walking by the shore, when they noticed the water was getting higher and closer. "The tide is coming in," said mother crab. "We should keep away and inform the other crabs." "Look what I found!" said the baby crab, so happy to discover a shell under the soil. "Very good," said his mother. "Looks like this would be the perfect spot for our new town. It's far enough from the tide coming in, and it's sheltered." The other crabs came and congratulated the baby crab and his mother for their find. The baby crab was so happy that because of him, now the entire colony had a new place to stay. The soldier crabs returned with the materials and started building the new town, which started to take shape. Very soon they had a sandcastle, rocks, flip flops to relax on, a spade for excavation, an umbrella for shelter and many holes and tunnels to hide in. The crabs were happy with their new town, and the soldier crabs stood guard, keeping them safe. Post-Reading Questions What did mother and baby crab look for on the beach? How did baby crab help with the building of their new home? Re-read. Ask: What did baby crab want to help out with? Re-read. Ask: What did mother crab see? Re-read. Ask: ﻿Why were the other crabs so happy? ﻿If you could live anywhere, where would it be?
author: Hello English

title: Steven Gets Sick
text: Story Description Three children see their mother return from the market with a fruit basket. Steven, the eldest sibling, stuffs his face with fruit and regrets it soon afterwards. Pre-Reading Vocabulary and Phonics Scrumptious sc-rum-sh-uss The fruit basket looked scrumptious. Pleasantly pl-ez-unt-lee Mother was relaxing pleasantly, enjoying her knitting. Quivering kw-iv-er-ing Steven felt so ill he was quivering all over. Stomach st-um-uck He felt sick in his stomach. Steven, Roberta and Donny the youngest, were three kids who lived in a lovely house. When school was out, the three would regularly be together playing and having fun during their holidays. Their mother would often visit the market to pick up fresh fruits and vegetables and bring them home. "Look, she's got an entire basket," said Donny. "They look delicious," said Roberta. "No doubt she won't allow us to eat any yet." "I'm not sure," said Steven. "Perhaps taking a pear or an apple won't do any harm. Or a pineapple. Just look at those bananas, they're so ripe!" "Calm down, Steven," said Roberta. "You know how you like to eat." "Yeah, remember my chocolate that you ate?" said Donny. "Of course I don't remember it," said Steven. "It's gone now." Roberta and Donny went off to play, but Steven stayed. He felt so hungry and couldn't resist taking a banana and a pear. He knew what he was doing was wrong. "I don't care," said Steven. "These are so scrumptious." Steven couldn't control his hunger. Later Donny and Roberta came back to see that someone had eaten and half-eaten most of the fruit. "Who did this?" said Donny. "Steven!" said Roberta. "Let's get him in trouble. You tell Mum." "We're telling on you," said Donny. "What you did was greedy and wrong. How could you?" "Relax," said Steven. "I didn't eat any of the fruit that you two enjoy. Besides, I can go to the market and buy fresh ones. Mum will never notice." Donny went to find his mother who was happy and sitting pleasantly doing her knitting. "Mum, Steven ate all of the fruit that you bought from the market," said Donny. "I don't have time for jokes right now," said his mother. "Go back and play and leave me in peace." "But I'm telling the truth!" said Donny. "I'm sure you are," said his mother. The way that Donny insisted he was being honest sparked something in his mother's mind. She wondered that perhaps it wasn't a joke. She inspected the fruit basket and found that Donny had been telling the truth. "What do you have to say for yourself?" said his mother. "I'm sorry for being greedy," said Steven. "I'll replace all of the fruit that I ate." "You can go and spend your pocket money on a new basket!" said his mother. "Do you think I'll forgive you that easily? You're always greedy and snacking." Steven came back later. "I don't feel so good," he said. "My stomach is cramping. Do we have any medicine?" "I'm not surprised," said his mother. "You've eaten too much fruit." Steven felt himself shivering and his stomach cramping heavily. He could barely stand up because he was quivering so hard. He lost his balance and wobbled around the room. "Oh, I feel sick!" Steven blurted. He was moments away from the toilet when he vomited all over the floor. He didn't even make it to the bathroom. To make matters worse, he was sick all over Roberta's favourite doll. "How are you feeling now?" the family said to him. "Better, now my stomach is empty. I'm really sorry for what I did. I'll replace the fruit and not be greedy again. And Roberta, I'm sorry about your doll. It smells really bad." "That's ok, dummy," said Roberta. Their mother washed dolly and put her on the clothes line to dry. Steven went to the market where he brought a lot more fruit for the whole family. And Donny and Roberta helped themselves to however much fruit they wanted, while Steven nursed his poor stomach, thinking twice about being greedy again. Post-Reading Questions How did Steven justify eating the entire fruit basket? How did mother find out about Steven eating all of the fruit? Re-read pages 7-8. Ask: How did Steven defend his actions? Re-read. Ask: What toy was Steven sick all over? Re-read. Ask: How much fruit were Donny and Roberta allowed to eat? Why must you not be greedy?
author: Hello English

title: Berry the Special Bug
text: My name is Berry. No one likes me and everyone says that I am ugly. I am on an adventure to see who thinks that I am not so ugly after all! I went to a ladybird. She said that I look very ugly and that I am always so blue! She said that she didn't want to be my friend becasue I did not look special! But I will never give up on finding people who appreciate me the way I am. I asked some bees what they thought about me, and they said that I was very ugly! They didn't want to be my friend because I looked weird to them! But I will never give up on finding people who appreciate me for who I am. I met with a grasshopper and asked him if I looked handsome to him. He said that I was ugly! He told me that my teeth were too big and my face was too small! I met with some beautiful butterflies! I asked them if I looked handsome to them. They told me that I looked super ugly and that my wings were too small for me! No one thought that I was handsome! I searched for someone the whole day! I realised after crying for so long, that I did find someone who thought I was handsome. It was me! I think that I am handsome, even if others don't. I can glow in the dark! Not many animals can do that! That is what makes me handsome and awesome! I love myself for that.
author: Repostly Admin

title: King the Puffer Fish
text: My name is King. I want to swim in the big ocean but I am stuck in this small pond! I will never give up on my dream! I will always try my best to find a way out of here! The other animals nearby heard my dream of swimming to the big ocean! They all laughed at me because they said that I was too small to live there! I did not listen to what they said. If I can be strong enough then I can push against the flow. But it is too strong! Everyone is laughing at me for trying to go to the ocean, but I do not listen to them. I have planned so many escapes but failed so many times! I tried and tried but it was very difficult to jump out of the pond! There is always a way to find a solution. I puffed up really big and I became like a huge balloon! Then I was ready to escape and get out of there. The water couldn't push me around! The other animals laughed at me because I was very big! They laughed and teased me but I knew that I would never give up on my dream. One big push and I was free from the pond! I got what I wanted! Never give up on your dream, despite what others say.
author: Repostly Admin

title: Fixing the Skeleton
text: Story Description Anita and Tammy are sisters who go to see the doctor. While waiting for the doctor, they get into a fight and knock over a model skeleton, which they have to fix before the doctor returns. Pre-Reading Vocabulary and Phonics Skeleton sk-el-e-tun The girls accidentally knocked over the skeleton. Irritating I-ri-tay-ting Tammy was being irritating and annoying to Anita. Lopsided lop-sy-did The skull was lopsided, hanging to one side. Complicated com-ple-cay-tid The skeleton was too complicated to put back together. Anita and Tammy went to see the doctor, and while they were waiting, they got into a fight. "I'm so bored," said Tammy. "Let me play with your hair!" "Ouch!" snapped Anita. "Quit doing that! Get off!" "You two, that's enough fighting!" said the doctor. As they were colouring, Tammy knocked over Anita's crayons. Anita poked Tammy in the ear for being annoying, and the two began shoving each other. Tammy put a wet finger in Anita's ear, which really annoyed her. Suddenly Anita got up and pushed Tammy really hard against the skeleton display. They both fell. The skeleton struck the ground and detached off the stand, breaking into several pieces. The shock of what happened caused a big silence. "Look what you've done!" said Anita. "You've broken the skeleton. You are in deep trouble now." "I'm not, Anita!" said Tammy. "You're the one who pushed me into it! I'm going to tell them it was you. Then you'll be the one who gets in trouble!" The skeleton was scattered across the floor. "Perhaps we should work together," said Anita. "Why would I work with you? You're irritating!" said Tammy. "Because if we fix the skeleton before the doctor notices, then we'll get away with this. So we work as a team to put it back together." "Oof!" said Tammy. "The stand is so heavy to carry." "Here, let me help you," said Anita, taking the stand and placing it upright. "You take what you can carry." "Let's separate things into groups," said Anita. "You put the legs together. I'll put the arms together. We've done the mid-section. We know where arms and legs go." "Yes, but which piece fits into which joint?" said Tammy. "It's complicated." "Is that really how an elbow flexes?" said Anita. "Eww, that's gross!" "Let's fix the pelvis to the stand," said Anita, and Tammy helped her. "There. That was easy. Now we have to fix the limbs." "It's strange having a spinal cord that long," said Tammy. "Look at the bottom. It's like a little tail coming out. That means I have a tail that can come out of my back!" "Now for the simple part," said Anita. "What's this?" "The skull," said Tammy. "Correct. What's this?" "The wishbone," said Tammy. "No, that's the collar bone," said Anita. Anita and Tammy sorted out the legs and arms and twisted them into place on the stand. The doctor was about to enter the room, so they worked with great focus and attention, trying to make sure they were not caught. "And the final piece," said Anita, placing the skull on the top of the stand, as Tammy kept the chair steady and kept watch for the doctor underneath. "Hurry up! I can hear her coming!" said Tammy. "All right! Don't rush me!" snapped Anita, reaching to balance the skull in place. "Oh no, I've put one of the leg bones on the wrong way round!" said Tammy. "Don't worry, I don't think the doctor can tell," said Anita. Anita got off the chair and hugged Tammy, thinking fast as the doctor entered the room. "Well, it's lovely to see you two getting along again," said the doctor, and Anita and Tammy laughed nervously. "I'm ready to see you both now." The doctor saw the skull hanging lopsided on the skeleton, and she gave the two girls a suspicious look. Their mother came to collect them from the doctor, and took them out for ice-cream. "I hope you were well behaved," she said to them. "Yes," said Anita. "We work great together as a team." "Doing what?" "Colouring, obviously," said Tammy. "But I still think that leg bone was on upside down." Anita told her to be quiet as they ate their ice-cream. Post-Reading Questions What caused the skeleton to get knocked over and fall apart? Why did Anita and Tammy hurry to put the skeleton back together? Re-read. Ask: What did Anita suggest that they do? Re-read. Ask: What mistake did Tammy make while putting on the leg bone? Re-read. Ask: What made the doctor feel suspicious? Do you think Anita and Tammy's mother knew what had happened?

title: Jackal, Rabbit and Tortoise
text: Story Description A tortoise gets lost on its way home. A jackal and a hare kindly help the tortoise find its way back to the nearby stream. Pre-Reading Vocabulary and Phonics Stealthily ﻿st-el-th-ill-ee ﻿The jackal moved stealthily across the land to avoid being seen. Warren ﻿woh-run ﻿The rabbit dived and hid inside its warren. Habitat ﻿ha-bih-tat ﻿The lake was the tortoise's natural habitat and home. Journey ﻿jut-nee ﻿ ﻿At the end of their journey, the three animals found the lake. There was once a jackal roaming the giant open range of its home. There were trees and mountains dotted around, but there was nowhere for the jackal to drink. Thirsty and desperate for water, the jackal trundled along, wondering if he would ever find a lake or a river. He had been walking for too long and his energy levels were low. A short while later, the jackal saw a tortoise moving very slowly and stealthily, and a rabbit hopping in a high mood. There were deers around eating the grass and staying in groups. "What are you doing out here?" the jackal said to the tortoise and the rabbit. "Going to the lake," said the tortoise. "We're thirsty and looking for water," said the rabbit. "I thought this place was covered with lakes," said the jackal. "It is, but I take a long time to get from one place to the next," said the tortoise. "For you the same journey may only take a day. For me it takes an entire season." "I rarely go out of my warren because of the predators," said the rabbit. "I do remember a lake not far from here," said the tortoise. "Then if you give me directions, I can carry you there," said the jackal. "The journey will be much faster. What is that rabbit doing?" "I thought I saw carrots growing," said the rabbit, digging the soil and finding only a rock. "What is this lake like?" said the jackal. "Oh, it's wonderful," said the tortoise. "It has elephants and crocodiles and deer, and lots of other predators that would eat me. I'm sure you would be fine, being a jackal. You can scare off some of them. But the rabbit will get stepped on by the elephant, and so will I." "This lake sounds terrible," said the jackal. "We'll find a more suitable one and I'll carry you." "I'll use my nose to sniff out predators," said the rabbit. "Predators to me are different," said the jackal. "I am not frightened of cats. In fact, I scare them off with my bark." There it was - a new lake, another afternoon's travel away. They had made it. The rabbit leapt for joy but landed in the water, and the tortoise returned to his natural habitat. The jackal drank a lot of water, enough for an entire day, and the three celebrated finding their new home. The jackal knew that company on the road had helped him to survive. Post-Reading Questions What creatures did the jackal find on his way to the lake? When they found a lake, what was bad about it? Re-read. Ask: How does the jackal help the tortoise get to the lake? Re-read. Ask: Why was living by the lake too dangerous for the rabbit? Re-read. Ask: ﻿What had helped the jackal to survive? ﻿Why is it important to make friends with others?
author: Hello English

title: Pollution in the Sea
text: Story Description An educative short story about pollution affecting sea life, and the importance of not dumping litter in the sea. Pre-Reading Vocabulary and Phonics Dumping dum-ping People are dumping their litter in the sea. Interfering in-tur-f-ear-ing ﻿The trash is interfering with the local habitats. Current cur-ant ﻿The trash flows and spreads through the sea current. Conscious con-sh-uss ﻿To respect sea life is to be conscious of not dumping trash in the sea. Thousands of species live in the ocean. The actions of people have affected their habitats. One way people do this is by dumping trash and litter into the sea. These materials do not degrade or break down, so they stay around, meaning fish and other wildlife get tangled or trapped in them. The fish bashed its head against an empty coconut husk, which instead of being thrown into a litter bag, was carelessly thrown into the sea. Luckily the fish wasn't hurt. It could have been worse. Maybe the fish could've been trapped inside the coconut! The fish have to face the current each day, and due to the direction and force of the current, trash can spread out over a wide area, interfering with the fish's habitat. Empty chip and chocolate bar wrappers, bottled drinks and other plastics are just a few things that fish have to look out for. Thankfully some locals are conscious of protecting the seas and being kind to the fish. These fish look distressed, and the man can tell that they have seen some litter. The man and his buddies can find and remove it from the sea. The man scolds his friend about throwing things away in the ocean, and the friend apologises. The matter is not understood by a lot of people, because their main focus is on problems that exist on the land. This way, the fish are ignored, and we do not protect our seas well enough. Fish cannot communicate verbally, so we assume they are fine. But when dead fish wash up wrapped in plastic, we have to ask questions about how we treat the ocean. With care, or carelessness? These fish swim around a healthy reef, carried by the current. If fish could use their fins like people use their hands and arms, they could clear the trash themselves. These fish find books inside the reef which they take away and place on the beaches, so the people can clear up their own trash. This man finds the location of the trash and starts emptying the sea of clutter, as the fish look on and say thank you. This man cares about the sea. He understands from the fish's point of view because he swims at the beach. Sometimes a plastic bag will wrap itself around his leg when he swims! Gross! Always be conscious about litter, and never throw anything into the sea. A couple of men have spotted the coconut husk and will arrive to remove it, but the damage is already done. The fish hit its head on the husk. It'll be ok this time, but remember, don't throw things into the sea. Post-Reading Questions What happens if we dump trash in the sea? Explain why plastic is particularly dangerous to sea life? Re-read. Ask: How does the trash spread across the sea? Re-read. Ask: What does the man do to his friend and why? Re-read. Ask: ﻿How does the man understand from the fish's point of view? ﻿Why must we take care of the environment?

title: My Special Blankie

title: How I Like My Rain
text: Then is how I like my rain When water tells insistent tales When the world comes to a stop And it’s tough for you to talk Then is how I like my rain When the world comes to a stop When water tells insistent tales And it's tough for you to talk When strings of silver streaming down Sting my skin so slight When all day long the frogs go on And take no heed of night When yam is wild and everywhere And here and there the lilies stare When water runs and kisses seeds And the earth belongs to millipedes When fungus rules and mould is bold And the paddy's high, loaded with grain Then is how I like my rain!
author: Salil  Chaturvedi

title: Look around You
text: Squirrels in my garden, Sparrows on my roof, Cat dozing on my steps, A wag of the tail, a woof! Peeping through the window A crow that wants a bite; Tabby on a languid stroll, Dogs who love a fight. Lovely, majestic pigeons Soft and timid and slow, Fly up, flutter the wings And put up quite a show. Trying to cross busy roads Cows with liquid eyes; Goats so gentle and ‘stupid’ Looking on with patient sighs. From the myna, magpie-robins To the horses’ haggard existence, The city would be a jungle But for their graceful presence.
author: Kamalika Mitra
illustrator: Jayesh Sivan; Preeti Krishnamurthy; Priyanka Agarwal; Sandra   McDougall; Sarthak Sinha; Wiehan de Jager

title: With a Little Help from Ma
text: Mithi is in a new class. Sometimes, she feels a little afraid. There are so many girls and boys. So many things to learn. Most times, Mithi keeps quiet. She will make friends, but slowly. She will learn everything. Slowly. One day, Mithi comes home crying. “What is the matter?” asks Ma. “There is a big boy in my class,” says Mithi. “I am very scared of him.” “Why?” asks Ma. “He says he will not let me come home!” cries Mithi. “He cannot stop you from coming home or going anywhere!” says Ma. “But he is a big boy,” says Mithi. “Bigger than me. What if he locks me up in school? How will I come home?” “Listen to me, Mithi,” says Ma. “The next time he tries to scare you, don’t be scared. If he says he won’t let you go home, you tell him that you won’t let him go home either.” How will that help me, thinks Mithi. He is such a big boy. How can I ever stop him or scare him? The next day, the big boy gets hold of Mithi again. Mithi is very scared. “I won’t let you go home,” says the big boy. Mithi is scared, but she remembers what Ma said. She tries very hard to be brave. She looks at the big boy. And she says, “I won’t let you go home either.” As soon as she says this, an amazing thing happens. The big boy stops trying to scare Mithi. He goes away without another word. He does not try to scare Mithi again. Mithi is so surprised and so happy. How did Ma know how to stop the scary boy? A bully is someone who tries to scare or hurt others by acting big and strong. In truth, bullies are great cowards. If someone tries to scare you in the class or the playground or anywhere else, tell your parents and teachers about it. They will help you. Do not feel alone.
author: Kamalika Mitra
illustrator: Anastasiya Ivanova; Aphisith Souphavongtay; Jeyanthi Manokaran; Karen  Vermeulen; Krishna Chandran; Nguyễn  Minh Hải; Ntembiso  Velemane; Ouk  Ratha; Preeti Krishnamurthy; Rupa Prakash; Suvidha Mistry; Tanvi Bhat

title: Rage the Tiger

title: Hunter the Bat

text: My name is Greedy the caterpillar, and I want more than what I have! I want a lot of everything and I will never be happy if I do not have a lot. title: Fear of the Ocean
text: My name is Ziggy, I am very afraid of the ocean and the sea animals that live there! My mother told me to be brave and face my fear of the ocean! I was going to do it! I want to face my fears and show myself that I am brave! So I slowly went deeper into the ocean, the water kept on rising and rising from my knees to my waist to my chest and to my neck! I was scared but I kept on telling myself to never give up and to face my fear of the ocean and to be brave! I could see so much beautiful things the more I went deeper in to the ocean, the animals below me were very cute! and the corals below were as beautiful as a flower! I slowly could not feel the floor anymore but I wanted to go deeper to see whats down there! I went all the way down to the bottom with no fear but excitement in my heart! I saw many beautiful fish and the corals were amazing! The life of being a fish is amazing as they can just swim around in such a beautiful place! I swam with so many fish and they became my friends as all of them came to smell me if I was dangerous but they all loved me! I looked at the shark and then the shark was going to bite me but then... I got saved by these Bottle-nose Dolphins! They rescued me from the scary shark and they were swimming me to safety, I swam with fish and saved from a shark! What a day! I have learnt to face your fears and be brave by standing up to what you are afraid of and doing it! You will be free and enjoy that you have faced your fears just like me!

title: Oliver the Otter
text: My name is Oliver, and I have three brothers! I don't listen to my mother when she tells me something, and I don't want to obey her! I want to have my own adventure see the ocean myself! One day, when everyone was sleeping, I sneaked away from my home and went into the ocean! Now I am free to see the ocean myself! Nothing bad will happen to me! I chased and ate so many fish! I was so happy that I did not listen to my mother. Now I don't need to share the food with anyone! I love this adventure and I will never listen to my mother again! I swam away too far from home! There was a hungry crocodile waiting for food! I was very afraid! Usually mother will always scare the crocodile away but I don't think I can! I was so scared I started crying! I should have listened to my mother! I saw a scary trap! Usually mother will destroy it but I am to small to destroy such a big trap. I was very scared of the world outside! I should have listened to my mother when she told me to not leave her yet! I came back home and mother was very sad and she cried a lot. I was not there when she woke up! She had been looking for me for hours! She hugged me and kissed me and told me to eat some fish to calm down! I love my mother! Mother told us why it is important to listen to her! title: The Brave Bunny
text: My name is Brave and I am a bunny living with my brother Dan! Many wolves like to destroy our house, but this time I have a plan to stand up to them. We made our home stronger so the wolves could not enter and destroy our things! Even if I fail, I will always try my best and never give up! They were able to steal our stuff again! The house was not strong enough to keep them out! We ran up to the roof to hide! When the wolves came back a week later, we hid behind the door with a brave plan! We waited until the greedy wolf was in position to get hit! We were very brave and we never gave up even if we failed! We were going to throw some hot water at the wolf, just when he wasn't looking. The wolf was so scared he ran as fast as the wind! He was so afraid of us that he told his friends that we were too dangerous. We were so happy for being brave! We showed the wolves that we aren't afraid! I have learned to be brave and to never give up when there are problems.
author: Repostly Admin

title: Rusky the Rabbit
text: My name is Rusky and I am very smart! I can solve lots of math questions and I am very hardworking! But inside I am really sad. Many of my classmates make fun of me for being smart. They laugh at me every day, calling me names and bullying me! They want to make me feel very bad. Every morning I tell myself to forgive my classmates. I try not to think badly about myself but look to the future and be hopeful! I should not be sad anymore, but be strong and move on! I came up with a plan to show my classmates how to be hard working. I hoped they would realise that working well is a good thing. I learned how to teach people from Mr. Owl. He showed me how to present sums on the board. My classmates became smarter and all of them were so happy with me. They all said sorry for the bullying and they all became my friends! The most important thing is to love yourself, even if others don't. You are special in your own way!
author: Repostly Admin

title: A Bright Future: Amber's Dream
text: My name is Amber. My dream is to make dinosaur statues for the museum! It is very hard to make dinosaurs because they are so big, but I never give up! Dinosaurs have long tails, some have fur, and some have spots! They have strong and powerful feet with long claws on their toes. They have small arms with large body and a long neck. They have teeth as sharp as swords. I have to start by looking at the inside of the dinosaur. I have to find out where all his bones are. it is very difficult to create a replica of a dinosaur. Usually, dinosaur bones are underground and they are not always joined together. I have to dig out the bones, match and clean them, put them together and make sure they match. It is so difficult to do! If I could have seen the dinosaur age, then I would know what they looked like. But I have to guess. I won't give up! The last step is to use large machines that need to carry heavy bones from the ground. This is dangerous because the machines can damage the bones by squeezing them. This is the only way! Time to make my dream real! I have learned to never give up, no matter how hard the task or problem is.
author: Repostly Admin

title: Hilda and the Scarecrow
text: My name is Hilda. My best friend is Ogi the scarecrow! Ogi always scares away animals. Ogi and I are best friends and even if we fight a lot, I always forgive Ogi no matter how annoying he is. I always tell him that I forgive him. One day there were birds stealing from our farm. They took grains and vegetables from us! Ogi was very mad and he wanted to scare all of them away. All of them flew away! But I told Ogi that the birds need to eat too, and they are not stealing! Ogi felt very sad that he did not listen to me. The birds decided to attack us and steal from us! I needed Ogi to help. The birds behaved badly and he was the only one who could save us. Ogi roared as loud as a lion! All the birds flew away, never wanting to come back again! I said sorry to Ogi for getting mad at him. He forgave me and even if I was so mean to him. I have learned to always care for those closest to me, because they will be there one day, just when I need them the most.
author: Repostly Admin

title: My Parents
text: I love my parents so much! Our parents have been there feeding us and playing with us when no one else would! Our parents taught us to cook even when a bat fell in our soup! This is the story of where a bat suddenly came to our house, it fell in our soup, and it was set free. Our parents are there when no one else is. This is the story where everyone didn't like the little goat on his first day of school! Our parents are there giving us gifts that we want. They want to see that smile and happiness in our eyes. This is thee story of Athena and Marina, the friends for life! Even through fighting, they just want us to be safe and want us to not get into trouble. This is the story of where Jet protects Red the dog from all the mean and trouble Red causes, and where Jet stands up for Red, even from his mother! Our parents want us to be safe and listen to them becasue they know what is right for us. This is the story of where the little girl doesn't listen to her mom and goes off on an adventure! Our parents want us to grow into kind people who will take care of others.
author: Repostly Admin

title: Having a Brave Heart
text: Being brave is more than just doing something scary. It's looking out for others and standing up for what is right. This is the story of when the brave boy stood up to the bullies, who were bullying his lion friend. To be brave you have to go and face your fears. This is the story about a girl who decides to be brave and to stop being afraid of the ocean! To be brave you have to look out for others! You have to go through problems and save people that are hurt or in pain! This is the story of the firemen who rescued people trapped inside a burning school. To be brave you have to stop evil. This is the story of the boy who was brave enough to protect his friends. To be brave you have to not be afraid of challenges or problems that come your way! This is the story of Mora and Kelly, the two brave sisters who went on an adventure to stop the Drowsy Dragon! Bravery is when you stand up for what is right. Luther the bird was set free because of his brave heart, to fight for what was right!

title: A Bright Future: Austin's Dream
text: My name is Austin and I love studying hard. My dream is to go to a very nice school but it is hard! I will never give in and I will not lose hope for my dream! I wrote a letter to the school many times! They never said anything back to me! But I will never give up on trying to get into that nice school! After many weeks of sending letters to the school, they finally sent me a reply! I was so happy that they finally sent me something! I never gave up and I never lost hope, that's why I got what I wanted! I got accepted to the school! They were very happy with me and how hopeful I was! I hugged my mom and told her that because I did not give up on my dream, and I always looked forward and was hopeful, I was accepted by the school! She was very proud of me and happy that I never gave up! Mother made a party for me to celebrate. All my friends came and told me that they were very happy and proud of me. Mother is dropping me off at my new school!
author: Repostly Admin

title: Boast
text: My name is Boast. I love pretending to be caring towards others and pretending to look out for people! I get so many rewards for pretending to be kind! I pretend to love the environment and the animals. The animals think that I am their friend! Now I can use the animals to protect me from bullies! I love pretending to look after the elderly! That is why I have so much money! They always like to give me money and candy for being very kind. But actually I am just very good at pretending! I am better than everyone else! I am the best person in the world! I always do these many things because I think everyone should bow down to me. Mother found out and told me that I should not say that to anyone. She said I should really care for the people and not expect them to do things for me. I said sorry to everyone forlying to them and they all forgave me! I know now that I should no be so proud but tell myself to be humble. I have learned to not be proud or think that I am better than other people.
author: Repostly Admin

title: Clover the Loving Mother
text: My name is Clover. I am a mother hen! I love my children and I want to protect them from danger. I just hope my little chickens will be brave people like their mother! I hope they love me! I always protect my eggs from those who want to take them away from me. This pig wants to take away my eggs so I tell him to go away. I protect my kids from those who want to hurt them. I hope my kids love me. When my kids are sleeping and someone is noisy, I always tell them to keep quiet. I don't want anyone to ruin their sleep. I feel they want to hatch out of their eggs now! I run as fast as the wind to get food for them to eat. All of the eggs move. "Chic! Chic! Chic! Chic!" go the eggs! Their eggs all crack and they start bursting out of their shells! All of them scream that they love me! I feel so happy that after everything, protecting them, making sure they have enough to eat, that they love me. I brought them to the park on such a beautiful day! We are a loving family.
author: Repostly Admin

title: Earth
text: My name is Earth. I have over 7 billion people on me! But becasue of the people on me, I am getting sick every day. I wish the people could take care of me better. I wrote a letter on all the falling leaves from the trees, to tell the people that I am very sick. I told the people to recycle and stop using so much plastic, because it's hurting me. When the people of the world got my message, they all worked together to take care of me! Everyone started throwing their rubbish in the rubbish bins instead of on the floor! Many factories that create black smoke closed down. By working together, the streets were cleaner than ever. The air was fresher and the ocean was clean. Some countries and their people still like to throw rubbish on the floor. Many still do not take care of the environment! Not everyone wants to look after me. I am still very sick, but at least I feel much better now. I will never be fully healed and back on my feet, if many more people do not take care of me! I have learned that you have to protect the environment and take care of our earth from pollution! Ask your teacher what you can do to protect the earth.
author: Repostly Admin

title: Billy's Hearing Aid
text: Story Description Billy has trouble hearing properly, until his grandmother lets him borrow her hearing aid. Suddenly, Billy can hear sounds that he has not heard before! Pre-Reading Vocabulary and Phonics Conversation con-vur-say-sh-un Billy had trouble hearing the conversation. Microphone my-crow-phone Inside the hearing aid was a microphone to pick up sound. Chirping ch-ur-ping Billy heard the birds making a chirping noise. Troughing tro-f-ing Billy heard himself troughing his food. Billy, in the yellow t-shirt, had problems hearing the teacher when she asked questions. It took Billy a while to grasp what was being said, and so he always missed out when the teacher asked questions. Other students were faster in their responses, so they could answer before Billy understood the question. Tammy, Billy's friend, made sounds to help Billy understand, but Billy could not hear her properly. This was very stressful for Billy, because he found it difficult to hold conversations with his friends. "This is my hearing aid," said Billy's grandmother. "We are going to take you to the doctor to get your hearing tested, but before that, you can borrow this to see if hearing is easier for you." "How does it work?" said Billy. "We place this over your ear," said Billy's grandmother. "And inside the canal. The little microphone picks up sound and makes it louder, then sends it through a speaker to your ear drum, so you can hear better." The first day Billy wore the hearing aid, he found it difficult to adjust to the new sound. Suddenly he could not only hear so well, but he literally picked up everything in his ear, from minor movements to major sounds. He heard the ball being caught when he was playing with Tammy. He heard himself running. He heard himself leap and catch the ball, and he could hear his own voice fully. He laughed at how funny he sounded. Billy's mother asked him maths questions, and when he answered correctly, she clapped her hands. "Wow!" said Billy. "I can hear you. I've never heard you clapping before." At school Billy ate his lunch with Tammy, and when he bit into the bread, he could hear himself chewing. Billy was so surprised to hear the chewing that he fell into laughter, and Tammy cackled with him. "Not only can I enjoy my lunch," he said, "but I can hear myself troughing and munching on my food too!" "Eat quietly!" said Tammy. Things were much better for Billy. Not only could he play catch and hear all of his friends speaking, but there were other sounds. He heard something coming from the trees. "What is that noise?" said Billy. "You mean the chirping?" said Tammy. "Look, it's the bird making that noise." "This is what birds sound like?" said Billy. "This one makes a chirp chirp noise. It keeps repeating the sound to call for other birds." "That's amazing," said Billy. Billy took Tammy to the fields and they found something strange happening. There were holes in the ground. There were some workmen. It looked like they were laying new pipes. Billy heard a large banging sound and he took Tammy towards it. "Be careful, Billy!" said Tammy. "Whoa!" said Billy, jumping over a huge gap, taking Tammy with him. They found an annoyed worker waving a wrench at them. "Some sounds are dangerous, so we should avoid them," said Tammy. Tammy drew pictures of animals and machines on the board at school, and Billy had to guess what sound each creature and machine made. He was getting used to the new sounds he was hearing, and soon he went to the doctor for his own hearing aid. The doctor discovered a build up of ear wax which was making Billy deaf. When the doctor cleaned out the ear wax, Billy could hear fine, and he didn't need a hearing aid. Post-Reading Questions How did the hearing aid help Billy hear sound again? What did the doctor find that was stopping Billy from hearing well? Re-read pages 8-9. Ask: What could Billy hear so well? Re-read. Ask: Why was Billy laughing while eating? Re-read. Ask: ﻿What did Billy do that was dangerous? ﻿What happens if our hearing is poor?
author: Hello English

title: Video Games
text: My name is Aldo and I love playing my new video games. I play from morning until night and when I come back from work! I don't have any time to spend with my family. The newest games are in virtual reality. Aldo wears glasses that take him to another world. "I love this world in my game," he says. "I just wish I had more time to play it! I don't want to spend time with anyone except my game." My kids are very sad! They want to spend time with me or at least talk to me. But I am too busy playing my games! They wish they could spend time with me and play with me but I'd rather play alone! My wife gets very angry at me for always just coming back home and playing my games. I have realised that my family is more important. I should spend more time with them. I decided to not play with my video games for so long anymore! I decided to spend time with my kids and my family! They are more important than playing video games! They are more real than my games can ever be! I decided to show my games to my kids and spend time with them while playing the games! They loved my games as much as me! We have great times going on adventures in new worlds. I have learned to open up your eyes and realise what is most important in life. To me, my family is what I love the most!
author: Repostly Admin

title: Sally the Squirrel
text: My name is Sally, and I never lose hope! I don't worry about many things! I want to always have faith that everything will be fine! One day, I woke up suddenly because I felt something bite my tail! I felt very weird and my tail started feeling very painful! I was very worried. My tail started losing fur! I was starting to cry and freak out! I was very afraid, I didn't know what was happening. I tried my best to not worry but have faith! When I reached the bottom of the tree, the fur on my tail all fell off! I was very thirsty too! I started getting scared and started crying! But I still tried my best to not worry and just go to the doctor! I ran as fast as the wind! I was very scared! I lost all faith and all my hope! I was so scared by what was happening to me. I arrived the hospital, and the doctor told me that my fur was falling off because of hot weather. He told me there wasn't a problem and that I would be fine. I have learned to take action in times of trouble, and see someone who understands. I have learned to place faith in those who can help. You don't need to worry.
author: Repostly Admin

title: Ana the Big Saver
text: My name is Ana and I never give up on saving my money. I always want to save my money, but I want to buy so many things too. I control myself and never give up on saving my money. I work a lot around the house so I can earn so much money. I want to save enough so that I have what I want. I am always sad because most of the time I spend the cash that I earn. I can never save it up because I want to buy toys. I should never give up on my saving! I have saved so much money already! I love to see the amount of coins I have in my cups. It makes a jingling noise! I want to save as I get older and not buy toys and clothes with it. I want to save for a good education. My aunt gave me some money to help with my savings. I will continue to save throughout my life and not waste money. Finally, after years I saved enough to put myself through university, giving me a great career and a wonderful family. I have learned to stay disciplined.

title: Jelly and Jazz
text: My name is Jelly and this is my brother Jazz. We fight a lot about many things but we always forgive each other! We always say sorry to one another whenever we make a mistake or do something wrong. We were heading to the beach and I told him that if we fight, then we will not go to the beach anymore! We don't want to fight anymore and we always forgive each other! My brother is always so annoying! He annoys me when I do my homework. This is one of the reasons why I always want to get mad at him! My little brother always gets us in trouble! I always tell him to be kind to other people and not be mean to anyone! He always disturbs others. He also gets mad at me because I do not let him play with my friends. That's because he is so bad! He always gets sad and angry at me when I don't let him play. We forgive each other every single day, even though we fight. We have learned that we should always forgive one another becasue we love each other. We are the best of friends! We must always forgive one another no matter what we do.

title: Kris the Crab
text: My name is Kris and that is my mother! I always listen to her when she tells me to do something! I always obey her when she asks me to do something! She told me to never leave her side otherwise something bad might happen! I was too excited that I could finally go outside! But my mother lost track of me and she lost me in the crowd! I ran off to see the world and everything in it! I saw so many beautiful things like this yellow crab! I was so amazed by the colors of the world! Everything is so colorful! This crab looks so cool as well! Instead of running away, I stopped and looked for my mom instead of going on an adventure without her permission, I decided to have an adventure with her! I will obey my mother and listen to her so I will find her! The yellow crab saw that I am a very kind person and I listen to my parents, he waved at me and gave me a toy becasue of how good I am! He told me that I was a really good boy for listening and obeying my mother! My mother and I had a great time together! I listened to her instead of running away and having my own adventure! I listened and we went on adventures together! We saw so many beautiful things and seen many interesting people! I was so happy I listened to my mom and nothing bad happened! I have learnt to listen to your parents and obey them when they tell you to do something just like me when I listened to my mother, nothing bad happened and I had a great time!
author: Repostly Admin

title: Manda's Blood Donation Day
text: My name is Manda, and I am afraid of the blood donation day tomorrow. But I will try my best to be brave and not be afraid of anything! I was very afraid though and could not sleep that night! I had a dream that the doctor would be as scary as a ghost! I was afraid for awhile in my dream but I became brave and stopped worrying. I woke up scared! I was very afraid of getting an injection! But I told myself that it was just a dream. I became very brave and decided to be calm and not worry anymore! I ate strawberries to show my mom I was very calm and brave! She was very happy that she saw how brave I am! I got a bit scared again because of my dream! The needle hurt so much. I fought through the pain and remained calm and kept a strong heart and mind! My mother was so happy with how calm I was and how I was very brave.
author: Repostly Admin

title: Different Friends Come In Different Sizes
text: Long ago, men and women didn't often do work. Dogs did. People argued about who did the work. Very few argued about them doing the work. Most dogs were trained to do work and they didn't mind it. Not all though. One dog was afraid of people and did not want to be hurt from it. This dogs name was Ben. Ben was lonely and people called him "weekling, soft, not wanted" and even more. He wanted a friend, someone to play with. One day Ben was wandering instead of working when he saw a cat being cared for. He wanted her, as a friend. The cat's name is Jennie. He wanted to go meet Jennie while the owner is gone so he ran up to it but it ran away as quick as possible. He chased it around but it kept running. He didn't know what was wrong with him. Was he scary, ugly, or not like the other dogs? He wanted to know why it kept running. Ben chased Jennie around for almost all day, tired and upset. Ben wanted to be friends. Jennie never thought of it like that. She felt good because her friends warned her about dogs and not to trust them. But at the same time, she felt bad for making him run so much. Jennie ran to where Ben couldn't to have a snack from all that running. She found the two common mice around. Jeremy and Jack. Jennie found a place to rest. She knew she must be careful because just looking, Ben was searching all throughout the block. She felt very guilty and controlled by her so called "friends". She wanted to rest but she knew it was time to have a real friend. Jennie ran up to Ben and was ready to meet her new mate. She found Ben panting heavily by some food bowls. She introduced herself to him and explained that her friends told her not to trust dogs. He understood why and told her that he wasn't like other dogs. They ended up hanging out for the rest of the day. They told each other jokes and ran around chasing one another. They made a promise that they would never hate each other for anything that they would ever do to each other. At the end of the day, the both end up tired, exhausted, and friends. About The Author Leanna Luchico is currently 10 years old. She was born on July 22, 2008. This is her first story ever on story weaver. She loves sports. She loves volleyball, wrestling, and jiu jitsu. She has 3 siblings and she has 2 chickens, 1 chick,1 horse, 1 fish, and two dog. She hopes to make more stories for other people to read on.:)
author: Leanna Luchico

title: THE MISSING ANIMALS
text: Chapter 1 Missing It was 1983. That's when I was born. It was cold and dark. I cuddle in my mom's brown fur to produce body heat. I saw my brother who had black fur and was bigger than mom. I had blackish brown fur. I was tired and fell asleep. When it was morning, Mom and brother wasn't there. I wonder where they went. Did they went to go hunt for food? I tried standing up but it was hard. I heard a whine. "Get those dogs!" I heard someone yelled. I waited for mom and brother to come back but they never did. When it was dark, I was alone. I was tired and hungry. My stomach rumbled. I whined for help until someone came up to me. It was a fox. She had light orange fur like the dessert. She grabbed me from the mouth with her sharp teeth. Is she going to eat me? I thought. She took me to her barrel and fed me. I mad some friends who are also foxes but small like me. The foxes taught me how to walk. BOOM! Chapter 2 The Hunters We heard a LOUD explosion. All the foxes cried because they were scared but I didn't. I was too busy thinking what it was to be scared. The fox went out to check until I heard someone said "Kill the fox. We need to move all the animals to start a business here." a man said. After the man was done talking, I heard Fox whined. What happened to fox? The foxes whined more than they did before. I backed up to the end of the barrel with the foxes. I saw the man bending down and looked into the barrel we were in. He put his and in the barrel. Before he can grab us, I ran to his hand and bit one of his finger so he can go away but that made it worse. "Hey! That hurt!" The man said. "Whats wrong Greg?" the other man said. "I got bit by this crazy fox" Greg said. All the men gather around the barrel we were in. I tried to communicate with the foxes to dig so we can get out of here. But they didn't listen. They were too scared to do anything. I tried to show them to dig and to be honest with you they started digging. We got out and ran out of sight. I was still learning how to run but I ran really fast for the first time. It felt good to stretch my legs when running. The foxes were pretty fast until I notice only two of them was with me. The other two was gone. Where did they go. I saw the two foxes in the man's hand. He had a bat to hit them. I was too scared to go back so I took the two foxes with me and protected them from the people. I dug a hole behind the tree and cover it with some leave to camouflage with the forest ground and the trees. I learned how to hunt myself and fed the 2 foxes. I made a warm bed filled with dead leaves that might make the foxes warm. I kept wondering what happened to the fox and my mom and brother. There was so many to think of. When it was dark, I heard footsteps coming near our hole. It was a man. Why is he here? To kill us? It was a different man. He looked friendly but i was to scared to. move. He grabbed the two foxes and then me. I was about to bite him but my mouth didn't want to. He took us somewhere, somewhere where it was warm and cozy. "Sweetie look what I got," said the man. I saw a woman came out the door. "Oh My Goodness!" the woman said. "Lets take them 3 a warm bath" said the man. They took us to the bathroom and put us in the tub. I felt warm water touching my cold dry skin. After that we ate these things call sausages. It was so good. We went outside and I saw beautiful flowers and butterflies. I was named Bacon and the two foxes are name Sara and Kara. Kara and Sara and me went and play some games. When a month past, I had 3 new born babies and the foxes had 2 newborn babies. We lived a happy life. THE END
author: Jazzlynn Xiong
illustrator: Barkha Lohia; Brian Wambi; Candice  Botha; Preeti Krishnamurthy; Vinayak Varma

title: There's a Ghost!
text: A whooshing noise came as Jake stared at his bedroom ceiling. Then as Jake closed his eyes, an even louder whoosh came by. This time he was convinced there was a ghost! "Mommy, there's a ghost!" screamed Jake as he hid under his blanket. His mother arrived and asked what was wrong. "Mommy, a ghost is trying to talk to me!" said Jake. "Please don't leave me alone." Jake asked his mom to close the window to keep the ghost out. Jake's mom checked the window to see the ghost, but instead of being scared, she laughed. "Mom, why are you laughing?', asked Jake. "It was only the wind," she said. She tucked Jake into bed and told him not to worry anymore. As Jake was about to close his eyes, he heard something else, like a purring noise. Jake opened his eyes and screamed, "Mommy, there's a ghost!" His mom quickly ran to his bedroom again. "I heard it again," said Jake. This time his mom heard the purring sound. She checked under the bed and found their cat, Mimi, sleeping. "It was just the cat," said Jake's mom. She tucked Jake into bed once more and left. "Mommy!" shouted Jake. His mom went back into his room. "There's no ghost mommy, " said Jake. "I just wanted to say thank you for always being there for me." Jake's mom kissed his forehead and went back to her room, and Jake was finally able to sleep peacefully. THE END
author: Repostly Admin
illustrator: Adie Řezníčková; Adrija Ghosh; Gwendolene van der Merwe; Kavya  Bagga; Lutfia  Kamish; Sonali Zohra

title: Pishi Caught in a Storm
text: They were feasting on tonnes of fish, far from the coast of the Andaman and Nicobar Islands. How they had splashed and jumped out of the waters of the beautiful Indian Ocean! When he saw a ship ahead, Pishi had taken a huge dive in the water. His friends scattered. Pishi flapped his huge cloak-like fins and tried to swim to safety. There was a huge streak of lightning and a sound of thunder next. Pishi lost his bearings. The ocean had gone dark for him. A big wave rolled up, pushing him directly under the ship. Aaah, a cut on his belly! He knew what he had to do. He had to find his friends. But first, he needed his wound to be treated. He swam and glided as fast as he could towards the coast. Pishi’s heart beat fast. He wished he was not so big – 10 meters long, and weighing over 900 kilograms! He had to get to a hospital. Fast! His life depended on it. Then he saw the lighthouse on the coast. He leapt with joy! Pishi had reached the hospital, nature's hospital. A huge school of fish swam around him immediately. The same fish that he ate at other times were now his nurses. They cleaned the deep gash in his tummy. The ‘cleaner fish’ nibbled on the torn pieces of skin. Soon Pishi felt so much better. He loved the Indian Ocean with its 5,000 species of marine life! Dear Reader, The Indian Ocean is known as ‘Ratnakara’ in ancient Sanskrit literature. Ratnakara means the mine of jewels. Manta rays often visit cleaning stations. A cleaning station can be called nature’s hospital in the ocean. Here, small fish such as angelfish swim in the manta ray’s gills and over its skin. They are called cleaner fish because they clean the manta ray by eating up parasites and dead tissue. Even though manta rays are huge, they are quite gentle. They are hunted by many animals like big sharks, whales and humans. #6FrameStoryChallenge: A Carnival of Art
author: Adriana Baldibia-Bejar

title: Arthur the Delivery Boy
text: My name is Arthur, and I love helping my mother. I also never give up no matter how hard the problem is! We have to carry heavy things and I want my mother to rest, so I offer to help. This is the basket that I use to carry all the heavy things around my town! I have to deliver many things to people. It is a hard, tiring job but I will never give up because I love my mom so much. I started doing the job because my mom does a lot for me! On the first day, I was very tired! My arms couldn't move after just five deliveries! I was very tired but I told myself to never give up. I got stronger every day! I put my heart into it, that's why I could deliver so many things in just one day! I do this all for my mom so that she can rest. By the end of the first month, I was as strong as a bear I could carry 3 hundred apples in one basket with no problem! I always told myself to never give up and that I was doing this job for my mom! I have learned to never give up no matter how hard the problem is or how impossible it looks. Remember that your parents love you so much. Maybe try to show them that you love them!
