title: A Wise Old Owl
text: There was an old owl who lived in an oak tree. Every day, he observed incidents that occurred around him. Yesterday, he watched as a young boy helped an old man carry a heavy basket. Today, he saw a young girl shouting at her mother. The more he saw, the less he spoke. As the days went on, he spoke less but heard more. The old owl heard people talking and telling stories. He heard a woman saying an elephant jumped over a fence. He heard a man saying that he had never made a mistake. The old owl had seen and heard what happened to people. There were some who became better, some who became worse. But the old owl in the tree had become wiser, each and every day.
author: Devaganga P.S
illustrator: Brian van der Spuy; Eshita Munshi; Maya  Ramaswamy; Megan Lotter; Sain Thuokna; Santhini  Govindan

title: The Bird And Mother
text: One fine morning Glow was sleeping in her nest on her egg. But she was awoken by a sound. Glow's six eggs were hatching!an egg broke and out came a chick and another and another. Glow hatched six beautiful chicks.She gave them the food she had saved up for them and started their training. One day Glow found that two of her chicks were missing! It was so hot the chicks might not survive."No!" Glow said to herself "it is up to me to find my chicks and I will." She hugged her chicks goodbye and gave them to a babysitter and set off on her journey. She traveled and traveled and traveled through a desert but she did not find her chicks. She t raveled and traveled and traveled through a forest but she did not find her chicks. She t raveled and traveled and traveled through snowy mountains but she did not find her chicks. She t raveled and traveled and traveled through an ocean and she did find her chicks! Glow's chicks were safe and on a boat floating on the water. Glow took her chicks home and lived happily ever after. ﻿THE END

title: The Washerman And His Donkeys`
text: Ramu was a Washerman. He lived with his family in a hut. He had two donkeys, Meddy and Leddy. Meddy was a helpful donkey, it carries all the clothes that needed to be was hed from houses to Ramu's house, But Leddy was a lazy donkey, he sleeps and eats all day. Both the donkeys looked the same, so Ramu did not know who was Meddy and who was Leddy. One day, he was going to a house to collect clothes that needed to be washed. He went there with both the donkeys. But when he reached there he kept the clothes on Leddy's back but Leddy started moving and shaking. After seeing this Ramu kept the clothes on Meddy. Meddy was tired because the clothes were very heavy, but at last they reached Ramu's house. That day Ramu gave Leddy more food than Meddy thinking he was the one who carried all the clothes. After two days it was time to return the clothes. Ramu wanted to teach the lazy donkey a lesson. So he placed the clothes on both donkeys.But the second donkey started to move and shake his body. So Ramu kept the clothes on the same donkey. While walking the donkey dropped the clothes knowingly and it fell right to a muddy puddle. This time Ramu got angry and decided to sell the lazy donkey The buyers came to buy the donkey. Eventhough Ramu was confused which donkey was the lazy one. He decided to sell one. His wife said, "Are you sure this is the lazy donkey". Ramu replied, "Yes, I am sure this is the lazy donkey. "Do you want to check if it is the lazy donkey by putting some clothes on its back. If it is the lazy donkey it will start to shake and move it's body by that you can understand if it is the lazy donkey", His wife said again.After hearing this Ramu got angry and said, "I told you that I am sure this is the lazy donkey. The buyers were from different state. So they told Ramu that, "If he sells the donkey to them he cannot have it back". Ramu replied. "Ok, no problem. Ramu sold the donkey. In the evening it was time to return the clothes that the lazy donkey made dirty. He placed the cloths on the donkey's back and the donkey started to move and shake his body. After seeing this Ramu understood that this was the lazy donkey. Ramu told his wife about it but she did not say anything. From that day onwards Ramu had to go himself and collect the clothes and he also sold the other donkey too. Moral-Think Twice Before Talking The Next Step
author: anan muhammed
illustrator: Adonay Gebru; Angie & Upesh; Megan Andrews; Ouk  Ratha; Riya Gogte; Salim  Kasamba; Yusuf Ali Noton

title: A good friend
text: Maya has got a new pet porcupine. It's name is.... Porcupine. Maya really likes her new pet. Maya is getting ready for school. Porcupine jumps into Maya's backpack, looks like Porcupine wants to go to school too. Maya said "shhh!! we need to be quiet if we want to get past mom!" So the pair swooped out of the house and got on the bus. Maya wanted to show her new pet to her friends. So after school she took out her porcupine, but none of her friends liked her pet, and started bulling her. Were they jealous??? Porcupine knew that Maya was really sad, but what could he do? Porcupine has an idea!!! Porcupine tells Maya to imagine an think of happy thoughts, so Maya lay down and fell asleep...........and dreamed that she and Porcupine had drawn a beautiful pictures; Sailing on a mini paper bout with an umbrella; Eating ice cream with Porcupine; And that Porcupine had super powers and was flying! That was an amazing dream. And was very, very lucky to have such a caring and friendly pet, what more could could she want???

title: Lucky the Elephant and Twinkle the Fairy
text: Once, there lived an elephant named Lucky in the forest. Lucky loved to eat bananas. One day while searching for bananas, Lucky reached the side of a river. There were banana trees full of bananas on the other side of the river. Lucky was thinking on how to cross the river when, a fairy named Twinkle came. Twinkle created a bridge across the river using her magic wand. Lucky crossed the bridge and got to the other side of the river. Lucky thanked Twinkle for helping him. Lucky ate the bananas and he was very happy. After this, Lucky and Twinkle became friends.

title: My Cat Mitu.
text: This is my cat Mitu. She is as mischievous as can be. Oh, so you really don’t believe me? Well then see for yourself. This is Mitu trying to play with our pet dog Rana’s tail. This is Mitu trying to catch our pet parrot. This is Mitu trying to catch our goldfish. Oh yeah that’s Mitu, my Mom is throwing her out of the kitchen. But at times Mitu can be quiet and peaceful as can be. She purrs and rubs her body against us to get our attention. But whatever mischief she gets into she knows that we all love her.

title: My little superhero
text: One day Sally went to a pet store because she really wanted a pet cat. She found the right one and she named it Kassi. What a cute cat she said to herself. Sally wanted her to be the best cat in the whole world. She trained Kassi a lot. One day Kassi saw Sally play a game of a girl getting stuck on a railway track and Sally came to the rescue. Kassi wanted to be a superhero and save people just like Sally. Kassi put up her ears and heard a person screaming. She ran out of Sally’s hands and ran to the voice following it. She saw a girl stuck on the rail track as the train was coming, she ran and saved the girl,and brought her home safe and sound. Sally was really proud of Kassi and hugged her so much and kissed her too. Sally was the happiest girl ever in the whole world and Kassi was the happiest cat too. Everybody gave Kassi a gold medal of being my little superhero. But Sally gave Kassi a makeover but she still looks good doesn’t she. Here’s one of my secret if you want an intelligent pet keep on training him/her Or be really happy, kind and have a great day.

title: Three Little Dinosaurs
text: Once there lived a dinosaur in Africa. Its name was Rosy. She laid 3 eggs. The eggs started cracking. The eggs cracked open. Three little dinosaurs peered out of their shell. 5 years passed. The little dinosaurs have grown up. One day they went out to search for food. They got a lot of fruits. They started eating them. They had a good dinner. After dinner they went to sleep. They had a good sleep. When they woke up in the morning,there was something on one dinosaur’s back. It was a caterpillar. It took a stick and threw it away. After that they went home happily.

title: The Forest Party
text: Once there was a girl called Meena. She used to play in the forest near her home. She had many animal friends such as mice … frogs... hornbills… …and many more animals. Together they used to explore the forest. One day, Meena wanted to have a party with her animal friends. She called a little mouse and told it to spread the message to her friends that she was going to have a party. By the time her animal friends reached the party, Meena had decorated it well. She had got colourful balloons and different fruits and flowers. They all played together and went back home. Meena was happy too, as she a had good party with her friends.

title: How Bella the butterfly got her courage
text: Once upon a time their lived a butterfly called Bella which means BEAUTIFUL. But Bella is always afraid. Some insects call her " Timentes" means scared in Latin. Bella got very sad, she sat alone not talking to anyone not even her family. She said to herself: everyone is right, I am a timentes butterfly, I will never have courage. One day, a new butterfly came. She just came out of her cocoon, everyone was so excited, then she flew and came next to Bella. The new butterfly said: hi, my name is Clara what is your name? Bella said: oh, um.... are you talking to me? Clara said: of course I am. Bella said: well........ my name i-is... i-s Bella. Suddenly a pink butterfly came and said: hey, Clara why are you talking to Bella? She is a bad butterfly she is always scared. If you talk to her you will also become like her. Clara said: hey! Don't talk to Bella like that! Bella said: she is right Clara, you shouldn't talk to me. Clara said: wait, you to? The pink butterfly flew away without saying a word. Clara came to Bella and said: Bella don't listen to that butterfly, you are great! And you know what, everyone gets afraid it is normal. Bella said: but I am afraid of everything I was even afraid to come out of my cucoon! Clara said: ok, it might be that you are afraid but at least look at your wings, they are so beautiful! Just, be happy and you will forget everything about your fear. Bella said: a-alright, but why don't we go to a place where there is no one because if we stay here and talk everyone would disturb us. I know a perfect place said, Clara. Where? Asked Bella. You will see, just follow me. A-alright said, Bella. Both of them flew and flew for an hour. Bella got really tired, then Clara stopped flying and sat on a Banyan tree. She said: Bella, why don't you sit here with me, thins is where I was born, far away from your home. Bella also sat with her and said: re-r-really? Yes, and do you know whenever the wind comes, the Banyan tree comes alive, and he can listen to our words and when the branches and leaves of the tree shake, we can understand what the banyan tree is trying to say. And then suddenly the wind came and the leaves and branches shook the banyan tree became alive! The banyan tree was crying too! Clara said: Banyan tree why are you crying? The banyan tree said: soon, the humans are going to chop me down, and they will build houses and buildings over here. Clara said; What? I am not giving up my home. What do you say about that Bella? Bella said: um..... uh... d-d-do you think it will be safe to f-f-f-fight with the humans? Clara said: I know it won't be safe, but this is my home! I have to save it! Why don't we go and ask the other insects to help us so that we can save the Banyan tree? Bella had no other choice and helped Clara. So both of them were flying, to go and meet the other insects for help. On their way, they saw a little girl trying to catch them. Although the little girl was like a monster to Clara and Bella. She had a little goat too. Then Clara and Bella hid near the bushes. The little girl went away because she couldn't see the other insects as they were hiding. So they quickly went and convinced all the insects to help the banyan tree. All of them agreed and went to guard the banyan tree. After a couple of days, the humans arrived. They had HUGE machines and axes to chop the tree down. The birds pecked on the men's heads and the butterflies gave nectar to the bees and with the nectar the bees made honey and they threw it on the men's foot so that the men couldn't move. After hard work, the humans ran away and never chopped the banyan tree. After that Bella got a lot of courage and she never got scared again. The End Moral of the story: ﻿ ﻿ never be scared
author: Aarushi  konda
illustrator: Advaith A; Kashmira Sarode; Lavanya  Naidu; Mahbubur  Rahman; Malvika Tewari; Princy Niravkumar Bhavsar; Sandhya Prabhat; Sheena Deviah; Vinayak Varma; Zainab Tambawalla

title: The Monkey And The Elephant
text: One day, an elephant was walking past the forest when he saw a monkey swinging from the branches of a tree! The elephant ignored the monkey, but the monkey started mocking him by singing in the loudest and most irritating voice in the world! The elephant was very annoyed and could not enjoy his day at all. The very next day, the elephant wanted payback. So, the elephant sucked a huge amount of water from a nearby lake into his trunk and went to the forest again. The elephant wasn’t surprised to see the monkey in the same tree singing and mocking. The elephant immediately sprinkled all the water on the monkey. The monkey was drained and learnt his lesson. He said sorry to the elephant and they later became friends. Moral:As You Sow,So Shall You Reap.
author: Parijat Chakraborty
illustrator: Athumani  Saidi; Parijat Chakraborty; Shabani  Hamidu; Warmly Designs

title: Best friends

title: THE FAWN
text: There was a race in the fofrest among the animals. The fawn wanted to win the race. The fawn wanted to win the race so he pushed every animal in the race. title: An Exciting Dream
text: Once, there was a boy named Siddharth who lived in Bangalore. People fondly called him Sid just the way the ground sloth Sidney was named in the movie “Ice Age”. Unlike the clumsy ground sloth, Sid was a very friendly, humble and creative boy. He loved trains and building models out of scrap. His favourite train was the electric train. As Sid was a friendly boy, he had many friends. Ayush, Karan, Aanya and Sreeja being few of his close friends. Aanya was Ayush’s younger sister. One day Sid was playing with his friends in the playground. While playing, his friend Karan saw a baby named Taashu in the pram being pushed by his mother Amrita aunty. Seeing Taashu in the pram, Karan was tempted to stroll him. He asked Amrita aunty, “Aunty, can I please walk Taashu in the pram?” “Oh sure!” agreed Amrita aunty and handed over the pram to Karan. Karan enjoyed walking Taashu in the pram. To cheer Taashu he thought of an idea… And started running behind his friends. In excitement, Karan started running very fast. Taashu was thoroughly enjoying this ride. He was jumping up and down and laughing….Heeehee. As Karan picked up speed, he missed a step and both Karan and the pram started flying. They were somersaulting in the air. Though, Taashu was securely strapped to the pram. While Karan holding the pram was screaming for HEE HELP….Taashu was laughing Ehhhaaa. Due to the fierce wind Karan started flying higher and could not control the pram. With their gazes fixed on Karan, as if kite running, Sid and Ayush started running in their direction to save them. While Taashu landed safe and excited, Karan settled on Taashu’s lap somersaulting. But now they were trapped between two narrow walls. Sid and Ayush stared at Karan and Taashu in disbelief! Karan looked scared, so Sid comforted him and said, “We are there. Don’t worry. We will take you out from there.” Hearing his friend’s assuring and compassionate words calmed Karan. Sid and his friends sprung into action to rescue Karan and Taashu. Taking the lead, Sid asked Mona, Ayush’s cousin to call a fire brigade. The fire brigade arrived after an hour. Hearing its siren “OOOOAAAAAA…..OOOOAAAAA”, Sid looked at the fire engine and directed the driver to come to the incident spot. Meanwhile, Sid asked Ayush to get an axe. They helped the fire fighters, as the engine could not go near the narrow wall. Ayush climbed up the ladder and jumped on the wall. With the help of an axe, he tilted the ladder near Karan and Taashu. All this while, Sid managed the traffic. Redirecting them to another route. Finally, Sid and his friends rescued Karan and Taashu. Just as Sid was sinking in the joy of rescuing his friends, he heard his mother calling, “Siddharth wake up, you will miss your school bus!” Rubbing his eyes, Sid woke up with a gentle smile on his face. While getting ready for school, he cheerfully narrated about the exciting dream to his mother.
author: Siddharth Shivani Venugopal

title: Abel and his sister's doll
text: There was a boy whose name was Abel. He made himself a cart. Abel had no driver for his new cart. He said to his sister Meri, "I want a driver for my cart. Please give me your doll. She can sit in the cart." But Meri said, "No, I want my doll." When Meri would not let him take the doll, Abel was very angry. He grabbed the doll and pulled her. Meri pulled the doll's other arm. Abel pulled and Meri pulled. The doll's arm came off! Meri cried and ran to her mother. "Look Mother," she said, "Abel pulled my doll's arm and it came off. He wanted my doll to sit in his new cart but I wanted to play with her." Her mother said, "Abel did not behave well." Mother thought about how to teach her son not to touch his sister's toys. She had an idea. She went to her friend who was a doctor and she asked, "I want you to help me please." The doctor replied, "How can I help, my friend?" Mother answered, "My son Abel is behaving badly these days. He pulled the arm off his sister's doll. He must not do that. Tomorrow I will tell him to bring the doll to you to put the doll's arm on again. "Please tell Abel that he must pay you for your work. He doesn't have any money, so you will tell him to clean your big old car that is always dusty," said mother. Her friend laughed and said, "Ee–ee! That will be good." Abel's mother went back to her house. She asked Abel, "When you are ill or hurt where do you go?" Abel answered, "When I am ill or hurt, I must go to the doctor." Abel's mother said, "You hurt the doll, now you must take her to the doctor." So Abel took the doll to the doctor. "This doll is hurt very badly. My mother told me to bring the doll to you. Doctor, can you give her a new arm?" The doctor agreed to look after the doll. She was able to make a new arm. The doctor said to Abel, "The doll has a new arm. You must pay me. How much money do you have?" Abel answered, "Please doctor, I don't have any money. I can't pay you for your work." The doctor said, "Well! You don't have any money? My big car is very dirty! Clean my car and that is how you will pay me." Abel got a bucket of water and a clean cloth. It took a long time to wash that dirty car. Then Abel took the doll back to Meri. She was delighted and she said to Abel, "You are a good brother. Thank you for fixing my doll." "My sister, I'm sorry for getting angry and making you sad," said Abel. From that day, Abel never took his sister's things again. And he tried his best not to get angry with her. Abel remembered how long it took him to wash the doctor's big, dirty car. He decided it wasn't worth the price to get angry and break things.
author: Abhishri Jana

title: THE WATERMELON
text: Once upon a time in a jungle, there lived a fox that liked eating a fruit. It stole these fruits from farms and ate it. It filled these fruits with water and stitched it back. It sold these fruits filled with water for the passers-by at a good price. On a certain day, the animals of the jungle went and bought these fruits from the fox. T he animals gather at a place to enjoy these fruits. When they open these instead of finding fruit they find water in it. All the animals get angry. The fox gets a good amount for the fruits it sold. A wise old owl helps the animals plan to take revenge on the fox. The animals go to th e fox and the elephant who has a trunk binds the fox in its trunk, then puts it in a fruit shell it sold to them. The animals tape the fruit with the fox in it. The elephant kicks the fruit with the fox. The fox lands with a crash and falls in a different jungle. Never to be seen again in the same. That is how the name watermelon came into use as the size of the fruit was like a melon and the fox filled it with water.
author: Ponagoti Saanvi

title: Where Did The Sun Go?
text: It is a misty morning. Ting! Ting! The clock shows it is evening. Owls are sleeping...Coo! Coo! Some people are listening stories while Rashi is excited as she wants to see the sun. She goes out but wait...where is the sun? Where is it? Where Did The Sun Go? It is noon but the moon is shining, not the sun... Rashi hurries back to see the clock and it is showing noon as same as before. Rashi decides to find the sun. She now begins her hunt. She is shocked. She sets out on the hunt and looks everywhere in her neighbourhood, her house, her friend's house but can't find any trace..."Where is it?" She muttered to herself. Well, it was her lucky day... Rashi has found the perfect solution. She secretly took a rocket from NASA and whoosh! She went into the space...Now she was orbiting the earth! She took a boost and went out of the atmosphere and went out to the outer space.. The spaceship was so fast that Rashi was getting all wobbly. It stopped...she was out of the galaxy! Still....she didn't find the sun...she entered the Andromeda Galaxy and the radar started beeping.....It was the sun! Then she took a boost again but that was a wrong thing to do. There was a black hole in front of her but she didn't notice. She got too fast and got sucked into the black hole.... "Help!" she screamed but no one could hear her as space is a vacuum. Rashi was hopeless...she could also see the stars which were also being sucked. Now Rashi got courage. "I can do it! I can come out!" She said.... She then sat on her spaceship chair and clicked a button. The Spaceship started to move. It was hard as the black hole's force was pulling them inside but Rashi wasn't going to stop....she was a brave girl. She went out of the black hole with her courage. "Yay! I did it!" She said to herself. Now she went on further in the galaxy to find the sun. She took the help of S.P.S..."Space Positioning System." Now she saw a bright light ahead. She went near it and there! It was the Sun! It was sad. When he saw the space shuttle he got happy. Rashi was happy too! "C'mon Sun! Let's Go!" Rashi said. "Yes but...Oh! I am so heavy how will you carry me?" The Sun said." " I have a rope feature in this spaceship from which I can tow you" saying this Rashi pulled the sun. After all of this Rashi and the sun got back to the Solar System and then the sun told that he was invited for the Star Awards in the Andromeda Galaxy as he got the title "Known to help life on planet Earth." So he was going to the function but he got forgot the directions so he was lost. He was so lost that not even another star could help him. He was crying and that when Rashi had come. The sun thanked Rashi and went to the spot in the Solar System where he usually is. He gave Rashi a smile and Rashi was happy. Now she returned to the earth. Now when she was returning people in her neighbourhood were surprised....Rashi told her all about her adventure and word spread fast around the world. An author wrote a book and this was it. Hope you like it!
author: ARNAV KUMAR

title: MISSION MOMMY'S NEW RECIPE
text: JAZZ an 8 year old boy loved helping his mother in making new dishes, his mother too loved to create new recipes on her own. One day Jazz says to his mother" Mommy, How long I should eat these PASTA,PANCAKE,FINGER TIPS and all other old dishes. I am just fed up. Mom Why can't you make something new" " Mmmmmmm, NEW, I was also thinking about it, let's create a new recipe" replied Jazz's mother. "Mommy I will also help you, WHAT IS THE NAME OF THE DISH? WHAT ALL INGREDIENTS ARE THERE? WHAT SHOULD I DO?" said Jazz. "OH! Dear don't be so excited, THE NAME OF THE DISH................. I will name it at last after the dish is ready, Jazz won't you help me?" replied mom. "MISSION MOMMY'S NEW RECIPE" said Jazz "So, first let's take a pan, butter please!, butter on the pan, TURN AND TURN, OK, Well, let's take a bowl, Jazz take the bottle of the Chocolate Essence and Brown Food Colour" said mom, "Mommy is it this" replied Jazz. "OH! That's, Chilly powder, not that, wait, one minute, What about adding some Chilly powder, Jazz bring the Chilly powder and the Essence and Food Colour too. Mmmmmmm just a pinch of Chilly powder" said mom. "Mommy here I come" said Jazz and dropped all the Chilly powder into the batter. "OH! Dear, It's OK,NO PROBLEM,MORE SPICY, MORE TASTIER." Some Essence, some Food Colour, WOW, OK, Now mix the batter, ROUND AND ROUND,UP AND DOWN,WHIRL AND SWIRL. Done, Now pour the batter into the pan. Now, Jazz bring the packet of Bread and Milk." said mom "Mommy there's no packet of milk" said Jazz "OH!,SORRY, forgot it, it was in the container, that right one in the shelf." said mom "Mommy here it is" said Jazz "OH, Well some milk into the pan and some powdered bread pieces, One minute this is not milk, OH! GOD, Is this curd? OH,NO! It's OK, some sour, some more flavour added, OK, now mix all in the pan, SWIRL AND WHIRL, WOW, What should I add" said mom "Mommy What about some Tutti Fruiti, Jelly Beans" said Jazz "OK, take the Jelly Beans and Tutti Fruiti, Choco Chips too" said mom "Mommy here it is "said Jazz "Some Jelly Beans, Tutti Fruiti, Choco Chips. Oh, dear, this is not Choco Chips. This is clove which we add in Fried Rice, NO PROBLEM, NEW FLAVOUR,MORE TASTIER THE DISH, WOW, THANK YOU Jazz, Love you, NO need of Choco Chips, this is enough" said mom " Mommy, let's add some Coco Cola" said Jazz "Yes, of course, some Coco Cola, WOW, Nice. HEY Jazz its 12:00 did you gave food to Chommy? Jazz give the previous days rice" said mom Jazz took the bowl of previous day's rice and kept in front of Chommy, but Chommy kicked the bowl, he was fed up of eating previous day rice's. Jazz ran and went near his mother and said" Mommy, Chommy kicked away the bowl of previous day's rice, now it's all waste" said Jazz " Waste, NO, Dear, we will add it in our dish, take it and come here, some wasted rice added and mix in the pan and at last, What about something healthy? Some Vegies, Dear Jazz bring all the vegetables in the refrigerator, bring the knife too......... BROCOLI,CARROT,POTATO,TOMATO,BRINJAL, OK let's cut all these vegies and make a juice of it, Jazz bring the juicer, WOW, VEGIE JUICE READY, Now let's add it in the pan and mix it, Now last, some whipped cream and MIX, 'MIX AND MIX 5 MINUTES, MIX AND MIX 5 MINUTES.' Now let's keep it in the oven for 1 hour, till that let's watch telivision" said mom AFTER 1 HOUR "Mommy smelling something, smell of something burning" said Jazz "Burning?, OH!!!!!!!! OUR DISH, run and run, OH,NO cake is all burnt" said mom "Mommy let's taste it " said Jazz. They both tasted the dish and spit it out "BUAAAAAAAHHHHH, Ugly, What taste? What dish is this? said Jazz "OH, NO, What will I do?, Now, Who will eat this?" said mom "Mommy let's serve it to DAD" said Jazz "But the taste of it, OH, GOT AN IDEA! We will add some powdered sugar and add some whipped cream, cashew, jelly beans, then the dish will all be sweet" said mom They added powdered sugar and whipped cream in each layer of the cake and decorated it with Jelly Beans and Cashew. AT THE EVENING DAD CAME AND SAT AT THE TABLE AND ASKED FOR DINNER Jazz and his mom came holding the new dish and served it to DAD. DAD tasted it and said "WOW, tasty, What is this, What's the name of the dish" "DISH'S NAME......" murmered mom "MOMMY'S JELLY,CHOCLATY,CREAMY,HEALTHY CAKE" said Jazz "Healthy, this word doesn't suits it, It's, OK, name doesn't matter, the taste matters" said DAD Jazz and his mom smiled, mom said "THANK YOU Jazz, For ' A WONDERFUL NAME FOR THE DISH' 'Mother hugged Jazz and went to sleep.' NEXT DAY "Daddy, daddy, Where are you?" called out Jazz "I am here" replied DAD ' YOU COULD IMAGINE WHERE WOULD DAD BE!' I AM HERE!!!! DADDY, daddy, Where are you? "MOMMY'S JELLY,CHOCLATY,CREAMY,HEALTHY CAKE" INGREDIENTS BUTTER- 1 PKT CHOCOLATE ESSENCE- BOTTLE, POWDERED SUGAR- 1 BOWL, BROWN FOOD COLOUR- BOTTLE, POWDERED BREAD CRUMBS- 1 BOWL, CURD- 1 PKT, TUTTI FRUITI- 1/2PKT, JELLY BEANS- PKT, CLOVE- 100GM, COCA COLA- 1 BIG BOTTLE, PREVIOUS DAY RICE- 1 BOWL, VEGETABLES- JUICED, WHIPPED CREAM- 1 PKT, CASHEW- PKT, CHILLY POWDER- 1 KG, HOW TO MAKE TAKE A PAN AND GREASE 1 FULL PKT BUTTER ON IT. TAKE A BOWL & POUR BOTTLE CHOCOLATE ESSENCE AND BROWN FOOD COLOUR AND MIX,WHILE MIXING ADD 1 KG CHILLY POWDER TO IT AND MIX WELL.NOW POUR THE BATTER ONTO THE PAN.BRING THE POWDERED BREAD CRUMBS AND 1 PKT CURD AND ADD IT AND MIX WELL. ADD SOME TUTTI FRUITI, JELLY BEANS AND 100GM CLOVE AND MIX WELL TILL IT BECOMES A PASTE.NOW ADD 1 BOTTLE COCA COLA AND ADD THE PREVIOUS DAY RICE AND MIX WELL AND ADD THE VEGETABLE JUICE AND MIX,WHILE MIXING ADD 1 PKT WHIPPED CREAM AND MIX SO WELL FOR 5 MINUTES, AFTER THAT PLACE IT IN THE OVEN FOR 1 HOUR. AFTER 1 HOUR, IF THE CAKE IS BURNT ADD SOME POWDERED SUGAR AND WHIPPED CREAM IN EACH LAYER OF THE CAKE AND DECORATE IT WITH JELLY BEANS AND CASHEW.!!! MOMMY'S JELLY, CHOCLATY,CREAMY,HEALTHY CAKE IS READY!!! ATTENTION NEVER EVER TRY THIS RECIPE AT YOUR HOME, SURELY IT WILL BECOME A DISASTER AS READ IN THE STORY. THE END

title: Recycle, Reduce, Reuse
text: Ajay and his friend Bablu were fishing and then a bottle floated by. Ajay kicked it aside but it rolled back to him. Bablu said, " try o pening it let's see if there's treasure inside". They tried o pening it with their fish rods but it did not work. they tried using their hands and teeth but it was no use. They tried many ways but it did not work. At last they used a big bottle ca p o pener. But. THUDDDDDD!!!!!!! They fell down. Then they lost their ho pe of trying to o pen it. Then when they were returning home with the bottle to throw it in the dustbin. There was Meenu, their friend standing who saw them throwing it away and went to sto p them. she said try Recycling, Reusing and reducing it, instead of throwing it But Ajay and bablu were curious about what they were. So Meenu ex plained. Recycle is when you turn an object after use into another object instead of throwing it. Reuse is when you use some object again and again. So they recycled it into drums. After many days the drums were broken and they felt bored so they tried reusing it. So they imagined it as house for their toys. Even though it was broken drums it was used as a house for their toys. After sometime they felt like thanking Meenu. So they went to Meenu's favorite area and thanked her and also asked a question "Meenu you mentioned reduce too but forgot to tell what it means". Meenu re plied, I did not forget, its just that this object cannot be reduced but I will tell you what that means. Reduce is when you use less of something and not waste it and not use more of something like plastic bags you can use them but less and use cloth bags more. So the boys understood and said "Goodbye" and went back to do more recycling, reuse and reduce if possible.

title: What do you see outside the Window?
text: "Sidhu, why don't you look outside?" said Amma to Sidhu, who is bored at home. "Look outside the window?" asked Sidhu "Yes and tell me what do you see?" said Amma What do you see outside the window? I see lots of dust flying, and a yellow crane at the construction site. Few wires swaying, some trees and many buildings in my sight. Alright, let's try rolling our fingers into binoculars and zoom in and out. Ah, look at the parapet and tell me what do you see outside the window? Aha, I see Yellow Beak & Yellow Feet. Pecking food, that is "Myna", Tweet tweet. Excited Sidhu tried Pecking, Peck!Peck! Shh! It is human shy, you make sounds and it will fly. What do you see outside the window? On the yellow crane, I see Green birds with a long tail and a red bill. Preening out there, it is the "Rose Ringed Parakeet". Zoom in and you will see a rose ring around its neck. "ZOOOOOOM" went Sidhu. Shh! You make sounds and it will fly. What do you see outside the window? On the wire, I see a bird with blue wings and white throat. Perching before it dives for its catch, that is a "Kingfisher". Sidhu are you sitting on the edge of your chair? Shh! said Sidhu. I am Perching, y ou make sounds and it will fly. What do you see outside the window? I see a golden bird with black wings. Hiding inside the canopy of a tree, that is the "Golden Oriole", chirp chirp. Thrilled Sidhu tried Chirping, Chirp! Chirp! Shh! You make sounds and it will fly. What do you see outside the window? In the pot, tiny brown bird. Dust bathing in the soil, they are "House Sparrows", Delighted Sidhu exclaimed, that must be so much fun. Shh! You make sounds and they will fly. What do you see outside the window? I see lots of birds flying, Yellow, Green and Blue. Leaves and branches swaying, c olourful flowers, Oh such a beautiful view!
author: nisha nair

title: the summer at home
text: Reina is a 10 year old and very and I mean very very very very very stubborn kind of girl, she wanted to have a fun vacation this year, in fact she had been planning this years summer vacation since the last one ended! that's how serious she was! but due to the virus she couldn't go anywhere and was stuck at home. all she could do was sit and relax with her dog Jamie. who believe it or not looked like a big roti jumping around as Reina described him. don't believe me? just look at the picture here, yes that's a dog not a roti! all Reina had to do now was go talk to her parents for the summer vacation. so she decided to make a plan, but here's my question if you were in Reina's shoes (not quite literally) what would you do? "mummmmma, papppaaaa" Reina screamed as she ran through the corridors of her house. hearing this mumma papa came inside from visiting the garden. and they asked as (every mumma papa asked when their child does something like this) "what happened is everything ok beta?" and Reina replied " no nothing is ok we were suppose to go to nani's house today! what about my summer vacation?" Reina got a little frustrated mid way saying the sentence, and papa replied " Reina, beta we told you that due to the lockdown we cannot go anywhere. but do you remember how much fun we had last summer?" "yes" exclaimed Reina. and mumma spoke up " then why don't we take a trip down memory lane and reminisce our last summer vacation!" "yes that seems like a good idea" said Reina papa agreed by nodding his head. "remember when we went to mamu's house by train Reina?" said mumma "yes, of course I had so much fun, the people sitting next to us were so nice as well we had a gala time!" said Reina "and remember we went on a picnic with all your cousins and nanu and nani as well?" asked papa "yes it was so much fun we even played soo many games there like hide and seek, it was so exciting nobody wanted to go back!" said Reina while laughing, "and remember after that we went to bua's house, you had so much fun playing with her pets!" exclaimed papa, "ah, yes it was so much fun too! me and ahana (her cousin) played with her cat ginger!" " and your other cousin Adrik came too remember! said mumma "yes of course all the animals loved him " said Reina while giggling, " see Reina, we cannot go anywhere on vacation now but we can still remember what fun we had last year in our heart" said papa "yes papa's absolutely right Reina and we can all still have some fun at home, like we can all watch a movie or have a picnic in the garden!" said mumma "yes, these all sound like fun mumma papa" said Reina, "come on then lets go watch a movie!" said mumma and papa "yes lets watch a movie" said Reina, and that's all folks they all watched a movie happily ever after... but wait I have some questions for you turn the page to see! trivia time! lets see if you were really paying attention to the book here are some questions and you'll have to answer them each question contains 2 marks the more you payed attention the more marks (teachers can too use this technique too!) and hey! no cheating I am watching you all! 1 what is Reina's dogs name and what does Reina describe him as? 2 where was Reina suppose to go to today? 3 name the two of Reina's cousins. 4 what was Reina's nature? 5 what was the cats name? 6 how old is Reina? 7 what did mumma suggest they do? 8 where did Reina find mumma and papa and that's all hope you paid attention bye!

title: Mia's tune...
text: Do you all know how to sing? Today I am going to tell you a story of a girl who loved to sing... Once upon a time, there lived a girl named Mia. She used to live in a house with her parents and her uncle James. Her father was a snake charmer. They also had pets. They were a very happy family. One day, Mia's father got a letter from the king. He was surprised.. When he opened it, he saw that it was an invitation letter. He was invited to the palace!!! Mia's father called Mia, her mother and her uncle James and shared this happy news with everyone... The next day, when Upesh (Mia's father) was leaving for the palace, Mia shouted " Papa can you take me to the palace?" Upesh smiled and agreed. Mia quickly packed her things and came back running. By then, the bullock cart had already come. It took one day for Mia and her father to reach the palace from their village. At last, when they reached the palace, they were stopped at the entrance of the palace by the guards! Upesh said "Dear guards, please allow us to meet the king. He has invited us to the palace." The guards were still not allowing them to enter. Upesh requested them a lot but the guards still did not listen to him... This led to a quarrel.. Like this, an hour passed by.. The king got up from his throne and said his servants to look for a snake charmer... After few minutes, the servants came to the royal court and told the king "Oh my Majesty, we saw a snake charmer but there was also a small girl with him. The king laughed and said" Oh that must be Upesh with his daughter Mia" The king ordered the guards to allow Upesh and Mia to meet him. The king asked Mia " Dear Mia, I hope you did not have any problem in your journey." " No your Majesty, I did not face any problem, but I am very hungry after this long journey.. Then, the king invited both of them to the lunch.. Mia's tongue watered as soon as she saw all the yummy South Indian dishes like dosa, idli, uttapam,rawa upma,lassi,etc. When they were eating, the king said to Upesh" Last year I decided to visit my kingdom. I saw the sufferings of the poor and needy, and decided to help them. Like this, I came across your village where I saw you charming a snake. You were perfect with your job. So, I thought to invite you this year to the shahi mela. I am very happy that your daughter has also come along with you. Can you perform in the shahi mela?" " Your Majesty, it will be an honour for me to perform in the shahi mela." said Upesh.. The next day, when Upesh woke up, he got to know that the shahi mela was beginning from that day itself!! He went to the shahi mela with the king.. When they reached the shahi mela, the king announced" My dear citizens, this is Upesh, a snake charmer and has come here as a special guest. From the next day ownwards, Upesh started performing in front of everyone.... On the third day, Mia also came to the mela.. She loved the mela, she ate ladoos and jalebis. She also saw a woman playing a sitar and singing songs, and next to the woman a man was playing the tabla. Mia loved the tune, but she could not recognize the musical instruments as she had seen those musical instruments when she was only one year old and after that she did not see any musical instrument except her father's bean. She asked her father" What is that man and woman playing?" Upesh smiled and replied " They are playing sitar and tabla." After Mia and her father came back to their own home, Mia told her father that she wants to learn singing. Her father was very happy to see Mia's interest in singing, but there was no such good singer in their village. So, her father told her" My dear Mia, I know you want to learn singing, but there is no good singer in our village who can teach you singing. Wait for another year, when I will go to the shahi mela again for performing, I will tell the Majesty about your wish." Again after an year, an invitation letter came from the king. Mia and Upesh went to the palace, but this time the guards did not stop them at the entrance of the palace! Upesh told the king about Mia's wish. Mia started to learn singing and became a famous singer. One day the king called her and asked her to sing for him. The king praised her a lot. Can you guess what is Mia's favourite musical instrument? It is...... sitar....

title: What is a Palindrome?
text: A palindrome is a word, number, phrase, or other sequences of characters that reads the same backward as forward. Let us look at some word palindromes. The alphabets in the word from left to right are the same as the alphabets from right to left. The word Eye is a palindrome. When you read the word from the left to right, the alphabets are E, Y, E. When you read the word from right to left, the alphabets are E, Y, E. The word mom is a palindrome. The word noon is a palindrome. The word Wow is a palindrome. The word madam is a palindrome. The word racecar is a palindrome. The names of people like Bob, Hannah, Eve, Ana, and Elle are palindromes. Multiple words or phrases can be palindromes. My gym Don't nod I did, Did I Some numbers are palindromes: 11, 121, 9009, 75257, 906609 Now that you know about palindromes, can you do a small homework? Find out the largest word palindrome in the world. Good Luck.

title: The magic carpet
text: Once there lived a very poor boy.His name was Ram.He was an orphan.He lived with his friend Chotu on the streets.They both did different works like shoe polishing, washing clothes, working in restaurant etc.Sometimes they had to beg for food and money.In this way they managed to get food. One day they sat down in a corner of the street.They decided to save some money.They decided that everyday they would earn at least 2000 rupees and save 1000 from it.From that day they did as decided.After some time they managed to built a hut.They also started to go to school.There life began to change.They started to wear new clothes.They ate properly.Now they earned 5000 per day and lived properly. Then one day some big boys who lived near their hut entered in their hut and threw them out. Ram and Chotu became very sad.They started walking on the street.They sat down on a carpet in a corner of the street and talked.Then suddenly Ram said that he was very hungry and wanted to eat chappati and dal. As soon as Ram said this chappati and dal appeared in front of them, they both were very scared and surprised.They understood that the carpet was not a ordinary carpet instead it was a magical carpet.They said names of different food item and ate till heir heart's content and slept on it.Next morning when they woke up they decided to open a restaurant and sell food to people.They called the customers and ave them anything they wanted.This continued foe many months.After some time they had enough money to open a restaurant of their own.They opened a new restaurant.Now they made a strong house made of brick and stone and started to live comfortably.Time passed and they both grew and had become 20 years old.Their restaurant was going smoothly.Now they need not work in the restaurant, as they had different workers.After sometime they became the richest man in their city but they were never arrogant, they were very kind.They often donated their food,clothes, etc. to poor people as they had already suffered it and they didn't want anyone else to suffer it. One day the boys who took away Ram and Chotu's house got to know about their richness. They tried to again take their house but this time they were not successful as one of the servants of Ram heard the boys plan and told his master immediately Ram and Chotu thought of a clever plan to teach the boys a lesson.When the boys entered their house they saw that the whole house was in complete darkness.Ram and Chotu started to make different and scary noises.The boys got scared but they gathered up some strength and went inside.As soon as they entered one of the rooms they saw a white ghost in front of him.Actually the ghost was none other than Ram.The boys were so scared that they felt unconscious and fell down.After some time when they woke up they found themselves hanging on the wall and as soon as they looked upwards they saw a skeleton and felt unconscious.This time they found themselves on the gates of the house,but they were so scared that they ran as fast as they could and never came back.From hat day Ram and Chotu lived happily ever after.
author: Rohit Sharma

title: Detective Brothers and the Antique engine
text: Detective Brothers and the Antique engine Chapter 1 It was a beautiful day in the month of May. Abhi woke up and said, “Gi, have you booked a jet for us to travel?” Gi said, “Yes, Abhi we also have to take Sandy.” Sandy is Gi’s friend, some other reason is also there for them to take her along with them. Detective Brothers and Sandy were in a private jet. Vish exclaimed, “I am so eager to see the great Antique engine!” Gi replied, “Me, too! Vish.” Yes, they all were equally excited. Few days before…. Vish’s uncle Sam, who is a famous archaeologist was telling them about the Antique Engine in his private lab. Antique engine is a very old engine, a Tamil merchant named Swaminathan owned it. The great merchant Swaminathan was nothing but the ancestor of Sandy. It is said that the Antique engine was not only used as a time machine by the merchant but also it has so many special features within. No one knows what happened to the machine after the merchant died. One of its specialties is, it is so strong that even a Nuclear Missile can’t destroy it! It is nearly 500 years old! Uncle Sam also told them about the secret place where it is kept, it is an island called Amrutling which is somewhere located in the Indian Ocean, near Kanyakumari. This mysterious island is not mentioned in any of the atlas. They all planned to visit it out of curiosity, though they all know that they are risking their lives. Chapter 2 The Detective Brothers got ready for an amazing adventure. They didn’t know that it is going to be an unforgettable experience for them. They engaged a private jet. On their first day of the journey they reached the place where Amrutling is located, using an old map handed over to them by uncle Sam. But to their astonishment, it was nowhere to be seen. Just then, Gi remembered and told them that, he read about this submerged island in a fantasy novel, in which all mermaids and mermen live. They were all wondering how to go inside the water. The pilot interrupted them and said the jet they are travelling can be transformed into a submarine as well. They all gave a sigh of relief. Chapter3 The pilot transformed the jet into a submarine and all went inside the water. To their surprise they saw an enormous water bubble. When they all went inside the bubble, they saw a separate world located underneath the sea. Vivo just remembered something and asked everyone, “Hey guys, do you all know about the Revrede Mountain ranges of the island Amrutling?” They all gave a puzzled look. Vivo continued, “Let me tell you all a fact what my uncle told me about the Revrede mountain. You can nowhere see a mountain like this in the whole world. It is cold in summer and hot in winter! Not only that, it is also circle in shape and floats in the sky!” They all were stunned. So, they planned to visit the mountain first before started their search for the Antique engine. They pinched themselves and cannot believe their eyes when they saw the Revrede mountain ranges. The mountains were like heap of white cotton balls floating up. Since the island was located under the sea, the sky was not be visible, instead a thick blue layer of water was seen. Sandy was not at all interested in all these things, her mind was fully occupied with the amazing antique engine, she said, “ hurry up guys, I want to see the great Antique engine.” They all started searching for the engine. Adi saw something was twinkling on the white surface of the Revrede mountain. Harsh hurriedly took his bino out and looked it. Immediately he shouted with joy. “ guys I have found the engine, it’s up over there!” he pointed his fingers up. Suddenly a flying saucer appeared. Chapter 4 Abhi shouted, “ Hide!” Everyone hid behind the huge rocks scattered on the ground. Huge dust cloud raised when the saucer landed. Everyone was petrified when they saw the saucer, because it was not a saucer but the mountain itself. A beautiful snow palace and the antique engine was also on the mountain. Vish said “ Guys I have informed my uncle about all these things happened here, he will be arriving here with the police at anytime.” Sandy started walking towards the landed mountain. Before Gi could stop Sandy, she went very close to the palace door. Unexpectedly, an alarm buzzed near the Antique engine. When Gi turned, the Antique engine and Sandy were missing. The Detective Brothers were shocked. They immediately ran towards the palace door and went inside and hid behind a door. Harsh saw a man and immediately recognized him and said, “I know him, he is the famous thief Subbu!” They called the police and told what all happened in the island. The police were already on their way to the island informed by uncle Sam. Inside Subbu’s palace, they saw two body guards guarding there. Abhi said, “Let’s wear the body guard’s dress and fool the guards!” “Let’s dress up like the guards to go inside the palace.” The Detective Brothers saw a control room nearby and went inside. There they saw few uniforms were hung. They wore them and went out of the control room and shouted at the body guards saying that there are a gang of thieves outside the palace. The guards immediately ran out. Gi said, “What a fool they are!” They went inside the palace. They saw a man sitting on a throne and was chatting with Sandy. Harsh said, “That man who is sitting on the throne is Subbu.” Subbu called Vivo, thinking he is a security and said, “ open the paint.” Vivo asked, “ I did not understand.” Subbu said, “You fool! (It means) I said, open the paint door which is on the first floor!” Vish said, “Let’s check what is inside it.” They went near the paint door and opened it and saw a key inside. Vivo said, “What we are going to do with this key?” Abhi said, “See there is a door, I think something is inside it?” Vish tried to lift the key but it was very heavy, then also they did not give up, all of them tried to lift it but failed. Abhi said, “We need one more person to lift, then we can easily succeed!” Vivo said, “Where is Adi?” Adi was looking at the interiors of the palace as if he has come for a picnic. Gi started to sing ‘I can see you!’. Abhi asked, “Oh! Come on, why are you singing!” Gi, “see someone is enjoying the interiors, so I am playing the background music.” Adi said, “ sorry guys! Come let’s lift the key.” They lifted the key and opened the door. To their surprise, inside the door was the antique engine! They came out of the room and saw Subbu was standing outside. When Subbu was about to hit them but the police came and arrested him. Sandy is the only person knows how to activate the antique engine. That is the reason Subbu kidnapped her. Now the antique engine is kept safely in the government museum and Subbu is behind the bars now. Happy ending! You can also share your reviews and follow me on Insta, facebook and youtube at Curious Adersh

title: A good hair day!
text: It was a beautiful day. Marta got ready and her mother took her to school. Marta enjoyed class and recess. She played with her friends. In the afternoon, when her mother came to pick her up, Marta looked sad. Her mother was worried and she asked Marta, " Honey, what's wrong?". title: The red shoes

title: Doesn't matter if black or colorful
text: One day, when the florid orange sun just rose, it was misty allover. 5 birds flew and sat on a lovely, bright tree having dark green leaves as it was their favourite season 'spring'. The birds were very kind to each other. They never went alone to any place unless any emergency or very necessary to do so. And there was a captain or a queen for that group. They took turns to become leaders, each week their leaders change. Bird Nina Bird Hinsa Bird Sam Bird Nala Bird Peepa That morning, they saw 4 more birds chatting and laughing loudly, sitting on a wire which does not have electricity as it is the wire, Mr. Jake the house owner tied it to two poles to hang his wet clothes in the morning. Bird Golu Bird Sina Bird Laali Bird Paila But a black bird named 'Lander' sat on a tree branch with tears dropping from his eyes. The 5 birds came flying near Lander to know the reason for his sadness. His reply was, "No one is taking me in their group and starts laughing at me. I feel lonely. But I have many praiseful talents. I can dance, sing, weave beautiful nest than everyone can do. No one is recognising my talents except me!" His heart was so much affected by the 4 birds who told him he was the ugliest and blackest. They are not knowing Lander is filled with talents. Bird Lander Those 5 birds consoled Lander and told, "Hunters mostly attack colourful birds for their color feathers. They keep them in cage, ask them to sing or dance. So you are the luckiest! Be happy dear friend! You can come in our team, we will be very kind and friendly to you. Now we will go to those 5 birds and explain your talents to them". Nina, Hinsa, Peepa, Sam and Nala flew towards those 4 birds. "Hi friends, I am Nina the queen, he is Sam, she is Nala, this is Hinsa, and she is Peepa", introduced Nina the Queen. "What! Queen?", asked Golu who was puzzled. Others were wondering, is she the queen of birds or the queen of her team. Please don't upset Lander's mind by telling him you're the ugliest and blackest. Suddenly Sina bursted out the puzzling question about the queen which went zzzzzzzzzzz in their minds. As a reply Nina told, "I am the Queen of our team, not the queen of birds". Laali questioned, "Then why are you ordering us? Are you very bossy?". Before Nina spoke, Hinsa rushed, "She is trying to be kind and requesting you not to hurt lander by harsh words which kindles and upsets him". "We want to become true friends with you, not to order you", Peepa sounded pleased. S ina, Golu, Paila and Laali was not bad but was a little mischievous. They understood that they all have come to become friends with them. So they apologised and happily told "Lets be friends forever". Lander smiled and said, "Thank you friends! I will just bring my food which I have stored, I have decided to stay with you all. I will surely share it to you guys too". When Lander flew away, they saw orange color on his back. Wow!, the birds grinned.' Lander told, "When I become happy, my back becomes orange".......... And then they all became best friends.!!!

title: Trouble with Exam
text: "TRING!" The school bell rang. All the children from class A ran outside screaming " YAY! School is over!". It was the second last day of school. They had their math exams today and they would have their English exams tomorrow. Mina and Mo dashed outside the door. They had to go home early! They had to study for their English exams! They took their English books home with them. Mina and Mo were really good at math but they were not really good in English. They always got bad grades and Baba always scolded them because of this. They wanted to impress baba this year by getting good grades in English. They decided to study as soon as they get home. They went home, dressed up and as they were looking at the first page of their English book, "KNOCK KNOCK" someone had knocked their door! Mina and Mo ran to see who it was. It was Mynah! Mynah said " HI Mina and Mo! Do you want to play skipping with me?" Mina looked at Mo. Mo looked at Mina. They both smiled and said "SURE!". They had completely forgot about their exam!😲 Mina Mynah and Mo went to the garden and played. Mina skipped singing " I like coffee, I like tea, I'd like for Mynah To skipped in with me" Then Mynah and Mina skipped together. Mynah sang " I like coffee, I like tea, I'd like for Mo To skipped in with me" All of skipped together for 1 HOUR! Just then Mo said " MINA! We have to go home and study!" Mina and Mo ran home. Mynah came with them because her house was just next to Mina and Mo's house but on the way they saw Ina. Ina ran to them and asked " Mina! Mynah! Mo! Come and Play with us in the park! Me and Rahul are playing slide tag! Come and play with us! Mina looked at Mo. Mo looked at Mina. Both of them said " Sure! We can play for 10 minutes!" Mynah joined them too. Oh no! Mina and Mo forgot about their exam again!😶😶 Ina, Mina, Mynah, Mo and Rahul played slide tag together. It was so much fun! " TAG!" Mina tagged Rahul. "TAG!" Rahul tagged Mo! " TAG!" Mo tagged Ina. They played and played. Not for 10 minutes, not for 20 minutes, they played for 60 minutes (1 hour)! Just then, Mina looked at her watch and said " Oh No! Time's up Mo! Come on!" Both of them said goodbye and were about to leave but, Akshat came and asked " Mina! Mo! I have no one to play with! Can you guys please play with me?" Mina and Mo did not want Akshat to feel bad so they agreed to play with him. "WUSH! WOOOSH!" They were swinging back and forth. Mina and Mo loved to swing! They could look at everything. The birds, trees, nests and many other pretty things. Akshat was pushing Mina and Mo. Akshat said " Mina! Mo! I am so excited for tomorrow! It is the last say of school and the last EXAM." Mina and Mo stared at each other. Oh No! They had forgotten again! They said bye to Akshat and ran home. When they almost reached home, they saw Kevin and Tara. Tara came running and said " MINA! MO! COME AND PLAY THE STONE GAME WITH US!" Mina and Mo loved the stone game so they could not resist. They both agreed to play for 15 minutes. They played and played. They were so lost in the game, they did not notice the dark sky. Suddenly Mina looked up and shouted " Ayo! Mo! Look at the dark sky! We did not even study for our English Exam!" Mo said " Bye Tara! Bye Kevin! We have to go!" Mina and Mo ran home quickly! They entered their house and started studying. " It was a sunny morning and chip chip the bird was making a new N-E-S-T on a B-E-A-U-T-I-F-U-L- tree." Mina read " Chip chip collected twigs, leaves and small C-O-T-T-O-N balls to make the nest C-O-M-F-Y." Mo read. Mina and Mo studied a lot but still did not understand anything. They did not want to ask Mama or Baba for help. They would scold them. Mo had an idea " Mina! I know! We can ask Anu Didi for help! She is really good at this stuff!" Mina smiled and said " YES YES! Good idea Mo! Let us go to Anu Didi's house now!" Mina and Mo run to Anu Didi's house. Anu Didi opens her door and smiles. " Hi Mina! Hi Mo!" Mina and Mo go inside. Mina says " Anu Didi! Me and Mo don't understand anything about a book. We really need your help Didi!" Anu Didi smiles and says " Oh children! If you practice every day and read every day, you will understand everything." Mo frowns and says " But Didi, our exam is tomorrow. What do we do?" Anu Didi looks surprised and asks them " WHAT? Didn't you study?" Mina and Mo shake their head. They tell Anu Didi about their day. Ano Didi says " Oh! Mina! Mo! You should never do this. It is very wrong to keep all the work for the night. You should learn to make decisions. You should know what is more important. Now tell me, what is more important? Studying for your exam or playing?" Mina and Mo say together " Studying!". Anu Didi says " Exactly. You should have studied earlier." Mina says " Yes Didi. We were wrong. We learnt our lesson. Now what do we do? We can't understand anything" " As I said, all you can do is practice. Here! Take these books and start reading.". Mo takes a book and reads " Mola the R-A-B-B-I-T was hanging out with Nai the D-O-G" " What does that mean?" Anu Didi asks. " I think that means that Mola was playing with Nai. Am I correct?" "Yes! Good job!" Anu Didi exclaims. " Mola and N-A-I loved to play C-A-T-C-H" Mina says. " Good! What does that mean?" " I think that means that they both like to paint." " No... It means that they love to play catch. You and Mo like to play catch right?" Anu Didi says. " YES!" Mina says. " The same way, they like to play catch too" Anu Didi says with a smile. They practice for 3 hours. After 3 hours, Mina and Mo go home. The next day when both of them go to class, everyone were revising for the test. Mina and Mo go and sit down. They take their books and start revising too. After some time, Ms Githa hands out their test paper. Mina and Mo were good at ELA now. They finished the paper and gave it to Ms. Githa. They couldn't have done it without Anu Didi's help. They also learnt a very good lesson. That is to make right decisions.
author: Niyati Makkithaya

title: PERSEVERANCE
text: The following story will give you an understanding on how a daily wage earner could succeed in life with a sincere and dedicated effort. Once there were two brothers Aarush and Niraj. Aarush was the elder brother and Niraj was the younger brother. With meagre income Aarush had to feed his family consisting of his wife and two chiidren apart from a younger brother Niraj. Since their parents died when these children were too young. Aarush as the older brother had to shoulder the responsibilities of the family. From childhood Niraj showed great interest in studies with the result scoring high marks in every class. Sensing the boy's excellent performance right from primary school, Aarush dreamt of making him a doctor.However,he did not reveal his wish to Niraj. But at the same time he started saving a part of his daily wages for the higher studies of his brother.Time passed and after his top ranking success in 10th Standard, Aarush told his brother Niraj of his long cherished wish. Niraj could not believe Aarush's words in view of huge funds involved for the studies. Then Aarush informed Niraj that he had long started saving some amount for his studies. Since Niraj was good in his studies they may be able to get some amount from Scholarships. Due to his hard work and support from his god like elder brother, Niraj went on to complete his MBBS and became and famed doctor. However, he did not forget his elder brother in his prosperity and asked his brother along with his family to stay with him for the rest of their life. This is a true story based on real life incident. MORAL Do good and love,affection and good will come to you.

title: The Story of Okapi
text: Once when god was creating one of his creatures - the animals he created an animal called Okapi. Okapi was plain and white-in-color and was teased by all the animals. Okapi was sad but he knew that kindness was more better than beauty and kindness shows our true beauty. So he set of finding an animal who was in need. Soon he came across a baby giraffe who was crying. ﻿ ﻿'Why are you crying?' asked Okapi ﻿to the baby giraffe. 'My mother is missing and I can't find her anywhere.' said the baby giraffe to Okapi. 'Don't worry. I'll help you find her.' said Okapi to the baby giraffe. Many hours later, they found the baby giraffe's mother who was also searching for her baby worriedly. The mother giraffe was overjoyed when she found her baby. 'Thank you for helping my baby giraffe find me.' said the mother giraffe to Okapi 'From now on you will be a part of our family. I bless you that you will have a face like us.' Okapi was delighted. As he was on his way to home he saw a zebra who was injured. He felt sorry for him. 'You're injured. I'll take you to the doctor' said Okapi to the Zebra. 'Thank you!' said the Zebra to Okapi. 'No one who has passed here passed here has helped me except you. You are very kind.'. Okapi took the Zebra to Doctor Bear. Doctor Bear said to Okapi 'His wounds will take some days to heal. You have behaved kindly to him by bringing him here. The Zebra said 'You are very kind and you will be a part of our family from now on. Your legs will have the pattern of our stripes. Okapi was delighted. On his way towards his home, he saw a horse who was panicking. 'Help, Help! The lion has broken my stable and eaten my friends. Now it is coming after me. Help!' the horse shouted. 'Don't worry. I'll help you.' said Okapi to the horse. He saw Mr.Porcupine coming that way. He had an idea. 'Mr.Porcupine, could you please stand in the lion's way and prick his eyes when he comes?' asked Okapi to Mr.Porcupine. Mr.Porcupine agreed. The horse watched interestedly. What was Okapi up to? As the lion came, Mr.Porcupine pricked the lion's eyes. The lion became blind and wondered how to reach the horse. Okapi whispered to the horse 'Now do as I say.'. And Okapi whispered the plan to the horse. The Horse shouted to the lion 'Over here! I am here!'. The confused lion tossed and turned around trying to find out where the horse was. The horse and Okapi kicked pebbles in lion's way. The lion fell down the pebbles and died. His skin splitted and out came all of the horse's friends. 'We are grateful to you for saving us. From now on you will be part of our family. You will have your skin colored as brown.' said the horses to Okapi. Okapi at last went to his home, happy that his true beauty was revealed. Okapi shares interesting points about himself to us. Hi. I am Okapi. I am also known as Zebra Giraffe, Forest Giraffe or Congolese Giraffe. According to IUCN* I am endangered for there are only about 10.000 - 32,000 Okapis left in the world. Wildlife conservationist John Lukas founded the Okapi Conservation Project (OCP) in 1987. * International Union for Conservation of Nature Protection of Okapi According to IUCN'S Red List of threatened species my friend is endangered. Though the tiger is Okapi's chief predator in the wild, human hunters pose a greater threat to Okapi's existence. In 2012, a Militia Group killed 14 Okapis at a conservation center located at the headquarters of the Okapi Conservation Project. The Okapi unusual appearance helps it to blend in with its native jungle environment and elude predators. John Lukas, founder of Okapi Conservation Project says that if Okapis were extinct it would be a great loss for the people of DRC*. the okapi is their symbol of their bountiful biodiversity and wild places, and as a symbol of ICCN, it would be a failure that would be difficult to overcome and a foreboding for the other endangered species that require protection to survive such as gorillas, chimpanzees and forest elephants. For the world, it would be the loss of a living fossil that has lived on earth for 7 million years and the only living relative of the giraffe. Not many would notice its passing, but the rainforest of DRC would have lost its flagship species that has rallied the world to care about the largest intact forest and the most biodiverse country in Africa. ﻿*Democratic Republic of Congo Will you protect the Okapis? Many people have been protecting Okapis for many years. You can also protect the Okapis. Here are some tips to protect Okapi. Talk about Okapis to people.. Try to find more facts about Okapi - it's eating habits, how the Okapi is the only living relative of the giraffe, why is Okapi helpful to the nature and more. Make it interesting by telling them how to protect Okapis and and giving them activities about Okapi. Invite some friends and people for an 'Okapi Learning Session'. Go to a shady, green spot and tell the audience how Okapi helps conserve the nature. Show them picture of tiger and explain how tiger is the chief predator of Okapi. Show them pictures of giraffe and zebra and tell them how they are related to Okapi. Talk about Okapi's food habits. Give them a book about Okapi and print interesting activities and the things you explained in the whole session. Make a book or website about Okapi. Make interesting activities which help learning about Okapi. Tell how you can protect Okapi and why should we protect Okapi. These are all suggestions to spread the word about protecting Okapi. You can also open an Okapi protecting project like John Lukas but remember that many hard work is needed to open such a center. You can make it your life's ambition to protect Okapis - the only living relative of the giraffe. You can spread the word about protecting Okapis on the World Okapi Day that is on October 18. Good Luck!!!
author: Advika Vijay

title: A Walk In  The Jungle
text: The Sailing River is sizzling beside it. Umbrellas of trees rising up as if trying to touch the sky. No, destitute, no voice. Probably immobile, stable. Definitely peaceful. But not literally. There is no silence in the forest. Speaks beetles. A huge brown woodpecker crumbles over the trees. Hulloke langurs with no tail, long arms shouted together. The call of the great Indian Dhanesh resonates throughout the forest. It is here in the morning as if an orchestral is playing in unison, and where all the residents of the forest are giving a voice, "Good morning, we have also woken up!" In this playful melodious tune, a keeper of the forest is at work. Zakhuma Don is investigating a camera trap placed on a tree along the river. He is the guard of the anti-poaching camp of the Mizoram Forest Department. He walks in the forest every day to make sure that nothing or person causes any harm to the forest. These camera traps, they help in monitoring the forest even while sleeping at night. Zakhuma sees pictures from the previous night captured in-camera. A picture of a hog-badger was printed here suddenly. And there is a picture of a big nose of Kakad! Zakhuma smiles. He is most fond of these moments. Zakhuma loves the forest and everything in it. It seems like last night was quite peaceful. Zakhuma loves to take pictures to know and understand the nature of animals. So when he goes out to visit the forest, he takes photographs and videos in his private room. Later he would share these pictures and stories with the local people of Mizoram and the people living far and wide, Let's share After all, very little information is available about the forests of North East India. Zakhuma has been able to take pictures of many unique animals such as the gray peacock pheasant ie the gray peacock pheasant and even a very rare leopard known as the cloven leopard in English. They now know that this leopard is very efficient ascending and its front teeth are very long. Hey one minute! what was it? Zakhuma looks at Apalak towards the video - three men secretly disappeared into the darkness. He replay the video. Zakhuma holds the camera trap back, and begins to search for clues they might have left. Perhaps they have come from a village in a resistance area outside the reserve? Zakhuma starts thinking. Mizo, Riang and Dodge * live around Dampa. Sometimes they come inside the reserve to collect timber, fishing or hunting, although this is prohibited. * Mizo, Riang and Chakma are the local tribes of northeast India. They are also called hill tribes. Zakhuma and his co-workers have been facing a threat in the jungle for some time. There are apprehensions. People have started planting many palm trees, Because palm oil extracted from fruits is sold very quickly. But the entire forest may be weak to make room for these gardens. The Forest Department spoke to people about the importance of saving forests and wild animals Has continuously done the work of spreading awareness. For the wrong thing The punishment given to the offenders is also explained. But Zakhuma knows that it will take time for change. Zakhuma quickly walks to the river bank. Suddenly he sees something that stops him. The hunters have laid a trap. They have kept a trap. A Kakad is stuck in it. Zakhuma's heart groans for that Kakad. How many times have they not seen such a scene, Yet every time they see an animal in pain, it hurts. Cautiously he approaches the scared Kakad deer. Luckily, despite being tired of trying to redeem himself, he is alive. Zakhuma immediately goes to work. After informing his department via radio, he tries to keep Kakad quiet until his arrival. In a while, help arrives and the visiting guards help cut the trap. Care is taken that the animal does not get hurt. As soon as he is released from the trap, Kakad jumps and runs away into the forest. Everyone is convinced that the buck was fine. But still, the work was not completed. The hunters will return to test the trap. Because of this, some crew members hide and wait for them. The dusk starts pouring in the dark and the wind sends the low-pitched sounds to the party's people. Zakhuma recognizes the three men seen in the camera trap video. The hunters proceed to steal. They have large cloth bags in their hands, in the hope that the hunt will return to them. Before they can escape, Zakhuma and his crew surround them. The hunters are caught and taken to the camp. The game is over very quickly! Officers will question him in the camp. Dampa is darkened. The wounds pass through steep mountainous areas, He returns, walking through a thick clump of trees and bamboo. He stops and hears the buzzing of the bamboo. As if bamboo is talking to them. These are the secrets of nature, these wonderful beautiful sensations that inspire Zakhuma to protect the forest every day. Nothing is easy - there is a war on the border, the hunters are getting furious, and their small income is a challenge in itself. But for them, all this is part of their day to day work. After all, the forest belongs to the forest, and the forest belongs to them. Meet Zakhuma Zakhuma works as a forest guard and wildlife photographer at the Dampa Tiger Reserve of the Mizoram Forest Department. It is one of the most remote and inaccessible tiger reserves in India. Zakhuma has learned photography himself. He has created a valuable collection of Dampa's bio-diversity photographs that include everything from plants, animals, insects, spiders, amphibians, snakes, birds, mosses and even fungi.
author: Haripriya P. J.

title: Selfish Friendship
text: Once a cat was caught in a hunter's net. A mouse used to live in a nearby hole. The mouse seeing the cat in the net started playing around the cat. Soon a mongoose came there. He wanted to kill the mouse. As he lifted his head, he saw an owl sitting on a tree trying to catch him. The mongoose went very near the cat's net to save himself. The mouse thought "When the hunter takes away the cat, the mongoose will not spare me and the owl is there to enjoy both of us." The Mouse went to the cat and said, "I can cut the net if you promise to save my life from the mongoose and the owl." The cat agreed. The mouse started cutting the net slowly and freed the cat only when the hunter was just near the cat. The cat took to heels and so ran the mongoose too. The owl was very much disappointed to see even the mouse running away to safety. A few days later, the cat being hungry, went to the hole of the mouse and requested him to come out for a game. The mouse replied, "I sought friendship and saved you to save my life." Now you can go home. MORAL: Don’t nurture friendship with selfish people.

title: Tennis Disaster
text: I quickly climbed down my bed and brushed my teeth, wipe my face and splat cream on my face. I was in a rush because I was really hungry. Gobble, gobble, gobble. I munched down my cereal. The cereal was delicious! I quickly moped my mouth then jumped down my chair. My day was starting to be wonderful! Suddenly, my dad asked me if I wanted to play tennis. Pop, my dream went off. I was daydreaming about living in a mansion, in my own private pool, hanging out with my friends and drinking cocktails. I answered glumly “ sure.”as me and my dad went into my mom’s bedroom. My dad helped me to pick up a big, red, tennis ball and set up the target. I was ready to start. Punk, went the ball. I hit the red tennis ball using the tennis racket. The ball fell down onto the hard concrete floor. My heart almost skipped a beat. I was trembling with sadness as tears streamed down on my face. I asked my dad if I could have a sip of water because I did not want my dad to see my tears. He replied “ sure, my dear.” After drinking water, my dad asked me “ why are you crying, my dear? “ I gasped. How did my dad know that I was crying? I asked him” how did you know that I was crying? My dad replied “ I saw the tear stains on your face.” Getting back to his question, I answered “ I was crying because I was disappointed that the ball went on the floor.” My dad told me “ your ball went on the floor because you were holding the racket the wrong way.” “ Then can you teach me?” I sniffed. “Sure, why not? My dad answered. Soon after my dad taught me how to hold the racket, I tried again. The ball fell on the floor again! But, this time, I did not cry. Instead, I tried again and again. Finally, the ball hit the target.” Yay!” I cheered. “ Good job.” My dad said. I learnt to never give up and always go forward even when things seem hard. Also, if you gave up, and actually, something good would happen? You will regret it your whole life. THE END
author: Allie  Cheung
