title: Under the bed
text: I wake up at night and I am very thirsty. I want to get a glass of water. I'm looking for my slippers under the bed. Oh my God! There's a tiger under the bed! What do I do now? ﻿ Should I call mom And what if the tiger growls? Should I just go back to sleep? But I am no longer tired. ﻿ Then someone turns on the light. Mama is at the door. "What happened, my darling?" "Did you call me?" asks mom. I point to the tiger. Mama bends down and pulls the tiger under the bed! Hey, that's not a tiger. This is my thick yellow and black jacket. Their buttons shine like tiger eyes. I had no reason to be afraid! Mama will get me some water. Now I will sleep. And dream of real tigers in the jungle!
author: Angel Liz varghese

title: The hat seller
text: One day, a hat merchant was going to a village to sell his hats. After walking for a long time, he was tired. So he sat under a tree to rest. He was so tired that he quickly fell asleep. While he was sleeping, a group of monkeys watched him from the tree. They climbed down the tree to take a closer look. They opened the bag and looked inside. They were delighted to find many different colored hats, just the right size. Quickly each monkey wore one of the hats! The monkeys happily danced in hats of red, blue, green, yellow, orange, purple and pink. Suddenly the hat merchant rolled over in his sleep and all the monkeys ran up the tree. When he woke up moments later, the monkeys looked at him and waited. The hat seller checked his bag. He was very sad to find it empty. There was no longer a single hat. Then he looked up and saw the monkeys wearing his hats! He thinks about how he could get his hats back. So he took off his own hat and threw it directly at the monkeys. The monkeys thought the hat merchant was trying to hit them and they were angry. So the monkeys took off the hats they were wearing and threw them one by one to the hat merchant. The hat seller gathered all of his hats and put them in his bag. The monkeys looked at him in amazement and he walked away to sell his hats, laughing.
author: Levin Leo

title: Ahilyabai Holkar
text: She went inside. Add oil to the lamp and stir. Gabhara was illuminated by that light. She closed her eyes and folded her hands before God. From Malwa province. He had gone to Pune. On the way, he stopped at the village of Choundi in Maharashtra. And the elephants and horses that Ahilya saw were all his. Malharrao thought, “This girl is different from others. This girl will be a wife for your son Khanderao. ” Early marriages were taking place in those days. Holkar's daughter-in-law Ahilya is the daughter of Patil Mankoji Shinde of the village. From a simple shepherd family. In those days girls were not taught. At that time, it was customary for a woman to look only at home and family. But Ahilyabai's father had a different opinion. He had taught Ahilya to read and write. Within a few days, Ahilya came to Indore as the daughter-in-law of Holkar from Malwa. And then she made history. She became the queen! A very real ruler! Who was Ahilyabai? Maharani Ahilyabai ruled over the Malwa region of the Maratha Empire 300 years ago. He ruled for 28 years. In particular, extremely just and dutiful.His reign (1767 to 1795) as a ruler flourished. This period dates back to the 18th century. Of the Maratha Empire under the leadership of the Peshwas of Pune Prosperity was at that time. From Thanjavur in present day Tamil Nadu The flags of Maratha prowess were flying till Peshawar in Pakistan. Shinde of Gwalior and Holkar of Indore helped the Marathas to succeed in the north He had a big share. Malharrao Holkar was brave and dutiful. He is known as the first Maratha Subhedar of Malwa province in Central India. After him, Ahilyabai took care of Malwa. Ahilyabai took care of the people with love! He also did a lot of charity. Destroyed temples were rebuilt and ghats were built, hence they were also called Punyashlok Ahilyabai. Even if they had done so, they would have gone down in history. But the leap of his accomplishments was huge. Crisis Series (1754) Ahilyabai's life was never quiet. Shocking events were happening one after another. She was only 29 years old at the time. The Kumbheri fort in Rajasthan was besieged by the Marathas. At that time the fort was in the possession of the Rajputs. The battle was raging. Ahilyabai's husband Khanderao was unconscious. Just then, a ball of gunfire erupted and Khanderao collapsed. His death was a great shock to the family.Do you know of any wicked practices of that time? When the husband died, the wife would jump on his leopard and go to Sati. That is, to burn oneself while alive. Because at that time it was wrong for a wife not to live if her husband was not alive! Sati is now banned in India. Ahilyabai also went to Sati. In those days men had more than one marriage. Khanderao also had three wives. The other two passed away. But her father-in-law Malharrao stopped Ahilyabai at the very last moment! They were not allowed to go to Sati. Distressed, he said, “My only son has been killed in battle. Now don't jump into this leopard. If you left, who would we look to? Now you are like a child to me. ” All the expectations of Malharrao are now on Ahilyabai.Were gathered. He knew that his daughter-in-law was more capable than his son. Arrogant After that Malharrao used to go on campaigns to fight and Ahilyabai used to see the rule of Malwa. Malharrao trained him in administrative and military work. Despite being on distant missions, he wrote several letters to Ahilyabai regarding governance. At that time it was customary to take the family with them during the war. With your husband and father-in-law Look at an incident which shows how much faith Malharrao had in Ahilyabai's deeds. Once on a mission, he sent a message to Ahilyabai, “Go to Gwalior and set up an ammunition factory. The artillery should be ready. ” Was it a little easy to set up a factory to make such ammunition? But it was achieved by Ahilyabai! Hundreds of people were needed to do this work. It would take a hundred and a half oxen to carry a gun. Ahilyabai to the people Make the right choice. That is why this difficult task started so fast. Glorious mention In his book 'Discovery of India', Pandit Nehru has proudly mentioned Ahilyabai. He has said, "Ahilyabai's 30-year rule was ideal enough to make a legend. That great administrator.And were the organizers. People look up to him as a highly respected person. After his death, people gave him the same status as the saints. ”The British historian John Kay called her the Philosopher Queen. John Malcolm was a British officer in Central India, but Ahilyabai's work had left a lasting impression. While collecting some of his memories after Ahilyabai's death, he realized that the people of Malwa see her as a goddess. He has written, "Who is the most sattvic and ideal ruler so far, this is the queen." Who will be the Subhedar now? Fifteen years after Khanderao's death, Malharrao, the father-in-law of Ahilyabai, died. He was 21 years old. But Ahilyabai would take care of the daily affairs. Unfortunately, the boy remained a nobleman for only nine months. He was mentally unstable. At this stage, a weaver from the village died at his hands.Ahilyabai was so unjust that she even made this kind of impartial inquiry. It turned out that there was nothing wrong with that weaver. Maloji began to feel very guilty. His mental state became so bad that he died in it. Shining mastery Maloji's death was a very difficult and extraordinary test for the state. Even though Ahilyabai was in charge of the affairs even when she was a boy, her name was Maloji as Subhedar. It was not acceptable at that time to give full subhedari to wives. I mean, power could go now. There were many attempts to seize the state. Besides, the opponents were wondering what the lone woman would do. One of them is.Ahilyabai's Diwan Gangobatatya. They plotted an evil plot. For this he called Raghobadada Peshwa to Maheshwar from Pune Do you know this Raghobadada? He is the uncle of Madhavrao Peshwa. Notorious as a conspiracy. He was unhappy that the Peshwa was not found. It was Gangobatya's instinct that Raghobadada would secretly come to Maheshwar and take charge of Malwa. However, Ahilyabai's system of secretly extracting information was extremely cumbersome. They had a hint of this cut. He immediately summoned Tukoji Holkar, a trusted officer in his army, to Maheshwar. He then wrote a letter saying, "Let me take charge of this place and appoint Tukoji Holkar as the Chief of Army Staff."Madhavrao sent Peshwas. Besides, he sent letters to Shinde, Bhosale, Dabhade and Gaikwad asking the great chiefs of the Maratha Empire to stay by their side. Called in their troops. Ahilyabai was now on fire to Irela. He sent a message to Raghob, “Naturally, a woman should not come to fight with a man. Not yours, but yours. ” Then they made another play. Raghoba had come to Ujjain till then. She left to meet them. But how So, with all your army, horses, elephants in full entourage! It was like a big procession. Ahilyabai was sitting next to her favorite elephant. Arrows were pierced in the four corners of the amber. People were flocking to see their brave and beloved queen, cheering her on. It was an unprecedented ceremony that showed the love, appreciation, respect and loyalty of the people. Ahilyabai's bravery, diplomacy, hard work and faith in the people finally won. Madhavrao Peshwa persuaded his uncle to accept Ahilyabai's rule.Ahilyabai moved her capital from Indore to Maheshwar on the banks of the Narmada Simplicity in wealth Ahilyabai was the richest ruler in the Maratha Empire! But their fort was very simple. The Holkar family's specialty was that they never used state money for personal expenses. Sitting on a simple blanket and wearing a white cotton sari to fill the court every day! What many women still have to fight for today Trade flourished during the time of Ahilyabai. The peasants and the army rejoiced. The capital was overrun by literature, music and art. Weavers, craftsmen, sculptors and artists used to get honors and salaries. Flourishing textile business Beautiful cotton fabrics and fine silk are still the hallmarks of Maheshwar. The Maheshwari sari is famous there. The weaving business flourished there because of Ahilyabai. Maheshwar's cloth was so good that even big men in the Peshwa court used to order it. He also started a textile mill in Maheshwar city. Maximum of foresight Another sign of a good king is foresight! Ahilyabai was the best in this regard. Ahilyabai was one of the few people who recognized the great danger of the British. Ahilyabai strongly felt that the emperor of Delhi and all the Maratha chiefs should come together and fight the British. They knew that the European way of fighting was different. So a French general was appointed to the Holkar army. He built four European-trained battalions. In 1772, Ahilyabai wrote a letter to the Peshwas. Close to the English He gave an example of how dangerous it is to have a relationship It was given. He wrote, “It is a bear to hug the British It's like embracing. ” Ajramar Smriti (1795) He died in 1795 at the age of seventy. In 1996, the Government of India issued a postage stamp in his name as a tribute to such a great ruler. In his memory, Indore Airport was renamed as Devi Ahilyabai Airport and Indore University was renamed as Devi Ahilya University. Good work in public life Everything for the people Ahilyabai maintained the motto 'People are more important than herself' throughout her life. The words carved on his castle are eloquent enough: "My job is to make the people happy. I am responsible for my every action. I want to answer to the Lord for everything I do. ”
author: Vaishnav  Rajan

title: Was it a bad day?
text: It was valentines day, Clara had not received even one valentine card.She sat in the corner of the living room, sad and glum. She did not expect to be this years valentines day so. In fact it was the worst valentines day Clara ever experienced. That's when Claras mother came there asked why are you feeling so blue today? Anyway, come to the kitchen. " I don't want my tongue to be sad as well, i would rather not eat the green things you give me if I could!" Clara; i know you did not receive any cards this year but that does not mean no one loves you; By the way, I did make something that would turn that frown upside down! " Clara had a sudden enthusiasm in her heart but kept quite. " PANCAKES! Clara was as happy as a sand boy! The pancakes looked appetizing! Maple syrup drizzled over them and looked like waterfalls. Subsequently, she felt better. She went to sleep and had a dream where she felt into an endless pit, once again she was down in the dumps. She felt like she was not a good enough friend and thought her dream meant that here friends threw her in that pit. Looking out of the window, she saw Oliver being all suspicious and roaming around Claras houses mailbox. She had butterflys in her stomach. She thought that either he came to give a valentine card or he was spying on her. Then she had an idea, why not just confront him about his behavior? Right? But surprisingly, Oliver was delighted to see her! His smile was sweet and innocent, so Clara calmed down a little. She casually asked him why he was standing beside her mailbox for 30 minutes....He said" HAPPY VALENTINES DAY!!!!" Well, Clara recalled her day She had scrumptious pancakes She slept like a log and well, she got what she wanted a card!! Her day wasn't that bad after all, was it? MORAL-Never think no one loves you, you deserve all the lovein the world, if you are sweet to someone they will be sweet to you.

title: High in the tree
text: Where have you been?" Mom asked angrily. ﻿ Dara replied, "You know, there is a tall tree outside our school. I climbed this tree. It's too high and it's reaching into the sky." "I looked down and saw white clouds. I looked up, but I heard the leaves laughing "I don't think the leaves can laugh! Then I found out that the squirrel hiding under the leaves was giggling." "The big squirrel asks me to eat a lot of nuts. The little squirrel is playing hide and seek in my hair!" "We played for a long, long time, until I remembered that it was time to go home. But I don't know how to climb down the tree!" "The squirrel started calling for help. You should hear these sounds! Haw--chiw--chiw--" "Fortunately, a purple plane flew across the sky. Can you believe that the pilot heard the squirrels cry?" "The plane descended from the sky. The pilot picked me up and drove me home." "Mom, that's why I came back so late." "Dara! Don't make up stories and make excuses," Mom said "Haw-- "Haw-- "Haw—"

title: Thommy and Tingu
text: I have a puppy. His name is Thommy. I like Thommy very much. ﻿ This is Rohan. Rohan is my best friend. We are students of the same class. ﻿ Rohan has a big cat. Her name is Tingu. ﻿ She is always angry. ﻿ Thommy and I stay away from Tingu. We call her Tingu the Tigress.

title: Imandari Ki Roti
text: Once, there was a dog named Sommy. Sommy was a street dog. One day, a boy passing by the street offers him a roti. Sommy took away roti to eat it. title: Monkey And The Pencil
text: Chatpat was a playful monkey. He leapt from tree to tree all day long eating mangoes,guavas and bananas that hung from lower branches. chatpat was a tiny monkey and he was scared to climb too high One day,when chatpat was jumping about,he spotted an open window. He looked closely n saw something shiny lying on the ledge chatpat took a flying leap. The next moment he was at the window.the shiny thing was a red and yellow coloured pencil. Chatpat loved the colour piece of wood it was bigger than an ordinary pencil and thicker, too. Chatpat looked around.No One was watching him.He grabbed it and ran away!Chatpat scampered up a tree and made himself comfortable on a branch I wonder what it tastes like" he thought putting the pencil in mouth. yuk he promptly spat out. Now what do I do with this? he wondered. Then he remembered,Hey I can use it to break fruit from the higher branches."And he did just that With the pencil he struck down many fruits which he ate and he ate and he ate till he could eat no more This is very useful, he said to himself, I am going to keep it. Now that his stomach was full, chatpat got into a playful mood. He saw a rabbit munching a carrot. He tickled his ears with the penci. Alarmed,the rabbit ran into the bushes haha laughed chatpat. Then he saw a squirrel nibbling a pine nut. chatpat gently tapped her tail with pencil.The squirrel dropped the nut and ran away!Chatpat found that very funny. Next, chatpat saw an elephant snoring under a tree. With the pencil he playfully stroked its trunk. The elephant woke up with a start. before he could react, Chatpat hopped out of his way! He tapped the beehive with the pencil. All of a sudden,thousands of bees buzzed out. the honey dripped to the bhalu bear happily lapped up honey. The bees swarmed around chatpat and stung him all over. He cried. The other monkey heard him cry came to his rescue.They threw mud on him. they asked to roll on the ground. It is good thing no one missed it, Chatpat thought as he put the pencil back on the ledge. Just then chat pat saw the little boy come to the window. he saw the pencil and said hey! that is mine! “the little boy picked up the pencil and started drawing a picture of chatpats

title: Didi's colorful treasure
text: There was a large ground near his house. The field was of a strange type. There were no trees, no plants, just garbage. The entire city was full of thrown things and filth. Those children did not go to school. The whole day was spent walking in the field. Used to search for plastic bottles. Used to remove cloth pieces… They knew a lot about waste. One day, Didi came to the garbage field. A red scarf was draped around the neck. She sat in a place, staring at the wandering children. She started looking at something from her bag. First the children were staring from a distance. Then came a little closer and started looking. Didi had plenty of books. Thick, thin, colorful, full of stories. The children kept coming closer. Sister started coming everyday. The children also started coming to the sister. He started listening to a lot of stories from Didi. In a few days, he started reading letters and words. Slowly they started telling stories. Let's make Didi's place beautiful. The children brought a chair-table from the trash. Someone brought a rug, some curtain. Brought some piece of luggage from somewhere, which was also found in the trash. Didi did not come one day. The next day did not come either. Troubled children kept waiting. Started reading the book in many things. Started reading and teaching himself. One day he finds Didi's address in the book. The children immediately set out to search for Didi. Do not forget to carry a bag of books together. While searching, the children read the number of a bus. While walking, I understood the name of that road. Because Didi had taught them all. Where is Didi's house? Where is it? Children got upset after searching. Going back tired, someone saw a red scarf. Sister was lying on the bed. She was looking sick and sad. There was neither a smile nor a glow on the face. The doctor gave medicine. But the sister was not recovering. The children ran and reached there. Sister was hugged. Showed them a bag of books. Children read something. Sister smiled again. Her eyes began to glow. Now the sister is coming again. All the children are beginning to gather. Have started meeting every evening. Have started laughing and reading a lot. Together, children are having fun, children, sisters and their books!
author: Vaishnav  Rajan

title: A Prankful Diwali
text: It was a winter evening, the one before Diwali. It was both cold and hot at the same time. The cool winter breeze made you shiver while the diyas and lights provided warmth. Unfortunately, crackers burst every few minutes. They looked beautiful, but their light revealed the smoke, the true sinner. I was excited yet worried. Diwali was being celebrated with great pomp, however many people were meeting and hugging each other without wearing a mask. I decided to be on the safe side and never took off my mask. My brother and I were pranksters and we decided to pull a great prank on our parents. One day, they went outside with the excuse of “an important meeting”. However, I discovered that there were some Diwali gifts presumably for us in the car’s back trunk. How I discovered it will remain anonymous since a magician never reveals his secrets. I whispered to my brother, “You know, Mom and Dad went to get gifts for us. I have a great idea.” “What idea?” A head peeked out from the newspaper. “Nothing, Dad.” I decided to tag my brother along with me to my room. “Remember the shoe boxes that you decided to hoard? They seem to be the same size as the gifts. We will get some wrapping paper and wrap each shoe box in it.” On going to the shop, Dukandar bhaiya looked at us in resentment. “What are you doing here?” “Bhaiya, we are just here for some gifts for Mom and Dad. We need to wrap them in some gift wrap.” “Then why is your brother playing with the toy cockroaches?” My brother seemed to have a private brain wave. He was going to put toy cockroaches in the shoe box. “Oh, I don’t know, bhaiya. His new hobby is researching insect anatomies.” We paid him (with some extra tips for not kicking us out) and sneakily scurried away. Our master plan was finally coming to fruition. My brother shoved a few cockroaches in both boxes and I wrapped it in the paper. He was not so good at wrapping things, but better at tearing it apart on Christmas. We carefully put the boxes in the same position as the real gifts. When Diwali finally came, my parents held the gift behind their hands, pretending there was totally no gift there. “I want you to open it for me,” I said. “Why?” “Pleaseeeeee”, I insisted. My mother reluctantly opened it. She let out a big scream and dropped the box. I fake screamed, but inside I was trying not to laugh. My father immediately knew that I was the culprit. However, my brother stood up for me. “Dad, I did it. I put the cockroaches in the box.” Which was technically true, however I was the leader of this operation and I was to be blamed. I will never look at my brother the same way again. Who knew he had compassion in his heart? We finally decided to laugh it off. My mother found the hiding place where I kept the real gifts. My father opened the box of sweets, my favourite part of Diwali. The Diwalis before this were all the same, but this year I decided to do something different. This was the best Diwali I have ever had.
author: Aryamaan Goswamy

title: The Mango Girl

title: Clock 'O' Meter
text: It was a bright sunny day. Pinky was lying in her bed and looking at the picture of clock. That day, She refused to eat food from his father. She was getting late for school. She was screaming here and there not willing to go to school. That day in the evening she went to the park. There her friends were saying that today a Magician has come to school to teach magic tricks. She became sad because she has not gone to school today and missed the tricks. Pinky told this to her mother, and her mother explained, "You should obey time then only time will obey you otherwise time will run away and you will not be able to fulfill your dream and learn new things. To fulfill your dream you need to go to school on time". Pinky said, "You are right from tomorrow I will go on time to school to fulfill my dream, and also I will do my daily activity on time so that I will get extra time to learn new things". The next day, She went to school on time and came back". After coming, She helped her mother with the daily chores, ate food, and done her homework on time. She feeds her dog on time. She went to sleep early in the night. Her mother came and saw her from the door. Her mother was happy that Pinky has now understood the importance of time. The next morning, Pinky wake up and said to herself, "I will always obey time and will do everything on time otherwise it will run away, and happily she went to school on time".

title: The dragonfly and the frog
text: She chose a beautiful leaf and she leant against it. Soon it stopped raining. The sun came out bright. ﻿ Flying, she found herself in front of a beautiful tree. When he was a tadpole other frogs made fun of his voice, only a dragonfly became his friend. From then he sings only for them. At that point, the dragonfly decided to stay near the pond for a while and listen to the frog's beautiful song.

title: Fluffy and the Ducklings
text: One morning in spring, Farmer David said, "I see that Fluffy wants to raise some more chickens. I think I will let her raise some ducks instead. I will get some duck eggs when I go to town this afternoon." When Farmer David came back, it was dark. Fluffy was fast asleep. He carefully picked her up and put duck eggs in the nest. Then, he put her back in the nest. When Fluffy woke up, she was surprised that she had already laid two eggs. And, she was also surprised that her eggs were bigger than last year’s eggs. It took 28 days for the eggs to hatch. Fluffy was worried that they were not going to hatch, because her last eggs took 21 days to hatch. She waited for a week, and then, they hatched. Fluffy was happy but also confused, because the babies were growing faster and they looked different than her other babies had. She kept on trying to feed worms to the little ducklings, which she thought were chicks. But, the ducklings did not like them as much. They kept on going out into the yard to eat grass. Also, the ducklings were going to the pond a lot. Fluffy didn’t understand why the ducklings liked to be near the water so much, because she didn’t like to be near the water and none of the chickens she had ever known liked water. One day, Fluffy found her babies swimming in the pond. She realized they were ducks. A fairy appeared and cast a wonderful spell making Fluffy and her babies be ducks one day and chickens the next. Like that, they lived happily ever after. But, Farmer David never understood why some days he had chickens and other days, ducks.

title: Gel in space
text: I want the stars to wish me a happy birthday And the sun, and the moon too. wake up in the morning Look what I see... There is a missile waiting outside I try to hide my happiness The missile has been launched My bags are packed and complete Now, I am a Gel Astronaut! My cat is shaking and shivering My head turns and turns In a few minutes we'll be off the ground Six hours later... This is my new home in outer space It is called the space station Hello my new home, you are a beautiful place! We go from one stage to the next, I can hardly feel my legs. And quickly we roll on our heads! Then we floated up in the air To the left and to the right. Through the air we move And we roll on each side My bag rolls upside down And out of it all the sweets Desserts I carefully packed I think the whole dessert has lost its mind!! I'll stick to packaged space foods! My hair is getting sticky And my clothes are now in a mess And my cat is trying to lick me to clean up Bathing will solve everything But there is a little secret There are no taps in the space I'll wet this towel And I will wipe my face with it Then I will squeeze some shampoo into my hair And I'll rub it well After the final cleaning My hair now looks clean and neat I'll wear my space suit Because it is a very special day Come join me in the fun Let's go out in space Step by step I go outside I crawl slowly It is dark, cold and calm The stars are clearly shining It looks great and very close The moon is smiling... as if to say Happy birthday, dear gel. Time to go back And get some rest Space travel was very tiring That was scary... but the best of times This is where I need to sleep, I need to sleep in my bed for the next few days Relaxing in bed is really great fun The belt must be tied while I sleep in my place I wake up after some time, We can't waste a minute But first I go brush my teeth And swallow all the toothpaste! I want to talk to my mom, The laptop is screwed into place "Hello who is this?" "I'm a gel from outer space!" I tell her about the things I've done, On the magic that exists in space And how the Earth looks so far from here I have lived in space for two whole months, Time to go back... Away I hear some children wishing for a trip to the moon Raise your hand if you also want to go to the moon And keep all your bags organized Me and my cat will be back tonight It will soon be your turn Do you know? - You need to sit inside a rocket to go into space. There are different types of rockets, but the most popular ones are the one used by Gel and its cat, and the rocket takes them to the International Space Station, which has been Gel's home in space for two months, and they use a spacecraft called Soyuz to return to Earth from the International Space Station. There is a specially designed spacecraft going from Earth to the International Space Station carrying food, water, and other things that astronauts need to live there. Jel must be careful in using water inside the space station. Because every drop is precious. Gel and other things on the International Space Station also float like balloons. Anything untied will float up, because things are weightless in space. There are no taps inside the International Space Station because water cannot flow in an environment where things have no weight. So she should use a special shampoo that does not need to be rinsed off, and she also swallows toothpaste. If you accidentally leave the water bag gel open, the water droplets will float in the space station and combine to form a large ball of water.

title: How does the Rainbow form.
text: It was dark. A girl and a boy were lost in the forests. They were worried. Would they find their way home? At last, through the mazes and the tunnels of the forest they found their way home. Then there was a bright flash, then a loud sound. Thunder! It was raining!!! They managed to reach home, but they were soaked in water. They bathed and changed their clothes. They brushed their teeth and went to bed. Next day, the boy, who's name was Hari remembered that he had seen a rainbow yesterday when it was raining. He wondered how the rainbows formed. He pondered over it for a long time. He was deep in thought. Suddenly his little sister called him. 'Bhaiya! Come on! Mummy has called us for snacks!' she shouted. 'Coming!' shouted Hari. At the table, Hari's little sister, Shila noticed that her Bhaiya seemed to be deep on thought. 'What's the matter Bhaiya?' Sheela asked. 'I'm wondering how the rainbows form.' said Hari. Now Shila also thought about it for a long time. She finally said, 'Bhaiya, let's go to the library and read a few general knowledge books.We might find the answer.'. 'A great idea!!! Let's go there after finishing snacks.' said Hari. They went to the library after finishing snacks. Together they read lots of books. Finally, Hari shouted, 'I've found it! I've found the answer!'. 'Pass it to me! I'll read it!' said Shila. Shila read it out. As soon as they read it they felt they were in it themselves. Hari said 'Look, look at the sky.'. 'Wha-a-a-t? Wait. I'll also look.' said Shila. As they both looked, they saw that a huge bow in the sky was forming. 'What is that?' asked Hari. 'It's a rainbow!!!' said Shila. Rainbows are sunlight and water. When it has just rained, or is about to rain, there is water in the air. There are billions of droplets of water. When sunlight hits the droplets, it shatters and we see all the colors of light. The colors of sunlight are red, orange, yellow, green, blue, indigo and violet. Light from the sun colors our world. Light can bounce, scatter, shatter or be absorbed, the way a sponge absorbs water. We see sunlight as white. So when light bounces, it comes back to us the same color - white. When light is absorbed, it goes away and we see darkness. And we see all different colors when light is scattered or shattered. An Irish legend says that there is a pot of gold at the end of every rainbow. Each year on April 3rd, National Find A Rainbow Day challenges us to look to the sky and find a colorful ray of hope cast across it. There are people that see rainbows as an artistic masterpiece in the sky, to others it is a sign of hope and to many a sign of promise. Happy International Rainbow Day!!! Next time you're at a waterfall, or a big water fountain, stand with the sun behind you and try to find a rainbow through the water spray. Try Out.
author: Advika Vijay

title: What is at the end of a rainbow?

text: This is an Isisaurus dinosaur. A birdlike dinosaur called Bambiraptor was named after the Disney Character Bambi.It is only two and a half feet (76 cm) long. A girl in England named Mary Anning was 12 when she found her first dinosaur. People did not live at the same time as dinosaurs. Some dinosaurs made nests and laid eggs. Some dinosaurs made whistling and clacking sounds. Some dinosaurs could fly while some could swim. Most of the dinosaurs lived up to a hundred years old. Horseshoe Crabs, Jellyfish and Dragonflies were some animals who lived with dinosaurs. Dinosaurs have been extinct for millions of years but it's bones are still being found. They have become fossils. First, the dinosaurs had to die in sand or mud, so it would get covered over and preserved. After a very, very long time the ground became rock and bones became fossils. This is how the bones became fossils. Did you know that you can celebrate dinosaur day? June 1st is International Dinosaur Day. The third Tuesday in May is also International Dinosaur Day. So readers, don't forget to celebrate and pool in all your information about dinosaurs. Happy International Dinosaur Day!!!

title: Why You Need a Job?
text: A person goes to an office or any other workplace to work or do a job. But, why must you have a job? There are many reasons for it. A job gives you a monthly paycheck or salary. You earn your bread and butter and put food on your table with that salary. Your salary also helps to pay bills such as house rent, electricity bill, internet bill, school fees, hospital expenses, and many more. A job allows you to exhibit your skills and talents. A job gives you self-confidence and self-respect. If you love to travel or have other interesting hobbies, the savings from your salary helps a lot. You can save money for your retirement. Above all, a job gives you the satisfaction of contributing to and giving back to society.

title: Happy Diwali
text: Diwali or Deepavali is a festival of lights. Diwali symbolizes the victory of light over darkness, good over evil, and knowledge over ignorance. People light diyas in their home and burst crackers. People shop for new clothes and wear new dresses. They give sweets and gifts to neighbours. Some draw kolams and rangoli designs on the floors. Many clean their homes so that they sparkle. The Diwali date of a year comes anywhere between mid-October and mid-November. In 2017, it was on October 19. In 2021, it is on November 4. Diwali is celebrated by Hindus to mark the victory of Lord Krishna over demon Narakasura. For some, it also signifies the return of Lord Rama to his kingdom Ayodhya after defeating Ravana. You can celebrate Green Diwali to reduce the pollution caused by crackers in the atmosphere. You can minimize the use of crackers that emit too much smoke or are too loud. Happy Diwali to all of you! May you sparkle as bright as the festive lights.

title: Sonic the Guinea Pig in a Speed Challenge
text: Sonic the Guinea Pig and the speed battle By Andreas Maginas One day, Sonic the guinea pig was at home and the owners left. Sonic, Tails, and Snowflake had an emergency call. Smoothie and Luna got it too. The boss Rula sent them on a mission. The evil guinea Jumper, was trying to destroy them, and their base. They got in their suits and went to save the base. When they got there, Jumper was waiting for them. And Jumper was in his evil suit then they got out there carrot swords and they started a battle. They got home, just in time before their owners got there. Then the owners, Andreas and Stephen, held Sonic and Tails for a little bit. Then they had to leave to do more errands. They had no idea what their guinea pigs had been up to while they were gone. Later they got another emergency call. The problem was, their owners were back home. What would they do? Jumper was trying to knock over one of the biggest buildings in town, so they thought they should stop him. They had to wait until their owners went to bed, then they got in their suits, jumped in their megazords, and they went out the garage. The owners wondered what was happening to the garage, and the guinea pigs walked to the building and saw jumper waiting for them. Jumper said "we were expecting you." Jumper and his robot had a chain saw and were trying to saw down the building. The chain saw was a big as their megazords. They had to stop it. They used their giant sword to fight it off, but it didn't really work. They all had to use really good weapons to stop the giant chain saw holding robot. Then they hopped out of their megazords and used a giant laser to melt the chain saw and it worked. They were excited because they had been trying to destroy it for a long time and they finally did it. Jumper and the robot got angry, so they got out their swords, and sonic, tails and snowy got their ultimate guinea ranger suits and ran to battle. Jumper challenged sonic to a race after they were done sword fighting. Sonic was really fast. Snowy and Tails cheered as loud as they could, but it only came out as "wheeks." Sonic and Jumper started to run. And in the middle of when they were running, they got out their swords and fought each other. They were angry at each other, so they fought as hard as they could. Sonic got to the end before Jumper and won the race. Jumper was sad and wanted to fight even more, but with their megazords, they destroyed him. I t created an explosion. This knocked the robot into a pool and it stopped working. Nobody saw it again. They got home just in time to see their owners in the morning. They got held, a nice breakfast, and took a nice nap. The End.
author: Kids Maginas

title: Little caterpillar has lost his shoe!
text: She has pain in her foot from walking. Little caterpillar decides to go see Madame Spider. "Can I borrow a shoe from you?" " But Madame Spider's shoe is too small. Little caterpillar is sad. He misses his shoe. Little caterpillar decides to go see Madame Grenouille. "Can I borrow a shoe from you?" " But Madame Grenouille's shoe is too big. Little caterpillar decides to go see Madame Sauterelle. "Can I borrow a shoe from you?" " But Madame Grasshopper's shoe is too itchy. Little caterpillar decides to go see Monsieur Crab. "Can I borrow a shoe from you?" " But Mr. Crab uses his shoes to dig the sand. They are too sharp to walk. Little caterpillar is too tired to continue his research. She curls up against a leaf to rest. Little caterpillar decides to make a cocoon cozy to sleep in. The days pass. When Little caterpillar finally comes out of its cocoon... She no longer needs shoes!

title: The Lazy Pumpkin
text: One day, all the vegetables were planning to go out for playing. They all asked pumpkin to join them. But, the pumpkin was very lazy. He said, "I will sleep and enjoy". They all knew that pumpkin was lazy; he would not come so they walked away. Raddish and Onion were playing together hide and seek. Chilli was trying to get down from the branch to play with them. Green leaf was also shouting from a distance, "Hey all I am also coming". Pumpkin was looking at all these. He thought, "I should also join them and enjoy". He went there and said to all, "Please Can I also join". Then everyone said to him, "Yes, you can but next time please don't become lazy". They explained to him, "If you will be lazy then you will become a rotten pumpkin". He agreed and happily started playing with them. All the vegetables had a wonderful day. Happily, they all went home in the evening.
author: Mansi Paniya

title: Cooko-do-coo-coo
text: Once there lived a hen which always said Cooko-do-coo-coo. The villagers were irritated with its sound. The villagers went to the owner and asked him to make the hen keep quite. That day the owner killed the hen and sold it to a shopkeeper for Rs. 500. After a week the owner understood what he did was wrong as he did not have eggs to eat. He prayed to the god to give him another hen. After a moment he heard a hen’s Cooko-docoo-coo sound and he rushed towards it happily. The villagers did not complain as he told that the god had gifted the hen and it helped him by selling its eggs and helped the villagers by waking them up at sharp 5:00 am.
author: Adithya Manoj

title: The Little Dinoo
text: Long ago, there was an island. There were very few people on the island. One day, a spaceship landed on the island. A dinosaur came out of the spaceship. The little green dinosaur named Dinoo started jumping in joy by looking here and there. Suddenly, he saw a boat and thought of exploring the island. He sat in the boat and started rowing the boat. He became happy by looking at the flowers and greenery. But, after some time he realized that he is lost. He thought of getting out of the boat to find the way. After going at a distance, he met with an old man. He told him, "My name is Dinoo and I am lost on this island". He showed a photograph of his spaceship which was lost somewhere on the island. The old man said to him that I will help you in finding your spaceship. They both started searching for the spaceship everywhere on the island. The old man started imaging that when we will find the spaceship I will ask Dinoo to give me a ride before going back. Finally, the old man found the spaceship. He started dancing in the joy that he will have a ride in the spaceship. Dinoo gave a ride to the old man in the spaceship. Both the old man and Dinoo were enjoying a lot in the ride. After giving the ride, the little Dinoo went back to his home.
author: Mansi Paniya
illustrator: Anuradha Sahoo; Satya  Krishna Prakash; Sweta  Roy Choudhury

title: Janu's Treat
text: Janu is a short, adorable girl who is 8 years old with bob cut always. She loves cooking and watches with lot of interest when her mother cooks. She always wanted to cook on her own. Lily is a 10 year old, tall and smart girl with a very long hair. She spends most of the time with her grandmother. Lily's grandmother used to tell about her childhood memories. Lily is very curious and always asks her grandmother, lot of questions like, "How will you spend your time without gadgets?" One day, it was raining heavily so the schools were closed. But Janu's parents had to go to work so her mother told, "Ask Lily to come to our home and play with you". Okay, said Janu. Then she called Lily from their home landline number. "Hello!", said Janu. "Hello Janu", said Lily. "Can you come to my home and let's play Jenga?", asked Janu. Lily said, "Yes. I will be there in ten minutes". She took her umbrella and crossed the road to reach Janu's house. At that time Janu's landline rang. tring.... tring.... Janu picked up the call. "Hello Janu", said Aunt. Tell mom that, " I will come to your home in the evening with two of my friends". "Yes Aunty. I will inform", said Janu. Janu called her mom and told the same.. Janu's mom said, "I will come home and cook a quick snack". "Okay Mom", said Janu. Lily also came to Janu's house and Janu asked, "Can we cook ourselves for my aunt? ". Will you help me? Yes, said Lily. Then they ran towards the kitchen to decide what to cook.... As Janu has seen her mom cook sweet corn soup often, they decided to make that. Lily calculated vegetables for 8 people, then she took 4 carrots, 5 beans, 3 onions and 4 sweet corns from the fridge. Janu chopped the veggies and when it was time to grind the sweet corn, the power was out.... Janu was upset. Suddenly an IDEA flashed in Lily's mind! She had seen her grandmother using the grindstone in her home for grinding. Then she said" Janu, Let's take the sweet corn to my home and we can grind in my grandmother's grindstone". OLDEN MIXER GRINDER Janu was very happy and then they ran to Lily's home. Lily taught Janu how to ground and they both grinded the sweet corn. They carried the grinded corn to Janu's house. Then Janu took a large cooker and put the grinded sweet corn, vegetables, and poured 3 cups of water and Lily helped in getting the salt and pepper from the top shelf. Janu checked for salt and after 2 whistles the soup was ready. After 10 minutes,there was a knock on the door it was her Aunt, Aunt's friends and her parents. Janu's mother ran to the kitchen to cook for the guests... But, by that time Lily was carrying the large cooker to the dining room. Janu took the bowls and spoons. Janu's mother was shocked, and she also sat on the table. The soup was poured into everyone' s bowl and everyone told that soup was yummy and delicious.... Good work girls!!!
author: Aaruthra Gandhi

title: That Day When Fanny Fish met Pinky Parrot
text: This Story won the “First Prize” in the " Creative Expressions Story Contest " (Special Entry Category - VIDYA) conducted by The R.E.A.D Club on the occasion of “International Literacy Day 2020" Like every evening Fanny fish was also getting ready with full of excitement that evening, and just then her mother asked her, “ Fanny, I have noticed that since the last few days you really enjoy your evening outings, is there something special now which makes you so happy?” Fanny replied “ No mom it’s just a new friend.” And rushed away saying “ Bye mom, I am getting late.” Mummy fish sighed and murmured “ Naughty girl ”. After some time it was about to get dark but Fanny didn’t get back home, Mumma fish getting disturbed decided to search Fanny at her friend’s place. She started with Nemo fish and Dory fish and others but Fanny was nowhere to be seen. Mumma fish was about to cry being frightened about where her little daughter went away, then she saw that Fanny was coming from the far end of the pond they were living in. She took a sigh of relief but after that just like every mother in the world she started scolding Fanny for being late and wanted to know where she had been because she had already looked for her at her friends’ place but Fanny was not there. Who was that new friend, how did she meet her? And many more questions ……. Then Fanny replied “ Relax mom! I’ll answer your each and every question but first let’s go home because I am hungry. ” They swam to their home, Fanny had her evening snacks and started to tell mom about the day, “ When fanny fish Met Pinky parrot ”. “ My new friend is Pinky parrot, yes you heard it right mom, it’s a bird not a fish. A few days ago when I was enjoying my evening swim a caterpillar fell down in the water in front of me and naturally I just grabbed and ate it but just then I heard a sound of crying and shouting “Why you ate my food? “ I looked down, on both sides but found no one then again that sound came with more volume, and then I realized that this sound came from upwards, when I looked up then I saw a beautiful parrot was there and she looked really stressed and angry.. I said “Hi!”to her but she was very angry and shouted again. Then I replied that I didn’t have her food. She said, “ The caterpillar you just grabbed was in my claws and by mistake it fell into the pond and you ate that.” Then I said sorry to her but she started crying loudly and said “ What will I do with your “SORRY”, my mother was teaching me how to search food since the last few days and today it was my final exam to search food on my own and after trying for so many hours I just found that caterpillar which you ate and it’s time to get back home for result but now I am empty handed, you know what it means? It means I have failed in my very first exam, and she started crying again, then I told her not to cry and follow me. “Perhaps I can help you.” Then she became a little calm and followed me by flying in the sky. Then I swam to the opposite side of our pond where a garden of flowers is there and our cool conversation started. Fanny: Look at that garden. Pinky: What to do with garden now? Fanny: See who are flying here? Pinky: Butterflies (in a sad voice) (she didn’t understand what Fanny was trying to say) Fanny: What do we call the babies of butterflies? Pinky: Caterpillar (with sparkle in her eyes) Fanny: Then what are you waiting for? Pinky flew at once to the garden and grabbed four caterpillars; two in mouth and two in her claws and returned to fanny Pinky: These two I took for you. I want to say, “ Thanks and sorry.” and she threw the worms in front of Fanny. Fanny: I don’t need this, I need something else. Pinky: What? Fanny: Let’s be friends. Pinky: Best friends (With joy) Fanny to her mother: From that day we used to meet daily, she lives on the big banyan tree on the side of our pond. Mother to Fanny: Oh! My dear daughter, I am proud of you. Keep it up.
author: The R.E.A.D Club

title: Peacock's Dance
text: Hina went to the field with her father. Father was busy with work. Hina started wandering around the field. She saw a peacock there and went near it. Just then it started raining. Seeing the rain, the peacock started dancing. Seeing the peacock, even Hina started dancing. The peacock forgot dancing It stood up and saw Hina's dance.

title: The Cat Purred
text: She made it by mixing milk, sugar, and rice. My brother Saravanan asked, "Do you know that kheer is also known as phirni or payasam?" A cat smelled the kheer. It slowly peeped into the kitchen. It secretly ate the kheer. Mother went into the kitchen to get kheer for us. There she saw the cat eating the kheer. She screamed. "Oh. I made the kheer with a lot of love for my children. Now, the mischievous cat has eaten the kheer," she said. Mother chased the cat. The cat jumped and then ran and ran. Suddenly, the cat stopped running. It turned back and looked fiercely at my mom and purred loudly. Then the cat again started to run. It jumped over the wall. And again ran. My mom was happy that she chased away the cat.
author: Anitha Selvanathan

title: Uses of Trees
text: Vinayak Varma Trees are a beautiful and useful part of nature. A tree has a trunk, branches, leaves, flowers, and fruits. Let us look at the various uses of trees. Trees give fruits for eating. The wood from the trees is used to make furniture. The wood is used for heating the surroundings by creating a bonfire. The wood is burnt to make a fire to cook. The wood is used at a fireplace in homes during cool weather. In some countries, houses are built of wood. Doors and windows are made of wood. Birds build nests on trees. Trees are used to make modes of transport like bullock carts and boats. Many medicines are made from the bark of trees. Trees prevent soil erosion as their roots hold on to the soil. Animals live in forests that are full of trees. A tree breathes in carbon-di-oxide and releases oxygen to the atmosphere. This oxygen is useful for people to breathe and live. Paper is made out of wood. Trees provide shade and shelter during summer. Tourists stay in tree houses built on trees. Many musical instruments such as tabla, piano, harmonium, veena, guitar, and violin are made out of wood.
author: Anitha Selvanathan

title: Dreamy Raju
text: Raju had a wonderful day at school. He was returning home from school. That day his teacher had taught about the importance of vegetables. title: Snow Man
text: Mommy and Daddy were busy. Varnika saw them packing stuffs. "Are you ready? shall we leave?" asked Mommy. Daddy was driving the car. Varnika was curious to know.. "Where are we going, Mommy?" asked Varnika eagerly. "That's a surprise Varnika "said mommy. "It takes a long time...why don't you take a nap. I will wake you when we reach there.. "said Daddy. Varnika was watching as the trees were moving backwards.. soon she fell asleep. "Varnika..wake up.. we are HERE.." Varnika woke up.. she was very surprised.. Everywhere she saw it was ALL white. She bent down and touched it, it was very cold. She took it in her hand it soon melted as water. S...n...o...w... The snow was everywhere even the trees and plants were covered with snow. The Snow felt like wet sand... She shaped it.. She stomped on it too... She placed her hand print on it. Varnika's friends and their family came too. S he was very excited to meet her friends. Varnika and her friends shaped the snow into a ball and had snow ball fights. They all ran and fell down.. then the little girls made Snow Angels.. Then the friends had an idea. They all started to work together. They made there big snow balls and put them on top of one another. Then one of the friend brought twigs.. other friend brought black stones.. Varnika asked her parents and brought a carrot. They placed the Stones as Buttons,Eyes and Mouth, Twigs as Hands and Carrot as Nose.. As they placed everything together.. it looked like a Perfect SNOWMAN... After returning home, Varnika drew a picture of snow man and her friends to remember it forever....

title: Incredible world of insects
text: Honey bees are very important pollinators, they help plants to grow seeds and fruits. Bees have to fly over 55,000 miles to make 500 grams of honey. A queen is the largest bee in the hive. She is busiest in the summer months, when she can lay up to 2,500 eggs a day. Dragonflies were one of the first insects to inhabit this planet and have been around since 300 million years. They are expert fliers and hover like a helicopter, barely an inch and a half long, they can migrate across oceans and between continents. Carpenter bees have hairy legs and the wings reflect a metallic blue-green colour in the sunlight. They build their nest in wood and bamboo, but don't eat wood and feed on flower nectar. Butterflies can taste and smell with their feet. They have two antennae that they use to smell, navigate and even know the time of the day. Butterflies play an important role in flower pollination. Jewel bugs are also known as metallic shield bugs. The jewel bug’s diet consists of plant juices. When they feed, they alter the plant by injecting an enzyme from their saliva into the plant, which turns the plant into a liquid state. Fireflies can produce their own light without producing any heat. Firefly light can be yellow, orange or green. Praying Mantises are the only insects capable of turning their heads from side to side to scan their surroundings. They have 5 eyes with two large compound eyes and three other simple eyes located between them. One female mantis can have up to 1000 babies. "If all mankind were to disappear, the world would regenerate back to the rich state of equilibrium that existed ten thousand years ago. If insects were to vanish, the environment would collapse into chaos" - E.O. Wilson I f all mankind were to disappear
author: Rashmi Gopal

title: Bayan tree
text: There was a huge banyan tree on the corner of the road that led to the village. It had stood there for years. The passers-by halted under the tree when they became tired. The tree happily gave them shelter,which gave the tree, a sense of joy. One day, the branches of the tree felt proud of themselves and said to the root,''We are so great. We, along with the leaves, give shade to the tired travellers and they thank us in return. Nobody even acknowledges or knows you. ''The root replied,'' You are forgetting something i am your strenght. am if i would not be you would have been not there.

title: Hawa-Hawai
text: Early morning as the sun rose, Ram, an auto driver went out for his work. A lady got in his auto. She asked to drop at a place which was very far away. The lady wanted to reach on time at that place. She got worried and the driver also became annoyed because of traffic. The driver said to the lady, "You please don't get worried. My auto has magical powers. We will fly up in the sky and will reach on time". The driver used the magical powers and the auto started flying in the air. The lady became very happy and surprised. In the meantime, the auto was up in the sky. They both were enjoying it a lot. After some time, the woman became thirsty she asked the driver to get down to buy a water bottle. She bought a water bottle from a boy. They both drank plenty of water and again the auto flew up in the sky, The auto reached up high in the sky and they were able to enjoy the view of cars moving slowly on the road because of traffic. They enjoyed seeing birds flying in the sky. The birds were shouting " Chew Chew ". The lady became astonished by looking at the view of zigzag roads. After some time, the lady realized that she was getting late. She requested the driver to please get down. Slowly, the driver started landing of the auto. The auto started reaching the road. The auto landed on the road. The lady reached her destination. The lady paid the amount to the driver. She said to him, "Thank you for such an amazing magical ride and helping me to reach on time".The driver said, "Thank You for traveling in my Hawa-Hawai ". The auto driver went away to another place and started shouting, "Who wants to travel in my Hawa-Hawai? Please come here and have a wonderful ride in my auto".
author: Mansi Paniya

title: The Elephant and the Squirrel
text: Not very far there lived an elephant in a dense forest. His name was Jospha. While he was crossing the forest, he heard a tiny animal crying behind a bush. It was a squirrel. He asked the squirrel, "Why are you crying?". So the squirrel told him about the accident. "When I was playing with my friends, a man was passing by my home. He saw the juicy fruits on my tree and wished to have them. So he picked up stones and threw on the fruits. One of the stones hit me and I got hurt". Jospha felt bad and took the tiny squirrel to the vet doctor. He checked the squirrel "what happened?". The squirrel told the whole story to the doctor. He was pleased to hear and he cured his wound. The squirrel thanked the elephant for his kindness. After some months the the squirrel became better. The elephant and squirrel became best friends.
author: Pranika Menon

title: 20 Spices
text: Spices are used to add flavor to food and sometimes to change the colour of the food while cooking. Spices are the root, bark, seed, or fruit of a tree. Let us take a look at the different Indian Spices. Cardamon Pepper Red Chilli Cinnamon Garlic Mustard Seeds Cloves Fennel Seeds or Saunf Ginger Cumin Seeds Fenugreek Seeds Bay Leaf Coriander Seeds Green Chilli Tamarind Marathi Moghu or Kapok Buds Turmeric powder Black Sesame Seeds Curry Leaves Asafoetida Powder or Hing The spices not only make the food tasty but also have medicinal value. Mix the right amounts and combination of spices while cooking. Enjoy aromatic and healthy food!
author: Anitha Selvanathan

title: The Land Of  Virus
text: Once upon a time a virus called Covid-19 had hit mankind. Covid wore a unique crown and became the microscopic king of the world. The crown’s edges were very sharp. King Covid would be present everywhere and would enter people’s body through their noses and sit on their tongues and lungs. This made people sick. It seemed like a fairytale but Covid was a reality. Covid made a huge fortress on earth. As Covid was freely roaming around, even the moat as boundaries couldn’t save people from its prick. And there was no vaccination to prevent the spread of Covid. The dangerous part of Covid was it was highly contagious. So to avoid getting the virus inside their noses, people started wearing masks and washed their hands frequently. Humanity lost the human touch of embracing and hugging each other, as they maintained social distancing. People feared Covid that locked them at home. In the midst of thunder and lightening a roaring voice was heard in the sky “MHAHAAAA, I’m the king of the world, you people destroyed the earth and its environment. You cut trees, damaged the forests and caged animals. Now I, the microscopic virus, have caged you HAAAAAA.” Hearing the sinister laugh, people skedaddled to their homes. The ones in their homes closed all the doors and windows. During Covid times, the nature was at its best. While people were locked inside their homes, birds and animals roamed freely in the deserted driveways. There were no pedlars as well to disturb them. The birds and animals were having fun. They danced, made merry and drank water from the moat. Sadly, humans were watching the nature’s beauty from their caged homes. While people feared Covid, a young boy named Siddharth too was having fun. He admired the nature. Siddharth was happy to see the flowerbed and the greenery in his home. He also found new friends, the Bulbuls, who had built a nest in his garden. Siddharth enjoyed their high-pitched sweet squeak of “Queek queek quu ukaka”. Initially the Bulbuls were scared of Siddharth. They feared that he would destroy their nest. One day, Siddharth called out to the Bulbuls and said “Hey Bulbuls, don’t be scared….I love your nest and sweet voice and want to be friends with you.” The Bulbuls were overjoyed and flew out of their nest to the ground and squeaked, “We too enjoy you playing the violin and watch you making models. You seem to be a very kind and compassionate boy somewhat like a Jack Horner.” “Hey I’m no Jack Horner,” said Siddharth gently patting the two Bulbuls. He invited them inside his home. During the day the Bulbuls helped Siddharth with his models made from scrap. They would sit on either side of Siddharth’s shoulders. At times the Bulbuls sat on his head and ruffled his hair. Siddharth fed his new friends grains and they had a good time together. The Bulbuls would also go visiting their other bird friends. Siddharth had always wanted birds as pets, but not in a cage. He was happy to have uncaged pets at home. The Bulbuls freely soared high in the sky just like the Rafale fighter jet. At night in the midst of the waxing and waning of the moon, Siddharth would read stories to the Bulbuls. The Bulbuls in turn shared the stories with their friends too. Siddharth was happy to have found great friends during Covid times. He said, “Hey Corona, thanks for making the Bulbuls build their in nest our garden.” Corona was touched by Siddharth’s compassion and humility and gradually disappeared in its own invisible way.
author: Siddharth Shivani Venugopal

title: The smelly bed room
text: When Sara woke up from her bed, her room was smelling so bad. title: Zoya's First Letter
text: She dreamed about her grandma giving her mangoes. But, grandma was not near her. Her grandma lived far away in a village. She was thinking about her grandma that morning. Just then, she heard a knock on the door. Who could it be? Was it her friend Devi? Was it her neighbour Shyamala aunty? Was it a door-to-door salesman? She went to open the door with curiosity. What a surprise! The postman was at the door. Zoya knew the postman's name. His name was Gopi. "Zoya, you have received a letter in your name. Here it is," said postman uncle Gopi. This was the first letter that Zoya had received in her life. She was excited. She was proud to see her name in the letter. Then she turned the letter to the other side and quickly glanced to see who wrote the letter. It was her grandmother. Zoya read the letter her grandma wrote to her. "Dear Zoya, How are you, mom, and dad? Are you going to school regularly? Here, I have started planting trees in our home garden. My leg pains a lot these days. But, I still go for walks in the morning..." Zoya was very happy after she read the letter. Zoya told everyone about her grandmother's letter. She told her father Zakir, Ahmed uncle, her mom Fehmida, Zeenat aunty, and little Qutub. Zoya decided to write a reply letter to her grandmother. Zoya thought, "Should I write in Tamil or English? Grandma had worked as an English teacher. So, I will write it in English." Zoya had never written a letter before. This was the first letter that Zoya wrote in her life. "Dear Grandma. All of us are fine here. School is fun. My dear friends are Anjoo and Mary. Qutub plays a lot. All of us here are waiting to see you. We will come to your village in the summer holidays..."
author: Anitha Selvanathan

title: A Lesson For The Sons...
text: There was a small village of Rajasthan called Kasthavra, covered by the sand dunes of the Thar. It was a small but colorful village. The sand dunes, almost tall as hills, had footsteps on them of the many domesticated camels that walked with people on their humps everyday. The men wore turbans with numerous colors and patterns and kurtas and pajamas and women wore beautiful cholis*. Little boys ran around playing games on the sand and enjoying themselves, smearing their faces with sand, and then coming back home to drink the oasis water which was a scarcity. It was, in short, a cheerful and colorful village. Cholis*-Clothing of Rajasthani women. The houses were made out of baked bricks and the houses were in a grid, like in one of those old civilizations. The village looked like the Indus Valley Civilization, other than camels being domesticated instead of bulls. In one of these houses lived a man named Ahmed and his wife Binya with their few camels. Ahmed was a writer. Whatever money he got from his books, it was enough for his family's needs. His stories were illustrated by Binya, and it was an amazing duo. He had three sons who always quarreled. Raja, Kishan and Mohammad. Ahmed's mother, Jima, always used give them advice, about stopping their quarrels, but they never listened. So, Jima cooked up a plan. It was something that involved Ahmed. If only he was free, from his work... The next day, she told Ahmed to write a letter, with his fine handwriting, when he was free, saying: 'Dear Children, I am fed up with your quarrels. So, I am leaving to a holy place in Kashmir - Kashi. I need something called peace, which obviously is not found at home. God will decide to spare or grab me. Wish me good luck! PS: I might be killed by the scary and furry animals on the way or in Kashi. Be prepared for me not to return!' Then, Jima explained the plan to him. It was set for the afternoon. Jima took a camel in the corner of her collection of camels that she had domesticated. She soon reached the hut of the brothers, in front of which they were fighting. She just said, along with passing the card to Mohammad, "This is for all of you. Read it." Meanwhile, Ahmed was walking to Jima's place, for hiding. The brothers read with agony visible on their faces. Meanwhile, Jima was listening to what was happening secretly. As they read to the end, they started crying, "No! What have we done! We're sorry, Abba." Just then, Jima entered, and said, "So you want him back, eh?" The brothers nodded, sniffling, and saying, "We were an awful lot, quarreling! We will never do it again..." Jima had already mounted her camel, and was rushed to her house. Ahmed sat on her bed, and Jima nodded. Ahmed then joined Jima. And they reached the hut soon on the camel. The sons were overjoyed to see their father. "Abba!" they cried. Ahmed explained, that this was a lesson for them to be good to each other, because they were family, not fiends. And thus, Ahmed's life full of literature continued, and the family lived happily. That's the end, mate! Yeah mate! THE END
author: Sai Prabir Iyer

title: Neha and Shruti
text: "Amma, Amma" shouted Rohan. He's mother arrived and asked him "What happened?". Rohan said "It's bedtime tell me an amazing story, Amma please please!". Amma said "Ok I'll tell you but first be quite and listen". "Yes Amma" said Rohan. Neha and Shruti are best friends. They go to school together, saying bye to their parents. But, there's a difference between them. Shruti was excellent in her studies, where else Neha is not so good in studies. Neha always feel bad seeing her bad marks and also feel good seeing her bestie's excellent performance. But, Neha never stop's trying. When they went in their class, their teacher took a surprise test that shocked Neha. When the teacher gave their grades, Shruti got, where else Neha got. Neha was sad, but after seeing the happiness at Shruti's face Neha too smiled a little. Now, Shruti was overconfident of her grades and thought "I am so cool in my studies, so may be I don't need to study a lot as I do everyday". But, Neha thought and made up herself that "Now I will study a lot and try to score good marks". When they went home, Shruti started playing with her pets. But, Neha kept her bags and started studying. Shruti was a little bit shocked but did not paid a lot attention at Neha. Neha studied a lot at that day. Now Neha thought and said "I should really study like this everyday". Shruti herd it and thought "My bestie came directly at my home to study?😮". Of course as Shruti decided she didn't study for 4 days, but Neha continued her studies for 4 days.. Again after 4 days, at school their teacher took a test. But this time Shruti was a little bit tensed rather than Neha. The test was about start, Shruti thought "I know everything why should I be tensed then?". But, Neha took a long breathe and said to herself "I'll try my best". The test was started. Shruti as she thought was not much better this time and said to herself "How am I not able write anything?". The test was finished now!. The grades were about to come. And then........ To the teacher's surprise Neha got and Shruti got. Shruti was so sad. When Neha saw her she said "My dear Shruti, I know how you are feeling because I too experienced it not only 1 time but many times and you know we both learned a very good lesson". "What lesson?". Shruti asked. Neha said "A lesson for me was hard work tells you too work hard but after we complete the work it comes and brings a smile on our face and thus, am always ready to meet hard work and also to do it". Shruti asked " And what's the lesson for me?". Neha said "The lesson for you is that Don't be overconfident because it can lead to.....". "I know what it can lead to as just experienced it". They both smiled at each other and promised to keep studying. "Wow! Amma what an amazing story it was". "Yes Rohan so, will you promise me that you will not behave like Shruti?". "Ummm Promise Amma I will not behave like Shruti" said Rohan. Amma said "Rohan come on sleep now it's night". And slowly Rohan felt a asleep.
author: Ilisha Pawar
illustrator: Promina Shreshtha; Rajiv Eipe; Ruchi Shah

title: The Chai King
text: One day, Sita was looking at the tea made by her father. Her father used to run a tea stall in the city. She said to his father, "Don't you think we should prepare tea from tea leaves available in our garden. So that we can prepare delicious tea to sell and expand our business". Her father said, "Yes, Let's do it". She brought tea leaves from their garden and asked her father to prepare tea. She became very curious while her father was preparing tea with new tea leaves. Two cups of tea were prepared. She thought of offering this to someone so that they can know the taste of tea. She went to her teacher's place and offer her tea. Her teacher admires it a lot. She became very happy. The next day, Sita went to various places and offer them tea. She got good feedback from various people. Thus, her father started selling that tea at a tea stall. Many customers started coming at her father's tea stall to taste such a delicious tea. Soon, her father became rich and was known all over for his best tea. He became the biggest chai maker because of his daughter's ideas and help. Now, he was famous by the name "The Chai King".
author: Mansi Paniya
