title: The Owl King's Night
text: He opens his eyes and gives his body a shake. After moving, he gets ready to eat. At midnight, he calls all his friends to meet. The gathering ends, all his friends sing a song. As the sun comes out, the owl king makes his bed. He soon gets lost in the dreams in his head.
author: Pratham English Team

title: The Tortoise and The Rabbit
text: One was tortoise and the other was rabbit. Always friends no matter the weather, food and play they enjoyed together. One day, the rabbit shared an idea with the tortoise. The tortoise liked the idea. They both decided to race. After running for some time, the rabbit stopped to rest. He fell asleep. But the tortoise did not stop. Suddenly, the tortoise saw a lion. He was scared. He stopped running. The rabbit woke up. He ran to look for his friend. The rabbit saw the lion and jumped to save the tortoise. The tortoise climbed on the rabbit’s back The rabbit started running, saving the tortoise's life.
author: Kratika Pande

title: Ali
text: home. Suddenly he noticed the tap outside the door. Water from the tap was dripping on the ground. Ali put a pot under the tap. The water now started dripping into the pot. Ali started studying again. After a while, the pot became filled with water. Ali poured water from the pot in the plants.
author: Ankita Kushwaha

title: Bunty and Mother's Kite
text: Bunty kept his kite near the window. It rained heavily during the night. When Bunty woke up in the morning, he saw that the kite was all wet. After seeing that the kite is all wet, Bunty becomes very sad. Then he heard his mother's voice. In her hands were glue, paper and broom sticks. Mother said - let's make a kite by ourselves! They quickly made a kite. Bunty wrote on the kite- Bunty and Mother's Kite!
author: Ankita Kushwaha

title: Colours Everywhere
text: She mixed red with yellow. Which colour did it make? Orange! This time she mixed white with red. Now guess the colour? Pink! She mixed a little black with red. Which colour did it make? Brown! Wow! That was fun! Now you try - mix different colours and form new colours!
author: Ankita Kushwaha

title: The Key's Lock
text: He started to look for the lock of the key. He placed the key in the lock of the trunk. The key was very loose. He placed it in the lock of his uncle’s cupboard. The key did not even go inside. He placed the key in the lock of his mother’s cycle. The key got stuck in it. He tried very hard to take out the key. Finally, the key came out. Now he placed the key in the lock of his grandmother’s trunk. Click! The lock opened. Hurray! It is the key to grandmother’s trunk.
author: Kaminee Singh

title: Ants
text: There were many kinds of trees in the garden. There were anthills built under the trees. The grandmother told Nisha that she used to feed ants in her childhood. Nisha felt happy to hear this. She went back home and took out some dough from the box. The next morning, she went to the garden with her grandmother again. She put some flour in the anthills under the trees. The ants started eating the flour. Seeing this, Nisha and her grandmother were very happy.
author: Kaminee Singh

title: Hide and Seek
text: Siddhant Dogra We have come to the village to meet our grandmother. Me, my mother, my father and my brother. Grandmother has a garden so neat, all the fruits there are very sweet! Sometimes when I am free, I quickly climb and hide on the tree. Everyone keeps looking around, in the well and in the ground. But I come down only when, my lovely grandmother calls my name.
author: Nancy Siddhant Dogra

title: Zera and Jojo
text: Siddhant Dogra It was Zera’s birthday. He wanted to invite Jojo, but his mother said no! Both Zera and Jojo felt very sad. The next day when Jojo came to the party, Zera smiled and became happy. Jojo told Zera that Zera's mother invited him to the party. JoJo carried Zera on his back. The party was over and it was time to say goodbye. As Jojo walked away, Zera and his mother started to cry.
author: Nancy Siddhant Dogra

title: Train
text: It runs on the tracks. Chak-chak-chak. It stops at the station. A train travelling miles away. Engine at the front and coaches at the back. Train coaches filled with people. Some people on the train are reading. Some people are seen talking. Some are just looking outside the window. These are the ways everyone travels on a train.
author: Ashwini Joshi
illustrator: Preeti Krishnamurthy; Priya Kuriyan; Sahitya Rani; Vallabhi   Shegaonkar

title: Naagu and Nunu's Problem
text: Nunu are best friends. One day, both of them did not want to go to school. But Nunu’s mother made her understand. She also put potato ﻿parathas in her tiffin﻿. Naagu‘s father also made him understand. He filled his tiffin with eggs. Upset Nunu started walking towards her school. Naagu’s father had also sent Naagu to school. They both reached the school but they were afraid to go inside the classroom. Math questions were troubling both of them. The teacher elephant knew the secret to their problem. He called to both of them. He drew pictures like this to explain the maths questions. After that, both of them explained a lot of maths questions to each other by drawing pictures. Both of them said, “Hurray! It is so simple to solve maths questions. Today we have understood so much.”
author: Kaminee Singh

title: Pinku and Pankhu
text: This is Pinku and I am Pankhu. Let me tell you about all the work that I do. Early in the morning, I wake Pinku up. When Pinku throws his ball, I go and get that too. When Pinku dries the ﻿papad, I shoo away the crows. When Pinku paints a picture, I give him the colours. When the cat sips the milk, I chase it out. When Pinku sits to study, I become his pillow. When Pinku is tired, I am tired too.
author: Kratika Pande

title: The Kitten
text: She looked here and there. There was a small kitten lying on the roadside. Aashi went near it. The kitten’s leg was hurt. Aashi got scared. She called her mother. Her mother came out and took the kitten inside the house. Her mother put medicine on the kitten’s leg and tied a bandage. Aashi brought some milk in a bowl. Mother took the bowl in her hand and fed the kitten. As soon as it drank the milk, it fell asleep on mother’s lap. From that day onwards, the kitten started living with Aashi.
author: Ashwini Joshi

title: Never Give Up by Viraj Bisht
text: Priya was a nine-year-old girl. She had an elder sister named Shriya. They both went to the same school that was a little far away from their home. While Priya's parents would drop her at school, Shriya would like to ride her bicycle to the school. Priya's 10th birthday was approaching. She asked her parents, "I too want to go to school with Shriya. Please get me a bicycle for my birthday." The parents agreed but on one condition. "You must learn to ride a bicycle first", they said. Priya agrees. The next day Sunday, Priya took out Shriya's bicycle to practice. Unable to balance the cycle, Priya kept falling down. She struggled the whole day but couldn't succeed. She promised herself, "no matter what tomorrow will be my day". The first thing Priya did on waking up the next morning was to practice cycling. By noon, Priya has not only learned to balance a bicycle but also ride it comfortably up to a distance. Happy to see Priya achieve her goal her parents kept their promise and gifted her a new bicycle for her birthday.
author: Priyanka .
illustrator: Ajit Narayan; Kabini  Amin; Priyanka .; Shamim Ahmed; Suvidha Mistry

title: Scared Sonu
text: Sonu is in grade2 and she is almost scared of everything.From cockroach, snake, dog, stranger people, night......the list never ending. Every night she think about the ghost with white saree, long hair, big tooth... roaming around outside her home. She always hold her mother's finger while going everywhere. Friends and relatives used to say her like mamma's tail. Sonu used to go to school with her neighbour hood friend. Everyday she notice the man who was in the shop near the school. He also make her scared by making his eyes big. She thinks that he will catch her,tie in a sack, scoop her eyes, break her arms and legs and sell her to someone else for money. Days passed.First term exam started. Sonu prepared well. She was very happy thinking about her vacation of 10 days after exam when she can go to her grandparents who were living in long distance. On the day of science exam she is walking to the school alone because her friend have exam in the afternoon. She walk fast with a scared heart. She reached almost near the school but she fell down on the road. Her face hit and started bleeding from the chin. The man in the shop come immediately took her from the road and take her to the hospital with his 2 friends. after dressing up the wound he take Sonu to the school principal and explain what happened. The school principal said she can write the exam later. The man and his friends take sonu to her home in his cycle. When Sonu saw her mother she ran to her fast and hug her tightly. The man explains to mother what happened. After this incident Sonu is not scared about the man. But still at night the ghost with white saree, long hair, big tooth roaming around outside her home.
author: soumya abu
illustrator: Anastasiya Ivanova; Mayur Mistry; Pawnee Maiden; Priya Kuriyan; Ruchi  Bakshi; Stephen Wallace

title: Ants
text: There were many types of trees in the garden. There were billions of ants under the trees. Dadi told Nisha, "As a child, I used to feed the ants." Nisha was happy to hear this. She went home and took out some dry flour from a box. The next morning, she went with her grandmother to the garden again. She put a little flour in the ant hills under the trees. The ants started eating the flour. Nisha and her grandmother were very happy to see this.
author: Anitha Selvanathan

title: The Baby Elephant Learns To Drink Water
text: It felt thirsty while walking. It reached a river alone. After reaching there, it thought, how can I drink the water? First, it dipped its ears in the river’s water. But it could not drink the water. Then, it dipped its tail in the water. Even then, it could not drink the water. Then its mother reached there... the mother slowly came towards the baby elephant. The mother dipped its baby’s trunk in the water... and the baby elephant started to drink the water!
author: Kaminee Singh

title: Who Am I?
text: I can hop on two legs. I can use my tail. I can jump far. I can run far. I keep my baby in my pocket. Wherever I stop, my baby comes out and plays a lot! When my baby gets tired, it comes back in my pocket and sleeps with ease. Guess, who am I? Think, think! What is my name? Can you guess or should I tell you? Yes! My name is Kangaroo.
author: Nancy Siddhant Dogra

title: The Lion's Feast
text: They ate the food and played a game. The squirrel sang a song. The peacock danced along. But the elephant was not happy. He was left out of the party. The monkey had an idea! The lion said “I am sorry”. The elephant said “Do not worry”. Everyone had so much fun!
author: Kratika Pande

title: Jolly Swing!
text: He told his sister, "Mamuni, where do I swing? There is no swing anywhere. " Mamuni said, "We can make our own swing." Mamuni brought an old bicycle tire and a thick rope from the roof. She threw the rope on a strong branch of the tree. The rope came down through the top of the branch. Mamuni put the tire in the rope and tightly tied it. "Brother, See, this is our own swing," said Mamuni. Both kept swinging for a long time.
author: Anitha Selvanathan

title: Bunty and Mom
text: Bunty put that kite near the window. At night rain came. At morning Bunty saw that his kite has been wore. When Bunty saw the kite he was very sad. Then only mom called. In mom's hand their was Glue,Broomsticks and Paper. Now mom said'' Now, let's make our own kite. '' after that both of them made a kite. Now on the kite h wrote '' BUNTY AND MOM'S KITE!
author: sanjali jain

title: Jalebi
text: Translator: sanjali jain First the sweet seller put fire then he put the frying pan on the fire. Now he put the Jalebi in the frying pan then he put the sweet liquid in the frying pan Now Muniya saw the Jalebi and smiled on it. Then she put out her tounge. Then she bought money from home And ate a lot of Jalebi
author: sanjali jain

title: The Selfish Crab and  Helpful Fish.
text: Once there were two fishes, they were good friends. There was a rude crab too in the same ocean who did not have any friends. Whenever the two fishes passed the crab it would trouble the fishes. One day a fisherman was catching fish. The friendly fishes and the crab were trapped in the net. The crab yelled for help, while the two fishes decided to help themselves and the crab. The fishes worked together to free themselves and the crab. The crab apologised for being rude to the fishes. The crab realised that strength comes from unity and decided to become friendly. They all became friends and lived happily ever after.
author: Anika Sharma
illustrator: Ounla  Santi; Pia Meenakshi; pradip kumar  haldar; R. Surendran; Seng Visal

title: Ali Saves Water
text: home. Then his eyes fell on the tap. Water from the tap was dripping on the ground. Ali placed a pot under the tap. The water now started falling in the pot. Ali then started reading. In a while, the pot was filled with water. Ali poured the water in the pot on the plants.
author: Anitha Selvanathan

title: animals my life
text: Once apon a time there was a poacher always hunted animals which were endangered one day his wife said why do you always hunt animals cant you do something new like make animals your friends. what his wife said he ignored. But after that day he grew more and more greedy so he hunted more animals every day but after a few years all the animals died and the poacher was shocked that and feared that without animals the jungle was the jungle was like a desert after a few days he realized his mistake a spend all his time saving animals. don't treat animals as animals treat animals as living beings because that's what they are.
author: vedant sharma
illustrator: Abin  Shrestha; Ketan Raut; Merlin Rosita; Wiehan de Jager

title: My Warrior Mom
text: Oh! mom you are always working and working. Never know when you will take rest. You are the best. You work harder than a machine, but you are as normal as anyone. In my imagination you are the most hard working person but in real world you are the same hard working person I ever know. I wonder how will it be if I am in your place for a day. I guess I couldn't do much but I am happy to have you. You read me bed time stories, wonder how beautifully you do it. You help me grow plants in our garden, I never know how you do the magic. You make me your assistant and let me help you cook, but how do your hands make you the magic cook. when I get sick, you fight like the warrior with my cold all night. You fight with no break or rest. In the morning, you are sleeping all tired and exhausted and I am all well. I wonder how powerful you are but I always LOVE you!.
author: Ruchitha T

title: Our Swing
text: He went to his big sister Mamuni and said to her sadly, ‘there is no swing anywhere nearby, is there?’ She replied and said ‘we can make a swing ourselves!’ Mamuni then went to the roof to get an old tyre and some rope. She threw the rope onto a strong branch! Anuj stood there observing with curiosity. Mamuni then tied the rope to the tyre, making sure the knots were tight. She then said, ‘our swing is ready!’ Anuj was happy… and the two siblings played on the swing all afternoon!
author: Zubin Miller

title: Pakhi the Pigeon
text: She flew high onto the roof of someone’s house. She was hungry… and started to caw loudly! A girl heard her and appeared. She threw some seeds near Pakhi. Pakhi started gobbling them up! But ouch! She felt a small stone in her mouth. She started to shriek. From her own shriek, Pakhi suddenly woke up. Her mother asked her – what happened? Why did you shriek? Pakhi wobbled all her teeth to see if they were fine. She then said to her mother that she was just having a dream. It was time to go back to sleep…
author: Zubin Miller

title: A Scary Pit
text: She crouched down to look into the pit. A baby goat had fallen into the pit. She was trapped. Samira bravely climbed down into the pit. She then picked up the baby goat and got her out of the pit… and the baby goat happily hopped along and was with her mother once again.
author: Zubin Miller

title: Baa...Baa...
text: Bella looked back. A big goat was looking inside a pit and making sounds. Bella got off the bicycle and reached the pit. She looked into the pit. A baby goat had fallen in the pit. It could not get out. Bella boldly got down into the pit. She lifted the baby goat out of the pit. The baby goat ran near to its mother.
author: Anitha Selvanathan

title: The three fish friends
text: Once upon a time there lived three fish in a pond. They were good friends. Once, a fisherman came fishing. The wise fish told the other two, "We should leave this pond now. Or else, the fisherman will catch us." The other two replied, "We will not leave the pond in haste." Then, the wise fish left the pond alone. Soon, the fisherman cast his net. Just then, the second fish jumped out of the net and saved itself. The fisherman caught the lazy third fish. Thus, lazy perishes and wise succeeds.
author: Sushma Rao
illustrator: Amal Akash; Rohit Kelkar; ROSH; Thea   Nicole de Klerk; Thulisizwe  Mamba

title: THE STORY OF A SNAIL WHO DISCOVERED THE IMPORTANCE OF BEING SLOW
text: A little snail lives in the grass. The snail lives in the grass with a lot of snails. They love the flowers. The other snails are all happy, but not our snail. She is sad. The little snail is so sad because she hasn't got a name and she is slow. She needs to go away. The snail meets an owl. The owl is fast and it flies. It lives in the trees. The snail is sad because she is slow and she wants a name. The snail walks and walks, she is tired, she sees a big stone and she wants to sleep. The stone is a turtle and her name is memory. The snail tells her that she has no name and she is slow. The turtle wants to help the little snail, so they go near a street. Near the street there are cars, bikes, motorbikes, school buses and they are very fast! The snail and the turtle are scared. The snail is now happy to be slow. The turtle says to the snail that from now her name is " rebel "! The little snail is very happy and she thanks the turtle. Rebel knows she is slow, but now she has got a name! Then she returns to her friends! Drawings and texts by children iii class grottarossa
author: Flavia Stabile

title: My Dream by Dhruv Joshi
text: Last night I saw a dream which was very amazing and I felt very excited. In a dream, I went to Shimla with my parent and enjoyed a lot. I throw an ice ball on Mumma and I also saw that all trees were covered with snow that looks like a white tree as I was about to go on the hill with my father. My mother make me up from sleep.
author: Priyanka .

title: THE FROG
text: ONCE there lived a frog. But she is sad.. why is she sad?? Because her brothers are not playing with her. then she came home. She told her mamma about it, her mamma told her "why don't we learn something." Her mamma started teaching her children to learn the alphabets. Then, Lilly told her mamma " mamma! I am hungry!!!" Then they went to eat dinner. after having a healthy lunch. The children were very sleepy so...... Their mamma told a bedtime story and they went to sleep saying "Good Night"
author: Shreyansh Pola
illustrator: Belvia Chan; Marco Tibasima; Partho Sengupta; Trần Lưu  Đăng Nguyên

title: Key Lock
text: He started searching for the key lock. He put the key in the lock of the chest. The key was very loose. He put the key in Kakaji's cupboard lock and saw. The key did not enter it. He put the key in the lock of his mother's bicycle. The key got stuck in it. He pushed hard to get the key. Eventually, the key came out. Now, he put the key in Grandma's chest. Click! The lock opened. Oh wow! This is the key to Grandma's chest!
author: Anitha Selvanathan

title: When will it rain Ma?
text: I wear it now?” asked Manu. “No, my dear, the rains are near, but just now the sky is clear,” said Ma. Monday was bright and sunny. “WILL it rain today, Mummy?” asked Manu. “No Manu, not today. If you wear your raincoat, you will look quite funny!” said Ma. On Tuesday, the sky was blue. “Ma, WHEN will my wish come true?” asked Manu. “Not today, my dear, there is just one white cloud in the sky!” said Ma. Wednesday was hot. “Ma, WHY doesn’t it rain?” asked Manu. “Son, I think it will rain very soon. Maybe even before it is noon,” said Ma. On Thursday Manu went on a picnic. “Ma, WHAT if it rains? Shall I take the raincoat with me?” asked Manu. “No my dear, it will not rain today. The little white clouds are too high in the sky,” said Ma. Friday was cloudy. “Ma, will it rain today?” asked Manu loudly. “It might, my dear. There are some dark clouds low down in the sky,” said Ma. Saturday began with a bang! Badaboom! "Ma, is that thunder I hear? Will it rain very soon?" asked Manu. And then at last, it started raining! “Oh, it’s raining, it’s raining,” sang Manu, running out. “But Manu,” called Ma, running after him, “you forgot your raincoat!”
author: navya agarwal

title: Aayush Learns About Extinct Animals
text: A family lives in a city. In that family there were four family members. Sunita (mother), Mehul (father), Aayush (brother) and Tina (sister). Tina was in grade 7th and Aayush was in grade 5th. They both were very sincere and intelligent. They like to play and study. Today, when they were leaving for their school, Aayush eagerly asked to her sister, " Didi, what are extinct animals." Didi said, " Aayush, extinct animals are those animals who did not live now on earth." Aayush was confused, so her Didi said" Now we should go inside the classroom so you can ask from your teacher for more explanation." Aayush and his sister come to their classes. In few minutes later, the class started and teacher asked their queries. So, many children raised their hands. Teacher asked Aayush to speak up and for others to wait for their turns to come. Aayush stands up and start asking his query. He said " Ma'am what are extinct animals or plants and, and what are the names of few of them." Teacher said with happiness " Aayush and all other students listen to me carefully. There are 2 types extinction. 1. Plant extinction 2. Animal extinction Today, I will tell you about animal extinction. There were many species of animals on earth that we cannot see nowadays. There all species were dead due to some reason. Some reasons are like- volcano eruption, widespread poaching etc. Name of some extinct animals are 1. Dodo bird 2. Dinosaur etc. So, Aayush! did you understood about extinct animals?" Aayush said "Yes ma'am now my doubt is clear." Teacher said " Oh wow. "
author: Ayaansh Bansal

title: Who am I ?
text: I jump with two legs. I support the tail. Take a long jump. I run away. Keep the baby in the bag. Wherever I stop. The baby comes out. Plays well outside. When he is tired. Goes in the bag. He falls asleep comfortably. Tell me who I am? Think, think my name Missed or should I tell? Yes, my name is Kangaroo!
author: Sahanoo Prasad  Nishad

title: About Kraftinn
text: I will be talking about a company called Kraftinn. The word Kraftinn come from craft – inn. In inn’s there are some stuff there which Kraftinn makes with some more designs. Kraftinn is not only about making things and selling them, it is about a social hub where all the workers work together and have some fun. They make baskets, bags, purses, chairs, sofas and lamps. Kraftinn is about things which are made from bamboo. Kraftinn has a workshop in Assam. It is big as a house. Inside the workshop they cut the bamboos to stripes and make them smooth. They make them bamboo stripes smooth from some carving tools and a cloth. After they make the bamboos smooth, the make a cross design and a line by line design to finish the item. In bags the have to stich some buttons and some threads. I think you might ask how do I know about Kraftin, I know about Kraftin because my uncles Parikshit Borkotoky and Pramethesh Borkotoky owns and directs the company. Parikshit Pramethesh
author: hiya borkotoky
illustrator: Deepa Balsavar; hiya borkotoky; Shivika Nayyar

title: Zoo Visit
text: Seven year old Tiya was visiting a zoo the first time. she was travelling from a car. She was very exited.All the way from her home to near the zoo she talked and talked. But near the zoo she saw an herd elephants so the driver had to stop.Tiya asked her father "why the animals are coming here don't they like to stay in the jungle " her father replied "What jungles,we humans are cutting the forests" Tiya looked very sad and to fresh her mood her mother pointed at a monkey and said "look at that monkey's baby how funny he looks" Tiya looked at it and said "haha" Tiya said.All the 5-6km she kept watching animals.she was very surprised to see so many animals,monkeys jumping here and there,ostriches running, the giraffes eating the grass, but her mind was not in it she asked her father that "cant we do anything about the animals.Her father replied "yes we can do we can help the animals in various ways 1)we can help them by not buying the clothes that are made from animal skin. 2) we can feed animals so They do not die. Tiya asked her father that "why do we hunt animals" her father replied "we hunt animals for: 1.for their fur 2.for their skin 3. for their teeth 4.for food 5.for fun. "but that is too bad "said Tiya.Yes that's why poaching is the poaching is banned in our India. "are we not doing any thing about it "asked tiya" we are "replied her father. project tiger started in 1973, many national parks and sanctuaries were built like: 1. Bandipur National Park, Karnataka 2. Nagarhole National Park, Karnataka 3. Sariska National Park, Rajasthan just then Tiya's mother called them her father booked the metro tickets and then they went home
author: Saranshi Yadav
illustrator: Abin  Shrestha; Huynh  Vu Tuong; Mamun Hossain; Offei Tettey  Eugene; Raju Babu Shakya

title: CINDY THE CIRCLE
text: There was a unique world with full of geometrical shapes who were alive. They could speak and talk too!!!. Isn't it surprising. Cindy the circle, squirky the square and shiny the diamond were best friends. They would share their thoughts with each other and three of them would stay in the same house. Best friends one day cindy the circle was walking alone and started talking to herself."why am i round"?"why don't i have sharp edges"? "why i always roll whenever i sit"? She started asking question to herself. On the next day cindy,squirky and shiny were walking across the streets. A paper came flying and it landed on cindy's face. On that paper it was written that a running compitation is going to held tomorrow. Three of them were ready to participate and they were just dreaming about it for the whole day. All were ready to go. Get.. Set... Go!!! All started running but some of them fell down and they were not able to get up.. As there sharp edges were stuck inside the running path. When cindy fell down she did'nt even get stuck. She started rolling and won the first place in the compitation. What did u learn from this story?? That we should not compare us with others. You should be happy for your lovely appearance.
author: Chethanya Babu
illustrator: Chethanya Babu; Huynh  Vu Tuong; Preeti Krishnamurthy

title: A visit to the zoo
text: Pinky went with their mummy and papa to a zoo.There were different types of animals there.At first they went to see the cages with monkeys.The monkeys were jumping inside the cage. As they moved forward,they saw a giraffe with long neck.Pinky was very happy to see its long neck. The lion was roaming inside the cage like a king. Bablu and pinky got frightened on hearing the lion, roar. As they moved forward,they came across deer, bear and many birds.They clicked many photos. All felt tired after roaming. All of them ate food together.Then they sat in a railway train in the zoo.They came back in the evening.
author: sabita nair
illustrator: Aliya Shetty Oza; Crooked Arrow; Lavanya Nagappan; Preeti Krishnamurthy; Rob Owen

title: The clever mouse
text: A lion was once sleeping under the mango tree in the jungle. A mouse came there smelling the mangoes. He thought that the lion is sleeping. So he started eating the mangoes which had fallen on the ground from the tree. Hearing the sound around him the alert lion slowly woke up and saw the mouse eating mangoes. The mouse was so busy eating the mangoes that he didn't notice that the lion was awake and watching him. Suddenly the lion caught the mouse with his claws. Mouse felt helpless and scared for his life. The lion said I am gonna eat you. But the mouse got his act together and thought of an idea to save himself. He said to the limn lion I am a small mouse, If you eat me your stomach would not be full. Let me take you to the cave where there are deer and you can eat them. Lion gets greedy and agreed to go with him. The mouse said over here you will find giraffes, donkey and some more rats etc, in this cave. Lion agreed. Then the mouse said I will wait out you go inside. Lion said ok but wait here only. Then the mouse ran as fast he could. When lion went inside he found a another angry and cruel lion. They both fought. Then the lion realized the mouse had made him a fool. After few seconds lion said, You are thinking wrong,I thought there is a mouse as squeaking sound was coming. Like this the lion saved himself.
author: Trisha Bhandoola
illustrator: Amy Uzzell; Chandana Bandara  Samarakoon; Morgan Gardner; Suchitra Prakash; Tanish Yadav

title: Super Kitty
text: There was ones a cat named billy. Billy was a special cat. Cause he could fly, be strong and had x-ray vision. He was a heroooo....... Billy was sneaking behind the bushes to save the son of his friend. HE was kidnapped by Catty Freeze, As Billy punched Catty freeze. POW Catty freeze fell on the ground. Billy ran out with his friend's son as fast as he could But when Billy was running. Catty freeze came in front of him. He was very biggg. Instead Billy turned into a big blackish robot. And tried to destroy catty with his gun. But nothing none of the bullets shot Catty freeze as he blocked the attack when Billy was shooting him. So Billy used his full power to punish Catty freeze. But now Billy turned into a blue electric car. Then he shot a super electric cannon ball that exploded Catty freeze. POOOOOOOWWWWWWWW PO.. PO.... PO
author: Varun Kumar
illustrator: Kavin Dhanabal; lokamanya lokamanya; Poorvi Garag; Yogita Soman

title: The Kitten
text: She started to look for who was it. When she was looking for where the voice was coming from.She saw a helpless kitten was lying in the corner of the busy road. Aashi went to it. Cat's leg was hurt. Aashi panicked. she called her mother.Her mother came out and took the kitten to the house. Mother put medicine on the cat's feet and tied the bandage. Aashi brought some milk in a bowl. Mother took the bowl in her hand and gave it milk. The cat fell asleep in the mother's lap as soon as she was drinking milk. From that day onwards the kitten lived with Ashi.
author: Anushka Das

title: The hula hoop dance
text: Jack's Grandpa told that when he was a kid he loved doing the hula hoop dance, so he went to a talent show and did the hula hoop dance. And then he whispered softly, do you know that the hula hoop dance is our National dance?! No, said Jack! And let me tell you this, there is some magic in that dance so I got famous! What's the magic?, asked Jack. You need to figure it out yourself!, said Grandpa. After that Jack got inspired to be a hula hoop dancer! So when Jack grew up he searched every place in the house to find a hula hoop! But the only things he could find were plates, a wheel, a coin and more. Then finally he looked in the garage and found a small black hula hoop. He started to measure the hula hoop. After some fixing, Jack was ready then he asked his Grandpa to teach him! Grandpa told he shot a video of his practice. Then Jack saw the video and practised and practised until he finally got how to hula hoop! Then he did the hula hoop dance and then something magical happened!!! He started to fly in the air. WOOOOOHOOOOO!!!, Jack yelled then he thought for some time how is this happening then he said to himself it's the magic Grandpa told me about and then he settled in the sky with 2 birds on the hula hoop. THE END
author: Zana Beulah

title: Freinds
text: My name is Biju. And I have four freinds My good friends are Zazu, Ayodhya, Pastu and Kapil My friend Zazu loves to play Soccer My friend Ayodhya loves to do swiming My friend Pastu likes to play Hide-and-Seek And my friend Kapil loves to Read And I like what they like to do
author: Vihaan Sharma

title: Endangered species
text: Bajaj Mira was talking to her best friend Nayonika about a course that their school was offering which was about endangered species, " We should protect them " said Mira "but how?" said Nayonika. Mean while, Mira's sister Meenu entered the room and heard their talk. "What are you talking about?" Meenu asked. Mira answered " We are talking about a new course that the school is offering about endangered species". "What are endangered species? " Meenu asked Endangered species are the species that are in danger, if we don't start protecting them now, one day they will be extinct. How to protect them? asked Meenu "We will learn about it in the course. ﻿ ﻿ The next day Mira entered the house after the course. Meenu came running to see how to save animals from getting extinct. Mira answered- 1. We should stop poaching and hunting of animals, 2. Open more of wildlife sanctuaries and national parks and 3. Declaring more forests as protected. At last Mira thought that she must join the course to understand more about these poor species.
author: Riddhima Varshney
illustrator: Àanya Bajaj; Abin  Shrestha; Seat Sopheap; Tanish Yadav

title: Grandma's glasses
text: Akash and his family live in Aroravil a village on the top of a m ountain. One sunny morning grandma said 'I need an eye check up' everything went in silence till I said " I will help you grandma " She was very happy. The next morning we left on a bus to go to Sanivil, w here the best docters had their clinics. On the way we all sang a song- " I hope we meet again and have fun eat good food and meet again" Sudenly we heard a loud noise.... A tree had fallen on the path.The driver said we had to walk till Sanvil. I t was a long way as we were only in pearvil 60 mins away from our destination. It was almost night and we were tired so I setup a camp for grandma to rest. From no where, man yelled "get away you idiot" I was so scared as the man had an axe in his hand and there was no one around. Suddenly grandma came from behind and shouted at the man and told the man to go away. We headed `to our destination after resting all night at the camp. When were about to be late and miss the appointment, Grandma said "Let's have an adventure" I was surprised.. went to the Amusement park. There we sat in the merry go round which was over speeding... jumped onto the roller coaster which was also over speeding and whosshhhhh Grandma jumped into the doctor clinic from the ride when we reached the adjacent window of the clinic.. I am still in surprise.. does Grandma really needed the glasses when she is so efficient.. i will never forget this!!
author: Advik Arora
illustrator: AARVI NAIDU SATTHI; Greystroke; Jailene Parroquin; Ketan Raut; Soumya Menon; Vongsavanh Damlongsouk

title: Chacko and Packo
text: This is Chacko. And I am Packo. Let me tell you how hard I work everyday. Each morning, I wake up Chacko. When Chacko throws the ball, I fetch it for him. When Mother puts the crisps out to dry, I chase away the crows. I hold the crayons while Chacko paints. The cats come to drink milk... and I chase them away too! I become Chacko's pillow while he studies. At the end of every day, I get as tired as Chacko.
author: Anand Patil

title: A Dream
text: She flew down towards the roof of a small home. She started cooing to express her hunger and the want of food. Just then a pretty little girl walked towards her. The little girl realised the pigeon was hungry and spread seeds in front of her. Hungrily, Rama started pecking at the seeds. The little girl joyfully watched Rama. She felt something sharp between her teeth as one of the seeds turned out to be a tiny stone and she yelled out in pain. The loud scream in her head woke her up! Her mother who was lying next to her woke up as well and with great concern asked Rama why had she screamed. Very confused Rama reached out to her teeth to inspect them afraid that one of her tooth was broken. Her concern vanished as she realised it was just a dream and told her mother so. In no time she was asleep again.

title: The Tortoise and the Rabbit

title: Where is Kitty ?
text: Grandma said, "Have to seen kitty? I went to feed her but she seems to be missing." Mom said, "I was also searching for her." Amy shouted from her room, "Mom have you seen kitty?" Meanwhile, kitty had gone wandering around the city. She had become curious when she saw a leaf blowing and had followed it. She had gone very far from the city, she had entered a robber's house. The robber was about to catch her but she had made her escape. After some time, kitty got picked up by a boy. She meowed very loudly. Then she noticed something, the boy was Michel- Amy's brother. He carried her home, and she lied down on the soft bed and went to sleep after her very adventures day.

title: When Daniel Got outsmarted
text: Adhikara[Adhi] was a garbage collector. He was known for his smartness. He thought: I am very smart. No one is more smarter than me. I am smartest man in the whole wide world. One day an old man told him to pick up the garbage on the street. Adhi nodded his head and started cleaning the street. While he was doing that he sang and hummed and telling himself about how smart he is. The old man heard him singing and said: if you think you are so smart, can you cure my grand daughter from a disease? If you can cure her, I will accept that you are very smart. Adhi nodded his head and took the old man in his truck and went to his grand daughter's house. When they entered the house they saw a ill girl on the bed coughing and sneezing. The old man said: a week ago, my daughter went to the library. She saw her favourite book at the top shelf and asked her friend to help her reach to it. They started climbing on each other. Soon all of them fell down. She came back home coughing and sneezing and all of us knew she was sick. All the doctors try to cure her but everyone failed. Now her health is in your hands Adhi. Adhi swiftly went home and gave her all of the medicines he had but none worked. Then Adhi gave up and went to the old man. He laughed and said: my grand daughter was never sick in the first place. She never fell. Then Adhi realized that he had been outsmarted. Adhi learnt and important lesson that day. Then he drove of and was never to be seen again. Moral of the story: Moral of the story: Pride will give you nothing
author: Aarushi  konda

title: The mosquito bite
text: Once upon a time there was a baby in a village. She was bitten by a mosquito. Little bit of blood came from the spot where the mosquito had bitten. Because of that, the baby started to cry a lot. Immediately a lion and a tiger who were living nearby came to see the baby and said,"Don't cry baby, We didn't bite you. Just a mosquito bit you." Still the baby didn't stop crying. Then the tiger made a call to the mosquito and said, "Hey Mosquito, why did you bite the baby?mmm, Never do that again, understood?" Later an elephant, bear and a frog came to the baby and said,"Baby, Don't cry, everything will be normal". The baby got cured. Later the mosquito visited the baby and asked an apology.

title: Friend in need is a friend indeed

title: What is Nature?
text: Nature refers to the physical world and everything in it that is not made by people. Nature refers to the features, forces, and processes that are not caused by people. Let us look at the different elements of nature. Trees, plants, shrubs, and all the vegetation Animals Fish and underwater organisms Sun, moon, stars, clouds, and the galaxy Lakes, oceans, sea, ponds, streams, rivers, and waterfalls Insects Birds Reptiles Land, Soil, and Mountains Vegetables from the trees and plants. Fruits from trees and plants Flowers from the trees and plants Human beings There are lots of processes that happen in nature. Let us see a few of them. Wind, Breeze, or Cyclone Rain and the Rainbow Lightning or Thunder Day and Night Snow Photosynthesis in plants and trees Earth’s rotation and revolution Birth and death of animals, insects, plants, and other things in nature Basic biological functions such as digestion, breathing, walking, running, seeing, metabolism, and many more in animals and other things in nature Volcano eruptions, earthquakes, and tsunamis Now, you must have a fair idea of what is nature and the things and processes of nature. Can you think of five more examples of natural things and processes? Also, ponder about why all human activities are not a part of nature. Good Luck!
author: Anitha Selvanathan

title: Max's friends
text: Hi! I am MAX! I live in Abbelle street where most of the stray dogs live. 'WooF WooF' I am a very friendly dog! But, if you try to harm me, I will cause harm to you. 'WooF WooF' Today, I am going to show you all my friends. Some of my friends are nice and friendly while some are a bit bumptious. 'WooF WooF' Now lets go meet my friends! This is my best friend Charlie! He always loves it when people are around him. Me and Charlie always share our food and eat it together because we learnt from some humans that 'Sharing is Caring'. Me and Charlie spend a lot of time with each other because we are BEST FRIENDS! Meet Buddy..... He is just the opposite of me and Charlie because he is very scared of humans. But, when there is nobody around him, he is very naughty and plays pranks on other dogs. This is Buddy's younger sister, Lucy. Every dog in my street likes Lucy because she always helps other dogs when they are in trouble. This is Pebble. He is the strongest dog in our street. He is the Alpha / the Leader of our group. Don't try to mess with Pebble when he is in a bad mood or else he will attack and bite you. All the dogs in this street are scared of Pebble when he is in a bad mood. But, Pebble is always friendly with dogs when he is in a good mood. This is Cooper. Cooper is always in an angry mood because he says that he finds no pleasure in anything that he sees. But Cooper always keeps us safe from other dogs which are not from our territory. This is FlapJack. Unlike Cooper, FlapJack finds pleasure in many things around him (from the smallest ant to a huge aeroplane which he sees flying in the sky). And when you come near him, the first thing he does is, smell you because he likes smelling things and people. And this is the youngest pup in the litter of pups of our street- Jack. He is very playful and very active. He also loves to eat food a lot. So these dogs belong to my litter. We always have fun together just like you and your friends do. The main lesson that we learnt from you humans is that- FRIENDS ARE FAMILY!
author: Mohitha Sai
illustrator: Nicolene  Louw; Brunda Anandarao; Catherine Groenewald; Deepa Balsavar; Gauri Kathula; Marleen  Visser; Preeti Krishnamurthy; Subhadra Sridharan; Sunando C

title: The Sun and his family
text: Once upon a time, there was a star called The Sun. He had 8 children. Their name was Mercury, Venus, Earth, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus and Neptune. One day they all thought to play a game that was to race around the Sun. Mercury came first that is because it was closest to sun. It was followed by Venus, Earth, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus and last was Neptune. Then Uranus fell down, and when he was getting up he was tilted. Venus was sad to see this and she started oozing lava. Earth had a lot of water so she gave some water to Venus to make her calm down. Just then asteroids came to attack Earth, “help, help” cried Earth. When Jupiter saw that, he became angry and storms started forming over it. He then pulled the asteroid with its gravity and burned the asteroid with its atmosphere. Saturn started dancing with its hoopla rings. Mars was red with shyness when he saw Saturn dancing. In the end, they had a nice party.

title: Let's Buy Vegetables!
text: Today is a day off for Riya and Raja. They wanted to eat something tasty. "Why not children? But you have to get some vegetables from the market," said their mom. Riya and Raja had never bought vegetables before. They both left to the market with their mother's vegetable list and an empty bag. ﻿ Akbar Chacha's stall was the most colorful in the entire market. Akbar uncle asked, "What do you want children?" "10 Potatoes," Rhea said. "10 brown, fat potatoes!" said Raja and laughed. ﻿ 9 onions 9 pink, dome-shaped onions 8 carrots 8 long and orange carrots 7 brinjals 7 small and purple brinjals 6 chillies 6 green chili peppers 5 lemons 5 round and yellow lemons. 4 bananas 4 green, raw bananas 3 capsicums 3 yellow, green, red capsicums 2 bitter gourds 2 green, small, coarse bitter gourds 1 cabbage 1 fresh, white cabbage "That's all Akbar uncle," the children said. And they walked towards their house with a bag full of fresh vegetables. "Mother we have come," said the children. "Wash your hands. I will make your favourite and tasty food," said the mother. What did mother make? Bajji! Potato, Brinjal, Chilli, Capsicum, and Cabbage Bajji. And... Carrot Pudding!! It was yummy...

title: Save Animals from Extinction
text: 66 Million Years ago, Dinosaurs roamed the Earth. That was until another mass extinction happened. There have been such 5 mass extinctions. Are humans dealing the planet a sixth? More than 99% of all organisms that have ever lived on Earth are extinct. As new species come older ones fade away. But the rate of extinction is far from constant. At least a handful of times in the last 500 million years, 75 to 90% of all species on Earth have dis appeared. FUN FACT Burcado an extinct animal was brought back to life in 2003, 3 years after it's extinction! But it lived just for 7 minutes. Any way it was still a major scientific breakthrough as this shows scientists can clone extinct animals to bring them back may be just like Jurassic Park movies - we may meet real Dinosaurs! We are heading towards another mass extinction but we can stop it before it is to late! Let's all work to make sure we humans do not lead one! Let's stop cutting trees, reduce pollution and stop killing other animals to help earth able to sustain all life.
author: Arihaan Kaushik

title: RULES OF CORONAVIRUS
text: We must wash our hands with soap and water for 20 seconds after we come from outside, before and after we eat our food, when we touch something that has come from outside without being sanitized and after we have been to the washroom. We should wash our hands every one hour as well. NEEMA SINGS HAPPY BIRTHDAY WHILE WASHING HER HANDS Nani says "Stay at home until urgent to go out; Don't stand outside and walk about". "The park can wait there is no doubt. Sit inside and learn something new - COOKING or READ BOOKS or MANY CHOICES FOR YOU". We must leave a distance of 6 - 7 feet with someone who is sneezing or coughing or is sick or suffering from any disease. Otherwise we may fall ill too. SEE! THIS IS WHY I TELL YOU NOT TO GO CLOSE TO ILL PEOPLE! When we sneeze or cough, do it in a tissue. If a tissue is not available, sneeze or cough in your hands, or even better, do it into your elbow. Wear a mask which covers your nose and mouth properly. Do not touch your mask on the cloth part. To adjsut, use the part that goes on your ears. School is online but don't get sad. Soon schools will get offline. Till then, have fun with family. TOGETHER, WE CAN DEFEAT CORONA!!!

title: Somya's Smile
text: Grandpa said. "Eat a lot of toffee, that's what will happen," said the grandmother. "You don't brush the teeth with a good brush," shouted the brother. "Now, what will happen mummy?" Somya panicked. "Let's go to the doctor," said her mother. "What will happen there?" Somya asked. "Your rotten teeth will be taken out," her mother said. "No more sweets for you," said the grandfather. "Chocolate, ice cream all will be stopped," Grandma said. "Hey, why are you scared?" Papa asked. "I don't want to go to the doctor," said Somya. "My queen, my daughter, let's go to the doctor," said her father. Somya jumped into the lap of her Dad. "Milk teeth are rotten. They have to be removed," the doctor said. "How many teeth will you extract?" asked Somya. "Four teeth have gone bad. If you remove them, then the new teeth will come out well. Don't panic. Today, I will take out only one tooth," the doctor explained. "Here is your rotten tooth," the doctor showed the pulled out tooth. "Always rinse after eating sweet food. Brush up in the morning and at bedtime," explained the doctor. "Can I still eat sweets?" Somya asked. "Give Somya the ice cream now," said the Doctor. "How much ice cream can I eat?" Somya asked. "As much as you want," said the doctor laughing. Somya reached home with a lot of ice cream. "Have you started eating sweets again?" grandfather, grandmother, and brother asked. "Papa, when will I go to the doctor to remove the other teeth again," Somya said while eating ice cream. Everyone started laughing at her actions.

title: The chimpanzee's visit
text: Once an early morning Ram was in a sound sleep. Suddenly, he heard a loud thumping and roaring sound. He woke shocking. Then to his surprise he saw a chimpanzee out of his window. It was looking large and massively strong. It was causing chaos. It was uprooting trees and throwing everywhere. Ram was delighted to see a chimpanzee at his place. He called all his family members to see it. Now there appeared another chimpanzee. It was black and comparatively smaller. They both started to fight. Ram was over excited to see who is stronger. The black chimpanzee lost and was injured badly. There was another roar, it was a lighter one. A smaller chimpanzee was coming from other way. Ram thought that it was a baby chimpanzee. When it came the bigger chimpanzee stopped roaring. They both looked alike. They both went away together. Ram thought that the bigger chimpanzee was the mother of the smaller chimpanzee. That day he came to know that the animals also have feelings and he took a resolution of never harming any animal. Moral- Never harm animals because they too have feelings.

title: Endangered animals
text: Simba and his sister were confused because there elephant friends have so many cousins but they have very few cousins. So both of them went to their mom. Let's see what their mom said. MOM!! why are there only a few tigers Once upon a time you also had many cousins but due to the excessive hunting, diseases, and due to loss of habitat our number has decreased in 2010 only 1700 tigers were left. We were on our road to extinction. Then what happened?????? The humans realized their mistakes and also our importance in the ecosystem. So, their Government set up protected areas knows as Wild life Sanctuaries and national Park where hunting is completely banned. Now our number has increased to 300, but still we have a long way to go. Now there are 103 National parks and 553 wildlife scanturys in India

title: We went to a Fish Farm
text: Varnika went to a Fish Farm. When she went inside,she saw developmental stages of Fish inside a glass box. she was really surprised.Varnika called mommy to see it. She saw lots of Salmons in the Fish Farm. There was a Person who said so many information about Fishes. ﻿ Salmons breed in Fresh Waters. They lay their Eggs in the river bed.When the Embryo develop from the Eggs, they grow in Fresh Water. After reaching a certain stage,they swim to the sea. Then again they come to fresh waters to lay their eggs. The male and female fishes lay their eggs and die,making the water nutritious for the small fishes that grow from their eggs. "How do they know the way to come back?", asked Varnika. "Fishes have their Smell Memory Bank, they can easily track their way back to the Fresh Waters. Scientists also believe that Salmons are also guided by the earth's Magnetic field ", he said. Varnika saw small and big fishes. She fed the fishes and saw them fight for food. They made a big S..P..L..A..S..H.. As she tried to touch them the fishes slipped from her hands. It felt a bit slimy. The Fishes leaped out of the water. She touched them, fed them, played with them. Varnika learned a lot about Fishes that day... Did you?

title: Mango Time
text: Today is a bright sunny day of summer. Let us look what is happening in the jungle. A pigeon, rabbit and squirrel are playing. Wait, there are huge mango trees in this jungle. Suddenly, a mango fell from the tree, plop! Pigeon asked rabbit: Did you hear any sound? Rabbit: Yes, I heard a sound. Pigeon: Let us go in that direction Squirrel said, Wait, I am also coming with you Crow came over the tree and said, where are you are all going? Pigeon: We are going to find the plop sound Squirrel: Are you coming with us? Crow: Yes, I am (They are slowly moving towards the huge mango tree.) Pigeon: Do you know that the mangoes are ripe in summers only. Crow: Off course, I am much older than you. I have seen a lot of mangoes ripe. Squirrel: Then tell us how these mangoes grow every year. You are so smart. Crow: Yes, I am Rabbit: Here we are, this is the place of plop sound. The mangoes fall from the tree and make the sound, plop. Squirrel: Let’s eat these yummy mangoes first. Crow: Then let us sing our mango song, Are you hungry? Yes, I am Then, eat a mango. Tastes so yum Go have a mango It is the fruit king I taste too tango When it is raw it tastes a little sour Eat it when it’s raw it gives a lot of power Crow: Rabbit what are you doing? Rabbit: What am I doing? I am eating juicy mango Crow: Why are you throwing the seed of mango? Rabbit: If I eat them, they’ll hurt my stomach. Crow: Don’t throw them away. I know what to do with them. Let me search for a stick. Squirrel: What are you doing crock? Rabbit: Can’t you hear, he is looking for a stick. Squirrel: Are you looking for sticks? Crow: Yeah, I am. There it is. Crow: Squirrel and rabbit, it is your turn to dig a hole in the ground. Rabbit: Here I go. Done. Crow: Now, it’s your turn to put the seed inside the hole squirrel. (Meanwhile, a herd of elephants was passing through the side.) Elephants: What are these animals doing? Elephant Dumbo: Don’t know, let us ask them. Dumbo: Hey, what are you all searching for on the ground? Pigeon: We are sowing a seed in the ground. Dumbo Oh, what a pleasing experience. Go on! Pigeon: Yes, sure Cow: By the way, where are you all going? Dumbo: We are going to the lake. It is just near this huge tree. Crow: Can you bring some water for us? Dumbo: Yes, yes! (Comes with some water in its trunk) Crow: Please put some water over the seed we are sowing mango seed. Dumbo: Okay, here I go. Crow: Thank you. Now, this seed will again ripe mangoes next summer. Dumbo: But, what shall I do with the rest of water in my trunk? (The animals got confused and looked at each other.) Dumbo: I know what to do. SPLASH! (Dumbo sprayed water all over the animals.)

title: A Giving Christmas
text: Hi, I’m Alex. The month of December has come. And we all are excited about the upcoming Christmas on December 25. As a first step, we have decorated the Christmas tree at home. Christmas symbolizes the birth of baby Jesus in a manger. So, we set up a crib like a manger near the Christmas tree. The crib had dolls of Jesus, Mary, Joseph, and the three kings. Few days before Christmas, members of our church came home and sang Christmas carols. "Silent night, holy night. All is calm..." One of them was dressed as Santa Claus and gave us chocolates. Dad asked me, ”Alex, What gift do you want for Christmas?” I told him, “I want a red car-shaped backpack.” Dad agreed. Christmas day came with all its joy and splendour. My dad said, "Alex. Here is the car-shaped backpack you asked for." I was very happy and told, "Thanks a lot, Dad." Then, I remembered what my friend Jacob told me once. "Alex, I love to have a car-shaped backpack. But, my parents are poor and can't buy me one." I told Dad about Jacob. I said, "Dad, I have an idea. Let us surprise Jacob on this Christmas day." And then I told Dad about my plan. As per my plan, Dad and I went to Jacob’s home. I gifted my new red car-shaped backpack to Jacob. Jacob was overjoyed, and he laughed loudly. Jacob said, "Thank you so much, Alex." My dad gave a large plum cake baked by my mom to Jacob. Then dad and I returned home happily. The spirit of Christmas is to love, give, and share. I was happy that this Christmas was a Giving Christmas. Merry Christmas to You!
author: Anitha Selvanathan

title: Manikantan Has Enough
text: It had been a long day. The Amulet around his neck flashed once. “Manikantan, put your Schoolbag where it belongs,” said the Coffee Table. “Yes Manikantan,” agreed the Schoolbag, “I don’t belong here. I suggest you put me in your Room in a proper place.” Mani knew better than to argue. He picked up the Schoolbag and trudged towards his Room. He put away his Schoolbag on the Desk, kicked off his Shoes, and then lay down on the Bed. He groaned. “Are you not feeling well, Manikantan?” asked the Room. “I’m fine. Leave me alone.” Mani moved the Amulet to the back of his neck. He longed to throw it into the Trash. The objects in the House would still be able to spy on him but at least they wouldn’t be able to talk to him. “You groaned twice.” The Room’s voice sounded muffled. “Do you have a headache, Manikantan?” “Leave me alone.” Then after a pause, Mani added, “Yes.” “Tsk, tsk. So sorry to hear that, Manikantan.” The Room sounded very sympathetic. “I have let your Amma know. Perhaps you are hungry. That may be why you’re having a headache. How about a nice hot cup of chai and some pakodas?" Chai and pakodas would be nice, though Mani wished the Room hadn’t told amma he had a headache. Now she would worry. “Okay.” “Great. I have told the Kitchen. And Manikantan, put your Shoes in the ShoeRack.” “Yes,” said the ShoeRack, “I have plenty of space. Waiting.” Mani knew he should get up, but he didn’t feel like it. Maybe he should just sleep a little. He was so tired. “Waiting,” said the ShoeRack. Mani closed his eyes and thought of Anandpuram. His Amma called it a village, but to Mani it was home. He recalled the graceful sway of the tall palm trees and the vast rose-blue sky. In the morning the gentle gusts of wind carried the wonderful smell of porottas cooking over charcoal fires. The winter months were the best. The cool air was nothing like the air-conditioned air in Smart City’s buildings. No, wait, the rainy season was the best! It was such fun to watch the fat heavy warm droplets splish-splosh into the river Periyar. Oh, how he’d enjoyed sitting by the riverbank. So quiet, so peaceful. If only things could go back to the way they had been. “Waiting,” said the ShoeRack. Mani sat up with a sigh. He didn’t mind being given helpful hints, but this was too much. It was almost like being a prisoner and nobody, not even Amma, understood. Mani placed the Shoes on the ShoeRack and headed for the Kitchen. He had to warm the pakodas himself, but the FoodGenie brewed some chai. It tasted exactly like the kind of chai a machine would make. “Is the chai to your satisfaction, Manikantan?” asked the FoodGenie. “As good as cow urine.” “Thank you.” Mani’s Amulet beeped. It was his mother. She wanted to know whether he was feeling better. “How is your headache, kanna?” Her loving voice made Mani feel very sorry for himself. “The headache’s better, Amma. How’s work?” “Wonderful. It’s not like my old Anandpuram job at all. How was your day, kanna?” “Great.” His Amma worked so hard, such long hours, worried so much about him, cared so much. She was his mother and father and all the family he had in the world. He just didn’t have the heart to tell the truth. “I had a great day.” “You sure, Mani? Your SchoolBag told me you were sent to the Principal. What was that about?” “Nothing.” “Mani?” “Nothing! You can ask the Schoolbag. It seems to know everything.” “Mani, what’s the matter? Look, why don’t you go to the Mirror? I want to see you. Whatever the problem is, we can solve it.” “No, we can’t solve it!” Mani felt tears beginning to form. He tried to press back the tears but they kept coming like the rain on Periyar. He knew the House would report to his mother that her son was crying. Everything he did was watched and reported. He knew it was all for his own good and he knew Amma loved him, but sometimes, he wanted things to be. He closed his finger around the Amulet, and pulled the chain so hard, it snapped. Mani threw the Amulet into the Trash, and ignoring its shouting, ran out of the apartment. Mani didn’t know how long he ran or where he went or how exactly he got lost. Without the Amulet to guide him, he simply didn’t know where he was going. But the smart objects of the City had guessed he was lost and alerted the proper authorities. After his mother had thanked the nice policeman who brought him back, Mani took the Amulet from her. He was ashamed but also really glad to be back. “I have adjusted some of the settings,” said his mother. “The House will now give you a little more privacy. But it is really for your own good, Mani.” “I know,” mumbled Mani. “So how was it, your little adventure?” Mani shuddered. The streets had been filled with people but they were all somehow different. They were all strangers. With the Amulet, the streets were filled with many people he almost knew. Their names, the kind of music they liked, who their friends were, lots of fun stuff like that. Without the Amulet even simple things, like crossing the streets, had become difficult. There was no voice to tell him: “You can cross now, Manikantan.” And nobody knew him either. When he had passed the poster for the movie 'Mission Maut', the hero of the movie Vikram Seven said: “Hi, do you like action movies?” If he’d had the Amulet, Vikram would have said: “Hey Manikantan, nice to see you again, yaar, let’s talk.” Without the Amulet, every object was as stupid as a stone. “I thought so,” said his mother, with a small smile. “Now Mani, you know you shouldn’t have left the House without the Amulet? We were so worried!” “I’m sorry I broke the rules, Amma.” “That’s not always a bad thing, kanna. But you are a big boy now. You have to be more mature. Our life here is pretty happy, na?” Mani thought of Anandpuram. An Amulet would be pretty useless in Anandapuram. Maybe that wasn’t such a good thing. He nodded. His mother was very sweet. She prepared dinner by hand — well, mostly by hand, the FoodGenie helped, just a little. Then she read him a story as he drank his milk. Later she tucked him into bed, gave him a good-night kiss, and touched her Amulet to his. He could tell Amma was very tired. “Good night, Amma.” “Good night, kanna.” “Good night, Manikantan, good night, Amma,” whispered the House. “Sleep tight, and I won’t let the bedbugs bite.” The Internet of Things Does your alarm clock know that you have exams tomorrow? Will it remind you to set the alarm so that you can get up early to do a final revision? If you are going somewhere and get lost, can your shoes give step-by-step directions? Of course not. Today, most of the objects we are surrounded are just objects. They don’t really know anything about you or the objects in the house. The clock is just a clock. The radio is just a radio. The clock does not know what the radio does and vice versa. They are not connected to you or to other people or to the objects in the world. But things are about to change. Soon, all human-made objects will be interconnected. They will be more aware of what is going on around them. They will be smarter. They will be able to exchange data and keep track of your needs in a better way. When objects get interconnected and can communicate with each other, as if by an invisible telephone network, we say we have an Internet of Things. If it were up to you, would you like to live in Smart City or in Anandpur? Why? What if they all started talking? Count the number of objects in your home or classroom (door, chair, clock, radio, books, etc.). Are you surprised by the number? Imagine how it would be if they could all see and hear and speak. How would your life change?
author: Shivank Mohanty

title: The Lonely Frog
text: Beyond the green grass, was a pond. It was no ordinary pond. It was a special pond. How special you ask? Well, it had all types of flowers with all the colo rs you could ever imagine. The pond had water of purple color. All the people their used to say, ''Whoever touches or drinks the water from that pond, turns into a frog''. And not just a normal frog, a frog with unique powers. Powers like heat breath, teleportation, super strength, the power to jump ten times higher than an average human, the ability to stretch its tongue further than one meter and so many more such powers. The young ones of the frogs also had unique powers, powers just like the humans who were turned into frogs. But there was one frog who always isolated herself from other frogs. Her name was Zakia. She isolated herself because of her ability to live on land and in water. She was always bullied by her friends because of that. They thought she was lame and boring. They would say, “Get out of here, we only hang out with cool kids, unlike you.” They would push her and call her stupid and dumb. Zakia was always unhappy, and would lock herself in her room and lie on her bed crying with her hands covering her face. Zakia had no siblings. She always complained to her parents when she was bored. Her mother would say, “Don’t be sad Zakia. They are the ones missing out having an amazing friend like you.” “What is wrong with me? Why am I being treated this way?” she would ask herself. The pond was always beautiful and amazing. Humans thought that the pond and the organisms in it were a danger to their species. Not only because the water would turn them into frogs, but also because of the powers the frogs had. The humans tried to destroy the pond, but were not successful because the frogs would fight back. However, there was one thing that was able to destroy the magic of the pond. That was sand from the ocean. If the humans found out about this, the pond and its creatures would be doomed. This is because, if the ocean sand was spread around the pond, the frogs would turn into statues, the flowers would die, and the water in the pond would turn grey. One morning, Zakia was woken up by the loud sound of her fellow frogs screaming. “What is happening?” Zakia asked herself in a scared voice. She quickly ran outside to see what had happened only to find herself looking at the most horrible thing she could ever imagine, “Oh my goodness! Noooh!” she shouted. She could not believe what she saw. The pond was grey. The frogs had frozen like statues and the flowers were dead. “This could only mean one thing: the humans have found out how to destroy the pond. And now I am the only frog here,” she told herself while staring at the pond from outside her home. She started to cry. Tears were running down her cheeks like a waterfall. “Why me? Why am I the only one left? Why am I not a statue like others?” she asked herself. The more she asked herself these questions, the angrier she got. She started punching the water thinking how beautiful it used to be. Then suddenly, the water turned purple again. You can only imagine how happy and shocked Zakia was. “Yes, yes, yes, oh my gosh!” she screamed with joy, while jumping up and down. “How could this happen?” she asked herself, “What have I possibly done to turn the water purple again?” She touched the flowers near the pond. “I remember how gorgeous the flowers were.” Then suddenly the flowers she was touching came back to life. Zakia was shocked now even more than she was before and she could not move. She figured out that she has the power to fix things and bring them back to their normal state just by touching them and thinking about how they used to be. She was so happy. Then she began to bring all the dead flowers back to life. Then she sat down by the pond and thought, “If I can bring dead flowers back to life, can I bring my fellow frogs back? There is only one way to find out. I should try it.” She rushed to her mother and stared at her with sadness and tears in her eyes. Then she tried to bring her mother back to life. She thought, “I remember how my mom used to be, breathing and alive.” Then her mother opened her eyes. “Mother! Mother! Can you hear me?” Zakia asked. “Yes, Zakia, I can hear you,” her mother replied. Zakia’s mother asked, “What happened?” Zakia told her mother everything that had happened including her newly discovered powers. Then she went on and brought back to life the rest of her fellow frogs. When Zakia was 15 years old, she was chosen as the leader of her frog community. This was not only because of her powers but also because of her bravery and quick thinking. She carried on leading her community and the pond remains immortal.

title: Animals of the sea
text: We live in a beautiful planet called Earth, which has land and water. Earth is covered by 70% of water. The water bodies are called Oceans, Sea, Rivers,Lakes, Ponds....These water bodies are home to lots of Animals and Plants. Lets look at some of the interesting facts about some sea creatures.. A Sea turtle is a Reptile like Snake or lizard. A group of sea turtles are called a "Bale". Sea turtles eat Sea grasses, Sponges, and Algae. Adult Sea turtles eat Crabs, Shrimps and Jelly Fish. Fishes live in the Sea,River and Ocean. A group of Fishes is called a School. Fishes eat Algae and Sea Grasses. Penguins are Flightless Birds. They have Flippers to swim in Ocean. They eat Krill and Fishes.Groups of Penguins in water is called Raft. They live as Colonies in the land. Sea lions wriggle, hunch, roll and slide. They walk on all four flippers. Sea lions eat Crabs, shrimp and Clams. They are 34-38 teeth which they use to catch the food. Dolphins live in Oceans and River. They eat Shrimps, Squid and Fishes. Groups of Dolphins are called Pod. They love to play.. just like us,they play with pebbles and things they find. Sea otters sleep, rest, and usually swim by paddling with their hind flippers on their backs. They eat sea urchins, crabs, abalone, clams, mussels, octopus, and fishes. Group of otter is called as Romp. Aren't they cute?? Crocodiles live in sea. They have 60-110 teeth. They live from 35 - 45 years. They are Carnivores, they are meat eaters. They have tough skin.

title: Dumroo
text: Once there was a big village. In the village were many green fields. In the middle of one green field was a small white school. In the small white school was a playground. In the playground were many children. And the children were sitting together in a circle. “Shall we play a game?” Didi asked. “Yes!” said the children. The circle got smaller. “Shall we play a fun game?” Didi asked. “Yes, yes!” said the children. The circle became even smaller. “Shall we play a very fun game?” Didi asked. “Yes, yes, yes!” said the children. The circle became so small that the children were almost in Didi’s lap. “I will say a letter,” Didi said, “You will tell me words that begin with the letter. So if I say ‘ka se’, you will say...?” The children thought. “Ka se... Kaka!” “Ka se kakdi!” “Ka se kambal!” Their words tumbled out, one on top of another. Only Mimi was quiet. “Come on, Mimi,” Didi said. “Come play with us. Ka se...?” Mimi looked at Didi. And she said… “ Dumroo ”. “No, no,” said the other children. “You have to say a word that begins with ka.” But Mimi said “ Dumroo ”. So they moved on to another letter. Didi said, “La.” “La se lassi!” “La se lamba!” “La se lal!” “La se lathi!” Didi looked at Mimi and said, “La se...?” Mimi looked at Didi. Mimi looked at everyone. And she said “ Dumroo ”. Next, Didi said, “Pa.” “Pa se papita!” “Pa se papa!” “Pa se pani.” Everyone looked at Mimi and said, “Mimi, pa se...?” Mimi looked at everyone, and everyone held their breath. And Mimi said “ Dumroo ”. Now things were getting interesting. Everyone knew Didi’s game. Everyone understood Mimi’s game. “Okay fine,” Didi said. “Da se...?” Everyone looked at Mimi and shouted, “ Da se dumrooooooo! ” Mimi gave a big big smile, and said… “Da se... Dafleeeeee!” ​THE STORY BEHIND THIS STORY This book is dedicated to the real "Mimi", all her friends and to all children who love to play with words. The story is based on a real incident in a government primary school in Sitapur district in Uttar Pradesh. The author played these games with Std I and II children and everyone had fun that day and it all became a story later.
author: Rukmini Banerji

title: Ben Is late!
text: Mr. Ram was the head of a software company. Ben, was one of his favourite employees. One day Mr. Ram announced: Aattention, Attention, Tomorrow we are going to have an important meeting. Ben, you are going to attend it, It starts at 10:00. Even Pam should attend the meeting. After finishing working in his office he went home with a big wide smile. Then he ate his dinner, and stayed up late night forgetting about his important meeting tomorrow. The next day Ben woke up very late. When his alarm rang, he just simply turned it off. When he realized that he was late, he swiftly went to his office. But then he saw some people who were talking to each other. One of the women said: Hey, did you know that for my job to get done I went to a software company but I had to wait for hours. He realized that they were talking about the same office he worked in! When he entered the offfice and entered the meeting room, he saw Mr. Ram sitting furiously. He shouted: Ben! All because of you we lost 10 customors! I am sorry dear friend, but I am firing you. Ben saddly nodded his head and went out of the Software company. Moral of the story: If you do one silly mistake, you may fall in serious trobule

title: Count Your Calories
text: Partha was a very fat boy. He always ate junk food and fast food. One day his father called him. He said, “Partha, do you know that you always eat more calories than you need?" Partha asked, “Daddy, What do you mean by calories?” Daddy said, “A calorie is a unit that measures energy. Calories are used to measure the energy content of foods and beverages that we eat and drink.” Partha asked, “How many calories do we need per day?" Daddy said, “A man on an average needs 2000 to 3000 calories per day for his daily body functions and everyday activity. A woman needs 1600 to 2000 calories per day. For young children, it is 1000 to 2000 calories per day.” Daddy said, “Your body needs 1300 calories per day for your age. But you are eating foods such as pizzas, burgers, sweets, doughnuts, cakes, and fried foods that have more calories. So, every day you eat food that adds up to 1800 calories. So, you are eating extra food that gives the extra 500 calories per day.” Partha asked, “What happens when I eat extra calories?” Daddy said, “The extra calories are stored in your body as fat. You become fat and you will find it difficult to do basic activities such as climbing stairs. In the long run, it may lead to diseases such as hypertension and diabetes.” Partha asked, “So, what must I do dad?” Daddy said, “You can eat nutritious and healthy food with fewer calories such as milk, vegetables, fruits, eggs, rice, and chapati with side dishes. Occasionally, you can have other foods like a piece of halwa or ice cream.” Partha said, “I will try to reduce my calorie intake.” Daddy said, "Good. Another way is to exercise and engage in other physical activities. This will also help you to burn the excess calories." Partha said, "Ok, Dad." Some common foods and their calories are as follows: 1 boiled egg - 78 calories 1 cup of milk - 103 calories 1 regular cheese pizza - 275 calories 1 bowl vegetable salad - 179 calories 1 Gulab Jamun - 125 calories 1 Chapathi - 104 calories 1 bowl of cooked rice - 150 calories 1 Vada - 73 calories 1 Piece of Cake with Icing - 350 calories Did you notice that you have to eat more amount of high-calorie foods to fill your stomach? You will not feel full even if you eat 5 Gulab Jamuns which will be 625 calories. But, if you eat 2 chapatis which is 208 calories, you will feel full. Calories you burn or spend on different activities are as follows. Walking for 30 minutes - 100 to 300 calories Sleeping for 8 hours - 266 to 342 calories Reading for 30 minutes - 42 calories Aerobics for 30 minutes - 180 calories Cycling for 30 minutes - 280 calories Did You Know? A person with more weight spends more calories for any activity. Activity 1: In the food items shown above, can you spot and name the two food items that have high calories. Answers in the last page. Activity 2: In the food items shown above, can you spot and name the two food items that have high calories. Answers in the last page. Answers: Activity 1: a) Pizza b)Cake Activity 2: a) Burger b)French Fries

title: Hide and Seek
text: Mom said, "Sure, Dodo." His mother closed her eyes for some time. Dodo looked for places where he could hide. He opened a door and saw if he could hide inside the room. He saw seven baskets, one on top of another. "Oh. Let me look for another place to hide," he thought. He opened a cupboard to see if he could hide there. He saw six vases of different shapes inside the cupboard. "The cupboard is full. Let me look for another place to hide," he thought. He opened the door to their garden. He saw five shuttlecocks on the grass. "I think friends are playing in the garden. Let me look for another place to hide," he thought. He came inside the house and opened another cupboard. He saw four pants hanging there. Then he went to look for another place to hide. When he peeped into another room, he saw three veenas. *Veena is a musical instrument. He looked behind a curtain, and he saw two hands. Then his mother held him and said, "I found you." So, Dodo's hide-and-seek game came to an end without him hiding somewhere.
