author: Prisha Pandey
illustrator: Isha  Valentine; Manobendro Golder; Measa Sovonnarea; Muniza Shariq; Srikrishna Kedilaya

title: BEAUTY OF THE BEAST
text: " The train is about to leave! Rush Sanya!!" said her mother. Sanya was very excited as she was going to her granny's house to Palwana, a small village in Dharamshala. Get up Sanya, we have reached granny's house" said her mother. "Maa look at the green forest, beautiful flowers and snow covered peaks." Hurray!! She ran up the hill. Grandma welcomed them with glittering eyes.. Sanya had her dinner and slept with granny. Next morning she was so excited to visit her favourite place on the top of the hill. "Mom I will be back by afternoon" said Sanya. hmmm....laaaa....ohohooo.... (vulture singing) Wow!! What a melodious voice, but how can a wild scavenger like you sing so well?.. "Sanya can we be friends?" asked the vulture. " Sanya will u fly with me and meet my friends?" No, humans don't fly. My mom also says that you can eat us. No, I am scared. I can't fly with you.. Yes we both can be good friends and i will call u OSCAR. Come with me Sanya. I will show you something, so you know us better! Don't be scared dear! You all see only one side of our living...but do you know, if we (vultures) get extinct from the world, then entire ecological balance will be disturbed? Sanya, I will hold you in my claws and we will fly together to see some of the unseen things. " I am really excited, let's go" said Sanya. "Wow Oscar!!, I am flying so high like a kite sailing in the sky. I am above the clouds hurray!, you all are so lucky Oscar" Sanya said excitedly. "Its not like that Sanya! we fly like this the whole day, let me show you the reason behind this" said Oscar. "You all are the real heroes Oscar!! You are my best friend and you indeed taught me a very important lesson today": "ONE SHOULD NEVER JUDGE A BOOK BY IT'S COVER!" "Oh Oscar! where are we?"...its stinking badly and there is lots of garbage around. See Sanya all my friends are here on duty to clean, if we will not do our duty daily, then this world will be a filthy place filled with rotten carcasses and diseases all around!!
author: Aaryav Makol
illustrator: Imile  Wepener; Kausikaa T; Muniza Shariq; Patrick Latimer; Samidha Gunjal; Samit  Shrestha; Santosh Pujari; Wiehan de  Jager

title: Neha Loves Colours.
text: Neha was very fond of colours. Every day, Neha watched her garden through the window. "The leaves of the tree are green," she said. She started to count the number of birds on the tree. 1, 2, 3, 4... "The birds are blue, yellow, red, and black in colour," she said. ﻿ Neha likes to play by spreading her mother's saree pallu over her head. "Mom's saree colour is yellow," she said. When she was planting trees in the garden with her grandpa, she noticed his moustache. "Grandpa's moustache is white," she said. Neha said, "The soil is brown." She ran behind a cat that ran behind a squirrel. "The cat is black," she said. Leaves fell on the ground and clouds floated in the sky. Neha noticed the different colours around her. Green, White, Brown... The colourful birds started to chirp. Basker was making natural colour water to spray for the Holi festival. Neha said, Baskar, mix these orange coloured flowers in the water. Neha was fond of all the different colours of Holi powder. She used the pichkari and screamed with joy, "Here you go. Blue water on you." Basker put red powder on her face and Neha continued to have fun with colours.
author: Anitha Selvanathan

title: Surprise, Priya!
text: It is a very sunny day,Priya and her twin sister Medha are off to school and their father has gone to work, as their mother stays at home with grandma and grandpa, her father went for work and came back late (usually) and he is tired and mum says he needs rest, granny is stitching some baby clothes for there baby cousin who’ll be coming to there house next week! When Priya came back with Medha they made cookies with their Mom, she was surprised to see her dad early for the first time! Medha was stressed out she had lots and lots of homework given by her Maths and Science teacher so she told that she can’t join them in make the scrumptious cookies, she knew that she’d love to make and bake them all along. It was afternoon close to lunchtime and the cookies were ready they asked Medha to try them because she hadn’t been there to bake the cookies, “Crunch,Crunch and Crunch” went Medha’s mouth, she closed her eyes and told “Delicious, the cookies are perfect to stay for more than a week!” Poor Medha, she sat till evening and avoiding to go to play she really loved playing with Priya and her friends, she went down stairs for granny’s help for science and granny was surprised and said aloud “Oh, how I wish you asked me more, those days when I was a kid like you I just asked and asked questions that would never end that sometimes made my parents rather annoyed, ho ho ha ha” laughed granny “They were the most delightful times, now here come close there’s a secret I want to share to you,”she whispered “But don’t tell it to Priya!,” in a rather warning voice she said. “Oh, okay,” Medha said not knowing what her granny was going to say to her. “Okay here we go, you see Priya’s birthday is coming soon and we must have a surprise and those cookies they made were made for her birthday and your aunt, uncle and cousin baby will be coming that’ll be a fine surprise for are sweetie Priya!,” she said in an exiting and whispering voice. “Oh, how could I forget her birthday!?,” cried Medha. Next day was Priya and Medha’s last dance practice for their dance programme of the school, the twins and their friends were excited, they would twirl and swirl on stage and they’ll jump and hop gracefully with all their friends surround them, how happy they all were, but after the practice they had that day the school declared the dance programme canceled, Priya and Medha weren’t sad, they have lots more to do so they thought of playing hopscotch outside with their friends. They all got tired and rested for a while and thought okay let’s go indoors that’ll be better.Priya forgot that her birthday was coming soon and she didn’t take a notice, even if they gave her clues of something special that would happen? Finally their baby cousin came to their home, but it cried so much that Priya and Medha got so annoyed and they couldn’t sleep at night because of their cries, but surprisingly granny and grandpa loving sang lullabies to them and made them wear granny’s hand weaved baby clothes the looked very cute on them, eventually everything settled Priya and Medha sang lullabies for them and made them sleep.Suddenly the next morning their mother caught cold so they took her to the doctor. Their aunt cooked the food for them and took them to school while their uncle takes care of the baby cousin. They were all concerned about Priya and Medha’s Mom, but fortunately she was well soon so she returned home and she brought along with her Priya’s birthday party decorations and hid them as soon as she could, she brought juice, chips, popcorns, ice cream and a beautiful cake with Priya’s face on it, “phew! I hope Priya hasn’t seen me hiding these things”, she said with a sigh. Finally the day arrives, it’s Priya’s birthday, she is fast asleep on bed everyone turns of the lights and she wakes up and brushes her teeth and she runs downstairs, she gets scared cause it’s too dark, suddenly all of them at on screamed “SURPRISE PRIYA! AND A HAPPY BIRTHDAY!”. She gasps and says “It’s my birthday!”. She said “This is my best surprise birthday ever and Thank You!” The summer vacations were coming soon so they all decided to have fun in the sun, so they visited the beach and made sandcastles and clicked few pictures on their sail in the boat, all of them enjoyed, they all brought their favourite snacks and the cookies, they made at home, their baby cousin, slowly started crawling around and they all clapped along, they sang some songs and had a pleasant day! And at last Priya and Medha whispered at the same time, “They best vacation ever!”
author: Kirtimayee Swain
illustrator: Ana RoGu; Annada Menon; Kabini  Amin; Megha Vishwanath; Sandhya Prabhat

title: Aiman's Backpack
text: There is a little girl starts open her eyes and gets ready to go the school. This little girl named is Aiman. And me? Her beloved I stare at her from the corner of the room. I am so happy because she will bring me with her to school. Aiman carries me on her back every morning going to school. When she starts to run, my heart beats as fast as she runs. I lean on her back until we arrive to the bus. In the bus, I sit comfortably on her lap. She does that because she loves me. I meet other backpacks on the way go to school. We talk and sing until we arrive at school. Then, we hop and run with each of our beloved partners. There are lots of school stuff that she keeps inside my belly. There are a colorful book, notebook, eraser, pencil, and also her lunchbox. Yummy! the lunchbox smells so delicious. The stuff inside my belly scatters because she jumps and runs around. But I always along with her everywhere she moves. When the lunch break bell rings. She leaves me in the classroom. I feel alone, but the other backpacks still in here with me. We talk, laugh, and sing again. However, I miss her. When the bell rings for the last time. Do you know what she does? Yes, she puts all stuff into my belly quickly! She wants to come home soon. My heart beats very quickly because she runs as fast as lightning to get the bus. She keeps me in the corner when we arrive home. She will forget me, again. I just can stare at her from my place. When she is going to the next class, she puts more stuff in my belly. She starts difficult to brings me on her back. Is there any solution to help us?
author: Muhammad Saiful

title: HARRY AND GARRY
text: Harry and Garry were a loyal friends. They stayed in Goa One day Harry and Garry they had a fight with the king of Goa. The king said I will execute Garry. Garry said that I have a family give me one month and I will be back. The king said let us bargain that if you are not back in a month's time I shall execute your friend Harry. Garry said ''yes I agree with you. When Garry was coming home he had to fight with storm and monters. It was very difficult journey of he coming back home. He reached his home in the night. He narrated his story to his family and said I have to return to king after the month He finished his work and packed his bag to return to the King. The king was surprised to see that Garry was arrived. The King said you are a loyal friend. I forgive you and your friend Harry. Both the friends were happy and they returned back to there home. THE END
author: Sravya Vohra
illustrator: Julie  Smith-Belton; Maithili  Joshi; Malvika Tewari; Wiehan de Jager; Yuwak  Shrestha

title: Best Friends Forever
text: Once upon a time, there was a little girl name Sita. She was looking some fruits in forest. She saw that two animals are arguing with each other. Loin and Bear. She called her brother Bittu to stop arguing in between Lion and Bear. "Sita is asking" Why are you arguing? Lion is my friend he shares all secret with me but one day he has the best friend and he didn't tell me, "Bear said". "Sita ask" This is true? "Yes" Lion said. I am sorry Bear. Ok Lion, now we are friends again! Yes, we are success to make bear and Lion friends. Now, we are going to find fruits in the forest. They are all eating fruits. Then, Sita was telling about her family. I have Father, Mother and my Brother. I have four members in my home. I love my family and they also loves Me.... Do you like about my family? All said yes, but feeling lazy. "Sita said" ok let us sleep I am also feeling lazy. Then they where playing with each other. "Sita said" now we want to go home. "Elephant said" I also want to go so I will leave to your home. "Bittu and Sita said" Ok bye and see you again. (Thanks)
author: Rudrakshi Kaushik

title: Neha and her father
text: Neha is a very bright and energetic young girl who studies in Bombay. She is in the 6th grade and participates in a lot of class discussions. She loves playing with her friends. Neha's papa is Mr. Vivek who is a Railway officer. Neha and her father love spending time with each other. He teaches her Science and Mathematics. Neha believes her father is the smartest and some day wants to become as accomplished and smart as him. One day, Neha receives a school Science project and as always goes to her father seeking his help. To her surprise her father asks her to manage the project on her own. Neha is quite upset by this and starts to blame her father for not being there for her. After a day or two, Neha realises that her father is still not helping her and the submission for the project is very near. She has no choice but to start to work on it by herself. She had already wasted a lot of time feeling upset about not getting any help. After spending an entire day on it she was able to complete most of the project. Her father saw her progress and was quite impressed. He then decided to help her out with the rest. She learned that she could do anything difficult if she just put her heart and hard work in it. Her father wanted to teach her the meaning of hard work and self confidence. Neha presented her project with pride in class and was very pleased with her own progress!
author: Anubha Bhatnagar
illustrator: Anastasiya Ivanova; Madhuri Purandare; Mayur Mistry; Preeti Krishnamurthy; Priyankar Gupta; Sahitya Rani

title: Let's Buy Books
text: One day Grandpa gave my brother and me some money. "Go! Buy books," he said. We were both very happy. We both love to read. Shall we go now? Shall we go later? Shall we go today? Shall we go tomorrow? We decided to go now. Should we go to the big market? Should we go to a smaller shop? Should we go with someone? Should we go alone? We decided that only the two of us would go to the small shop. We like the little bookstore. It is small but there are many books here. The shopkeeper recognizes us. He always helps us. Should we buy a book that has lots of pictures? Should we buy a book that has a lot of stories? ﻿ Shall we buy the thin book? ﻿ We couldn't decide. The shopkeeper smiled at us. "Kids, come with me," she said. “These books are about animals. They are about fairies. The battles above are about. Take whatever you want. I picked up some books. My brother picked up some books. I sat on the floor. He sat on the chair. And we both went on reading, reading and studying. How peaceful was there! No sound anywhere. An hour passed. Two hours passed. Finally, we knew which books to buy. The shopkeeper smiled at us. I bought a thick book containing many stories. My brother bought a large book containing many pictures. We ran to Grandpa's house. He climbed on his bed and sat down. He made him sit next to him. We keep reading, keep reading, keep reading...
author: Rudrakshi Kaushik

title: What if.....?
text: She was thinking... Will the jelly beans really help him jump higher? Will she be able to reach school with a big jump! What if goats and chickens could talk? Would she tell funny jokes? If everyone's houses were like rocket-ships? Then his family could go on vacation to the moon! What if you don't have to cook? And dinner, would have come on the table on its own? (And that would have been his favorite food.) What if the ball of ice never melted? Then we could eat it all summer long. When dad was reading books, And what if all the pictures in the story were flying around your head? What if my pink gumboots were magical? Then I could run faster than my older brother! What if you closed your eyes and... "Nandi, what are you doing?" Nandi's elder brother asked him. Then Nandi, with a big smile on her face, sat down on a ladder. "I was just thinking," she said.
author: Rudrakshi Kaushik

title: Pet Dog Nunu
text: Nunu is Surjit’s pet dog. His father bought Nunu when he saw a post on Facebook asking for people who can adopt an abandoned puppy. Nunu and Surjit always played fetching the ball game in their house. Surjit’s mom always scolded them both for turning things upside down in the house by running behind the ball. One day, Surjit and Nunu went to the nearby park for walking. There were many people walking and playing in the park and Nunu could not run freely. Then they sat in the park and looked at the seashore. Nunu barked and Surjit understood that Nunu wanted to go to the beach. So, they both went to the beach and played fetch the ball game. Surjit thought, "Wow. There is so much space to run around in the beach. We are not disturbing people or toppling things also." Surjit decided to play fetch with Nunu only at the beach and not at home. After some time, Nunu became very excited and started running fastly in one direction. Surjit ran behind Nunu, but Nunu was very far off. Nunu then slowed down, and Surjit ran and caught up with Nunu. He gave Nunu biscuits he had bought with him. Both of them went home happily. They have found the beach to play and have fun.
author: Anitha Selvanathan

title: Salish and the snow story
text: One day, A girl named Salish wanted to play in snow. Salish asked her mother, when we will go to snow. The mother said we will go soon there in December. She said yay!!. In December she was so happy. She went to the airport and travelled for 8 hours. She landed at United Kingdom and was feeling very cold. She wear a heavy jacket with a wool coat to survive. She did so much of shopping and started skiing in the snow. The next day, Salish get lost from her parents. She was crying and nobody listened. She did a mistake that she was running because a dog was chasing her and luckily she escaped but she was not able to find her parents. Her parents rushed to the shopping market and finally she was there with her parents. Moral of he story is do not go away from your parents. Bye, meet you until the next book!!!
author: Amit Vij
illustrator: Isaac Gergan; Sahitya Rani; Sirawon Khathing; Upamanyu  Bhattacharyya

title: Love your parents!
text: A girl named Sita lived with her poor mom, on an island far away from the village, but her mother some how managed to send her school. Her father also stayed and worked in the village. She went in a big bus, but one day she missed the bus. She was very sad but her mom tried to cheer her up. It wasn't Sita's fault because the bus came early that day. They tried to catch the bus but could not. It was Sita's exam today and she could not miss it at any cost. Her mom tries to sell her gold in order to get some money. She gives the money to a bus that also goes to school. it is really expensive. Finally Sita is able to go to school. She thanks her mom and is very grateful
author: Asmita Chauhan
illustrator: Karmacharya K.K; Manasi Parikh; Mango  Tree; P.G. Dinesh; Suvidha  Mistry

title: A hungry Dog
text: Once upon a time there was a dog who was very hungry. He was in search of food. Then he saw a chapati who fall at ground. He was very happy and want to eat it. When he started eating it,his teeth broke because it was so hard. Then he saw a bowl filled with curd he started eating it, and was happy. Then he want to drink water. Then he want to a river and drank the water.He was happy and fall asleep.
author: Aarush Gupta
illustrator: Brad Cuzen; Karen  Vermeulen; Noyonika Banerjee; Partho Sengupta; usha aswath iyer

title: The Chutulu's Demand
text: Once upon a time there was a ship which was sailing near the west of point nemo. The place point nemo is very dangerous because it is rumored that cthulhu is in there swimming in the ocean very quitely. Cthulhu is a mythical creature which is rumored to live in the point nemo where a town has drowned underneath the ocean. The ship has 2,400 people in it and 1 driver suddenly it starts storming and their ship starts going up and down. Then the all mighty Cthulhu shows up and drags the boat with his arms and then just drowns it to the ocean. Then The Crew Members try to escape the driver escaped somehow to the main island. The Cthulu still doesn't regret and fights more and then when its fighting the other crew members the other people escape and go to the main island now there is only 15 people remaining that Cthulu could get. Chutulu leaves them alone and it eats other animals and boats instead.
author: Thunder Raptor
illustrator: Adrija Ghosh; Amy  Slatem; Thunder Raptor

title: The Cunning lion
text: Once upon a time there was a forest named Harinvan.In that forest lived a lion named Sam.He was the king of the forest.He had a friend,a crocodile named John.One day,Sam told his friend that he can leave his children to him and he would teach them without any cost. John had faith on him that he would not harm his children.He had ten children.John sent his children to him and he left out from his den.Then Sam talk to them very friendly and after 15 minutes.He growled and pounced on them and ate 9 of the children. Then he rudely said that he should not tell that he ate his siblings.Later the child's father came and the lion displayed the small child. This went for a year.One day John came to visit his babies.But it was too late,the lion had already eaten the last child.When the father came he cried and cried,as the lion said that he had fooled him and eaten all his children. After some time he called his friend John,but he did not get any response.He realized his mistake but the crocodile did not forgive him.Sam felt sorry and spent rest of his life with sorrow and grief.
author: Marcellina Barman
illustrator: Ajit Narayan; Ashok Rajagopalan; Partho Sengupta; Phùng  Nguyên Quang; Rob Owen; Robert McEwan; ROSH

title: Janey loves Jake
text: This is a Hornbill. Her name is Janey. She has a big beak. These are her neighbours. Mrs. Robin and the swarm of bees. They love to keep her company and help eaach other. Janey sees a hornbill named Jake. She loves him. But what is this, he is being carried away by a boy on a scooter. He waves goodbye. But Janey follows him, she isn't discouraged. The boy leaves Jake at his home. Finally, Janry and Jake are able to meet. They become a happy couple.
author: Pratikshya Singh
illustrator: Anjora Noronha; Diana James; Febin Raj; Nafisa Nandini  Crishna

title: Greedy Magru
text: He never listened to anyone, he took away all the bananas from his brothers. ﻿Magru, being greedy is not a good thing. ﻿But Magru didn't listen to anyone. By following this habit, he ate a small quantity of mangoes and pears, and he threw away the rest. '﻿Magru, destroying food is not a good habit' said one of his friends Sonu. Magru said, 'This is really funny.' '﻿Come on, let's swim' said Magru while jumping into the water. Under the tree, his brother was eating the fruits thrown by him. ﻿In this way, Magru spent his free time. ﻿He shared his bananas with Muggu the hen and Gadhdu the donkey. But these animals didn't eat bananas. Magru wasn't aware of that fact. ﻿One day all the brothers were playing. Just then, Magru saw a banana. ﻿He said 'Brothers! There is a banana inside the cave.' ﻿ Magru! Bananas don't grow in caves.By seeing him Magru's brother said 'It might be dangerous.' But, Magru didn't listen to his brothers and ran towards the cave. ﻿ ﻿﻿Just when, Magru entered the cave and started eating the banana, the cave opening closed. It was not a cave but a snake's mouth. He kept Magru as a prisoner. By, seeing this the brother who had come with him escaped. Greedy Magru died because of his greediness.
author: Pratikshya Singh
illustrator: Aliya Shetty Oza; Jayaprakash Bojan; Jess  Jardim-Wedepohl; Salim  Kasamba; Sandra   McDougall

title: Rabbit and the pumpkins.
text: The rabbit and plants play in the garden. One day, the plants were playing with the rabbit. One day the rabbit was surprised to see the plants turned into trees. The rabbit cried seeing the trees. He planted some new plants. They also turned into trees. He was very upset. He planted lots and lots and lots of plants. They also turned into trees. He was very upset. And then, he had a very big idea. He planted a pumpkin seed. The pumpkin seed turned into a pumpkin. Then, the rabbit was very happy! He played with the pumpkin. He planted lots of pumpkins and then he played with the pumpkins everyday.
author: Sooryakala Jeyasooria
illustrator: Chamath Prasanga Lokuliyana; Rohit Bhasi; Sanatan Juanga; Sunaina  Coelho

title: Cow
text: Cows has four legs and two horns, two ears and two eyes. They are black or white coloured. Some cows are even brown coloured! Cows live in barns. Cows eat grass. Also cows eat plants, cows are vegetarian. Cows give a lot of milk, from the milk we make curd, buttermilk, butter and ghee. A cow's child is called a calf. We make fertilizer and Govarya from cow dung. A cow is a very useful animal.
author: Atharva Sunkersett
illustrator: Gomathy S; Shreya  Sen; Srikrishna Kedilaya

title: Food Bank
text: Hi! I Rabhya. I live in a society named Urban society. Today, there is a meeting in which all the society members are invited. As the meeting started, a question raised " How we can not let food get wasted "? All the society members were thinking, but to no avail. Then, I said " What about starting a food bank "? I continued, " People can brought the food to the food bank and there we can store it ". I said it by pointing to a empty flat. All the people agreed. The next day, all the society members started working by bringing many chairs, tables and fridges. So that food can be stored for more time and the eater can eat comfortably. As days went by, many people joined and worked together.
author: Divyanshi Sharma
illustrator: Bindia  Thapar; Deepa Balsavar; Divyanshi Sharma; Ekta Bharti; Rajiv Eipe; Siya Masuku

title: Birthday Feast
text: He saw the frog in the pond. "Dear frog, please come to my home on my birthday," he said. Naresh said, "Hi Deer. Please come home for my birthday on this Thursday." The deer asked, "How old are you turning? Naresh said, "I'm turning 10 years old on my birthday." "I will surely come," said the deer. Naresh said, "Hi monkey. You are always eating only bananas. Come home for my birthday. I will give you other fruits like apple." The monkey said, "Sure. I will come." "Hi sheep. Come home for my birthday on Thursday," said Naresh. The sheep said, "Sure." "Hi peacock. I want you to spread your feathers and dance on my birthday. Please come home," said Naresh. The peacock said, "Sure. I will." "Come home for my birthday, Cow." The cow said, "Moo, Moo." "Dear Buffalo. Come home for my birthday," said Naresh. The buffalo shaked its head in acceptance. "Hi elephant. I want to ride on you for my birthday. Come home and then take me for a ride, " said Naresh. The elephant raised its trunk and accepted. Naresh's mom Vaidehi asked, "Who is it?" Naresh said, "My friends have come home for my birthday feast." Vaidehi said, "Welcome. Come inside and please be seated. The feast will begin soon." Friends of Naresh happily went back after eating the delicious food each one of them liked. Naresh waved and said, "Thanks a lot for coming. See you all soon again. Bye for now."
author: Anitha Selvanathan

title: kangaroo
text: It is the national animal of Australia. Kangaroos live in grasslands. Kangaroos are herbivores. They eat leaves and fruits. Kangaroos run very fast. Kangaroo tails are long and heavy. Kangaroos do not have toes on their feet. Their hind legs are long and the front is short, due to which they move by leaping. Kangaroo is a mammalian animal. They keep their joeys in the bag. Kangaroo's pouch is in the lower part of their abdomen. They roam all the places keeping their joeys in the bag.
author: Hema Shankar

title: MY NAME IS HOPPLER, RENEDIS HOPPLER #BOOK-1
text: Dear Readers, I live in Writer's City. I am #1 Writer and my office is named as Writer's Spot. My city's name is Writer's city because here everyone is a writer. I regularly go on. Ohh I haven't introduced my self, my name is Hoppler, Renedis Hoppler. Okay where I was yes, I regularly go on adventures but I am a fraidy Human but I don't know how I get stuck into these things. I have my younger brother who always plays pranks on me but still he is nice. I am coming up with a series of good book based on my real life adventures. Stay Tuned.
author: Ishat Kumar Jha

title: A Cat's Day
text: Emma was riding a bicycle one weekend when a cat ran up to her. The cat followed her to her house when Emma gave her food. At first, the cat wasn’t close to her, but after a week, they became close. Because the cat doesn’t have a tail, its name is Stubs. Stubs still lives at Emma’s house. Stubs only likes Emma and her older sister. Stubs doesn’t like the neighbor’s dog so Stubs only goes out at night when the dog is asleep. The cat also doesn’t like other cats so usually it is with Emma. Every morning Stubs come out to Emma’s room to wake her up. Stubs is picky so he only eats his favorite food. So Emma only gets Stub’s favorite food. Stubs is a little chubby but very cute. Stubs doesn’t do anything during the day. Usually he plays by looking at fish or playing with toys. Stubs likes to nap on his favorite red pillow. Stubs doesn’t like loud cars, but when the weather is nice, Stubs goes outside. When Emma comes home from school, Stubs greets her at the front door. In the evening, Emma does her homework and watches K-drama on her bed with Stubs. Stubs likes to watch “Imagine Cats.” Stubs doesn’t like to stay indoors at nights, so he is usually outside. Stubs goes to the neighbor’s backyard or looks at the neighbor’s dog. If he is sleepy, he sleeps on a bed Emma made for him last year. So Emma is usually not worried even when Stubs is outside, but last month, something big happened. Late at night, Emma woke up to a loud noise from outside. Emma quickly went outside and saw a large raccoon under a car. The raccoon saw Emma and let out a loud screech. It was scary so Emma couldn’t do anything. Stubs let out a loud growl when it ran up to Emma. The raccoon scratched Stubs and but his head. Surprised. Emma ran up to them, but the raccoon ran away. title: Budd the dancing postie
text: Budd Cabbagewhite is a beautiful, elegant dancer. His dad says he’s a fidget! He’s a good listener to his friends - he’s not so chatty himself but would rather dance, dance, dance all day long. Budd's all grown up now, and his job is to deliver letters and messages. He's a postie! He wants to do a great job. When Budd was little, he was worried about being very plain because he’s just a creamy white colour - - unlike his friends who seem much more interesting - like Phil the Pheasant...... and Spiky the Chameleon. Budd now has the most glorious colours and patterns all over him. Can you see them? This is the story of how Budd got his marvellous wings. One sunny day in the springtime, Budd Cabbagewhite went to see his human friend Jojo. H e twirled around the garden, trying to spot the best, purpliest flower. Jojo had to follow Budd around the garden to keep up. Which flower do you think Budd landed on? Jojo told Budd Cabbagewhite that even though it was a happy kind of summery day, and she loved playing in the garden with her brothers and sisters, she sometimes wished she could talk to he r grandpa. Some people we love live far, far away from us don’t they? Jojo’s grandpa lives far away on the moon. So Jojo can’t visit him and he can’t visit her. But he is still her grandpa and he loves her with all his heart. I’ve got a brilliant idea! said Budd Cabbagewhite. What is it? Jojo wanted to know. If you want to say hello to your grandpa, I can tell him for you next time I fly to the moon. My job is to take messages between people or animals who can’t travel very quickly or very far. Everyone is good at different things, aren't they? Some animals are excellent at keeping smart and well presented, like cats. Some animals like dogs are crazy and scatty, running about, can’t keep still but they make everybody happy - even those people who think they don’t like dogs. Animals like birds and butterflies are brilliant at delivering messages. It’s not because they have the best memories – it’s because they can fly! Pigeons carry messages on paper attached to their feet. Birds like the Song Thrush invent tunes that contain messages, that they repeat over and over so they don’t forget it: ‘love you, love you, love you’ they sing. At insect school, Professor Kader had noticed Budd couldn't remember facts without clues or tricks to remember them - like when was the biggest anthill made? Or where is the yummiest honey found? So how does Budd remember the messages he carries? We'll find out soon. Now let's go back to Jojo - she had a lot to tell her grandpa! She wanted to describe what she’d been doing, what she’d been playing and all the fun she’d been having with her brother Toby. What a loooong message! I can’t remember all that! cried Budd Cabbagewhite, rubbing his head. It’s like a school test! He brushed off some pollen that had settled on his wing while they’d been discussing Jojo’s message to her grandpa. Look, this pollen has made a big yellow blob on my wing. And now it’s itchy, I can’t help putting my wings together to scratch it. Eek, there’s another blob on your other wing now, Jojo pointed out. Shall I help clean it off? Don’t touch it! Budd Cabbagewhite’s eyes danced with excitement. When I look at that blob I'll remember you told me a story about eating ice cream with Toby. So let me make more shapes to remember the different bits of your letter to your grandpa. So Budd Cabbagewhite weaved this way and that, using all different colours from the garden to make tiny shapes and symbols on his wings to remember different bits of Jojo’s message. Dots, stripes, blobs, lines, wavy lives and a big splash of blue – each thing meant Budd could remember something that Jojo wanted to say to her grandpa. He went on and on and on, making sure he got it all just right. When Budd finished, he did a perfect pirouette with a small bow at the end. Ta dah! Jojo couldn’t believe it – you look so beautiful! She said in a small voice. You’re not a plain butterfly any more, you’ve got bright colours and patterns all over you. That’s right, Budd agreed, I’m so beautiful because your message is full of love and happy stories. Off I go to find your grandpa! Jojo waved furiously as Budd Cabbagewhite danced away, transformed from the creamy white butterfly she’d first met. Next time you see a butterfly, notice how many colours and patterns you see. If it’s a plain white butterfly, they might take a message for you to someone you love. If you see a butterfly with very decorated wings, you’ll know they’re taking an important message to someone – it might even be for you! And - if you get really good at understanding codes and symbols - look at Budd when he returns you might even work out Grandpa’s message back to Jojo! What do you think Grandpa's message will say?

title: A Sweet Story
text: It was going to be a grand wedding. Juicy jalebis 1 glistened in rows on large trays. Golden boondi laddoos 2 were piled like a pyramid on plates. The cooks were frying puris 3 for the feast. Some voices were heard over the din. Oh, these weddings! They go on and on. Look… The bored guests are just waiting for the lunch to be served. 1 Crunchy, sweetened pretzel-shaped confection. 2 Sweet globules of fried batter moulded into mini balls 3 Palm-sized, light Indian bread served with savoury curry I am Jackson Jalebi. Call me JayJay. Hi! I am Lalita Laddoo. Call me Lulu. This wait is boring. Let’s do something exciting. How about a race? Come on. He slid off the tray and dropped neatly to the ground. Lulu followed, excited by JayJay’s challenge. Lulu merrily rolled down the road, enjoying the gentle breeze. A cyclist was speeding along the slope when Lulu crossed his path. The startled rider lost his balance. Lulu looked back to see the village Postman fall in a heap by the side of the road. Lulu apologised remembering her manners. But sped on, wanting to stay ahead in the race. Sorry, Sir. JayJay was not far behind. Just in time JayJay noticed a puddle in his path and took a mighty leap across it. JayJay boasted and raced along. Yippee! I am good enough for the Olympics. Lulu picked up speed. A dog looked puzzled as the laddoo sped by ….. was that a ball? Catch me if you can! Lulu yelled and raced ahead. JayJay was panting, breathless. His head was spinning. Jalebis are not used to this exercise, you see. Huff-puff. But he dare not stop. What if ….? JayJay looked all around. Not a sign of roly-poly Lulu. He decided to rest and catch his breath. Within seconds something small and yellow whizzed past him. What’s this, for God’s sake? Did Lulu think she was a planet? JayJay pulled himself up and decided to turn into a flying saucer. The flying saucer collided with an object. JayJay muttered in annoyance. Oopsie…Whoever placed this gulmohar tree in my way? Whoosh! JayJay spiralled down. Guess where? Right where Lulu was stuck in a thorny bush. The jalebi broke into a hundred pieces, big and small. The laddoo dispersed into a hundred-and-fifty golden pearls. A sharp-eyed crow was perched on a branch above. Folks! This way! Come, for a surprise meal. Cawing excitedly he summoned his friends. Within moments, a horde of noisy crows had swooped down and started on a sweet feast. And that was the end of the two runaways and their adventure. But they had fun, don’t you agree?

title: A glass of milk
text: Ron was poor. He sold pencils for a living. He had skills of a doctor. He wanted to become one but, he was poor so he thought it was impossible. One morning he was roaming around the streets. "Take the pencils, good pencils." He shouted "Oh I am so tired. I wish I'd get a glass of water." He sighed He went to a girl's house. "Miss, would you be kind enough to grant me a glass of water?" He said "Oh, of course." replied the little girl She went inside and brought a glass, which was filled with something white. Ron was waiting "What is this miss, it does not look like water. He asked "oh, you poor boy. This is milk, we had some extra left. Drink it." Smiled the little girl. "No no no miss, please take it back. I asked to only give me glass of water, this is too much." Said Ron. Half scared Half hesitant. "Drink it, no need to be scared. For me? Because I have always believed, 'what goes around comes around'." "If you say so...." Said Ron still hesitant He drank the glass of milk. Days passed and he went on his usual routine. "Take the pencils, good pencils." Years after that day, The little girl who was now a woman fell severely sick. She went to a famous hospital, but she recovered in one year. "How are you feeling" Asked the nurse. "Umm....Actually i won't be able to pay my bill. It must be so Expensive..." The woman replied "No problem" Replied the nurse And handed her a note "Doctor Ron has not charged you any fee" The note Read " What Goes Around Comes around. In return for a glass of milk. Moral- What Goes Around Comes around

title: Smarty Pod & Curious Pod in The Case of the Missing Diary
text: Curious Pod was a curious little chap. He wanted to know everything about everything. Every time Curious Pod found out something, he would write it down in his diary. One day, Curious Pod lost his diary and without his diary, he felt very very sad. Curious Pod looked for his diary in the garden. He looked under the bed. But he just couldn’t find his diary anywhere. He looked behind the sofa. Smarty Pod stood at the door. “Oh, Smarty! I have lost my diary. Please help me find it. You are such a smart detective,” said Curious Pod. But he just could not remember. “Ok, let us go everywhere you went today and search,” said Smarty Pod. “Hmmmm,” said Smarty Pod. “I had better put on my detective gear. Now tell me, when did you see your diary last?” he asked Curious Pod. Curious Pod thought and thought and th ought... in the garden... They looked in the bathroom… in the dining room… in the bedroom, but the diary was nowhere. “I went for a walk today,” said Curious Pod suddenly. “Maybe I dropped it there.” They walked along the path Curious Pod had walked, but still they didn’t find the diary!!! Suddenly, Smarty Pod heard a rumbling sound. “What’s that sound?” he said looking around. “It’s my tummy, I’m hungry,” wailed Curious Pod. “I have a pie in my fridge. Let’s go home and eat it.” They went back to Curious Pod’s kitchen. Smarty Pod had an idea. “I think I know where your diary is,” he said. Smarty Pod opened the fridge and guess what he saw there? THE DIARY!!! Silly Curious Pod forgot the diary inside the fridge. Curious Pod was happy. Smarty Pod had solved thecase of the missing diary.

title: Cooking with Veronica and Gabriel
text: Gabriel are fraternal twins. They love to cook. Their favorite food to cook is Empanadillas de Carne (Meat Dumplings). They want to cook because their grandma is going to visit them. But first, they need to buy the necessary ingredients. They need meat, oil, onions, garlic, thyme, tomato sauce, spring onions, salt, pepper, eggs, wheat flour, and unsalted butter. After buying the ingredients, Gabriel and Veronica return to the house to cook the Empanadillas de Carne. First, they are going to make the dough for the Empanadillas. In a bowl, Veronica adds 3 cups of wheat flour. Then, Gabriel puts in of a teaspoon of salt and 6 ounces of unsalted butter. Finally, Veronica puts in an egg and of a cup of water. After that, Gabriel and Veronica both work together to thoroughly mix the dough until it's ready. Then, after mixing everything, they begin to make the filling for the Empanadillas. To start making the filling Gabriel and Veronica need help from their mom, because there are jobs that are dangerous and that they cannot do. The first thing that must be done is to chop the meat. So, Veronica and Gabriel ask their mom to help them chop the meat. When their mom finishes chopping the meat, they will also ask her to cut one cup of onions and of a cup of spring onions. Once they finish cutting the ingredients, they add the minced meat into a bowl and sprinkle salt and pepper over it, and then set it aside. Then, with the help of their mom, they heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a frying pan and add the cup of chopped onions, and then wait for the onions to turn brown. While they are cooking the oil and onions, Gabriel adds the spice, garlic, and thyme. Then, Veronica and Gabriel let them saute for a couple of minutes. ﻿Veronica adds the meat to the pan and separates it into small pieces. Then, Gabriel adds the tomato sauces, as well as his preferred amount of salt. Veronica then adds 2 cups of water and mixes everything together. They leave it on the stove until it boils. When it begins to boil, they reduce the temperature and cook it on low heat until the liquid evaporates and it becomes a thick sauce. Then they turn off the stove and let it cool down. Finally, Gabriel grabs a little bit of dough and rolls it out into a flat circle. Using a tablespoon, Veronica adds the filling to the center of the circle. Then, Gabriel folds it in half and seals the edges by pressing down. They repeat these steps until they make all the Empanadillas. When they finish, they put them in the oven and leave them until they are golden on the outside. After waiting, they pull the Empanadillas out of the oven. They are finally finished making them. Now they can show the Empanadillas to their grandma. Discussion Questions: ﻿1. Would you like to make this recipe? Why or why not? 2. If you have to cut something, who will you ask for help? Or, will you do it on your own? 3. Before cooking you always have to wash your hands. Do you know why? 4. If you cook Empanadillas de Carne, what is the first step after buying the ingredients? 5. How many ingredients are used for Empanadillas de Carne? 6. Why did Veronica and Gabriel cook the Empanadillas de Carne? 7. If you like to cook, what things would you cook? 8. When you cook you always have to be careful around fire. Why? 9. Do you always have to have adult supervision when you cook? Yes or no? Why? 10. What is your favorite food, and who makes it for you?

title: Friendly Pod and Naughty Pod in The Doodle Party
text: Friendly Pod loved to doodle. She could doodle the nicest flowers you ever saw. She could draw smiling faces, sad faces, funny faces and angry faces. She could draw animals and birds and just about anything she felt like. But every time she doodled something, Naughty Pod would come sneaking up from behind her and spoil the doodle. Naughty Pod loved playing tricks on everyone. Everyone in Podville was tired of her tricks. You see, Naughty Pod was the naughtiest Pod in all of Podville. The Pods wondered what they could do to make Naughty Pod stop. Friendly Pod met Naughty Pod on the street and tried to explain to her that it wasn’t nice to spoil someone’s picture. She would simply shake her head, laugh loudly and walk away. But do you think Naughty Pod listened? She would simply shake her head, laugh loudly and walk away. One day, Naughty Pod was very excited because it was her birthday. She planned a birthday party and invited all the Pods in Podville. She put up balloons, made a yummy cake and lots of sandwiches. All the Pods came for the party, with lots of presents for Naughty Pod. Everyone had a lot of fun playing games. Soon the party was over. Naughty Pod began to open her presents. She had got a lot of fun things. A lovely book about birds, a big beach ball, a box of yummy chocolates and many other wonderful presents. She couldn’t wait to open the biggest gift of all. It was packed in lovely dotted paper and stood in a corner. She opened it and what do you think she saw? A large easel, rolls and rolls of paper and a big box of colour pencils. She looked at the gift tag. It was from Friendly Pod. “I wonder what I should do with this,” Naughty Pod thought to herself. I can’t draw or doodle. I had better ask Friendly Pod.”So the next day, Naughty Pod went to Friendly Pod’shouse. As usual, Friendly Pod was busy doodling something on a big piece of paper. “Friendly Pod, I wanted to say Thank You for the gift,” said Naughty Pod. “But what am I going to do with your gift? I don’t know how to doodle. Or draw. Or paint!” Friendly Pod grinned at Naughty Pod. “That is exactly why I gave it to you,” she said. “Would you like to learn?” “Oh, yes!” said Naughty Pod. “Will you teach me?” So the next day, Friendly Pod began to teach Naughty Pod how to doodle. She taught her how to draw a circle. Then she taught her how to draw faces in the circle. She showed her how to make a circle into a flower. By the end of day, Naughty Pod was having fun. She doodled dogs and cats and birds. She doodled flowers and stars and clouds. She simply loved doodling. And guess what? After that day, she never spoiled Friendly Pod’s doodles ever again. What’s more, because she found herself such a nice hobby, she quite forgot to be naughty for a long, long time.

title: Estrella and her Tortillas
text: They inflate and, to Estrella, are the most beautiful tortillas she has ever seen. The next day, Estrella asks her mother to leave her some dough to make tortillas just like her grandma's. She made one, but it broke. Her older sister said, "Leave the tortilla for more time on the griddle." But the tortilla burned. Her aunt told her, "Put the tortilla upside-down on the griddle." But the tortilla got stuck to the pan. Her mom told Estrella, "Put the tortilla face up on the griddle." But the tortilla got toasted. Her grandma, who had been observing Estrella, called her over and said, "Come closer, my child, if you want to know how to make your tortillas like mine, pay attention to what I am going to tell you. Search for a gopher and rub its belly. Try it and see if what I tell you works. Estrella was glad to hear her grandma's advice, and hurried to find a gopher. She found one that had barely finished eating some roots. Estrella spoke to the gopher: -Oh gopher, you beautiful little animal, I see that you have just finished eating many roots. Please allow me to rub your tummy to prevent you from getting stomach pain! The gopher enthusiastically accepted Estrella's offer. Estrella rubbed the gopher with both her right and left hand to ensure that the gopher will give her the ability to make good tortillas with both hands. Once Estrella got tired, she said to the gopher, "Gopher, dear animal that lives in my home, when you have stomach pain and wish for me to rub your belly, just say the word and I will come to rub your belly!" The gopher accepted and went to eat more roots. Because of this, Estrella's tortillas now come out beautifully. They are round, soft, chubby, and inflated, just like the belly of a gopher. My mother told me this story when I was a little girl and didn't know how to make good tortillas. And you, do you already make good tortillas, or do you need a gopher?

title: What is Block Printing?
text: Block printing is the method of making designs on cloth with wooden blocks. The wooden blocks are two to three inches thick. The designs such as flowers, animals, trees, and other geometric designs are carved at the bottom of the block. Each block has a small handle shape at the top to easily hold and make the print. The dyes used for printing are natural or synthetic. Lime, Holly, Sycamore, and Pear tree woods are mostly used for making woodblocks. The cloth to be printed is spread out on a table. Then the wooden block is dipped in one colour dye and the block is pressed on the cloth. The craftsman hits on top of the block once with his hands to get a clearer print. Sometimes, the block must be applied two times at the same point for a design. If there are other colours in the design, the block with the next colour has to be applied after the first colour has dried. Cotton or cotton linen materials are the most suitable for block printing. Block printing originated in China. But, India is now the largest creator and exporter of block-printed fabrics in the world. Jaipur in Rajasthan is famous for block printing in India.

title: Hengbu and Nolbu (A korean folktale)
text: Name: Hayah Fathima Class: Grade 7-F (girls) Age: 12 Gender: Female School: Bright Riders School Once upon a time, there were two brothers named Heungbu and Nolbu. Nolbu, the older of the two, was a greedy man. After their father died, he took all the heritage and family fortune, not giving a single coin to Heungbu. Heungbu, who was now really poor, received little to nothing from the family heritage, but he could do nothing about it since Nolbu was older than him. Nolbu lived in a fancy house, that was made of a brick roof and his house was safe from wind and rain, leading a luxurious life. While Heungbu lived in a house under reed, without being able to provide for himself and his family. One day, a bird flew to the younger brother’s house and it crashed into the ground, breaking its leg. Heungbu felt bad for the bird and so he started treating its leg, feeding it, and nurturing it, even though he had little to no food for his own family. The bird eventually healed from its wound, and when it was ready to leave, it gave Heungbu a seed of a plant. When he planted this seed and watered it, a month later gold began growing out of the plant. This plant provided for Heungbu and his family, and he was able to sustain a better life due to the plant and the kindness of the bird. Word spread of this to Nolbu and when he heard about the brother’s plant, he got jealous and sought to seek this out for himself. After a few days, Nolbu found the same bird that Heungbu had nurtured back to health, and when he got a hold of the bird, he broke its leg. He then proceeded to heal the bird, just like the younger brother, giving the bird food and treating its wound. When the bird was healed, it too gave Nolbu a seed and left. While Nolbu was excited that he had been given the famous seed, when he planted it and watered it, the plant did not provide gold like it did for Heungbu. Instead, from that seed came a bunch of ghosts, trolls and other bad spirits to destroy his house and wealth. Heungbu was then left with nothing as everything he owned had been taken away by the bad spirits.” The moral of the story: good deeds bring you wealth and luck, But it’s not just about doing a good deed, it’s about the spirit. It’s why you do it, and the people who have a good spirit will eventually come out on top at the end. Even though both the brothers technically did the same thing for the bird, the greedy brother’s intentions were for personal gain and personal gain alone. He did not care for the bird and even went so far as to harm the creature to be able to heal it.

title: The vehicle city
text: Once upon a time there was a vehicle town. So many vehicles were lived there. Cars, jeep, trucks, buses. One day one baby bicycle reached there. Baby bicycle told to other vehicles, "Will you be my friend?" All the other vehicles started laughing. They said, "you are very small and you can run very slowly, so we can't consider you as our friend." Baby bicycle became very sad. He reached his house and started crying. Mother bicycle asked, "hey baby, what happen to you? why are you crying?" Baby bicycle told all the things. Baby bicycle said, "am not a good vehicle, no one loves me." Mother said," baby, don't say like that. You are small and you can run slowly. But you have so many good things also." Baby bicycle said, "no, am not a good one." Mother said, "listen to me. You are small, but the kids love you most. Kids only use bicycles to ride. They can't use any other vehicles. So the kids love you most. You can run slowly, but you can run any time. But other vehicles need petrol or diesel to run. If there is no petrol or diesel, they can't move. The other vehicles make air pollution. But you didn't make any pollution. So you are best in your own way. All are different." Baby bicycle became happy. After some days there is a deficiency in petrol and diesel. The other vehicles can't move. But the baby bicycle ride on the town. Other vehicles saw baby bicycle riding there. The other vehicles understand the benefits of bicycle. They said, "sorry baby bicycle you are best in your own ways. Now we all are your friends. Baby bicycle became very happy. Baby bicycle reached house and said, " mother I got so many new friends today. I am very happy now. Now all the other vehicles know my qualities." Baby bicycle and mother bicycle became very happy.

title: I Found Puppies - Book1
text: I went for a walk down the road… Wait! I heard a sound! I found Baby puppies crying. They were looking for their amma! But amma was nowhere around. Should I take the puppy home? But if I take them… I should feed them. I should clean their susu and potty. I should play with them. I should take them for a walk every day. Am I ready to do this??? YES I AM!!! There were three puppies I brought them home. They were crying and hungry. I used a little dropper to give them milk. We made a home for them with a box and cloth. But they were cold and crying. They wanted amma…… So, I brought a hot water bag for them, filled it with warm water, covered it with cloth and put the puppies on it. They thought it was their amma’s warm belly! So, they felt warm and slept happily. We began to call the hot water bag – “amma”. Next day one puppy did not wake up! He had died. So, we dug a little place under a tree and buried him. We said goodbye to him and came back home. I wanted to name the other two puppies. One puppy had a line on her forehead, so I named her Naama. The other puppy I named Laya. Both were girl puppies. They did susu – tiny puddles of susu. They did potty – it looked like tiny sticks! I cleaned it up with newspaper, water and cloth. Laya would all the time want to suck my finger because it felt like her amma. They cried when they were hungry. The dropper was too small, so I started feeding them with a baby feeding bottle. They would eat, sleep, wake up, do susu and potty…... eat, sleep, wake up do susu and potty…... They did this for 45 days!! They would walk very slowly with shaky legs. Sometimes they would fall, get up and walk again. They would love to sleep on my lap! Now Naama and Laya have become a little bigger. When they are awake, they play together and play with us! Do you like to play with dogs and puppies?

title: Chatty Pod & Shy Pod in The Talk-a-thon
text: He could tell the most amazing stories. He knew some really, really big words that no one else did. In fact, Chatty Pod talked so much that he never gave anyone else a chance to talk. Chatty Pod was a real chatter-box. Everyone in Podville was really impressed with him. When any of the Pods spoke to her, she would turn red in the face and run away and hide. What no one knew was that Shy Pod was shy because she did not know too many words. Chatty Pod, who had a very kind heart, saw how scared she was and he decided that he would help her. He had a wonderful idea. Shy Pod had quite the opposite problem. She was very very very shy and could not bear to talk to anyone. You see, when she was little, she hadn’t bothered to read. So she knew very few words indeed. Because of that, she was just too shy to talk to anyone. The great Podville Fair was coming up. There were going to be lots of games and contests during the fair. There was the Hop-AboutContest that everyone was sure Healthy Pod would win. There was a Pie Eating Contest that Hungry Pod was sure to win. There was even the Merry Math Contest that Smarty Pod would definitely win. But the contest that Chatty Pod was interested in was the Talk-a-thon. The Pod who could talk for one full hour without stopping would be the winner. All of Podville was sure that Chatty Pod would win the Talk-a-thon because no one could talk as much as Chatty Pod. One evening, a week before the fair, Chatty Pod went to Shy Pod’s house. “Shy Pod, I have decided that you must take part in the Talk-a-thon,” he said. Shy Pod went red in the face. She couldn’t even answer him. She seemed to have lost her voice. She just shook her head from side to side. “No, no, no,” she finally said. “I can’t. I won’t.” But Chatty Pod just laughed. “Are you worried you won’t be able to talk?” he said. “Leave it to me. I am Podville’s Champion Talker and I will teach you.” The Pods were busy getting things ready for the fair. There was lots to be done. Everyone had a job to do and all the Pods walkedbusily around setting up stands and stalls. Some of the Pods were decorating the stands with bunting. Some others were making piles and piles of pies. And still others were blowing up truckloads of balloons. Everyone was excited. Everyone except Shy Pod, who was really scared as the day for the fair came closer. Soon it was time for the fair. Podville looked lovely. The fair was bright and colourful. There were food tents, game huts, a merry-go-round, a giant wheel and many, many rides. The biggest tent of all was for the contests. The Pods crowded in to see who would win the prizes in the different contests. One by one, the contests went on. Healthy Pod hopped about at top speed and won the Hop-About Contest. Hungry Pod ate 50 pies at a go and won the Pie Eating Contest. Geeky Pod and Smarty Pod shared the Merry Math Contest Prize. Soon it was time for the Talk-a-thon. Shy Pod who had, been watching all the contests from backstage, trembled in fright. But Chatty Pod was right next to her. He smiled at her kindly and said, “Just remember the secret,” he said. “You will be fine.” Shy Pod went on to the stage. All the Pods clapped loudly. She closed her eyes and began to talk. A big silence fell. Shy Pod talked and talked and talked. The judges rang a bell to say that her time was up. But Shy Pod wouldn’t stop talking. It felt like there were thousands of words inside her that were just tumbling out. Of course Shy Pod won. The Pods asked her the secret ofhow she had talked so much when she was so shy. She said shyly. “Chatty Pod taught me so many new words. He told me the secret is that whenever I’m scared, I should close my eyes and imaginethe things I love and I won’t be scared anymore.” From that day on,though Shy Pod remained a little shy, she always spoke to everyone.
author: Sonia  Mehta

title: The Tree Goblin
text: Buri was a little girl with shiny black hair that fell on her shoulders like a curtain and eyes that sparkled like gemstones. She lived in the city in a house with a beautiful garden. Buri had an older sister and a brother. Every morning, she would wave to them as they climbed onto the school bus. The bus would burp clouds of grey smoke and disappear around the corner of the lane. Buri wished she could get on that bus and go to school with her brother and sister. But she was only three years old, too young for school. So, she stayed home and played in her garden all day. There was a neem tree in one corner of the garden. It was taller than Buri’s father with a thick brown trunk and bright green leaves. There was a hollow in the middle of the trunk. Buri’s father told her that a goblin lived inside their tree. “The goblin must be hungry,” Father told Buri. “Let’s give him some food so that he doesn’t starve.” Every morning, before he went to work, Buri’s father would help her hang scraps of food inside the hollow with a string. A tiny piece of cucumber, some apple, a small bit of toast – whatever Buri could get from the kitchen. She would watch the tree from a safe distance throughout the day. If only the goblin could climb out of the tree and say hello! In the evening, when she peeped into the hollow, the food was gone. “The goblin has eaten his food,” she would shriek with excitement. Father would smile and ruffle her hair. Her brother and sister would stare at her in amazement. “You are so lucky Buri, tell us about your goblin?” Buri would turn pink with pride. One day, when Buri was sleeping, Mother asked Father, “Who eats up the food? Is there really a goblin inside our tree?” Mother’s eyes were big as plums. Father grinned. “There’s a squirrel inside our tree, not a goblin. Don’t tell Buri that.” You mustn’t tell her either. It will be our little secret! Tree squirrels are brown, grey, reddish brown, or black. Tree squirrels have bushy tails and long hind feet which help them keep their balance on the tree. Tree squirrels make nests in branches or inside of hollow trees. It is not a good idea to feed squirrels. Once they become friendly with you, they stop being scared of humans and that is dangerous for them. If an adult squirrel visits you or lives in your tree, you can feed it chopped apples, carrots, spinach, green beans or celery.

title: The Girl at Green Fields
text: I woke up early in the morning, and I expected a lot of noise. But to my surprise it was calm and quiet.I wore my scarlet shirt and my hat, I set out into the paddy fields, first I saw not a single person from our village were their,I decided to walk ahead. I saw my grandma and ran to her, she was wearing the maroon scarf I knitted for her.She smiled at me and asked “Why are you up so early? Shouldn’t you be in bed fast asleep?” “I don’t know grandma? I just woke up,” I told her. She was collecting tea leaves from the hills to make hot tea, because the uplands are cold and misty. I helped her collecting the leaves. The Earth’s soil was soft and was smooth today, the soil was getting stuck to my slippers. We both went near the lake and relaxed in the cold breeze, it was so calm I could only hear the sound of the chirping birds and the nature’s whispers. We talked about our memorable memories and the funny stories she told about, we talked about the gods in history and the ones we worship. Then we played in the ponds, SPLASH!SPLASH! The droplets rained onto our faces and legs.Then we wiped ourselves and got dry. We returned home and made some food. We made delicious and healthy fresh food from green Vegetables that would make your sight stronger and clear! The greens were special picked fresh from the paddy fields. The fragrance of the flowers in the worship temple are so strong it just fills my heart with calmness cause they were picked fresh in the Dawn! The food was ready to be packed in the leaves, the whistle of the cooker blew hard and the hot air spread around the kitchen. The metal handle was steaming hot so grandma wore her gloves to make sure her hands don’t burn. I could smell the scrumptious food made by my grandma! After the food was ready grandma and I started wrapping the food in the leaves and put them one by one into the basket so we could carry them to the hills and have a picnic, I held two baskets that were ready to go with us. Grandma tied the rice into one big wrapping leaf. Grandma and I crossed the paddies, then up the strawberry hill and finally at the bamboo’s garden. We sat by, told jokes and ate the delicious food and I had carried along my favourite page turner. We were lost in laughter and looked at the beautiful scenery, we almost stayed for four hours talking! Then grandma went home and I stayed behind reading my book, I was feeling cold as the wind blew hard, I felt as if I was having a fever. I thought it would be better if I go home and sit near the chimney fire. As I walked I saw birds plants vegetables. I can’t leave green fields it’s the best place and home to me! At night I thought about dancing beans and many food around them. I listened to them sing and dance about in my mind!They merrily danced about and wrapped the food,it looked amazing. I was astonished that it all happened in my mind. I thought and slept peacefully at night. La!La!La!La!La!Laaaa!Lo!Lo!La!Lo!Lo!La! Next morning, I woke up and ran down to my grandma. “Whoa!” I said surprisingly “Grandma, who did you make this for?” I told her. She giggled “It’s all for you who else? You were such a good girl yesterday, you helped me, for that this is all your food!” It was too late I had started eating it smelled so scrumptious, while Grandma laughed “Ha!Ha!HaHa! Silly you!” “We are going to the city just for a visit this afternoon!” Grandma joyfully said. We packed some of our clothes, scarfs and I packed my toys. We went in the afternoon bus and we had a memorable journey to the city! 1. Never waste food while eating! 2. Eat all the vegetables in the food 3. Always take quantities of food! 4. While eating rice, eat each grain. 5. When you are eating any food make sure it is well done. The End!

title: The mermaid Story
text: One day Anu and Manu reached the beach. They started playing. Suddenly they saw one mermaid was sitting there. They reached the mermaid. The mermaid was looking sad. Anu asked," hey mermaid, why are you so sad? What is your problem?" The mermaid said, " my teacher asked me to find out the good habits. I asked to all the sea animals in the sea, but I didn't get answer. " Anu said, " I know the good habits. I will help you." Mermaid became very happy. Mermaid said, "thank you Anu." Anu said," wake up early in the morning, brush your teeth daily, take bath daily, have a good diet, go to school on time, have a play time, help others, throw waste on dustbin, do your home work daily, pray to god. These all are the good habits." Mermaid said, "yes, I do all these things." Manu said, "we should do all these things, then we will good kids." Mermaid said," thank you Anu and Manu! Are you come with me? let's go to the under water?" Anu and Manu said," we like to see the under water, but we don't know how to swim." Mermaid said," don't worry, you simply sit on my back, I will carry you." Anu and Manu sat on the back of the mermaid. Mermaid said," let's start?" They said, "okay." They started their journey. They saw so many water animals. They saw turtle, sea horse, octopus, lobster, crab. All of them asked to mermaid, "who is this?" Mermaid said," these are Anu and Manu, my new friends." Mermaid said " Anu and Manu, these are my friends." Manu and Anu said, "we saw all your friends pictures in our books." Mermaid said, " let's go to my palace." They reached the palace. Anu and Manu said, "wow, what a beautiful palace." Anu and Manu saw all the family members of mermaid. All of them became happy. Anu and Manu ate lunch with them. Anu and Manu said, " we want to go back to our home." Mermaid said, " let's go." Anu and Manu sat on the back of the mermaid. Then they reached the land. Anu and Manu said, " thank you mermaid, this is a great day for us." Mermaid went to her house. Anu and Manu went to their house.

title: Best Diwali
text: It was the month of October. Festival season has arrived. ﻿It was Diwali!. ﻿Like everyone else, Lakshmi was shopping with her family. ﻿Everyone was decorating their houses with diya and leaves hanging on top of their door. ﻿Lakshmi was helping her mother make sweets. ﻿Lakshmi loved sweets mostly Rosogolla which was a very famous sweet from West bengal. ﻿Lakshmi went to her mama's sweet shop to buy ﻿Mishti doi. ﻿ ﻿ Lakshmi sees her best friend, Kallu staring at the sweets which mama was making. When mama saw me, he says, "Happy Diwali Lakshmi,! what do you want?" ﻿"Happy Diwali mama!. title: Gulli's box
text: Why is Grandpa wrong, why aren't you reading the newspaper?" Gulli asked one morning. "Oh dear, I broke my reading glasses, and I can't read anything without them," Grandpa said. "Ah, don't worry, Grandpa. Let me find my box of goodies." Gulli ran out and returned with his little brown box. Clink... clack... paff... plass... knock!... What has he finally found?... A bright magnifying glass! If you mind looking through it, everything will seem bigger and better. "Thank you, this is better, now I can read each line clearly," Grandpa said. "What's wrong, Mangal Chacha?" Gulli asked one Sunday. "I have to pour the oil from this package, but the neck of the bottle is very small. I am sure I will make a complete mess in my kitchen," said Mangal Chacha. "Ah, don't worry, let me find something super quick," Gulli said. Clink... clack... pop.... Let's see. What has Gulli found this time? A funnel with a big, wide mouth! "Pour anything in and watch it be collected so easily, drop by drop!" "Here you have it Mangal Chacha1, use this. Now the kitchen will be clean and the kitchen will be fun!" "Thanks for helping me, Gulli!" "What are you looking for, grandma?" Gulli asked. "Oh, I was mending Grandpa's wool cap, and the needle fell off," Grandma said. "Please sit here in the rocking chair, while I go get something from my little brown box!" Gulli said. Clink!... clack!... tin!..... What did Gulli find this time? A magnet! All the little metal things will stick to it! "Let me run it across the floor, and the needle will soon be found," Gulli said. "Look Grandma, look how your needle has stuck to the magnet, and I have also found other long-lost metal things!" "Thanks Gulli, you are so clever. Your little brown box is really useful!" Grandma said.

title: Meena and the Magic Tea Leaves
text: Meena’s eyes twinkled as she woke up. Meena could smell freshly brewed tea made by her mother, every morning her mother would make fresh tea from those tea leaves that were plucked gently from the hilltops. She let her legs gently fall down so she could get on her feet and out of the bed.She made her way out of her room, down the smooth wood stairs and finally at the breakfast table. Meena pulled one chair out and sat on it, then she tucked herself in. She stared eagerly at the tea as her mother stirred and stirred. Her father smelt the brewed tea and was pleased. He was an ultimate tea lover. They all sat and sipped the tea.Meena was lucky it was a Friday, because there wasn’t school and she could go discovering the hilltops. Meena always loved discovering from the age of three, she found it was adventurous and exciting. Meena decided to call her friends. She called her friends but unfortunately they couldn’t come. She sat near the telephone, her face turned red and tears were trickling down her puffed cheeks. Meena’s eyes shimmered with tears. Then her mother came out of the kitchen and walked her way to Meena, she gave her a tenderly hug and wiped out her trickling tears from Meena’s cheeks. “Don’t worry Mrs.Meena we won’t fail your discovering mission, me and dad will come along. How about that?!” She told merrily. Meena gave a faintly smile “Thanks Mom, but where’s dad?” Meena questioned. Her mom explained that he would be back in a while. But her father had arranged a tea party stall secretly for the whole society which only Meena’s mom and dad knew. Her mother and Meena got ready with there discovering tools and took a bag with them. Meena and her mother set out to the hills and there they found her father. They all walked, as they did they could smell the fragrance of the tea leaves everywhere around them. This was something Meena wanted to discover so she picked one tea leaf and set up a small carpet and took out the tools, Meena sat down and told her mom to help her. They both sat and Meena took hold of the microscope, she stared at the stem of the leaf, to her shock she saw sparkling particles. Meena spoke with her mom and dad about these magic leaves! She went shop by shop and collecting tea leaves and at one spot she compared them. Meena thought they were all divergent but surprisingly they all were same. Days past by Meena finally found the answer, she looked at the tea powder made in the city and the ones on the hilltops. “The tea powder made in the city is bitter because there are chemicals in them, but the ones made here are natural!” said Meena in a proud and confident voice. Everyone was amazed and gave her a standing ovation, she merrily smiled. All the people gave her a big gift, it was a discovery set box! Meena cheerfully galloped around. Her father came by her side and whispered “Celebrations?!”. “Oh! Daddy you don’t really mean it!?” Meena replied. “YES! You’re a genius, Meena you know that discovering all these as a kid is great!” he exclaimed. Woo!Hoo! Mission Successful! Meena got ready for the tea stall party and cycled all the way till the stall.“Hi Raju Uncle, hmm! The tea sure smells elegant, doesn’t it? Meena told. “Oh, the tea sure smells elegant, but no one ever came and thanked me for making the tea.” He replied sadly. Meena Thanked him and went over to her parents and enjoyed the tea stall with her friends and family! Meena loved discovering, if you like it too discuss with your friends and start discovering! At home, if you’re bored, get up and start discovering your house! Things You Need: 1.A Shool Bag 2.A Pencil 3.A notepad or booklet 4.Magnified Glass Put them all in the bag and you’re ready to go! Go ahead discovering your garden and bedrooms in your house, You’ll enjoy it!
author: Kirtimayee Swain

title: Sun
text: There is day when the sun rises and evening when it sets. He shines in the sky all day long. Looks like it's moving. Have you ever wondered what that is? The twinkling stars that we see at night are all burning balls of different gases. The Sun is also one such ball of gas, which is about one million times larger than the Earth. He is far away from Earth. Being so far away from the earth, it appears very small to us. The sun does not revolve around the earth, rather the earth revolves around the sun. That is why the sun appears to be moving from east to west. The Sun has a large family called the Solar System. The members of this family include Mercury, Venus, Earth, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn etc. The names of the days of the week are also named after these planets. Some stars shining in the sky are bigger than the Sun, which appear smaller due to their distance. Some stars are visible in a group. Such a group is called a constellation. Sometimes a white milky road-like stripe is seen in the sky, it is called Akash Ganga. A good way to learn more about the stars is to observe the stars at night. Many planets, stars and other things in the sky are visible only with the naked eye, but telescopes are needed to see more distant things.
author: Ethan Sen

title: thread to fabric
text: It will not absorb sweat. It does not shrink. It doesn't even need to be ironed." replied Aslam, Salma's brother. "Really Mamu?" Salma wondered. "Yes." Mamu replied, "Clothes are made of two types of threads. We get one type of thread from nature, e.g., cotton, silk and woolen threads. Jute is made from the bark of the jute tree. It is also called jute. Cotton is obtained from the cotton tree. This makes cotton yarn. Wool is made from the hair of animals such as sheep, rabbits, camels and yaks. Similarly silk worms produce silk threads. We make other types of yarn in the factory with different chemicals to make clothes. These are called synthetic threads." Mamu paused for a moment and asked me. “Khadi is a hand woven yarn. Mahatma Gandhi used to spin yarn with a charkha. Aslam said. “Mamu, tell me also about the synthetic thread?” Salma said. “Synthetic yarns such as nylon, polyester, acrylic and rayon are manufactured in the factory with different chemicals. Synthetic threads are stronger than natural threads. These threads do not absorb water and melt as soon as they get near the fire. The synthetic threads are wrapped and then threaded into the warp and weaved on the handloom or machine and the cloth is ready.
author: Ethan Sen

title: Popular Proverbs
text: Proverbs are short and catchy sentences that are small pieces of wisdom. Proverbs can be a truth or advice. Usually, a culture or a region has its own set of proverbs. Let us look at some common proverbs. An apple a day keeps the doctor away. This proverb is used to convey the health benefits of eating an apple. If you consume this healthy fruit, you will not fall sick often and visit the doctor. All that glitters is not gold. This proverb tells us that we should not be fooled by outward appearances. Actions speak louder than words. This proverb tells that instead of just talking about good things, it is better to do a good deed or help others. Birds of a feather flock together. This proverb tells that people with similar behaviour and interests join together. Jack of all trades, master of none. This proverb tells that some people can do different jobs at an average level. But, they are not masters of any one type of job. Some proverbs describe the goodness of proverbs. These are known as metaproverbs. Here are few examples of metaproverbs. 1. Proverbs are the cream of language. 2. A conversation without proverbs is like stew without salt. 3. Honey is sweet to the mouth; proverb is music to the ear. The study of proverbs is known as paremiology.
