title: Finding Home
text: Today is the day Lizzie and her family travels to England. Lizzie's grandpa is from England. Lizzie has heard of England from her grandpa since she was young. So, she always wanted to travel there. Lizzie and her family finally arrived in England. They saw the view in the car. The view was beautiful, and the weather was nice. Lizzie and her family arrived in a small town and looked for a house to live in. They were tired, but they explored the small town. There wasn't much people, and it was quiet. Next morning, they ate breakfast to go hiking. They got to the mountain by boat. The dark water was calm. The hike was tiring but fun. Lizzie sat at the summit. The view was so beautiful that she started drawing. Lizzie's sister said, "Wow, you're drawing!" Lizzie smiled and replied, "Yeah, I want to show this to grandpa. Lizzie's sister sat up and walked farther. There were goats and sheep graze grass. Lizzie's sister said, "They are so cute! I'm going to take a picture of them!" Lizzie followed her sister and saw goats and sheep. There were a lot of them. They returned home in the afternoon. Mom cooked delicious food for the family. After dinner, they watched television in the living room. Sister asked, "Should we watch a movie or a drama?" Lizzie said, "I want to watch a movie." Both watched a movie and went to sleep. The next morning, while Lizzie and her sister were talking a walk near a lake, someone came up and asked a question. "Have you ever been on a kayak?" "Yes" "You can rent a kayak here. Come and rent one whenever you want." Lizzie and her sister kayaked for about two hours. After kayaking, they went to a candy shop. Lizzie's sister said, "They have my favorite lemon drops!" Lizzie replied, "I want chocolate more than lemon drops." They both bought their candies and bought some for their friends. After leaving the candy shop, they returned home. The next day, Lizzie's family went to the top of Welsh Cone. Th top of the cone is famous. There were a lot of people at the castle. Lizzie saw the ocean while walking on top of the castle. She told her sister, "Look over here!" Lizzie took a picture of her sister with her phone. After visiting the top of the castle, they went to London. There were a lot of people and things to see in London. On the last day, they saw Hamlet. The musical was much more exciting, because B enedict Cumberbatch played Hamlet. Lizzie said, "I think Benedict Cumberbatch is a great actor." Her sister said, "Of course, he's the best!" After their trip, Lizzie and her family returned to the United States. Lizzie visited her grandpa and discussed about the trip. Lizzie talked about what she saw in her grandpa's hometown in England. When her grandpa heard Lizzie's story, he thanked Lizzie for remembering his hometown.
author: Claire Park

title: If You Give Me a Rice Cake...
text: One day, while grandmother was going to the mountain to sell rice cakes, a tiger appeared... and said... I won't eat you if you give me a rice cake. Grandmother quickly handed a rice cake from her basket and ran away. The tiger ate and ate the rice cake and eventually got a stomachache. So, the tiger went to the hospital and got a shot. The grandmother who safely returned home lived happily ever after with her granddaughter.
author: Claire Park
illustrator: Nivong  Sengsakoun; Priya Kuriyan; Rohan Chakravarty; Sanjay Sarkar

title: Deya and Leya
text: Deya and Leya were 2 sisters. They loved each other very much. They were also best friends. One sunny day Deya and Leya woke up early. Today Leya was very happy. She was happy because it was her birthday. She rushed downstairs and saw a surprise." 'wow" she said. She had got a new toy. It was a doll with a beautiful dress. Deya was jealous. She was jealous that her sister had got a toy and she did not. She went to her mother her mother was doing some work. She asked"Mom can I also have a doll." "No Deya " her Mom replied. 'But mom Leya got one! " said Deya loudly. "That is because its Leya's birthday" said mom. Mom had got irratated now. "If you want a doll ask Leya to share hers." So Deya went to Leya. Deya said "hi Leya, happy birthday. could you please share your new toy?" Leya replied "No I will not share my toy with you. Leave me alone Deya" 'fine!" said Deya. "We are never friends again. I am leaving." said Deya. Leya felt so sad she began to cry"why did I have to be so mean to Deya" she said sadly. She ran to tell Deya sorry. When Leya reached she saw Deya crying. Leya said "Hey Deya I am really sorry for what I said" "can we be friends again?" said Deya "yes we can" said Leya sounding happy. So Leya and Deya were finally friends and realised sharing is important. ﻿

title: Naama and Laya begin to explore - Book 2
text: Naama and Laya were growing fast! They were 2 months old now. They needed to eat more so …. We stopped feeding them with a milk bottle. We taught them how to eat from a plate. At first, we dipped our finger into cream and put it in their mouth……they loved it so much that they licked it up! Now they began to drink their milk from little bowls. They were always curious. They wanted to….. SEE everything, TASTE everything SMELL everything! Hmmm….what are these round things! The smell is new….. can I eat them? What are these long pokey things?! Let me taste it!! One day Naama was playing with the bottle, when she saw something at the corner of the door! Look there is something here, Laya...... come see! Everything was play to them. They played with hanging things like curtains and dupattas. Hey this moves… Let's pull it! I found some ropes!! Look…I’m pulling the mat…..it’s my car! It’s soft let’s try and chew it! One day, Naama stopped playing. She was not in a mood…. but Laya wanted to play. Naama come, play with me, see I found a hiding place! See we can play hide and seek!! There are nice chappals we can chew them!! They chewed up many of my *chappals! *Chappals are slippers By now they were two and a half months old. So we started giving them solid food like bread, papaya, carrots and rice. Their favorite was dosa and idly with butter! Now Naama and Laya knew that food came from the kitchen! The moment someone was in the kitchen they would sit there and look up. We are waiting….. We can smell all the yummy smells….. Once, I found a bump on Naama’s tummy and the hair on her tail was falling! Oh no…… so I called a doctor! Doctor said the bump is the belly button. Sometimes it shows in puppies. Don’t worry. For the tail…..crush some garlic in coconut oil. Rub the oil where the hair has fallen. And very important, take them out in the SUN in the mornings and evenings. The sun is good for all of us. Next day we took them to our terrace. They were so tiny on the big terrace, they were scared! But they liked running around. One bathroom had become their room. They were happy to sleep and play in their little cardboard box home. They were now doing a lot of susu! We would keep placing newspaper wherever they did susu. We named their room – The susu palace! They were also doing a lot of potty now! Their potty looked like ‘p’ ‘b’ ‘s’ chakli or a jalebi!!! When my friends came home, they would hold them, cuddle them and play with them! Naama and Laya were always excited to see people! Naama and Laya were naughty and very cute. They were always excited to cuddle and play…..
author: Nandini Ram Mohan

title: Monster Escape
text: Long long ago... Jasmine and her mother lived at Thalkapur in a small hut. One evening, when school was out, Jasmine asked her mom, "Mom, shall I go out to play with my friends, please?" Mom replied, "Yes, but be careful and do not go to the forest to play." And so went Jasmine. Jasmine joined her two friends Rana and Lila in the playground at the border of Thalkapur near the forest. They played with Rana's new big blue ball. Rana was very excited. He threw the ball so high that Lila could not catch it. Unfortunately, the ball went into the forest. Rana wanted back his new ball but the forest was not a safe place. Many people had said that there was a dangerous monster inside the forest. Rana cried, "Please, help me get back my new ball. I don't want to leave it in the forest." Jasmine and Lila stared at each other. Then Jasmine said, "Rana don't cry, let us go quietly, pick up the ball and come outside as soon as possible." Rana and Lila agreed. They entered the forest quietly. Within a few steps they found the ball near a big, grey rock. Rana ran and took it. Meanwhile the rock started to shake. Rana froze in horror. Lila cried out, "We should leave immediately. Within a minute, the rock turned into a monster. The monster took Rana in his hand and yelled, "You disturbed my sleep and now I am going to eat you all three!" "We just came here to pick our ball. We never wanted to disturb. Please, let us go," said Jasmine. "I do not care. I am hungry now!" the monster shouted. Jasmine thought of a plan and said, "You can eat us, but under one condition, that is you should win in a challenge." The monster smiled at her, left Rana down and asked what the challenge was. Immediately Jasmine ran and passed through the monster legs. Then she said, "Now do the same without touching my legs." "But- but- how? You are small but I am big-" wondered the monster. "You have to or let us go," said Jasmine. The monster agreed, "I lost." Jasmine ordered the monster to apologize to the people of Thalkapur and should help them instead of hurting them. The monster went with them to Thalkapur to apologize and promised to help them. Looking at this Jasmine's mom felt very happy. She blessed them and said, "I am so proud of you three."

title: Child's Play
text: Yet another skirmish ensued at the Sookhapur village well – this time between Sheela and Sunaina. But, honestly, who could blame them! The hand pump wasn’t working and both of them needed water. They both had families to feed, bathe and care for! Villagers quarreling over their turn to draw water had become commonplace. Not just in this village, but around the world, poor villagers struggled to obtain water to sustain life. There had to be a solution to this. Turns out, there was! This daily tussle moved Rohini, one of the only five girls allowed to study in the hitherto boys’ school at Sookhapur. Her mind conjured up a smorgasbord of solutions. They were advanced, yet required only rudimentary elements to construct and work. Yet, nobody at Sookhapur could accept the fact that a little child, let alone a girl, could come up with ideas that could solve one of their primary problems. Every time she approached someone for help, they would walk away or change the topic. While the others saw her as an annoying know-it-all, Rohini’s parents saw in her Sookhapur’s saviour. With their support, she managed to realise her best idea – a contraption involving Sookhapur’s famous merry-go-round. The objective was to pump out groundwater to a tank which would cater to the entire village – the merry-go-round being the centre of this smart adaptation. Connected to the merry-go-round was a generator upcycled from a discarded one, procured from the scrapyard that Rohini’s father was employed at. She adapted the design from a book she had stumbled upon during one of her forages for knowledge at her school library. Wow! Thanks to Rohini’s ingenuity, the cost-effective pump was up and running. Whenever children frolicked on the merry-go-round, the generated electricity powered a pump, drawing water to the tank. The villagers were in absolute awe on witnessing this. Acknowledging the potential of education, they sent all their girls to school. At last, Rohini had earned the respect she always deserved and Sookhapur was no longer 'sookha'. Google Story-A-Thon Story-A-Thon was an online contest launched on 8th September 2020, International Literacy Day, by Google, for little authors from 5 - 11 years to explore their creative writing skills and share their own original stories. From the over 10000+ entries received, 11 stories were shortlisted by the judges. This is one of the winning stories. You can read many more engaging and fun stories on the Read Along app.

title: A Noble Return Gift
text: Today Lily woke up with a big smile on her face because it was the first of November and her birthday was now just two weeks away. Her grandparents had come for a short visit and like every time, they gifted a plant to her. Lily asked, “Why do you give me a plant every time you visit?” Grandpa said, “Because when this plant will grow, it will give us more oxygen and clean and fresh air.” Lily kept the new plant beside a bunch of other plants in the balcony. Later in the afternoon over lunch, while looking at the plants, Lily said, “Idea! Ma, Papa, shall we give plants as a return gift to my friends on my birthday?” Lily’s parents were surprised but they liked the idea and asked how she had thought of it. Lily said, “Just like Grandma and Grandpa give me a plant every time, I thought I also could give a plant to each of my friends.” Lily’s parents smiled and said, “Tomorrow we will go to the nursery and get those plants.” The next day Lily and her grandpa went to the nursery and saw lots of different plants. Lily selected colourful ones and said to Grandpa, “I am really excited to give these gifts to my friends and can’t wait to see how they feel.” She also made a handwritten note to give with each plant. It read, “Take care of them and water them regularly." Days passed by and soon it was Lily’s birthday. All her friends came to her house in colourful dresses with gifts. Lily cut the cake. Everybody sang the birthday song and wished her but Lily was waiting for the moment to give the return gifts that she had selected. Finally, the moment arrived and she said, “Here are your return gifts!” All her friends were surprised to see the colourful plants. Lily also told her friends, “If we all look after them properly, they will help protect our environment by giving plenty of oxygen and clean air.” All her friends loved their gifts and promised to take care of them. title: The Guardians of Bodha
text: A long time ago, there was a village called Bodha. It was surrounded by a beautiful dense forest. The villagers got everything they needed from the forest. An old man named Gautham was the headman of the village. One day, three greedy woodcutters came from the neighbouring village. They wanted to cut the trees of the forest to become rich. They convinced the youth of the village by saying, “If these trees are cut down, you can make big buildings here. Your village can become a city. We have cleared the forests of all neighbouring villages and helped to transform their villages to cities.” But when they were about to cut the first tree, Gautham stopped them. He said, “I will not let you cut a single tree. If you protect them, they will help you when needed.” The youth agreed and sent the woodcutters back. Some days later, there was heavy rain. It flooded all other villages except Bodha. The people of those flooded villages ran to Bodha for shelter. Gautham asked the Bodha villagers to give them help. The three greedy woodcutters were also there. They had also lost their homes. They asked Gautham, “All other villages are flooded! Why is Bodha not flooded?” Gautham answered, “These dense forests guarded us from the flood.” They made a promise at that moment. “We will not cut trees and for each tree that we have cut, we will plant two saplings.” Google Story-A-Thon Story-A-Thon was an online contest launched on 8th September 2020, International Literacy Day, by Google, for little authors from 5 - 11 years to explore their creative writing skills and share their own original stories. title: Sam And Ram
text: Once there were two brothers named Sam and Ram.They lived with their parents. Sam was a naughty child. He always played pranks on his parents, friends and on his brother. He hated his parents as they always told him to study and not to play pranks on others, but he never listened to them.Whereas Ram was the right opposite of him.He was loving, caring and always listened to his parents. They both studied in the same school but were poles apart. Ram was favourite amongst his teachers and friends. Whereas Sam was one of the mischievous boys in the school. One day Ram saw his brother fighting with his friends for just a keychain which had a picture of Captain America on it. He ran towards Ram, tried to stop him, but instead Sam pushed him away. Ram got hurt on his knee and the other students took him to the medical room, where he got his knee bandaged. After the school got over, their parents saw a bandage on his knee. Instead of hiding the truth from his parents, Ram narrated the whole incident. When his parents heard the truth, they scolded Sam and told him not to behave in this manner again. Sam promised them but since then started hating his brother even more. Soon 20 years went by, and both the brothers grew up.Ram was a rich and successful doctor whereas Sam was jobless and a failure. One day when Sam was watching an interview of a very famous actor,the anchor asked the actor “ Sir,May I know, what is the reason behind your success?"The actor replied in turn "Well, the reason behind my success is that I always listened and obeyed my parents and never went against their wishes”. Sam thought about this line for a moment but soon got distracted. After a few days Sam again saw another interview of a business tycoon. That business tycoon shared her past life story and thoughts. She said that when she was a child, she always listened to her parents and obeyed them and with hard work and determination she became a successful business women. After hearing this Sam thought "When I was a child I should have listened to my parents then I would not be a failure now". Sam learned his lesson the hard way and started working hard. After 2 Years, Sam finally became a renowned book publisher. He had an office and more than hundred people were working under him. Also he used to publish books which were animated and had stories with a moral. His parents were very happy for him and so was his brother. And They All Lived A Peaceful Life. Thank You

title: I Found Puppies - Book 1
text: I went for a walk down the road… Wait! I heard a sound! I found Baby puppies crying. They were looking for their amma! But amma was nowhere around. ﻿ ﻿ Should I take the puppy home? But if I take them… I should feed them. I should clean their susu and potty. I should play with them. I should take them for a walk every day. Am I ready to do this??? YES I AM!!! There were three puppies I brought them home. They were crying and hungry. I used a little dropper to give them milk. They didn't Know how to drink with a dropper! We made a home for them with a box and cloth. But they were cold and crying. They wanted amma…… So, we brought a hot water bag for them, filled it with warm water, covered it with cloth and put the puppies on it. They thought it was their amma’s warm belly! So, they felt warm and slept happily. We began to call the hot water bag – “amma”. Next day one puppy did not wake up! He had died. So, we dug a little place under a tree and buried him. We said goodbye to him and came back home. I wanted to name the other two puppies. One puppy had a line on her forehead, so I named her Naama. The other puppy I named Laya. Both were girl puppies. They did susu – tiny puddles of susu. They did potty – it looked like tiny sticks! I cleaned it up with newspaper, water and cloth. Laya would all the time want to suck my finger because it felt like her amma. They cried when they were hungry. The dropper was too small, so I started feeding them with a baby feeding bottle. They would eat, sleep, wake up, do susu and potty…... eat, sleep, wake up do susu and potty…... They did this for 45 days!! They would walk very slowly with shaky legs. Sometimes they would fall, get up and walk again. They would love to sleep on my lap! Now Naama and Laya have become a little bigger. When they are awake, they play together and play with us! Do you like to play with dogs and puppies?

title: The Busy Ants
text: Preetha and her Grandma went for a walk in the garden. Preetha wanted to feed the ants near the trees. Preetha asked, “Are ants found only in India?” Grandma said, “No. Ants are found all over the world. But, the continent of Antarctica does not have any ants.” Preetha said, “These ants are brown. Yesterday, I saw an ant inside our house. It was black and larger.” Grandma said, “There are 12,000 different species of ants in the world, Preetha.” Preetha fed the ants with flour. “Grandma, did you watch? The ants are carrying the food on their backs?” asked Preetha. Grandma said, “Yes. Ants can carry up to 10 to 50 times their body weight. They usually go in a line one behind the other and carry the food to their nests." Grandma said, "Look at the anthill there. It is a small mound of earth and has openings at the top." Preetha asked, "Can the ants hear us talking?" Grandma said, " Ants do not have ears. But they use their feet to feel vibrations on the ground." Grandma said, ”Ants live in colonies. Each colony may have hundreds or sometimes even millions of ants. Every colony has few queen ants, many female worker ants, and male ants with wings. The biggest ant colony in Argentina was 3700 miles wide.” On their way back home Grandma said, "The ants are always busy. They also make hay while the sun shines. They collect food in the summer and store it for the winter. We must be active like the ants." Preetha said, "Ok Grandma. Sure will."

title: The cleverness of the rabbit
text: Once in the jungle of Mongolia, there lived two deer. They were brothers and lived happily. But one year something terrible happened. It did not rain and the land went dry. The brothers set out on their journey in search of the green field. After few days of travelling, the big brother said "You go ahead younger brother. I will stay here for some-time and will join you soon. But do not open any packages if you don't know what's in them." So he set off alone. A day later he saw a package. Despite his brothers warning he opened it. Oh! What a mistake! A hungry cheetah jumped right out of it, ready to eat the deer. Just then a hare came and said to the cheetah "Were you hiding in that package? How did you fit in it?" The cheetah said "Do you want me to show you?" Saying so the cheetah slipped inside the package. The hare quickly closed the package. They both ran away. Soon they reached a beautiful lake and a field full of grass. After some time, elder brother also reached. He heard the story from his younger brother and thanked the hare and they lived happily ever after.

title: My Good Health Charter
text: Once, their lived a boy named Ram. He was a fit and healthy boy. He exercised for 1 hour in the morning. Ram ate healthy fruits and vegetables. Ram's neighbour John was Ram's best friend. John was a very fat boy. John did not eat healthy fruits and vegetables. Instead, he ate junk food like burger, pizza, chocolate, etc. In fact John was ill, most of the time! One day, when Ram and John went to school, they took their seat. After few minutes, their teacher came and announced about a competition. It was Sports Day. Ram was excited about Sports Day. It was his favourite competition. After few hours, they went home. Ram told his mother about the competition. His mother happily agreed. Ram started exercising. Next day, when John and Ram were going to school Ram asked John " Hey John, will you participate in Sports Day?". John said yes why not. They both started practicing for Sports Day. John started running but he fell down very early and he was unable to complete the race whereas Ram completed the race in record time. Ram told John to do pushups which would help him decrease his weight. John started push ups. After 2 days when John measured his weight he found out that he has decreased his weight. John was very happy. He told Ram about this and John thanked Ram. Now both of them exercised daily. After few days, it was sports day. John won many gold medals. Ram too won many gold medals. After sports day ended, both of them congratulated each other. Their mothers were proud of their kids.
author: Aakarsh Pandey

title: Meena's health charter
text: This is Meera. She loves junk food like Chips, Maggi, Biscuits and other junk stuff. She always refuses to eat healthy food. Once she got a stomachache. It hurt a lot so she asked her friend "Why is my stomach hurting so much!?" her friend said "I think it is because you eat too much junk food" She ate healthy food for some time, she still had some problems, she then decided to visit the doctor. At the clinic, the doctor checked her stomach, hands, mouth and face. She said "Meena you need to eat healthy food, clip your nails frequently, stay active, brush your teeth and start taking a little break from slugging around the house also take good sleep." After the consultation, she started to drink fresh clean water, eat fruits and vegetables that helped her gather nutrition, energy that kept her body and mind in sync. She got disciplined: ate on time, played on time and slept for 9 hours daily. She became hygienic and healthy. She even got an award for b eing happy and healthy. You know what they say: A happy mind in a healthy body!

title: The beautiful and the ugly
text: Once in a forest there lived a deer with his herd. He looked his reflection in the water. He thought that his antlers were beautiful and his legs were dirty. ﻿ ﻿Just then he heard a roar. There was a tiger behind him! He ran as fast as he could. He could not see the tiger anymore. He thought "Wow! I thought my legs were ugly but they helped me escape the tiger." ﻿ He heard another roar. The tiger was back. He ran again. But as he ran his antlers caught into the lower branches of a tree. He struggled to get free but it was no use. ﻿ He thought " I think my antlers are beautiful but they got me stuck." Then he heard another roar and with one leap the tiger pounced on the helpless deer.
author: Advit Aswal
illustrator: Kalp Sanghvi; Rob Owen; Rohan Chakravarty

title: My Good Health Charter
text: Nutrition:: I drink at least 8 glass of water everyday, eat a balanced diet which includes vegetables, gains, diary products, fresh vegetable juice instead of cold drinks and sugary products and avoid eating junk and fried food. Personal Hygiene I brush my teeth twice a day and take shower everyday, cover my face while sneezing and cough and make sure to throw used tissue in bin, trim my nails regularly, wear clean clothes, comb my hairs, wash my hands every time I return to my home after playing outside and before each meal and always keep my room tidy with all things in its place. My mantra for fitness is ""A healthy body shelters a healthy mind", so I exercise regularly by doing yoga, cycling and attend sessions by my School on fitness. In this pandemic when I am not able to go outside then I make sure to do indoor activities to make myself fit. 'Happy Mind is Happy Life", I follow this and take proper sleep, spend quality time with family and stay happy.
author: Advit Aswal
illustrator: Aakarsh Pandey; ISHKIRAT  SINGH; Joanna Davala; Meenakshi Shandil; Ridhima Chamoli

title: The Dream
text: It was the eve of Aaditya's 11th birthday. He was happy and he rushed home from school as soon as the bell rang. He was awaiting a surprise from his family, as usually they used to surprise him before his birthday. He sighed to see no surprise, and started reading the newspaper. Aaditya's family consisted of 7 people (that is, including him) - his parents, elder sister and his grandparents. Aaditya, disappointedly, went to the garden, where he loved to climb the mango trees, and enjoyed the juicy mangoes. But, today, he just wasn't in the mood. He sat on the damp grass and thought to himself, "Is it really true? Did they forget my birthday? No, no, it's not possible! How can they possibly forget?" He was devastated and went back inside the house to do homework. After some hours, he went to the dining room for some dinner. They didn't have a dining table, but still always managed to have a lovely dinner in the company of each other. There was a surprisingly big dinner that night. Salad, fish, potatoes and soup! Mm! Aaditya's thoughts about his family forgetting his birthday suddenly disappeared. Aaditya then goes to his bedroom, but, he wonders, "Ma is not here yet. She usually tucks me in. Hmmm...There is something fishy going on" He decided to wait and see whether his suspicion was confirmed the next day.He closed his eyes, and before he knew it, he fell asleep. Afterwards, he started dreaming. The dream started something like this... Aaditya woke up to see many gifts scattered around his bed, decorations above the door, streamers and banners everywhere. He was happy. He went to the bathroom and brushed his teeth, took a shower and changed into some fine clothes. He went outside his room, only to be surprised by his family! "Happy Birthday to you! Happy Birthday to you!" How they sang! Then, Aaditya rushed to open his gifts! From his parents he got a set of sketch pens, crayons and a sketchbook, from his sister, he got a small size camera and two gifts from his grandparents; a new mobile phone, and a set of books! How delighted he was! He was to draw and color in his sketchbook, take photos with his camera, talk to his friends with his phone and read the new books! Then there was the birthday party! How beautiful and elegant the cake was! A delicious vanilla flavor, with light blue frosting on the outside, little blue pearls stuck onto the frosting and a green candle with the number '11' on it! The family enjoyed the party and even played some games! Then suddenly, Aaditya woke up with a jolt. "It was a dream?! Let's see whether my family really did forget my birthday" said Aaditya. He rushed to the bathroom and got ready and went outside his room. There they were, all ready to sing the birthday song! Aaditya proved to be right after all, his family would never forget his birthday!
author: Riya  Taneja_Bloom Public School

title: Rishu and Rules
text: Rishu and his Momma started gardening during the 2020 lockdown as a hobby. Rishu learned that small butterflies help big trees. His small friends while feeding on nectar also take pollen from one flower to another and help in seed formation. From then on he started loving butterflies so much. He planted a few more flowering plants and he started to see various colourful butterflies around his garden. He is very proud of his garden and his Lil friends. He also framed rules for his garden. Rule number 1, don't pluck any flowers. Rule number 2, don't disturb butterflies while sitting in the garden. Rule number 3, be gentle while harvesting vegetables. He often makes sure his momma and papa are following the rules. Today after finishing their gardening rituals, Amma had gone inside to make dosa and coconut chutney. Which was Rishu’s fav breakfast too, so he was sitting on his favourite spot in the garden waiting for his crispy dosa. A black butterfly with white and red patches has come for her breakfast. She was feasting on her nectar happily. Now Rishu got hungry more, he couldn't wait to eat. When he turned to see the butterflies again it was fluttering over the curry leaves of the plant. “What is she doing at the curry leaf plant?” wondered Rishu. “ I have seen this a few times, why do butterflies go to curry leaves? They don't have any flowers. What's happening?" Right at that moment, Momma called, "can you bring some curry leaf for chutney? Our already hungry Rishu quickly went to collect the leaves and thought, “my Lil ones seem to love curry leaves too.” He plucked a few leaves and saw something wiggly woggle chomping the leaves. He got irritated, “I like curry leaves and my Lil butterflies also seem to like them. Now, what's this doing here? I should get rid of it.” Amma shouted, " “Rishuuuu leafffff" Rishu thought, let me finish my breakfast and look after these and went inside to his crispy dosa. While eating he told his problem to momma, "Amma, we both like curry leaves, I just now found out our butterflies also like it, and I don't know why? Let's find it out and I was thinking of changing the rules and giving more protection to curry leaf but I found some wiggly woggle thing there, eating our leaf. We got to do something. " Amma said, " let's eat and see what's happening ". They went to their garden after finishing breakfast. Amma took a look at these wiggly woggle things and asked, " Rishu you know the life cycle of a butterfly? What's that? Rishu went on “Of course! butterflies lay eggs and from eggs, Caterpillars come out and Caterpillars make pupae and from pupae, butterflies come out.” Now guess what's this wiggly woggle one? Inquired momma. “Of course the Caterpillars.” Rishu was excited now, “I was right I will now extend the rules to curry leave too.” Rule number 4: Collect only a few leaves per day and also be careful with Caterpillars. Rishu asked, “Okay, and now back to your 1st doubt, why were the butterflies fond of curry leaves.?” Momma replied “ It was laying eggs because your wiggly woggle caterpillars love them. Rishu was super thrilled, “what? Really Mumma?” “Yes, dear. Go near and check out for a green round and small thing on a leaf,” replied Amma. Rishu shouted,” yes mummaaaaa, our little ones have laid eggs over here...come see.” Amma smiled and said “These are called host plants. In our case, these black butterflies are called common Mormon, and Caterpillars of common mormon love curry leaves. “ Rishu was elated with new sets of Information. He also framed the final rule as " Rule no 4, collect only a few leaves per day and also be careful with Caterpillars and eggs."

title: You Do Know Me!
text: YOU DO KNOW ME! Cappy caterpillar was on a leaf munching spree. He was very, VERY hungry! Cappy HAD to EAT lots of food to make and store ENERGY to grow and become an adult. It was difficult to talk to anyone as his mouth was busy just doing munch-munch-MUNCH! Chikki sparrow was perched on a branch of the big leafy tree. She was on the look-out for a FAT, YUMMY caterpillar. She saw Cappy happily munching on his green, leafy food. “AHA!” chirped Chikki. “Finally, I found WARM, WRIGGLY food to eat!” Chikki perched herself next to Cappy. “Birdie!” said Cappy, “If you wait patiently, you can eat a FATTER me!” “That’s true,” agreed Furry squirrel. “Cappy can NEVER stop eating. He will soon become very FAT!” “My name is Chikki!” said Chikki sparrow to Cappy. “And I DO want to eat a FATTER, TASTIER you!” “Then you will have to wait until my outer coat bursts!” said cunning Cappy. “This will tell you that I have become really FAT. You can then PECK me up and enjoy a JUICY, TASTY lunch!” Greedy Chikki did NOT allow anyone to come near Cappy. “He is MY food,” declared Chikki. “I was FIRST in the line!” “If you keep waiting, your WRIGGLY caterpillar will RUN away,” warned Furry. “Nobody promises to be someone else’s lunch!” Many days later, Chikki could NOT find Cappy! “ My food RAN away!” shouted Chikki. “ I waited patiently for many days for Cappy to taste YUMMIER for MEEE! ” “THAT shows how STUPID you are!” retorted Tinki monkey. “Furry warned you. WHY should Cappy wait for you to MUNCH him up?” “He asked me to wait till he grew very PLUMP,” said angry Chikki. “He promised to give his FAT self to me!” Chikki searched and searched for Cappy. “Furry, did you see Cappy?” asked Chikki. “NO!” said Furry. “Tinki, did you see Cappy?” asked Chikki. “NO!” said Tinki. ““Maybe he fell down on to the ground.” “And some creature must have gobbled him up!” retorted Furry. “Chikki, forget Cappy. LOOK! I can see two new caterpillars in front of you!” Chikki saw the two caterpillars perched on a BIG leaf in front of him. Was Chikki happy? NO! The two caterpillars were much THINNER and would NOT taste YUMMIER than his FAT Cappy! “They seem very UNHEALTHY!” said Chikki. “ Cappy, CAPPY! WHERE are you? ” Some days later, Chikki heard a voice say, “Hello Chikki, my friend! How are you?” A beautiful yellow butterfly with black-spots was sitting on Chikki’s favourite tree branch. “Hello!” replied Chikki, politely. “Sorry. Who are YOU? I do NOT remember ever meeting you!” “You spoke to me every day,” said the butterfly. “Your beady, black eyes were always looking at me. YOU were waiting to EAT me up!” “I NEVER eat butterflies,” said Chikki. “Their wings keep fluttering inside my mouth. It is difficult to GULP them down. Sorry, I do NOT know you!” “I’m Cappy!” said the black-spotted, yellow butterfly, cheerfully. Chikki stared and STARED at the beautiful butterfly. His Cappy was WOBBLY and WRIGGLY, and had many legs and NO wings. Caterpillar could NOT fly like this beautiful butterfly! “ DO you think I am STUPID? ” shouted Chikki, angrily. “ A butterfly is NOT a caterpillar!” “Where does a caterpillar come from?” asked the butterfly. “From an EGG like ME!” retorted Chikki. “When I hatched out of my egg, I was a very tiny, hungry LARVA (caterpillar)," said the butterfly. "All I did was eat-eat-EAT! This eating spree made me grow into a very FAT, LONG caterpillar. A day came when I was NOT hungry and stopped eating. I became an immobile PUPA (chrysalis) encased within a cocoon and was now hanging under a leaf. The food I had eaten as a caterpillar gave me the energy to transform myself into a butterfly.” “Do you think I am STUPID to believe what you just said?” asked Chikki. “If a TADPOLE can become a FROG, why can’t a CATERPILLAR become a BUTTERFLY?” “This process of physical change is called the ‘LIFE-CYCLE’ of these creatures, Chikki,” said Furry. “I’m amazed you do NOT know the facts about real life. Butterfly IS indeed your HUNGRY Cappy!” Chikki did NOT reply. He had been very FOOLISH to wait for Cappy to happily walk into his mouth! Furry spoke the truth. A prey will ALWAYS be on high alert to be able to make a quick EXIT before the HUNGRY predator decides to POUNCE on it! Chikki now knows that he HAS to strike when the iron is HOT. Otherwise, he will have to say GOODBYE to the TASTIEST meal-of-the-day! METAMORPHOSIS – is the process through which some animals/insects/mollusks/fish undergo major physical changes some days after they are born. These changes involve changes in body shape, the number of legs, limbs used for mobility, mode of breathing, and their daily food menu. Life cycle of some insects, animals and fish Egg--tadpole--adult frog Egg--caterpillar--pupa--butterfly/moth Egg--maggot (pale worm)--adult fly Egg--larval fish (attached to yolk-sac)--fry (no yolk sac)--juvenile fish--adult fish
author: Hema Rao

title: Matt the Savior of Sea-creatures
text: Matt was an honest and trustworthy boy, he had dark skin as he lived on an island. He loved the sea the birds and the sunset. One day, as he was walking by some rocks, he found a rock pool with a hurt fish in it. He rushed back home and found an empty tin can and cleaned it, then he rushed back to the rockpool then put the can in the rockpool and the fish swam into the tin can. Matt went back home and started searching for a clear glass bowl … and at last he found one, he poured the water, seaweed and the fish into the glass bowl then he went to his mother and said “mum, mum come to the kitchen I found a rock pool with a hurt fish I got the fish home.” Mum looked at the fish and said it is an angel fish there are not many here, you are lucky to find one. I know what just you need, an aquarium. I will get a big one for you because I have to go to shopping to buy fruits and vegetables so I will bring one for you when I'll do shopping. Ok mom thanks a lot. after that he goes to find more Rock pools with helpless animals, he finds lots of them. help us! Then when his mother brought him an aquarium, he first got some sand and pebbles and put them at the bottom and then poured some water and added some salt he got some seaweed and stuck it by putting some pebbles near it then he gets all of the sea creatures and puts them in the aquarium. His mother had bought some fish food also. After that he fed the poor sea creatures. He named them the star fish was called: Rohit, the pipe fish was called Harry, the Fingered Dragonet was called Hili, the sea horse was called hulk the Tang was called Gini etc. Day by day his pets started increasing. He made a dairy and started noting down on which day they had come and their new name. when they were big or had got cured, he would pour them into the river and say goodbye

title: My Dream
text: One day Ravi came home from the playground and said, "Mom, mom, I don't have anybody to play with. Everybody has gone on vacation. I am feeling very bored." His mother said, "Shall I tell you a story?" Ravi fell asleep while listening to the story. While sleeping Ravi slipped into the dream world. In his dream, he was flying! He saw a beautiful flower garden and went into it. There he saw a butterfly, "Will you be my friend?" he asked. "I can't be your friend.' said the butterfly and it flew away. ﻿ He flew a little further and saw a field full of fruits. There he saw a bird and asked, "Oh Sweet bird! will you be my friend?" The bird replied, "No! no! my mother and my sisters will be worried about me." Saying this the bird flew away. He kept flying and floating, higher and higher! He saw an aeroplane and said, "I don't have anybody to play with. Will you take me to my friends?" But the plane made a loud noise and flew away. Ravi flew even higher! There he saw a 'Rocket' spitting out fire. By seeing its speed he was amazed! And kept seeing the rocket. Suddenly there was darkness everywhere. Many adorable little stars came around Ravi and started laughing. Even Ravi started laughing and said, "I finally got some friends!. Saying this he began to chase the stars. Just then his mother said "Ravi, get up.It's time for snacks." Ravi got up and said, "Wow! what a dream!." He told his dream to his mother.

title: Boredom Can Be Defeated Easily
text: Memorial Trust Varun was bored. He asked his twin sister, Varsha, 'What shall we do? 'I don't know,' replied Varsha. 'Shall we play carrom board?' asked Varun. 'No,' said Varsha. 'Let's play Chess!!' 'No,' said Varun. 'Let's play Superheroes!!' 'No!' said Varsha. 'Let's play barbie!' 'No!' said Varun Mother came inside the room. 'What's up?' she asked. 'Ma, we're bored and we don't know what to do!!' said Varsha. Mother smiled and handed them a small book. 'Boredom can be deafeted easily,' she said and left the room. The book was titled - "Boredom Can Be Defeated Easily" Varun and Varsha read the book and learnt many ways to stop being bored. They noticed suddenly that it was night! title: OPERATION ANIMAL RESCUE
text: ﻿ Have you ever seen a kitten atop a tree, too frightened to come down? Often, it is frightened of the person who tries to rescue it. Can you imagine the destruction, the construction of Lake Kariba Dam in Africa caused in 1960? The land behind the dam got flooded with water. It became a big lake with islands here and there. These islands were crowded with all sorts of wild animals – zebras, elephants, monkeys, wild pig, rhinos, antelopes, leopards, buffaloes and snakes like cobras. As the water rose, the island grew smaller. The animals could have drowned or died of hunger if nothing was done. How were they to be saved? People who knew how to handle wild animals went out in motorboats to see what they could do. Using special guns, big animals like rhinos were shot with darts. These darts contained drugs to make them sleepy. The animals were taken to safety before they woke up. One rhinoceros, however, woke up too quickly and attacked one one of the men. Do you know what the man did? He took off his hat and hit the huge animal with it. The poor rhino just turned and ran away! Taking snakes to safety was a dangerous business. Many snakes were caught and sent to snake farms. There, the poison in their fangs was taken out to produce a special liquid called serum. This would help in treating snakebites. Snakes are very good swimmers, so most of them found their way to dry lands.
author: Rachit  Gupta

title: Peanut's Life
text: One day my owner's son, George, came home from school. He said, “I want to learn to play soccer.” His dad, Matt, said he was good at soccer so he could teach him. I am starting to wonder what this soccer thing is. A few minutes later Matt brought George and me to the park. I watched Matt and George to see what they were doing. It seemed fun so I thought I could maybe come to play with Matt and George, but Matt pushed me away and tied my leash to a pole. Finally, we got home. I went to my toy collection to find a ball. I eventually found one and I started practicing kicking and running. When we went to the dog park, I would always practice with my dog buddies. One day I was practicing at the dog park. That day George came with us, he usually does not come. When I was playing soccer with my dog friends, Fluffy and Tony. George screamed, “LOOK PEANUT IS PLAYING SOCCER”. His dad looked at me with a smile on his face. He said, “You are right George, he is playing soccer.” From that day onwards I started playing soccer with George and Matt. Matt taught me soccer techniques, George’s mom sewed me a soccer uniform, George would always play with me, and all of us would watch soccer games together. I may not be a professional, but I LOVE WHAT I AM DOING!!
author: Harini Ashok

title: A WORLD WITHOUT HUMANS
text: HMM.... HMM...YAWN. I can tell you're bored so... Why don't we explore a topic where you and I and all humans disappear. So on the first day most probably nothing would happen just the nuclear power plants would stop working and all city's wouldn't have power except Los angels.Now you must be confused like... Well it's because Los angels is powered by hydro~power, which is power of water, and soon Los angels will also shut down. Okay fast forward to a week. How come los angels will still have power??? So it's already been a week and mice, ants etc. are eating all the food and termites are also chomping on our furniture. There would be no smoke in the air and animals would be having a great time because there would be no humans to hunt them for their skin, scales or meat. Okay fast forward to 6 weeks. By this time mother nature would have swallowed houses and small buildings. In zoos animals would have burst out of their cages and would recognise their surroundings as their home as mother nature would have transformed it to their natural habitat. So now let's fast forward to a month. By this time sky scrapers would be deserted and worn out as there would be none to take care. The sky scrapers will be house to birds and other animals. Not to mention, the small houses all will be covered by mother nature and the air would have 0% co2(carbon dioxide). Now we will fast forward to a year. By this time most structures would have been destroyed all replaced with mother nature. The quality of air, water and soil would be very good because humans aren't there to pollute them and life would thrive and survive. Well I'm sorry to say this is the end of this book. But I hope you enjoyed!!!! (THE END)

title: Will Kaali Find A Pet?
text: Kaali loves pets! She always dreams to have one. All her friends have pets. Kabir Sarah Munna All her friends have pets. Sarah has a dog, Munna has a parrot, and Kabir has a cat. Kaali has none! It makes her sad and dull. Kaali has none! It makes her sad and dull. " I have so many toys. Elephant, froggy, monkey and little chick too. How I wish they move and talk like the pets do!" s he wonders. "I have so many toys. Elephant, froggy, monkey, and little chick too." "How I wish they move and talk like the pets do!", she wonders. One day, her friends thought, "why not give Kaali a surprise? " They silently leave their pets at her place. “Woo-hoooo!” “It is lunch time, and I can’t wait to feed them!” Kaali is all surprised and excited! "Meeeooww meow" She gives the cat a bowl of milk. Waits… and waits.. The cat does not drink even a drop! Whooooosh! goes the cat hiding behind a fruit basket. “Munnaaaa Munnnaaaa! ”, calls the parrot and flies away in fear. She goes near the parrot with a yummmmyy guava. Kaali quickly turns to the dog to pamper, “Tch tch tch”…. Bow bow bow! Before Kaali can stop, puppy runs back to Sarah’s home! Kaali turns to lift the puppy and hug it. She calls out, “Tchu tch tch”…. Bow! B ow! B ow! Before Kaali could hold the puppy, it runs into the backyard. Kaali feels sad, and sorry for the pets too. “Let me call my friends for lunch and see if it comforts the pets”, she thought. Oh nooo... Kaali feels sad, and sorry for the pets too. “Let me call my friends for lunch and see if that makes the pets happy”, she thought. As soon as Sarah, Munna and Kabir come home, their pets jump in joy! As soon as Sarah, Munna and Kabir come home, their pets jump in joy! They all have a gala afternoon treat! Cat happily drinks milk, puppy enjoys, and parrot bites into the guava from Munna. Kaali feels joyful to see the pets happy. Munch Munch! Sluuurrppp. They all have a gala afternoon treat! Kaali feels joyful to see the pets happy. Kaali sits by the table, wondering, " How nice to have a pet that I could play, talk and feed. With moving limbs and making sounds" While all her friends are busy feeding their pets, Kaali notices something moving behind the flowerpot. Kaali looks with wide eyes and slowly pushes a bowl of rice. The hungry crow hops to take a peck of rice. Hey!! Kaali all wide-eyed, slowly pushes a bowl of rice. The hungry crow hops and eats the food. Kaali and all her friends curiously watch as the hungry crow feeds on the bowl of rice. “um um ummmm” Kaali and all her friends curiously watch as the crow feeds on the bowl of rice. “ Nom n om nommm! ” Next day, Kaali hears, “ caw caw ca.. ” She runs to the window and is amazed to find the crow! She feeds it and feels so happy to have finally made a pet! Match the pets Match Kaali’s friends with their pets Sarah Kabir Munna Help Kaali find Kaaka Help Kaali reach her pet crow, Kaaka

title: Zitara goes swimming!
text: Zitara, as usual was protesting to her mother. Mother insists that she have to swim. Amma and Appa were well trained in swimming. So, Zitara also have to be well trained in swimming. She was feared of water. Every time her mother tell her to swim in the lagoon, she tells a excuse. One day, her mother asks her" Zitara, We are going to Tilakpur for a business in a boat. title: Love for trees
text: Minu loves reading story books. She study's in Class 2. She reads many stories... about dolphins...cuisines... and many more. One day, at school, Class 2 was having a competition. And of course, Minu would participate! That day, their teacher announced to them, " Students, on 30th of August we shall have a competition. That day, all of you shall speak about your favourite story and maybe something you learned from it. Suppose, the story "Farm". You all might tell about the lesson from it that food is precious, don't waste it. The winner will get a magnificent prize. So, start preparing for the big day!" Minu was extremely exited! She started searching through her each and every story book to find her favourite one, but she didn't like them. Then how will she participate in the competition? She became disappointed. But, her father came to her aide. Minu told her father about the problem. " Hmm.." her father said, "maybe I can take you to the library to find your favourite book. There are many books there... I am sure you'll like one of them." Minu jumped with joy! The next day, she visited the library. She searched through many books... book shelves... sections... and finally, she found a book she liked! On 30th of August, The competition was held! Everyone was telling about, Cinderella, Little Red Riding Hood, etc. But when Minu's turn came, she completely said on a different topic. She told everyone about trees. In that story, there was a man who thought everyone should be grateful to humans, not trees. Humans only made factories, humans only wells, then why should everyone be grateful to trees? So, he started cutting trees. But one day, there was famine everywhere. There was no food to eat. The man had also become poor. But, to survive, everyone needs food. So he decided to hunt. But, there were no animals left anywhere. All the animals had died because of the lack of food. The carnivorous animals had died because there were no herbivores and the herbivorous animals had died because there were no trees. So the man couldn't have fruits neither flesh to eat. So, he thought of only drinking water. But the river had dried up as there was no rain. There was no rain as here were no trees! So that man lamented about his cruel deeds and few days later when he died because of hunger and thirst he just told one phrase," Love The Trees". "This story has many morals," said Minu, "but the main lesson is that we should love the trees and plant them, not cut them of. If we continue cutting them, our future is also going to be like the man's." And now, guess who won the competition.... Correct! It's Minu! But actually... it is the trees who one the competition!

title: The way to the mysterious island
text: It was winter afternoon and the wind was blowing fast and there were spooky shadows all over the street. I was reading my favourite book 2 leaves and a pot of fondue. Oh sorry I forgot to introduce myself. My name is Petunia, Petunia Pretty Paws. I am a TV reporter on New mouse city the capital of Mouse island. So as I was talking, My phone begun to buzz. It was the call from my favorite niece Bugsy Wugsy. Auntie, I have found a magic book in the library in which there is a magical island far away from mouse island so can you go there and publish the report of it on your channel? She asked. I went in thought then I agreed I also said she can come with me and take a friend if she wants. Then I started packing by bag. Just as I finished packing my bag the doorbell rang. Ding Dong. It was Bugsy Wugsy, I asked her what was the matter. She said that we are leaving now, and I have brought a friend of mine his name is Benjamin, And also the camper is ready outside. I thanked my niece for being so kind. When I went out to look the camper it was so much beautiful. Just turn the page to see the camper! We went inside it was a long journey. As I was driving it Benjamin and Bugsy Wugsy were talking and playing. They were playing space mice. They had a lot of fun. It was a long journey but amazing. When we were out of new mouse city I asked Bugsy for the map. She said that the map was torn but she had remembered it we had to pass through the giant valley of flowers, Green park town, and through crystal lake. By the time we reached the giant valley of flowers it was dawn and the sun was setting we thought of having dinner so we sat under the tree to have our dinner it was so much yummy things to eat. When we finished suddenly it started to rain. We hurried into the camper continuing our journey. It took 2 days to reach Green Park Town. It was such a beautiful place, there were birds chirping and the flowers smelt amazing and the breeze was cold but it could tell it was very beautiful sight. We went through the whole forest. Bugsy clicked many photos of them, and Benjamin made some notes of how butterfly and flowers smelt and looked. I thought I could tell my friend Geronimo Stilton to publish a book on this adventure. Do you know him? Well, he is owner of the Rodent's Gazelle the most famous newspaper on mouse island. His hobby is to write books. The Green Park Town looked somewhat like this. Finally we reached The crystal lake. We were amazed to see that the lake was made of crystal. Bugsy took many pics of it. Even the trees and fruits were made of crystal. And there was no sunlight and only dark. After a while we heard a strange voice it sounded like this. Bzzzz Bzzzzz. Then I came to know it was my phone and the sound had echoed. Finally after 1 to 2 days more we reaches the island. We thought of naming it the mysterious island. We went inside to see it was really beautiful and amazing until we came across a castle! Benjamin and Bugsy wanted to go inside so we went. It was the palace of a princess that lived many centuries ago. There were many ancient stones, the crown of the queen and the king and there was also there throne! Benjamin and Bugsy loved it. Bugsy again took many many photos and Benjamin made notes. For me, I was helping Benjamin and Bugsy. As we were about to leave the castle a mystery popped out from the roof. It was a secret message but the ink was melted! Aha, I said I understood what it said. It said that please turn the castle into a museum so everyone could see it, I am queen Elisabeth! She was the one whose book I was reading at home her book was my favourite one. She wrote 2 leaves and a pot of fondue the extra mystery and super exiting novel. So we again went to new mouse city and guess what we had spent one whole month and it was summer by the time we reached there. I quickly dropped Benjamin and Bugsy home and I went to my home to get fresh. Once I came out I took Benjamin and Bugsy to Geronimo's office. I told him to publish the book. He happily agreed. I also reported in my channel that please turn Elizabeth's castle into museum. Geronimo made a book named the way to the mysterious island. It is the very book you have finished reading. Hope you enjoyed it. He also shared this book with his friends, family members and even with his assistants. Everyone said the same thing, this is truly an amazing adventure. And guess what the book was on top of the best seller. The famous movie company asked him to make a movie based on it he was directing the film! Hope you like it and good bye until the next book. This is his family and friends. (The Photo is big enough so turn the page to see the next part)

text: I don't like Chiku, grandma", said Raju. "Come Raju let's play a dice game", said grandma. "I don't like dice games, grandma", said Raju. "Come child let's play with the dog", said grandma. title: Playing with Friends!
text: There was a boy named Vansh. He was very friendly, he always helped his friends. He played with them a lot! He played games like hide and seek, football, cricket and badminton. As usual, he went to play with his friends in the evening. They were playing in the playground. A Match of Football was to be started! They were just about to start the match. They counted the number of children which were playing, there were 22 children. It meant that they could play football because they had enough children. They divided the teams, Vansh was in a different team and his friend Arun, was also in a different team. They started the match. Both the teams were playing great. Vansh's team then scored a goal! Arun's Team couldn't do anything about it. After sometime, Arun was very angry, he asked to other players in his team to pass him the football. He was passed the football by their team's midfielder and he scored the goal after sometime. Now the score was equal! The game was about to end, but, Guess What? Arun was about to score a goal. Vansh tried to defend it but he was pushed by Arun, He got hurt! But he had to play, So, he again tried to defend him and finally succeeded. He took the ball and scored a brilliant goal! title: Where do you get Apples from ?
text: YUMMY, DELICIOUS APPLES!!!! Do you like Apples? Do you know where Apples come from? Grocery store? Market..? Do they grow in Plants..? Shrubs..? Vines..? Lets learn all about Apples...in this book. Apples are sweet tasting fruit that is consumed by people all over the world. Apples grow on trees. Apple grow well in cold winter and moderate summer. It is a Perennial tree. Apples are for fresh eating and some for cooking too.. Apple buds looks like this!! These are Apple Flowers... Look closely they have male and female parts in them. POLLINATION When the male part of the flower is transferred to female part of the flower,it is called as Pollination. Apple Flowers have male and female parts. Some Apple trees are Self Pollinating, pollination occurs in flowers from same plant. But Cross pollination (pollination occurs from one plant to another plant) is required to produce more fruits. Apple Farmers depend heavily on Bees for Pollination. The Bees have successfully done their job. Pollination is successful!!! Young Apples are formed. Now the Apples are big and after few days they are ready to be picked.... Apple Varieties There are 7500 Varieties of Apples throughout the world. Some of the popular varieties are Gala, Red Delicious, Granny Smith, Fuji..etc., SIGNIFICANCE OF APPLES Apples come in variety of shapes, colors and flavors. They provide a range of nutrients. Apples are high in Fiber, Vitamin C and various Antioxidants. They also help prevent several health conditions. Do You Know This Is Why They Say," An Apple A Day Keeps The Doctor Away". Now do you know a lot about Apples? Next time you eat Apples will you share this with Your Friends??
author: Sree Devi Priya Mani

title: Liar Rabbit Nang Bya
text: This is a story of the Kachin people of Myanmar. One day in a forest, there were a rabbit called "Nang Bya" and a tiger, who were good friends. Tiger was clever and hard working. With the rainy season approaching, Tiger gathered what he needed to gather, including food. He was working very hard to prepare for the coming rainy season, covering things that needed to be covered in his house. At that moment, Nang Bya didn't work hard, but lived happily like what he could find today then he ate all today. He lived happily that way. He told Tiger, "Hey, friend, why are you working so hard? No need to work hard. Living from day to day is enough. " Tiger said, "No, my friend, we have to work hard. The rain will come soon." Then, Nang Bya replied, "OK, OK, you can work as you like. I'm happy. I'll sleep." Then he slept and ate. He spent every day that way. The rainy season was getting closer and closer, and it was almost the time. Nang Bya thought to himself. He was a very good liar, so everyone else did not believe him. However, everyone who met him kept falling for his lies. He thought and told Tiger. "Hey Tiger, come and see my house. You will see the sky, moon, and stars widely, and you will be delighted." Tiger thought, "Hmmm, it looks like Nang Bya is trying to trick me," and he didn't go out that night. It was not yet the rainy season, so Nang Bya's house was really cool and comfortable. The next night, Nang Bya said again, "Tiger, come and see my house. My place is very nice. Try to lie down. You can see the moon and the stars, the sky is so beautiful. Come to visit my place." On that night, Tiger definitely went to Nang Bya's place. When he turned over his body on the floor, he saw the sky with the moon and the stars, and it was really pleasurable. Tiger said to Nang Bya, "Your place is so nice, so enjoyable, and so cool." Then, Nang Bya said, "I think you might want to exchange your house with mine." Tiger said, "Yes, yes, your place is so comfortable. Let's exchange! Let's exchange!" Then the two of them exchanged houses with each other. Tiger enjoyed staying there, watching the sky, stars, and moon every night. However, after a while, the rainy season arrived and heavy rains started pouring down. Nang Bya was having a good time in the house that the tiger had built well in advance of the rainy season. Tiger went back to his old house and called his friend, "Nang Bya, Nang Bya, please let me in." But, Nang Bya said, "This is not your house anymore. Go back. We have exchanged our houses already." Tiger was amazed, "Oh, so that's why people call him The liar Nang Bya!" As this story shows, there are many liars in the world today. So we have to think very carefully for ourselves whether we can trust what others say. This story is reproduced based on: H. Lu Lu Aung (speaker), Keita Kurabe (depositor), 2016. title: The bear and the bird
text: Once there was two friends, a bear and a bird. They were very good friends. But one day, they had an argument about who was the best. The bear said, " I am the strongest and biggest so that means I am the best." The bird said, " If you are the biggest and the strongest that doesn't means that you are the best." Then the next day, a fierce tiger came. It had a plan to eat the bear and the bird. Then, the bear came and started to fight the tiger to stop it from eating them, But the tiger was very strong and the bear wasn't able to fight the tiger. So the bear fell into the ground, wounded. ﻿Then the bird came to the rescue. With it's sharp beak, it pecked hard on the tiger's body and it started to bleed a lot. The tiger was hurt. It ran away from the bear and the bird. Then the bear realized and said, " You were right, my friend. If i am the strongest and the biggest that doesn't means that I am the best." The bird forgave the bear and they became friends again.
author: Meenal  Bansal

title: Birds
text: There are different types of birds living near our house.Some birds cannot fly very high, like Peacock,Rooster and Duck. Some birds can fly very fast, like Eagle,Falcon, Crow, Pigeon,Parrot and Owl. Birds do not have any teeth, but they have beaks.Each bird's chirp, texture of beak,colour of wings and texture of toes is different.All birds have different types of eating habits.Some birds are vegetarian while others are non-vegetarian Parrots use their beak to cut and eat fruits and vegetables.Eagle, Vulture and Falcon are non-vegetarian birds.Their beaks are sharp and fast, By which, they cut their meat into pieces and eat it.All birds make nests before laying eggs. Nightingales lay their eggs in crow's nests.

title: the last leaf
text: once upon a time two girls lived in the artvillie street,the street was losing it's lusture as painters stopped doing painting because they got very less money to do it. The two girls jonsey and sue were also painters but never stopped doing what they love. They resided on the third floor of an old house. Johnsy fell critically ill in November She suffered from pneumonia and used to lie in her bed without moving. She continuously gazed out of the window Sue, her friend, became very worried. She called the doctor. Although he came every day, yet Johnsy’s condition showed no improvement. The doctor confirmed that Johnsy was not willing to live. As a result, the medicines were ineffective to cure her ill-health. Sue tried her greatest to make Johnsy take an interest in things around her. She talked about clothes and fashion However, Johnsy was irresponsive. She continued to lie still on her bed. Sue brought her drawing-board into the room and began to paint Suddenly Sue heard Johnsy whispering something. She speedily rushed to the bed and heard Johnsy counting backward. She speedily rushed to the bed and heard Johnsy counting backward. Looking out of the window, she was saying, “Twelve!” However, after some time she whispered “eleven”, then “ten” and so on. She saw an old ivy creeper climbing half-way up the brick wall opposite to the window. Also, the creeper was shedding its leaves in the strong wind. Johnsy was very depressed. She created a thought that she would die when the last leaf fell. Moreover, she did not accept the soup offered to her. Later, in the last leaf summary, Sue tried to show affection towards Johnsy. Sue told her that she would not die. She kept the curtain open as she needed the light to complete her painting. She desired to fetch money for them by selling it. Sue pleaded Johnsy not to look out of the window. Also, she told Johnsy that she would not die. She has to live for her friends. Moreover, Sue would become lonely without Johnsy. But Johnsy was sure that she would die as soon as the last leaf falls. She added that she would sleep after the last leaf falls and would sleep forever. Sue was very worried about her friend’s condition. She was helpless. Sue rushed to the ground floor to seek help from a 60-year-old painter. His name was Behrman. His lifelong dream was to paint a masterpiece. Unfortunately, it remained a dream only. Sue told the condition of his friend to Behrman. She refused to eat and continuously looked outside the window. She declares that she would not survive after the falling of the last leaf. He condemned Johnsy for being silly. However, he agrees to paint the last leaf for Johnsy so that she could recover. Johnsy woke up the next morning. To her surprise, the last leaf survived the storm and it was clinging to the creeper. It survived another storm in the evening too. This incident opened Johnsy’s eyes. She apologized to her friend for being so irresponsive and depressed. She realized that it was a sin to think of death. Then, she combed, had soup, and a desire to live. The doctor arrived. He told about the improvement in her health. He added that she would recover soon as her desire to live was back. Sue went to see Behrman. He was only two days ill. However, he dies of pneumonia contracted while being out in the wet and cold. Sue tells this news to Johnsy. She tells her to look at the last leaf clinging to the creeper. She reveals the truth that it was the masterpiece of the old artist, Behrman. He always wanted to produce a masterpiece painting but had never succeeded in his attempt to produce the same. However, to help her recover from her depression, he spent considerable time painting with great realism a leaf on the wall. title: Admirable Companion
text: The Schools were on Vacation on account of the Summer Holidays. She needed someone to play with her, anyone or maybe even an animal. She dreamt of a Cat on a Sunday night, She rubbed the cat on its head and brought some milk. The next day, the girl ran to her mom saying "Meow, Meow" and asked for a Cat. The Mother said No! The cat might fall from the balcony. The Girl dreamt of a Dog on Monday night. She pampered the dog and threw a ball towards the dog. The girl went to her father the next day and asked for a Dog making the noise "Bow, Bow". The girl dreamt of an Elephant on Tuesday night. She went on a Safari with her elder sister and brother. The next day, the girl pulled her granny's Saree and said - "Dear Granny, it would be so good to have an elephant" with a smiling face. To which the Granny Replied, "It's not possible to have an elephant in a small house, it would break the doors and walls" On the Wednesday night, the girl dreamt of a monkey. The monkey put it's tongue out and was hanging up-side down on the tree branch. The girl brought a coffee to her Grandpa the next day and said, "Grandpa, let's get a monkey and feed him fruits". The Grandpa replied, "Why do we need a four legged Monkey, when we already have three monkeys with two legs at home" On Thursday's night, she dreamt of a mouse. She followed the mouse into a hole. The next day, she went to her brother and said, "It would be so good to have a pet mouse". Her brother replied, "The mice will bite the books, spoil the grains". Never ever should we bring a mouse. She dreamt of a rabbit on Friday night. She sat the rabbit on her lap and fed a carrot. She sat on her elder sister the next day with joy and said "Rabbit's fur is so soft" and giggled. She ran towards her mom and said "I want o pet a long eared, white rabbit. The mom replied back angrily "It would be difficult to clean and the rabbit gives birth to a lot of babies and hence it would be difficult to take care of" The girl was disappointed with this. The girl was sad and prayed not to have any dreams of pet animals. She heard a squeaking noise outside the window to find a Squirrel on the tree branch. It's foot was stuck in the branch and the squirrel was bleeding with a lot a pain. She picked the squirrel and rubbed her soft palms on the squirrel's head. She mixed turmeric in water and applied it on the squirrel's hurt foot. The squirrel slept on the tree branch till evening and the wound vanished by nightfall. The squirrel ran on the branches the next day. The squirrel came on to the balcony window. The girl gave a guava fruit to the squirrel. Things we can learn from this story" 1) Family Members 2) Names of the pet animals 3) Names of all the days in a week This story which is in a poetic form would be remembered in the minds of the children forever. Children become knowledgeable learning these kinds of stories. This is the main objective of the book.

title: Lost World of Bhagirathi
text: Shri Bhagirathi Mahapatra was an Indian politician. He was a member of central legislative assembly from (1945-1947). He was a Member of Parliament, representing Odisha in the Rajya Sabha the upper house of India's Parliament as a member of the Indian National Congress. Shri Bhagirathi Mohapatra was also the founder secretary of Utkal Pradesh (Odisha) congress Committee (1921-1937) along with Utkala Mani Pandit Gopabandhu Das, who was also the Founder President. He was also one of the main trustee of Swaraj Ashram (Which was the Sabarmati Ashram of Odisha), Odisha (1940). Shri Bhagirathi Mahapatra was an Indian politician. He was a member of central legislative assembly from (1945-1947). He was a Member of Parliament, representing Odisha in the Rajya Sabha the upper house of India's Parliament as a member of the Indian National Congress. Shri Bhagirathi Mohapatra was also the founder secretary of Utkal Pradesh (Odisha) congress Committee (1921-1937) along with Utkala Mani Pandit Gopabandhu Das, who was also the Founder President. He was also one of the main trustee of Swaraj Ashram (Which was the Sabarmati Ashram of Odisha), Odisha (1940). ﻿ Bhagirathi Mohapatra (Circled) with all Eminent Personalities of the Nation like JN Nehru, Subhash Bose, Sardar ValabhaiPatel 1st Parliamentarian Photo taken before Independence. Shri Bhagirathi Mohapatra was born in 1892. in 1914 he graduated from the Ravenshaw College,Cuttack. He took his M.A. degree in 1916 and Bachelor of Law in 1918. For three years he practiced and joined the Non-cooperation Movement.I n 1921 he was elected the first Secretary of the Provincial Utkal Congress Committee. In 1922 he was arrested for his political activities and convicted for two years and one month imprisonment. Since 1921 he wasa member of the A.I.C.C. He was the Director of Khadi Association. In 1932 he was arrested while on the way to the Delhi Congress and was detained in Alipore jail. In 1935 he was elected the first secretary of the Utkal Provincial Congress Committee and took control as a Chairman. Smt. Sarala Devi, an Indian Independence activist, a Feminist, A social activist, a Politician, a Writer was his wife. Shri Bhagirathi Mohapatra led the Freedom Struggle, Non Cooperation Movement under theguidance of Shri Mahatma Gandhi who accompanied Bhagirathi in the Satyagraha Movement in Odisha, Bihar and Bengal. Shri Bhagiarathi Mohapatra’s Properties were attached in 1932 by the British Officials. Bhagirathi Mohapatra being such a great Leader of the Nation, his sacrifices went unnoticed but some of them found their way into history books and are even remembered today with great pride and honour. Shri Bhagirathi Mohapatra was non other than my Great Grand Father and I take the Pride of being his great grand daughter.

title: Barking deer and Indian gooseberries
text: This is a story of the Kachin people of Myanmar. Once upon a time, there was a barking deer. He was so hungry that he walked around all day looking for food. It was very hot that day. So he rested under an Indian gooseberry tree near the stream. The tree had a lot of berries on it. He had never eaten Indian gooseberries before, but he was very hungry. So he hit the tree with its antlers and dropped the berries. Then he picked up and ate a berry. However, the berry was very bitter. So he got angry and cursed. "I will never eat such berries again, even if lightning strikes!" The berry was so bitter that the deer drank water from the stream near the tree. As soon as he took a drink of water, a sweet taste that he had never tasted before filled his mouth. It was so delicious that he wanted to eat the berry again. So he picked up the berry again and ate it. When he ate it, lightning suddenly struck him, a s he had cursed earlier. Lightning struck his straight forehead. That's why you can still see the scars of lightning strikes on the forehead of the barking deer. This story is reproduced based on: J. Roi San (speaker), Keita Kurabe (depositor), 2017.
