title: The Marvellous Laser Man
text: The Marvellous Laser Man Once upon a time, there lived a man called Gokle. He was a young, honest and energetic man. One day he went to a nearby local supermarket to shop for food items, beverages, and self-care products. In that supermarket, a few thieves embezzled money from the cash counter. When they saw Gokle entering the shop, they thought of a cunning plan and set out loping frantically. Gokle could not understand this; however, by the time he got the picture, the thieves had rushed with the money that they had just amassed. To trick the police, one sly thief made a prank phone call to register the case, after this they fled to the local supermarket. In reality, the cunning thieves locked up the local supermarket staff in their secret tunnel. When the police arrived, they alleged Gokle as the thief. Nonetheless, the police found no money when they squared his pockets. They thought he might have kept the money somewhere safe, so they took him to the court for a trial. Gokle narrated the entire incident as he saw it, but the judge convicted him of the crime, and he was ordered for a test their new and innovative, dazzling optical machine. The device was called a laser. That machine could slice the victim’s head and Gokle knew about this. The judge insisted on executing this on the same evening as it was predicted that Gokle might run away if the case got delayed. Following this, Gokle was taken to the intense machine, he shuddered for a moment and his spines chilled at the horrible sight of the laser machine. The sheer elegance and simplicity of its design belied the intellectual achievement it represented. Finally, a marvellous thing happened when they were about to cut his head. Unexpectedly, he encountered a superpower, his head turned and a laser-sighted rifle from the intense machine managed to shoot the guilty people during the attack and from that moment Gokle started using the rifle and hunting down the criminals for their heinous crimes. From that day onwards, he became popular as the laser man.To keep his powers secret and to protect his family and friends, who might be endangered by his criminal enemies, and to help humanity, the laser man wears a characteristic suit; ‘the laser man suit’ that looks like a beam of light with a letter ‘L’ embarked on it and a poncho. He took to wearing eyeglasses, styling his hair differently, altering his body language, modifying his voice, and wearing the laser man suit every time he acts on the laser-sighted rifle. This way he can hide his physique from the observers. Since then, he continued to use laser rifles to hunt criminals and stories of his generous deeds have continued to make the audience awe-struck. This way laser man has helped to capture many criminals and his incredible deeds have become everlasting. The moral of the story is “be honest and good will come to you.” THE END
author: Dhanvin  Napolean

title: The cat who was afraid of fish
text: Soni and Kate are friends for a long time. They love to play and listen to music with each other, especially Soni. They've lived together since he was just a baby. One day Kate prepared a surprise trip, a boat trip! But there was a main point she had forgotten, Soni was afraid of fish. Everything was fine until a fish appeared, he quikly jumped on Kate and she got hurt. Soni: I am so sorry! It wasn't my intention! Said him trying to explain the situation. Kate: There is no problem Soni, I knew you were afraid of fish and even though I brought you here. But then the unexpected happened, a shoal appeared and Soni passed out. When he woke up quickly he shouted: Please let's go home! I can't do it anymore! OK! Now calm down. We are going home, she said while she was hugging him. Next to they're city he was atarting to be a little too exited. You are shaking the boat! Said Kate. But he was so happy saying that they were next to go home. They went out of the boat, he lay on the floor and screamed: I missed you so much! Soni and Kate ran to they're house and Kate said: Finally home. You can relax now Soni!
author: Sebastiana Bittencourt

title: Love for pets...
text: Theme: Love for pets Characters: fatka (main character), Bhidu (a dog), Mr.Shashikant Bhide (a politician), (8 naughty children, Mr Dubey (Personal secretory of a politician) Setting: The children of a society make friends with an orphan and his dog Bhidu but when a scheming politician plans to get rid of stray dogs. They all come up with a plan to save their four - legged friend Problem: A politician plans to terminate all the dogs of society for public safety so, all friends started doing a march to save their pet. Eight innocent but feistybkids lead carefree lives in Chandan Nagar, a colony in mumbai where each has his own identity and a nickname based on their qualities. Not only that, but their whole team has a nickname that has earned them significant noriety. They explain that they have mainly two enemies- the neighboring cricket team to whom they always lose and a dog they named "loose motion" since she dirties their cricket pitch so, they developed an enemy against dogs. Their hopes are shattered shortly, after a boy Fatka enters their society with his dog Bhidu. He was employed to wash cars of the society. The children of the society do everything to throw him and his dog out of the society. But they become unsuccessful. Eventually they developed a friendship between each other as Fatka helps them by serving as the lead bowler during the match with neighbouring cricket team. They started living happily but their happiness short-lived when a reckless politician, welfare minister Mr Shashikant Bhide enters their life, because his personal secretary Mr Dubey was attacked by Bhidu for hurting Fatka. Bhide announces in a news telecast that all the stray dogs roaming about in residential buildings in Mumbai will be caught and terminated, misleading audiences with a concern for public safety. He further inform that the dogs can only be saved if the society files No Objection Certificate with 1 month. The kids, shocked by this, strive hard to get at least more than 50% votes of total residents in the society. 31 votes bits they manage only 10 votes after 15 days... With more efforts gone in vain, the kids finally organize a march across the streets purely in underwears. These gains them enough fraction to pull 10 more votes with more hardwork and awareness they manage to get another 10 vote counting a total of 30 votes. With only a day left for the deadline as declared by Bhide, A T.V channel invites Bhide and the kids for face off. Seeing this as their last chance, they attend the interview which is being telecaste across India. Knowing that is the last day and dog catchers are after Bhidu they pray hard to save him during the interview they are constantly mocked by Bhide who questions their education and upbringing, but it soon takes a turn and culminates in the kids answering Bhide back with their moral education responses. Having won, the kids plead to leave after a moving speech by Fatka and the interviewers agree. When they reach the society they are disheartened as there is no sight of Bhidu suddenly, Bhidu comes jumping in, wearing a collar readind "Bhidu-Chandan Nagar society". Bhidu and the kids become happy.... Moral: We should love animals. Nothing is more loyal than an animal to whom you've bounded with.
author: Ayushi Sharma

title: Nature helps them who help others
text: Once Upon a time, there was a girl named Kuhu. She was very poor but she was kind hearted. Her times were challenging. One day she decided to go out for a stroll. She had nothing to eat but only water. So she took a bottle of water with her and started her stroll. On her way, she saw a cow. "Can you give me something to drink, I am very thirsty." The cow spoke to her. " Sure, I have little water, I don't know whether it is sufficient for you, please have it." Kuhu said. "No problem, this will be enough for my rumbling belly." the cow said. Kuhu offered the water. The cow said, "You quenched my thirst, I am extremely grateful. One pedestrian offered me the grains, you may please take it. By the way, where are you going?" Kuhu said, ''Thank you for the grains. I am going on stroll". "May I also come with you?" the cow said. "Why not! It would be a pleasure." Kuhu said. Both of them started on stroll. While, they were passing by an orchard, suddenly, they heard the sound of one pigeon, "Oh dear girl, would you be so kind to offer me something to eat, I am very hungry. Kuhu looked at her hand and gave her the grains she had. " Thank y ou and what is your name" the pigeon asked. " My name i s Kuhu" she said. " Very well Kuhu, can I join with you? I want to give this flower to you" the pigeon said." thank you for the flower and yes you can join me" she said. The trio went back on the path. After a little while, they saw another tree but this time it had a beehive, a worker bee was sitting a few inches far from the hive on the same branch. He looked sad, old and weak. Kuhu asked him "What happened, dear bee?" " Huh" the bee deeply sighed "Listen my story, during this spring, our population reached the highest limit ever seen, but this summer is the most different summer in our entire history, because there are only fruits in the place of flower because of which my family is starving including my queen, I know a flower garden a little far from here but Alas! I am old so I can't go that far" the bee said. Kuhu took pity on her and gave the flower. T he bee was grateful to have the flower. Kuhu, cow and pigeon decided to return as it was about to dark. During her stroll, one rat was following her and watching her helping nature and kind heartedness. The rat had one magical seed and he wanted to give it to the right person. He said, "My search is complete, you are the right person for this magical seed, please sow it and it will give you golden fruits. Continue your good work and help others." Kuhu sowed the magical seed. After a year, the seed became big tree with golden fruits. She started selling them and became rich. Now Kuhu was not alone. She had lot of money as well as friends. Moral 1- If you help others without any expectation of returns, Nature will surely help you. Moral 2- If you want to do a task, do it, don't wait for others, others will follow you.
author: Devansh Varshney

title: New Age Woman
text: This is Navya, at the age of 11 she saw a woman driving a truck. She was surprised as there was a lot of gender discrimination around her at that time. when she told her father "papa I saw a woman driving a truck" he said "oh really, maybe you mistakenly saw a male driver as a woman." Women can't drive vehicles" he said. She was shocked! she thought about how her father can talk such things about women. from then on, She made it her goal in life, to drive a truck with her father. She started her "truck driving journey" with researching about trucks, the types of trucks, how to drive a truck and so on. One day, as she was doing the research on her laptop, her father caught her doing so, and he asked her "what are doing wasting your time researching about a stupid goal that you won't even achieve". Navya was angry at her dad for saying such things about what she loves doing. she argued with her dad till the extent where her mother had to come in and interrupt. "What are you guys doing don't you have better work" her mother said. After that heated argument Navya's mother confronted her father, she asked him why he was scolding her, he said " Navya is wasting so much of her time researching about trucks after she saw that lady driving a truck". Her mother silently went up to her phone, opened it, and to her father the old photos of herself driving a auto after battling her parents who didn't want her to act like a ' cowboy '. But she had a goal in mind, and she was not going to budge. She was tired of watching her parents judge woman and tell them what to and not to do. Navya's mother changed her father's mind. He was sorry for Navya's mother who had to stand up against a lot of discrimination. Navya's father finally went up to his daughter and apologized. He said "Sorry Navya for saying such things about your dream of driving a truck, I hope you can do it some day, you will always have our support". With this support, on Navya's 16th birthday, her father surprised her with her own car. she started driving a car and then she started taking truck driving lessons. at the age of 22, Navya finally got her truck license. she started a delivery business of delivering construction goods to architects. Navya made a lot of money and hired all the women. Navya lived happily ever after.

title: Convalescence
text: I look around. Everything has been reduced to ashes. There is a melancholy in the air and the only thing I could hear was my heart weeping for him. He died. Just vanished off the face of the Earth in a millisecond. Just when he was to join the navy, he and many others were brutally died in the fire and I, I didn’t even get to say goodbye. Today is the day of his funeral. I couldn’t bear to go and pay my respects to a photo of him as no remains were found. But the whole town went on behalf of me. How do you think I should cope with this loss? Its like the ground beneath my feet has been stolen. I don’t feel like doing anything. I just want to be in his arms and hear him say a quiet “I love you” in that husky voice of his. I feel empty. A part of my heart died with him. People say, “You have to let him go.” But my heart keeps telling me to hold on. So I do the one thing I never would have thought of- dive into work and block every single person out. My town, White Bridge, had been set ablaze in voracious flames. So, my best friend, Penny and I took the initiative to provide food, clothes and a roof to the ones who lost everything. “Are you sure you want to do this?” Penny asked “Yes” “Don’t you think you should be at home?” she cautiously asked, not wanting to annoy me. “He was a true army man. He gave his life for White Bridge and would’ve wanted me to do this.” I replied firmly. “He must be so proud of you, Iris, watching you from heaven.” White Bridge was a large town with a huge marketplace located right in the centre. We went from places to places, providing the homeless with food, clothes and set up a large mansion for shelter. We then spoke to the Mayor, had him sit with us and design a structure to rebuild our town. We employed the citizens of White Bridge and constructed that plan. When our beloved town was re- inaugurated, everyone cheered, celebrated and tried to forget their miseries they had been affected by. But I, on the other hand, was quite the opposite. The next day, I woke up with a feeling the someone was there in my house. I searched the whole house to come up with nothing. I made the mistake of opening his cupboard and since I couldn't get myself to throw out his belongings, his scent crashed down on me. His cupboard was just the same- organised and clean with the smell of his cologne lingering in the air. I reached out and touched the first shirt of his I saw. Tears clouded my vision and I broke down, letting out the nerve- wracking sobs I had buried deep within. I caressed his face in a picture that had been kept on his desk and cried for help, cried for him to come back to me. Penny came in. Hearing my cries, she rushed to sit down on the cold floor besides me and held me till I didn't have any tears left. We didn't need any words. I didn't want to talk about it and she respected that. She recommended I talk to someone about it and handed me a card of a therapist before shoving me out the door. I thought of not going at first but then decided against it. Penny had stuck with me through thick and this. I'll do this for her. 'I have never heard of him before..' I thought making a mental note to ask Penny about it later. Since I didn't have a car and the clinic was all the way across town, I decided to take a cab. Once I reached, I sat inside, patiently waiting for my turn. My stomach was churning and my anxiety levels were bursting through the roof. "Next!" the nurse called, breaking me out of my reverie. I took a deep breath and stood up, striding towards the open door. As soon as I saw him, he motioned for me to close the door and take a seat. I looked around the small room he called his office. "Hey. You must be Iris. Penny told me you would be coming in." He said, warmly welcoming me, his British accent on full display. "Hi" I reply timidly with the smallest smile I could come up with. And this is how we began. Leo became more than just a therapist- he became a good friend and helped me out every single time. He and Penny were right beside me when I opened my lost love's 'memory bag' as he used to call it. It took me five years to muster up the courage but it was worth the wait. When his 'memory bad' was opened, lots of tears were shed. But this time, I had them right behind me, standing like pillars, supporting me. His bag contained pictures of me as well as his childhood ones. It was a bittersweet moment and I just couldn't decide whether to smile or cry. I knew I would never be able to come out of it and just forget him. I will always love him not matter what. I know that I will never be able to be in his arms but that's okay because he'll always be in my heart. "I don't have to let someone go just because I don't see him everyday. I know I will have bad days but I also know that there'll be good ones too. I will always miss you and you can't be replaced. I believe I will see you in heaven someday and we will be united again. I realise this now but that is what life is- Loved ones leave willingly or unwillingly but they always stay in our hearts and become memories we'd like to relive over and over again. So, I'll see you on the other side, my love" I let out a shaky breath and set down the bouquet of tulips in front of his picture in the churchyard and place a small kiss on it.
author: Anusha Chavare

title: The Power of a Four-Leaf Clover
text: BEFORE YOU READ!!! Everyone in this life wants to live the happiest life possible and when they face any difficulties they blame God or their luck. When times are right you consider yourself lucky but just imagine that you are lucky everywhere and anytime. What could you have done then? Everyone knows how evil bullies are for a person's life. The same goes for Chloe, an 8-year-old girl. Chloe or Chloe Adams, living in a village near Chicago, Illinois, USA. She studies at 3rd standard at Rosegardens Primary School which is very near to her house. Chloe is a sole introvert; she has trouble starting conversations with children and loves to stay alone because groups are her weakness. This doesn't mean that she isn't someone nice. She is a very literate girl for her age, she is good at singing and playing the piano, but all these skills are hidden due to her fear of talking with people. She also has some sports as her favorites, especially volleyball; she plays volleyball with her friends near her house. Some days before Halloween Chloe was sitting on a bench in the park in front of her house. She often does this as she wants to spend some time for herself and her cat. Her friends hadn't come yet and she was not expecting them anytime soon, she could wait for as long as she wanted to as she had completed her homework. Suddenly.... some of Chloe's seniors came. Conor and Tyler were students of Chloe's school, they studied in 5th grade and were regarded as the mafia heads of the school because of their actions. They were in habit of ragging their juniors. They used to bully the so-called " Nerds ". These two boys were as close as brothers they both got suspended together for a week. They were the go-getters of the school, though being the worst in school they were the most trusted people to do a certain job and they were masters of keeping things a secret. Chloe, casually vibing and playing with her cat saw the two guys approaching. She was nervous at first as they were her seniors and they had never come there before. Both of them came close to Chloe she started to talk with them. " Are you Tyler.... and Conor 5th grade...? " She asked nervously. Conor responded while looking at Tylor and then Chloe who was keeping her head low " Yes! and you must be Chloe of 3rd grade ". She responded with excitement " Yes! Yes! " She was incredibly happy as she was the most forgetful girl in the school. From here things went south really fast. The bullies had an opportunity to strike at the young girl. It was the afternoon time nearly around 2:00 P.M the park was empty and nobody could be seen in the far sights of the park so they went for it. They started by sitting on the bench where earlier Chloe was sitting and then they called Chloe near them. Tylor stretched his legs and ordered Chloe to massage them. Conor started to laugh, and Chloe resisted Tylor's order but she wasn't that powerful enough to stop those two bullies it turns out Tylor began threatening Chloe and said " Listen you little brat if you don't massage my feet right now we both will beat you to death ". This was enough to shock Chloe to the core; it also doesn't help that she is the so-called " nerd " of her class. She started the massage and Tylor was smiling and feeling relaxed and Chloe didn't even dare to make a sound. Finding the opportunity, Conor went behind Chloe and kicked her butt very lightly, but still, it was a lot for Chloe to bear, remained silent and continued the massage. Conor again kicked her, but this time with full force, forcing her to fall from her knees. Tyler stood and now both of the boys began brutally beating Chloe. In the end, they stood Chloe up and pulled her pants down and they went running. Chloe barely had any power left in her body. With all the bits remaining, she pulled up her pants and started dragging herself to the bench where she was sitting earlier and her cat was hiding during her getting a beat from those two guys. She ran away and came 10 mins after the boys had dashed from the park. She began wailing and shedding tears. After a few minutes, she could pick herself up and again move forward. She was in grievous pain; her shirt was extremely dirty and torn up, and not to forget that she had to stand shameful without pants for a few minutes due to her weakness. In deep grief, Chloe was walking home still, all those incidents roaming in her mind. It was almost 4:00 pm due to the incident happening near Halloween, it was the fall season, and the whole street was covered with orange leaves. While walking, Chloe found a different-looking leaf than the common leaves which were usually seen in the neighbourhood. It had four heart-shaped laminas attached to a single petiole. It was rare to see a green leaf during the orange leaf season, so she decided to carry it with her. Surprisingly for her, after all the beating she suddenly felt no pain from those bruises she had just got, and to her happiness - those bullies had been caught by some uncle living right beside the park. Now she returned happily to her house, and her cat came with her too, but it can be no surprise her mother came all horrified at the miserable condition of her daughter. Chloe told everything truthfully and gave her the news that those bullies had been caught; she was angry at the boys but also happy that her daughter was doing ok. It just took just two days for the complete recovery from all her injuries and now she could again go to school. She was extremely scared to go to school for fear of getting bullied again, but she couldn't be luckier. The government issued a report for an upcoming storm for which schools had declared leaves for an entire week. She rested at home while gaining some confidence to go to school again. Again, something good happened was that the storms stopped for Halloween and continued for two days afterwards. After a few days, in school, Chloe about that rare kind of leaf which was called the " Four leaf clover " which was a rare type of clover of the common " Three leaf clover " and also was the symbol of good luck. Chloe remained silent in school but as she reached home she rushed to her room looking for that leaf which was inside her desk's drawer. She wanted to test if the good luck thing was real or not, so she asked her mother for 5$ and she gave it without a question. Now she was starting to believe the luck theory but there was something she wanted to do before completely believing in this which was to buy a lottery ticket. She found a local ticket seller, she bought a ticket worth five bucks. The prize on the ticket was worth a million dollars. the prize pool will be announced 5 days after. She returned home happy and she got another surprise her mom had made her chocolate waffles with a scope of ice cream. She was determined that she would win the lottery and was jumping with joy. The day came. Chloe rushed for the newspaper and that was that. She had just won the lottery!!! She had got a Million dollars!!! She exclaimed with overjoy " Yes!! This clover is lucky ". Now she believed the luck theory the fact also helps that she recently gave an MCQs test for which she didn't study at all just to test if the majority of her guesses would go correct and would you believe it she got all her answers right which was just pure guess. After 7 years puberty struck and Chloe became the most attractive girl you would see. She was now in high school and all boys there fantasised about her but still she wasn't the popular girl you would expect her to be. She was in the best relationship with the best boy who was very handsome, awesome at studies and perfect at soccer. She loved her life and what was going on in it and whoever lived near her were the nicest people known to mankind. It was all due to her so-called " Rare Leaf ". She preserved it with all her heart while keeping the secret to herself. Not to forget her academic progress during this time - She aced her primary school and middle school and was doing well in high school. She went with her volleyballs and singing skills because of her luck she could play on the national level and also win the first prize in it and win a national singing contest but, this doesn't she didn't put her hard work into it at all. This was related to her future and she didn't want to take risks regarding this matter. She gave it all for everything and she was also excited doing so as she knew god was on her side. She never took unfair advantage of the power she had, she was as kind and sweet as she was earlier. She never brag about her abilities or luck and remained the kid she was earlier though she was now not as introverted as she was earlier. Times went by now she was even a college passed out and was working for a big company and was earning thousands of dollars per month (10000$ to be exact). She was working on an increment basis and is supposed to receive a rise of 7% per annum and she married the same boy who she was dating just a few years back. He was also quite successful in soccer as he was in high school. He got selected for the international soccer competition and represented The United States of America. Even Chloe didn't leave her passions. She works as a commisioned singer for diverse producers, games and songs for movies and is also very successful in that too. Her luck transferred to all his family i.e her husband and her 2 children who all enjoyed their life to the fullest. Sadly her mother died when she was 34 but fortunately, she died peacefully and didn't have to suffer a lot. Chloe had the most adorable, intelligent, fun and loving kids. they took immense care of their parents when they grew up and married gorgeous girls. When the children were mature enough, she finally revealed her secret to both her husband and their children all were surprised at first and weren't that keen to believe it but after she told them everything they had to back down. She requested her children to preserve the thousands of leaves she had preserved for their well-being. Her children were highly obedient and they started to take care of the leaves. Both Chloe and her husband died together loving for over 100 years and leaving all their assets for their two children for which they never fought with each other.
author: Kunwarjeet Singh Arora

title: The Losted Man
text: Once there lived a man, Whose name was Kim. He live with his two sisters on a lonly hillside. He was the youngest, but he work the hardest his among sisters. His two sister always keep fighting with eachother and never give time to their little brother. After their mother passed away and their father leave them. alone, they gave up all the works to their little brother Kim, who was just about 14 years old. One day Kim came. home from outside and all to his amazed he saw that the glass made pot which was given by their mother was broken The asked his sisters that how it broke but they were fighting and didn't get so busy in their time to listend to him or say anything. After Seeing this sad moment in his life. He sadly wrote a letter and left the house. All after, when his sister saw the letter and picked it up, she start reading - "One day you will understand-" and then the other sister snatch it and teared it. The letter won was not read by anyone. They again. started fighting and after sometimes they stoped and kept waiting for their brother. 1 year passed, 2 year passed, but their little brother didn't came back. But, in that much time they became much better. They do their work themselves, they don't fight anymore, and many other things also changed. A long time passed like. this, and then, after Seven years their Losted brother came back. They were. really happy to see him, they asked him mony. questions - "Where had you gone?", "What you did there?' and They were many other questions. also eager to know that what they he had written in that letter. He told them to stop and told that he had to the cit gone city and job, everyone was very bush their own works there and was found a busy in all he worte in that letter that - One day, you will understand how it feels to do yourself and if your own work you Keep fighting like this, you will realised someday that you have wasted the most precious time in you life. His sisters realised their fault and said sorry to him. They started to live their new life with a lot of love and care.
author: Maria Abida
illustrator: Julie  Smith-Belton; Jesse  Breytenbach; Kalp Sanghvi; Maithili  Joshi; Priya Kuriyan; Vishnu  M Nair

title: Ghostly creatures
text: Wearing shoes, Nancy is ready to go to school. As soon as she reaches her school, on the entry itself, she is welcome by a big hug given to her by her best friend, Minnie. 'Hey Minnie!' says Nancy, and the reply Minnie comes out with is a hello too. Then, they were about to go to the class but again got interrupted by their other friends, Alex, Peter, and Helen. They all waved to each other and moved to their respective classrooms. As they entered the classroom, the first period started. Everyone was focused on their studies when, suddenly, the lights appeared flickering; it looked like or was supposed to be an electrical issue, but only for a diminutive time; all the fans turned off too. Everyone was surprised and shocked as it was not usual for them. The school has inverters through which the fans can keep working. After a few minutes, the lights turned on again, and the same case was for all the fans. Nancy went to the washroom with her friends Minnie and Helen to wash her hands as it was recess period. Minnie said that she needed to use the restroom. Nancy and Helen agreed and said, " it's fine! You can go. We will be waiting here only for you." Minnie went inside, and as she entered, she heard some weird cracking noises coming from the side. She got afraid and ran outside. Nancy and Helen saw her running like that, and out of their anxiety, they asked Minnie,' What happened, Minnie? Why do you look so scared?' she was panting, sweating, and shivering. She didn't reply as she was trying to catch her breath. Helen said '' Nancy, wait a minute; I will bring my water bottle real quick." She said, and after a few minutes, she came back. They gave water to Minnie, comforted her, and asked the same question again. Minnie said, 'I heard some weird cracking noises from the side walls of the restroom.' Nancy and Helen's jaws dropped as there was no chance of anyone around it because the washroom was on the first floor at the end of the corridor. They all freaked out and went to their classes. The girls told the entire incident to the boys. They were shocked by the incident and didn't believe it, but after seeing Minnie's condition, they understood that none of them was lying. Peter said, 'it is weird today.' First, the lights and fans turned off, and now these sounds. Alex said to everyone," Exactly, these things are unusual." they all just shrugged these thoughts off, got back on their seats in the classroom, and started focusing on the lecture as the next period started. All the time, Nancy was thinking about those unusual events that took place today. She was lost in thoughts when suddenly the floor and ceiling started shaking. Everyone was running here and there. After it, the teacher instructed everyone to go out into the ground. Everyone got gathered in one place; on the school ground. Teachers were calming down the children who were afraid and panicking. Out of nowhere, a teacher came running and said, "Miss Kim, one student is missing; a girl is missing." Miss Kim, the principal of the school, stood up in shock. She instructed the teachers to find that girl around the school, but no one could find her. Nancy and her friends were hundred percent sure; something was unusual there. Everyone in her group was discussing this. Suddenly, Alex saw a shadow disappearing into the corner of the school. He immediately screamed, " Guys! Someone was going down in the basement; it might be that girl." Alex went to the basement with his friends. They searched the whole basement but couldn't find her. In between this, they realized that the building had stopped shaking a while ago. They all thought; it was Alex's illusion to see that shadow moving and disappearing in the basement. They were about to move back, but the next moment they all heard a few more sounds coming from a storage room that had been closed for some years now as it was useless. They all were curious about that room. They sneaked through the window and saw a strange old man, tied to a chair with a cloth in his mouth. The biggest astonishing thing for them was that some more creatures were doing strange things. Helen immediately recognized the man and said, ' isn't that the same scientist who was arrested for the crime of doing illegal experiments and ran from jail a few weeks ago?' Everyone agreed. They saw someone was coming. Thus, they hid behind the benches. After confirming that no one was there, they went inside the room, started untying the scientist, and asked him everything. The scientist admitted that he was experimenting on a superhuman, but something went wrong, and these creatures got invented. He also claimed that he had come to the school sneakingly and started doing experiments. Everyone was stunned after hearing his confession. Nancy asked how to destroy these ghostly creatures, and she asked about the girl who was missing. Dr. Den, the scientist, said, 'I need to do some experiments in the system so that these creatures will disappear and that the girl is with them only. Once all the creature gets disappear, the girl shall be back too. Nancy and her friends decided that they'll divert the ghostly creatures. They all were standing outside. All of a sudden, they saw two of them coming. They ran here and there. Unfortunately, Alex was stuck as he was chased to the end of the hall. As soon as the creature was about to attack him, it suddenly disappeared. Helen ran to Alex and asked him if he was okay or if he was hurt anywhere and told him that the scientist successfully amended the changes. But for that, I need at least 20 minutes.' There was a possibility of any creature coming at any time. Nancy and her friends decided that they'll divert the ghostly creatures. They all were standing outside. All of a sudden, they saw two of them coming. They ran here and there. Unfortunately, Alex was stuck as he was chased to the end of the hall. As soon as the creature was about to attack him, it suddenly disappeared. Helen ran to Alex and asked him if he was okay or if he was hurt anywhere and told him that the scientist successfully amended the changes. He was in jail again as she called the police. Everything was fine after it; the girl came back too. The whole school praised Nancy and her friends for their good deeds.
author: Mannat Chugh

title: Poacher Friends
text: Once there was a poacher named Gabriel living between a city and a jungle. He hunted animals in the jungle and sold them in the city. He gained huge profit by hunting and selling animals. Like every day, he was hunting animals. Another poacher was hunting animals in the same jungle. Accidently, Gabriel shot that poacher. When he came to pick the animal he killed, he saw the poacher fainted and lying on the grass. A wolf was running towards them swiftly. ‘No time to waste,’ Gabriel said. He dropped the animal he killed, picked up the poacher and ran swiftly and hid behind a tree. The hungry wolf cannot figure out where they were and he went back sadly. Gabriel went to home quickly, started his car and went to the hospital in the city. It is very hard to save him because the bullet has gone through his stomach. But we will try our best, the doctor said. How much will the operation cost, said Gabriel. 2 lakh rupees, said the doctor. Please save him, I will arrange for the money, Gabriel said in a painful voice. We can save him, doctors said in a cheerful voice. Thank God, said Gabriel. When Gabriel went to check him, he asked, what is your name, tough guy. Gabriel replied, my name is Gabriel but what is yours. He said, my name is Willy but how did I come here? Gabriel told him the whole incident and said, I’m really sorry. I did this by mistake and I have also paid for it. Will you be my friend, Willy? Willy and Gabriel became friends and they hunted and sold the dead animals together. Their friendship was growing stronger day by day. One day they were hunting and Willy saw a bird holding a paper. He said, Gabriel, the one who shoots the bird gets the item it is holding. Ok Willy, said Gabriel. He missed some of his shots and the bullets in his revolver ended. Willy killed the bird and after finding a little he could find that piece of paper. What is written inside? Asked Gabriel. Let me check, Willy answered. There was half of a map drawn on the paper. Gabriel thought a little and said, I think I have the second half of this map. Now this was the problem that who will get the map and the treasure. Willy said, I have a challenge for you. If you could find the treasure and return to home in less than 12 hours, you can keep it, but if you cannot the treasure would be mine. Challenge accepted, said Gabriel. He went home took the second half of the map and started his journey. He easily got to the place where the treasure was but had trouble finding the treasure. So, let’s check what’s inside, said Gabriel. There was a big gun and a guide of how to use it. It was written that it could pierce through anything. Now that is a big and interesting one, said Gabriel. He took it and went home in under 12 hours. You are fast. But what is inside, said Willy. You see yourself, replied Gabriel. Willy was surprised to see a huge gun. He was expecting something like gold coins or lots of cash. Now I will hunt with this gun, said Gabriel. He started to gain more profit as he killed every single animal he saw very easily. Does it have unlimited bullets? Willy asked. Yes, it does, answered Gabriel. They were hunting normally one day but something very sad and life changing happened. A tiger was coming towards Willy and Gabriel. Gabriel was firing continuously at the tiger through a tree. The tiger died but there were a number of holes on the lower part of tree that it got disbalanced and fell on Willy and he died. What I had done? Killed my best friend, said Gabriel in a questionable voice. He was so angry that he started to kill animals. But then he realized that futility to kill animals. When I was killing them, I accidently killed my best friend. This was the message of God to Gabriel that killing animals would always result in a big loss. From then on, he left poaching and started to conserve animals. He opened a wildlife sanctuary named after his best friend Willy and he started to take care of animals there. He had become a good person and realized his mistake.
author: Priyanshu Bansal

title: Minho's Wonderful Day
text: It was December 29. Everything was going well. But that day would be Minho's happiest day. Mom: Minho, why haven't you woken up? It's Monday today. Won't you go to school? Minho: Okay, I'll wake up. Would you please make my breakfast? You're the best mom ever! Mom: Breakfast is ready! Go wash up then let's eat together. Minho: All right. After breakfast, Minho grabbed his bag. Minho was ready to go to school. Mom: You still have time, right? You won't be late, will you? Minho: Yeah. It only takes ten minutes from home to school by bus. It's okay. I'm leaving now. Bye! Minho was waiting for the bus at the bus stop. The bus that day came late, and it made Minho worried. Thank God, he wasn't late to school. Since the winter break started the next day, all the students were excited. At break time, Minho and his bestfriend, Jihoon, talked to each other. Jihoon: Hey, Minho, what are you going to do in winter break? It's three days! My dad and I are going to go skiing. Minho: Oh, it must be fun. I don't know yet. My mom hasn't said anything about it. Jihoon: Why? It's weird. Normally people have plan it a month before. Why hasn't your mom planned it? Minho: Really? Jihoon: You failed the test the other time, that's why your mom gets angry, so.... Minho: Yeah, it could be so. I don't know. The school was over. All students came out with a smile on their faces. They had been waiting for this holiday. Jihoon: Bye, Minho! See you in three days! Minho: Bye, Jihoon. Mom! Why are you here? Mom: Quickly get in the car! We can't park here for so long. Mom: Son, you did a good job today. Minho: Why so sudden, Mom? Did I do anything wrong? Mom: No, my son is the best. Minho: Mom, why are you driving this way? This is not the way home. Mom: Yes, we're not going home. We're going to the airport. Minho: What? Airport? Mom: Yes. We're traveling to Jeju Island. Minho and his mom were in the car. Minho: This is cool! Mom: Is there anything you want to do? Minho: I want to eat yummy food and see beautiful sceneries. I also want to see the ocean. Mom: All right. We'll do it all. Minho: Mom, you're not kidding, are you? Mom: I'm serious. Your dad is now waiting at the airport. He has bought us tickets. I have searched for a hotel from which we can see the ocean and also near the restaurant. Minho: I'm so excited now. Why didn't you tell me before? Mom: This is a surprise trip. How do you feel? Minho: I feel so happy. The weather was really nice that day. Going to Jeju will be an exciting trip. About Me Hello, my name in Sojemun from China. My hobbies are listening to Korean songs and watching Korean entertainment show. I want to travel to Korea and watch Korean shows that's why I study Korean in UW. Right now, my Korean language skill isn't fluent yet, but I will study hard in the future. I'm a fan of boy group Winner, that's why I named the main character Minho. This was my first time writing a book in Korean. Thank you for reading my book.
author: Nisa Kh
illustrator: 211 Studio; Angie & Upesh; Brad Cuzen; Deepa Balsavar; Dr. Sushma  Singh; Ekta Bharti; Fahad Faizal; George Supreeth; Jiwen Xiao; Lindy  Pelzl; Linh Chi; Padmanabh; Rijuta Ghate; Ruchi Shah; Students of  Himalayan Public School; Tanvi Bhat

title: The Dream
text: Memorial Trust Ram was a school child who wanted to become a soldier. He was very patriotic. His love to his country was endless. He was good at studies but still he didn't showed well in physical education. But it didn't go well. All just fell down one day in front of him. He got epilepsy. A disorder in which nerve cell activity in the brain is disturbed, causing seizures. The Doctor said he'll be Okay. But still he had seizures, he went hospitals to hospitals with his parents. Nothing improved. He was 18 when he went to an army selection camp. He was happy, but his dream flew away. He got seizure in the camp and he was rejected to join the army as he was physically unfit. Since his childhood, he was good at right decision making. He was thinking and thinking. A flash of hope came to him known as "COMPUTER". Since childhood he was good at hacking but he did it ethically. He knew the ethics of a hacker. After requesting with his family, he went to IIT Madras. He performed well there. He got his graduation there and he learned many branches of computer for example CEH(Complete Ethical Hacking). He was deciding what to do. A thought came to him ' Indian Army Corps of Signals'. He was very interested to play with the codes. If he couldn't secure his country in physical aspect he could surely Secure his country in the aspect of technology. He passes the Exam easily. He joins the Department and starts his life. Within a few days he started becoming famous in his department due to his knowledge in computer and his intelligence. He had secured a lot of Army's data and other Army equipment. Soon people started suggesting him for many Technical issues for the Army. During his Service life He got a friend who was also a professional ethical hacker like him. His name was Gyan. He became older and older. His knowledge about computer increased. He got his retirement from the Service. But the Army contacted him for various purposes because that much was his skill on Computer. At Last He Decided to set up a company for security services mainly for the Army and he did it with his friends. Now Ram is the Head of ' Bharat Institution of Cyber Security'. Now he is a millionaire who lives a simple and successful life and donates all his wealth.
author: SACHIN B PILLAI
illustrator: Abhimanyu Ghimiray; Delwyn Remedios; Joanna  Mendes; Krupa Thakur-Patil; Maya  Ramaswamy; Rai; Rohit Kelkar; Sachin Pandit; Sheshadri Mokshagundam; Sourav Sarkar; Vidyun Sabhaney; Visvesvaraya National Memorial Trust; Wesley   van Eeden

title: The Turtel and The Rabite
text: The turtul and the rabit. the turtel is very slow in all the works that he do and the rabit was very fast. one rabit ask to turtel that you will do a race with me and turtel say yes. the race was started rabit was fast he run fast when he realise i am vary fast he stop and sleep but turtel was walking slowly and he reached the finish line and won where the rabit was sleeping.
author: Tanisha Chadha

title: A FAMILY'S FOOD ANGEL
text: "Kindness is the seed of the most delicious fruit!" We make a living by what we get, but we make a life by what we give. Dear God, please bless Mr. X with abundance of happiness and success who helped my best friend in her tough times. While going through a divorce, my friend, Carolina's mother fretted over her new worries: no income, the same bills and no way to afford money. Her mother was continuously going to give job interviews at different companies. She was well-educated and scored a good percentage in her post graduation but due to lack of experience nobody was offering her a job. Carolina's was in his high school and could not drop his studies. They were helpless. It was around this time that they started finding boxes of food outside their door every morning. This went on for months, until aunt was unable to land a job.. A month ago, my friend's mother was crying while reading a letter and my friend's grandfather was standing somewhere behind the woods and smiling. Carolina never found out who it was who left the groceries for them, but Mr.X really saved their lives. It seems like her mother is hiding the truth from her. What do you think who was that person? Maybe an angel from God or the kindest man. Kindness is a virtue that is rarely found these days. People these days are so busy gratifying their own needs and desires that they overlook that of the others. The person was really Carolina and her family's food angel. Some people are created rich and others are poor but ones who have enough should give a helping hand to those in need and show an act of kindness as well as happiness. Everyone should be caring and empathetic for all around them. You don't need to be a millionaire to offer help and be nice to people around you. You just need to have a good heart. Being kind and compassionate towards others brings immense joy. Kindness gets us closer to God and renders inner peace. No act of kindness even the smallest one goes unnoticed. God is watching us all the times and he is known for being fair in his ways. People who indulge in charity work and help others with various big and small tasks are happier than those who work only for themselves. Showering kindness on those around us should be the ultimate goal of all of us. There are some examples of how you can spread happiness like the one of Mr. X. People must be kind to those around them and see how things change for good. Being kind to others, helping them and spreading smiles does not only does good to the recipients but also offers a deep sense of satisfaction to the one who indulges in the act. Do you know who is Mr. X? Just think and get the answer yourself. Being kind to others we not only help them but feel good at a deeper level. Let me tell you that a friend in need is a friend indeed. Consider everybody as your friend and help them. Kindness is the quality of being polite and considerate towards others. It is a quality that not everybody possesses. Very few in this world are blessed with this quality. Being kind to others is out of question for most. "A generous heart, kind speech and a life of service are the things that renew humanity."
author: DISHA DISHA
illustrator: Jesse  Breytenbach; Niloufer Wadia; Nyambura Kariuki; Rijuta Ghate; Siddhi   Vartak

title: Sun Mother
text: In the months of Mangshir and Poush, dark clouds cover the skies. The cold winter is here. Two sisters, Dolmo and Palmo, shiver from the cold. But the sun does not show. *Mangshir and Poush are the names of months on the Nepali calendar. Shine on, oh Sun Mother. Your baby cow is sick in the cold. Shine on, oh Sun Mother. Your calf trembles in the cold. Shine on, oh Sun Mother. Your kid trembles in the cold. Shine on, oh Sun Mother. Your puppies whine in the cold. Shine on, oh Sun Mother. Your chicks wail for some warmth. Shine on, oh Sun Mother. Your Dolmo and Palmo are in danger in this cold. Oh look! Sun Mother listens to us. She shines for us. She pushes away the dark clouds. Sun Mother is a song sung by the children of the Tamang community in winter. The lyrics are inspired from the original song but written in a new form as a nursery rhyme. The sun is referred as a mother who gives warmth and protects all living beings
author: Sancha  Kumari Lama Tamang

title: Misunderstandings
text: There is a rumor spreading in this town. It is said that if you go to the woods at exactly 12:00 p.m. and shout 'Witch of the woods in the middle of the night, You may come to haunt as the time is right', You'll hear a loud shriek from the woods. This is your sign to run away, she heard you. But has anyone ever thought of her feelings? Is it really a shriek or just a cry for help to be normal? This is the story of Ginny a girl with Supernatural Powers. When she was born, she was considered as a bad omen for her Village. She could control objects with her mind, boil water by touching it. It was true. Ginny was no ordinary Girl. The village children were strictly told not to play with her. Why can't I be normal? She would think every day her parents built a small Hut in the middle of the woods. So that way their child would get a better upbringing. She was home schooled by a brilliant mother and her father cooked the most delicious meals. Life was good for Ginny. She finally felt like she belonged. Ginny was 12 when it happened. Just 12. It was the middle of the night. She woke up to small spots of orange and red dancing in the distance, coming closer. Fire! 'Drive that, witch out,' the townspeople chanted. Ginny's parents ran out and tried to talk to them. 'No', screamed Ginny as the crowd walked back towards their town. GinnyJ ran out of her home to where she was met by her mother. Lying down, her breathing, slowing down. Mom, whimpers, Ginny. Her mom looked at Ginny. And smiled. Ginny held her mother's hand. It slowly slipped out as a mother took her last breath. She said 'I love you Ginny'. Tears gushed down, Ginny's face. She scanned around for her dad, but he had been taken. It had been four years since this happened in the town. A fiesty young girl; Rosie had been invited to a sleepover by her good friend Rue along with two others. The evening was spent gossiping watching movies, and baking cakes. Finally at around 11 p.m. Rosie suggested they give dares. The dares started normally, like, do a chicken dance or become a mime for one minute. Finally, it was Rosie's turn. Rue turned to her mysteriously and said, I dare you to call The Witch of the woods. Everyone suddenly became silent. The Witch of the woods asked Rosie, taken aback. By the day, if you don't want to said, Rue. It was cut off by Anne. It's not called a dare for nothing. She snapped. Rue fell silent. Rosie agreed and they jumped out of the window. She lived on the ground floor. Not like they were Apartments. The two girls ran deep into the woods and looked at Rosie. Rosie screamed 'Witch of the woods. It's the middle of the night come out to haunt as the time is, right'. Rosie looked around. Anne abandoned her. She heard the shriek. It sent chills down her spine, but it wasn't much of a shriek more like a wail. Rosie made her way slowly through the dense forest. She found a girl, her age weeping on the ground. Ginny saw her, Go away. You'll get hurt', Ginny told her. Rosie sat next to her. So you are the witch? Ginny wept harder, Rosie felt bad. The next morning, Rosie visited Ginny. This time, Ginny wore a huge grin and hugged her. That night they talked and talked and talked and over time, they grew close. They were just like sisters Rosie showed the town heads, that Ginny was normal. She could help fix the town with her powers Ginny soon moved in with Rosie's family. She had been adopted by them. It was evening. Ginny was lying down on the roof. Watching the Stars, Rosie came up, her hands, filled with snacks. She lay down next to her and there was a comfortable silence. Not awkward. Both were lost in your thoughts, Rosie glanced at her sister. She thought perhaps this was all just a misunderstanding.
author: Aayushi Auti

title: How Do You Sleep?
text: How do you sleep, bird? I fly in my sleep. How do you sleep, bat? I sleep upside down. How do you sleep, bullfrog? I rest on my side. How do you sleep, octopus? I change colour in my dreams. How do you sleep, duck? We take turns to guard each other. How do you sleep, baby owl? I sleep on my face. How do you sleep, otter? We sleep holding hands. How do you sleep, walrus? I sleep on the land and under the water. How do you sleep, giraffe? We sleep on each other. How do you sleep, meerkat? We sleep in a heap. How do you sleep, Pula? Goodnight! Sleep tight. How do you sleep, giraffe? We sleep on each other.
author: Diane  Awerbuck

title: THE BAD BOY
text: A boy named Rakesh. He was a bad boy. He treats his friends at school. Teachers of school punish him but he is always treating his friends. One day, he went to the beach. When he reach, he started to play with sand and ball. He make houses from sand. Suddenly, he find a lamp. When he rub the lamp, a big Jin came out. He saw the Rakesh and asking them,"What's your three wishes"? Rakesh was shocked and scared but he said to the Jin, I want a bicycle. Jin said," Ok". He made a pinch and a bicycle has come. Rakesh was happy but he was also in worry. He wanted to hide the bicycle, so, he said to the Jin," I want to hide the bicycle." The Jin hide the bicycle. In the night, he satyed in the 5 star hotel. Next morning, he again went in the 5 star hotel. Next morning, he again went to the beach. He picked the lamp and he again rub the lamp. The big Jin came out from the lamp and Rakesh said," Today, I went to eat a pizza. The Jin made a pinch and a tasty and yummy pizza came out. Few hours later he wanted to a remote control car. The Jin made a pinch and a remote control came out. Rakesh became greedy. Next morning, he said to the Jin," Please Jin, gave me some wishes more". Jin said"No I don't have any wishes." Rakesh said," Please Jin, Please my mother was sick and my father was poor". Jin thought and said, "Ok". Rakesh gave money. Jin gave him money but Rakesh say False. Jin thought first time, I saw his mother was sick and father was poor. In the night, he find where Rakesh live. He find a 5 star hotel and he saw a window when he went to in that room, he saw Rakesh. He was shocked and he went to the lamp. Next morning, Rakesh wake up and he suddenly saw the Jin. The Jin said," You said false, that 's why I disappear. Rakesh was starting. Moral:- Greedy is curse.
author: KV BSF

title: The attitude of gratitude
text: Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Evelyn. She had dreams of being rich and always envied people with beautiful expensive, things like phones, bags, dresses, jewelry and million dollar luxury homes. She was raised in a small little home with parents who couldn't afford these luxuries Evelyn dreamed of. She would often get mad at her parents. When they refused to buy her this, entire she would lock herself in her room for hours and spent her time crying hating her parents and wishing for new ones. Her parents would be heartbroken and worried at her behavior towards them. When it was Evelyn's 13th birthday, she had high hopes for her parents to get an Exquisite two thousand dollar dress that she had been drooling over when she had seen it in the store. When she realized her parents had gotten her a completely different dress, she lost it. She screamed at her parents, bawled her eyes out and went completely hysterical. She took a pair of scissors and cut holes in the dress out of anger. Her poor parents were so shocked at her behavior; they didn't know what to do. Evelyn ran to her room without even eating a lovely cake that she got. At night when everyone was asleep, she quietly packed her bags and ran away from her home. She stayed at the hotel for a night. She left first thing in the morning. She was walking down the road when she stopped short. She was absolutely starving. She looked around for any shops or restaurants, but none were in sight. She noticed two people near an old abandoned shop. It was a middle-aged, man and a girl who looked Evelyn's Age. The man noticed Evelyn and invited her over. He saw that she looked really hungry and gave her some bread. Evelyn asked who they were and found out that the man was Kevin and the girl's name was Aria. Evans daughter, they both were homeless, Kevin had lost his job six months ago, due to false accusations and Arias mother had died due to cancer. It was Area’s birthday today, and her dad had gotten her a dress that looked way worse than Evelyn’s dress. Evelyn was shocked to see that Area was so ecstatic and joyous because she had expected her to be sad and angry. She asked her why she was happy with the dress that looked like that. Aria just stared with a confused expression on her face. But then replied, “I am grateful for things I get because I know my parents work hard to get them for me. ‘Evelyn always be grateful, not hateful”. After hearing this, Evelyn felt emotionally touched. She then remembered how she had behaved with her parents the other day. She told Aria and Kevin ‘thanks for all this but I have to go now. Bye’. She ran home and apologized for everything she had done the previous day. She even picked up the torn dress from yesterday, and looked at it with sad eyes. She got out her sewing kit and sewed the holes, she had cut. She then wore the dress and her parents faces lit up at how pretty she looked. She picked up a brand new flower necklace she had never worn and her untouched birthday cake, and changed the icing to happy birthday Aria. Then she asked the parents to drive her to the place where Aria and her dad stayed. The three drove to the same place where Evelyn came earlier and gave Aria, a big surprise. She was so confused at what was happening, but when she saw the key and everyone's happy cheerful faces, she looked delighted. Evelyn carefully, put the necklace on Area’s neck and she loved it. They all cut the Cake and sang Happy Birthday and had a great time Evelyn's parents also thanked, Aria and her dad for taking good care of Evelyn and teaching her an example of being grateful.
author: Jaagravi Bhatia

title: The Big Mess
text: Urmu and Urgen are playing outside. "Oh no, it's raining!" "Oh no, it's raining!" "Let's go inside." "Hey, look at all that marcha. * " * Marcha is yeast. One by one, Urmu and Urgen start throwing marcha into the pond. "Oh no, I can see Aapa Aama." "Let's go hide." "What is all this mess?" "Urmu! Urgen! Is that marcha in the water?" They feel really, really bad. "Do you know that marcha is very useful to us? Remember when our pet goat had blisters all over her face, we used marcha to make her feel better." "Aama, we will help you make new marcha." More About Marcha Marcha is yeast. In the Tamang community, marcha is prepared by mixing mugwort and Brahmachi, a local herb, with rice and millet flour. Marcha saves the food from rotting. It is also used as a medicine.
author: सिर्जना  गोले तामाङ

title: The Thirsty Cow And The Greedy Daughter
text: The Thirsty Cow And The Greedy Daughter By-Anya Saini (IX) Once upon a time, in a small town lived a widow with her two daughters. Her elder daughter Meera was very kind and often used to help her mother. But her younger daughter Radha was very lazy and always looked for excuses. They had their two cows and a small piece of land as their only earning sources. The widow loved her cows; as it was the only thing left with her that was given by her husband. One day, it was boiling hot outside. The widow noticed that her cows were thirsty. So she asked both of her daughters to take the cows to the lake to quench their thirst. Meera agreed within no time, but Radha started making excuses. So to make her younger daughter agree to go to the lake, she declared, “Whoever will come first, I will reward her with a cold glass of lemonade”. Radha agreed. They both went on the way to the lake along with their cows. Radha kept on thinking about the cold lemonade and how she could return home earlier. Suddenly a thought crossed her mind. “What if I return home from half way”! But what about my sister, she will definitely tell mother about it,” she thought. After walking a while, she thought of a plan. She told her sister to take a different path and see who would reach home first. The naive elder daughter got trapped in her plan and agreed to her challenge. Just after they changed their ways; the younger daughter returned from half way. Meera reached the lake and found that nobody was there. “Sister must be on her way back home already," she thought and started on the way back home after her cow had drunk enough water. To her surprise, Radha had reached home before her. "See your younger sister! She is so caring. The cow has drunk water and is no longer thirsty." The widow looked admiringly at Radha. The widow tied the thirsty cow in the shade and went inside and awarded Radha with the lemonade. The greedy daughter finally got her share! The widow gave her elder daughter only cold water Poor thirsty cow! It somehow managed to survive the evening but in the middle of the night, finally died of thirst. The next morning the widow woke and was shocked to see the cow dead. "Radha," she shouted, "come outside immediately and see what you have done to the cow." "Oh, my beloved cow! Curse to you!" Radha came rushing towards the shed and was also shocked to see the cow dead." "What would happen if she told the truth to her mother?" “Mother, the cow did drink enough water,” she lied again. Her mother, whose sorrow was slowly turning into anger, shouted on Radha furiously. “I don't want to hear anything! You just leave the house right now,” the widow said. Radha was shocked by her mother’s behaviour. She tried to cook up another story, but mother did not budge! She didn't know where to go. She was walking around the village. She noticed some workers working in the fields and a man was watching them. The man appeared to be a monk. Radha just stood there and watched them working from a distance. After a while, Radha realised that she was hungry. She went to the monk and asked him for food. "I am going to the village to get food for you, till then you work in the field with other workers”. Radha agreed. After about one hour, workers started to leave. And now Radha was alone but she still kept on working, waiting for the monk to come. The Sun shone bright. But the man didn't come. Radha was very hungry and thirsty too, because she hadn't eaten anything since the morning. She was very tired too. She decided to lie down on the ground under the shade of a tree. Her body was getting tired and a little weak from hunger and thirst. Radha thought of the cow, as she was resting under the tree. There was a criss-cross in her mind. A tinge of regret was visible in her eyes. She was thirsty too! She felt as if she would die, when the monk appeared. He had brought her some food and water! “My child, come eat some food, you will feel better,” the wise monk said. Radha, with great difficulty, sat down and started to eat. While she was eating, the monk asked, "My child, you look a little troubled”. Radha kept quiet. Just then the monk said, "Don't be afraid, you can tell me. Maybe I can help you in some way”. Radha told everything to the monk. Tears started to fall out of her eyes. “My child, what you did was wrong, but I think you've learnt your lesson." He continued. “You should go back and tell your mother the truth, I am sure that she will understand you”. But before leaving, the monk told her one more thing. He told her to always remember one thing- Whatever you do or say, will gradually come back to you - either it’s good or bad”. At home, the widow also realised what she said to Radha was not right, and what she did was all because of her anger. She was thinking where Radha could have been. There was a knock at the door. She rushed to open it to find Radha in front of her. She cried to see her condition. The poor mother! She had already calmed down, let her in. Radha told every bit of the truth. She had learned her lesson! Her mother kept quiet for sometime, but then forgave her. She hugged her and warned her not to do it again. Radha promised her mother that she would not do it again. The mother and her two daughters hugged each other tightly. All eyes were tearful!
author: Fallen Star

title: A Man of Few Words
text: This is a story of when Thomas Edison hadn’t graced the world with his revolutionary lightbulbs. During this period the world woke up with the sun's rays and slept when the rays left. At the time the rate of crime was elevating with every passing day, and the number of people left to fight against it was decreasing. They were either bribed, murdered, or left the city for mysterious reasons. And in this crime-infested city of Karampur, our story begins. In Karampur, there lived a boy named Ramanujan. He was a shy boy, and his overbearing parents made matters worse. They always found fault in everything he did, and whenever he tried to uphold himself, they used to shut him up by calling him an uncultured boy. One incident that he remembered vividly was the time when he had wanted an RC Car. His conversation with his parents had gone something like this “Mom….Dad?” “Yes?” “Can I…get an RC Car for my birthday?” “Why are you so greedy? Don’t you already have a car?” “No Mom… that car is two years old. One of the tires broke off.” “So you can’t even take care of your things? How many times have you been told to keep your toys in good condition?" “I’m sorry Dad.” “Don’t say ‘I’m sorry,’ say ‘I am sorry.’ Do you understand?” “Yes, Dad.” “And because of your carelessness, you are not getting a gift this year.” “But..but...I… the car, it -” “Don’t speak back to your mother like that! Have you forgotten your manners too?” “Sorry, Dad. Sorry, Mom. Please excuse me. ” “You are excused.” Conversations like this made him almost mute, and he spoke only when necessary. The silver lining of his life was his 6-year-old sister - Maya - who always used to brighten his day. One day, after getting chastised by his parents, he went to his room and started crying. The door opened, and he heard Maya’s voice, “Bhaiya. Please stop crying.” “You do not…know how much…it hurts.” “You are right. I don’t know. But I do know that you don’t like crying either." “Fine. I will stop crying.” “By the way, I got chocolate. Want some?” “Yes, please.” In his high school - a shabby building with a crumbling roof - everybody used to make him the scapegoat because of his mute nature. When the teachers would ask him questions about the incident he was involved in, he wouldn’t say anything. Even though the teachers knew that he was innocent, they would have to punish him because he couldn’t say anything in his defence. The bullies used to bully him because they knew that even if they really hurt him, he wouldn't speak a single word. Even after everything, he couldn’t make himself speak. Then, one day the unthinkable occurred. Maya, his funny, sweet, compassionate sister was murdered. She was coming home from school, and for some random reason, she was coming alone. A few members of a local gang started to follow her and started catcalling her. She ignored them and started sprinting. This gesture offended them, and the leader took out his pocket knife. I’ll spare the details of what happened next. The reason why I know this is because Ramanujan was hiding behind a parked car, and had just witnessed the murder of his beloved sister. He hadn't been able to utter a single word to save Maya. While his parents wept, he internally screamed. Screaming at his helplessness, the unfair city, the stupid world. This helplessness and anger propelled him to work on his shyness and become a defender of the helpless. His parents were against his decision and wanted to discipline him, but for once he was ready to be the uncultured boy who went against his parent’s judgments. He started his transformation. At first, it was extremely hard for him to get out of his comfort bubble, and start conversations with others. People used to stare dumbfounded at him when he used to speak full sentences. But, after a short period, people around him accepted the fact that he too could speak full sentences, and he was a voice that would be heard against crime. He graduated his 11th standard with decent grades, but he vowed that he would be at the top of the class when he would graduate the next year. And he was true to his words. Over the next year, he worked honed his speaking skills and decided that he would become a prosecution lawyer. He graduated from his school with flying colours in Political Science, History, Economics, English, Legal Language and Law of Contract. Due to his exceptional grades, he received a scholarship to the top law school in the country - Stardom College of Law. Once arriving at the College, there was no stopping him. On average, it took a person seven years to complete law school, but it took him only six. In no time, he was a Prosecutor and had gotten a well-paying job in the nearby town of Govindnagar. After fighting a few cases, he had become a popular figure in the city, and was well respected. But even after the respect and the fame he couldn’t forget his sister’s murder and was always looking for opportunities to go back to his hometown. One fine holiday, he decided that he would visit Karampur. He left bright and early and reached there by quarter to nine in the morning. As soon as he got into the city limits, the change started to appear. He saw boarded up windows, overturned trash cans, and other horrid scenes he wished he hadn't seen. He decided to pay his parents a visit. When he knocked on their door, he was shocked to see that the door was in such a bad condition, that it was about to fall off! His Dad opened the door, and looked at him in disgust. He hadn't seen his son since he had graduated from college. he still felt that Ramanujan had done an uncultured thing by becoming a lawyer. "What do you want?" he asked in a cold voice. "I want to do justice to Maya." was Ramanujan's reply. That was all it took to break the public facade that his father had made to hide the internal despair. He started sobbing, and went inside. Ramanujan, taking this as an invitation to come in, proceeded in the house. Because his sister's murder was still fresh in his mind, he couldn't help but cry alongside his Dad. Hearing them cry, his Mom came, and seeing them cry made her tear up too. She cried with them, and this was their family reunion. He then remembered his reason for going there in the first place and talked to his parents about Maya's murder. After collecting some information about Maya's murderers', he bid them farewell and started for his house in Govindnagar. Once he reached, he began making a case file against the gang that had murdered his little sister. Unsurprisingly, it wasn't very hard to find information about them. He searched the state crime records, talked to the locals of Karampur, and talked to some of the victims. In a few months, he had the case file ready, and so he went to the court, and filed a case against that gang. The gang was called to the court, and upon seeing the man who had executed the killing shot, Ramanujan went numb. His old shyness came back and he had to force himself to stand up and speak. When he had to charge the defendant with questions, he framed the questions in a way that he had to use the least words required. Talking to the judge became a pain, because he was required to speak in full sentences. At one point during the duration of the case, he realised that all of his practice, his effort, and most importantly, his sister's death would go in vain if he didn't win this case. This thought gave him the warmth that he needed to push away the numbness. He started speaking freely and confidently, and soon he had proven to the judge that the gang members were indeed guilty. As the judge gave them a sentence of ten years in jail, he felt peaceful for the first time since his sister's death.
author: Aaditya Sarkar
illustrator: Adonay Gebru; Annika  Brandow; Aratrika Choudhury; Jesse  Breytenbach; Rae  Zachariah; Sanjay Sarkar; Subinita Deshaprabhu; Sunaina  Coelho; Swathi Sambasivam; Tapas Guha; Therson  Boadu; Wiehan de Jager

title: Olivia's Selfishness
text: There was a girl named Olivia. She had some good friends to cherish always. One day, her friends Daniel, Maria, Ellie, they all made a plan to go for a trip in their coming holidays. Everyone was so excited that they started discussing about the places they could visit. All of a sudden, Olivia thought of a plan to go to a forest for adventure. She knew that it was very dangerous to visit there. Hesitatingly, She informed about her idea to her friends. At first, her friends rejected this idea. Olivia said, "Why don't you want to enjoy it?” “There are lots of chances of losing our lives there," Ellie browed. “Just think positive and try something new. Boost up yourself guys," she argued. Olivia started convincing her friends. Later, her friends agreed undoubtedly, without knowing the consequences. After some days, their holidays commenced and they all were ready to go. They took permission of their parents too. Unwillingly, they gave permission on the condition that they will not go deep into the forest. It was the plan to go in the morning, but as it had been raining since morning, they thought it would be better to start in the evening. They picked up their cycles to ride to the area nearby. It was getting dark too. “Can we cancel our plan?” Maria suggested. “No way!” screamed Olivia. She started laughing at her cowardice. Maria's heart was pounding with fear. She remembered her night hallucinations and her bedtime stories told by her uncle about ghosts living in forests. When they reached the forest, she did not even get to know. Olivia was going faster than others in excitement. After walking some distance, Olivia looked back and found that her friends were not there. She thought that they would not be far. She was now lost in this dense forest! On the other hand her friends also realised that Olivia was not with them. They thought that she must be playing pranks. They started finding her thinking that she must be playing hide and seek. Olivia in search of her friends was going deep into the forest. Now Olivia was also scared of the dark. Suddenly, she heard a hissing sound. She looked back, and could make out a snake staring at her. The view was so terrible. She was dumbstruck. The chivalric snake was looking straight into her eyes. As it creeped nearer to her, Olivia suddenly shouted 'HELP ME'. “It must be Olivia," said Ellie frantically. They all moved in the direction from where the voice was coming. Maria was very worried about Olivia. After a distance, she was discovered. What they saw shocked them. They found her fainted over there. “Olivia, get up," Maria screamed. They tried to bring her into senses, but in vain. They quickly decided to rush to the roadside to take Olivia to a nearby hospital. “Taxi,Taxi," shouted Daniel. It was almost dark. At last a taxi stopped. The taxi driver asked, “How can I help you?" They asked him to drop them to the nearest hospital. Now everyone was trembling with fear. Ellie sped to call the doctor. Till the doctor came, Maria was rubbing Olivia's hands.When the doctor came, he examined Olivia. “She has got a panic attack". What did you tell her? What happened?” the doctor enquired. Now How could they tell because they also didn't know themselves. He said, “No worries. She will be fine soon. I have given her an injection.” Everyone was praying for Olivia’s recovery. What actually could have happened? All minds were restless. They feared about what to tell their parents about this incident. After some time, Olivia trembled. She still was under the effect of injection. “Olivia, are you okay? How are you feeling now?” Maria asked. Olivia could say nothing. Her friends asked her what had happened to her in the forest. “You know, I could not see you in that condition. It was as if my heart had stopped working. What if something happens to you, huh?
