title: An Undiscovered Secret
text: Hi, I’m Emma, an ordinary high school girl living in a not-so-ordinary world. My world is different from any of yours but I’m pretty sure I’m not that different. Of course, I live in the same universe as you but my world is completely different from yours. Now you must be wondering what I’m talking about, and I would tell you but I gotta rush for school. It starts in 10 mins. She hurriedly dragged herself into her bathroom and stood in this really weird area enclosed with dark marble on all sides. All of a sudden, her teeth were sparkling white, her fuzzy dry hair were now silky and straight and her baggy night clothes were now switched to her usual white t-shirt, light blue jacket and black pants and she looked fresh and ready to go to Montero High, her high school. She walked out to her room, picked up her bag and entered this huge capsule like structure. A lightning like spark was released by the capsule, a gust of wind speeded by and suddenly she just....disappeared I reached school on time, FINALLY, that was a task. At least I have 5 minutes before class starts to tell you how it works. Anyways, like I was telling you! You must be really confused right now, I'm sure but don't worry I'll explain everything to you. This is how it works here in Fnatic. It’s very different here from your life. Fnatic is the galaxy I live in and that was a transmitter. It’s like teleportation but it works on the principle of quantum physics or something. I don't know, I don’t really understood all this science stuff it's actually a bit much for me to handle even living here so I can't imagine how it is for you. Oh, the bell just rung so I guess I'll have to tell you the rest later. She went to her class and sat at her usual place, the 2 nd row from the right and the 2 nd last bench. Instead of a book she took out this tablet like device out from her bag. This wasn’t any ordinary iPad or Kindle; it opened any book she wanted. As she read a page, it flipped on its own. Woah! The e-books tracked the user’s eyes and switched the page on its own………how cool was that?! She decided to check out the newspaper…...well, it wasn’t really on paper but you get the point. It was called “Fnatic Happenings”. She read the first headline and sighed as if she was annoyed for some reason. It said, “Alpha Dimension situation does not get better!” Oh, yea did I tell you this is not the only dimension in our galaxy? We have 12 dimensions in our galaxies, they’re like alternate realities so a person can visit different dimensions at the same time. Like I said, I don’t really get how all this science stuff works. All of a sudden at the front of the class a hologram like bubble appeared and an old aged man wearing a brown coat with a subtle yet significant white moustache and a weirdly funny hairstyle appeared. The class was now as silent as death. It seemed as though he was their teacher. They all stood up in a robotic manner in synchronization and bowed down at an angle of 45 degrees addressing him as ‘Haku’. This is our professor, he’s also a Haku. A Haku is a protector of the thread. The cross-reality thread connects the dimensions and maintains their balance. If the thread is fiddled with, the realities will overlap. All the dimensions will collapse and Fnatic will forever end. It'll be worse than doomsday. “Good morning class!” he addressed them in his deep and sort of calming voice. The class continued like any ordinary one would. It was time for the morning addressing. A holographic screen appeared and floated at the centre of the class. A video played on the hologram and flew back to where it came from or, disappeared into thin air. After this finished the Haku started teaching. He taught them defence against undesired forces. Suddenly, an alien like creature entered the room. It looked more human than alien though, not really sure what he was. This is a crocogon, it’s like a training dummy we use to learn different subjects practically. We aren’t really allowed to fight against them until the end of the academic session but it’s really fun to see how different concepts work in real life applied by our professors. Beware, they can get pretty brutal at times! Exactly like you'd picture an alien - dark green, slimy and almost gross, it had long thin legs with a lean body that looked like it was made of wood pulp and a giant face that looked extremely disfigured and disturbing to even look at. Suddenly, it pounced on top of the table of the child sitting on the front seat. It looked like it was gazing at the child's eyes and trying to hypnotise it. Just as the child started lifting from her seat and her eyes started to merge in with the disfigured face appearing like a haze that somehow still looked disgusting, the Haku chuckled lightly, closed his eyes and took a deep breath......nothing Then suddenly, as he looked like he was in a position to meditate, the creature flew like it had just been pinned from the opposite side and just disappeared with force. "Greta, visit the medical room immediately!" commanded the Haku. Wow, that was one of the weirder lessons. I think that was more intense than it should've been. Greta did not look okay. "Alright class, I think some work just came up. Today's lesson was enough for you all anyways. Your task is to research on the hypnotical powers possessed by creatures in the modern world, and how they can enchant one directly. Prepare a 3000 word research paper. Submissions due tomorrow. Class dismissed. Well, if that doesn't sum up Haku for you, I don't know what does. Anyways, now that he just dumped that work on us, I need to de-stress so I'm gonna go get some fresh air. Emma walked out of school while the deafening screams of the other students echoed in the background. She went and sat outside in a narrow alley with her head down and just stayed there for what felt like a gazillion hours. She loved going into this meditative state, feeling at peace, isolated from the world. Just as she thought she was going to reach a state of zen, a strong cool breeze passed by and disturbed her. Annoyed, she put her head up and looked on the side and saw nothing. She was just going to put her head back down, when she thought she felt someone right on the other side. A chill went down her spine as she looked and pounced of surprise. 'Woah, woah, woah! Chill out man, who are you?' The man chuckled and looked at her with a look of arrogance, like he was surprised she'd talk like this. "Hi Emma," he said. 'Who are you? AND HOW DO YOU KNOW MY NAME.' I'm freaking out now. "Emma, Emma, calm down. I'm not here to hurt you, in fact I'm here to give you something. I'm Josh by the way," he reached his hand out for a handshake. Emma nervously shook his hand with a lot of disinterest. 'What are you here for? I don't even know you, what would you want to give me?' "You don't know me Emma, but I sure know you. I worked with your dad at a time and I'm here today to honor his soul. May he rest in peace," he said starting to feel a little emotional. Emma chuckled. 'My father left me when I was 2. I don't have a father, Josh. I don't know what you're talking about. Can you please let me be and stop with this stupid prank or whatever? I really have to go to class.' "Emma, your dad left you when you were young but it was for good. Trust me, he had no other option or he would never leave you. He had to go," he appealed to her almost desperately. 'Heh, yeah okay sure. I don't have a dad, Josh. Don't you get it? And what could've been so important that he had to leave his own daughter behind who could barely even walk for herself.' "Emma, you won't get it yet. He did it for the people of Fnatic, for the galaxy," he said. 'Yeah, and now you're going to give me some grand cause to justify his actions. He left me, and I left him. I have nothing to do with him anymore.' She almost started walking away when Josh said faintly, "He died a month after he left you, Emma. He died serving the people. He saved the people of Fnatic. This school, this-this building, these people, none of this would've existed today if it wasn't for your father. He might not have been a great father, but he was a great man. He was a hero." He's dead?..... That shouldn't have affected me as much as I did. 'How'd he die?' ﻿"Your father was a protector of the thread. We were among the 3 protectors assigned at genesis. After your mother abandoned him, he had to protect you alone, but he had a choice to make." ' ﻿So my father chose a thread over me. Wow!' ﻿ "No Emma, no. He chose the existence of Fnatic itself, over you," he said finally and this was enough for Emma to be attached. 'So what do you have to do with me?' ﻿ "He left something for you. In his job of protecting the thread against the Balkams, he made a sacrifice. He protected the dimensions, but there was one thing he left behind. His ring. A ring that assigned him his responsibility in the first place, one he wanted to give to you. I travelled dimensions looking for the ring he'd hidden to give to you. I mean, this was the least I could do for him, but I found nothing. Finally, after years of search, I found the ring. And this ring, is for you, Emma," he offered her a shining blue ring with a pearl on top that glowed but not too bright. ﻿'Woah. Isn't this a big deal or whatever? So, I can just wear it like that, I don't have to do anything?' ﻿He nodded, wiping off tears from his eyes. Emma put the ring in her finger and stared at this beautiful sight. The ring was pretty no doubt, but it felt like it had some energy to it. Something different that felt powerful to her. All of a sudden, a large blue radiation started coming out of the pearl connecting it with the sky. A light of sorts, it wasn't the most subtle thing you'd come across. Emma, astonished and scared screamed, "What's this, Josh? Did you know this was gonna happen? What's happening?" "I think it's a signal for help, Emma. I think the ring sees your father's blood in you. It's chosen you once again to protect the thread, just follow it and honor the galaxy. I'm proud of you," he tried to make himself heard through the loud noise of the radiation. AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA Faint screams were audible over the huge extravaganza
author: Aarya Saraf
illustrator: Wesley van Eeden; Jit  Chowdhury; Upamanyu  Bhattacharyya

title: What has happened thus far...
text: Everybody frozen in silence, seeming as if time had slowed down, the magroads seeming slower than usual, an entire planetary observatory still, patrols reporting, scientists observing, lights appearing darker than they were, this was phenomenal. I watched in horror seeing a melting Acex the icy blue moon of Pluto, shining due to a phenomenon that shatter entire planetary systems, devastate civilizations and end life. The death of a star. The Sun is now dead. It remains slowly cooling in the freezing temperatures of deep space. Our sun is now a stellar corpse unknown to the universe, never to be heard from again. The fate of the sun, is the same as for all stars one day they must all die, slowly ebbing away the life of the universe. The story of the sun might have ended with a glorious supernova but the children of the Sun live on. Humans have devised a civilization in possession of energy at the scale of the milky way galaxy, building colonies all over place, exchange with other civilizations, energy extractions, unbelievable technological advancements, a complex, but melodious symphony
author: Ganeshh G

title: Casey and the Tower of Terror
text: The story starts with Casey walker was a tall girl with fierce eyes and a brave heart. She lived with her grandma she had no other relatives. Her parents had gone missing when she was only 6. But before going missing they gave her a necklace; it wasn’t like some other necklace in fact it was weird. But it was the only thing she had of her parents and she wore it every day. Fast forward a few years later Casey was coming back home from buying groceries, when suddenly a car came out of nowhere and hit her, she fell face flat on the ground and everything went black. She woke up in a hospital and saw her grandma crying and she felt sad. is she going to be ok yes, she just needs some rest The next day the doctor came with bad news he said that last night Casey’s grandmother had a heart attack. Hearing this Casey was heartbroken, the only family she had in the whole world her grandma was dead. The nurse came after a little while she said that your grandma said to me to give you this before she passed away. She had a gift in her hand. Casey grabbed the gift box and opened it. Inside the box there was a note that read “enter the realm, fulfil your destiny, I believe in you.” “Enter the realm, fulfil your destiny, I believe in you” Reading those words, she became confused, there was also a black button inside a glass case. She opened the case and clicked the button. The seconds she clicked the button she was teleported to a mysterious place; she looked around and it looked like an endless field of fully grown rice but there was a big tower there which looked pretty far. She was shocked and a little bit scared. Then suddenly she heard a sweet voice. She followed the direction of the voice, and it led her to a cave. She went inside, the cave was scary it would have scared any ordinary girl, but it didn’t scare Casey. She went deeper and deeper into the cave, then at the very end of the cave she saw an angel trapped in a golden cage. The angel saw Casey but before she could ask her for help, she looked at her necklace; she said, “how did you get this necklace”. Casey said “it was given to me by my parents before they disappeared. The angel looked shocked she said, “that can’t be, it belonged to the queen; she wore it every day.” The angel paused for a second then she said, “are you Casey walker by any chance.” yes Are you Casey Walker by any chance Casey replied” yes.” Hearing this the angel looked at Casey in utter disbelieve she said “that can only mean one thing, you’re the heir of the kingdom of Fantasyland. Your parents aren’t dead they are imprisoned in the Tower of Terror by a wicked witch called Jennifer Walt. Jennifer possesses the powers of shapeshifting. Your parents have powers too.” Casey said “what! My parents have powers.” The angel replied “of course, i am the one who gave those powers to them. Your father has the power of wisdom. And your mother has the power of teleportation. But somehow, they are not able to use their powers. But you have to rescue them.” Casey said, “ok I am ready.” The angel said, “the only way to defeat Jennifer was by stabbing her right in the heart with The Sword of The Rising which you will find at the bottom of the tower the only way to move it is by using the necklace you are wearing.” Hearing this Casey first freed the angel then rushed to the Tower of Terror. She entered the tower, and she saw The Sword of The Rising she was able to pick it up and her necklace glowed. Then she rushed to the topmost floor. When she was there, she heard a sweet voice she hadn’t heard in years, The voice of her mother! She rushed to her and hugged her with tears in her eyes. Then she asked, “where is dad”. Then her mother said “I’ll answer that later, first give me the necklace and the sword” Casey didn’t hesitate and gave her both the things. As soon as her mother got the things, a black smoke covered her, and she showed her real self. She was the evil witch, Jennifer Walt. Then Casey suddenly heard the voices of her real parents they were in a corner, and they looked so weak. They could barely stand. Casey’s mother hugged her while tears were coming from her eyes. In the middle of this Jennifer charged at Casey with the sword it was about to kill her Casey closed her eyes, but she was still alive when she opened her eyes, she saw that her mother had teleported in front of her saving Casey but killing herself in the process. Seeing this Casey filled with rage and a red aura surrounded her and flames appeared on both her hands she swung her arms and threw a fireball at Jennifer. It severely damaged her and the sword fell out of her hands, Casey used this opportunity and this time and she was able to pick up the sword without the necklace and stabbed Jennifer right in the heart. A few years have passed since then and now Casey is the queen of Fantasyland.
author: Himanshu kafaltiya
illustrator: Selina Masego Morulane; Aaryama Somayaji; Arindam Dhar; Aritra Roy Roy; Jesse  Breytenbach; Maithili  Joshi; Nilesh Gehlot; Sahil Shaikh; Shreya  Sen; Suvidha Mistry

title: My dog, Timothy
text: Timothy, who I affectionately call Timmy, is a black Labrador, a very protective and energetic breed. His mother, Helda, died after giving birth. I found him abandoned in the streets, pushed and kicked by merciless people. I gave him shelter and warmth. After his refreshing bath, he jumped out of the tub and licked me. Then, he hung his tongue out, indicating that he was hungry. We went to the pet shop and got some dog biscuits for him. Oh, the joy in his eyes! After some weeks, he went to the hospital for his first injection! He was as nervous as me and actually hid behind my mother! But after a lot of coaxing and a packet of dog biscuits, he finally agreed to get an injection. He placed his hand on my hand when I almost fainted while seeing a trickle of blood coming from his fur. But the vet reassured me that the blood would stop flowing on its own. Many months passed by, and Timmy was getting used to our routine and also started trusting us more than ever. He also learned to enjoy and cherish happy moments with us as well as many tricks like shaking hands, fetching anything we ask for etc. He would also guard the house beautifully. Once, when we were out to get more groceries since we were short of food, as soon as we opened the car's door, we heard Timmy barking! We rushed to see what had happened. We saw a horror-struck thief in front of us. We called the police and the thief was arrested. Now, Timmy is 1 year old and more childish than ever!
author: Tavisha Thakur
illustrator: Karen  Vermeulen; Marleen  Visser; Sanjana Rajamohan; Sarthak Sinha

title: Our Real Friends
text: Once upon a time there was a very beautiful and greenish forest which was the house of many animals. They lived there with a great happiness and peace but it was destroyed by hearing a shocking news that within few days humans are coming with Bulldozers and mechanical saws to cut their forest and make a new Town there. Some animals heard that a person was telling this to the forest ranger, hearing this the animals ran to the lion because the lion was the king of the forest, they informed this to the king. The king was worried about his kingdom and his family. The king and the courtiers discussed about this problem, one of the courtiers said- "The humans a very strong, we can't defeat them, I think we should this forest", the king replied- "If we will run today then tomorrow some other humans with the machines will come and we have to leave our shelter again. It's better to fight, this forest is our home so we should protect it!" the courtier said- "But they have very strong arms". the king said nothing. The king called all animals lived in the forest, they were his family, He said- "Today we all have to fight with the humans, This forest is our home and the humans are destroying it!". But many animals like rabbit, different birds etc. were not agreeing with the decision taken by the king they were worried about their kids, but they also had to fight for their shelter. They were telling their kids about the struggle they have to do, the problems they had to face and many things and We have to fight for our shelter. because the kids were very small they were asking- "What is struggle? What is fight? The Doe (Female Rabbit) was telling her kits- "You all will not come out of your burrows, because outside, the human will come and try to harm us." The other animals were also telling about this to their kids. The kids also wanted to come out and see what is happening but they obeyed their parents. When humans came with bulldozers and mechanical saws to cut the forest, the animals attacked on them. Many humans were injured and some of them ran away. The next day they came with more people, guns and hunters so that animals can't stop them. But animals didn't Stay in your burrows till I come. Ok mom. change their decision, the again attacked to the humans. Many animals were killed. This was the fight between the establishment town and protection of shelter. In this struggle many animals and humans loosed their lives. The forest ranger tried his best to stop these destructive activities but the greedy businessman ignored him. He tried to convinced them by saying that- "Animals, trees are our friends we must save them otherwise we will face a big problem in near future, our ecological balance will we disturbed. This incident of fight between animals and greedy businessman was spread through newspaper. Some people who are campaigning for saving trees, forest and animals Please don`t harm the animals and the environment sir. I AM DOING MY WORK. came forward and stopped the establishment of town on that forest. So the animals could save their shelter. MORAL OF THE STORY: In our country, there is "Wild life protection" act, National park sanctuaries for protection of wild animals. But if all the animals are not aware about the necessity of protection of wild animals, our ecological balance will be in a big threat. We should also take care of our environment.
author: Mrigangka Roy
illustrator: Ajit Narayan; Kripa B; Pratham Content Group; Raju Babu Shakya; Sangeetha Kadur

title: Kindness
text: Once upon a time, there lived a family of four in the coastal area of Chennai. They all posed to be a happy and fun-family but in reality, it was quite different. The elder brother Vansh, and his younger sister Shree lived in fear. They often asked their mother about her cuts and bruises, but she always told them that she had and inadvertent fall on the roadside, or that she hurt herself while working. After a while, the children stopped asking her about her scars. The only source of joy in the children's life was going to Kalicharan Chacha's store, as he always met them with a smile and gave them candies for free. One day, as the kids were buying bread from his store, Kalicharan suddenly spoke up,"Buying bread for the third time this week? Is your Amma (mother) feeling fine?" "No, Chacha. Her health has been deteriorating since the last few days." replied Vansh. Kalicharan felt empathetic for the kids but he also couldn’t help but feel suspicious too. Was something odd going on at their home? He asked his wife Madhuri later that evening, who replied “Don’t you know what condition those children are living in? Didn’t you notice the cut on Geeta’s lips last week? Her husband is behind them. We have to take action immediately. Those poor kids......” Kalicharan wasted no time in calling his niece Jaya, who worked as a constable in the police department. She went to their house the very next day and questioned Geeta. The children had also arrived by that time and piped up about how their father abused their mother. Soon Jaya had all the required information and left after half-an-hour. Geeta’s husband Divecha returned after a few days from an office trip and was met by the cops at the door! They had filed a restraining order on him after Geeta’s approval. The villain was now behind the bars! Can you believe that one person’s kindness helped save a whole family from living in terror?! Let us all spread kindness and make the world a better place.
author: Dashleen Kaur

title: Aruna's Great Save!
text: It was a bright sunny day for Khandvi village. The sun shone brightly through the cliffs. Aruna, a girl of about 7 years was peeping through the window of a small house. 'Woof' 'Woof', came the sound of a puppy barking. It was Aruna's puppy Babloo. An year ago she had pleaded her father to get her a pet dog. 'Baba..Baba please get a dog for me..'. Her father found a street dog and Aruna named him Babloo. As Aruna was thinking about these things, she heard the sound of truck tires roaring up the street. She was surprised. Usually, people used bullock carts in her village. She went outside to look and was even more surprised when the huge truck advanced towards her house. As it stopped, two burly men emerged and took Babloo by the collar. Aruna fought, but all in vain. The men took him away... When Baba came home, Aruna told him everything. He asked the police and talked to the men who had taken Babloo away. After an hour he came home and said that Babloo was their pet only. It went missing about an year ago, and that was the time that Aruna's father had found Babloo on the streets. Aruna was shocked. As night drew near, Aruna packed some food and ran. She ran all night long and then stopped at a clearing. This was it. She had come to the address which she had seen on the truck. In the clearing she saw a big building. She ran towards it. She needed to rescue her Babloo. As she reached nearer, she heard two young and rich looking women whispering to each other. She quickly hid. She thought they were sisters; at least they seemed like sisters. Aruna couldn't help eavesdropping. One of the women dropped a ginormous hint about Babloo. Aruna heard her say, "You know Meena, I heard daddy say that he had found a puppy which could cost a lot. He will sell it in something called a black market and earn a lot of money!" Aruna had studied about black marketing. It meant an illegal traffic or trade. She thought about it. If this bad man was clever enough to outsmart the police, what made her think she could stop him? Hmmm... What shall I do? She thought, I could go and tell everything to the police; but then who would they believe, a little girl or rich landowners. S he would have to do this on her own. Suddenly her mission to save her dog had become a dangerous mission to expose a conman. She sneaked up the stairs and landed up in a huge room. She saw a small man wearing sparkly robes and jewels. She thought this must be the rich man. In the chamber, she saw a red button. She pressed it. And hey presto! A door appeared in the floorboard. She almost jumped out of her skin. She stepped inside and the first thing she laid her eyes on was a small puppy crouched in the corner of a cage.'Babloo!' she spoke through her tears. As she came to her senses, she saw many cages which imprisoned sad and hungry looking animals. Then Aruna did a very brave thing. She tiptoed to the cages and freed the animals and birds one by one. Then brave Aruna picked up Babloo and ran towards the police station. S he told the police everything truthfully. Even though they didn't seem to believe her, they agreed to investigate the case. They found out that she was right and did the needful. As they reached Aruna's little cottage, they gave Aruna a doll as a thank you and told her they had arrested everyone involved in the con. But.... unfortunately the rich man himself had managed to escape.....!
author: Chehak Kaur
illustrator: Angie & Upesh; Ankitha Kini; George Supreeth; Karen  Vermeulen; Melany  Pietersen; Nancy Raj; Niloufer Wadia; Nivong  Sengsakoun; Partho Sengupta; Priya Kuriyan; Santosh Pujari; Soumya Menon; Swarga Bhattacharya

title: HASTY CHOICES ARE FUTILE ONES
text: That day, everything was peaches and cream. A delightful symphony was being played by the wind. Kiyara was playing hide and seek with her buddies under the clear skies. She spent two hours of her quality time in playing prior to actually returning home. She was fatigued and worn out. She was sputtering and gasping. Her cheeks begun to blush. They turned rosy. She drank some water to ease her fatigue and had some fruits and nuts because she was hungry and entered to her room. She began by sketching a picture. It was a fantastic and admirable sketch of a dead-drop stunning female. She danced and sang after completing her sketch. After engaging in such activities, she was often satisfied. The single activity to which she was least addicted was sports. She went to eat a delectable lunch after spending the entire day playing and having fun. She devoured her food and chugged her beverage while sporting a stubble. "Kiyara, its time to hit the hay. Her mother said. Kiyara bid her mother good night before retiring to the bed. She was frequently extolled by her Art and Dance teachers at school, but her Mathematics and Science teachers were less than pleased with her. The following day after school, she made a call to her best friend and a voice came through the wire, "hello". "Hi, I am fit as a fiddle and I hope that you are also sailing in the same boat." Kiyara spoke. "yes! I am doing great." Her friend Maria said. "Ping me whenever you are free. Lets catch up today." "Okay! All done." Voice of Maria came through the line. They met that evening and discussed their future plans. Maria questioned Kiyara about her career plans. Kiyara pondered. She wanted to experience every occupation but she knew she could only pursue one. When she got home, she continued to think, which caused her face to become unhappy and stressed. She explained the situation to her mother, who responded, "you are a young child. You don't know much about careers and different industries. There are thousands of professions you can opt for but you are unaware about all of them. If you wish to pursue a solid career, studying in other topics is even more crucial than learning art and dance. Kiyara was adamant and determined and continued to consider her career, eventually deciding that she would like to be a dancer. She felt relieved from her mental strain and believed that choosing a career was sufficient in life. Dance became her passion and she used to spend her leisure time in dancing. A few years later, she got graduated and joined a well-known dance academy but she was unable to receive a qualification which was required to be a professional dance because she only knew the fundamental dance moves which she had learned as a child and was unable to perform well in front of the judges at her academy. she knew only the fundamental dance moves that she has learned as a child and was unable to perform well because Other pupils made fun of her for being uneducated and failing badly at what she was good at. Success stopped following her when she quit exerting herself. For the second time, she didn't even attempt and because she was impoverished and unemployed. Her life was difficult and she had to struggle a lot. She realized the importance of her mother's words when her mother was no longer around to provide guidance because she had already passed away. She was upset and disheartened and remembered her mother's words "To make our dreams come true, failures are the only thing that we have to go through, hard work is the only thing that we have to pursue and success will never leave us, this is a promise to you."
author: Gunjita 13802

title: Greedy Farmer
text: T here was this Farmer in a village named Tunar Gaon. This farmer was the one and only Farmer in the village, named Vaibhav and had a son named Rahul. His wife died a long time ago and is still respected by most Villagers for her qualities she has Vaibhav looked like a normal person but was cunning inside. He was still respected by many because of her wife, but there were some who used to disrespect him for gaining respect by the name of her wife. He was the only farmer in the village because no one can stand against him in the competition, every farmer used to start fresh but because of some strange actions, they always got bankrupt No one knew Why? Rishab (a pandit) and Abir (a new farmer) talking. Hey Pal, how is your farming going? Don't talk about it brother, I am quitting, my competition is very powerful, he must have a gang who is destroying and stealing my crops What a Coincidence? Each Farmer had same, or similar reason. Either their crops are gone, no money left, can't make enough profit to invest. This was a big problem as the only farmer, Vaibhav used to make a big profit and used to sell things way more than the original cost (turnover) The pandit was then very curious and decided to call Panchayat What?!? You had a lot of savings, how can you quit?!? All my saving is gone, like all of my crops Panchayat Settles Down Sarpanch: Abir, what happened, explain please "Sir, The land here never gets fertile, I tried everything but no luck, Sometimes When I get crops, my competition Vaibhav have it in less value, I can't go more cheaper, My family needs to eat" Abir said very slowly This was the first time when a huge issue got to panchayat, Everyone used to be afraid but pandit Rishab had courage, Abir was very thankful Everyone started to question Vaibhav Vaibhav shouts "LIAR" in anger "You are doing this to defame me, You liar" Vaibhav shouts Everyone was still suspecting Vaibhav as he have a record of allegation similar like this What was the point?!? We have no proof! Truth always win, Either today or tomorrow Don't Worry Now Abir, The State government have installed CCTV Camera in this village because of recent Cases about Farmers We will check in that and tell you who is right or wrong ‍ Everyone then goes back to their houses Vaibhav goes to his Farm in a sudden shock Vaibhav: H-How? I am all gone now, I can't hide my secret now, God Save me Next Day, The Panchayat again settle down for the recent case of Vaibhav and Abir This time Sarpanch got the answer about who is guilty Attention Everyone I have the answer to the recent case but I want to show you all the truth by the cctv footage CCTV footage shown The following are the conversation going when everyone is watching CCTV footage Abir: Who's kid is that? Is tha- Is that Rahul? the son of Vaibhav? Everyone looks at Vaibhav in the eyes of ange r People Started Screaming: "Tell the truth or go to jail!" "I knew it's this person" "Stop Teaching Children these things" "Why were you even doing this" Vaibhav says in disbelief: Sorry Everyone, It was me not Rahul, I made him do this, I never wanted anyone to surpass me after the respect I had, Not even me My wife had. Please don't throw me to jail, Please. Quickly, Vaibhav lost his business, Everyone went to Abir Instead New Farmers started joining, The monopoly is gone from Vaibhav's hand Abir still Thanks the pandit and Sarpanch for the sake of Justice and Kindness After a year, Vaibhav didn't had enough to feed his son and his son died because of hunger Vaibhav's news went over everywhere and no one believed him After all of this, Police came and arrested Vaibhav because of stealing of crops he did from Abir Vaibhav learned that "truth is god" the hard way The End Greedy Farmer Story by J Avinash Kumar Army Public School Tezpur Class VI B
author: Jigmet Avinash
illustrator: Abin  Shrestha; Adonay Gebru; Annada Menon; Google India; Isuri Dayaratne; Jeyanthi Manokaran; Michael  Sagikwa; Srikrishna Kedilaya

title: The Farmer and Potter's Donkey
text: Once upon a time, there was a village named Laxmanpur. The village was very beautiful and peaceful. Here the people lived as a family in harmony with the nature. It was far from the pollution and noise of the city. One can always feel a connection with the nature and soil. There was a farmer named Ramajibhai Patel and his wife with 5 year old son. Ramaji was doing farming and his wife helped him. She was taking good care of her family alongside. They were living happily. In their neighbourhood there lived a famous potter, Kalubhai. He had a great skill of making dishes, pots, vases etc. out of clay. He was always busy with his work. He had 2 donkeys for transporting soil from the field and supplying pots to the nearby villages. Ramaji and Kalu were very good friends. They were helping and taking care of each-other. One day a saint came to their village. The saint used to hold Satsangs every evening. The villagers always listened to him with full of attention and devotion One day while the saint was giving his lessons and 'Pravchan' the farmer’s wife was also there in the crowd. That day, she was highly impressed by the saint's dialogue that ‘you should set a thing or habit that you have to do daily without fail. It will surely bring something good in your life'. The farmer’s wife was so impressed by this and that night she made a decision that she would always wake up before the sunrise. She would start her day with Tulasi Pooja which was planted in her courtyard. And as decided, she started doing it daily without fail. She also insisted her husband to decide something like this and follow it daily. Ramaji believed in hard work and so he was not taking all these things seriously. He told his wife that all such things are good to listen, but not possible to practice in real life. She often says him the same matter, but he never bothered to listen. After a few days, he finally agreed, but for namesake only. He agreed to what his wife said just to make her mouth shut. He told her that he would see the face of potter’s donkey in the morning before starting his day. After that he will start his routine works. He started to follow his decision on a daily basis– he woke up, went out to see the face of donkey and then began his work. This activity continued for long time. One day the potter woke up very early in the morning to do his work. He went to collect the soil with his two donkeys to a field which was around 2 KM away from the village. When the potter was digging the soil he found something hard under the soil and he started digging it more. Finally he found three old metal pots full of gold and diamonds. He was very happy and started collecting them fast so that no one will see him as the Sun was going to rise. On the other hand, our farmer Ramaji woke up and went to potter’s house to see the face of the donkey. But there he found nothing as donkey was way with his master. He asked potter’s wife about the donkey and potter. As potter’s wife told, Ramaji went to that direction to see the donkey’s face. From a little distance he saw the donkey and potter, and so he started back towards his home. Potter also saw him and thought that the farmer had seen all this and was going to say all that he found gold and diamonds. The potter started to shout loudly “Ramajibhai wait, please listen me!" But farmer kept on saying that "I have seen’’. The potter said "wait-wait", but farmer was saying that I have seen and went back home. The potter quickly collected the jewels and gems and went to the farmer’s house. The farmer saw the potter and asked ‘what happened?' The potter replied, ‘this is for you, keep it and please don’t say to anyone about what you have seen in the field'. The farmer replied ‘what there is to say?' The potter was in a confused state and told the whole matter that how he found the pot of gold and diamonds. The farmer was shocked to hear this and said that I was not aware about it. I was saying that I have seen the face of your donkey and that’s all. The potter was completely in shock because the situation was completely different from what he was thinking. The potter requested him that whatever be the matter, but now do not disclose the details about this treasure to anyone. 'We will share it equally'. The farmer was really happy. His wife told him that you were not ready to listen to the saint and was making fun of him. But now it proved right. ﻿As the saint told, it is great to develop one good habit in our life and keep following it daily. That good habit will give us wonderful results finally.
author: Sharvi Patel

title: Stuck in Elevator
text: Danielle is a 13 year old who loves to learn about Medical Science. She is a lot like her dad but her mom and her don't get along very well. But they managed fine for a while but recently things have gotten a lot worse for their family. Danielle had a huge fight with her mom usually when that happens, she goes and stay's with her dad. She packed a few things, shut the door and left. Danielle and her mom live in a 16-storey building with two elevators one big & one small. She pressed the button to the elevator to go down, the small one came but she hates it as Danielle's claustrophobic. If she stay's in a narrow place for a while, her chest tightens and she can't breathe. If she stay's even longer, she loses control and has a panic attack. She got into the small elevator. On the way down it stopped on the sixth floor. "I hope it's not Megan" Danielle thought and then she saw that it was her. Megan is the only enemy Danielle has. Unfortunately, they live in the same building. She was on the phone and sounded upset. "I'm home, where else can I be? I'm about to reach". I'll call you back she said as soon as she saw that someone entered the elevator. The elevator door closed, she noticed that she wasn't alone she was about to say 'Hi' but when she saw that it was Danielle, she clearly wasn't happy. "Oh great!" she said and started randomly pressing the buttons she wanted to get off before we reached the ground floor. She was obviously not happy that Danielle was with her. Suddenly, the elevator started shaking and then stopped as if hanging in mid-air. Megan waited for the door to open so she could go out but when it didn’t, she tried to press the open button. Nothing happened so she started randomly pressing the buttons again. Danielle couldn't help herself and said, "Will you stop doing that?", she met Danielle's eyes for the first time. Megan replied, ‘I think you should stop blaming others for bad things that happen in your life", she said crossing her arms. Danielle knew what she meant by that but she kept quiet because she was already sweating. She had to get out of there as soon as she could. Danielle had three panic attacks in her life. She knew how bad they were and she didn't want to have another one. She tried to make the elevator doors open. She pulled as hard as she could but it didn't work. Megan started punching the door while shouting, " Oh my god...no!! We're stuck in the elevator. Anyone there?", shouted Megan. Megan took out her phone she knew that there was no signal in the elevator but she still wanted to give it a shot. She tried calling someone but, of course, it wasn't going through. They both knew that the second you step into an elevator in this building you lose connection and the internet stops working. Megan was standing right in front of the buttons "‘Can you move over?" Danielle asked. Megan did. Just as Danielle thought that there was an emergency button with the alarm sign on it at the bottom, She pressed it for a very long time. They didn't hear anything so the alarm must be ringing somewhere else but who will hear the alarm and come? And how would they get them out of here? Danielle's chest started tightening, now on top of the sweating. She was also having trouble breathing. Megan sat on the floor took out a pack of cookies from her bag and started eating. Danielle remembered that she hadn't had breakfast & it would have been nice to have one but she'd rather die than ask Megan for a cookie. Anyways, she wouldn't give Danielle any, even if she asked. Do you want to know what happened? Megan moved into Danielle's building with her family last summer. Danielle saw her around but they hadn't been introduced. When school started, she saw that they were in the same class. Eventually they both became friends. Since they lived in the same building, they would hang out after school. Danielle shouldn't have trusted someone that she had just met but she ended up sharing a lot of personal stuff. It got so bad that when Danielle called her over to her house. She said "You betrayed me Megan, you are my enemy now!", Megan said the same thing to her too. They stopped being friends right away, that is until they got stuck in the elevator. In Danielle's whole life, she only ever had one enemy and now she was stuck in an elevator with her for the past four hours. There was no sound coming from outside. They kept on pressing the emergency button but nobody was coming. So either the button was broken or nobody was checking. Because it was a weekend, Danielle was feeling dizzy from hunger and claustrophobic. She was moments away from having a panic attack. All of a sudden, the elevator fell a few floors down with a loud bang, they both screamed. The elevator shook for a while and then stopped. When things had calmed down, Danielle noticed that she was holding Megan's arm in fear. She felt ashamed and pulled away. Megan smiled and she smiled back. Danielle was no longer strong enough to stand so she sat down. Megan took out the pack of cookies again. She offered Danielle some, "I wanted to offer you some earlier but I was afraid to", she said. Danielle took a couple of cookies. Megan sat next to her since she was dizzy. "D id you know that I have claustrophobia? Don't be scared if I have a panic attack soon, I act crazy when I have a panic attack but I won't hurt anyone except myself", Danielle said. She teared up and had to hold back from crying. Megan held her hand than in a gentle voice. She said "Close your eyes and imagine that we're in a beautiful garden, the flowers are blooming and the soothing voice of the birds is there. Look around what do you see?". Tears were rolling down Danielle's cheeks. Megan said, "We’re sitting on the grass, can you smell the flowers?", Danielle was relaxed, she said "Yes, I can hear the birds singing too!", right after they heard something. Danielle opened her eyes, "This doesn't sound like a bird", She thought that someone's here to help. She yelled, "Help us! There are two of us here!". T here was an immediate response "Be patient I'll get you out of there". Danielle was already feeling better, thanks to Megan. Danielle started laughing out loud. She looked at Megan and saw that she was sulking for some reason. "We're getting out! Cheer up". Danielle said. Megan took a deep breath and the elevator again made a loud noise and shook again. They screamed and hugged each other but this time they weren't going down, they were going up. They started shouting happily. The staff slowly pulled the elevator up. It took around half an hour. Both the girls were now able to hear voices much more. The door opened slightly and saw two dirty hands reaching inside. Then finally, the doors opened fully. There was a person with oil in his hands. He said "When the people got your emergency call, I had to set up a safety wire to pull you up & that takes a long time to do. I'm sorry you were stuck here for such a long time." He further said that it was a terrible experience for them. The girls were finally out. Danielle was so happy that she ran down the stairs when they were outside. She stopped and looked at the sky. Life was beautiful. They grabbed some coffee and went to a park. Megan, sincerely apologized to Danielle, "I'm such a stupid person. Will you be able to forgive me? Those seven hours we spent together inside the elevator formed a special new bond between us". So I forgave the only person who was my enemy.
author: MEDHA GUPTA

title: Summer's here!
text: Summer, It’s the season of popsicles and holidays but for Arjun, it meant he had to face swimming classes. Arjun's mum was determined to get him to learn to swim, Arjun however was dead set on not doing precisely the same, he found the water terrifying. He still remembers the incident clear as day even though he was just a toddler at the time, How could he forget, it was his first time at the beach and he was having a blast chasing the waves and collecting shells of all shapes and sizes. He found a huge one and turned to face his mum beaming with pride on his discovery and then came a wave sneaking up on him from his back and sweeping him into the water, after that everything was a haze but he was rescued by the lifeguard and only woke up the next morning and swore to never go near water every again. But now there was no turning back. He was already at the pool, fingers crossed hoping the swim coach would forget about his existence and just when he thought he had gotten away he met the eyes of his coach, who called him over. Arjun walked over, “Why aren't you in the water Arjun? ” questioned the coach,” um I have an injured elbow” lied Arjun and immediately regretted it”, "Fine then, just sit with your leg in the water and practice your leg stokes”. And so Arjun went to the shallowest part of the pool to sit in the corner and started swinging his legs. Some time passed and Arjun got bored so he looks around the pool and when he reaches the other end of the pool he sees a puppy, “What is a puppy doing here? ” he wonders and looks around for an owner and finds no one, but the puppy started wandering about and was standing at the edge of the pool and was dangerously close to the edge, and was looking into the pool. Arjun decides to stand up to move the puppy from the edge to make sure it doesn't accidentally fall in and as he's walking there, the puppy sees him coming, gets frightened, and jumps into the pool! Arjun in a panic without giving it a second thought jumps into the pool after the puppy to rescue it, but he fails to get a hold of the puppy as it waddles away from him, then Arjun notices that the puppy is fine in the water and is enjoying himself then realization strikes him that he's doing just fine as well. He's initially surprised but then goes along with it and has a nice time in the water. After a long while, he gets ready to return home, eager to tell his mother the story of how he got over his fear. On his way out he sees the coach, “I saw that you were enjoying yourself over there Arjun, so what was that about the elbow you were saying? ” To this Arjun shoots him an awkward smile and walks away.
author: Nidharsana S.R
illustrator: Catherine Groenewald; Monappa; Shirish  Ghatge; Siddhartha Tripathi; Thulisizwe  Mamba

title: One Stair Up
text: This Morning Harshit found himself in the City Hospital of Mudvar, lying on the bed. He finds his hands grabbed by a beautiful young woman. It is a strange but a very familiar feeling. He can’t recognize it. He is with full of doubts. Only a cheerful voice is whispering in his ear, “ You have done it my boy, you have done it.” Suddenly, the woman cries off with a joyful cheer. It was more doubtful for Harshit to recognize the woman. In a very thin voice Harshit said, “Who are you Madame? Can I know the reason behind your cries?” Woman replied, “Aren’t you be able to recognize me??? I am your best friend Disha” He tries to utter Disha’s name but unable due to lack of energy. Disha shouted with a very joyful voice, “Uncle, Harshit has woken up!!!!” Suddenly, the door opens, and a number of faces are on Harshit…………. Harshit and his parents are in the principal’s office. Principal addressed Harshit as “Stone less Stair”. The reason behind this addressing is the attitude of Harshit. He does have a positive attitude towards everything except studies. His parents were very much disappointing on hearing the performance from Principal. Harshit was very quiet that day. Principal utters his last words by addressing Harshit “Stone less Stair”. Harshit and his parents are now in home. His parents tried a lot to thrust him to studies but Harshit feels very irritating and rushed into the room and closed the door. He was crying and thinking about the addressing again and again “ Stone less Stair, Stone less Stair……….” STONE LESS STAIR!!!!! T he whole day passes like this. His parents tried to make him calm, but he was rigid in his decision. Next day morning, Harshit wakes up very early, prepare breakfast for his parents and keep it on the table with a note. When his parents came down, they were very much surprised. Harshit’s Mom Samridhi reads the note. It was a message from her son, “Sorry Mamma for yesterday’s incident. Please forget it and have this small gift from this moody boy” Samridhi smiled, “My Cutie Harshit”. Some miracle activities have started from that day. Harshit started taking studies seriously. He was studying on a daily basis with an increasing pace. Coming bad reports from schools has stopped. Harshit was found to be asleep, studying till midnight. He started scoring full marks in every subject one after the other. He also started giving his interest on extra curriculum activities like, essay competition, debate competition, quiz competition, etc. One day, principal called Harshit and his parents for consultation. This time Principal said, “Harshit, you have improved a lot. You can be the topper of this nation as well. You can do it my boy, you can do it” On hearing good addressing of Harshit, his parents feel very much proud. They said, “Today, I am also very happy and why I shouldn’t? It’s a prestigious moment for me. But don’t be stagnant, you have to achieve your dream, your teachers dream and our as well”. RE-INTERPRETETION OF HISTORY The flame which was in Harshit’s mind re-ignited in a huge amount. He gave his full potential in studies. And finally, he became the topper of this nation. Everyone is saying, “Harshit, Harshit ….”. He revealed his secret of success. He said, “Today What I am is because of my mistakes, because of my failure, because of my rigid attitude. Because of my friend’s co-operation, parent’s love and affection and teacher’s proper guidance. The one who helped me a lot is my best friend, my study mate, the partner of my depression and anxiety Disha. She may not have secured the topper’s seat but has secured the seat of a topper’s mind…………………….” The last lines that he said is that “Be Confident, be rigid towards your aim and be soft towards your parents, and friends.” He was welcomed like a king in the school. Principal come forward and hugged him and said, “ You have done it by now, You have done it”. But in this beautiful moment a worst incident occurs. While returning to home, Harshit have a big accident and he went to Coma. “Harshit!!!! What happen,” said Disha......... He Wake Up from Coma. Principal enters the room and come closer to him. Principal said,” You have done it my boy, you have done it”. As soon as Principal utter those words, Harshit’s head starts twisting and he gains back his memory. He hugged his principal and said, “Thank You Sir, for addressing me Stone less stair on that day”. Principal sir replied you should now be addressed as, “ Stair with up gradation I,e. One Stair Up” STAIR WITH UPGRADATION

title: Catherine's Sojourn into the Space
text: It is the year 3031. The Earth which was once filled with life is now suffering from pollution and global warming. People cannot move out without protective suits which enshields them from harmful UV rays. NASA and other space agencies are setting up a space city where humans can live like Earth. Researchers and astronomers are searching for a planet in space which has suitable conditions for human life. Catherine Fusco is a Ph.D. in Mathematics who graduated from the prestigious Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) university. She is an expert in astronomical calculations and predictions at a young age of 26 and works for NASA. Her father Robert Fusco is an astronomical physicist who is the supervisor of the space city developmental program "LivSpace".She dislikes her father as he got married to her physics teacher after her mother died with cancer when she was eleven. He carried out an expedition into the space when she was thirteen and returned five years later. Her stepmother tried to be good to her but she believed that no one could take her mother's place. Her father wanted Catherine to be interested in physics but she was more interested in applied mathematics which often created a tussle between them. Although they both worked for NASA, they had never worked on a project together. Robert also dislikes Catherine's husband James, who is also a Mathematician. NASA is in chaos today. An abnormal signal has been received by ETSU (Extra terrestrial signaling unit) of NASA, that had been constantly working for detecting any extra terrestrial life or UFOs. For the first time in 1000 years this unit had received some signal. This had divided researchers and astronomers into two groups, one who believed in the existence of aliens and the other one believed that it was due to a supernova explosion in the spiral X23 galaxy that was about 1283 million light years away from our own Milky Way. Catherine and James sided with one who believed that UFOs exist and Robert was in the other group. But no group could come to a proper conclusion or could prove their beliefs. NASA chief advised that both groups should work together so that they could be safe from any incoming danger. Catherine thought,"Working with dad would be working in hell" but agreed when James convinced her that they would be working for a bigger cause that is humanity Catherine and her Dad started working together for a week but Catherine never talked to her father. All she said was" I am working Mr. Fusco. Please keep your work on the table, I will see it later. ". Although it did hurt Robert but he didn't say a word. Three weeks passed and as the intensity of signal was increasing, the bond between father and daughter started growing stronger. They started understanding each other and James was happiest to see that. Robert realized that he was so struck with grief by the passing away of his wife that he could not spend quality time with Catherine. He admitted that he never wanted Catherine to marry because he thought that marriage would make Cather ine dependent and incapable. Catherine also realized that her father loved her a lot and just that his way of showing love and care was different. Although he was not there with her during her teens but was always up to date with her activities and achievements. They both realized that they had missed each other's company but promised to spend the rest of time together. Time passed, and with the intensity of signals astronomers could make sure that it was the aliens who were in search of earth since 2000 years. They lived on salt which was in abundance on Earth in the sea water. That is why they wanted to live on Earth by finishing all the human life.Their spaceship was only 6 months to arrive on Earth. NASA geared up the "LivSpace" program and started sending children and some learned people to the space city which was set up between the orbits of Mars and Earth. Catherine had worked on the life beyond the Milky Way in which she believed that in the Andromeda Galaxy a planet named U223 could be inhabited by humans. She was helped by Robert and James and could finally convince the astronomical society that life was possible on U223. But first someone had to go and check the planet before sending the common people. A group of trained astronauts and astronomers was selected for visiting the U223 planet. The only drawback was that it would take 58 years, 73 days to reach and so the crew would have to be put up in hibernation capsules and all the functions would be done by AI programmed robots. The crew would wake up only after 58 years and 73 days. Although Robert was selected as crew to accompany James and Catherine, his health condition did not allow him to be in the hibernation capsule. Catherine was extremely emotional to leave her father again. She knew that when she would wake up her father would be no more. Before leaving she said to him, "You are the best daddy in the world", something that Robert had longed to listen.Robert was overwhelmed and said to James,"Always be with her as you are the only one who she has in this world after me". They bid each other good bye with teary eyes. After 58 years and 73 days, Catherine woke up along with the crew. The AI programmed robot gave her a message that her father sent before passing away 10 years ago. It said "We were able to defeat the aliens. Thanks to your calculations. but Earth was too affected to be inhabited. You are the apple of my eyes and I love you very much. May you succeed in your life and be blessed. Remember I am always there with you.When you miss me just keep your hand on your heart and you will hear me say "I love you my dear daughter". The planet U223 was green and blue like Earth" and so Catherine's mission was successful.

title: A Carriage Ride to the West.
text: Every morning he left for school only after touching her feet. “Bless me Dadi.” “Let the almighty give you all that you desire and more.” And off he ran away to the cold plains of Shimla. He knew these frosted plains like the back of his hand. Green grasslands flushed under the colossal mountain ranges. A valley formed around urban lands. Now, at present, it was covered with white crystal snow with the weather so cold it turned your ears pink. Cottages were constructed close to each other to preserve heat. A road crisscrossed through the snowy plains. Cars rushed onto the road. People saw a slight boy of seven walking to the nearest school four kilometres away. He jumped onto the sidewalk and started skipping about. He stopped to admire the children skiing along the snowy flatlands. “Rich brats”,Satpal said “ They love showing off,” Lakhan replied. “Aren't we getting late?” “I guess.” And off they ran, reaching school just in the nick of time. Their school was a huge building distempered in turquoise. It did not have a proper roof which often caused the canopy to leak. After the morning assembly, they had mathematics. As they entered the class, the sky changed into a hoary black canvas. Their Maths teacher was a short, round man with very little neck. He had a mean face with wispy hair and was always seen with his trusted cane.He could quieten the class with his mere presence. “Did you all finish your homework?” he asked assertively. Homework? Oh no! Lakhan had completely forgotten about it.He had spent the whole day playing cricket with Satpal. Five strokes later he was asked to stand outside the class for the first two periods. There was a break after the first period. Students from all the classes came out to either use the washroom or to meet their friends. Ranbir, a fat-good-for-nothing boy of twelve years was having a very bad day. He had gotten detention from his English teacher for not finishing his homework assignment and so, he decided to make someone's day horrible. He started looking for Lakhan who was an easy prey for his antics. “Oye Lakhan, getting punished already?” “Stop it, Ranbir bhaiya.” “You are just like your father, a complete loser.” Lakhan hated it when people talked about his father. He hadn't seen his father since his mother's death two years ago. Lakhan started crying. Seeing this, Ranbir ran away. He didn't want to get into any more trouble. As Lakhan stood sobbing, there was an announcement in the school. A monotonous voice was heard. “Attention to all students and teachers. A huge storm is expected to hit within the next hour. You are asked to leave home. The same applies to the teachers.”Huge cheers were heard throughout the school. Lakhan was ecstatic. Shouts of “Free holiday” were heard throughout the campus, as teachers tried to contain the crowds of students justling towards the door. From the glass windows, Lakhan and Satpal were seen hopping about with no fear of the upcoming storm. The entire sky had turned stygian. There was a cold, pleasant breeze blowing about, trying to scatter the clouds. The friends were dancing and singing all the way that they almost missed a wounded rabbit lying on the road. Its eyes were watery and it had a deep cut along its forelegs. Blood was oozing out, dampening the snow around it. It almost camouflaged with the surrounding snow. “We have to save it Lakhan,”Satpal said “It won't survive” Looking defeated, the rabbit let out a final snort. Satpal bent down and touched the rabbit. It lay there lifeless. Tears came down Satpal’s eyes for he had lost his pet dog,Toto just three days back. Lakhan looked down expressionless. Teary-eyed Satpal dug out a hole, pushed the rabbit inside and covered it up with snow. Just then a tall man cycling came up to them. He had a pale face, blue eyes and a hooked nose, just like Satpal. “Namaste uncle,” Lakhan said “Namaste beta. What happened, Satpal? Come here.” Satpal ran towards his father and hugged him tightly. “What happened beta?” “ Uncle, when we came …..” As Lakhan narrated Satpals cries came down. “Don't cry beta. Just like Toto, the rabbit is taking a carriage ride to the west.” Hearing this Lakhan stood there stunned. His legs felt weak. He wanted to cry but the tears wouldn't flow. “Don't play outside Lakhan, the storm is approaching and convey my respects to Dadi.” Lakhan started running. He ran and ran and just didn't want to stop. Memories flashed before his eyes. A short man with a thin face and large eyes was shouting. “What have you given me? You gave everything to that wretched daughter of yours. She ran away with that cunning broker, disowning you. I need money to take care of him.”He pointed towards Lakhan. “Everybody calls me a loser. I feel ashamed to show my face in public. Savitri would have understood me. You know what, I don't want to live with you.” He pointed towards an old man with a skeleton face and a large broken nose, his Dada. “You can take care of Lakhan.” And off he walked away into the abyss. From the corner of his eye, Lakhan could see Dadi standing in the corner crying. He hadn't seen his papa since that day. The next morning there was a huge bang on the door. Satpal’s dad came rushing inside. He showed Dada the newspaper. As Dada was reading he collapsed in his chair. “Baba, have you taken everything,” Dadi asked “Yes, Dadi” “Don't stay up late. Remember to brush your teeth and don't trouble Mausi.” “Yes, Dadi.” Hot tears came out of Dadi’s eyes. “Come, say bye to Dada.” She took Lakhan inside the house. Dada was sleeping on a mattress. He appeared frail. His pillow looked wet. “Bye, Dada.” There was no reply. “He is asleep,” Dadi said. Mausi came inside. She was a fat woman with heavy make-up wearing a pink lehenga. “The taxi is waiting. I have to pay for it.” Dadi choked, “I am helpless. That is why I called you. Take care of Lakhan” “Nobody cared for me when I stood helpless. Anyway, take care of your husband. Send me a telegram when all of this is over ”, Mausi said bitterly. “Remember, we gave you everything we had,”Dadi lamented. “Really?" As Mausi replied with spitefulness, Lakhan found the newspaper near Dada’s mattress. He was about to open the newspaper when he found himself in the air. Mausi lifted Lakhan and carried him out of the house. As their taxi took a turn, Lakhan saw a police van speeding past them. The front cover of the newspaper lying near Dada’s mattress read-The body of a 34-year-old found near the banks of Giri. Police identify him as a resident of the Dahanu village. Lakhan came back home after spending two months with Mausi in Rajasthan. He had missed Dada and Dadi. He missed Dadi's stories. He missed Dada carrying him on his shoulders. He missed playing with Satpal. Mausi dropped him outside the house with his luggage and sped off in the taxi. Dada was a retired headmaster in the state government school. He always had his former students come and seek his blessings for future endeavours. But now, the house looked quiet and empty. Dadi came out running and hugged Lakhan. She carried him inside and asked him how his trip to Rajasthan had been. “Where is Dada?” Lakhan asked Dadi turned downcast. Her eyes turned wet. “Dada is taking a carriage ride to the west, ”Dadi stuttered. “When will he come back?” Lakhan asked innocently. “He won't come back. When you grow old, we will go there.” Dadi looked strange. She was not her usual self. It looked as though all the happiness on her face was drained. She was wearing a very simple sari and not her usual bright salwar kameez. “I don't want to go to Rajasthan ever again,” he said “I will never send you away ever again,” Dadi replied. Lakhan was now sprinting. It had been two years since that incident took place. All this made sense now. He wanted to talk to Dadi. Lakhan took a sharp turn and came to a stop. He had reached home. Dadi was in the backyard tending the gooseberry trees. He ran to her. “Baba go inside. I think there will be a downpour.” Lakhan just stood there, speechless. “What happened Baba?” Lakhan stared blankly. He felt something heavy in his throat. “Tell me, What happened? ” She couldn't bear seeing tears in her grandson’s eyes. “Dadi, where is papa?” Dadi’s face turned pale. “He is with Dada.” Lakhan’s vision turned blurry. His breathing became fast. He caught Dadi’s arm. “Don't leave me Dadi. Don't take a carriage ride to the west.” Dadi had tears in her eyes. She hugged Lakhan. Lakhan couldn't stop himself. He burst out. Lightning flashed, and thunder shook the Earth. It started pouring …..

title: STORY OF KHAJADLI
text: Once, in the middle of the Sahara Desert, there was a village named KHEJADLI. Even it was in the middle of Sahara Desert, it was green. There, the animals roamed freely. The villagers took much care of plants then their children. The elders used to say that'' Agar per hai to hum hai'' it means that if there will be no plants, there will be no human. THE children that lived here played with the trees throughout the day. The trees provided them shade. The children also shared their secrets with the trees. One day, a king named 'WASIR MUSTAQ' wanted a palace for himself. He ordered his servants to cut off the trees. the servants quickly cut of the trees. When the villagers heard about this, they quickly go to the forest and hugged them to save them. Like this, other people also joined them. But the servants had to follow the orders, so, they took their axes and cut off the trees. Many people died due to making of palace. After some time, when the king heared about the killing of people, the king realized and quickly stopped his work. THEN, he came to the khejadli village, he asked the villagers that '' Why are you trying to save the trees and giving your lives?'' Then the villagers said that what their elders used to say. Then the king realized that he was not doing good and said that he will never cut off the trees. THEn, from that day, the villagers and both animals lived together happily forever.

title: The Theif
text: 3PM in the evening. Everything peaceful and a perfect weather. I open the door of my room and grab a book I borrowed from my friend, Ryan. He was my best friend. I lie down on my bed and start reading. " 𝘖𝘯𝘤𝘦, 𝘵𝘩𝘦𝘳𝘦 𝘭𝘪𝘷𝘦𝘥 𝘢 𝘬𝘪𝘯𝘨, 𝘸𝘩𝘰 𝘩𝘢𝘥 2 𝘴𝘰𝘯𝘴. 𝘛𝘩𝘦 𝘬𝘪𝘯𝘨 𝘩𝘢𝘥 𝘢 𝘭𝘰𝘵 𝘰𝘧 𝘵𝘳𝘦𝘢𝘴𝘶𝘳𝘦, 𝘢𝘯𝘥 𝘵𝘩𝘦 𝘦𝘭𝘥𝘦𝘴𝘵 𝘴𝘰𝘯𝘨 𝘸𝘢𝘴 𝘪𝘯 𝘤𝘩𝘢𝘳𝘨𝘦 𝘰𝘧 𝘬𝘦𝘦𝘱𝘪𝘯𝘨 𝘵𝘩𝘦 𝘵𝘳𝘦𝘢𝘴𝘶𝘳𝘦 𝘴𝘢𝘧𝘦. 𝘖𝘯𝘦 𝘥𝘢𝘺, 𝘵𝘩𝘦 𝘬𝘪𝘯𝘨 𝘨𝘰𝘦𝘴 𝘪𝘯 𝘩𝘪𝘴 𝘵𝘳𝘦𝘢𝘴𝘶𝘳𝘦 𝘳𝘰𝘰𝘮 𝘢𝘯𝘥 𝘧𝘪𝘯𝘥𝘴 𝘰𝘶𝘵 𝘵𝘩𝘢𝘵 𝘵𝘩𝘦 𝘵𝘳𝘦𝘢𝘴𝘶𝘳𝘦 𝘩𝘢𝘥 𝘣𝘦𝘦𝘯 𝘴𝘵𝘰𝘭𝘦𝘯." "What was the eldest son doing?" I wonder. I then continue reading. " 𝘛𝘩𝘦 𝘬𝘪𝘯𝘨 𝘧𝘰𝘶𝘯𝘥 𝘰𝘶𝘵 𝘵𝘩𝘢𝘵 𝘩𝘪𝘴 𝘮𝘪𝘯𝘪𝘴𝘵𝘦𝘳 𝘩𝘢𝘥 𝘴𝘵𝘰𝘭𝘦𝘯 𝘵𝘩𝘦 𝘵𝘳𝘦𝘢𝘴𝘶𝘳𝘦, 𝘢𝘯𝘥 𝘩𝘦 𝘱𝘶𝘵𝘴 𝘩𝘪𝘴 𝘮𝘪𝘯𝘪𝘴𝘵𝘦𝘳 𝘪𝘯 𝘫𝘢𝘪𝘭. 𝘏𝘦 𝘵𝘢𝘬𝘦𝘴 𝘩𝘪𝘴 𝘵𝘳𝘦𝘢𝘴𝘶𝘳𝘦 𝘣𝘢𝘤𝘬." "is that it?" I say. I turn the page and see that it's still left. " 𝘛𝘩𝘦 𝘯𝘦𝘹𝘵 𝘥𝘢𝘺, 𝘵𝘩𝘦 𝘬𝘪𝘯𝘨 𝘸𝘢𝘴 𝘷𝘦𝘳𝘺 𝘩𝘢𝘱𝘱𝘺 𝘢𝘴 𝘩𝘦 𝘩𝘢𝘥 𝘧𝘰𝘶𝘯𝘥 𝘢 𝘣𝘳𝘪𝘥𝘦 𝘧𝘰𝘳 𝘩𝘪𝘴 𝘦𝘭𝘥𝘦𝘴𝘵 𝘴𝘰𝘯. 𝘏𝘦 𝘩𝘦𝘢𝘳𝘴 𝘩𝘪𝘴 𝘴𝘰𝘯'𝘴 𝘷𝘰𝘪𝘤𝘦 𝘢𝘯𝘥 𝘴𝘵𝘢𝘳𝘵 𝘵𝘰 𝘸𝘢𝘭𝘬, 𝘣𝘶𝘵 𝘸𝘩𝘦𝘯 𝘩𝘦 𝘩𝘦𝘢𝘳𝘥 𝘴𝘰𝘮𝘦𝘵𝘩𝘪𝘯𝘨, 𝘩𝘦 𝘚𝘛𝘖𝘗𝘗𝘌𝘋." I wonder what made him stop. " 𝘛𝘩𝘦 𝘦𝘭𝘥𝘦𝘴𝘵 𝘴𝘰𝘯'𝘴 𝘷𝘰𝘪𝘤𝘦- ' 𝐇𝐞𝐲 𝐉𝐚𝐜𝐪𝐮𝐞, 𝐬𝐭𝐞𝐚𝐥𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐭𝐫𝐞𝐚𝐬𝐮𝐫𝐞 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐤𝐞𝐞𝐩𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐢𝐭 𝐚𝐭 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐦𝐢𝐧𝐢𝐬𝐭𝐞𝐫'𝐬 𝐡𝐨𝐮𝐬𝐞 𝐝𝐢𝐝𝐧'𝐭 𝐰𝐨𝐫𝐤, 𝐬𝐨 𝐟𝐚𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐫 𝐠𝐨𝐭 𝐡𝐢𝐬 𝐭𝐫𝐞𝐚𝐬𝐮𝐫𝐞 𝐛𝐚𝐜𝐤. 𝐖𝐞 𝐧𝐞𝐞𝐝 𝐚𝐧𝐨𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐫 𝐩𝐥𝐚𝐧 𝐭𝐨 𝐬𝐭𝐞𝐚𝐥 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐭𝐫𝐞𝐚𝐬𝐮𝐫𝐞.' " 𝘛𝘩𝘦 𝘬𝘪𝘯𝘨 𝘸𝘢𝘴 𝘴𝘩𝘰𝘤𝘬𝘦𝘥, 𝘢𝘯𝘥 𝘩𝘦 𝘱𝘶𝘯𝘪𝘴𝘩𝘦𝘥 𝘩𝘪𝘴 𝘴𝘰𝘯, 𝘢𝘯𝘥 𝘩𝘦 𝘮𝘢𝘥𝘦 𝘩𝘪𝘴 𝘮𝘪𝘯𝘪𝘴𝘵𝘦𝘳 𝘵𝘩𝘦 𝘪𝘯 𝘤𝘩𝘢𝘳𝘨𝘦 𝘰𝘧 𝘬𝘦𝘦𝘱𝘪𝘯𝘨 𝘵𝘩𝘦 𝘵𝘳𝘦𝘢𝘴𝘶𝘳𝘦 𝘴𝘢𝘧𝘦. 𝘌𝘕𝘋" I wonder if anything like this has ever happened in real life. Before reading the next story, i rush towards the bathroom. The moment i close the bathroom door, there was a knock at the main door. I told my mother I was in the bathroom, so she opened it. It was my neighbor and as well as my friend, Rai. I heard mother's and Rai's conversation, Rai wanted Ryan's book for reading. Mother told Rai I was in the bathroom and told her that she could go to my room and get the book she wanted. I hadn't read it, but Rai was my friend, so I let her take it. When I got out of the bathroom, I thought I'd hang out with her. But Rai was already gone. I had nothing to do now so I just slept. I slept till the evening but then my mother's voice woke me up. She was looking worried, and she was looking really, really upset. She looked like she was looking for something. Something very important and precious. I asked my mother what the problem was, and she said that her jewelry which was very expensive and was kept in my room, was stolen. I stood there shocked, not because the jewelry had been stolen, because i knew who it was. It was Rai, and it was obvious. She came to my room to take Ryan's book, but she took my mother's jewelry too, because no one else could steal it. I called Ryan so that we could go to Rai's house together, and we headed to her home. We knocked, and Rai opened the door. She was holding Ryan's book in her hand. "We want to check your house, just for confirming." I told her. She looked confused, she said- "Confirming what?". I told her that my mther's jewelry had been stolen, I told that she was the one who entered my room to take Ryan's book, she got surprised. "Oh?! You think I stole it?" She was angry. Ryan said- "Hey, we don't want to fight, please..." Rai said- "Go on, check my house, there's nothing." I walked forward while Rai and Ryan followed. I checked every room, 'every' single room. Rai helped too, she turned the house upside down, but we found nothing. We were very confused. We didn't find anything in Rai's house. She said- " Are you satisfied, want to check more?" We said no, and got out of her house. We were walking, and I spotted my mother in front of Ryan's house, but I was shocked when I saw a police officer there. We walked there. And the officer had the box of my mom's jewelry. I asked mother what was happening, she said she had called the police to find the jewelry. When I looked at Ryan, he was crying. I was confused how Ryan stole it when he didn't even come at our house today. Then I realized, that Ryan came to our house at yesterday night, he might have taken the jewelry at that time. I asked him why did he do this, he wiped his tears, and told me that his mother was very sick and the doctors wanted a lot of money, he wanted money for mother so he took my mother's jewelry. My mother took the jewelry and we headed back home. I felt really sad for Ryan, and how he is suffering. My mother felt the same all the time. The next day, it was sunday. My mother talked about Ryan with my father. And everyone was sad. My father headed to Ryan's house and asked Ryan's father how much money the doctor was asking for treatment. Ryan's father said it was ₹35,000. Mother and father collected heir money and they paid the bill for treatment. Ryan was very happy and said he won't do such a cruel thing again, and apologized. After that, Ryan's mother was okay, and Ryan could spend time with her once again. At last, it all ends normally and happily.
author: SXMXSH
