title: A Typical Day in 2070
text: Imagine you sleep tired after working full day at the office, and wake up in the future. This is a story about Charlie, a busy person who works in an import-export company. He works most of the day, not having a lot of time for his friends and family. His only concern was to put bread on his family’s table but he would hardly ever spend time with his family. “Good morning!” Says a robot with a screen on it listing the different things you can have- Tea, Ice Tea, Coffee, Cold Coffee and more. A second one is vacuuming the floor and a 50 inch screen shows the calendar- “It’s 2070!?” He yelled and jumped out of the bed, more of a smart bed. He immediately goes out on the streets to see levitating cars and bikes, holographic traffic police and the streets, which were now screens. Technology has skyrocketed in the last 3-4 decades and humans are ﻿ settling on moon as they research on the next mission- settlements on Mars. Humanoids are now citizens and are a part of the population. Robots are stealing a large part of jobs in industries and companies. Technology has made it possible for robots to now develop emotions and feelings, because the need for someone to spend time with, to talk with is increasing among people, as their loved ones grow selfish. Charlie is confused and excited as well, to explore ‘a day in 2070’. He finds his way to a taxi stand. As he was waiting, a flying taxi lands in front of him. He enters to find that there’s no driver but only a screen to select your destination. He selected K-501, Street-9; which was his office address in 2022, which takes him to an isolated location. As he was exploring, Charlie accidentally triggered a pressure sensor on the ground, which opened a secret door, taking him to the basement. A scientist was testing his immortality potion on a monkey, only 550 left in the world. As he approaches the scientist, he is trapped by the security system and instantly loses his consciousness. Charlie woke up in a hospital. He asked the nurse- a robot nurse about what happened. She instantly prints 5 sheets of text about the agreement a person signed about Charlie’s treatment. “It would’ve been the scientist…” he murmurs as the TV grabs his attention. There was a debate going on in the news show about the depletion and destruction of natural resources, plants and wildlife. On one hand, the world had seen exponential growth in technology while on the other hand, no one realized that what would happen to the nature. More than half of the forests were gone and 7296 species had gone endangered since 2022. 2994 species were extinct. Petroleum was exhausted in 2059 and other natural resources were halved. Charlie went out and rented a hotel room to live in. After a couple of hours in his room, he heard a knock on the door. He opened it to see 5 armed men. One of them pushed him aside shouting “This is a robbery! Get outta here. No messing around… Get out!!” Scared and confused he ran out and ended up in the compact streets. They were inhabited by the gangsters, who were against technological development. They would burn down buildings, rob factories and attack laboratories. As he entered the streets, he was instantly met with guns and rifles on his head. He tried to explain to them what he was going through but if only someone would listen. His remaining 150 bucks were stolen and he was thrown out on the road, where no one cared about what was happening, how would they? Most were robots. With a broken leg, bleeding hands and ripped clothes, he was roaming on the streets in search of help. And old man called him from the back “Hey kid! You look badly injured. Here, let’s go home.” Charlie was in a state where no one deserved any trust from him. But he had no choice. He went to the man’s home where he did Charlie’s dressing and gave him medicines, water and food. Charlie asked the man “Today was the most scary and thrilling day in my life. I woke up in the future, got kidnapped and robbed several times, almost died to gangsters and saw some weird things that I am still trying to comprehend.” The man, with a firm smile on his face, replied “Ohh! So you woke up in the future huh? It would’ve been a glitch in the matrix or something. This is becoming more and more common these days because of the weird experiments going on with the tech of this planet. Well, don’t worry. I have a solution.” The man took him to one of his friends. He said “A friend of mine managed to buy a time machine. It can help you. Don’t ask the price though.” Charlie was still traumatized. He followed the man and goes into the chamber of the machine. He feels a couple of electric shocks, and wakes up in his bed the very next second. ﻿ What happened to him within those 24 hours only taught him one thing- the advancements in the future will lead to the vanishing of relations and friends. No love or feelings, only money and development. People won’t care about anyone. Selfishness will hijack the mind of every human on Earth. It was an important lesson for him. He understood what the situation is going to become when people will not give time to their friends, family or relatives. There will be no one to talk with, to share your problems, goods or bads. He got to know that life isn’t long enough and you never know when it will end. You must take out time from your busiest days to sit down, relax and chit-chat with your loved ones. He was now excited to go back to his family and spend time with his wife and kids, have dinner with them, go on trips and enjoy every single bit of life he got. He was relieved to finally be back to the present and was wondering if it was a dream or an actual adventure. It was unreal. He suddenly noticed a note in his hands that read “Don’t worry kid. It’s 2070. Even you should be prepared for this in your old age. It’s normal for people to go through all this in the future. It’s just a ‘typical day in the future’…”
author: yuGGi

title: The matter remains same
text: Today is the fair of their stories. Come on, let's listen too. Gattu: When the eyes opened in the morning. Attu: Yes, early in the morning when the nains opened. Gattu: Hey! Attu you turned my point again. Attu: Yes, because it remained the same. Gattu: Alright. In the morning when the nain opened. Gattu peeps from his house, Look through your house towards the birds in the open sky you also look at those birds Who seems to be the happiest of them all? Attu: All right. Early in the morning all the nains open, Attu peeks from his home, Peeping from my home, To the birds in the open sky. I think, that bird is the happiest. Gattu: Hey Attu, you have turned my point again. I said home not home. Sky was not called sky. Attu: But the same thing happened. Now tell the story further. Gattu: One of these birds wants to be silent. Don't know why he doesn't want to twitter. Attu: Oh Gattu, why is this bird silent? Attu: Oh Gattu, why is the mother of this little bird not giving her permission? Why is she not letting him fly in the sky? Gattu: Don't be silent. Attu: Oh Gattu. You answer. Gattu: It seems that this bird wants to do something of his mind. Might want to fly higher in the sky, But his mother would not allow him. Gattu: Then it turned around, didn't it? Now you would say that the matter remained the same. Before that, let me tell the next story. The mother of this little bird is afraid, Somewhere it does not fly beyond these changes, towards that sun. Attu: Why is the bird's mother protecting him from the sun, across these clouds? Gattu: Oh, you turned the whole thing around again. I said cloud not cloud. The sun was said not the sun. Mother said not mother. Now listen further. This bird queen is very naughty, Gattu: This time, mother has decided, I will not allow this little one to be demonic. As soon as the night falls, it is in the nest to reach, And give him the command of gold directly. Attu: Oh Gattu, the little bird will fall silently into sleep as soon as the night falls. How was this order? But do you know that he got up again yesterday morning? And then go to meet that sun. Gattu: Hey Attu, you have turned the whole thing around again. Now can you tell everyone whether Attu said the same thing again?

title: Lisa And The Bucket
text: “Lisaaa!”called her mother from the other room, Lisa was reading a book about oceans. “Yes mom?”she said as she ran to her. “Your father and I are going out for some shopping; I want you to mop the living room before we come.You’re old enough to take care of yourself, sweetheart” she said soothingly. “Ok!”Lisa chirped. Later on, when her parents left for shopping, Lisa grabbed a water bucket, soap, and a mop. “This’ll be fun!”she sighed, looking around the giant room. She stirred the floor cleaner into the water.Then she dipped the mop in and swirled it around the floor. Lisa had done this for several minutes around her living room. Finally, she finished half of the living room. “Alright, now for the other half!”she cried. She looked down at the bucket, it was empty. “I’ll have to refill it!”she thought to herself. She poured water into the bucket, till it was overflowing. “It’s overflowing!”she yelped, and stopped pouring any more water. But the bucket did not stop overflowing. The water rose higher and higher and began to drip out! After a few minutes of panicking, Lisa jumped up on the couch as the bucket’s overflowing caused a puddle around it! The puddle grew bigger and bigger, till it reached every corner of the closed living room. It began to grow higher… Suddenly, Lisa screamed, small fishes were coming out of the bucket! Then came out octopuses, then stingrays, the room looked like an aquarium! The water was getting higher, enough to reach the couch, just below Lisa’s feet. Lisa had no choice but to climb on top of a nearby stingray, “Oh, hello there!”Lisa cooed while stroking the surprisingly friendly stingray. “ The water is high, but it won’t reach the ceiling in a while, I’ll have to find a way to get to the water bucket, and drain it.”She thought to herself, s he put her hands in the water, and started paddling towards the bucket, but the stingray wouldn’t budge. “I’ll have to find some other way to get to it!”she cried. Just then, a big moon jellyfish came towards her, then did several others, they formed a path to the bucket! Even though it wasn’t ideal to stand on jellyfishes, Lisa had no other choice; the water was almost to the ceiling! She carefully jumped on each of the jellyfishes, as if they were steppingstones. “But how will I drain the water?”she thought aloud. Lisa pondered on this for a while. Just then, she remembered her book about oceans. The book had many interesting topics: jellyfishes, whales, etc. But Lisa’s favorite topic was about whirlpools She learnt that whirlpools could drain out water. “Maybe if I create a whirlpool in the bucket, the water will be all drained out!”she yelped. She carefully stepped on the jellyfishes, clutching the mop the entire time. Lisa stepped on the last jellyfish; the water bucket was directly under her. “Here I go!”she exclaimed, as she dipped the mop into the bucket, and spun it around. The water created a whirlpool, it got bigger, and bigger.The water was lowering. It worked! The jellyfishes, stingrays and fishes were sucked in the bucket. Everything was back to normal. “Lisa!Open the door!”her mother chirped, from outside. She opened the door,and her mother looked around the spotless house “Great job dear!”she said “Thanks mom”Lisa sighed;the magical adventure was over…
author: IZRA SERAH

title: Here come!! Humans: A tale of 21st century jungle
text: Avni... Avni... Rukmi was calling her ten-year-old daughter. But, the little town girl was busy daydreaming about Rudyard Kipling’s Jungle book story. Mom entered the room. Avni beta, have you finished packing for tomorrow’s trip? Yes, mom and I’m very excited about our trip inside a forest. Avni had never visited a jungle before but went to the zoo a few times. There she saw some visitors, littering garbage here and there and teasing the animals. That made her sad. “Avni we need to leave early morning tomorrow,” Mom said. Okay Mom. The day went by and night came, but Avni’s dreams were still on. How the jungle will look in real? Mowgli, Akela, Baloo, Bagheera, and all the other fascinating characters of Jungle book story must be living happily together in the jungle. Sherekhan must be troubling the animals in the jungle. While lost in the scenes of Jungle book story, she went into the deep sleep. Avni, with her family, arrived at the forest of Uttarakhand and in an open-roofed gypsy, they entered the forest. The sky was blue with patches of white clouds; uncountable lush green trees were everywhere. Our safari jeep was moving slowly on the spiral tracks of the jungle. Melodious sound of bird’s chirping was breaking the silence of the jungle. The swarm of beautiful butterflies was spreading colours throughout nature. The night sky was full of twinkling stars and forest rest house campus embedded with hundreds of fire-beetles. The mesmerizing sound of flowing river left Avni stunned. She felt like, she was in heaven. The next morning, while on jungle safari, a whispering sound, caught Avni’s attention. Two birds on a tree were talking: Look! Another group of humans is here to disturb us. They too will tease and shout at us to get our attention. “Yes, you are right,” Said the other bird. What will happen, if someone breaches and disturb their life? If they don’t disturb us, only then they will be able to adore our life and beauty. But, being human, their only concern is enjoyment. “Just ignore them,” said the other bird. A few yards ahead, a mongoose was struggling to get rid of a plastic glass tucked around its neck. It was crying and saying, “Humans are turning our homes into dumping yards like they do in their cities.” They keep on throwing plastic wrappers, bottles, glasses, and other waste in the jungle too. Instead of enjoying the beauty and peace of nature, humans play loud music, as if they are in a club disco. “What have they come here for, if they can’t enjoy the serenity of nature?” said monkeys sitting atop a tree? Soon, our gypsy stopped where all the other gypsies were gathered. Look there is a tiger in the bushes; some of the visitors were shouting and pointing to the bushes. Deer grazing in the grassland were looking anxiously at that human crowd and were in a dilemma, as to where the threat would come from. The tiger was also feeling insecure, as if it was unable to camouflage in nature anymore. All this made the deer run away from the spot, and the tiger was left without prey for yet another day. When I entered their villages or towns, they tried to kill me. What now, when they entered my jungle and disturbed the life of mine and other animals, the tiger was thinking? Suddenly, the creaking sound of an alarm clock broke Avni’s dream and woke her up. Oh!! It was a dream, said Avni to herself. Avni went out to the living room and told the parents about her dream. Beta, Your dream is the reality, what the wild animals in the jungle feel every day. "Some tourists are not sensitive enough as to, where they are going and how to behave there," said the father. People should be sensitized and educated about forests, and the life of wild animals through films, books, blogs, and photographs that represent the real beauty of animals in their natural habitat without human interference. Father told Avni. Yes, papa, I will do my bit to make my friends sensitive about the lives of animals in the jungle and will write an article for my school magazine on, how humans should behave in nature. Very nice Avni. Now go and get ready for the jungle trip.
author: Yashneil Murari

title: A Friend's Betrayal
text: "Hey Kristie!" I shouted. "Oh hey!" said Kristie. She was my friend since childhood. I always get a good feeling when I am around her. We're more like sisters. We are in class 6; that too in the same school. But, I don't know why I'm always scared to lose this friend of mine. "Hey Ari, you seem lost somewhere" she added. "No!" I replied hurriedly, coming back to my senses. I was again thinking about losing her. My mom called me and I had to go. The next day, at school. I giggled in happiness as I talked with Maria, another friend of mine. Then comes Mark; and Kristie. Our Annual Examination had just ended. Just two days were left for the week to end. And the next time when we'll visit school we'll be in seventh. Tomorrow was the result day. All my friends were great students; not only according to grades, but also by behaviour. We were popular as the 'A's' in our school because of our grades. On the day of the result, we were very excited. We met as soon as the meeting ended. After taking permission from our parents, we agreed upon a sleepover; and as we had a lot of time we went to stroll in the park. We were roaming about talking with each other. "Hey Ari, what's your total percentage?" asked Kristie. "98%" I said. Her face turned pale. "What percentage did you get? I asked back. "90%" she said gloomily. I know it troubled her that she got less marks. "What about you guys?" I said referring to Maria and Mark. "95%" said Maria. "94%" said Mark. Kristie's head hung low. I wanted to console her but couldn't. The sleepover went well but, Kristie was not feeling so happy. Days had passed. Today, it was the first day of the school's new session. There were some changes, change in room, class, teachers and there's one more, Kristie's behavior was changed. She was ignoring me. My greatest fear was coming true. Was I going to lose her? I tried to approach her several times but she kept ignoring me. The next day, everything was back to normal. Kristie was talking to me with the same enthusiasm as before. I thought maybe she was having a mood off. "Ari, wanna go to the cafeteria with us?" asked Kristie. "Why not?" I said and followed her. We chit-chatted with each other, laughing and chuckling every moment, but this wasn't to last long. Sometime, if not now, we had to deviate. Our term exam was near, we were studying hard. Everyone wanted to be the top scorer; especially Kristie, she wanted to be on the top; but fate had other plans in store for her. She came to the school like always but was never absent. She had changed a lot. She didn't mingle with me anymore. I was sad but didn't show it a lot to others. It was one day before our first exam; it was the Science exam. Kristie came to me. Her eyes teary and burning red with rage. They were penetrating deep into my soul, sending a shiver down my spine. Her hands clenched into a fist and she spoke, "You are the reason for this condition of mine! If you want us to be friends again, then score less than me." I was shedding tears till then and she left me there. I was broken into a million pieces. My worst fear had come true. But now I was not as weak as before. The next day, I gave my exam as if nothing had happened. Soon, our exam ended. The results were out, I was the top ranker of the class. Kristie was enraged, but she didn't dare to summon me. I went to Kristie and said, "One doesn't need to be the last ranker to be one's friend. We're not friends anymore." with that I left her there, to meet other friends of mine. Seeing that, she broke into tears, but it was too late.
author: ARSHI MAULI
