title: The Stubborn Horse
text: At some time in the past, about a few years ago from today, a horse took birth in a stable near a barn. The foal had walnut-brown skin and had beautiful black main. The foal's main shifted in the air and gave a fiery look to it. This reminded the owner of the stables and horses about fire blaze and thus named him Blaze. After a couple of years, Blaze turned out to become a healthy and strong horse, and quite stubborn. However, he had great control over his speed and was faster than the rest of the horses in the stable. Blaze's cousins were jealous of this, his parents were proud of him, and another horse from the group called the wise horse, was worried for him. He was the eldest of all, responsible and was very prudent. Everyone had independent opinions, but why was the wise horse worried? One day, the owner forgot to close the door of the stable at night. All the horses ran away from the stable, including Blaze. They all headed to the forest and of course, because there was a lot of green grass to eat, but none knew about the wild animals as the horses never heard of them before, except the wise horse, but none listened to him. The wise horse had no choice but to go with them for their safety. When they reached the forest in the morning, all of them took a rest. After a while, they saw a cheetah. Quickly, everyone hid behind the trees since they were instructed to by the wise one. Blaze, being very boastful and careless as well, went fearlessly towards the cheetah and said, 'I'm the fastest animal you'll ever meet.'' At this, the cheetah came up with a plan, what was it? Cheetah said, 'You indeed are, but are you as fast as me?' At this Blaze was boiling with anger and decided to hold a competition between them to find out who was the fastest among them. This was what the cheetah wanted. The wise horse tried to stop Blaze, since they could not trust any wild animal. But we all know that Blaze was very stubborn, and he hesitated. And so, the race began! Cheetah was on the lead, he was running at his comfortable pace and yet, Blaze couldn't catch up with him. You could barely see Blaze. The cheetah thought, 'This horse is a fool! But everything is working as I planned. I'm going to have a scrumptious meal today.' After thinking of this, the cheetah started to do the next step of his plan. What was it? The cheetah stopped and let Blaze run ahead. As soon as he took the lead, the cheetah took a big leap and pounced on the horse. Scared, Blaze ran and ran and ran even faster, but it was of no use. Blaze felt as if he was poked by a bunch of random sharp things and then eventually, he took his last breath and passed away. 'I told you so,' said the wise horse now. 'don't be so stubborn, else that would be the reason of your harm,' What about the other horses, you might be wondering. Well, they all headed back where they came from right away and never showed up in another forest ever again. They also learned that listening to your elders and obeying them is the best way to prevent loss or harm to yourself in the future. Unlike Blaze, we should think before we act.
author: Rishita Bijalwan
illustrator: André Kieswetter; Chandana Bandara  Samarakoon; Kishor Joshi; Priya Kuriyan; Rajiv Eipe; San srei nou ch nou ch; Siddhi   Vartak; Stephen Wallace; Vishnu  M Nair

title: The Little Ant
text: She is not afraid to work hard. She lifts up heavy weights. She doesn't show helplessness. She brings grains after a lot of hard work. She loves sweets. She brings food together. She eats food together. The ants live together. Discipline is their precious virtue. They are friends with all types of creatures. After all, they are dear to everybody! When the elephant tried to control everyone by showing anger, they gave him a great lesson. Whoever takes up a fight with them won't come back in one piece. Whoever helped them, the ants never forgot their aid. The ants' houses are delightful too, like a beautiful and unusual world. They work, day and night. They rest when they are tired. Every day they want to discover something new. This is their biggest virtue. They work in all seasons. They never let laziness get to them. All we have learned from the ant is that- "Hard work pays always off."
author: Aaruli Wadia
illustrator: David Chisha; Deepa Balsavar; Padmanabh; Samrat Halder; Steven McKimmie; Wiehan de Jager; Yuwak  Shrestha

title: Two Friends
text: Once upon a time there were two friends named Mia and Maya. They were very good friends. They went shopping together, wore same clothes, played games together, but gradually their choices got different. They went shopping with other friends. One day it was Maya's birthday but she was sad as Mia was not with her. Not a single birthday was there that Mia was not there with her. In the morning Maya's mother wished her and asked "What type of cake you want". She said "Nothing" and went to her room. In the afternoon, Mia's mother called to wish and said "Happy birthday dear" May said "Thanks aunt". Mia's mother said sorry dear, Mia didn't wished youas she went to London for her studies, Maya said "Its alright aunt". After a week Mia was coming to surprise Maya but her plane crashed. There was a call from the hospital that Mia is admitted. Maya ran to the hospital saw Mia. She looked very weak and tired. Maya asked "Why were you coming here if something had happened to you then what will I do?" Mia said in a weak voice "I came because of you as we forgot about our true friendship, we didn't gave time to each other and we did not tell our problems to each other." Maya nodded and said "I just hope and pray that such an occasion never arises again in our lives!"
author: Lavanya Duggal
illustrator: Abin  Shrestha; Canato Jimo; Jesse  Breytenbach; Jitendra Thakur; Suvidha Mistry

title: Wherever you go, I will follow
text: This is Jasmine, a dog and she is very loyal. Her owners are Sandhya Reddy and Jagdish Reddy. They have had Jasmine for about 1 - 2 years. But Jasmine does not like them. She is unsociable and is not good at communicating with people. Although they gave 110%, Jasmine never got close to them. Jasmine would always run away from home. To avoid losing her Jagdish put a collar around her neck that said " Belongs to Sandhya Reddy and Jagdish Reddy. 2042, Prestige Garden Bay, Yelahanka, Bangalore. Please return if found. ". Sandhya noticed that whenever she ran away she would go south... But one day, out of the blue, Jasmine managed to remove her collar using her paws and she ran off. After a meeting, Sandhya came downstairs to check on Jasmine but she could not find her... She was worried so she told Jagdish. They searched for her day and night, but couldn't find her... So they decided to print some missing posters and pasted them around the neighbourhood. When nobody found her, Sandhya and Arnav got super nervous. One day, a bolt from the blue, Jagdish got a call. It was an unknown number. But after lifting the call, they got very happy. A person had called as they had found Jasmine and wanted to return her. They decided to meet the next day at a park at 5:00 pm to retrieve the dog. They waited all day for this. Then it happened, the clock hit 5:00, and a man was approaching. `I finally get to meet Jasmine` thought Jagdish. And then they met her. They were so happy, but she wasn't. She was angry that she got caught. She just wanted to be free.. When they asked the man where he had found Jasmine, he said that he found her behind a trash can on the streets eating some used dog food. right next to the trash can there was a missing poster of the same dog. So I took the poster and the dog home, gave it a bath and called the number that was on the poster. Once again Sandhya and Jagdish thanked the man and went back home. They thought they were living happily ever after, but no they were wrong. A few days after the incident Jagdish got an unexpected call. It turned out to be the same person that gave them Jasmine back. The man said, " Hello again, My. name is Manas. I work in a dog shelter where we train dogs. I remember your dog, that you named Jasmine. But her real name is.. " Before the man could continue Jagdish got angry and said, " Excuse me, you think that jasmine, our dog, was previously yours. HAHA... Ya right. If you think we are gonna give her to you, wait that will be in your dreams. ", and he hung up the phone. Just then Sandhya came to the scene and cooled down Jagdish. On the other hand, Manas was crying but later on, he got some confidence and was determined to get his favourite dog, Tara back. 6 days later, he called Jagdish again, but this time he used a voice changer and used a different tone. Jagdish did not realise that it was Manas and continued talking. They decided to meet at a mall at 11:00 pm. the next day. The next day when they met Jagdesh realised he had met Manas. He got Jasmine along with him. Of all the things that could happen, Jasmine ran towards Madav as she recognized him. But then Jagdish calmed down and got shocked. Jasmine or shall I say, Tara, got very happy. But suddenly Madav got a call and had to go because of some important work that came up. So he said goodbye to Jagdish and Sandhya and went off. But Tara followed him and did not stop. She ran very fast. Jagdish and Sandhya did not stop her as they wanted her to be happy. ﻿ THANK YOU READING HAVE A GREAT DAY AHEAD THE END
author: Hima Rockz
illustrator: Abhishek Choudhury; Angie & Upesh; Dushyant Mahajan; Kaanchan Prashanth; Keo  Phunphalla; Partho Sengupta; Rajiv Eipe; Sarthak Sinha; Siddhi   Vartak; Unknown  Person

title: A Friend
text: "Hey dear, stop, I can’t catch you, you run so fast!" Manu was running after a puppy near his house. It was only few weeks old. Manu somehow managed to catch the puppy. "You are tiny but can run so fast! We're friends now! " Manu happily walked back to his home with the puppy. "Why have you brought home a puppy?! Father will be so angry. He hates dogs! ", Manu’s Ma said. Manu replied..."No ma, it is very small. Baba will not get angry. It was alone and might get hurt. So I brought it home." Manu happily started to play with the puppy. Manu’s Ma couldn’t stop him when she saw that he was so happy to get a cute and lovely friend. They cleaned the puppy and gave it some milk to drink. In the evening, Manu was playing with the puppy. His Baba returned home from office. He was very tired. He got very angry when he saw the puppy. He quickly took it outside their home and left it there. Manu became so sad. Next morning, Manu’s Baba saw that Manu’s face still looked sad while sleeping. He went outside and saw that the puppy was still on the road! He felt bad for it. He thought maybe it also needed a friend. "My friend is back! " Manu was so happy! He said, " Thank you Baba! I love you!" Manu’s Ma and Baba were happily looking at him and smiling.
author: Spandan  Pal
illustrator: Anushka Kulkarni; Ashika Singh; Diya V; Isuri Dayaratne; Manisha Naskar; Noyonika Banerjee; Sarthak Sinha; Shivam Choudhary; Soumya Menon; Sushant Ahire; Suvidha Mistry

title: Mojo And Neethu
text: Once in a village there was a little girl named Neethu. She was 10 years old and her kind and soft nature were well appreciated by her parents. She does not had many friends, "kind of a lonely soul". Often her parents advised Neethu to get mingled with other students in her class, but for some reasons it didn't worked well. The next day when Neethu looked at the calendar, she saw, it is going to be her birthday in 2 days time. Her mother asked, "Neethu, what do you want for your Birthday". That very moment Neethu knew exactly what she wants, she always wanted to have a pet, a puppy for herself. Neethu replayed, " Mom can I have a puppy as my birthday present". Mother replayed, "Yes my dear". Neethu's heart filled with joy. Neethu's patents booked a cute little puppy for her and requested to get the puppy delivered to their home on her birth day. Finally the day came, many family and relatives were invited for a small get-together on this occasion. They all gifted Neethu with presents like books, toys and sweet boxes. But she was eager to have her puppy. Suddenly the door bell ran, ding..dong, she ran towards the front door. It was the delivery boy from the pet shop with a cute little box. she can't wait any longer, the delivery boy opened the package and handed over a cute little puppy. Neethu hugged the puppy. Her parents were so happy to see her joy. Neethu found a cute little tag on puppy neck its says "Happy Birthday Dear Neethu". They all agreed to named puppy "Mojo". Her parents also bought Mojo, puppy food and some toys to play with. Yes it was the most memorable birthday Neethu ever had. That night Neethu was so glad after seeing Mojo sleeping next to her bed. She can't able to take her eyes off from him. Next day Neethu was so lazy to go school as she wanted to play with Mojo and train him. But her parents convinced her to go school and made her understand the importance of education in once life. Then it was a routine for Neethu to spend time with Mojo early morning before school and after she comes back. Both Neethu and Mojo became so close and their bonding was sweet and lovely to watch. They started to play, eat and study together. Then it came the pets day at school when Neethu decided to take Mojo to school, all her class mates loved Mojo and they started to like Neethu. Mojo won first prize for pet running competition which was conducted on pets day at school. Their friendship has gained a lot of reputation beyond the school. On a weekend Neethu and Mojo went out to a near by supermarket. She found a strange man following them. She doesn't give him much attention. Then suddenly a car came and some strange people dragged her into the van. She was crying..."Mojo help me". Mojo ran after the vehicle which directed Mojo to an abandoned building. Mojo was able to smell Neethu and ran back for help. Mojo ran towards home, Neethu's parents surprised to see Mojo without Neethu around him. He started barking..Bow..Bow..Bow..Bow. Mojo was showing unusual behaviour by then parents understood that something bad has happened to Neethu. Mojo knew that he had got parents attention, he ran towards the abandoned building where Neethu was held captive. Neethu's parents also informed the police about the incident. Police surrounded the building and quickly ran into the building, Mojo was in-front and he found Neethu tied to a chair. Quickly they untie Neethu and all the culprits were arrested. Neethu couldn't control her emotion and started hugging and kissing Mojo. She knew that it was Mojo who had saved her life. Their friendship grew stronger and they lived happily ever after.
author: Tamai Tresa Varkey
illustrator: Nicolene  Louw; Candace di Talamo; Kavya  Bagga; Marleen  Visser; Natasha  Mehra; Santosh Pujari; Shamim Ahmed; Siddhi   Vartak

title: The Story of Master Chef Mini
text: It was a hot afternoon in the busy town of Kisanpur. Mini, who was almost 10 years old, returned home from school and hurried to their family's small eatery to help her parents, who worked there. She was the eldest of her siblings, with a younger sister and two brothers. Mini, unlike most girls in her village, did go to school. Although her parents were illiterate, they valued education and sent her there. Mini did not think it was sensible; after all, neither her friends nor their neighbour's children went to school. But being taught to obey her parents, she did not protest. Her first day at school was daunting, but she had slowly familiarized herself. She had learned to read and write many words, and an inner desire to be a wise and respected person was born. But now, she had to chop the vegetables so her mother could cook them. Her mother was an excellent cook, and so were her grandmother and aunt. Papa often joked that they came from a long line of royal cooks. Mini loved everything her Ma made, but her favourite was seviyan, or 'Vermicelli' as she had seen in a book. The sweet and milky taste, with crushed almonds and cashews that her uncle bought from a local trader, Mini could eat it all day. Ma did not make it often, but when she did, Mini danced with happiness. As Mini entered the kitchen at the eatery, she saw Ma making rotis. Ma turned and smiled at her and asked, “Mini! how was your school, dear?” Mini replied, "I had fun. We learned about the different spices in India. Ma, you use many of them when you cook, don't you?" Ma said, “yes, I do." Minni asked, “Even in seviyan?” Ma laughed, "Yes, even in seviyan. Cardamom, cinnamon, and rose petals give a lovely flavour. But the magic ingredient is love. It makes any dish better." She continued, "When you are a little older, I will also teach you how to make seviyan. Now, why don't you take some tomatoes and potatoes from the basket and chop them? Be careful while cutting.” “Sure”, said Mini. She hummed a popular song as she chopped the vegetables and asked her mother, "Ma, are you going to make seviyan today?" Ma sighed dramatically as she stirred a pot of gravy and said, "If you insist." Mini shrieked with delight and hugged her mother. Mini loved the eatery. Her family ran this tiny place at the corner of the market street for as long as she could remember. Even though it was cramped and dusty, it was another home for her. When she was very young, she had asked her Papa why they did not make a big restaurant, where it was big, and they had lots of space and people did not make a crowd. Papa looked at her with twinkling eyes and said, "when you grow up and become rich, we will have a big restaurant. "I will become a brilliant and famous chef and open a very, very big restaurant" "Yes, you will," Papa said and grinned at her. Many years passed, and Mini was nineteen years old, studied at a local college, and had cooking skills that rivalled her mother's. Ma had taught her to cook many things, including her favourite seviyan. Mini had many ambitions and still held on to the dream of owning a restaurant and being a master chef. One day, a family friend, Sunil Uncle, a schoolteacher, and his wife, Saima Aunty, invited Mini and her family to their house for dinner. They took off their chappals and entered the living room. It was decorated with bookshelves and pretty curtains, and a carpet. As a gift to their host, Mimi had brought a dish of sweet and gooey seviyan. Sunil Uncle's daughter, Rita, was also there. She and Mini have been best friends since they were little. Rita was studying to get a degree in engineering. She, too, was well aware of Mini's cooking skills and was eager to taste dessert. They had a lovely dinner together. Finally, for dessert, Saima and Rita served the seviyan that Mini had made in bowls to everyone. "Ah, this is so delicious!" exclaimed Sunil Master. "I agree; it even has a heavenly smell. You are a brilliant cook!" said his wife to Ma. Sunil Uncle's daughter, Rita, was also there. She and Mini have been best friends since they were little. Rita was studying to get a degree in engineering. She, too, was well aware of Mini's cooking skills and was eager to taste the dessert. They had a lovely dinner together. Finally, for dessert, Saima and Rita served the seviyan that Mini had made in bowls to everyone. "Ah, this is so delicious!" exclaimed Sunil Master. "I agree; it even has a heavenly smell. You are a brilliant cook!" said his wife to Ma. Ma beamed at them and said, "No, no, no, it is not I who has made this, but Mini prepared this for you." "Do you like to cook, Mini?" asked Saima Aunty. "Yes, I do." Answered Mini. "You really should go to the culinary school. You have talent and will become very successful with some training." Sunil Uncle said. "I would like to go there, but you see, it is costly and difficult for us to afford," said Mini. Papa added with a tired sigh," We also have to think of other things. Our two children are still in school, and my brother has also fallen sick recently. We are barely managing to pay for his treatment. Maybe, one day, we can send Mini to the culinary school, but certainly not now." During Papa's speech, Saima Aunty had looked thoughtfully at Mini and, in a slightly pensive voice, said, "I have a friend who works in a culinary school near Rita's college. That school holds food competitions yearly to give students scholarships and pays for their training. I think that you should try, Mini." "A scholarship? If that's the case, I think Mini can enter a culinary school." Papa said. Ma was also thoughtful, "Yes, Mini, if you are getting a scholarship, then you should definitely try." Mini agreed, but an important question lingered in her mind. "What should I make? I know many things but am confused about what to make." "I know the answer to that question! Make the seviyan that you have brought today. You will certainly win then," cried Sunil Uncle. "Do you think so?" asked Mini hopefully. "I am sure," said Sunil Master. Ten years later, Mini reflected on how her life had changed. Now, she was standing by the door of her own restaurant, Cinnamon's Bakery and Eatery. The seviyan delighted the judges at that competition. And today, Master chef Mini Aggarwal was famous all over the world. But more important was the smiles on her parent's faces and the warm feeling of believing and achieving her dream.
author: AAERA ASIF
illustrator: Angie & Upesh; Ankitha Kini; Kaveri Gopalakrishnan; Lauren   Nel; Nimret Handa; Rajeev Verma 'Banjara'; Ram Soni; Ravi Gupta; Ruchi Shah; Shamim Ahmed; Shivam Choudhary; Students of  Himalayan Public School; Upamanyu  Bhattacharyya

title: LITTLE SISTER
text: Being the eldest daughter, Leah always struggled to get her family's attention. Her little sister, Heal was being the centre of attraction. But Leah always loved her sister to bits. Their bond was unbreakable. They were best friends. One day, Leah and Heal went to the playground. As Leah moved away to buy ice creams for them, Heal, being a naughty mouse jumped and tripped over a rock. Seeing this, a kind woman, rushed towards Heal and helped her. Unaware of all this, Leah saw the lady holding Heal's hands and thought she was getting kidnapped. Without wasting another moment, Leah rushed and pushed the lady. She got startled and apologised. Heal looked at Leah with sparkling eyes and said-"L-Lee, (as that's how Heal addressed her sister) I t-tripped over a r-rock and that w-woman helped me". A wave of guilt rushed inside Leah. She ran and apologised to the kind lady and she forgave. On the way back home, Leah bought quite a lot of toys for Heal. That night, Leah rocked her sister to bed and went back to her room. She was quite tired which resulted in her drifting off to her dreamland. Not so long, Heal came crying and jumped on to Leah's bed. Startled by the sound, Leah woke up and took Heal into her arms. She asked-"What happened, Charm?" Heal replied,-"L-Lee, there is a-a big m-m-monster under my b-bed. Leah laughed and pampered her little sister.
author: Rejaputhri R S
illustrator: Abin  Shrestha; George Supreeth; Lavanya  Naidu; Shamim  Ahmed; Zainab Tambawalla

title: The Reality Of Success
text: (Based on a true story) So as we all know that becoming something great or just being successful in life is a big hassle, but still those how want to become something great or do something big, has to do a lot of hard work and go through a lot of pressure. So in this story you are going to learn about an Indian boy who wants to become an astronaut while facing all of life problems, but will he be able to?? Let's find out. Aahan was an ambitious child who just turned 13 years old and felt that he is now an teenager so he can do anything he desires or wishes for (as he saw in many American tv shows) but he forgot that he lives in India not in America. And if you know anything about India, you should know that the parents here are not even close to those of Americans. This was the year 2022 and you all might know that the two last years were haunted with Covid-19, and this also led his parents to buy him a laptop for his studies. But what they didn't know was that there child was getting spoiled by the very own thing that was suppose to get him on a right path. Moreover he started to bunk his classes. Now this isn't a big problem if he was doing it on a small scale but no. He bunked every single class of his and moreover didn't even completed his work. On exam days he cleverly cheated from the internet. With his tricks He was able to pass 6th and 7th grade with good marks. But all good things come to an end, and that what happened the wrath of covid calmed. And the year was 2022. Now Aahan wasn't always like this, before covid Aahan was one of the smartest kid in the class he was obedient and was always praised by his teachers and the thought of bunking a class never came to his mind. But now he is naughty, aggressive, still doesn't bunk study periods but is never present in any of the activity period. And considering he just turned 13 this must be the side effects of adolescence but it was mostly because of his laptop. Now offline classes started as he entered 8th grade. On the first day of the school he woke up late because of his habits but somehow managed to reach his school, he was so happy to see his friends after so long and flabbergasted to see how old they are now. He immediately goes and sits with his best friend. Some days past by and he starts to realize that his friends are in a way worse condition then him, but then also without any second thought he started using abusive language and even formed a group. Now this all was really bad but at least he was alright in his studies. Aahan was in a bad if not the worse group in the whole class. But it wasn't affecting his studies right? Well around his periodic (20marks) exam he started having feelings for this girl Shakti and the thing is, this girl was really not a good girl she had a really bad history which Aahan didn't had the knowledge of. So he tried to become her love partner. He was so desperate to be with her that he watched her in the middle of the lecture and that girl also watched him they started to bound, after some days the girl gave Aahan personal her number. As I said earlier Aahan was not a bad person nor were his intentions but he was really gullible, which meant he easily got trapped in her trap. They started to chat for just work purpose but, One day she asked him if he really loves her and he of course said yes she replied with a yes too. They now chatted for one to two hours straight. this was really bad cause his exams were started but instead of studying he chatted with her. But after one or two exams she broke up with him, he was so devastated that he couldn't even study properly he was filled with sadness and depression. And this depression became worse when he got to know that he barely passed two starting exams and had around 15 marks in other subjects. This doesn't sound like a big deal for someone who is average but Aahan was counted as the topper of his class, so his reputation also got worse in front of his teachers. And if this wasn't enough for a child like Aahan, the matter of his thing with Shakti also got to the class teacher and to his parents. Now his parents didn't hit him or anything they just stopped talking to him and were really disappointed in him now he was more devastated the ever. He even thought of taking his life but didn't. At this point it seems like it can't get any more worse but it did, Shakti now started to date his best friend, and he couldn't do anything about it. His sadness and all now turned into anger and jealousy. He was so keen on taking revenge that he forgot about his studies. This resulted in really bad marks in his half-year exam but after that too he learned nothing and still wanted to ruining his friend's relationship. His want to take revenge was not worth it, because after the final exam he wasn't able to end it neither he got much marks and was barely able to pass 8th grade. This let him to finally realize that this whole "dating girl" was nothing but a big distraction. With the new session he promised to himself to be on the top of his class again and not get trapped in these kind of things. He started his new session with renewed motivation. This time without trying to make a GF. This time he got 91% in his half year exam, which was the highest in the class and even his parents were happy now but he wasn't satisfied with it, but anyway he knew that the final exam means the most so he targeted for that and worked really hard. But he didn't got as much he only got around 93% which was really disappointing for him. He couldn't put his finger on the problem, "I left the dating world so what was the problem?" he asked to himself. But then it hit him, there was not one but many problems. You see he might had left trying to find his life partner, but his bad habit were still there he was always engulfed with his friends and didn't gave much attention to what the teacher was teaching, he didn't started to study until last day, was always on his laptop browsing through social media, and just wanted to live in the comfort zone of life. After all of this unfolded in front of his eyes he started realizing his true potential. And as they all say "its never too late for correcting your mistakes", he did just that, he started working really hard, made coding his hobby, got in good physic, and stopped staying up late. And as a result to all of that hard work he finally scored 99% in his final exam of 10th grade, he was so happy, because not only he topped in his whole class but in the entire 10th grade. Now learnt the truth, he completed his school with flying colors. Now in the break of choosing the right college, he was thinking of what to become then suddenly he remembered his dream of becoming an astronaut, but around the time of his breakup and everything, he got to know that to become one, he had to do three jobs first and only then he will be eligible to apply for becoming an astronaut, but after all that happened he realized that anything is possible if you work really hard for it. So he applied to an engineering college and after some tough years finally became an astronaut.
author: Anamay

title: Ajay's Luck
text: He wants his life to be interesting but doesn't want to take any risks in his life. He worked in a company as a secretary which offered him a good salary. After coming to home he would stretch on his sofa taking rest and watching television. He does all his work. In his work, he wasn't dependent on anyone. Having friends isn't important to him. His life was going as easy as ABC...... In the evening, he was walking in the street. He suddenly heard a sound. He got to know that there was a problem. Since he was not in the idea of being at risk, he continued moving. All of a sudden, a man with a covered face came running to Ajay and started intimidating to give him his wallet. He was frightened and gave the wallet. After this incident, he was threatened. He was confused whether he should give a complaint to cops or not. But he decided not to, since he knew there was nothing important in the wallet except a thousand rupees and a dollar which was believed to be lucky. He quickly came back home with fear. He was thinking about the dollar. He kept it with him always. He thought that because of it only he had luck in his life. Now it’s gone and there is no luck in his life. He wasn’t able to sleep that night. The next day, he went to work. There he met his colleague Kishor, but didn’t want to share the previous day’s incident. Kishor conversed and suddenly asked him, “Ajay, Did you bring a new wallet today.” He was shocked and wondered why Kishor asked about this. He kept silent and continued his work. Some days later, Ajay went to a market to buy some grocery items where he saw his classmate Dinesh. Dinesh talked to him and asked him, “Hey, Did you lose much money that day!!” Listening this, Ajay was startled again. He didn't answer him. While he came back home, he started wondering how both of them got to know about this. He couldn’t sleep that night since he was wondering about that incident. The next day, in his company, he went to his company’s manager’s cabin and met Mr. Raghav. He asked Ajay, “Ajay, Have you not taken rest last night?” Ajay answered him casually, “No sir. I did” He asked him again, “ You may have taken a leave today.” Ajay stopped for a while. Mr. Raghav continued, “Are you still not out from that robbery incident?” Ajay was shocked again. He kept quiet and came out of the cabin. He kept thinking about that. After he came back home, he worried about his lucky dollar. He thought now he is in danger as it is not with him. Then Ram, his classmate, came to meet him. He said to Ajay, “I felt worried when you lost your lucky dollar. I know that it was lucky to you but now it’s not with you. Don’t worry..... It’s alright.” This also shocked Ajay. After Ram left his home, he wasn’t able to understand what was happening. Suddenly he got a call from an acquaintance named Suresh. He casually talked to him asking, “Don’t worry about your luck. It’s better you believe in your hard work and success will reach you.” This again shocked Ajay. He didn’t react to him, instead he kept quiet. After which, he tried to sleep that night but couldn’t. The next day, he didn’t go to work either. He revised all the incidents and wondered how those people who were just acquaintances became aware about that robbery. He kept thinking about this for a long time. Not able to understand, he was just startled. He thought he should meet them again asking how they got to know about the incident. That day, he again met Kishor. He was not able to stop him from asking Kishor about how he got to know that his wallet was lost. He asked him. For which Kishor answered, “I became aware of this from Dinesh.” “Are you talking about our classmate Dinesh?” “Yes. I’m happy you remember him.” “Alright. Do you know where he lives?” “Sorry I don’t.” He then went to meet Dinesh but wasn’t able to find him. He wandered in the whole city but was unsuccessful to find him. Finally, with the shopkeeper’s help, he found Dinesh’s home. He tried to talk to him but Dinesh was busy. He was then able to do it after several hours. Finally he asked him, “Dinesh, Did you tell Kishor about my wallet and it was lost? And how do you know about that?” He said, “I got to know about that from Mr. Raghav. Do you know him?” “Yes, I know. He is my company’s manager. But how do you know him?” “I have known him since I was also the secretary of the company once.” “Oh. Thank you” Afterwards, he quickly moved to his company and asked the manager the same. For which he answered, “Ajay. I got to know about the robbery incident one week ago. I guess it was Ram who told me.” “Ram! But...” “Yes, he’s my neighbor. He told me that you have also lost a dollar.” “Yes. That was believed to bring luck and fortune, but now it’s not with me.” He knew Ram’s house, so he quickly moved there. He started asking him also, “How do you know that my dollar got lost?” He then pointed to the name of Suresh who was an acquaintance. Then Ajay tried to find Suresh. But since he was an acquaintance, he found it hard to find him. He remembered when he called him that night. So, quickly he got his phone to call him. Suresh answered him after three missed calls. Then he asked him, “Please let me know about how you became aware that I have lost my luck?” “Ajay, do you remember I called you that night?” “Yes, I do. But tell me, how.....” “It’s you only, who made me aware of this.” Ajay was shocked because he thought he hadn't told anybody about this. Suresh said, “Remember that night, I told you not to worry about your luck. And try to recall that evening also, when a man intimidated you for your wallet.” “Oh! Suresh, how come you know?” “And you lost a thousand rupees with your lucky dollar. Do you think now your luck is gone?” “Ah, not really. But that was lucky when it was with me.” “So now there is no need for that, right?” After this, Suresh ended the call. Ajay was lost in his thoughts. He kept wondering how Suresh, an acquaintance, described the whole scene. He wanted to meet Suresh. For that he again tried to find him. He was lucky this time. He met Suresh, and kept thinking for a while. Suresh said, “Did you identify me? I’m the same person who took your wallet.” To Ajay, it was a mystery and wasn’t able to understand. He then said, “Really, where is it and why did you do that?” “To teach you the value of friends and well-wishers.” He worried about his dollar and said, “Do you know how lucky that dollar is?” “Ah! But do you know how important are your friends in life? You don’t know. Remember all those friends – Kishor, Dinesh, Mr. Raghav, Ram and the last me.” “Yes, we all played a trick on you to teach you the lesson. But think of your friends who make you happier than the dollar.”Ajay stopped for a while. He returned him his dollar. Ajay returned home, and thought about Suresh’s matters. He remembered all his friends whom he tried to ignore but they all wanted to befriend him. He thought he was lucky to get such friends in his life. Without the lucky dollar also, he can be happy with his friends. He wanted to apologise to them. So, the next day he met everyone and apologised. He didn’t keep that dollar with him but his friends. He didn’t think he was unlucky anymore. He also thanked everyone for the trick by which he got his friends. After these incidents, Ajay was a good friend to all and helped everyone with a good heart.
author: Yuvashree R
illustrator: dej2bdj2bd ieci; Philip  Chummar; Yuvashree R

title: The Good Friend
text: Long ago there lived two friends - Sonu and Monu. Sonu was a sincere and hard-working man and was so he prospered. Monu on the other hand,was lazy and shirked work, so he had little to survive by. Monu was very jealous of Sonu's wisdom and development. As days passed, Monu's jealousy grew. He kept doing some or other things to trouble Sonu. One day, it dawned on Sonu that Monu was breeding contempt for him. Being a good man, he decided to shift to some other place. He brought a piece of land which had an old well and settled there as a preacher of good will. Soon, people began to flock around him to listen to his words of wisdom. Sonu's fame spread far and wide. Soon, Sonu's popularity reached the ears of Monu. Now Monu's jealousy knew no bounds Getting restless, Monu decided to see the reality for himself.. The next day, Monu went to meet sonu. The kind-hearted Sonu was happy to see his friend. But the evil-minded Monu had some other plans in store, though he pretended to be nice. Monu took Sonu to the old well and pushed him into it. Luckily, Sonu did not get hurt. Sonu kept falling in the well till he landed on hard ground. Lo! He had reached an other kingdom! A man recognised him as he is famous all around and took him to the sultan of that kingdom. The sultan was overjoyed to know who Sonu was. The sultan told Sonu about his daughter who has been unwell for a long time. And announced that if sonu cures his daughter, he would be rewarded with riches. And so the sultan led Sonu into a chamber where his daughter lay unconscious. With his wisdom, Sonu was able to cure her. As soon as she opened her eyes, there was joy and celebration in the kingdom. Overwhelmed, the sultan made Sonu his wazir. Sonu now strated living in the palace. Some years later, the sultan died and sonu was made the king. After becoming the king, Sonu thought of visiting his old house. When Sonu was travelling towards his old house, he saw a beggar. When he went closer, he recognised him as his envious friend, Monu. When he went closer, he recognised him as his envious friend, Monu. " O Monu, don't you recognise me?" Sonu asked. Monu looked up."Sonu!" he exclaimed, "But how is that possible? I had killed you!" said Monu "Yes" relied Sonu,"But I am still alive and have become king". "You have been reduced to rags only because of your jelousy, Monu!" added Sonu. Now, Monu realised his mistake, he began to weep bitterly. "sonu, please forgive me!" he said," I will become good man just like you ". Sonu was a kind-hearted man. He instantly forgave Monu and embraced him with love and generosity. Sonu also gave Monu some money to strat a new business. Monu was never envious again.
author: Ananya Jonnakuti
illustrator: Adonay Gebru; Celeste  Beckerling; Henu; Jayesh Sivan; Jesse  Breytenbach; Kailash Rai; Kavya Singh; Manisha Naskar; Preeti Krishnamurthy; Priya Kuriyan; Shadrach Munene; Shambhavi Singh; Sugrib Kumar Juanga; Suresh  Mohli; Upasana Mehndiratta; Vallabhi   Shegaonkar; Youm Kosal

title: Bharti
text: “Bharti, come back home!” Grandma shouted. Bharti was reluctant to return home as she was out in fields playing with her friends. Muttering in disappointment, the 9-year old sat down for evening tea. She asked, “Why was I named Bharti?” “Bharti means a person who represents and protects the rich culture and tradition of motherland.” Her grandma smiled at the satisfied girl. Before sleep, Bharti hugged the photo of her parents. She softly asked her grandma, “where are my parents?”. Her grandma looked away, unable to face the little child’s hopeful eyes. “You will see them once, Bharti, dream high.” While playing in her Grandma’s room, Bharti’s leg hit an old trunk box. She dragged it out carefully. Out of curiosity, she opened it to see an old folded newspaper. She wondered why her grandma had stored a random newspaper for many years. It was written: Lt. Ram Mehta and Military nurse Satvi Mehta martyred in Kargil war. When she checked the trunk further, she could see army uniforms and few belongings. She saw a picture of her parents and herself, kept there. Bharti felt terribly shocked to learn that her parents had passed away. Her body quivered and trembled. She ran out of the house to an unknown world where she could weep out her grief and unbearable pain. Her legs failed and fell down in the shores of nearby beach. When she started to think about ending her miserable life, she started to feel nervous. Her mind refused to succumb and so she lied down helplessly. Her sorrowful tears soaked the earth. Brief memories of her parents flashed through her mind. She could not handle it anymore. She closed her eyes and screamed out loudly. When she opened her eyes, she felt that her parents were sitting beside her and hugging her tightly. Soon she was relieved out of despair and felt that there was someone caressing her. Her father whispered something in her ear. Bharti’s eyes gleamed and she felt rejuvenated. “Now don’t leave me, forever” Bharti pleaded. “Calm down my dear child. Remember – while you breathe, you should hope.” By saying this, they vanished into thin air. Bharti could not accept that but soon realized that it was a dream and her parents were no more. Waves splashed at her feet as if nature was seeking forgiveness from her. She suddenly remembered her grandma. When she reached home, her grandma worriedly asked “Where were you, Bharti?” She sensed that something bad happened to the girl. Bharti broke down into tears - “my parents are no more, right?” Grandma hugged Bharti and started sobbing heavily. She whimpered - “Your father was a brave soldier in the Indian army and your mother was a military nurse. During Kargil war, when the nation needed them most, they decided to leave you with me and go to the war fields. It was a tough decision, but a brave one. I promised to them that whatever happened, I’ll look after you. The news of their martyrdom was dreadful and unbearable for me. I preferred to not let you know this as this would be shocking for a tender heart. It is my duty to guide you in the right path.” Bharti felt immensely proud of her family members. “Your parents gave their life for protecting and saving the nation. You must continue that tradition. You are India’s daughter. The nation needs you.” Tears rolled down Bharti’s cheeks and she knew it was pearls of strength. With patriotism running through her veins, Bharti remembered what her father whispered, ‘Vande Mataram’.
author: Drishika Renjin

title: Lost and found
text: Somi was a 12 year old boy, who lived with his grandparents and a dog. The dog's name was kalu. Kalu was a joyful and energetic dog who loved to play. One day while playing, Somi threw the ball out of the fence and into a deep jungle. Kalu jumped over the fence and along with the ball went into the jungle. Kalu was lost. Somi shouted and shouted to kalu, but kalu was nowhere to be found. Somi came out of the garden to find kalu, but still no luck. Somi feared to go in the jungle and too did Kalu. Kalu had gone very deep inside the jungle and couldn't find his way out. Somi now was very worried as their could be wild animals in the jungle and they could hurt Kalu. Somi went little inside the jungle, but, no Kalu found. After a week of consistent finding Somi had lost hope of finding Kalu. But still Somi kept finding for his lost dog consistently. By the ninth day Somi had completely lost hope of finding Kalu. As Somi was crying in the garden beside his dogs kennel and being consoled by his friends, he sees something moving rapidly behind his fence. It was Kalu who had found his way back home. Kalu was looking over the fence, straight into Somi's eyes and jumped over the fence right into Somi's lap. At last Kalu was found.
author: Amulya Srivastava
illustrator: Bhavya Kumar; Candice  Botha; Chaaya Prabhat; Sam  van Riet; Subinita Deshaprabhu

title: An Exchange Student
text: Once there was a girl named Jessica who lived in Nepal. She lived in a beautiful house. She had a good life but she didn’t get along too well with her family. To start with! Her mom was like five years old trapped in an adult body. All she wanted to do was to run around and play. Her mom’s idea of having fun was a water balloon fight with her and her elder brother Dylan and Jessica found her childish behavior very annoying. Jessica could never study in peace without hearing her mom’s sing show tunes. Mom: Come on, you little bookworm. Let’s bake cupcakes. Dylan: Don’t you know how to have fun? Jessica: Just go away. But a person worst for her was dad, he was barely home since he was a businessman who traveled a lot. But when he was home he treated treated all of them like servants. But a person worst for her was dad, he was barely home since he was a businessman who traveled a lot. But when he was home he treated all of them like servants. Dad: Bring me some juice will you? My toes hurt and I can’t move. Jessica: Uh, there is not much left and we are saving it for tomorrow morning. Dad: Oh, so maybe you should be the one who goes on a five hour flight to earn money for us. Jessica kind of hated being around them, so she spent most of her time alone reading and practicing violin. But when she got into 11 th grade, things took a crazy turn. Her mom told her one morning that they were taking an exchange student. Mom: She is from Tokyo. She will go to your school and live with us for four months. Isn’t that exciting? Jessica: Sure, but we will have to clean the kitchen first, so she doesn’t run crying. Dylan: Be happy Jessica. Now you will have a live-in friend. Jessica: I sure hope she wouldn’t be a live-in headache like you. That weekend they all drove to the airport to pick up their Japanese guest. Her name was Queenie and she looked like goddess out of a wonderland. Queenie: Thank you for having me. Truly, it means so much. Jessica’s mom: It’s our pleasure, sweetie. Look I got you a stuffed welcome panda. Jessica: Hi, I am Jessica and I am the normal one in the family. Please don’t judge me based on them. Queenie: Oh my goodness. This panda is so sweet. Can anyone help me with my bags? They are heavy because of all the books I brought. Jessica was really surprised to know that queenie was into books too. They both were talking about their favorite authors on the way home. After that they really started to bond. Queenie was also super helpful around the house, so both of Jessica’s parents adored her, specially her dad. Jessica’s dad: Aren’t you amazing? How about I buy a present to thank you for all your hard work? Maybe new shoes or gold earrings? Queenie: That’s very kind, but you guys have already done enough, really. Then one night Queenie and Jessica decided to go on a walk and Queenie grabbed a jacket from the coat closet. Jessica: oh, that actually is Dylan’s. Queenie: But it’s so comfortable, and I don’t have any warm jackets. Can’t Dylan lend cloths to his guest? Dylan: You can’t just take someone’s jacket without permission. Give it back I don’t want you to wear it. Queenie: Fine here you go. I will just freeze to death then. Come on Jessica. Dylan looked really mad and pulled Jessica aside and said “there is something about this girl I don’t like.’’ Jessica: you mean manner. Dylan got angry and stormed off. But after that Queenie started behaving strangely. One day before Jessica’s violin show Queenie called her teacher and said that Jessica will not play violin anymore and when Jessica went to her teacher’s house for practice the teacher told her everything and angrily slammed the door shut at her face. She went home and saw Queenie looking at her with an evil smile. She understood everything and asked her why she did this. They both fought and after sometime Queenie came to Jessica’s room and said sorry to her. Jessica forgave her but next day she went to school alone because Queenie had some work to do so she stayed home. At school when Jessica was at cafeteria she received a message from Queenie that where is your mom I haven’t seen her this whole morning. She rushed home and saw her brother siting on stares outside the house. He had also received the same message from Queenie and she was also not answering any of their calls. When Jessica went inside she saw Queenie in her room chilling she asked Queenie where is mom? Queenie: I don’t know. But after some time their mom got back home really tired she told her kids that queenie and she were going somewhere and at that time Queenie left her in between and threw her phone away. After that they called the police and Queenie was arrested. While investigating Queenie told them that Jessica’s dad left her and her mom alone to starve homeless so she wanted them to feel the pain that she and her mom felt. After this Jessica’s dad was also arrested. Jessica, her mom and her brother lived happily ever after. Moral- Never trust anyone blindly because most of the backstabbers are the one who you trust.
author: Prisha Banta

title: CURE KYRA
text: IN kitty's dale (a place). there lived a lovely family. In the family there lived a little cute 9 years old girl, Kyra. The whole family loves Kyra very much. One day Kyra suddenly fallen ill because she loves to eat fast foods daily. They visited doctors and doctors but all in vain. No one could cure her. Then her father got an Idea as he could talk to winds. He invited the Winds and discussed the matter. They told him to visit Olly's Yard (a place). There lives a fairy named Shine, who can cure any disease. Next morning Kyra and her Dad went to Olly's Yard. But the fairy was no where to be seen and while searching her they reached to the edge of the rock. Suddenly a voice came "Jump". Though they were very afraid they jumped and reached in a garden where Shine was sitting near a tree. They wished Good evening to Shine and she asked that "How may I help you?" Then her father asked to cure Kyra. So Shine examined Kyra and said there is only way to cure Kyra. You have to go to the Villa of Heaven. There live Five Seasons named Summer, Winter, Spring, Autumn and Rain. They sat at circular chairs with a throne in the center. The season which sits at the throne that comes. There are five herbs named Fire angel, White Flake, Lavender, Spirit of Autumn and Blue Berry which are needed to make the medicine. Only problem is that all of them grows in different seasons and it will be too late if we wait. So ask winds to take you at the Villa of Heaven and then request seasons to sit one by one to the throne and give the Herb of that season. Bring all the herbs to me. Till then I will take care of Kyra. So, Kyra's dad called winds and asked them to take him to the Villa of Heaven. Winds agreed and took him there. When He reached to the Villa of Heaven he told the whole circumstance to the seasons and requested them to help him. The seasons accepted his request and sit one by one to the throne. Each season given his medicine and Kyra's dad collected them happily. Then brought the herbs to Olly's Yard with the help of winds and given to the Shine. She made the medicine and given it to Kyra. The Kyra recovered fully and taken a pledge that "I will never eat Fast Foods again." Both returned home and were happy again.
author: Snigdha Yadav
illustrator: Lê Thị  Mai Phương; Snigdha Yadav

title: ACT OF AMENDS
text: Vera was about fourteen years old. She was intelligent but not hard working. She scored great, but did not study efficiently. She did not work up to her true potential, and that worried her parents and teachers. Arna, who came from a poor household was also a classmate of Vera. Her parents worked hard to keep their daughter in the school. Once, when her father was sick, her mother did both their jobs, just so they could have the money to pay her fees. Her mother seemed to never reset, and Arna’s father had only her to care for him. That week, Arna’s mother used to cry herself to sleep every day. She could hear the quite sobs and wails, and it made her sure as to never let her parents or her be that helpless again. So, she had studied and studied and scored the best marks in the annual exam, winning the scholarship in the state for the first time It usually was Vera who used to win the position, but she took the second position all in good faith, congratulated Arna and went back home. Vera’s father was the principal, so her family was saddened that she did not win the first position this year.. Five days before the exam, the government announced they would be providing a scholarship for students nationwide who would have the first position in the annual exams. The news of scholarship attracted Arna like moth to a flame. She wanted to have it, as it meant she could opt for higher education much easier and fluently. Meanwhile, Vera’s parents were persistent that she must bag the scholarship, as it could mean great things for her future and the family. Vera studied the best she could, and was sorry that she didn’t study more. Nevertheless, she thought, I have done it all these years, I shall do it again. It was the day of the exam. Each student in their grade had prepared. Arna, too, left no stone unturned. Vera and Arna were to sit on the same desk for the exam. When Arna had completed the exam, she left the answer sheets on the desk, got up and went out of the classroom. Well, Arna thought to herself, I think that went pretty well. I might have a good chance! Inside the classroom, all the students were busy writing the test, and the teachers were at the very back with the naughty students. When Vera had completed with her paper, she silently took the sheets on the other side of the table which had Arna’s name on it, and slipped out of the classroom. With the time of the results approaching, each student got antsy. Mostly everyone knew that Arna would get it. But they still had little hope that they could get it, too. The results came. The scholarship which should’ve had Arna’s name on it, bore Vera’s. Everyone was surprised. None more so than Vera’s own family. Vera had done it! She got the scholarship as they had asked of her. But Vera’s father was sceptical. He had noticed his daughter’s behaviour the past days. She appeared jumpy and sweated at the smallest of questions. He decided to tell Vera’s mother of his suspicions. But she questioned that why can’t he be happy at his daughter’s success. When he persuaded, Vera’s mother agreed to search her drawers or cupboard for anything fishy. Arna, on the other hand, was disheartened. She had had high hopes for herself. Her parents tried to console her that if not this year, then the next, she would get the scholarship. And that the sum of money she had won them the past few years was more than enough of what they could ask of their daughter. On searching Vera’s room, to her parents’ shame, they had found the answer sheets of Arna Ghariyal. When they questioned Vera of it, she told them the truth and owned up to her cheating, confessing that she only did so to please them. In three days, when Vera was awarded with the scholarship on the stage, she admitted to her cheating, and told the audience that Arna was the rightful owner and apologised. Back at Vera’s household, her father kept thinking of various alternatives for her punishment, each more ridiculous than the next to Vera’s ears. “I think,” her father said, “I’ve got it.” Vera looked up. “Arna’s campus is far, far away from the city. You, Vera, shall pay her transport fee.” “But I don’t have that kind of money, papa.” She sputtered. “Well,” her mother said, “you should’ve thought of that before you stole someone’s answer sheets don’t you think?” Her father responded to her earlier comment, “You will take your rickshaw money and give it to her. “And how,” she asked, “will I get to school?” Her father replied, “You’re a smart girl. Figure it out.”
author: Richa
illustrator: Andres Mendez; Catherine Groenewald; Diya Chopra; George Supreeth; Jupiter  Pradhan; ROSH; Somesh Kumar

title: The Magical Island
text: There was a peaceful morning in the city of Paris. All the people were overcome with joy. Everyone in cheerful mood. The mayor of Paris was going to Australia with his two children Mileva and John for vacation. Mileva was 14 year old and John was 10 years old. The whole city gathered around the mayor's house to say goodbye. It was so crowded. There were men, women and even children. At sharp 10:00am they boarded their helicopter and started their journey. Both Mileva and John were delighted and excited. John took out some snacks and started having it while his sister was so mesmerized by the view that she was busy watching it. Suddenly pilot said that there is leakage in the fuel tank and so the fuel has become low. Due to this they had to do emergency landing. The pilot and the assistant pilot talked among each other and decided to land in an island which was only landmass near to them. Everyone got scared. The Mayor hold his ch ildren by his side and told them to pray to God. The helicopter landed in a horrible way. It seemed like a meteoroid fell on the Earth's surface. The result was shocking. The helicopter caught fire. The assistant pilot, Charles took Mileva and John and jumped from the helicopter. The front part of the helicopter was totally damaged. Everything inside the helicopter was damaged. The engine was burnt. The Mayor and the pilot passed away. Charles was severely hurt. Mileva and John were also wounded. They were weeping seeing their father's body. They wanted their father to return. They wanted to go home and tell this unpleasant news to their mother but they didn't have any option. They cried intensely and ended up being sick. Charles too was sad as the mayor passed away. Charles explained them not to cry and be strong and thank God that he saved them. Now they should get up and explore the island so that they can get out of it. But both of them were still unconscious. After five to ten minutes they got up and walked to the shore of the island which was near to them. They were surprised by the environment of the island. They were surrounded by oceans. The water around the island was as clear as crystal, to the point they can see the depths of the sea. The island was surrounded with tall leafy trees. It was full of birds and animals. The scenery of the island lighten up their mood. They felt little relaxed. Then they moved inside the forest of the island. There were so many trees. The jungle was so calm and peace. Further they found a beautiful stream. And they cleaned there wounds and cut. Charles found some neem leaves which he crushed from a piece of stone and applied it in their wounds and covered it with leaves. So that their wounds get cured. While moving ahead, John heard someone's talking. He told this to Mileva and Charles. When they looked around, they saw a rabbit and a squirrel talking with each other. Seeing this, they couldn't believe their eyes. Charles asked that were they dreaming. Mileva replied that maybe, this is something unbelievable. They move forward and realized that every animal in the island can talk. They all were astonished after knowing this fact. Hereafter, Mileva and John had friendship with that rabbit. The rabbit was white in color. He was quite pretty as a rabbit. He introduced himself to them and said his name is Coco. He also introduced his friend Purly, the squirrel. Coco said that this was a magical island where two things were different from the rest of the world. One, here animal could speak and another was a secret which they would discover after they return to their home. Then Coco and Purly took Mileva, John and Charles for a tour of the island. They found that the island seemed as beautiful as paradise. They have not seen anything so beautiful. All the animals were enjoying with one another. Coco introduced Mileva, John and Charles to Nema the elephant, Simbha the lion, Haily the tiger, Bucky the deer, Angel the giraffe, Amelia the peacock, Kai the hippopotamus, Suga the parrot and many other animals. Mileva, John and Charles had friendship with these creatures. They hugged each other to grew their friendship more brighter. Soon after, night surrounded them so all of them took Mileva, John and Charles to small cottages and allotted them place to sleep. In the morning they got up and washed their faces.Then they ate some fruits and then everyone got engaged in their work. Mileva and John started playing with the kids of these animals whereas Charles started collecting things that would help them escaped this magical island. This became their routine. Everyday Mileva and John played with the animels, took bath in streams and whenever they felt hungry they ate fruits from the tree while Charles everyday used to discover the island and find things that wold help them to escape. A month later. He collected a safety kit from the helicopter. And this helicopter reminded him the whole incident and made him cry. Then he collected fruits, rescue signals, he made some weapons of wood and stones. Now it was time to get back home. Charles blew rescue signals consistently for days. One day a passing by ship noticed the smoke and came towards the island. The animals got scared from the large mechanism and the noise so they rushed and hid behind the trees. The crew asked Charles about the matter and after listening to their story they decided to rescue them. Mileva, John and Charles boarded on the ship and sailed towards their home. After they went a mile away, all the animals came out and wished them goodbye. One day a passing by ship noticed the smoke and came towards the island. The animals got scared from the large mechanism and the noise so they rushed and hid behind the trees. The crew asked Charles about the matter and after listening to their story they decided to rescue them. Mileva, John and Charles boarded on the ship and sailed towards their home. After they went a mile away, all the animals came out and wished them goodbye.. Everyone became emotional. After two days they returned home. Everyone was shocked after seeing them. People thought that they have died. They rushed towards their home. Her mother immediately hugged them and started crying. Then she asked about their father. Mileva told her the whole incident. This made her cry more and more. She thanked Charles. After that Mileva and John dicovered that everyone has grew old except three of them. After noticing this they realized that this was the second secret of the magical island that over there times goes slow. Visiting an island like this was a marvelous experience. Three of them had a lot of fun. They made new friends. They discovered new things. Despite all this fact the pain of losing their father also broke them. Later, Mileva and John decided to study hard and try to be as great as their father while Charles became a senior pilot and earned much more than before. This incident changed the life of Marlie, John and Charles.
author: FOUZIA ALI
illustrator: Abin  Shrestha; Lavanya  Naidu; Prabha  Mallya; Raju Babu Shakya; Sushant Ahire; Suvidha Mistry

title: THE BOYS ROUTINE
text: Once upon a time. A boy name Aakash lived in a small village and he was having a daily rountine and he changes his routine day by day.But his parents told him that you should focus on your studies and make a good routine, but he never listen to them. It countinue till many months and one day came when he go with his friend to watch a movie, and he didn't complete his homework.And after he came back at home and slept "THE NEXT DAY "his teacher scolded him very badly and the principal suspended for some days,after coming back at home he realised his mistake,and promised his parents not to repeat again. After that day he started to focus on studies and follow a good routine. THE END
author: khushi rojha

title: Unforgettable bondness
text: It was a lonely night, the town was quit with no lights. Lucas was returning home in his car. He was a man who lived alone in his big house. He was very rich and kind hearted too. He had never been to a family. His parents died in a car accident when he was four. He was then send to an adoption center, but no one adapted him. From a young age onwards his dream was to become a person who help others. Lucas was a counsellor. He was having so many clints and he was very happy to help them. He was very happy and satisfied with his job. One day Lucas was sitting in his office going through some important papers, someone nocked the door, Lucas let them in. A woman came in with a 2 year old child in her hands. The lady looked so stressed and depressed. Lucas asked them to sit and be comfortable. He offered some coffee. Lucas introduced himself to the lady and asked her why she was here. the lady said "My name is Evelyn. I am a mother. My husband had died two months before, We don't have any relative so we stayed in our rented house. I was trying hard to get a job but I couldn't and was not able to pay the rent. I was so stressed so I decided to come to a counsellor and calm down myself." Lucas felt so sorry for them. lucas said " I will arrange a place for both of you to stay. Don't worry about the money and food." Lucas went to them daily and spent some time with them. He played with the child and talked with Evelyn to relieve her stress. He felt so happy and comfortable the time he spend with them. Lucas felt something special with this clint and he never forget to visit them. Days went by..... Lucas never leaved the connection with Evelyn and her child. One day when Lucas was drinking his morning coffee and thought about his marriage and he wanted a family too. He can't forget Evelyn, He thought that both Evelyn and him now wanted was a family and Lucas couldn't stay a day without meeting them, however he decided to ask Evelyn to marry him. At that day' after his work he went to Evelyn's house she was now staying as ' regular. He spend time with the child and almost at the time he was leaving he asked Evelyn if she could marry him. Evelyn accepted the proposal as she felt so safe beside him. Lucas and Evelyn got married and lived togather forever happily.
author: Haniya  Mariyam

title: THE HEART OF MOTHER
text: It was winter season. In a broad jungle there were two years there name was Meeku and Maya. They were very close friends it was wonderful that both the friends gave birth to fawns at same day they were very close to the area of lions they were very happy and named their fawns as Cheeku and Cherry. They were very similar in appearance and habits. They were very naughty and play every time. One day, Meeku and Maya decided to go for searching food they kept Cheeku and Cherry and went from there. When Meeko and Maya come back they were shocked as Cheeku and Cherry was not there they started to search them but they were failed. Eventually, the decided to search them in the area of lions as the entered in the lions area they saw Cheeku and Cherry was surrounded by many lions. There had not enough time to think. Suddenly, Maya ran very fast and push Cheeku and Cherry but lions attacked over Maya and she died. Cheeku, Cherry and Maya rescued their life and returned from there. Maya sacrifice her life for her babies Meeku was very sad and decided to take care of both of them. After some weeks all situations become normal and they started living happily. Meeku always keep both fawns with her and never let them alone. One day, Cherry lost his way and entered in lions area. When Meeku realise that cherry is not with her she ran toward the area of lions. She saw that Cherry was surrounded by lions. She thought to go and protect her baby but she thought that if lions will kill her, Cheeku and Cherry will unable to survive. So she was looking cherry from a distance her eyes was wet and started crying. All the lions were going slowly slowly toward Cherry when they reached near to Cherry. Suddenly a lioness was coming Very fast and request lions to release Cherry. Lions agreed and release Cheery. Meeku was shocked and went near to lioness with her vibrating body. Lioness said, “I am also mother I can understand your feeling.” Meeku was very happy and very thankful towards lioness she was crying after seeing this act of kindness. They went back in their area and taught all the things with their friends. n Eventually, they started living happily. Conclusion:- Mother is mother. No one can take place of mother. Her hurt is full of love and she can do anything for her baby.
