title: The essence of life
text: It was another windy day in August when the cold breeze hit my face during one of my and my mom's timely car rides around the town. I sort of enjoyed it, the company of my mom, and how we could talk about anything as best friends may it be the potholes on the street to deep topics like the way of life. But today was the latter of the evenings. We were halted at one of the signals on the highway when a few "poor people", as they call them, knocked on our car's window selling balloons or asking for some money. It is a normal incident in a country like ours but this time it sparked a big debate in my mind. "They have no option, Mehak. They are helpless and it's a compulsion to live on the streets, looked down by others in order to survive. If they had the choice and resources, they wouldn't be on the streets", said my mother. That last line got me into deep thought. As kids, we are always told to not throw our food away and waste it as there are people who don't get sufficient, and we are supposed to be grateful for it. In the same way, resources like money, a roof above your head, and support are what can make a human achieve heights, or at least try. We, as fortunate people have those resources and the support we need, but not everyone does. Just like the people right in front of my eyes, knocking on windows, with a lack of money and a roof over their heads, and barely any support as they are helpless without the funds. And we end up lazying around, not making use of the resources we have been blessed with. We have dreams but do nothing to fulfill them. Just as I sat there thinking about this, it reminded me of an incident that happened a few weeks ago. When my grandmother was in her mid-thirties, she used to teach a batch of college-going students at a nearby association. According to how I imagine it to be, she must have been the most wonderful tutor to work with and learn from. She always hoped for the best for each pupil of hers and wanted each one to be successful for their own good one day. Now all elderly and fragile, she only tells us cousins stories about those days. Until the other day, when we were all prepared for a nap after lunch when someone rang the bell. A grown man, I guessed probably in his mid-forties stood at the doorstep with a bouquet in his hand, asking for my grandmother. My grandmother didn't seem to recognize him but he was beaming at her happily. "I'm the usual latecomer, ma'am", he said with his deep, husky voice. Something sparked in grandmother's eyes, almost sort of a glow of recollection and hindsight. "Akhil! Is it really you?", she exclaimed as if they were long-lost buddies. She then turned to me in excitement and said, "Mehak, meet Akhil. One of the students from my first batch. Although very bright, he always made it late to classes." I smiled at him as he grinned back at me. He then began, "It is so nice to see you again, ma'am. It's good to meet up with old teachers, its reminiscing." "Indeed, Akhil. So what are you doing these days? Is your family well?", she interrogated. I just smiled through the whole conversation of one of the purest bonds to ever exist, a mentor and student. He hesitated for what felt like almost a minute when he finally said, "I'm a clerk at a developing company ma'am." I noticed a slight frown on my grandmother's face, which made her look curious and worried at the same time, which i wondered the reason for. She didn't say anything to him, but instead turned to me and started, "Mehak, Akhil right here had the brightest of dreams in my class. He sometimes wished to be a scientiest at ISRO or sometimes would talk about being a surgeon or software engineer." I glanced at Akhil uncle, who looked a little disappointed, and I didn't know why. "Moreover", she continued, "He even had the caliber to achieve those dreams. But there was one issue. He would regularly be late to class or skip classes. He only came to the campus when there were tests. I spoke to him about this, but he wouldn't change his behavior until when I had to call his parents to meet me for the same." I wondered why grandmother was telling me all this, and that too in front of him but I continued to listen nevertheless. "His parents ended up having a disagreement at my office about whose fault it is that he was turning out to be that way", she said as Akhil let out a soft giggle on that which released the tension in the room. "I always wished for him to achieve his dream jobs and goals. But his attendance was affecting his grade. Habits became too permanent to change easily." She then turned towards him, and with a stern look she said, "I'm happy you are living an average, happy and healthy life, Akhil. But I'm afraid average and decent isn't what you'd choose right?" He didn't take long to respond with, "No, ma'am. Certainly not. I now realize how I had the resources, but never used them properly. I never worked for the dreams I had in my mind, and now it's too late." "I'm glad you realised that, Akhil." And suddenly i was out of that flashback and back in the car as we were pulling up infront of our house. 'Decent is not something you would choose right?' and 'I never worked hard for the dreams I had in my mind, and now it's too late' were two lines that I replayed in my mind. I was back to the beggars on the street who would choose even an average and decent life for themselves, only if they were given the resources. Meanwhile, us, having the resources to do so much more than that, choose not to. I know why my grandmother told me his whole story that day and now I know the difference between those who take things for granted because they have them and those who long for them. It's funny and scary at the same time how a small topic of people on the signals can turn so huge if thought upon and leave behind a lesson in your mind that you just might never forget.
author: Mehak Nagar

title: Night mare
text: "Dad this place looks so beautiful, shall we stop here and have lunch". said Vani." But dear this looks like the top of the hill dear ". said, dad. Here Vani came to picnic with her father at a hill station. She is insisting to stop on the hill and have lunch. "ok dear", said dad They all got down of the car and set up the table and Vani's father starts to cook. "What do you want dear", asked dad. I want..... omelet", answered Vani. Father started cooking by cutting vegetables. Ahhh! Vani and her mother turned to see the owner of the voice. It was her father screaming in pain because he mistakenly cut the nerve on his hand. They rushed to their father," Dad, Dad don't panic, the blood is flowing continuously, did you forget that doctor said you already have less blood, please don't panic" said Vani crying seeing her dad in that state. Mom, please call an ambulance. "Calling dear", said her mom. "Mom please call quickly, Dad, Dad, open your eyes, Dad! Vani was crying her heart out seeing her father in that state, but little did she know that her father is no more. Now the ambulance came. The doctor checked and said, "He's no more". Vani started more than her mother. Just for Vani, her mother is trying to stay strong, but deep inside she is crying more than Vani, seeing her love of life lifeless. "Doctor take him, we will follow you in the car", said her mom. "No mom, I will also go with dad" cried vani. 'No dear, come let's go get into the car",said her her mom yet strictly yet stopping her tears from falling down. "Doctor take h-him",said her mother shuttering. Doctor took her father to hospital to complete te procedures. Vani and her mother directly went to the house as it is already night and their house is not so far from there. They reached their house by midnight. In the car, Vani was continuously crying thinking about her father and their memories. After reaching the house, while crying only Vani and her mother slept in each other's embrace. They forgot everything that happened in the day, because of excessive crying so they slept peacefully. "Good morning mom", said Vani. "Good morning dear", replied her mom. They woke up, did their morning routine, and started eating their breakfast. Suddenly they heard an ambulance sound, the past(Which happened yesterday) flashed up in their mind. Vani started crying. The people in the ambulance brought the body in front of their house. Vani left her plate and ran to her father, crying her heart out! "Dad, Dad". Vani, Vani, wake up open your eyes, see me, open your eyes". she was surprised to see her dad alive in front of her eyes. She even rubbed her eyes multiple times to see if it is a dream. "Dad am I dreaming ". Vani hugged her dad and started crying hard. "No dear, you were just having a nightmare, see here, I am so healthy", said dad and started making some funny poses and expressions. "See my daughter is laughing at me", said her dad and made a pouty face. Seeing his father's pouty face, Vani started laughing even more. "That's my daughter, always happy and smiling. come on wake up and brush your teeth, your mom made something tasty for breakfast. We should not waste food right, let's have it", said her dad. "ok dad you go, I am coming", said vani. They enjoyed happily ever after. For any girl, her dad is her hero. He sacrifices everything just for his daughter's happiness. Always make your parents proud and happy. Never see tears in their eyes because of you...
author: Bhavya Sree

title: A Halloween With(out) You
text: It was time of Halloween, a day made to remember the lives foregone, a day when dead souls are believed to return home. These souls spend every little bit of time left for them to spend time with their alive loved ones before d eparting for heaven. For Halloween, People decorated their house with ornaments which symbolised death and spirits, people dressed themselves up as characters from horror fantasies on the day of Halloween and children knock the door while screaming ‘trick or treat!’ and people offer them candies which they collect in an object which is a part of their costume. Halloween is an enjoyable occasion for both adults and children, adults immerse in the activities of decorating their house and children enjoy both decorating and trick-or-treating, people stay excited for arrival of Halloween. Just like any other child who have immense joy on the day of Halloween and excitement for its arrival, a group of three friends was also ready with this spirit and decorations to decorate their houses for Halloween. Niya, Nori and Hank were names of these three enthusiastic teenagers who were waiting for Halloween more than they waited for their final grades. With everything ready they started decorating their house three days before the occasion. Hank was carving a pumpkin in the garden with his other two friends while his dad was watching television, the kids were well versed in their work just when they heard a sound of news from the room behind them in which Hank’s dad was watching television, they peeked into the room through the glass window which joined the garden with the living room of the house, eyes fixed on the screen Nori read the headline “Weak relations with neighbor”, Nori laughed and jokingly said “It doesn’t seem like it” while looking at her other two friends, they also laughed on it until they heard the voice of a woman coming from the television “Our country has failed to establish good relations with the neighboring countries, the situation is becoming tense day by day and it might be the last eve for the people living near borders” not only the news was heart sickening but now there was no audible or visible sign of happiness between the kids, rather, a serious expression was now on their faces. Hank’s father mumbled to himself “I should probably get some stuff ready before a curse bestow upon us” Hank wanted to cheer up the scene and distract his friends from the news in front of them so to lighten the weight of this despair he said “We don’t need to worry about it, we will be safe for sure and we can even help each other if bolt out of the blue happens, after all we are not just neighbours, we are friends” these words happened to be reassuring and the other two were now feeling light hearted. They were now back to decorating their houses, they carved pumpkins at Hank’s place and made props for decoration at Nori’s place. One day passed and now they were left with only few tasks on the list, one of them was to make costumes so they prepared costumes at Niya’s place, Niya’s mother was deft in tailoring, so she helped the kids prepare costumes, the work was tiring and took a brief time so they decided to do a sleepover at Niya’s place, that night was fun and they even made some desserts together while accompanying Niya’s mother, her father was also back at the house and they all ate dinner together, Niya’s father told the kids some stories of Halloween, in one of his story he mentioned that during this time of year ghosts and spirits of dead pass the boundary between dead and living to meet their families or the people that they were related to, to give kids adrenaline rush he recited the story of ‘Baba Yaga’, a witch who used to eat kids and he ended his story by telling them to sleep or else baba yaga might eat them. Two days passed and now the only thing that was left for them was to shop for remaining items on their list and then they would be done for the event. Hank was going out of his house to join his other two friends for shopping, at the doorstep he found his dad packing some stuff which seemed like clothes and some stuff of importance, Hank questioned his dad about it to which he replied “We will be going to meet your mom today so be sure to come back on time and pack your stuff” Hank didn’t question further and replied with “okay”, he was happy to be able to meet his mother so he didn’t think about anything, thought of meeting his mother before the occasion cheered him up and so he rushed towards his friends to tell them about his trip to his mother’s home, on the way to the shop he talked about his mother, this little kid loved his mother and even the weight of separation couldn’t suppress this love. The kids returned to their house and Hank was in a hurry to pack his stuff because the kids came a little bit late than they expected. Hank packed all his stuff and bid goodbye to his friends, he promised to return before the night of Halloween and told them that this time he will bring his mother back with him so that Nori and Niya can also meet her. It was five o’clock in the evening when Hank and his dad boarded the plane, they reached their destination at ten in night. Hank met his mother at airport and hugged her tightly, his mother embraced him in her arms, the family took the luggage and put it in a car which led them to Hank’s mother house. Her house was also decorated in the Halloween ornaments but to Hank it felt like his mom decorated it to welcome him which was true. The family ate cake together on the night and even had dinner together like a family, Hank was going to sleep just when he saw the door of the room where his parents were, it was just about two inch open and as he passed by it he heard them talking about staying at this place, he took a step back and eavesdropped on their conversation, by the words he could infer that this year the Halloween will be spent at his mother’s place. He felt sad but helpless about it, so he returned back to his room and fell sleep right after he lay on the bed. The day of the Halloween came and Hank was not really cheerful, it felt like a regular day to him until he saw his mother in the morning, a glint of happiness was now visible on his face, after greeting his mother he walked to his father who was watching television as usual in the living room, he entered the room and heard something horrible, the news was ear bleeding. The lady on the news channel said in a serious tone “Our fear came walking to us, thousands of people died at the border due to bomb blast on the night of eve, It’s a Halloween massacre” They are dead, he knew it but couldn’t accept it, he was too stunned to speak, he was able to survive because his mother’s house was in central part of country and the thought of not being able to help his friends saddened him more. He rushed back to his room forgetting about greeting his dead and tried to make a phone call but there was no response, it was hard for him to accept it and he lost himself in grieving. The Halloween passed and it was a Halloween without them. A year passed and the Halloween came once again, the time when the line between dead and living world starts to thin and the dead cross the border. Hank was ready to celebrate Halloween with his family and didn’t want himself to be dejected for his family. The day of Halloween was not just about decorating and going trick-or-treating but it was also a day to pay respect to the dead spirits so Hank’s family visited graveyard to put some food near the grave of dead. Hank felt a blow of chilly air on his skin when he was going out of graveyard and he felt like someone was following him on the way to his house. Maybe the dead wanted to meet him before they step into heaven, maybe the wish to spend Halloween with his friends was now getting fulfilled, Hank whispered to himself “maybe it’s a Halloween with you”.

title: The Undercover 273
text: This is Veronica! I live in Toronto. I am a widow. I was upset about the past events of my life, but the lessons of the Bible heal the heart. That's the reason I love reading the Bible. I used to work at a bakery shop and earn a little. My life had been monotonous. People say I am special, but this fact never triggers my mind. One fine day, as I was scrolling down through a few articles, I found something captivating. I read what was written on the page:- "What is lost, will be found" "Something which has been lost can be found if you help us! You will be rewarded with 25 billion dollars" Place:-UNDERCOVER 273, street 7, Los Angeles, USA Date:-4th April, Thursday This sounded exciting. I needed something new. So, I decided to join the club. Registration was done and I received my Id. I caught the bus at 5: 00 am in the morning off to Los Angeles for a stirring challenge. After a tiring journey, I stepped inside a pyramid-shaped building secured from all sides. I showed my ID and then what I saw was a miracle. 1000's unknown faces chattered among themselves in the building, all in a particular uniform. Suddenly all the voices fell and the soft thud of the shoes was heard. A man in his 40's,wheatish and tall said aloud:- "We are glad to have you here. Coming straight to the point, you all have to find treasure. How? In groups of 3-4 members. Remember it's not easy. Danger in every level and step you take. Thank you!" He marched away. I changed into the uniform. A few minutes later, a pair of unrecognized faces headed toward me. "Myself Stephen", one of them said, "and she is Ronda". Stephen was handicapped. He had an impaired leg. "Myself Veronica", I said, and soon after that we made a team "I am born with shooting hands and eagle-eyed vision. No one hires me because of my disability. Life has been discriminating" exclaimed Joseph. "I am an orphan and my house is the Boston orphanage. I have no one to love or to care. I pen down my emotions and compose my own music, but I get no opportunity. I have faced so many challenges that nature itself has made me a decision-maker." "I love reading The Bible. People say I am special. Ever since I lost my husband I feel meritless”. I exclaimed. "Let's make up a team and accomplish the task, friends” exclaimed Ronda hyping up the dull environment. The bell rang and the competition began. We were led down the staircase and now started STAGE-1. "What is written in the Bible text:-Joshua 1:6–9?. It's an easy level you need to have minimum knowledge of Bible" "I know this let me read it out" I said with confidence “The phrase 7 of Joshua 1:6-9 regards:-Be strong and very courageous. Be careful to obey all the law my servant Moses gave you; do not turn from it to the right or to the left, that you may be successful wherever you go" "That's all??....anyways we did it" regarded Joseph But that was not all, some more challenges were left. As we walked for a while, we found the banner of Stage:-2. "STAGE 2:-It's a Do or Die. Rather you pass through the tunnel of DARKNESS or end your journey here. Go down at your own risk. No torch or any illuminating object will be provided" "Only sharp and focused vision can help you and that's what I have. I have practiced shooting without light, so I am adapted to such darkness" "Perfect, and if something comes in the way, just shoot it", I exclaimed pointing towards the gun in his bag. We marched towards the cave. There shot the bullet 100 times as the cave was full of scorpions and lizards. We finally accomplished the impossible. We were pulled down into a whirling hole and landed on stage 3. "STAGE 3:- There is a house. One enters it blind and comes out seeing. Answer this. It will lead you to the treasure you were waiting for!!" "What? Ronda, do you know the answer? " said Joseph. "Well, I am trying. It's something that has awoken a person's mind. Some lesson is taught in the building because Education is a thing that broadens a person's mind. UMMM School? Yeah, it's A school. When you enter a school you are unaware of the world but eventually, you are introduced to the living world. The correct option is school. Veronica select school". As soon as I pressed the button, the surroundings got blurry and now we were on a barren land. "There's nowhere I can see treasure. Stage 3 was our final level, right??" asked Joseph. I was confused too but Ronda, after understanding the situation for some time said:- "Guys wait this all was not about the treasure of gold and silver but our abilities are our Treasure. A precious treasure that we all did not notice, which we all ignored. Our abilities were lost deep inside the bad memories which we could not focus on. " I realized what was so special in me after I thought about what Ronda had said. We realized that "Each morning we are born again with a new spirit. What we do today is what matters the most". So with a new start, we all accomplished the motive of our life:- 1) Presently, Joseph is playing The Commonwealth games in the field of Rifle shooting. 2) Ronda found a family and now handles the accounts of the Saudi Aramco company. She even works as an assistant composer in the movies. And I have learned that "The only thing that matters in life is your opinion about yourself." "When your past calls, don't answer. It has nothing new to say Thus, I found out my speciality of changing lives.

title: By your side
text: Rose field plains, a nice and peaceful village where the population was small. On this very village, a friendly competition is being played out in a week. And Luna is one of the competitors. She is the best at almost everything! But, she felt unsure. She did not feel confident about winning even though she had the skill and talent to. she felt scared. Luna decided to ask some of her friends; Amy, Kate and Juliet. First she went to Amy for advice. "Amy, my friend. Please help me in this situation." Luna pleads. "Luna, why would you ever need help? Your the greatest at these things. I'm sure you can do it in a minute!" Amy states. Luna thanked her and went on to ask Kate for advice. "Kate, my friend. Please help me in this situation." Luna requested. "Luna, you need to believe in yourself! you have great potential enough for you to win. I'll be there during your journey." and with that, Kate encouraged Luna. But some thing lingered around Luna. Her shoulders felt heavy. Her head began to think. 'I should be first! I should win this! I cant let my friends down.' And of she went to her third friend, Juliet, for advice. "Juliet, my friend. please help me in this situation." Luna asks. "Luna? Why so scared?" Juliet asks worriedly. "I need help to win the competition." Luna said. "My help? I think you're ready to go. You have practiced for it for a week and your surely going to win!" Juliet says proudly. "I don't think I can do this." Luna says in a sad tone. "I believe in you. You don't have to be first to be the winner, we'd be proud even if you didn't place "Why? Its not winning if I didn't actually win at all." Luna says confused. "Its because we're your friends, and we'd be proud of you no matter what." These words made Luna feel happy. she felt more confident and her shoulders turned light. Tomorrow is the day of the competition. Luna felt exited and confident with her friends by her side. It was a hard match that was for sure but one round after the other Luna kept passing through them. At the final round Luna sighed and began. She ran and ran knowing that her friends were by her side cheering for her. And at the final whistle... " EVERBODY GIVE UP A BIG HAND TO LUNA FOR PLACING 2ND!" Said the Judge. Although Luna placed in second her was happy with her friends by her side. The moral of the story is to believe in your self no matter what.

title: The Greatest Time of my Life!
text: The greatest time of my life starts as……… It was a Saturday night and my dad asked us if we had a holiday tomorrow because we were thinking of going to Ramoji Film City (one of the biggest film citys in the world) and having a blast and also spending the night until tomorrow after lunch. He added on and said “But you guys have to wake up early tomorrow or else I will not be taking you guys”. The next morning I woke up at 12:37p.m. “Hmmm.. why is the house so quiet? Mom, Dad, Karthik?” I Screamed to the top of my throat 4 times. No replies, so then I checked all the rooms but no one was there.``So, does this mean that I’m home alone!! Whoooooohoooo!” I screamed, then suddenly I heard the bell ring nooo is the end to the GREATEST TIME OF MY LIFE??? As I peeked through the peephole……It was my neighbors, but when I tried to open the door I realized that I couldn’t open it because it was locked! Oops.. a little too loud I Guess. Anyways it’s time to PARTY!! The first thing I did was to have breakfast and by ‘breakfast’ I mean to eat the best Flavour of Ice Cream, which is Cookies and Cream, chocolates and also some Doritos which are also arguably the best chips in the world. It's about 1 o’clock now. It's Lunch time, but I ain’t feeling hungry. “Yeah I’ll skip lunch today” I said. “It's Time for the next activity”. Which is to play Minecraft and Fortnite for an hour or two. Time really flies, because it's 3 o’clock now. I’m super bored right now. I know what to do,“I am going to watch a Movie with some delicious buttery popcorn”. Now Let's decide on which movie to watch, which is the hardest part. “There are no good movies anywhere”. I guess I’ll have to rewatch a movie. My Favorite genres of movies are comedy and action, What's yours? Now it’s between RRR, KGF 2, and Thor Love and Thunder. I was deciding for 27 minutes, and decided to watch KGF 2. It was about 3 hours. I finished the popcorn in the first 20 minutes of the movie. Well now it's about 6:30pm. Now I’m kind of hungry, and I'm also feeling some pasta, but I don’t know how to make it. I've got an idea, I'm going to search on YouTube on how to make some delicious pasta. Long story-short the pasta did not turn out too good. It's about 7:30. I’m getting super bored and tired. I really like drawing. I might just try to draw myself, as I got ready to draw myself........ Ding dong the bell rang. “Yes, they're finally home”. With my hair half combed, I was sprinting to the door, “ouch”!! I stubbed my toe against the wall. Ding dong I heard the bell again, as I was hopping toward the door to open it “I forgot I can’t open the door”, so then I decided to peek through the peephole, “It’s my friends” as it was a sunday my friends call me to come play cricket with them. “Oh come on I missed this one too”. As I went wining to the couch. It’s about 8 o'clock, and suddenly I remembered that my cousins gifted me a lego set in which you have built a mini globe which took me about an hour and half to finish building. It's about 9:30 and I'm still full from the dreadful pasta. I guess it's time to sleep (the best part of the day). The next morning I woke up at about 6:45 am thinking it was a weekday. I was thinking to myself “I could have woken up like this yesterday and had the best day ever”. This morning I was craving Oreos and milk for breakfast. It was mouth-watering. I felt way better after that. I also decided I had to take a bath, a long one. I was in the bathroom for about an hour singing songs and bathing at the same time. It's about 8:30 now. I felt like playing lawn tennis but I could not go out so instead I just used the wall as my opponent. Just as I was getting the hang of it…… crash!! “Oh No, my mom’s favorite flower vase, I broke it”. I wondered and wondered what my mom would say. Until…… I heard the keys unlock the door. “Yes you guys are finally back”!! As I gave them all a big hug, I was sad and happy at the same time. Then I started to have a big interview with all of them. And when I heard them talking about how much fun they had I was super jealous of them. “Hey Jagannath, where's my favorite vase?” asked my Mom. What I learnt from this was to never wake up late or to never be late, And also NOT TO BE LAZY!! By-Jagannatha Datta Rajanala
author: Jagannath Rajanala

title: A Day to Cherish
text: CAUTION: Hi! this is a roller coaster ride with hilarious and awkward moments. So, if you can’t handle the thrill, stop reading and NEVER touch the book again. This story is about Yuna Sasaki and her mom Mrs. Akira Sasaki. Let’s have a glimpse of their lives… “YUNA, YUNA”, said Mrs. Minato to the sleepy head in the class, “rise and shine Missy”, that’s Yuna a carefree teenager girl with hazel eyes and brown hair. Now let’s meet Akira a successful businesswoman. “Good morning mam. How are you this morning?”, said Cho, Akira’s assistant. “Drop the chit chat and get to work”, ordered Akira. Although Yuna is blithe she deep down has a desire to be successful like her mother, while Akira has her secret longing too. She wants a break from her stressful life. It was Friday the 5th of May. Yuna reached home exhausted, while Akira was still in her office, head buried in documents and a lot of caffeine. The clock struck eleven, both Akira and Yuna held their heads and screamed “AAAARRR RRGGGHHHH!” “I wish I was mom”. “I wish I was Yuna”. BOOOOOOM! It was morning. Yuna woke up and exclaimed “WOAH that was a bizarre dream”. She heard a scream and rushed to her mom’s bedroom. Her mom pulled her in front of the mirror and the color drained from her face. Yuna screamed louder than her mother “AAHH, mom is this real, someone PINCH ME! “. They had acquired each others body. Yuna suddenly exclaimed, “This could be the Japanese bliss, wait! You did not wish to be me last night, did you?”. Akira looked at her, “Well I might have, like”. “Mom, stop beating around the bush” exclaimed Yuna. “Well yeah I did”, called out Akira, “but what is the Japanese bliss”. “According to the Japanese bliss, if 5 th day of the 5 th month falls on a Friday, a wish will be granted for a day, explained Yuna. “So that means you wished for swapping lives with me too”, questioned Akira. “FINE! I did I just want to be like you” said Yuna. “Mom, think about it we are getting what we want, we can’t avoid it, come rain or shine” said Yuna. “NO, you will mess up everything,” said Akira. “Come on mom it’s not like your business will go up in flames in a day” said Yuna. Ok honey, FINE, let’s live it up!” said Akira still dubious. Yuna reaches Akira’s office. “Good morning, Ma’am,” said Cho. WOW! I get a personal assistant thought Yuna. “Hey howdy” Cho was shaken. Yuna happily skips around the office just then an employee comes and points at her, “what was that” he looks at Cho who still hadn’t recovered from the bombshell, “today really is a strange day” exclaimed the employee, “we must have misheard her" said Cho. Yuna came back and said, “sorry I got a little carried away, I want to take a round of the office”. “Sure, I’ll lead the way” said Cho, they both walk to the common room. “Why is everyone looking so distressed here?” asked Yuna. Cho looked confused and thought “you are the boss here”. Everyone looks like a corpse, let’s change the vibes around here. “What’s up guys, I have a surprise, today is a PIZZA PARTY for all”. Nobody answered, an employee said nervously, “Ma’am are you feeling under the weather today”. “NOO I am dead serious. “A PIZZA PARTY” everyone started chattering and finally yelled YIPPIE. “Sooo what do we do next?” asked Yuna. “We have a meeting with our biggest investor about a product not doing well,” said Cho. Yuna panicked, “OH NO! What do I do, mom will be mad if I mess up”. In the meeting, she figured out that they were talking about the product kept next to her. Out of curiosity she drank it and spit it out. Everyone’s eyes were on her. “I think we need to improve the taste, people won’t buy something even if it’s healthy but not good in taste”. Retorted Yuna, matter solved. Now let’s see how Akira was holding up. The bell rang and Mrs. Minato walked in “look who decided to show up”, she exclaimed sarcastically, “anyways students today is your algebra test, hope you are all ready, break a leg”. Akira solved the test as quick as flash. Mrs. Minato eyed her through her frames then frantically checked the answers and then said awestruck “f-f-full marks”. Phew that was easy thought Akira. Later that day she was sitting in the cafeteria when Yuna’s friends spotted her. “Hey! are you doing all right you are sitting alone and you pulled no prank today. want to join us for a prank? Astounded she said “I will be informing your mother about this Missy”. Yuna’s friend walked away looking at her as if she had lost her mind. After reaching home both shared about their amazing day. “You know mom I threw a PIZZA PARTY and even handled the biggest investors; it was so much fun”. “WHAT! a pizza party, well I got a perfect score on the algebra test,” said Akira. “You mean I GOT a perfect score” retorted Yuna. “Your friends might be just a little mad at you cause I-I-I scolded them in the cafeteria,” said Akira. “MOM!” ……. alas the day was over and both were elated to go back to their normal lives with sweet memories.

title: The Snow Dragon
text: The story begins in Russia’s East Siberian taiga, a forest laden with snow in the winter months. I am Aleksey and I live just outside the East Siberian Taiga. It was winter, and it had been snowing for the last three days. Now this evening the snowfall finally stopped, and we could go out. But first there were a lot of things to do. We had to shove the snow in the pathway. So, I began work. While doing so, Boris my best friend passed by, and I greeted him. He called me for skiing. I pointed towards the work at hand. After I had finished all the work both of us went skiing. Now something peculiar happened with us while skiing. I was going down a nearby hill (the hill that led to the forest) at full speed when I noticed something like a rat come peep out of a hole. Now, I stopped to ski so that I wouldn’t slam into the poor thing but in the process, I went rolling down the hill! So, Boris and I decided that we had to go to the place where the head had popped out. To our amusement, we saw an adorable, furry, and surprisingly tiny…only about four inches tall creature. A creature neither of us had seen before. A creature just like a snow dragon in those fictional movies we all love to see. I tried holding it in my hand, but it blew sparks out of its mouth. I was confident it was a miniature dragon. I gave it some food to eat because it was sure to be hungry… after such a snowfall. It ate all the food in a jiffy and now it was trying to climb me! I took it into my hand and showed it to my mother asking if we could keep it. My mother’s words- “Now, now Aleksey what did I say about keeping stray animals?” Finally, after a lot of requests and promises she let me keep it. I named it Igor (Now I know it is a weird name for a pet, but it was the best I could think of.) I took Igor outside to show him to my friends.. after all no one had a pet dragon. Now Igor looked like a snow dragon, so I assumed he was one. My friends were so jealous. Oh, I cannot forget the look on their faces. I soon realised that Igor really loved to play in the ice, and I got to know that ice dragons only wake up in the winter and hibernate the rest of the year. I was sad to hear this. I knew then that it would not be long before Igor would go to hibernate again. I could not do anything about it. Anyway, we would often go in the forest because that is where I found Igor. One day while we were in the forest, we heard a loud roar and a sound like a tree falling. I got really scared and was taking Igor back when he started running into the forest. I followed him and saw a huge ice dragon and Igor was near it. I guessed that the ice dragon was Igor’s mother and she had come to take Igor back. I knew that Igor had to go. I bid goodbye to him and so my adorable funny friend went away. I will never forget the time I spent with Igor. I even drew a picture of him and have kept the picture in my room.
author: Dhairya Khanna

title: Ode to the Lost World
text: 'Ode to the Lost World' is an attempt to tell a story in a narrative poetic format - like an epic, a saga, a legend, or a ballad of ages long past and forgotten. Cognition - A safeguard of naiveness amidst forbidden truths And deadly oceans of disillusionment: A gateway to derision and delirium; An awakening from the abyss and chasms, Decay, derangement, Ignorance, falsehood - That creep into the crumbling souls of man. In the desolate dead of night, Shattered moon glistening bright, Sat he in flower’s bay- brilliant dead white; Quoth he – The Wanderer to the sight: “I hurt myself today To see if I still feel pain, A sparkling gash upon a vein, A slash of glistening red stain… Consider this nary but a futile scream into the void Before sinking quietly into oblivion, A weep of once God - now dethroned Cast away and discharged of his duty; An embrace of the inherent duty of all mankind: To suffer for the entirety of eternity; Cast as casualty and cause, Outcast by objectionable opinion of outlaws; A maestro mistreated, masqueraded immodestly, The only derivation to deem is duty To prepare for the perilous passage of purity. So hearken well, For I, aye, have a tale to tell: A tale it is of sacrifice and doom Of lands that descend in sloom Sacred silence and serene sleep And the irrevocable fates that loom. For I cannot save self from the merciless wave – Wave of dishonor, wave of havoc, Wrecked and wreaked by times of late And sons of own who left me to suffocate. Lived have I many a fight And lost have I kith and kin; Alas, ‘tis a life lost to sin And forsaken through roads away Victim to passage of night and day For as wise men of seer’s sight say: Nay, nothing gold can stay.” For even in brightest day, Exists nary but dearth of light, No flame that glistening burns, No alluring hope to spring For wrong can never turn right, The world steeped with mourning. We were loved once, a time so far back Forgotten, truth that faded to legend For the vanity of humanity led to its end. How easy to hear alluring lies, Imagining our own self-importance, Drunk in the pride of wisdom, failing to see the truth… Why then ask the Almighty, “Why hast thou deserted us, O Lord?” To the wanderer: old age burns as a candle flickers- Fluttering of memories like shadows and embers; Words dampened, devoid of lightning. Last of eras whisked by, crying of stillborn glory, Begged he did to catch and preserve life in flight But they realised overdue and lamented delayed And near death see with revelation’s sight, And know ‘Aye – He was right.’ Trepidation to hearken they failed to heed- Not unlike the stars of heaven does the demolished moon bleed - Devoid of cosmic glory like sunken angels: Epitomes of that which once was and never shall be. Blazing meteors rain, A testimony to the valiant valorous slain Their pain certainly in vain. For neither god nor sage Nor even passage of age Could prevent the wrath, The incessant rage. The bleakest winter, Of crackling stone Of pleads of mercy Of mourning moan Of cities long crumbled, Yet fury untumbled. Of thunderous gunshots from barrels echo, Of screeching haunts to the faint humanity that quivers, Bloodiest of streams, corpse–littered rivers. Of shrouding mist accursed, crouching, engulfing; Entombing existence with heralds of ceasing breath - Aye! Obnoxious fumes amongst the damned brigade And in morality and mortality was the price paid. As time passes, we are lost in the textbooks of our descendants. History fades to myth, and our tales lay only in the big, Heavy dusty tomes stored in libraries- Never to be read again. Myth becomes legend, and that too is long forgotten. Life no more than a second compared to all that is, was or ever will be- Pushed backward into insignificance. Held The Wanderer last of Earth’s leaf - For mother of all sank to grief. Dejected souls ponder – Scouring lands yonder... Nay! Not here – for gone is all; To the stars beyond they make the grand fall. And on they go the last remnants… Somewhere into the unknown, Somewhere into the dark, Somewhere into the Cosmic sea. So hearken ghosts in the barren bay, The last man has but this to say: “Perhaps we deem one last pardon - Set on search for Eden’s garden.” And so, with the end of the end began the beginning of the beginning. They were in a very small state, so infinitely small, So utterly insignificant yet so significantly important, So tiny yet so big, So young, yet so late. In oceans uncharted, drifting through unknown- As men tied to Earth, we yearn to conquer the stars. As men tied to the stars, we yearn to touch soil; Though failed and thus returned but not alone. For they tread without dread On landscaped vistas of fertile grounds ‘stead, And grand spires of height immeasurable Stretched above towers of Babel On miles of grove-blessed hills ‘stead: The very grounds upon which they’d bled, And gardens nourished by thunderous rills, Of great carvings upon the hills; Break of dawn with glorious sun’s risin’ For new eons emerge at the horizon. Followed they, the scenery: Ancient groves and stark greenery, Meandering motion, of thoughtless notion, The ripples, the waves, through chasms and caves - Alas! ‘Tis was the sight that loomed In cavern sparkled by dancing light: Their father lay entombed. For in land long lost, in legend’s deep, A red sun rises over the land of sleep. Flame though extinguished, Yet still fluttered an ember, A last ray of hope – A miracle Preserved as if in amber. In epochs and eras ruled by God of old His dignity and life on the line – sold! Shall he not emerge to fulfill intrinsic exorbitant duty And yet priceless, to save his realm of gold? Bloated corpse on life’s tormented shore - Life wrought her ghost upon the floor. Out of the blue and into the black. The silent sea, there is no turning back. Upon the sand there be a stream of red, Upon the walls a message in stain - “I hurt myself today To see if I still feel pain, A sparkling gash upon a vein, A slash of glistening red stain.” Quoth the engraved, “In own blood last words I write; The empyrean crescent of night- Her desolate tears drizzle, Corrosive acid, blinding slithers, Blazing rock, Life that withers. Then hearken of distant tune: I remember clearly, you left so soon Alas! Albeit intellect so great That towering spires and magnificent cities built thee That dwarf the frontiers of cosmic skies And scream unto the vast dark; Mourn! For despite the wonder- You turned blind eyes to a crucial blunder And to flee you have the nerve say While your mother in last breath lay; ‘Tis the greatest order of shame To cast upon your God blame! These words left unsaid, Ideas unthought of, Roads untrodden, sight unseen, stones unturned. Immortal truth blinded, shrouded, hidden... Truth is that we don’t deserve mercy, That God is dead because he never was born, That we made our gods and demons ourselves, or rather: That there was a God and we murdered him, That we could have had a long way to go if we weren’t poisoned by hate, That we took the apple for ourselves and forced ourselves to bite it; And if we didn’t, we shoved it down our throats, That we were so close to truth until we began to think, That no flame is ever doused by more gasoline, That we ended the one and only home and now - Homeless, can’t cope with that fact; That we had a second chance and let it slide, That we point the guns at ourselves instead of fighting to do away with greed and corruption, That we made our own barriers of hate and forced others to do so, That we were offered the throne of heaven But we kicked ourselves out And crowned ourselves Satan Only to condemn the very thing we are… But I am your father who loves you, And you will come back home And be my sons again. Thus fought have I till last breath Desire do I no less than death, Nowhere to run, Nowhere to hide, Nothing beyond on the other side, For the heart that fed Is the life that fled, Hearken, for God is dead!” They are us and this is our tale, Wanderers in a lost world Hoping against hope; Hopers in a forgotten age Wandering in search of others like us. So hearken sons in the green bay, The last man has but this to say: “Like dignity fake, bestowed upon for mere sake Or infancy’s innocence inevitably exiled, Clouded minds, intellect’s concealed shrines But truth eternal indivisible. Granted you are, my last pardon You now stand in Eden’s garden.” “That is not dead which can eternal lie, And with strange aeons even death may die.” -H.P. Lovecraft
author: SHAURYA CHHATWAL

title: Lost And Reunited
text: Amy Miller was a happy-go-lucky girl who lived with her parents in California. They were very happy together. Amy also had a little white kitten named Rudolph. She loved him a lot and took him everywhere she went. One cold, rainy day, Amy and Rudolph lay on the bed, reading. At night, the terrible rain continued. The next day, Amy felt wet on her face and when she woke up, she got to know that the roof had been washed away with the rain. She also noticed something else: Rudolph was missing. Why, he was always there! Where did he go? She went to her parents, but they were very busy finding someone to repair their roof. They hardly heard Amy and her cries. She went from house to house asking people if they had seen a cat. But people either did not answer her or people said they hadn't seen him since yesterday. Feeling sad, Amy went home. The roof had been repaired by now. Her parents saw her looking sad and depressed. They asked her what happened. She replied, "Rudolph is missing." and started crying. Her parents tried to console her by giving her her favourite food and toys but she only said one thing: "I want my Rudolph back!" At night after making Amy sleep, her mother told Amy's father, "We must find that cat. Amy is inconsolable." To which Amy's father replied, "How do I find a little kitty, that too in a waterlogged area? Who knows, maybe it has died." Amy, who had heard this, was even more determined to find Rudolph. She remembered that their phone number was on his collar. She put flyers everywhere she could find place. Every day, she prayed that her cat would come back, or someone would return him back. Finally, her prayers were answered. It was Sunday. Amy was sitting on the couch when her phone rung. An old lay had called up. She said, "I have a cat that looks exactly like in the picture. He also has a collar with this number. Is he yours?" Amy's eyes lit up. "Yes!", she said, "He is mine! can you please return him back?" The old lady promptly answered, "Sure, where will I find you?" "At number 7, Dison Street." The cat was returned the very next day. The lady told her that scared from l lightening, the cat had jumped from the window and came to her. She had given him food and shelter until she saw the flyer. One sunny day, Amy law with Rudolph on the windowsill with a book. As she lay there, she thought, could life be better?
author: Mahek Porwal
