title: Beauty in Bald
text: ﻿ Laces tied up; hair kept in a secure bun. I was now ready to go on stage. To my surprise, I found it difficult to breath. This had never happened before but it was possible after all, it was the final match. The match that will determine who would be the best ballet dancer in our state. I took a deep breath glancing at the audience; there may be hundreds...no thousands of people watching my every step. As the song started, I started dancing, I had practiced this routine over a hundred times but for some reason I found it difficult to do it now, the pain in my chest from this morning had now worsened, I kept going until the pain in my chest became unbearable and after wards all I could remember was the blurry faces of the audience in shock. I woke up in the Emergency Room with a Nasal Cannula and my mother by my side. What happened to me? My mother looked worried, when she turned around, she did not say anything. She just brushed my hair with her fingers which comforted me a little. Just then a doctor holding some files barged in and gave me a smile but I knew something was up. “Good morning Mrs. Singh” said the doctor with a weary smile “Good morning doctor, what were the results of the CT scan and the X-ray?” “Um…yes. I was about to tell you about that. The X-ray showed a mass in lily’s lungs…” “M-mass? As in…tumor?” “Unfortunately, yes…” the doctor said as she gently stroked my head. There was pin-drop silence in the room, the word around me was spinning around. I am too young to die! The doctor then spoke about a few more things but I could hear none of that, all I could hear were my thoughts and how my dream of being a ballet dancer would be crushed. We drove home, with a nasal cannula attached. The doctor said I would have to wear it every day from now on. On the way home, mom did not say anything, just held my hand tightly. She was on the verge of crying but was resisting because it would upset me. We reached home and I went upstairs in a daze, my head spinning. I locked my door and stuffed my head in a pillow. The world around me had shattered, all my dreams, memories. It was all useless now. This was not what I wanted! I wanted to be normal. I wanted to dance and win trophies enough to fill a house, I wanted to go on a tour with all my friends, go to concerts, have fun! Not stuck with this stupid tube in my nose with an oxygen cylinder to be carried around everywhere I go! The sun rose and the world remained the same. Only, I was stuck at home with online classes going on. Eventually, I had the break the news to my friends and family, which was the toughest part. I couldn’t bear to see tears in their eyes. I started making memories; spending more time with my family, doing all that I wanted to do, in my power. Soon a week passed and it was the day of the next appointment, we walked through the hospital doors nervously. The doctor smiled at me as she walked by. “How are you, has the pain in your chest reduced? I hope you are taking your medications timely.” she said clasping my hand firmly. “Yes, the pain has reduced and I take my medications regularly.” I replied, giving a dishonest smile. The doctor smiled again and spoke about all the procedures and preparation we will have to make before the taking first dose of chemotherapy and gave us the medicine. But whatever that thing was, it was not medicine. Only a week had passed by, and I saw that devil sucking away all the remaining happiness of my life. First my strength, then my hair... I watched my bald head in the mirror, just a few months ago I used to braid my long, raven locks. Regret filled within me until I couldn’t breathe, this time even the cannula did not help. What if I had gone to the doctor when the symptoms first showed up? Could I have been cured then? All these thoughts were plaguing my mind, driving me insane. The doorbell rang but I was too tired to get up so my father answered instead, it was Sana. My best friend. She rushed to my room cheerfully which brought a grin to my face, this time an honest one. She was the only one keeping me going, the only one who did not treat me different. Being with her made me feel as if I were the same and nothing had ever changed. “Hey your birthday is next week! What should we do for the party!” she said jumping. “Ha...in this state what party am I going to have” I mumbled. “Oh, come on, don’t be so depressed. Plus, aren’t you a little curious on what I planned for you?” she said twirling her hair. “Wait- when did you plan something for me?” “You will find out; so shall we start planning?" And that said, we started planning for the party. The decorations, games, cake all were being planned and we were inviting everyone in our class and everyone I was close with. Like a flash, a week went by in busy planning and the day finally arrived! Today was my birthday and I never thought I would feel excited for my probably last birthday. I was greeted in bed by my parents from where I sat on the wheelchair and saw the decorations. It was truly wonderful. I wore the best dress I had and dressed like a princess. I patiently waited for the guests to arrive. I was happy and sad at the same time. It was nearly five and the guests started to arrive except for Sana, she messaged me and said she will arrive when it would be time for ‘the massive surprise’. Well now I was even more curious on what the surprise was. My friends did a good job of making me forget I was still on oxygen support. I had the best evening of my life; talking, playing games, singing songs, stuffing our faces with cakes. Who knew life could be so fun! Only if I had more time to enjoy it… It was 7:00pm and just as we were going to cut the cake, Sana appeared…only…she was…bald? Next to her were a few more strangers, all of them bald, all of them smiling bright with a sparkle in their eyes. Sana moved towards me, with a box in her hand. I felt a lump in my throat and couldn’t help but smile. Inside were the loveliest wigs I had ever seen! I burst into tears and hugged Sana. “Thank you, thank you so much...” I had no words; I could not stop crying. “Haha don’t say thanks to me, say thanks to these people who were willing to donate their hair” Sana said, clasping her hand with mine. Somehow that gave me more strength than I have ever felt up to this point. I had never been happier in my life. Even though I knew these wigs would not help cure my disease, but it gave the hope and support to live, I felt re-assured that there were still people who loved and supported me unconditionally and would continue to do the same.
author: Anashwara Manoj Menon

title: THE ROBOT WITH A HUMAN HEART
text: Jennifer Smith, a ten-year-old girl, lives in Sugarcoat Galaxy, in California, US. Jennifer was much loved and adored by her parents, grandparents, uncles and aunts-she would win over anyone with her winning smile and playful nature. Her mother, Becky, works for an MNC. Her dad, Smith, works as an engineer. Jennifer loved both her parents dearly, and would give up anything to spend more time with them. Her parents try to make the most out of any possible leisure time they get, which is seldom. Jennifer was gifted a pet dog by her dad for her eighth birthday. She named the dog “Skittles”, inspired by her favourite chocolate brand. Skittles was an ecstatic little creature, you would see him running around their house, turning everything topsy-turvy and breaking antique vases that Becky held close to her heart. Skittles was no ordinary dog-he was a hybrid of a robot and a Dalmatian. Smith had designed it exclusively for his daughter. It was a herculean task, he worked hours on end, and burnt the midnight oil starting literally eight months before her birthday. But his efforts did not fail him, it never did. And eureka! A new species, a new creature! Jennifer loved her pet dog so much. She would feed him every single food item she could come up with-be it burgers, pastries, ice-creams, fruit juices, and a strawberry shortcake-to top it all! Boy, how I wish I were Skittles! The family’s cook, Jumpkins, was a robot. She could make ten savouring, mouth-watering dishes at once! Jumpkins was the household helper too. She kept the house in order, helped Jennifer with her homework, and made comfort food for Mrs and Mr Smith when they needed it the most. Man, life in 2030 is radically different! There was a separate room in the house designated for her studies where she would sit for six hours a day, learning Math, English, Science, Art, and even Music! Her teacher was a hologram figure and would be activated with the touch of a switch. Boy, how she dreaded Math! In the tests held recently, Jennifer scored well in all subjects except Math. She was no Math material. She was no person who could remember numbers. The slightest sound of Math made her sick. The hologram supported six levels, of which she was in the fifth. Once all six levels were completed, a new package of the next four levels would be installed on the same hologram. Jennifer was a bright and inquisitive student. She typed and sent in her questions in the question box whenever it popped up. As Jennifer’s parents were busy almost every day, they seldom found time to spend with her or look after her. Jumpkins was her nanny, she would take care of Jennifer so lovingly and dearly like her mother. But a mother is a mother, and always will be. Jennifer yearned for her mother’s love. However, all was not well with Becky and her job. Everything was controlled mainly by robots, and the possibilities of humans being employed in the same company were slim. Becky knew that she would soon be fired, and the CEO hinted it constantly. This was something she dreaded. She contributed a huge chunk to the savings and expenses of the family, although Smith did too. But her getting unemployed would mean that huge chunk vanishing, which meant an extra burden on Smith, which she wasn’t looking forward to. Besides, she believed that women could work and had equal opportunities as men. Women, hypothetically and mentally, are stronger. As a result, Becky started working overtime, she would even work during her free hours and never got to spend time with her family. But she never shared her anxieties with anyone. She worked and worked ever more meticulously, spent little to no time with the family and scarcely had time to sleep. Although Smith was equally busy, he seemed to be able to negotiate for himself a little time for slumber and rest. Jennifer was deeply concerned for her mother. She tried baking a batch of her mother’s favorite cookies all by herself, seeking the aid of Jumpkins. She thought her mother would eventually take some time off her work and, possibly appreciate her for her efforts. But the worst was yet to come. Becky was in a very serious conversation with Mr Henry, a robot, the CEO of the MNC she was working in when Jennifer barged right in. Mr Henry threatened to sue Becky if she requested leisure time. Becky was trying to talk her way through it when she felt a gentle pat on her shoulder. Much to her shock, she saw Jennifer, standing there, ever so innocently, with a tray of her favourite cookies in her hands, eyes sparkling with hope of spending time with her mother. Whether or not it impressed her mother, it definitely infuriated her. She immediately declined the call with the CEO in a frenzy, wondering if Jennifer would have overheard something. “Don’t you know you shouldn’t be here at this time of the day?” says her mother, frustrated. “Mommy, I just wanted to spend some time with you. Do you know that you have been working non-stop for three and a half days? That is concerning, Mommy” replies Jennifer, innocently. “Out with you and your damn cookies! Don’t you realize that I’m staking our lives here? Don’t ever bother to come and disturb me! Get that straight into your head!” Becky yelled at her daughter, who was, by now, teary-eyed and shook. She slowly walked out of the room, still thinking about what was bothering her mother so much. This was all too much for her to digest. She instantly ran up to her room, closed the door and cried, with her head sunk into her pillow. She didn’t want anyone to know, after all. Her father coincidentally walked by her room and heard the muffled sounds of crying and sniffling. He immediately made his way into her room and asked Jennifer what had happened. Jennifer was inconsolable. “It’s mom” she managed to say coherently through sobs of distress. “I made a bunch of cookies for her, in the hope of spending more time with her, but she was rude and she admonished me!” said Jennifer. “Let me talk to her. Don’t worry sweetie, everything’s gonna be alright in no time!” consoled her father. He immediately went up to his wife’s office, where she was working like a machine, and pulled out the plug to the main system. “What in the world is wrong with you, Smith?” shouted Becky. “Well, that's something you’d have to answer. What is wrong with you Becky? Why do you not take time off work to eat, sleep or even spend time with Jennifer? We had agreed upon that when we decided to get employed, didn’t we? After all, it is mandatory to provide at least two hours of rest to every human worker” argued Smith. “They threatened to sue me if I wouldn’t work overtime. I would never want to be unemployed. Besides, the burden on your shoulders would become heavier. I don’t want that to happen to you, Smith” confessed Becky. “Don’t worry, my love. We will surely figure out a way to get ourselves out of this mess” reassured Smith. Besides working in an MNC, Becky is also a well-known baker in her locality. Whenever there was a birthday party in their colony, she would get orders for birthday cakes, and she never refused them. She made first-class, mouth-watering, and delicious cakes, with icing and cream in her kitchen. Smith decided to set up a bakery for his wife, where the chief baker would be Becky. The bakery was to be named “Jennifer’s Bakes”. Jennifer was thrilled. She helped her dad in organizing and setting up the bakery once she was done with school. She invited several of her friends to her apartment for the opening ceremony. Smith too invited a few of their neighbours. Once everything was organized, Becky was brought to the bakery and on seeing it, she was blown away! The opening ceremony was grand, with almost forty people present, to witness and take part in the Smiths’ happiness. Becky inaugurated the kitchen and baked a delicious white truffle cake. It was delicious and savouring! They even got in their first few orders, and the clients simply loved their cakes as it was delicious and was totally made with love. “Thank you so much for making this a reality, Smith” Becky exclaimed. She decided not to work for an inhuman CEO at the MNC, and took up the job in her bakery full-time with a robotic waiter, who could help her with everything. They were once again a big, happy and jolly family! Jennifer Smith, a 10-year-old girl, yearns to spend more time with her mom, who is busy with her work. She never turns up for dinner, checks on Jennifer, kisses her goodnight or reads bedtime stories to her. Meanwhile, something's happening with her mom and her job. Will the family survive, with such seldom family time? Will Jennifer finally get what she was yearning for all this time? “One machine can do the work of fifty ordinary men. No machine can do the work of one extraordinary man”

title: Katie And the Mischief Maker
text: "Ughh!!" Katie yelled. she was dying out of boredom. "Why did mom have to bring us here?!" she argued. Katie was a very curios girl. She talked a lot and questioned everything! Katie and her family had moved to the countryside for a few days because of her mother's work, but Katie had other plans. she had wanted to spend this time with her friends in the city. "The countryside is so boring! there's absolutely nothing to do!" she told her dad. " Katie there are plenty of thigs to do! take a walk, explore the area, go see the mountains! Her dad lectured. "Oh okay! i am going but can't say that I'll be having fun. "She grabbled. she grabbed her coat and went outside. she could about and saw a narrow path leading deeper in the forest She started walking towards it. suddenly the air filled up with thick mist. Katie hurried and walked faster in order to reach the end of the path. At the end she saw an old woman sitting on a rock with her eyes closed. the woman was surrounded by dogs! All sorts of dogs, they were all sitting with their eyes closed. "Hello! I am Katie, these dogs are so cute, are they yours miss." "They sure are!' the women slowly opened her eyes and looked toward Katie," my child, I too many of these dogs now. As I grow old it is becoming harder and harder to manage them all. If you want one, go ahead and take it."The old women spoke in a faint voice. "Miss I would love to, but I don't know which one to choose!" Katie blurted. She was quite taken aback by the offer. "Dear child How about that one, he is just a baby right now, his energy is too much for my old bones. "The women said pointing towards I white puppy with brown spots. Katie thanked the old women and started walking back home with her new dog." well, maybe this trip to the countryside won't be that boring after all. She said looking at her dog. Suddenly the dog grabbed Katie by the hand and ran in the opposite direction, even though Katie had a horrid expression on her face the dog was running with a massive smile on his face. The dog ran and ran until he stopped in the middle of the forest in front on a small stone statue, of a weird looking frog creature. Katie curious as always, walked towards it and then touched its head. as soon as she did that, there came a huge beam of light and the statue came to life! with a fake French accent he began to say" oh my lord! 150 years have passed already?!" he looked down at Katie and spoke again " you must be the shifter" "The what?" Katie asked, she was not expecting this sort of thing to happen out of the blue! "The shifter, my child! you are the one who awoke me. i am the mischief maker, i can grant you three wishes of your choice, the only rule is that you cannot ask for more wishes." he said proudly. Katie thought and thought, she kept on wondering what she wanted the most. Finally, Katie said" I would like to talk to this dog please" she said pointing towards her pet. "As you wish shifter" the mischief maker grinned. as soon as he said this, he disappeared and all that was left was the statue. "well, that was weird! but you shouldn't have trusted him," said a deep voice. Katie astonished looked at the dog, the dog looked back, they both stared at each other and then burst out laughing! "Oh! you can speak!" Katie roared the dog and Katie talked all evening, they had the best time ever! as the sun started to set, Katie realized she should better head home now. by now Katie had asked her pet his name, it was MOMO, Katie thought it was such a cute name! as soon as she reached home, she had wanted to go in her room, but her parents stopped her mid-way. "KATIE!! where have you been all day!? We were so worried about you!" Katie's mother yelled. Katie's mother was a scientist, she never came out of her study room, so you'd know that something big had happened if you saw her outside! "you know it's not safe to wander here and there in the night!" her dad said. " anyways me and your mother have something to tell you katie.... this might seem dissapointing, but katie you need to understand that we cannot go back to the city, your mother needs to stay here, in the countryside for her work" her dad explained hesitantly. WHAT!!? i thought we had moved here for a couple of days only! "Katie yelled. she did not want to stay in the countryside, she wanted to be with all her friends. "Katie are you okay? Why are you talking like this?" her mother questioned. by now Kattie had realized what had happened, her parents could not understand her at all because of the mischief maker, her parents could only hear Katie saying some rubbish in dog language, that no one understood. Katie thought it was all her fault because that trickster had allowed her to talk to Momo but at a very high cost. furious with not only herself, but the mischief maker and her parents, she grabbed Momo from the lawn and ran out the door. her parents kept on calling out to her, but she did not listen. "Katie! don't think rationally, I know you are going to the mischief maker but please understand, He's a trickster, I had warned you earlier also. just make sure you know what you are asking this time so that you won't get tricked again!" Momo explained to Katie while trying to calm her. Katie though, did not listen to anyone. she kept on running and running, she kept on thinking that if her parents had never moved her none of this would have ever happened! as soon as she reached the mischief maker, she awakened him from the statue "back so soon?" he said in a creepy manner. "THIS IS ALL YOUR FAULT!!" Katie yelled at him. " Child i think you are mistaken! this is clearly all YOUR fault! you are the one who came to me! "The mischief maker answered. "Yeah right, just let me make my next wish! i wish that my parents had never moved here! "Katie said, not thinking about it twice." uh oh!" Momo worriedly exclaimed.as soon as Katie asked her wish the trickster vanished again. "What just happened? why are we still here "Katie said after looking around. "that's right Katie, we will always be here now, while asking your wish you accidently said, 'my parents', which means that your parents haven't moved here but you have. i tried to warn you Katie, I wanted you to make the correct decision, but it's okay, we'll have to figure something out" Momo said sensibly. suddenly an idea struck Katie, but she knew she had to ask Momo if he would agree to it. after they both discussed how the plan will take place, Katie awakened the mischief maker again. Katie and Momo both held hands and said the last wish at the same time "we want to erase this reality!" "Are you sure?! do you know what consequences you will be facing?" the mischief maker said in a worried manner. until now he was having lots of fun tricking the young girl, but her final wish was not expected! "yes, i am completely sure" said Katie confidently. Yet again the trickster vanished into the statue but then came a huge gust of wind and then suddenly, the whole world went completely blank. Katie and Momo were only able to see themselves as they had been holding hands this whole time "i hope this plan succeeds" Momo said, suddenly feeling that they did something wrong. "This plan will not fail, i just know it. now all you have to do Momo is find the mischief maker and make your first wish to bring back things just like they were before i asked my first wish, got it Momo? so, Momo asked the trickster what he was told, his wish was granted, and everything went back to normal, nobody knew about it, it was just Katie's and Momo's own little secret!

title: The Two Gamers - The Successful and The Selfish
text: There lived two boys named Akash and Anil, they were 14 years of age and were professionals at gaming. They started gaming when they were 12 years old and found it really fun. At first they started gaming as they thought it would be a sign of "entertainment". They had played a variety of video games like Minecraft, Roblox, Fortnite and many more. One day when Akash and Anil were 13 years old, Akash decided to take things a step further. He said to himself "Instead of playing video games just for fun, I can try to make it into a career!". He thought of it for a while, but decided to tell this idea to his friend Anil. Anil found his idea really interesting. They both decided to make a Youtube channel named "Akash and Anil". They thought it was brilliant! They first started making tutorial on how to play some video games and later on started making gameplay videos. Their channel was growing quickly! They had reached 1 thousand subscribers and were really thankful to their fans. A few months had passed and Akash and Anil had finally reached 100 thousand subscribers. Akash and Anil were surprised at how much they had grown in population. Akash was super excited and so was Anil, But Anil had some other plans... Anil thought to himself "Since I and Akash have become so popular, I am going to make another channel for myself and leave out Akash". Anil didn't want to say this to Akash so he thought of just leaving it be and creating a channel for himself without Akash knowing. Five days have passed since Anil had created a channel, Akash had still not noticed but he decided to make a Questions and Answers video where they would look through their comment section and answer the questions their fans have sent. While browsing through the comment section Akash had found that several people were talking about Anil's new Youtube channel. Akash was shocked, he found out that Anil had his own channel even though he had promised Akash that they would have a group channel only. Akash told Anil that he knew what he was doing. Akash and Anil got into an argument. At one point Anil said "I never wanted your help to become successful anyway!" Akash was shocked. Their fight ended at that point and they both had split ways. A few days after the argument, Akash and Anil's fans noticed that their group channel had been deleted. The fans were wondering what was wrong, so some of them decided to comment on Anil's channel saying "Where did your and Akash's group channel go?", "Is there any fight between you and Akash?” A few months had passed and Akash had gotten over the fight and decided to make his own channel. His channel grew quickly because of his fan base. Akash had become more successful than ever meanwhile in the other hand Anil had not been doing so well. Anil was devoid of ideas and was only talking bad about Akash as Akash grew more popular than Anil. Anil regretted his decisions and felt guilty for talking bad about Akash. So, Anil decided to call Akash and apologise to him. They both talked it out and Akash forgave Anil and they both got back together and continued on with their group channel. They lived happily ever after. Moral: Forgive and forget the bad deeds, considering the good times spent together

title: Two Valid Quetsion
text: two Valid Question One day in compact and half destroyed forest lived a herd of elephant. Their leader "Ganraj" who had 80 years of long experience in this habitat. They were taking sun Bath on by one while Gunraj was keeping eye on hunters. Because there was limited space only one animal at a time. Now it was time for youngest, cutest and naughtiest calf of the herd name "Gannu". He was not behaving and was running hither and thither wasting time of others by not taking sun bath. Seeing this his mother came out and gave a tight smack on his head. Gannu cried Ouchiie! The eldest heard the bickering and came out to see what is happening. He asked what is going on?In an annoyed and angry tone. Gannu went to him and asked in a very irritating tone; why do we have a limited space of only one animal to have sun bath at a time? Gunraj looked at him at his sudden Question. He said everything has happened because of human and their so called innovation. Gannu cried What?! Humans; how and why? Now it is time for Gunraj to explain, he saidfirst take your bath. I will explain because it is almost time for the streak of tiger to take sun bath. And i don't want to create a mess. Gannu's patience level has reached in outter space he starts shouting at his Grandpa's face asking Why we have limited space? We also have dirty and limited drinking water. We also have dirty and dusty air, it really irritates my trunk! Now I better get my answer. Now Gunraj strated disclosing the hidden and untold story of the past and destruction of nature by human spices. When I was of your age, the forest had a greenery, freshness in air brithness, overwhelming weather, wherethere are birds chirping, morning's due, cold breeze to night where Owl's hooting and moon's cool rays in the ending. And for the fact there were many animals then this, there were some who went to extinct., who are endangered, and who are really rare. Years went like this, humans started evolving and started creating technologies. They started being selfish, as they stared demolishing, conquering everything. They miss used the gift of nature like air, water and soil. Gannu asked really!As the population of human started to grow they first captured our forest and they made concrete jungle but yet they were not satisfied. They created the destruction of nature the "PLASTIC". It started polluting marine life as well as land. Not only Plastic but the chemical water from factory, sewage water and dumping of garbage. It made the blue shining clear water to green dirty and foamy water. After almost destroying the marine life. They also didn't spare our atmosphere. They polluted it by deadly smokes from chimneys, cars and factories. They also didn't spare outer space by sending many space crafts and satellites. Gunraj was about to tell more but Gannu started sobbing and saying " humans are so selfish not less than monsters"! Why are they so selfish? Now Ganni's two valid questions forced Gunraj to think twice about past is past, we should think what we could do in our present for the future. "It is the biggest challenge for human to revert environment to its real". Gunraj consoled Gannu that now "humans have stared thinking about mother nature. May be when you will be in your youth you may experience better conditions than what we are leaving in". Grandpa's this line made small Gannu so happy that he stared dancing, thinking he will have better habitat to live in. Gannu's TWO VALID QUESTIONS " should be realized by humans before its to late".

title: Dog and his bone
text: The Dog and the Bone Once there was a dog who wandered the streets night and day in search of food. One day, he found a big juicy bone and he immediately grabbed it between his mouth and took it home. On his way home, he crossed a river and saw another dog who also had a bone in its mouth. He wanted that bone for himself too. But as he opened his mouth, the bone he was biting fell into the river and sank. That night, he went home hungry.
author: NikToxiC

title: GOOD DEEDS ALWAYS COMES BACK
text: I t was about six months back when my father was sitting idle at home without any job. He was distressed but never burst out his stress on us. He was a school teacher who lost his job due to corona pandemic. As the school had to reduce its staff. Our daily needs were running on his savings and after some days his savings were like a tip of a pen. He made so many efforts to get a job but due to the uncertain pandemic he was failed to get it. We all were worried about the job of my father and the rising needs of the family. Somehow, we were passing our bad days with a smile on our faces. One day Sharma Uncle, my dad’s friend came to our place. He is the only person who had not left my father’s hand in his hard time. They both were having a cup of tea together, and suddenly uncle told my father about a job opportunity in the nearby town. Mr. Sharma then enquired about that job opening in the nearby town from his one of his acquaintances. And asked my father to go and apply for that job. My father with a sigh of relief accepted that proposal and took this on priority, my mother also stood with him on his decision to move to different town for it. My father with a thought that ‘something is better than nothing’, packed his bag and left for the nearby town next morning. It took three hours to reach there. When he reached there, he found that the town is receiving very heavy rainfall which might have had lead to flood in some days if the rain wouldn’t stop. He decided to rest in a nearby inn as he was completely drenched. He went to the nearby inn and asked the owner for a suitable room. The owner showed a room which was good to spend a night and take some rest. My father spent that night there and looked forward for the better days ahead. Next morning, he woke up early and found that it was still raining cats and dogs and he couldn’t think of going out in search of a job. After waiting for two long hours, he finally decided to go out and check the place for work. Suddenly he noticed that his shoes were unfit to wear as they are wet due to heavy rain. He then, asked the owner of the inn whereabouts of the cobbler. To which the owner replied, “around one kilo metres ahead of this place”. While moving towards the cobbler my father saw few children crying helplessly and their mothers with teary eyes as they had lost their everything in that rain which caused floods. And the town with its people were almost shattered and cried for help. My father first decided to come back to his home but how could he leave those children looking for help who were stuck in the middle of water with no roof left on their heads. My dad decided to help them to get rid of the flooded street and provided some edibles to the people who were stuck in the flood. His work was noticed by one of the in-charges of the several rescue teams working there. And that same evening the in-charge of the NGO Rapid Response called my father and offered him an opportunity to work with his NGO, as they were also in the need of people who worked selflessly for the safety of the people stuck in somewhere because of the calamities. My father with a sigh of relief accepted this wonderful opportunity and that too on good financial terms. The very next day was my father’s first day as a lead rescuer in their NGO. He then telephoned us and informed about this golden opportunity and made our living better and financially stable. We were very happy and were feeling proud of my father as he was doing something that saved other people’s life. Moral – Good deeds always come back in sooner or later.

title: Love for Pets
text: Once there was a girl named Renu. She saw a cat lying on the road. She quickly picked the cat and went to her house. She gave the cat some milk. The cat was very happy to see the milk because she did not eat or drink for many days. Then Renu thought that she would make the cat her pet. At evening when she came from school she played with the cat. One day when she was playing with the cat the cat got senseless. Renu went her to hospital. After sometime the doctor came out and said Renu that the cat was totally fit and healthy. Hearing this Renu was so happy. After some days later Renu's father came from his work. On seeing him Renu quickly hugged her father and said that she had a pet cat. She called her Kitty. Renu told his father about her pet how she found the cat and played with her after coming from school. After some days his brother came from completing his studies. He loved the animals very much. On seeing the cat Renu's brother asked her about her pet. Renu told her brother about the whole story about the cat how she found her and how she played with her after returning from school. After 2 weeks Renu's brother found a dog on the road and he thought that he also make the dog his pet. He quickly picked the dog and then went to his house. He played with the cat and dog all time. One day when Renu's whole family went for shopping in the Bazaar a Thief tried to break the lock of Renu's house. When the dog saw he started to bark. The thief got afraid and quietly run away. Sometime later they returned home. Renu and his brother saw a shoe outside their house. They thought that whose shoe was that. They told their parents about the shoe outside their house. After sometime they saw the dog. There was a piece of cloth in his mouth. They understood everything that what was happened actually. They all got happy for the dog's work and arranged a special food for the dog and the cat. They both were happy and lived together at home and did not fight with each other.
author: Swayambhu Biswas

title: Women's Life in Iran
text: Two weeks ago It was a scorching day and I was quietly working when my boss arrived at me with a smile on her face. ‘Jyoti you are selected for a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity.’ ‘Do I finally get a promotion? Asked Jyoti. ‘No, You are selected to write an article about the current situation in Iran and for that, you are going to Iran.’ ‘Iran? that is nice. I am looking forward to this article and I will not disappoint you.’ ‘You better not. So, I have booked your ticket to Iran and you will be leaving tomorrow early morning.’ ‘ Okay boss, no problem. I will be leaving now.’ I was so thrilled when I heard this news from my boss. I have to tell my parents about this once-in-a-lifetime opportunity. The next morning was a big day for jyoti as she was leaving for Iran. it was her first time travelling on a plane to cover a story. Judy wondered what life would be like for women living in Iran. After a journey of seven hours, Jyoti finally arrived at Iran’s capital, Tehran. I am so excited to write an article. I should cover my head properly in case I get in trouble. Jyoti had to find a place to stay as she forgot to book a hotel in a hurry while she was looking for a place to stay, She spotted an Indian person near the Mosque. Judy thought maybe the person will be able to help her. ‘Excuse me, are you from India?’ ‘Yes, are you from India as well?’ Asked the person. ‘Yes, but I’m having trouble finding a place to stay. Do you know any place?’ ‘ You can come with me. I live nearby.’ ‘thank you.’ ‘ I can also, give you a tour so you can get familiar with the places. Said the person.’ ‘ I’m very thankful for your help.’ ‘You are welcome. Shall we go now?’ Jyoti was stunned by the art heritagewhen she was taking a tour. The locals living in that area were very nice to her even though she was Iranian. Days passed but Jyoti could not find anything to write for the article. ‘What should I do now? I am not able to write anything for the article.’Jyoti said to herself. Maybe I should go outside, who knows I will find something to write. When Jyoti was taking a stroll, she saw many people surrounding the mosque. full of curiosity, Jyoti went there to ask the locals what was happening until she saw it herself. A woman is being held in custody for not wearing her hijab appropriately. ‘Excuse me, why are they taking her in custody?’ ‘She didn’t cover hard head properly according to the rules. Soon after a young woman named MahsaAmini was taken in by the morality police, people rushed to the police station to see what was going to happen next. But when they reached the police station, she was not there and when they asked where she was they said: She is being taken to the hospital asshe fainted on the floor. The real case was that she was severely beaten up and died as a result of police brutality. That is when Jyoti thought I should write an article about the death of an innocent woman. This will help spread awareness. What shocked jyoti was women taking off their hijab and cutting off their hair around the world in support of Mahsaamini. I can not live in a country where women are suppressed by their own families. I will have to leave Iran as soon as possible. RIDDHIMA AHLUWALIA VIII C 1578
author: Riddhima Ahluwalia

title: The Talking Mango Grove
text: The sharp notes of the hawker whistling rang true early morning in Dhartiya. “Fruits, get your fruits” he shouted every once in a while, before going back to his sweet melody. A melody that was vaguely familiar to Ishani. “Have we heard this before?” Meera asked her before humming along with the stout man. Perhaps they had but Ishani had no time or interest left for mere music. She was on a quest for something far more appealing to the ears of a lonely sixteen-year-old stuck in a lackluster village. She was in pursuit of a storyteller. In a place like Dhartiya, storytellers were like pure honey – mystical and highly valued. And everyone knew the true currency in the village was a tale. Ishani was no ordinary girl. She didn’t rely on the notion of luck or good fortune – she was out to make her own. After months of exchanging letters with the enthusiasts like her, she knew with a certain amount of certainty that Reshu was coming through her town. Reshu was the kind of storyteller who had stories written about him. Meera had once told her that Reshu had tricked the king into lending him the crown. Reshu being clever, hadn’t specified when the crown would be given back, and had taken it along with him. Ishani had listened to the story with wide eyes and wonder. Now, she would finally get to meet him. And perhaps he could make her secret wish come true. Perhaps he would let her accompany him, far away from this town to a place where stories ran rampant. “Why are we here at the crack of dawn?” Meera complained, after the hawker had gone and her interest was open to being captured. Ishani didn’t answer, her eyes searching as far as they could. She hadn’t told her best friend about her dream to leave. “I hate mornings” Meera continued, “I miss my warm bed. You better have a good reason for dragging me here!” Meera in the mornings was almost as rare a sight as Reshu himself, so it was a mark of their friendship that she had come to support her. “I’ve told you a thousand times” Ishani said thoroughly exasperated, “Reshu is coming to Dhartiya”. Meera stopped dead in her tracks. “Wait” she paused, “you were being serious about that?”. “As serious as a jar of honey” Ishani said passionately. Meera looked as if she couldn’t choose between laughing or crying or both. But in the end she sat next to her best friend with grim determination. And so, the waiting began. It was amusing how time worked so efficiently when you were having a good time and it positively crawled along when you were not. It was taking so long that they dozed off. Ishani was just starting to dream of pink skies and everlasting horizons when she heard the clitter – clatter of leather boots coming their way. “Meera!” she cried, “Wake up, wake up. He’s here!” Meera woke up grumbling. That changed as soon as they saw the man entering their quaint little town, his flaming red hair the only indicator that he was no mere man. Other than the hair, the rest of him was surprisingly average. Often you build something up in your head so much that the reality is disheartening in contrast. “Sir! Sir” Ishani cried out from the edge of the town they were at, “Reshu!” On hearing his name, his head turned towards Ishani and Meera. “Who are you?” he asked, his eyes an enigma and his voice melodious. “Such and such” Ishani replied quickly, “who we are seldom matters. Who you are does. I have waited so long to meet you and hear some of your tales. Would you care to do us the honor?” “Ah that is where you are wrong. Who you are is the only sure thing in this sometimes predictably unpredictable but often unpredictably predictable world.” Ishani devoured each word he said, wishing she had brought a notebook. “To answer your question, I would be delighted to entertain a fellow aficionado. Let us make way to the center and I will answer every question you both have.” They made their way towards the center of town, gathering quite an audience on the way. The village was in a frenzy over Reshu being in their town. “I heard he saved-” “Did you know he once-” “Crown” And so, the whispers continued. Reshu was quiet, as if waiting for the perfect moment to start speaking. At last it did come. “Townspeople” he started, the entire town becoming silent, “I have travelled far to behold a sight in this very village. Before I continue west to reach my destination, I will tell you all this tale. Tell your friends, tell your family, scream to the heavens above that at last I have travelled thousands of miles and reached.” “ It is said that Aashvi herself, the ruler of all things wise, planted a mango tree at the very edge of the forest in this town. She watered the tree with her tears and sang to it whenever it was ill. She asked the Sun for a ray of light for her tree and asked Medhavi, the warrior goddess to create a shield to protect it. For millennia she protected the tree from the most dangerous thing of all – mankind. However, there was a slight flaw to the shield, since nature declared no one thing should be infallible. Once every thousand years, hope springs anew all over the world because the tree is open to us. If the myths are to believed than this tree will answer our deepest questions and tell us the story of creation." Meera scoffed beside Ishani. “This story is nothing new.” She laughed, “We have heard it a thousand times before. Ishani felt disappointment course through her. She had indeed heard it many times before but it was nothing but a children’s story. Right? She continues listening transfixed by not the content itself but the way he said it. “ I have travelled a thousand miles and lived a thousand lives and heard a thousand stories but not once have I heard the story of creation itself. I am here now to listen to a story instead of telling it. May Aashvi bless you!” With that he flicked his hand in a dismissing motion. The crowd remained silent for a moment. Then chaos broke through. This was by far the greatest piece of information they had ever been given. They were all so involved with talking to each other, no one noticed Reshu slipping through the crowd and actually heading on west. No one except Ishani. “Quick” she urged to Meera, “We have to follow him.” They walked as briskly as they could, trying to keep up with Reshu. At last, they reached him, completely out of breath from all the running. “Did you mean what you said?” Ishani asked, wonderstruck by what was happening, “Are you truly going to look for a mythical tree?” “One need not look for something they have already found” he said, smiling a satisfied smile, “We are here.” Ishani immediately looked at the grove in front of them and then…. had the urge to laugh. “Well, that was anticlimactic” Meera said, not even attempting to conceal her laugh. Reshu looked at them sharply. “Do not be so quick to judge. Things are rarely what they seem.” He started chanting in a beautiful, mystical way that left Ishani and Meera entranced. “Ask your question seeker?” said a deep voice. Ishani gasped and looked all around her before realizing the voice was coming from the mango tree in the center of the grove. The tale was true. “Tell me. Tell me the story of creation” Reshu said hungrily, bowing before the tree. “You are not the seeker, mortal. It is the girl who called me here. It is her soul begging for answers.” A cacophony of emotions went through Reshu’s eyes, but Ishani hadn’t quite processed what happened. “M-me? You mean me?” “Yes, you Ishani of Dhartiya.” Ishani stepped forward. She was in shock. She never thought she would become part of a story; she was meant to be the listener. Or the teller. But the tree was right. Which was something she never thought she would think. She was burning with questions about herself, her life, and her purpose. “Am I supposed to leave?” she asked finally, “or stay here forever?” “Your heart must sway you and your mind must guide you. Look around you and you will find the answer in those you love.” Ishani looked and looked and at the end all she saw was Meera – her best friend, who had stuck by her through everything. And she realized she was at home, and she had everything she ever needed.

title: Yes, I Can
text: May 14 Miss Sullivan, our class teacher calls me and tells me to follow her to the staffroom. I give a look to my friends, Alice, Devon and Tori. I feel a little weird because I’m not too close or friendly with miss Sullivan. Aside from going to the same church, we don’t really have anything in common I still feel a little doubtful, but I follow her anyways. When we finally reach the staffroom, she tells me, “Amara, I have given your name for an inter-class singing competition and you are to represent our cl ass. I freeze. I take ten seconds to process what i just heard and I let out A loud "WHAT!?" Hearing this, all the other teachers turn around to look at me. I realise what I had done and quickly apologise. I turn to my teacher and tell her, " I'm extremely sorrymiss, but you've clearly chosen the wrong person. I'm a very horrible singer. The ears of the people in the audience will start bleeding if they hear me sing." "What rubbish are you saying? You’ve sung in our church before, and it was the epitome of ‘beautiful’. You sing very well.” She says, genuinely." "But miss! That was just once. Besides, our church is really small. There are only about fifty people. I have extreme stage phobia and----- “NO! "She cuts me off. " You still have twenty days and I reckon that should me enough. I believe in you and I’m sure that you’ll be able to do it. You still have twenty days and i reckon that should be enough. Please do not disappoint me. You may take your leave now." I simply cannot comprehend anything that just happened and even as i step out of the staffroom, i feel as though there is a huge rock on my back and I'm struggling to walk as i carry it. “You don’t look too good.” Alice says as I join them in the cafeteria. "You alright? Did she say something that made you upset?” Tori asks with a concern look on her face. Devon stretches out her arm and tells me to have a seat.” Do you want to talk about it?” She asks. “Uh…..miss Sullivan was just telling me about an inter-class singing competition that will be held after three weeks. Do you guys know about it?” "Nothing much, but I’ve heard that your ‘idol’ Maya will be representing grade 10.” Devon exclaims. “Oh my! Maya has the voice of a literal angel. I simply cannot understand how such a melodious voice can be produced by a human being!?” Alice says and I continue fan girling over her with the rest of them. While heading home, I tell them what miss Sullivan had told me and Devon is the first one to say something. Yay!! I’m so excited! I’m so sure that you’ll rock the stage, Mara. This is probably the only right thing miss Sullivan has done for our class.” She chuckles and gives me a thumbs up. Alice too, gives me a bright smile and a thumbs up. “Do you need help with the songs? You could ask us for suggestions” Tori says, with a grin. Oh yes! Totally! All of us have such diverse tastes in music. I’m certain that we could help you.” says, excitedly clapping her hands and suggesting that we should start sending songs that would suit me, in our group chat. But………despite how excited, thrilled and happy they are for me, I just can’t help but feel ‘not capable’. I feel completely incapable and opportunity that I’ve been given. When I reach home, I rush to my bedroom and cry. I’m not at all good at singing. Sure, I enjoy my heart out doing it, but just because you enjoy something doesn’t mean you’re good at it. I’m bawling my eyes out and I feel so guilty for not being as excited as they are, for me. But what can I do? I’m just not good at it. Even when I listen to old recordings of me singing, I get severe embarrassment and I just think to myself, “ Just WHAT were you doing?” I continue crying all night. May 24,2022 Alice, Devon and Tori are coming over to my house today to check my ‘progress’. Being completely honest, I haven’t been practicing. I don’t have the motivation or inspiration to even surf the lyrics of any song, let alone practice singing. And, ten days have just gone by. When they reach, I offer them their favourite snacks and juices. We chat for an hour and for that time alone, I was free of tension and worry. But as realization hit harder, I knew that I had to break it to them. Very timidly, I started, “Guys, I have something to tell y’all. “Yeah, spill the tea!” Devon says, with a smile. “ “Truth is……. I haven’t been practicing….at all.” Silence--------All the three of them look as though I’ve just spoiled their favourite show’s finale. I continue speaking despite their confuse stares. “I’m not at all confident in my singing abilities…. I just can’t---I’m sorry. Even if I did try to sing, I would only end up crying and….I’m sorry.” After what seemed like forever, Tori says, “ I Trust in you, Amara. You know what? I even have a playlist of your singing recordings. You have a beautiful voice, just believe in what I say. You truly do.” “But you know that I don’t stand a chance at winning at all, right? Especially when Maya is participating?” That’s absolutely fine! What matters more is if you try. Just trying alone, winning isn’t everything.” Alice continues, “ The main reason why we even do something, is because we enjoy doing it and I think that’s enough.” I don’t say anything in response but Devon embraces me into a teddy hug and tells me, “ I wish to see you trust yourself as much as we trust you.” We stay in an embrace for quite a long time and finally, start searching for songs. June 4,2022 The day has finally arrived! Since the visit on May 24, I’ve definitely been doing better and my friends’ undenying support and trust in me never ceases. I can say for certain that I’m in a much calmer and relaxed state of mind. As I practice backstage, I catch a glimpse of Maya and rush to wish her luck. She smiles when she sees me and I say to her, “All the best, Maya! I know you’ll definitely emerge as the winner! You are AMAZING!” She blushes and looks embarrassed at my compliment and laughs it off. She asks me, “Are you nervous?” “Um…. A tiny bit?” I let out a nervous chuckle. "Don’t be, it’ll all go smoothly. Just trust yourself, alright? Don’t think think about how others will view you as. Sometimes, we can be so engrossed about what others regard us as, that we often forget to regard our own selves. You’ll do great.” She pats my shoulder, gives me an assuring smile and leaves. Wow! That was divining.” I say to myself. When my name is called and I prepare myself, Alice, Devon and Tori come up to me and they whisper,” We’ll always be your biggest fans.” I almost tear up. We have a group hug and they tell me that all will be well. I take a deep breath, and walk up to the stage. I realize this is what I love doing and I should no longer be afraid to pursue it. I look at the crowd and say to myself, “ You can do it.’ The end
author: lemoi konyak

title: How She Met The Magic That Changed Her Life
text: HOW SHE MET THE MAGIC THAT CHANGED HER LIFE Reshma and her cousins Rimy & Rohit were on a road trip to Kanyakumari in Tamil Nadu from Thiruvananthapuram. Due to pandemic, it’s been after nearly two years that they were taken to a long-distance tourist spot. They were accompanied by Reshma’s parents and Rohit’s grandfather. Rohit is a year younger than Reshma. Rohit’s younger sister was aged 6 years. She came to the trip on a condition that she be introduced to mermaids. They all were looking forward to see the sunrise and sunset in the famous beach of Kanyakumari. On the way, Rohit was bragging about him being an expert swimmer and was eloquent about his swimming skills. Rimy was busy talking about mermaids all through the journey. She declared that if she can meet any mermaids, she will be delighted but if it doesn’t happen, she will be very angry. “Sweetheart, do you really believe in those fairy tales, I mean really do you? exclaimed Reshma’s mother from the front seat of the car. Reshma’s father responded “It’s okay Seethu. Its okay to believe in such fairy tales. When I was young, I also believed in magical turtles called Blue turtles or neela Khachwas”. It is said that they could see the future. My grandmother told me about it.” Rimy immediately asked “Why don’t you believe in it anymore?” “Who said I don’t believe in it anymore. I just know that they don’t exist anymore.” said Reshma’s father. “Why” asked Rimy. “Because of the sea pollution, they might have become extinct” replied Reshma’s father. “What is sea pollution, uncle?” asked Rimy munching her chips. Meanwhile Reshma was looking out of the window and enjoying the scenery, until they finally reached destination. Alas, their excitement was short lived. They were shocked to see the beach. It was full of trash. The place looked horrible and crowded. “Oops! looks like mermaids are not going to come here” said Rohit. After settling in the Hotel room, Reshma was thinking about how the horrible the shore was. Reshma asked Rohit “Do you think we will have a good vacation after seeing the dirty beach” “Well, how bad can it be. I mean it’s not like we can change it or anything. Everybody is enjoying the beach as such” replied Rohit. “Wait, that’s it. “a change”. You are a genius, Rohit. We can just change it. We can clean the place.” Reshma excitedly told Rohit. After settling in the Hotel room, Reshma was thinking about how horrible the shore was. Reshma asked Rohit “Do you think we will have a good vacation after seeing the dirty beach” “Well, how bad can it be. I mean it’s not like we can change it or anything. Everybody is enjoying the beach as such” replied Rohit. “Wait, that’s it. “a change”. You are a genius, Rohit. We can just change it. We can clean the place.” Reshma excitedly told Rohit. “Clean the shore. Are you crazy? I mean really is it possible.” asked Rohit in dismay. “Well, I am serious. I mean how hard can it be. Oh no! are you scared of the sea Rohit” Reshma replied. “No, no…. nothing like that. It’s just that even if we wanted to do so we cannot do it alone, we may need some help.” said Rohit to Reshma. “That’s not a problem. We can ask grandpa for help. Even Rimy can contribute.” replied Reshma. Rohit though was not sure about futility of the task but still he agreed. They shared the plan with Grandpa and he was excited. Next morning, they all went to the shore and started picking of trash from one end of the beach. Grandpa also joined them with Rimy duly assisting him. Seeing small children do this, many people also joined. Rohit and Reshma got one big fibre net and they started collecting trash mostly plastic waste in the filtering net. Rohit was standing on one edge of the small boat on which they were sailing near the shore. Suddenly Rohit slipped and fell in water. Reshma ordered Rohit to swim and get into the boat. But to her shock, he was not able to swim. She quickly realized that poor Rohit doesn’t know to swim. Without wasting a moment, Reshma started yelling for help. Grandpa and Rimy heard her and immediately drove his boat towards Reshma. Rohit was already drowning, and Reshma was crying helplessly as she also did not know to swim. Rohit completely drowned in front of her eyes. By that time Grandpa and Rimy also reached near to Reshma’s boat. Suddenly, all of them could see his hands and head above the water level. They all saw a pair of silver hands lifting him up from the sea. They were shocked to see a mermaid. But soon they recollected their composure and pulled Rohit to their boat. Rimy was the happiest of them all and was excited to see the mermaid. Rimy asked her innocently, “Why did you help us?” The mermaid replied “because you all were willing to save me and my family from the pollution” The security staff of the beach came and checked our boats. Seeing them, the mermaid vanished to the surprise of all of them. They also didn’t tell anything about the mermaid to the security staff. After returning to the shore, they finished cleaning the beach along with many others who had assembled there. By now, Reshma’s parents also were ready for the beach. They felt proud of the children when they saw them leading the people there in cleaning the beach. They also happily joined them. While cleaning, Reshma’s dad saw some turtles. He was amazed by the beauty of the turtles. Among the herd, he could locate one turtle which was shining and was in blue colour. He concluded that this was the blue turtle which his grandma used to tell him. On seeing the blue turtle, a person came to pick it up and take away. But dad didn’t allow that, and he requested the person to leave the turtle to its natural home. He agreed and left. The turtle shook its head and thanked him for saving his life. Afterwards, they enjoyed the vacation. Rohit finally learned to swim. Rimy was eager to tell the story to her friends back in school. Reshma decided to post the video of cleaning of the beach by such a large group of people, which Rohit has recorded. Reshma believed that “more people will come forward to changing the look of the beach and do their bit to keep the famed beach pollution free.” Afterwards, they enjoyed the vacation. Rohit finally learned to swim. Rimy was eager to tell the story to her friends back in school. Reshma decided to post the video of cleaning of the beach by such a large group of people, which Rohit has recorded. Reshma believed that “more people will come forward to changing the look of the beach and do their bit to keep the famed beach pollution free.” “I mean this is what we all should do to have a change. It’s not that hard after all.” said Rohit with a wink. The End Short Story by: Riyan Khalid, VII D, Sarvodaya Central Vidyala, Nalanchira, Trivandrum.

title: TRUE FRIENDSHIP
text: We all have friends in our life.it can be a friend from school,a friend from neighbour hood or a pen friend who lives far away.We mostly have love and care for our friends but we also fight with them and sometimes do not talk with them for a while. Though it is true that fights are common in any kind of friendship, it is also important to remember that we must the good memories and try to forget the bad ones.Now all of us lets read a wonderful story of two friends who realized the importance of friendship and forgiveness.Once upon a time in small village in Rajasthan there lived two friends named mannu and raju. One day raju's parents told him that he have to go to nearby village for buying some grocery items. One that evening raju asked mannu to go with him mannu agreed and one the next day they both went to the another village while they were both have an argument and suddenly raju slapped mannu.He was very hurt but did'nt said anything indeed he just on sand 'my friend slapped me' seeing this raju was very amazed but did'nt understanded what mannu was trying to tell him.After the incident both again started walking while they were walking both water bottle's were empty and both of them needed water and luckily they founded a lake nearby now both of them were very happy and started drinking water after taking some rest raju went to swim in the lake mannu to was very excited to swim but he did'nt know swimming. Raju was very much expert in swimming and was showing his skills to mannu now mannu did'nt control himself and jumped into water and accidently he started drowining into the water when raju saw him without thinking twice before he started swimming as much as fast towards mannu and in a few seconds mannu has been saved but mannu did'nt thank raju to save his life but he writed on a stone nearby 'my friend saved my life.Now again raju was very amazed that why he did'nt thanked me and written this and he asks mannu why you did this but mannu did'nt answered indeed he told him that ask this question when the grocery will complete.After a while they reached the village and both of them completed the grocery when the where coming home raju again asked the previous question to mannu now mannu answered that "when somebody perfoms an act of cruelty it should be written on sand so that, the wind can wipe it away with forgiveness and a deed of goodness could be carved on a stone so that the wind can never wipe it.....

title: BEST FRIENDS
text: Once upon a time there were two friends named Lovely and Diana. Lovely is just like her name, She is so lovely and friendly with everyone. She studies a lot. She's the topper of the class every time. Everyone likes her so much. Diana is also a good girl but she's very jealous of Lovely. If Lovely was the class topper Diana would be in the second place. So she thought of being fake friend with Lovely and find out what's the secret that she is using to study. Everyday Lovely thought that Diana is her best friend forever and ever. On the other side Diana thought the opposite. They two walk together to school. One day when Diana were walking to pick up Lovely. Lovely's mother told her that Lovely has fever and she's at the hospital. She acted like she was very sad, but she was very happy. She didn't visited her. She just dreamt of Lovely Dying. She dreamt a lot. After a few days Lovely got her health back. But Diana was very sad that lovely came back. Diana was dull at school. So Lovely asked what the reason was. Diana lied "I was thinking about how hard time you had in the hospital. I didn't visited you." Lovely said " It's okay. It wasn't a hard time it was a fun time in the Hospital, playing with the other kids in the hospital. " Days passed and passed. One day, as the two of them were walking to the school, Suddenly a car came and crashed Diana. Diana was injured hardly. Lovely was very tensed. She called the people around her and took her to the hospital. The lady in the Ambulance said to lovely "Can't you go to school sweetheart she will be okay." But Lovely said "I can't go without her" as they reached the hospital. Lovely was very worried. When Diana opened her eyes. She saw Lovely. "Are you awake" Lovely asked. "I was worried about you." "Were you worried about me." Diana asked. "Yes I was" Lovely replied. "I just can't believe what you've done for me" Diana said. "I wasn't as loyal as you. Sorry for that I didn't visited you in the hospital" "Whatever happens I'll be your best friend for ever and ever, give me a pinky promise" Lovely said. Diana gave the pinky promise They lived happily ever after.

title: The Astronomical Mystery Solvers
text: Charlie is an eleven year old boy who wants to be an astronaut when he grows up. He was born in a family of five, he was the lonely middle child who got no attention at all in the house. His younger sister grabbed the most attention as she was five years old. His older brother was a prankster and never paid attention in school which caused a lot of attention to be applied on him. One day Charlie was walking to school and saw a rather weird thing in the sky, he was wondering what it was. He spent ten minutes gazing at the sky, but later realized that he would be late for the last day of school before summer vacation. He dashed like a bolt to the school gates, just making it to the hall. He checked his locker what was the first class he had that day, and saw that it was astronomy. He ran to the classroom and he was shocked to see he was actually earlier than everyone else. The bell rang and Charlie found out why he was so early. It was that everyone who had astronomy were passing time in the corridors while the teacher arrived. The astronomy teacher arrived and came in the classroom, class began and Charlie was listening the teacher very attentively. He asked a question about the weird object he saw to the teacher. Class ended and when Charlie was walking in the corridors he was suddenly stopped by a group of bullies. He was bullied for his extreme attentiveness in class. He did not take it to his mind and went to the next class. Many classes later it was a child's favorite time, recess. Charlie loved recess as he could meet his group of friends, the name of the group was The Astronomical Mystery Solvers. It consisted of six members (including Charlie), his friends' names were Harry, Daniel, Emily, Olivia and Ruth. They talked all things space during recess, they even had a secret headquarters (Daniel's room). Charlie talked about the weird object to them, and then Emily said " Well then we will discuss it after school at our headquarters." The recess bell rang in its unpleasant way and they went to their classrooms. So, the friends met again at leaving time, Daniel reminded everyone about the meeting during the summer. Joyous smiles every child had on their face as vacation had begun. School broke apart and Charlie returned home, he rushed to his room to take his bicycle lock's key. He went back downstairs and very quickly said to his mother " I'm going to Daniel's house." He peddled as fast as he could and reached there in ten minutes. He rang the doorbell and Daniel's mother saw he was very exhausted. She asked whether he would like some water, Charlie said no and went in Daniel's room. He saw a picture of planets and understood that they were going to talk about how the planets got formed. Daniel was talking to Olivia about the formation of Jupiter, Charlie told " Jupiter took shape when the rest of the solar system formed about 4.5 billion years ago when gravity pulled swirling gas and dust." They later started discussing about their car for the ecotricity race which is held every summer. They first discussed which type of energy to use, Emily came up with the idea of solar but Harry disagreed and said " What if we forget to charge it." Ruth suggested wind energy, Charlie thought the idea was stupid as the car would only go with the wind. Daniel said " Emily's idea is good, but we will have have to charge it." The group agreed on solar and the meeting came to an end. Charlie rushed home and came up with the car design, and sent it on email to the group. The next day begun and the group gathered in Charlie's attic to build the car, Emily brought the solar panels. Charlie brought the plan and they started working on the car, they wanted to finish it so quickly that they even slept over at Charlie's house. Days later the car was built completely and ready for racing, they also did a test run on who the driver should be. Daniel was quickest so he was the driver. They transferred the car to Harry's garage as it was closest to the road they were going to race on. The day had arrived it was race day. The group saw their competitors, they were not scared the cars were rolled to the grid and a few minutes later the lights went out. Daniel got a quick start of the line and took the lead, but during the midway point he was losing speed and engine power. He complained that " The engine is feeling very slow." Charlie replied on the radio that " Drive in the sunny part of the road." A few corners were just left and Daniel felt fast again, he came out of the last corner to win. The group was so happy they thanked everyone who helped, but they especially thanked Emily for the solar idea, Charlie for the design and Daniel for the driving. The next day they met again and discussed about the weird object Charlie saw the other day. The thought what could it be, was it a rock? was it a planet?, was it a meteor? Only god knows what it was, they came up with more wacky ideas till they came to a conclusion that it was a meteor. Ruth asked " Than where did the meteor land." The group found a new mystery to solve. Charlie told that the meteor was heading east, so they went to the east in the park. They saw the meteor, it was lumpy, large and red. They called The Natural History Museum and informed them about the meteor. They headed back to headquarters to find out where the meteor came from, the first guess was that it was from Mars and it was from Mars The Natural History Museum confirmed the theory. This was the last day before vacation had ended and the next day school would begin. The group had a delightful summer full of mysteries from space and to become the yearly ecotricity race champions was a fruitful achievement. The summer ended, the day ended. It was going back to school the next day. All the memories of that summer live in the hearts of all the members in the group of The Astronomical Mystery Solvers.
author: DEVARSH BODARYA
illustrator: Bhargavi Rudraraju; Drishti Agarwal; Seat Sopheap; Vidyun Sabhaney

title: The two best friends
text: One day Shiva wanted to show Ali his favourite temple ' as so Shiva took Ali to the temple but the Saints who are at the temple threw Ali away, Ali and Shiva felt really bad. Shiva want the saints to stop them beating Ali. But the saints told him " Shiva we know who you feel but Ali is a Muslim!, we can't allow any Muslim to any temples please let us do our job. " Shiva got really mad and he draged Ali and ran to Shiva's house when they reached the house they their fathers already got the news when they saw Ali and Shiva reached home Shiva's father took Shiva side and asked him as, " Did you got mad you know Ali is a Muslim but why did you still took him to the temple that is not not also a normal one it's a temple of lord Shiva " but Shiva told " father it's not about what region we are it's all about we are all Indians our great freedom fighters fought for not to draw any line between any cast or region please help us to slove this problem.
