title: THE PURPLE TREE
text: THE PURPLE TREE Once upon a time there was a girl named Ava, she was young with a long shiny blonde hair and she looked no less beautiful than any princess from the stories. But she was suffering from a deadly disease- brain cancer. There was no cure for the disease and so she was left with very less time. She had a family of three members- she herself, her mother, and a younger brother named Matthew. Both of them loved Ava dearly and she too loved them more than anything in this world. One day her brother was wondering around on the forest, suddenly he saw a bunch of dwarf with mix appearance of human body and fish faced; coming out from a tree, but there was something even strange, the tree- it was purple in colour and it had a shine; which looked attractive and was attracting him too. He saw little men gathering together around the dead body of a dog and chanting something like Ba-Mathu-Jak-Ba- Mathu- Jak and to Matthew’s surprise, the dead dog soon became alive. He was shocked and afraid to see this but then all of a sudden he thought of his sister ‘ Ava’ to bring here. He thought he can talk to the dwarf to heal her from her disease. The next morning he took her sister to that place but there was no tree that he saw last night, he was shocked and question himself of being in dream or in reality. His sister scolded him and went back home making him realize it is indeed real. But Matthew thought of coming back at the same place the next day with the hope of finding the dwarf and the tree again. So, in the next evening, he went but again, the tree was not there. He returned with loss of hope but suddenly he found himself surrounded by the dwarfs who stared him in confusion. With fear he said “I’m here to ask help from you all”. And then he told everything about his sister to the dwarf. The dwarf listened to him carefully and told him that they’ll take him to their leader to decide what can be done. So he went with them, on their way he noticed one of the dwarf who was alone and silent, he went to that dwarf and talked to him; they soon became good friends. After few miles of walk, they finally reached the leader. The leader agreed to help him but in return asked for the sacrifice of Matthew. He was tensed and shocked, remained silent for a while and but for the sake of his sister, he said, “I’m up for it.” ﻿ They both agreed. The next day, He took Ava and went at the purple tree. The dwarf along with their leader was waiting there for him. Ava was scared and confused when she saw the dwarfs. She asked to her brother, what was going on? He told her everything that had happened between the dwarfs and him. But Matthew did not tell her that he have to sacrifice himself for her. Ava was happy that she will be healthy again and live a normal life ahead. She went with the dwarfs. They surrounded her and started to spell Ba-Mathu-Jak-Ba- Mathu- Jak. After sometime, she came back to her brother and thanked the dwarfs. Ava along with her mother went to hospital to check whether her disease had cured or not. As expected she was alright and they were happy but her brother had to sacrifice himself as he promised. In the evening, he went there where he have to sacrifice himself. The dwarfs along with their leader gathered. The leader had an axe in his hand and was about to kill Matthew. Wait… shouted the dwarf friend of Matthew whom he met when he was taken to the leader. The dwarf said, sacrifice me instead of him. “Everyone was shocked and horrified”. Nothing like this ever happened before in the land of the dwarfs. To the surprise of all, the leader too decided neither to take the life of Matthew nor his dwarf friend. The leader understood that love among each is stronger than any other force in the world and can defeat any evil. After that day, all the dwarfs decided to use their healing power for good and started to help people, without anything in return.

title: Blueberries
text: BLUEBERRIES By Aditi Laguri, Class VIII Coco was a girl of seven. She loved eating berries. She was sweet as berries, very kind and gentle and was intelligent as well. Her garden has a variety of shrubs and trees of berries. Coco’s house was situated near the forest. There was a beautiful pond in the forest which was about 1 kilometer away from her house. Many animals of the forest come to the lake to quench their thirst. Coco had a good knowledge about berries. She could easily identify whether a berry is edible or poisonous. In the forest there were even more berry shrubs and bushes. There were edible as well as poisonous berries in the forest. She often collected them when she went to the forest and after coming home she tries to know more about those berries. Once when Coco went to the forest alone to collect some mushrooms and berries, she did not brought water bottle from home. She was very thirsty so she had to go to the lake. She drank water and was getting ready to go back on her way, but suddenly a small cute baby deer caught her attention by playing so joyfully near the lake. But the deer, by mistake, stepped on some small, round pebbles, and fell on the ground by getting slipped. The deer got wound on her front leg. Coco saw that and approach the baby deer to help him. She cried, “Oh dear! You hurted yourself.” She continued, “Wait, don’t be panicked. Let me think what can I do to give reef to your wound.”Coco was looking around and then her eyes fall on a plant. She knew about that plant. That was a medicinal plant which can help in healing wound. She pluck some leaves of the plant and made a paste of it and then applied the paste to the wound. The deer started feeling better and can stand up on his own feet. Then she also get up and gave the deer some berries to eat. title: THE FIRST IMPRESSION BECOME THE LAST IMPRESSION
text: Mrs. Malhotra goes to the market to get a packet of biscuit from her, after that she rises to a bench in the park ﻿ and start reading taking out a book from her bag. After that she starts eating packets of biscuits. then a man sit on a bench. He takes one of the biscuits from the packet of lady's biscuits. And starts eating it she starts thinking how bad it is to take someone's things without asking. The man again takes out a biscuit and start eating it. This happens three or four times when the last biscuits is left in the packet, the man gives the half of the biscuit to the lady, but she refuses to take it and leave from there. title: THE ADVENTURES OF THE TRIO
text: THE ADVENTURES OF THE TRIO All started when the trio siblings,Sona, Reshmi and Aarav went to loot the storeroom which was filled with Ladoos,Jalebis,Mysore Pak and many more mouth watering sweets. It was the time of Diwali so the guests who came,brought sweets with them. Reshmi was the eldest one among them. Sona was the youngest and Aarav being the middle child was the naughtiest child, not only in their house but in the whole colony where they lived. They lived in the Khushi colony in Maharashtra. He was a pragmatic strategist, after all the brave deeds of looting the kitchen now and then, without no one noticing.The three were not that notorious, they were kind, innocent,sweet but naughty. One day, their mother Shweta went to buy some groceries. While leaving, she called her children to warn not to even peep into the kitchen. They nodded mischievously. Shweta knew they wouldn’t heed her but for the sake of warning she said. She left for the groceries. Aarav was brimming with some pragmatic strategy in his mind. By seeing this,Reshmi asked him “What is cooking in your brain?” Sona replied laughing “Didi,it might be some plan connected to looting the sweets that uncle brought. Aarav breaking his silence said “Yeah, you both are not at all wrong. I just want to have some of the delicious mouth watering sweets our dear uncle brought. But mum isn’t allowing. I have a plan..” The plan was good but the problem now was our cousin, Veer Bhaiya. He came over our house to celebrate this Diwali. To mention Veer bhaiya was a person who is against stealing anything from the kitchen, he never lies and never liked to be a part of our team. He was in the hall, watching a new movie with his friends. Sona was made to look out for Veer bhaiya and his moves and to signal us. She skilled at watching over somone. Reshmi was asked to come with Aarav. She was tall and athletic and surely she will be really helpful. The plans starts its execution……. Sona was giving signals perfecly.Reshmi and Aarav stepped into the storeroom. They were shocked to see their pet cat Veeru meowing angrily. They guessed that mum made him sit there as a surveillance camera for capturing us in his memory and later complain it to mum. We had named him Veeru in the hope that he would be in our team. But no,he never liked anyone among us except Sona. The reason why we named him Veeru was because he was the doppelganger of our dear cousin Veer. Anyway we called Sona to take him away from us. In the Storeroom there were many sacks of rice, wheat and tins of spices. In the top slab was the junction of Diwali sweets. Mum might have kept them there in the hope that we wouldn't’ be able to grab them. Mum has a bitter pill to swallow because Reshmi didi could take it. As soon as didi took it,she vanished with a clang sound. In astonishment, Aarav yelled and by hearing this trembling voice Sona rushed into the Storeroom. Aarav explained everything to his little sister. While listening, she too got goosebumps. This was really impossible. Where did didi vanish to? They gathered all their courage and might and touched it. They felt that they were whirling in a dark and huge tornado. And with a thud, they fell on a smooth floor. It felt like it was made of marble. They found out where Reshmi was and ran to her. They could not see the other’s face as it was dim lit room. They could only communicate. Sona started to whimper but Aarav hugged her. After some minutes, a harsh voice came bursting out. It said; “If you want to see the blue sky again,answer these two riddles and do me a favor. Will you? A favor which will free me from this dark terrible fate and chamber. This is my command. Help me.” The voice horrified us. But we agreed to help that Nobody. The first riddle goes like this. “I am the first to answer and seek, I gave birth to Knowledge and Wisdom. My special powers include the ability to invent useful items People call me the war strategist My pet is an owl As my memorial, people named a city after me. Guess who I am.” Sona was well versed with Greek mythology. She answered “Athena, she is the goddess of wisdom and knowledge. That's the answer. People built the city of Athens to please her. Here goes the 2 nd riddles.. ''I am a unit of chemical elements, but I can never be trusted. What am I??'' Reshmi knew the answer, she said, the answer is an Atom. The answers were revealed and we were relieved to see that we had given the correct answer. Wasn't it a bit rhyming.. Now the favour was the problem!!! The same voice came again, now it said, “ Ahh you are really quick at answering these riddles. Now do me a favor. Analyze this map and reach the destination where I have marked X. Go there and bring me the cauldron kept there. I will teleport you to that place. Have a good journey and be careful.'' ‘’Okay we are ready but after doing this task, will you take us back home?? Or else our dear mother will be worried..” we replied. The voice assured us that it will take us back home. Let‘s go find the cauldron,we shouted energetically. WE ARE IN THE CAULDRON MISSION!!!! Again we felt that swirling sensation. This time it felt a bit retching sensation for Reshmi. They landed on a soft wet grass. The surrounding was pleasant. Birds were chirping. The blossomed flowers spread its splendid fragrance. We started following the X destination. It was nearby. We walked for about 10 minutes and finally arrived to the destination. The cauldron was kept on a beautiful and engraved rock. We took it from there. It was warm but shiny. After some seconds, it started to glow. Again we got teleported. this time we didn't feel ANY WEIRD SENSATION. We were welcomed with a nightingale's mesmerizing music. The dim lit place turned into a magnificent garden. There were no more harsh voices but sweet and soft voice. We looked in the direction of the sweet nightingale's voice, there stood a charismatic lady with dazzling eyes and dark black hair who was smiling at us. We stared at her blue dazzling eyes for a few minutes. Suddenly Aarav started bombarding her with questions. He asked "Were you the one who teleported us to here?? Did you ask us those riddles? Why did you make us go take this cauldron?? The lady answered him patiently" Be patient son. You will get all your answers done. F irst of all, let me introduce myself. I am the fairy of innocence,kindness, mischievousness and truth. I was caged by an evil power and to escape from it I needed your help. I thank you all from the bottom of my heart. When the cauldron is touched by an wise person,I become free. When I was under the evil cast, my voice turned harsh and horrifying. I asked you those riddles to make sure you are intelligent and brave. I knew you will crack it. Once again I thank you. In some moments you will be teleported to the storeroom of your house. And you will receive a gift from me. Enjoy this Diwali Sona,Aarav and Reshmi. They landed with a small thud on the wooden floor of the storeroom. Reshmi said, " I think the time was stopped for some hours." Aarav enthusiastically said," I wish we get the surprise gift soon. What we did a few hours ago is now just a mere memory." Sona replied, "I can't even think that we helped a dazzling fairy, a few moments ago." IT'S THE TIME FOR THE REWARD!!! ﻿ ﻿ We heard the calling bell ringing and we rushed out of the storeroom. We thought that we are goners with mum on the doorstep waiting to scold us for stepping into the kitchen. But nothing happened, she just came near us and kissed us on our foreheads. We got numerous Diwali gifts from her. She asked us to take some rest. When we went to our rooms,we were pleased to see the presents. We got colourful dresses and delicious sweets and a thankyou letter from that amazing fairy. THE END THIS YEAR'S DIWALI WAS THE BEST FOR SONA, AARAV AND RESHMI. THEY CELERATED DIWALI WITH LIGHTS AND SWEETS AND OF COURSE THEY CHERISHD THE MEMORY OF THAT FAIRY AS WELL AS HER GIFTS.
author: Sreegopika S

title: The Obedient Wife
text: She was a docile and obedient wife, with not many expectations, shouldering the responsibilities of the household willingly keeping in mind the welfare of her husband and all his family members. She was quite pretty, kind and an agreeable wife. She was a little educated but she was a real lady. Her name was Allison Mora. She was married to a man who worked hard and earned and saved a lot of money. He was a real miser when it comes to money. He was quite rich but stingy. Allison had wanted to get a job before she got married but her mother had gone on and on about how important it was for a woman to get married so she could raise her babies early. Her mother had said she would find a job later. Besides, her husband was a rich business man. She wouldn’t have to suffer. Allison was married to a man who loved his money more than anything else. Life with such a kind of man is not easy, it’s like living your life on a budget. It can be very suffocating when you have to limit your every desire and wish as per his spending capacity. The only luxury you have is to dream because it costs nothing!... When they got married first, he told her that there was no need for a honeymoon and that it was better if they channeled the funds into acquiring assets as a new family. Next, he told her that he couldn’t continue to subscribe for the full bouquet of cable TV so they had no choice but to watch about six channels only, only three of which were actually worth watching. In the earlier days of their marriage, she had always made a fuss about his behaviour and had wondered how she ever ended up with such a man, but soon she learned to adjust.If she ever happened to overindulge or go beyond the budget, he would never let her forget that. She would become a legend who dared to overspend and her stingy husband never missed an opportunity to remind her about what she once did. When she seated herself for dinner opposite to her husband he would give her only a piece of bread no bigger than a hand, with a piece of cheese on it. There is a thin line between being careful about money and being stingy. While it’s always good to spend money wisely but being too thoughtful about parting ways with money can be a very painful experience. He never bought her jewelry or flowers or treated her to a fancy dinner but Allison was so adjusting that she never questioned or argued with him. She would do whatever her husband asked of her without any questioning. One day he told Allison, "When I die, I want you to put all the money in the casket along with me. I want to take my money to the afterlife with me. " And so he got his wife promise him, with all of her heart. The time came when he got sick, after some time the stingy old man died due to kidney failure….. He was stretched out in the casket, while Allison was sitting there, in a black dress, with her friend sitting next to her. When they finished the ceremony and the undertakers were about to close the casket, Allison stopped them and said, "Just a moment." She had a small metal box in her hands, she came over with the box and kept it in the casket, then the undertakers locked and rolled away the casket. Then her friend asked her, “what’s in that metal box?” She replied,”I remembered that he told me to put all the money in the casket along with him as he wanted to take his money to the afterlife with him.” Her friend freaked out and asked her,"Girl you are not that foolish to keep all the money into that casket, right?" The loyal wife replied "Listen, I am a wife, I can't go back on my word, I promised him." "You mean to say, you kept all the money in that casket?!?!" "I sure did," said the loyal wife, While Allison was having this conversation with her friend her brother heard all this and had a malicious idea. He came back to that place after 2 days, he dug that grave but for his astonishment he found an empty box, he got a little confused and scared, he believed that the dead body used up the money, he rushed to his sister and explained what he did. Allison was very angry and disappointed with her brother’s action, she berated him and shouted at him, but all his brother wanted to know was about the money. He asked her,” where did all the money go, where did you keep it?” After a few minutes she calmed down and told him, "I got all the money together, put in my bank account and wrote him a cheque; I kept that in the casket along with him, now it's up to him to encash the cheque. If he can cash it, he can spend it." -Sanskriti kaushik

title: Kamalesh's dream journey
text: He had two sons. Kamalesh Sinha and Kamesh Sinha. Kamalesh, the older one never enjoyed his life since birth. Whereas, Kamesh was always the pet of his father and also lived with high ambition to become the number one businessman in the world. While Kamalesh was 10, he got inspired by the first Indian who climb all the mountains in the Himalayan Range, Thomas Ravichandar. After that he set his ambition that he will climb all the mountains in the Himalayan Range and will find the true meaning of his life. He waited patiently until he turned 18. Before two days of his 18th Birthday, his father expired. According to his will, the property must be equally split between his two sons. But, Kamalesh gave all his property to Kamesh and started to plan his journey. He packed his cloths in a travel bag and got ready.. He also took some food provisions, food tablets and medicines for his journey. And his journey has just begun. After few days, he set out of his house. He then boarded the city bus to drop him on the National Highway. He could have just flown to Kashmir with just his pocket money. But he did not. He thought he can walk miles and miles and reach Kashmir even if it costs his entire lifetime. It has been three days since he started his journey. The days were not like any of his usual days where he would sit inside a room with four walls, alone, with nobody to talk, playing with a cricket ball. He was on the fast-moving world, walking alone in search of happiness. Things changed on the 4th day at noon. He was feeling hungry and opened a biscuit packet to eat. Suddenly a silly dog came out of nowhere, lifting out its tongue waiting for Kamalesh to give him a few biscuits. He felt pity of it and gave 3 biscuits to it. And guess what, it followed him throughout the day. He tried to shake it off, but couldn't as the dog didn't move more than 1 meter. Annoyed by the dog, while inside a huge crowd, Kamalesh thought of a plan. He suddenly ran towards the other end so that the dog won't follow but the dog actually did. Knowing that he cannot do anything about it he gave up. After some time, he went to a market to buy some nails for his tent but was chased out of the market for bringing a dog inside it. He tried to figure out what to do with this troublesome dog. It didn't even look like a dog from a street nor a pet dog but like a dog from a really cold place so he couldn't leave it even when he enters Kashmir as his body was adapted to it. So, he decided it to keep it as his pet and his companion on his journey and named it Dug. It's been a week since Kamalesh started his journey. When he woke up in the morning, all the biscuits were gone to dug's stomach. Dug ate all the biscuits at night after Kamalesh went to sleep. This made Kamalesh eat food tablets throughout the rest of the day. The Next day he arrived at the border of Delhi, there was a board with "Welcome to Haryana" written in it. With one step he would leave his home land which he had never done before and move to Haryana. Even though he was curious about the life that awaits him, he was a bit anxious about leaving is home land. But, his mind was all into his journey, So he continued. Days went like minutes and before Kamalesh realized, it has been almost a month since he started his journey. He is currently on the border of Himachal Pradesh. Now Kamalesh is not only Going to climb all the mountains in Himalayan Ranges but, also is going to meet Thomas Ravichander who is currently living at Kashmir. The only thing that worried him was dug. Lately Kamalesh and dug have made their relationship stronger. They are now thick friends and of course, Dug is the only relation Kamalesh has now. Kamalesh entered Kashmir and while he was mesmerized by the beauty of it, Dug ran away. Kamalesh tried to follow him and suddenly while Dug stopped, he saw so many of the dogs of the same kind of Dug while he still Wasn't relieved from the shock, he saw a man guarding all of them who was none other than Thomas Ravichandar. Thomas took both Dug and Kamalesh to his house. Kamalesh explained a lot about his life and goal to Thomas. Thomas too shared a lot of things with Kamalesh while Dug was playing with his newly found friends. Kamalesh and Dug spent the day with Thomas. Even Kamalesh was allowed to sleep in a comfy cushion while Thomas slept on the floor. At morning Kamalesh woke by the barks of all the dogs. He knew There was something wrong and while he went out, he saw Thomas loading all the dogs in an helicopter. Just then he found out the real plan of Thomas was to kidnap the breed of dogs living here and send them to Delhi. And Dug was also a dog who previously lived here and was transported to Delhi. He tried to stop the helicopter but he couldn't. So, he held the landing skid of it and took control of the helicopter after struggling a while. He made all the dogs eject out with an automatic parachute and he jumped off with a parachute allowing the helicopter to crash land on the mountains. Now all the dogs were saved and Kamalesh became the hero of the day. The happiness of Dug and the other dogs filled his heart and he finally found out what is the true meaning of happiness is.

title: Brave Crystal
text: Once upon a time, there lived a girl named Crystal, in the home town of Los Angels. She was 15 years old. Her Parents were Anesthesia and Chris. She had a younger sibling Kate. She loved her family so much. She was learning the marshal art Taekwondo. She was a master of it. She thought she would start an academy for taekwondo learners. When she was 16, she started fangirling for the most two popular k-pop group which was BTS and Blackpink. She was just fond of them but not more than her parents. This did not affect her studies and taekwondo practice. Even her classmates and teammates were fangirling, she hand many of the merches too. Then she graduated and when she turned 22, her parents asked her for a wish She asked concert ticket. Her parents argued and bought her the tickets. She was so happy. She went to the concert and enjoyed a lot there. Then when she was back, she couldn’t wait to cry. Her parents had arranged a party for her and her friends. She was stunned to see the decoration. Then when her parents asked what would you do if you got a place for free and all the money to replenish it. She replied that she was going to start a taekwondo center. Then her parents granted her the key and to a house. It was big enough to open a taekwondo centre. Then she cleaned and organized the stuff to start a center. First she started to train for free as poor people could also learn. She was so happy teaching them all. Unfortunately her parents met with an accident and they passed away. She could not control her tears. Though she lost her parents she did not loose her courage. Argh!just one problem was making her feel sad. It was to take the students for a tournament. She didn’t have enough money to take them for a tournament. Now, she had to ask the children’s parents for help. Alas!when she stepped out of the center, she was surprised to see a suitcase full of money. She didn’t know, where it came from. Then again one by one, one by one parents started to come and give her money. Wow!it was such a beautiful face to see. She smiled bright after a very long time. By now, she had enough money to take them for the tournament. She was so happy. Finally her students won the tournament and made her feel proud. Then she was called for a interview by the New York Times. This was her first Interview. So she was very nervous. But she didn’t loose faith and proceeded. Then her center grew up to be big and famous. Still many people joined. But she was kind. She was still teaching for free. Then again she was given to attend a blackpink concert for free. She was excited and attended it. She was so happy. When she was 36, She had got a strange disease. She ignored it. Until she turned 49, she didn’t know this would be this much dangerous. Though she took severe precautions. She knew she wouldn’t stay any long. she was enjoying her last days. When she was called by the doctor to urgently rush to the hospital. Alas!they found a new way to cure the disease, which she had. She started to recover. She said she wanted to go to the center, where she was teaching taekwondo. She was very delighted to see her training center with so many kids and many improvements took place. She was mesmerized by the beauty of the center. She was so happy. She recovered very soon and again started her practice. Soon she became a role model to many women. Her sibling had passed away before the moment she was announced as the role model. Though she was in pain she took the place as No. 1. Then she hurriedly reached the place where her sister was laying without life, she cried a lot. But she was taken away from that place. Now she felt like an orphan. But her children and their parents encouraged her. Now, there were many centers in name of her. She was so happy tears. She never stopped to fight. She overcame many problems. Now she was very happy and lived with happiness and lots of courage.

title: Spaceship: The Birthday Gift
text: Max and Mini dreamt of becoming space exploreres. They loved space and everything about it. They would stay in the library after school reading books about planets, stars, comets, asteroids, meteors, aliens, and outer space. They were fascinated by how mysterious it is and enjoyed exploring it. On thier way home, Max and Mini saw a spaceship in the window of a shop. They got attractive to it and went inside the shop to check its price. It was too much expensive. They tried to sum up their money together but it still was not sufficient. They left the shop dejected and dispirided, as it was their great desire to own it. Suddenly, Max realised that his birthday is about to come. He decided to ask their parents to bring that spaceship as gift for the birthday. They both ran very fast towards t heir home. They were eager to tell their parents about that spaceship. When they reached home, they hugged their mother who ws setting up the table for dinner. Mother was curious to know what they were thrilled about. So, Max told her what he wanted as his birthday gift. When dad went to the shop, he found that spaceship too expensive. They were already in debts and could not afford it. On his birthday, Max woke up early and ran to see his gift. But when he entered the living room, he saw acardboad spaceship. It was made by his dad for him. It had wings on the sides and space to ride it. It was a spaceship but not what he wanted. Max was disheartened and ran back to his room. Mini had just got up and about to go the living room when Max ran past her. he slammed their bedroom door and locked it. Maya got to the living room and saw dad beside it, bent down on his knees with his head down and said, "Sorry!" Maya didn't want her father and brother to b sad so she looked at the cardboard spaceship made by dad and got an idea. Mom, dad and Maya got to work. Mice started to dance in Max's stomach. He didn't have breakfast and now he was hungry. He got out of bed and opened the door. Mini was by the door with the cardboard spaceship their dad had mad e and placed it in front of him and asked him, "Are you ready?" "For what?"he asked. " For our mission," she said. "Mission?" he asked. "Yes. We have a mission. Come on," she said. Mini got on the cardboard spaceship but left space in front for Max. Seeing excitement on Maya's face, he got on the spaceship. Then he heard his Dad's voice, "This is mission control. Are we ready for take off?" Maya answered, "Mission control. We are ready for take off." Their dad came in the room and stood himself behind the spaceship. He then started makind the sound of a spaceship during lift off and pushed the cardboard spaceship slowly. When they came out of the room, Max was surprised at what he saw. There were stars dangling the ceiling. There were moons and planets too. He felt like was in outer space. Then their mom started walking towards them holding gray rocks made out of cardboard on a string. "Asteroids approaching," Mini said. "On it." Max said. Max shifted himself from left to right trying to maneuver the spaceship away from the asteroids. Their dad steered the spaceship wherever Max shifted towards. After successfully evding all the asteroids, they stopped at the table. On the table, there was a label that said, "Best restaurant in Jupiter." Max and Mini got out of the spaceship. They walked towards the table as if there was no gravity and bounced around. After they ate, they got back on their spaceship. They spent all day on it, riding across the unknown depths of space, exploring and unveiling many secrets of outer space. They enjoyed letting their imaginations run wild. The day eventually came to an end and it was timw for bed. Before that, Max called out his dad. With a smile on his face, he said, "That was the most precious gift and you are the best dad ever. I love you dad." Max hugged his dad. His dad ruffled his hair and said that he was glad Max liked it. After that, everyone went to bed.
author: Nekvarna  Sharma

title: LAZINESS WON'T GIVE YOU ANYWHERE
text: Father was a hardworking man who delivered bread as a living to support his wife and three children. He spent all his evenings after work attending classes, hoping to improve himself so that he could one day find a better paying job. Except for Sundays, Father hardly ate a meal together with his family. He worked and studied very hard because he wanted to provide his family with the best money could buy. Whenever the family complained that he was not spending enough time with them, he reasoned that he was doing all this for them. But he often yearned to spend more time with his family. The day came when the examination results were announced. To his joy, Father passed, and with distinctions too! Soon after, he was offered a good job as a senior supervisor which paid handsomely. Like a dream come true, Father could now afford to provide his family with life’s little luxuries like nice clothing, fine food and vacation abroad. However, the family still did not get to see father for most of the week. He continued to work very hard, hoping to be promoted to the position of manager. In fact, to make himself a worthily candidate for the promotion, he enrolled for another course in the open university. Again, whenever the family complained that he was not spending enough time with them, he reasoned that he was doing all this for them. But he often yearned to spend more time with his family. Father’s hard work paid off and he was promoted. Jubilantly, he decided to hire a maid to relieve his wife from her domestic tasks. He also felt that their three-room flat was no longer big enough, it would be nice for his family to be able to enjoy the facilities and comfort of a condominium. Having experienced the rewards of his hard work many times before, Father resolved to further his studies and work at being promoted again. The family still did not get to see much of him. In fact, sometimes Father had to work on Sundays entertaining clients. Again, whenever the family complained that he was not spending enough time with them, he reasoned that he was doing all this for them. But he often yearned to spend more time with his family. As expected, Father’s hard work paid off again and he bought a beautiful condominium overlooking the coast of Singapore. On the first Sunday evening at their new home, Father declared to his family that he decided not to take anymore courses or pursue any more promotions. From then on he was going to devote more time to his family. Father did not wake up the next day.
author: DIVYANSHU ANAND

title: The Unknown Hero
text: It was a usual morning for Chotu, the pen seller who sells pens at the traffic signal. The destiny only know it was anything but a "usual morning". Chotu, as people called him, was a thin stick like boy who spent 5 years of life selling pens. Sometimes he met people with big heart who offered him money to which he bought something for himself to eat. "10 rupees each pen! 10 rupees each pen!" Chotu chanted grabbing some people's attention who were simply waiting for the traffic light to turn red. The air was filled with the loud noise of the vehicles and in all those noises, a sweet melodious voice called Chotu which made him turn to the direction from where the voice had just been heard. Chotu had to squint his eyes to get a better look at the person who called him as the sun was shining very brightly today. Which was indeed unusual. If Chotu had known this was a sign which indicated from this day onward his life was going to change, he would have eagerly waited for it. He made his way towards the young lady who looked as if she was in her 20s. She was wearing a yellow kurti with colourful dots, her hair falling flawlessly on her shoulder, beautiful oxidised earrings fitting what she was wearing. She moved towards Chotu and bent down to match his 4 feet 2 inches height. "What is your name chotu?" She asked in her melodious voice. "Chotu. Chotu is my name." He said. "How long have you been working under this bright sunlight?" "For a veeeery long time." Chotu said, extending his arms. "Did you eat or drink something?" She asked concern visible on her face. "No. But if you buy these pens, maybe I will soon." He replied with a smile pleading her to buy them. "How about we have lunch together? Right now?" She asked. With a quick nod, they both made their way to the nearest restaurant McDonald's. Chotu was a little hesitant at first to enter the restaurant as people in there were well dressed and as he opened the door to the restaurant, people were staring at him which made him uncomfortable. She noticed him and patted his shoulder. He looked over his shoulder and saw the most appealing smile. They made their way towards an empty table and took their seats. After few minutes of waiting, their food arrived. French fries, 2 burger, chicken nuggets and a coca cola. As soon as it arrived, they started having it. "How old are you?" Chotu asked out of nowhere. "Older than you... 22. What about you?" "8" "For how long have you been selling the pens?" "3 years" "So you have been selling pens since you were 5?!" She asked fully shocked. "Yeah. I guess." What about your parents? What do they do?" "I don't have parents. I'm alone. Ramesh uncle said I'm anaath (orphan). I never met them." "Who's Ramesh uncle?" "The person who gives me pens to sell them." He says munching on the food. For a moment, the lady is lost in her thoughts while he completes his lunch. After coming back from her thoughts she makes a phone call to someone and continues the conversation with the boy. "Have you ever been to school?" "What's that?" "A place where you get knowledge of things and many children of your age study there and have lunch and go back to home..." "Never heard of such a place." "Okay. I hope you liked the food my child. Tomorrow, I will be meeting you and you are going to introduce me to your Ramesh Uncle." "Okay. You know where to find me... Wait... What's your name?" "Rubina." And with a smile she made her way towards the leafy footpath. Next day, Rubina and Chotu made their way to a small roadside stationary shop where a man in his 50s was sitting and reading newspaper. "Ramu Uncle! She wanted to meet you" Chotu said. Ramesh Uncle turned his gaze away from the Newspaper and towards Rubina who was waiting for him to say something. "Yes, what do you need child?" He asked. "I'm Rubina and I am a part of NGO and would like to take him with me. He is an orphan and I would like to have the responsibility of taking care of him if it's okay with you sir." "Yeah I have heard of NGO. I offered him to sell the pens so that he could earn money and fulfill his needs." Ramesh Uncle and Rubina bought a cup of tea from the Tea Stall and had a conversation with each other while Chotu made his way towards a small hut. "His parents left him when he was just a baby as they couldn't afford to take care of a child. For the past 8 years I have been looking after him. He is a naughty child but when it comes to other things like painting and music, he is really good at it. But I can't afford to do anything for him as I have a life of my own. Everything is dependent on money nowadays and you can't live without it. Chotu also needed money to sustain and that's why I offered for him to sell pens at the traffic signal." After some time of chit chatting, Chotu reappeared and sat near Ramesh Uncle. Ramesh Uncle stared at him longingly and then said, "Even though I know you are naughtiest child ever to exist, I can sense you are going to have a bright future my child. Go with her and never disappoint her. She is going to look after you far better than I did and always respect her. If you ever think of me in future, you know where exactly I will be." With such kind words and an unforgettable hug from Ramesh Uncle, Chotu made his way to Rubina's car and from then onwards, Chotu started living a new life. 15 Years Later, I'm Advait, your Chotu. In my school people now call me Advait. It was Rubina's brother's name and she told me I reminded her of him. She lost his younger brother at the age of 9 because of cancer. Talking about my life, I am a 23 year old guy who finally got graduated. As Rubina got to know that I was great in painting, she polished my skills and opened my gate to the world of animators. I spent this 15 years of my life living with people who were like me when I was 8 years old. It wasn't just me whom Rubina gave a second life. She gave a new life to Hundreds of children like me. I am grateful for that. But to thank Rubina, she isn't with me anymore... 2017, When I was 18 years old, just like Advait, she got diagnosed by Leukemia and left the seven layers of the earth. But even after 5 years of her death, she never left my heart and she never will. She was someone who showed me the way when I was looking for one. I had no idea such a thing would happen in my life. I wish I could show her and tell her that the person whom she gave a second life in this world has turned into an asset to the Society rather than a liability. Something I would do for her is to repeat the cycle she started. I have already started it and if everyone did, maybe we could get rid of the poverty in our world and provide a new life to the people around us. I visit Ramesh Uncle thrice in a year and I can't thank him enough for what he did for me in the 8 years of my life... Something Rubina always used to tell me, "Live a life where you are an inspiration to the others, and did something big out of the life provided to you. Everyone lives and dies but only some do something for themselves and the world and even after their death, they are remembered and they are followed..."
author: Lohitha Sakku

title: A Flicker of Kindness
text: 12 January 2022, Bhopal “Class, please welcome Ananya, our new student from Udaipur." Mrs. Shruti said, a large smile plastered on her face as she ushered me into a rustic classroom. 9B read the plaque. It had wheatish walls, wooden desks, and terrazzo floors. The windows looked out onto the grounds, and the sunlight filtered alongside a soft breeze. I tried to hide my nervousness, grinning and looking around. Everyone smiled back. Everyone except her. She sat, crouching in a little corner with her head bent over the desk. I couldn't help but notice her matted, dirty hair, sooty face, and the mud stains on her off-white uniform, which was distinctly a hand-me-down. Her apathy amidst the enthusiastic class created a mystery about her, a mystery I wanted to solve. "You may sit there, next to Hina," she said, breaking my chain of thoughts. Her name was Hina, and she was the only one who sat alone in class. "All the best sitting next to her!" A boy jeered. "Make sure you hold your breath." another one said. "Why are they saying that?" I thought, walking to the end of the classroom. The answer came as soon as I sat down, as a strong putrid odor hit me. "She stinks!" I muttered, my face scrunching up with disgust. "Don't worry, she can't even follow basic hygiene. She hadn't had a bath!" a girl whispered. Hina shuffled nervously in her seat, turning away in response. "Well, I hope she learns to, someday," I said, turning away and focusing on the blackboard. I was new then and didn't know her story. I found it easy to adapt and make new friends, and soon found myself surrounded by my peers at all times. With this, thoughts of Hina left my mind. One afternoon... "So, class, who can explain to me William Wordsworth's 'Daffodils'?" our English teacher Miss. Martinez said. I and Hina raised our hands. "That's new. She never raises her hand in class." my friend Ruhi whispered. "Yes, Hina. You tell us." All heads turned to look at her, as she hesitantly got up, her legs quivering. She stared blankly at the ground and began, "It is about...it is about..." "Louder please." A shiver ran down her spine and her heartbeat fastened. She clenched her fists and said, "It is about...a...a flower. The poet's brother...brother dies. Poet is...is... Ma'am can I... can I say in Hindi?" "This is an English class. You need to speak in English." "I...I don't know..." "Sit down please." The class giggled. She meekly sat down, crouching even further now. "Go to a Hindi medium school if you don't know English," Ruhi said, smirking. I looked back at Hina, at the tearful glint in her eye. "It's okay," I whispered. "It happens with everybody." Alas! No response. Oh, how I wished for things to change for her. They did, but not for the better. A pleasant shock awaited us the next day. Sprawled across Hina's desk were the words 'You don't belong here, freak.' in big, bold black letters. "Who? Who could have done this?" I asked, flabbergasted, It shocked me to know that there was a bully among us. "Well, it could've been anyone. Hina is not liked by many." "We can't let her see this. We have to erase this!" "See what?" A weak voice came from behind, and I could feel my heart stop. "N...nothing..." I muttered, feeling my stomach fall down a bottomless pit. "What..." she stopped dead in her tracks, as her gaze fell on the letters. She took one look at them, another at us, and hurriedly ran off. "Hina, wait!" I screamed, running after her. "Why are you going after her?" Ruhi called, but I paid no heed. She ran straight to the washroom, locking herself in the nearest stall. "Hina! Hina, please open up!" I said, knocking on the door, and hearing sniffles. "Go...Away... Go." she mumbled. "Me no talk." "I promise to understand. Talk to me." "No...Go..." "Leave her alone," Ruhi said. "She anyways doesn't belong here." She then dragged me back to class. Mentally, however, I was still fixated on Hina. Would she be all right? Little did I know, that this question would be left unanswered for weeks. Hina didn't return to school after the incident. Weeks turned to months and the hot summer winds cooled down to give rise to fall. Tree-laden trees turned brown, as the canopies began to wither. We entered class on such autumn morning, decked in sweaters and cardigans to be greeted by the warmth of a return. Hina's return! She now looked better than ever and had lesser stains on the shirt. However, her head was still bent and her eyes low. She still sat in one lonely corner, only this time shivering from the cold. "Huh! She didn't care to bring a sweater and now pretends to feel cold. How dramatic!" Ruhi said, rolling her eyes. "It could be something else." "What else could it be? Why does she even bother to come." "Let her be," I said, walking up to Hina. "Welcome back." Much like before, she didn't respond and sat rooted to the spot. Ruhi chuckled in the background, as I sat down beside her, instead of with my friends. That afternoon, Hina too sat alone at lunch. "Where's her tiffin?" I asked, noticing how she looked longingly at everyone's food. "Who knows? She doesn't bother to bring a tiffin on most days." "Then why don't we share?" "Why should we? It's her issue, not ours." "But..." "Oh! Just eat!" Ruhi snarled. She'd always shut me up, whenever I tried to be compassionate to Hina, and with months of such behavior, I'd finally had enough. "I'm going to share my food," I announced with finality, getting up and going to her table. "Are you hungry?" Initially, she didn't respond but after much persistence, she replied, "Y...yes...I...I no eat in 2 days." "Why?" "Father not home." "And your mother?" "Dead. There is stepmother." "She doesn't help?" "She has 3 kid. 3 boys. She feed them, not me." "Here, take my food, then." "No no, you may be hungry." "No, it's okay. Take it." I said, smiling at her. Reluctantly, she took my lunch box and opened it. "Eat it." "You pakka are not hungry?" "Yes, yes. Don't worry." Despite being starved, she made sure I shared in on the lunch. It was a heartwarming sight to watch her eat, as with every bite life returned to her face. I felt a warm fuzzy feeling in my heart. The feeling of satisfaction of having done a good deed. In the days that followed, I started bringing an extra tiffin for her. I even brought her a sweater. The both of us had lunch together, much to the dismay of Ruhi and my friends. They taunted me about trying to help her, but I paid no heed. The mellow feeling of kindness and compassion was worth it. It was the feeling of peace. Some days we ate in silence, but other times Hina told me about herself. She told me her story. Her mother had died when she was still an infant, leaving behind an unwanted girl with her father. In the patriarchal mindset of her home, women were considered burdens, who belonged at home, not in classrooms. Yet, Hina fought for her education, sneaking from her father to go to school. She studied in secrecy, in the weak yellow glow of candlesticks. When her father remarried, things got worse and with her freedom, her privacy too was curtailed. Her stepmother mistreated her, often not giving her food for days and instead forcing her to work. Whenever life threw a curveball at Hina, she did not duck but instead faced it with all her might. She continued to sneak out of her home, pretending to go work as a domestic worker in households So, Hina didn't have lunch because her stepmother didn't give her any. Her hair was disheveled because she didn't have access to even basic facilities like sanitation. She didn't know English because nobody taught her. And she shivered with cold because nobody bought her a sweater. Hina's story helped me realize my privilege, a privilege we often took for granted. Yet, there was another lesson to be learned. One afternoon, I noticed a certain sadness in her. "What happened?" "My father knows. He got to know I was coming to school." "Oh my god! Now what?" "I no come from tomorrow. I no study, anymore. You are nice to me, the one friend I have. Thank you." she said, as her voice began breaking. These words hit me with the impact of a bullet train, as the world seemed to stop. Memories of the last few months rushed back to me. Hina had taught me so many things. She's taught me about kindness, empathy and compassion, strength, and standing up for what's right. I tried to change Hina's life, but she had changed mine. And here, I sit on the desk we once shared, writing her story, in hopes to change yours.
author: RISHA CHAURASIA

title: Always Be Ready
text: ALWAYS BE READY Once, there lived a girl named Pinky in a town. She lived happily with her parents and her little brother Rohan. Rohan was an excellent student who was praised by everyone. Pinky was an average student but a very hard working girl. Soon, their exam dates were announced. So Pinky started preparing for her exams. But Rohan was careless and he did not bother. Days passed and Rohan did not study anything. Pinky noticed his behaviour. She called Rohan and said “You should study for exams. You should not become overconfident. Let me tell you a story." Once there lived a crow and a squirrel on a big tree. They both were very good friends. There was a house in front of the tree. A girl used to stay in that house with her parents. Every morning the girl kept some food the parapet wall for the squirrel and the crow. When the girl gave food to them, the squirrel would eat some and take the remaining to her home because she wanted save food for bad times.But the crow did not think about the future. He was careless, he ate till his hunger was satisfied and he would spill over the rest of the food down which was eaten by a dog. The squirrel advised the crow to save the food for bad times but he told “You may save food for yourself. I can fly from house to house, tree to tree and gather food. So, I need not save food now”.Days passed, and this continued. One day, suddenly a cyclone came with very heavy rains. It kept raining for the next five days. Due to the bad weather, the girl could not keep food on the parapet wall. As it was raining very heavy, it was not possible for the crow to fly far distance in search of food.He had to stay hungry for many days. But, the squirrel managed to eat the food she had saved in these days. He then realised that he could have taken his friend, the squirrel’s advice. The crow was regretting for his careless behaviour. But it was too late. “So” said Pinky “You shouldn’t be overconfident. You should not become like the careless crow.” But Rohan said “I already know everything. I don’t need to study”. Soon it was the day just before the exam. So when Rohan sat to study, his friends called him for playing. Rohan forgot about the exam and went for playing. After sometime, it seemed like it will rain. So Pinky called out “Rohan! come home and study. It looks like it will rain and power cuts can happen any time!”. But Rohan ignored. Then it started raining. Rohan and his friends went home. As he came home and sat for studying, the power went off. Now Rohan got tensed and started crying. Rohan had realized his mistake. Pinky said I had told you to study before but you ignored me”. Rohan said “Sorry! Now please help me”. Pinky then explained Rohan all the lessons for his exam. Moral: We should never be overconfident and ALWAYS BE READY for future challenges.
author: Parnika Kadam
