title: The Hidden Cave
text: Finally my end term exams were over, and a long vacation lay ahead of me. I decided to do something special this vacation besides the usual games and movies. I wanted to do something adventurous. After exploring on the internet, an idea struck me. Why not go trekking somewhere around Bengaluru? TK Falls seemed to be the right destination for this one-day trekking trip. I spoke to my friends, Sia and Tia, and they both readily agreed to this trip. We decided to go the next day. My father volunteered to drop and pick us for this trip. I told my friends to start packing some essentials. We made a list of few things that we could need like a pair of new clothes, a mini first aid kit, binoculars, sunglasses, caps, snacks, torch, selfie stick and water bottles. Due to the excitement, I could not sleep the entire night. The next day morning I woke up, even earlier than my mother. I got ready and checked my backpack if I had everything I needed. We were ready to leave by 9.30am. We sang and had fun during our ride to the TK Falls. TK Falls was an actual adventure involving rock climbing, crossing a creek, passing through bushes and so on. At the end of the trail was the waterfall. We went under the waterfall and danced under the water. By mistake, I slipped behind the waterfall. I was shocked to see a cave behind the waterfall. I went past the waterfall and told about this cave to my friends. We all took our backpacks and sneaked behind the waterfall without anyone noticing us. The cave was pitch dark. We switched our torches and went further down the cave to explore it. We could hear sounds of different animals from the dark parts of the cave. It felt as if we were in a haunted house. After walking for a while, we reached the other side of the cave. As we were coming out of the cave, Tia tripped over a rock and fell on her hand. Fortunately, her hand did not break, nor did she twist her ankle. But she got a big bruise on her left hand. I had my first aid kit, so I cleaned her bruise and bandaged it. On the other side of the cave was a huge lustrous garden. While enjoying the diverse flora of the garden, we stumbled upon an old lady. She was surprised to see us. She welcomed us and asked us what we were doing there. We told her that we had come to the TK Falls for an adventure and discovered this hidden cave. The lady invited us for snacks at her place. We chatted and played with her while enjoying her delicious snacks. We had a wonderful time with her. Soon we realized it was time to bid farewell to the lady. Before leaving she gave us homemade cookies. We went past the waterfall, changed, and then I called my father to pick us up. On the way back home, we told my father about our adventure and the hidden cave experience.
author: Aaliyah Khambhaty

title: The Power of a Four-Leaf Clover
text: BEFORE YOU READ!!! Everyone in this life wants to live the happiest life possible and when they face any difficulties they blame God or their luck. When times are right you consider yourself lucky but just imagine that you are lucky everywhere and anytime. What could you have done then? Everyone knows how evil bullies are for a person's life. The same goes for Chloe, an 8-year-old girl. Chloe or Chloe Adams, living in a village near Chicago, Illinois, USA. She studies 3rd standard at Rosegardens Primary School which is very near to her house. Chloe is a sole introvert; she has trouble starting conversations with children and loves to stay alone because groups are her weakness. This doesn't mean that she isn't someone nice. She is a very literate girl for her age, she is good at singing and playing the piano, but all these skills are hidden due to her fear of talking with people. She also has some sports as her favourites, especially volleyball; she plays volleyball with her friends near her house. Some days before Halloween Chloe was sitting on a bench in the park in front of her house. She often does this as she wants to spend some time for herself and her cat. Her friends hadn't come yet and she was not expecting them anytime soon, she could wait for as long as she wanted to as she had completed her homework. Suddenly.... some of Chloe's seniors came. Conor and Tyler were students of Chloe's school, they studied in 5th grade and were regarded as the mafia heads of the school because of their actions. They were in habit of ragging their juniors. They used to bully the so-called " Nerds ". These two boys were as close as brothers they both got suspended together for a week. They were the go-getters of the school, though being the worst in school they were the most trusted people to do a certain job and were masters of keeping things a secret. Chloe, casually vibing and playing with her cat saw the two guys approaching. She was initially nervous as they were her seniors and they had never come there before. Both of them came close to Chloe she started to talk with them. " Are you Tyler.... and Conor 5th grade...? " She asked nervously. Conor responded while looking at Tylor and then Chloe who was keeping her head low " Yes! and you must be Chloe of 3rd grade ". She responded with excitement " Yes! Yes! " She was delighted as she was the most forgetful girl in the school. From here things went south really fast. The bullies had an opportunity to strike at the young girl. It was afternoon time nearly around 2:00 P.M the park was empty and nobody could be seen in the far sights of the park so they went for it. They started by sitting on the bench where earlier Chloe was sitting and then they called Chloe near them. Tylor stretched his legs and ordered Chloe to massage them. Conor started to laugh, and Chloe resisted Tylor's order but she wasn't powerful enough to stop those two bullies it turns out Tylor began threatening Chloe and said " Listen you little brat if you don't massage my feet right now we both will beat you to death ". This was enough to shock Chloe to the core; it also doesn't help that she is the so-called " nerd " of her class. She started the massage and Tylor was smiling and feeling relaxed and Chloe didn't even dare to make a sound. Finding the opportunity, Conor went behind Chloe and kicked her butt very lightly, but still, it was a lot for Chloe to bear, remained silent and continued the massage. Conor again kicked her, but this time with full force, forcing her to fall from her knees. Tyler stood and now both of the boys began brutally beating Chloe. In the end, they stood Chloe up and pulled her pants down and they went running. Chloe barely had any power left in her body. With all the bits remaining, she pulled up her pants and started dragging herself to the bench where she was sitting earlier and her cat was hiding during her getting a beat from those two guys. She ran away and came 10 mins after the boys had dashed from the park. She began wailing and shedding tears. After a few minutes, she could pick herself up and again move forward. She was in grievous pain; her shirt was extremely dirty and torn up, and not to forget that she had to stand shameful without pants for a few minutes due to her weakness. In deep grief, Chloe was walking home still, all those incidents roaming in her mind. It was almost 4:00 pm due to the incident happening near Halloween, it was the fall season, and the whole street was covered with orange leaves. While walking, Chloe found a different-looking leaf than the common leaves which were usually seen in the neighbourhood. It had four heart-shaped laminas attached to a single petiole. It was rare to see a green leaf during the orange leaf season, so she decided to carry it with her. Surprisingly for her, after all the beating she suddenly felt no pain from those bruises she had just got, and to her happiness - those bullies had been caught by some uncle living right beside the park. Now she returned happily to her house, and her cat came with her too, but it can be no surprise her mother came all horrified at the miserable condition of her daughter. Chloe told everything truthfully and gave her the news that those bullies had been caught; she was angry at the boys but also happy that her daughter was doing ok. It just took just two days for the complete recovery from all her injuries and now she could again go to school. She was extremely scared to go to school for fear of getting bullied again, but she couldn't be luckier. The government issued a report for an upcoming storm for which schools had declared leaves for an entire week. She rested at home while gaining some confidence to go to school again. Again, something good happened was that the storms stopped for Halloween and continued for two days afterwards. After a few days, in school, Chloe about that rare kind of leaf which was called the " Four leaf clover " which was a rare type of clover of the common " Three leaf clover " and also was the symbol of good luck. Chloe remained silent in school but as she reached home she rushed to her room to look for that leaf which was inside her desk's drawer. She wanted to test if the good luck thing was real or not, so she asked her mother for 5$ and she gave it without a question. Now she was starting to believe the luck theory but there was something she wanted to do before completely believing in this which was to buy a lottery ticket. She found a local ticket seller, she bought a ticket worth five bucks. The prize on the ticket was worth a million dollars. the prize pool will be announced 5 days after. She returned home happy and she got another surprise her mom had made her chocolate waffles with a scope of ice cream. She was determined that she would win the lottery and was jumping with joy. The day came. Chloe rushed for the newspaper and that was that. She had just won the lottery!!! She had got a Million dollars!!! She exclaimed with overjoy " Yes!! This clover is lucky ". Now she believed the luck theory the fact also helps that she recently gave an MCQs test for which she didn't study at all just to test if the majority of her guesses would go correct and would you believe it she got all her answers right which was just pure guess. After 7 years puberty struck and Chloe became the most attractive girl you would see. She was now in high school and all boys there fantasised about her but still she wasn't the popular girl you would expect her to be. She was in the best relationship with the best boy who was very handsome, awesome at studies and perfect at soccer. She loved her life and what was going on in it and whoever lived near her were the nicest people known to mankind. It was all due to her so-called " Rare Leaf ". She preserved it with all her heart while keeping the secret to herself. Not to forget her academic progress during this time - She aced her primary school and middle school and was doing well in high school. She went with her volleyballs and singing skills because of her luck she could play on the national level and also win the first prize in it and win a national singing contest but, this doesn't she didn't put her hard work into it at all. This was related to her future and she didn't want to take risks regarding this matter. She gave it all for everything and she was also excited doing so as she knew god was on her side. She never took unfair advantage of the power she had, she was as kind and sweet as she was earlier. She never brag about her abilities or luck and remained the kid she was earlier though she was now not as introverted as she was earlier. Times went by now she was even a college passed out and was working for a big company and was earning thousands of dollars per month (10000$ to be exact). She was working on an increment basis and is supposed to receive a rise of 7% per annum and she married the same boy who she was dating just a few years back. He was also quite successful in soccer as he was in high school. He got selected for the international soccer competition and represented The United States of America. Even Chloe didn't leave her passions. She works as a commisioned singer for diverse producers, games and songs for movies and is also very successful in that too. Her luck transferred to all his family i.e her husband and her 2 children who all enjoyed their life to the fullest. Sadly her mother died when she was 34 but fortunately, she died peacefully and didn't have to suffer a lot. Chloe had the most adorable, intelligent, fun and loving kids. they took immense care of their parents when they grew up and married gorgeous girls. When the children were mature enough, she finally revealed her secret to both her husband and their children all were surprised at first and weren't that keen to believe it but after she told them everything they had to back down. She requested her children to preserve the thousands of leaves she had preserved for their well-being. Her children were highly obedient and they started to take care of the leaves. Both Chloe and her husband died together loving for over 100 years and leaving all their assets for their two children for which they never fought with each other.
author: Kunwarjeet Singh Arora

title: Wounds that never heal
text: Ellie Adair (August 18th Friday 2017) “ I think it's getting worse. Elle, I am so terrified” Olive looks at me with wide eyes and holds my hand tight. Olive, she….. is my best friend, my ride or die, my partner in crime and also the person who is giving me chills right now with that look of hers. I embraced her in my arms and whispered softly into her ears “ Ol, it's okay…. We’ll be alright, I love you so so much”. At Least I think it will be okay... When I told her that we'll be alright, I'm not going to lie, I felt like there was an ounce of fear and uncertainty lingering in the back of my head. Dad says it's too soon to say anything. My Dad works in the army base for the Tilidian National Army. He says that all of this commotion will soon die down. For the rest of the day, while I was at school I tried not to think about this whole issue. It is kind of hard to do that when all that people are talking about is this. Anyways, to say the least I made it out of school in one piece. Gosh I’m going crazy. “Walking home are you?” he says while walking behind me “Oh hello, my brother dearest, how I’ve missed you” Evan really does get on my nerves. “and YES I am walking home, where else do you think I’ll be going huh?!?!?” “Ohh god why are you so fidgety today… ahhh let me guess you got in trouble at school didn't you?” he says that with a mocking smile on his face. “ FYI I did not get it into trouble, now can you stop following me ” “ What do you mean ‘following’ you?” his voice rose in anger. “I don't know if you noticed or not but we live in the same house alright? And I am walking home, do you understand?!?” he scoffs and starts walking faster. After this I am being reminded again that I am not going to be giving him anything for his birthday. Not if he’s going to keep up with this attitude. He is turning sixteen soon. I am three years younger than him but I truly believe that I am more mature. Him, on the other hand, disagrees. A few minutes later we reach home and mum is waiting for us at the front door like she always does. “ Hello my sweethearts, how was school today?” She says as we walk inside the house “ It was fine,” we say in unison. Mum’s smile quickly turns into a frown. “Judging by your long faces, I’m guessing you had a fight on the way home” “ Mum it was Evan” “ No, I did not do anything” and just like that we start bickering “Alright that is enough for the two of you. Now go change, I’ll get the both of you something to eat” she pauses “ Oh and don't forget we are having dinner a little early today” In our house mum made this rule where Friday nights’ are considered as family night. We’ll have dinner together, play some board games or watch a movie. She expects everyone to be there. No excuses. Mum is definitely the life of the party. I look forward to these because of her. When she’s around it’s a lot more fun and exciting.Oh and her sense of humor is contagious. Lord, I love her. Ben Adair (August 19th Saturday 2017) It is six in the morning and I just got information that I will have to join in combat against the Kingdom of Rhyndar. Honestly I have chills down my spine. I sit on my bed with my head in my hands. Stella rushes into the bedroom. “Ben! Is this true? I read that Tilidia is going to war with the kingdom of Rhyndar.” “I’m afraid so dear. They have started bombing the northern side of Tilidia…" Stella sits next to me on the bed "reports say that its only going to get worse " “Oh my Lord” She covers her mouth and her voice starts trembling. “What are we going to do, Ben?” She looks into my eyes, and i could see that those beautiful hazel eyes were filled with terror. “The Kingdom of Edessa is an ally…. Tilidians have started to flee to Edessa. You and the children will go to Edessa early tomorrow morning’’ I pause and take a deep breath and hold her hands. “I have been called to join combat” “Woah woah woah.. Hold on a second, what?!? You're leaving?” And now there are tears running down her cheeks. I can feel my heart beating faster. God, seeing her like this is killing me. I nod “I’m leaving today” “Ben, nooo, I can’t-'' she starts crying and I pull her closer to my chest, I can tell there is a long twisted road ahead of us. Ellie Adair “Evan, Ellie come down stairs quick” I get startled and I start rubbing my eyes in confusion. I look at the alarm and it's only 7:45. Goshh why is mum calling us? I wanted to sleep in. Oh…. wait a second. Am I in trouble? Nooo that won’t make sense. I don't remember doing anything to get in trouble. Okay now curiosity has shot through my system. Even though it was a struggle, I managed to get out of bed. After brushing my teeth, I went to the living room. “ What do you mean… in war?!?!” Okay why in the world is Evan screaming? I am so confused. “Oh good heavens, what is wrong with you Evan?” he does not answer, now my curiosity is through the roof. “ So will someone tell me what’s going on here?” I shoot a confused look at my parents who are sitting on the couch. “Mum? Dad?” “ Sit down Ellie” dad said this in such a cold voice that I have knots in my stomach now. “ I need the two of you to calm down and listen” He pauses. “ The kingdom of Rhyndar has started attacking Tilidia. It's getting quite serious.” My eyes widened “What? Why?” “There’s a lot of reasons as to why... But in more simpler words let’s just say there is a ‘conflict of interests’ ” “Dad, are you going into combat?” Evan aks, we both are just sitting there in shock and disbelief ‘Yes, Looks like they’ll be needing all hands on deck. I’ll be leaving home before noon” Everything that happened after that is just a big blur to me. I think it all hit when Dad said goodbye and drove out of our driveway. For the first time since this morning me and Evan started crying. Mum hugged us but didn’t say anything though. She was as numb and terrified as we were. Considering that Tilidia was a small country we were scared that it might be going to a stage of no return. We were scared that a loved one may not make it or we might not make it or dad might not make it. I swear no amount of words could ever describe what that felt like. That night I was barely able to sleep. All I could hear were airstrikes and bombs going off in the distance. I cried all night, it was horrible. Edessa was a neighboring country. So early in the morning a friend picked us up and drove us to the border. While I was in the car I closed my eyes, I hoped that when I opened it I would realize that all of this was just a nightmare. Surprise,surprise…. It was not. But It did feel like living in one. Ellie Adair (2 months later) My country and Rhyndar are still going through war. Hundreds of people have died in the bombings and many left injured. It is so excruciating to see all of this happen. Life in Edessa is quite hard. We are a bit short on money so mum works part time jobs now. For the time being me and Evan are not going to school. So during the day it's just the two of us. At this point I think sleep is overrated. I try to sleep but all that comes to my mind are the horrible scenes that I see on TV. Some days are harder than others, sometimes it feels like I'm drowning in my own thoughts, it feels like my chest is tightening and I can’t breathe anymore. When I have panic attacks I go to Evan and he helps me calm down. I actually don’t mind him anymore. It’s hard to admit but he is actually pretty amazing. It's weird when you think about it... how time can change everything. because at one moment I absolutely despised him and in the next he becomes my biggest support system. I didn't talk to mum about the whole 'late night troubles'. I don’t want to make her worry. She already has a lot on her plate. Mum is such a strong woman. Even though she isn’t as lively as she was before she still is amazing and we adore her. Also I haven’t been able to contact Olive since the war broke out. I’ve tried a ton of time but I was never able to reach her. She probably fled to another country right? I am praying that she’s alright. Ben Adair I only get to message Stella and the kids every three weeks or so. I miss them a lot. I miss our Friday nights. But at least they are safe. When I left home a few months ago I tried so hard not to cry. The thought of not being able to see the love of my life and our two beautiful children again made me want to throw up. Despite the worry I was in, I didn't cry in front of them.I didn't want them to be frightened. It is getting bad out here. The death toll is increasing and I've lost many of my fellow soldiers to heavy injuries. It's hard to keep going like this. But I think we are slowly seeing the light at the end of the tunnel. Ellie Adair (August, 2022) It's been 5 years now since the war. That war lasted for about three months. My father was safe and we were able to see him. I missed him a lot. Me, my mother and brother were able to go back to Tilidia a month after the war ended.. But NOTHING was the same. Everything was shattered, our homes as well as our hearts. But despite all of this Tilidia has gotten better. That is with a lot of help. Many countries around the world have contributed in the efforts of rebuilding Tilidia. Many people had donated money, food, clothes and so much more. It reminded me that there is more good than evil in this world. The country in itself is doing great now, we’ve rebuilt homes, cleaned up the streets and made it look alive and beautiful again. Our country will keep getting better with time, I'm sure of it. But this 3-month war...it created massive wounds in the hearts of our people. There's this void in our hearts that I don't think will ever be filled. Do you know what was the first thing I learned after coming back? That I lost my best friend. Olive died in the bombings. Oh and at that moment I lost it. I just fell on to the ground and burst into tears. All I wanted at that point was to see her one last time, to tell her how much she meant to me and how much I miss her. I have always loved her and I will never stop loving her. Don't get me wrong, we are happy for what we have and we are grateful that things are getting better. But it's just that…some wounds can never be healed. See the thing is there are going to be many moments in your life where life makes you fall, and that's okay. But what you need to do is slowly get up and keep walking...even if it hurts.
author: Nashwa Rasiya

title: The Friendly Sofa
text: He put it in front of his house,for the garbage collection to pick up. His sofa's name was Darla. She was sad that Mr Barry didn't want her in the house anymore. "She's is very old,"Mr Barry told his neighbour Willa. "The fabric is threadbare. I'm going to fall through it one day. "Am I very old?" thought Darla. She still felt springy. When Mr Barry put cushions on her and fluffed her up,she felt beautiful. But there were no cushions anymore. No TV, and no bookcase. Mr Barry hauled her out on a trolley, and left her there in the front garden, all alone. She sat in the sun, beneath the trees, and watched the street. It was very quite and sunny on the street. Darla had never been outside in her whole life. She liked the feel of the sun on her. She watched some cars pass. A little girl with red boots was skipping along the path. "Hallo!" said the little girl. "What are you doing here? Is someone moving house?" "I'm going to the rubbish tip," said Darla sadly. "Oh!" said the girl.Then she said, "Perhaps no one will mind then, if I sit on you?" At first Darla was alarmed that the little girl might fall through her fabric, as Mr Barry had said. But Darla didn't fall through the fabric. She kicked off her red boots and stretched out in the sun. She laughed and sang some songs to Darla. She didn't seem to need to go anywhere. Her doll liked Darla very much, too. Soon a boy on a bicycle came past. He stopped when he saw the little girl, the doll and Darla. "A sofa on the street!" said the boy. Does it belong to someone?" "To me!" said the little girl. "But you can sit on it too!" And it looked so comfortable and so relaxing that the boy leaned his bicycle up against a tree, and came to sit on it too. It was very nice in the sun. The birds that were hopping from branch to branch soon saw the children looking so comfortable, and wanted to investigate. They hopped onto Darla's arm and sang. The children were very quite, and the birds weren't scared. It was very nice to sit on a sofa in the garden. The ladybug that was flitting past hovered when she saw the children and the birds enjoying the sofa in the sun. She landed gently on the Darla, and walked up the back-rest. The flowery pattern on Darla's cover made the ladybug imagine she was on holidays, in an exotic jungle. She was happy to have discovered Darla on the street. Next a family of ants arrived. They knew that chocolates had once been dropped on the arm-rest and the sweet smell of melting sugar tempted them. They had meant to get the chocolate and go, but it was so nice on the sofa in the sun, so they stayed. Mr Barry came out of his house. "What is going on?" he asked. "Why are you all on my sofa?" The girl and the boy, the birds and the ladybug and the family of ants, all looked up at Mr Barry. Then Mr Barry laughed. "Is there room on that sofa for me?" And that is how Mr Barry decided to leave Darla the sofa in his front garden. He made her a little plastic raincoat for when it rained, and put a little table beside her. Darla was now an outdoors sofa, and with so many new friends to visit her, and the trees and the sun, she was the happiest she'd ever been.

title: The Case of the New Planet
text: Every evening, Anvi peers through her telescope. On clear nights, she can spot faraway stars and planets. But she is most curious about aliens and doesn’t tire of looking for them. One night, she sees a very bright spot in the sky. The spot gets bigger and bigger. It comes closer and closer. And it lands in Anvi’s backyard. It’s a spaceship! Two red blobs peep out of the spaceship. Each of the blobs has three eyes, two noses and no hair. Anvi rubs her eyes in disbelief! Are they aliens? The blobs stare and stare at Anvi and then stretch out their hands. Anvi is curious. She walks into the spaceship, as if in a dream. The doors close as soon as she steps in and the spaceship takes off. Anvi peeps out of the window. She can’t see her house anymore. Instead, there are huge, scary purple mountains outside. Bump. Thud. Bump! The spaceship seems to have landed. Anvi rushes to open the door. She steps outside and whooooosh... She slips and falls. She shivers. The ground is covered with ice. There are thousands of red blobs marching up and down. “Where am I?” she asks the blobs. They shrug and look up to the sky. Anvi looks up. She sees a big red sun and two smaller bright dots in the sky. “It looks like there are three suns!” she exclaims. Again, the blobs don’t respond. Once more, Anvi asks her new blob friends, “Where am I?” This time they shake their heads. “Could this be Jupiter? No, it is made of gas. I wouldn’t be able to stand on it,” she thinks. “Could this be the moon of Saturn?” she wonders. “ But no, where are Saturn’s rings? ” The next day in school, Anvi runs to her best friend Rukaiyya. “I met some aliens last night!” she says. “They were red blobs. I went with them to their planet in a spaceship. Which planet do you think they were from?” “Oooo, you lucky thing! I read a book which said there are billions of planets outside our Solar System called exoplanets. The one closest to Earth is Proxima Centauri b. Do you think the blobs came from there?” asks Rukkaiya. “Yes. Maybe they did. I would love to visit again,” says Anvi. Meanwhile, on exoplanet Proxima Centauri b: Two red blobs are sitting on a tower. “We went into space yesterday,” one says. “I think we reached another planet. A strange-looking creature was staring at us. She followed us into the spaceship.” “I heard they’ve discovered a new planet, and named it Earth. Do you think you went there?” Planet Proxima Centauri b Proxima Centauri b was discovered in 2016. It revolves around the star Proxima Centauri. Even though it is the closest planet to our Solar System, it is still 4.2 light years or 40 trillion kilometres away from Earth. Light from Proxima Centauri would take about four years to reach us. Did Anvi really go to planet Proxima Centauri b? Even if Anvi had travelled by the fastest spaceship today, it would have taken more than 70,000 years to reach Proxima Centauri b. So, it is unlikely that Anvi reached Proxima Centauri b — unless the blobs had a spaceship that goes faster than light! (Scientists think it is impossible to travel faster than light.) Earth Sun Proxima Centauri Alpha Centauri B Alpha Centauri A What were the three dots that Anvi saw in the sky? Proxima Centauri b revolves around the star Proxima Centauri, a small red dwarf star. This star is redder, cooler and doesn’t shine as brightly as the Sun. There are two other stars near it — Alpha Centauri A and B. If Anvi had reached Proxima Centauri b, she would have seen Proxima Centauri as a big red ball, and the other two further stars as bright white dots. Alpha Centauri B Alpha Centauri A Proxima Centauri Earth Sun Telescopes are magical instruments that can show us the wonders of the universe. The James Webb Space Telescope was launched into space by the scientists at the National Aeronautics and Space Administration (NASA) in December 2021. It began capturing stunning images of light emitted by some of the first galaxies born in our universe. The light from the stars in these galaxies was emitted over 13 billion years ago — our universe was still very young then. Imagine, the light travelled about 120000000000000000000000km before reaching the James Webb Telescope. NASA shared the images with us Earthlings in July 2022.
author: Ananya Dasgupta

title: The residents of Tummy Island
text: The residents of Tummy Island Once upon a time, there was a tropical island surrounded by the Indian Ocean. The beauty of this island was its radiant sky, ample sunshine, white sand beaches, rich soil, dreamy turquoise water, palm trees, and tropical jungles with incomparable geographical values. Its shape resembled the shape of a stomach, hence its name, "Tummy Island." People from across the globe used to live there. The main occupations of this island were tourism and the trading of spices and condiments. The specialty of this island was the berries, which were only available here. Maggi was a charming little girl with curly hair, bright eyes, and an adorable smile. She was the youngest active member of the Pineapple Club; she was a passionate volunteer for various activities organized by the club. She knew every corner of the island. Maggi's parents, Honey (Honeypreet Singh) and Cherry (Charandeep Kaur) were new to the island when they had shifted from Punjab, India. Uncle Taco was the one who looked after them as a guardian. Maggi's father, Honey, was the biggest trader of spices and condiments on the island. Uncle Taco was very friendly with Maggi and used to tell her about his journey over the past 50 years, starting when he first came from Mexico to Tummy Island as a trainee and how he met Aunt Sushi, who was from Japan, during his training and decided to marry her. Since then, Uncle Taco and Aunt Sushi have been running successful hotels on Tummy Island and are always ready to help others. One morning, Maggi received a call from Mayor Hamburger's office. She then took her bicycle and went to the Pineapple Club to collect the notice, as she had a duty to distribute it to all the houses on the island. Mr. Hamburger had called an urgent meeting for all the residents. In no time, everyone gathered to learn why the meeting had been called. Mayor Hamburger was stressed and pale, but he gradually started the speech and announced that a European brand called Mac & Cheese wanted to take over Tummy Island and its prestigious beachfront hotels and other businesses. This was shocking for everyone because no one wanted to leave the island or work under another brand. After all, it was their hard work that had made the island a great source of income. All the residents refused to sign the deal, but there was an absurd condition that if the people of Tummy Island refused to sign the deal, they would have to face a culinary art compe tition with the professionals hired by the big European brand. If they fail to perform and win, they will have to work under the brand, or they are free to leave the island. This was nothing but humiliation for them, as suddenly their lives were at stake, and their families were under fear, insecurity, and uncertainty about their future. Uncle Taco called his secretary, Ms. Ravioli, for a one-on-one discussion with all the residents. After a week, all the residents accepted the challenge of the Culinary Art Competition. The schedule and rules of the competition were printed and distributed to everyone. The competition had three rounds: Round one was a combo round, where both teams had to serve a combo of a mocktail and a starter. But the twist was that it had to be a seafood dish from the island itself. Team Mac & Cheese served roasted crab cakes as their first dish, with a glass full of strawberry punch. This dish looked good, smelled great, was well-seasoned, properly marinated, and uniquely garnished. This opening dish clearly showed the professionalism and culinary skills of Team Mac & Cheese. Now it was the turn of Team Tummy Island. The team was in a do-or-die situation, so they decided to opt for something uniquely available only on Tummy Island. Lobsters found on Tummy Island were a unique species in the seafood family, so they decided to go for a lobster bisque with a mocktail from their island called Very Berry Punch. This mocktail had a mix of all the berries, available only on Tummy Island. They presented it in Hawaiian style, and its contemporary taste was so fresh that the judges couldn't stop themselves from reordering it. And both teams got perfect points for their original recipes. After a gap of a week, round 2 started; this time, both teams had to prepare the main course from another country, with the twist that the dish had to be vegetarian. Team Mac & Cheese presented an Italian dish called corn cannelloni with bruschetta. It was fresh, full of herbs, and healthy. With the expertise of Honey and Cherry, they prepared an Indian dish of authentic Punjabi cuisine. It was a royal platter with lip-smacki ng dishes from Punjab, like rajma rice, paneer butter masala, dal makhani, and butter naan, with a huge glass full of buttermilk. This food was phenomenal, and this platter could have worked as a lifesaver for the residents of Tummy Island. There was a fair game going on and a tie again. Only the last phase was left, so the pressure was building bit by bit. The third and final rounds required desserts to prepare. At first, it looked simple to prepare a dessert, but again, the twist was to use seven tropical fruits from the Tummy Island. So this was going to be the difficult part of the competition. So, both teams geared up. Mac and Chess had professional pastry chefs who created the best of all sweets. On the other hand, residents of Tummy Island knew the place better than anyone else. The company had massive plans for investment on the island, that's why team Mac & Cheese did not want to miss the chance of winning the competition. To ensure that the residents did not win, they played a trick and purchased the entire berry crop of the island so that residents could not use them in their dish and lose the points necessary to win. However, innocent residents were unaware of the dirty plans of the other team. So the day came, and Team Mac & Cheese presented their dish "Berrylicious Pie" with Blueberry Sauce. This dish had all seven tropical fruits: pineapple, strawberry, blueberry, blackberry, kiwi, avocado, and fig. Now it was the turn of residents to prepare and present their dishes. But what? What Happened? Asked Uncle Taco. The fruit seller Dim Sum from China, refused to provide the berries, as all got sold out by then. Uncle Taco was now depressed, as he knew that it would not be possible to complete their sweet dish without the berries. Aunt Sushi immediately called Dr. Falafel to come for Uncle Taco's check-up, as he was feeling low and scared of losing their home and island. Maggi was disappointed to see the elders in panic. So, she decided to help them by figuring the way out. She went to Mrs. Waffles to check for the solution. Mrs. Waffles, who was Maggi's favorite teacher, told her that all the berries on the island were sold and not available to make the dessert. Suddenly, Maggi got an idea, and she took her bicycle and flew towards the southeast bay as if she knew something. She was in a hurry because there was very little time left. Upon reaching the east coast, she searched for a peculiar berry that was the specialty of Tummy Island. After searching for hours, she found a tiny little bush with rainbow berries. She jumped with joy and dove down towards the bush; this was the secret bay area where these rainbow berries used to grow. After gathering all the berries, Maggi accelerated the speed of her bicycle to reach the pineapple club competition ground, and there she shouted, "We have got the secret berries." Honey and Cherry were surprised to see Maggi shouting like this. Now, team Tummy Island had all the tropical fruits on their counter, so they started mixing all of them, and they added the rainbow berries at the end, which were super juicy, a little nutty in the middle, and looked like a rainbow in color. After completing the dessert, they even garnished it with a rainbow berry. They named their dish "Rainbow Lava Cake." It had pineapple, coconut, fig, avocado, dragon fruit, passion fruit, and rainbow berries. The dish looked delicious due to the beautiful color of the rainbow berries. All the residents were delighted with their dish. The judges were fascinated to see such a rainbow-colored berry for the first time. The opponents could not believe that there was one more berry on the island that nobody knew. The dessert was divine in taste. The heaven was smiling on the residents as they were declared the winners of the culinary art competition. From then on, this dessert became the national dish of the island. And people from all over the world visit Tummy Island every year for its serene beauty and delicious rainbow lava cake.

title: Gautama Buddha: The visionary sage of all times
text: Friends, we all know that every book that choose has an 'index'. But have asked yourself "What has this starting index to do with the entire book?". Many of you just ignore it thinking it just as a page in the book. But the real fact is that an index is simply a 'guide' for the book. When we look at the index, we come to know the contents of the book, their location (page numbers) and also we get to know the idea of the way to use the book. FIrstly, we always look at things that we often like. Isn't it? And then we attempt for the difficult ones!!!! Identically, our life is a story boo too! We too need an index for our life that helps us to lead our life in a proper way. We also get its real taste, good things that are awaiting for us and also interest to lead our lives. We never get tired of life unless we know its index. Who is its author? The person who leads his / her own life is its author. But then, to make your life and achievements interesting for someone else, never forget to tell its index first!!!!! I told this because one must know that an author always starts writing his book with the index first!!! Why? It is because this is a blueprint or a plan that helps him to complete the remaining part of the book. He also gets an inspiration to continue his job and never gets tired of it!!!!! THE STORY OF GAUTAMA BUDDHA Now let us refer to the story of Gautama Buddha who is the 'the creator of index of every individual's life.' We get at least some information of this great ascetic from the history books that we read at the school. This is the preliminary part. They say that he was firstly a prince named Siddharta and later renounced his riches and lived the rest of his life as an ascetic. They even say that he was the creator of 'Buddhism' that had distinguished itself from the then followed religion of India 'Hinduism'. But have you ever known that even Hinduism acknowledges some of the teachings of Buddha? Yes of course!! Than the normal opinion of the history books, Hinduism opines differently about the life and existence of the great ascetic, Buddha. The Hindus consider Buddha not just as a mere ascetic out of renunciation, but consider him as an 'incarnation' of the Supreme Lord, Krishna. Let us now learn why he incarnated. Reason of Buddha's incarnation: According to one of the Indian epical story, After the Dwaparayuga ended with Krishna's departure from this world, the Kaliyug or the demoniac period took its roots. The people who always followed righteousness as their ultimate life's goal, now switched onto heinous ways of amassing wealth. The Satvaguna (the quality or mode of goodness) of the people washed away and the Arishadvarga durgana (The six evil qualities of a man) dominated them. This included Kama (lust), Lobha (Greed), Krodha (Anger), Moha (unreasonable attachment), Mada (Arrogance) and lastly Matsarya (Jealousy). Due to this, the people dwelled in ignorance and lost the power of Mantrasiddhi (Spiritual achievements). Also, the spiritual quotient (SQ) declined in humans. The Brahmins, Kings, Traders and Workers were one of these badly affected people. Overpowered by these bad qualities, they had continuous conflicts between themselves. One always tried to overcome the other with these conflicts. Sometimes the common people were killed by the atrocities of the kings. Yagnas or the Sacrificial fires, which were to bring good harvests and happiness to people, had become 'burning pyres' for animals. Animals such as sheep, buffaloes, goats etc. were killed in these fires. Lost of Ghee, milk and curds was poured into these fires. For this, the farmers had to produce ghee not for consuming and being healthy but for these fires. This was against the Vedic scriptures. People who tried to stop this weren't spared by the wrath of these evils. They always supported their actions by illogical arguments. Soon, the Vedas were abandoned and without reading them, people invented their own customs as per their wish. When someone enquired about or challenged this, they always shouted "Its in the Vedas." So, to protect the nectars of knowledge - the Vedas, Lord Krishna thought of an idea. He realized that this was the time to restore back the goodness of the world. He even pledged that in this incarnation, he would destroy all the bad and restore the good people without using a single weapon!!!! This is why, in Buddha's history, we never find a situation in which Buddha used a weapon to change the world, yet he accomplished it!!!!! Lord Krishna took birth as a beautiful baby in the palace of King Suddhodana, the King of Kapilavastu, India (now in Nepal). He was covered with jewels from head to toe. His mother was Queen Maya. He was named Siddhartha. One day, an astrologer named Asita came to the court of Suddhodana. After accepting hospitalities from the king, he said to the king to be aware of Siddhartha which meant' One who is accomplished, successful and prosperous '. If this child was ever left out of the palace, he would learn everything about the world and then instead of being the future king (ruler), he would renounce his life and become a monk. King Suddhodana never liked this. So, throughout Buddha's childhood, he was always kept in the palace with full of luxuries and the King made sure that no one would ever educated him about the world. Due to this, the servants in the palace, the ministers including the queen feared to talk to him. As Buddha grew up, he became matured. Whenever he asked his father about the worldly matters, he always replied "The world is always luxurious and blissful". Siddhartha was never satisfied with these replies. He was always in quest of truth and wanted to find it out without leaving any stone unturned. By hook or by crook, when he attained the age of 15, he asked his charioteer Chandaka to take him on a round to witness the luxuries and blissfulness of the city. The charioteer agreed and took him on a round. As he was going, he saw an old man, dressed in haggard clothes and unable to walk. When buddha enquired about this, the charioteer said "this man is so old. He struggles a lot to walk. He keeps praying to God everyday to give him death. That GOD is blind!!!" Buddha didn't concentrate much on this. Later, another day, he saw a sick person. When he acquired about this, Chandaka said "Destiny is too bad. It treats us like a puppets in its hands and that is why is fallen ill." On the third day, he saw a dead corpse and people surrounding it and weeping dearly. Seeing this, Chandaka said to Buddha, "This is the dead young man and his family members. God is cruel. He doesn't have any feelings. He kills the living and puts its members into suffering." At last, he saw an ascetic. This time, when Buddha enquired about it, Chandaka had no answer or justification. Seeing all this, Buddha came to a conclusion to renounce his princely life. When this news of Siddhartha becoming a monk reached King Suddhodana, he was outraged. He in grudge of teaching a lesson, he married him to princess Yashodhara, the marvellous daughter of King Suppabuddha who ruled Burma, India (Now Myanmar). Siddharta was forced to life with his wife until he beget a son who would continue the rule the kingdom. He was never allowed to leave the palace even by the guards. Finally, a child named Rahul was born to him. Overcome by depression, one night, when the palace was in deep sleep and silence, abandoning his wife and new - born child, he sat in the chariot and went to the dense forests. There he sacrificed all his princely clothes and asked the charioteer to convey the message to the king of his renunciation. The King felt sad, but could do nothing about it. He had to bring up Rahul as his own child and make him the future ruler. Buddha walked nearly 511.3 km from Kapilavastu in the deep jungles. He had not eaten or drunk for many days, Yet he was so strong!!! He finally reached a huge tree and selected this place best for his meditation. He sat there meditated for 12 long years and soon got enlightened (Nirvana). This tree today is the world famous Bodh Gaya tree located in Patna, Bihar. Later, Buddha spread the spiritual knowledge also the ultimate by his foot. He walked throughout today's parts of western India, Nepal, North India. Spread of Buddhism When Buddha spread the wonderful treasure of knowledge he had, people from nook and corner of the country had a special attraction towards. They were able to relate his teachings with their daily life sufferings and felt that he was the real person to be worshipped and followed. They sprinkled flowers, rose water, washed his feet and listened to his words of wisdom. People followed him in large gatherings. They stopped bowing to the hegemony of the kings and powerful people and became independent. Due to this, the Yagnas slowly lost popularity. Buddha inculcated non - violence and consuming only foods that weren't obtained by harming any creature! These were very easy steps to be followed to lead a very peaceful and a happy life. The followers of Buddha are today technically called 'Buddhists'. These Buddhists are majority in South - Eastern countries such as Bhutan, Sri Lanka, Myanmar, Thailand, Cambodia, Laos, Vietnam and Tibet while minorities in countries like India, China, Nepal and Afghanistan. Buddhism was a religion that had wide spread from Afghanistan to Vietnam due to its popularity between 6th to 8th century!!!! The sects of Buddhism ﻿After Buddha led a life of 80 years from the year 623 BC, in the year 543 BC, he departed from this world. Later, there were conflicts regarding the teachings of Buddha among the followers. So, three sects of Buddhism were formed: Hinayana, Mahayana and Vajrayana. Teachings of Holy book 'Tripitaka' Buddha did not write any books. Instead, his disciples, to remember the teachings of Buddha always jotted down his words. They were later compiled to form the holy of Buddhists, the 'Tripitaka'. These contain three sections: The Sutra Pitaka, The Vinaya Pitaka and the Abhidhamma Pitaka. Some of Buddha's statues were carved during the Mauryan to the Gupta period. There were stupas or temples built in his honour. One of them is the famous Sanchi Stupa. The another Buddha temple was built in Bamiyeh and Kandahar province of Afghanistan respectively in the year 570 CE. But unfortunately, after the Islamic invasions from Iran in 1036 CE, they were destroyed completely. There are presently many such Buddha Stupas in Tibet and South - Eastern countries of Asia. One of the most important teachings of Buddha that is world famous is: "Lust is the main reason for grief" We can find its mention even in the Hindu Holy book, Bhagavad-Gita. Isn't this sentence meaningful? Only people who lust for things that they see, hear, touch, taste and smell come to grief. They must not lose control of the mind and realize that they and the things that they experience aren't permanent. So, by following this principle, we can eradicate 'grief' in our lives.

title: The Doorbell
text: The two children laughed and giggled aloud. They looked at each other with all the innocence childhood could offer. Anya watched as her friend Rohit’s laughter died. They were engulfed by a blue light. Anya lost her breath. Their hold on each other’s hands tore apart. Her eyes watered as she sunk. Anya woke up to the sound of the alarm clock that had been going off for the past hour. She never woke up early because of her weird vivid dreams which had never left her side for the past twenty years. As loyal as a shadow. She got up and changed quickly, chewing a breath mint because- who had time to brush? Not her, certainly. She grabbed her suitcase- spilling her meeting papers- and snatched the coffee from the counter and hurried to the door leading outside. She pounced on the doorknob like a lion at its prey but was interrupted by the calm jingle of the doorbell. With her hand still hovering over the doorknob she thought of who it could be. The milkman had come by early with the milk for her coffee and the newspaper man had already left a soggy newspaper that was wet from the rain near the gate. She wasn’t expecting any packages or guests. “Who is it?”, she thought to herself. What she didn’t know was that she would be crying in the arms of the mystery behind the door in no more than half an hour. She yanked open the door in a hurry to reveal the silhouette of lanky man with a slim frame in her verandah. He blocked the morning sun and could only be seen as a black figure at her door. “Who is it?”, she asked again aloud this time. The man stepped away from the lights path, revealing a face that made Anya’s head reel. It was her childhood friend Rohit. What was he doing here? Anya’s mind took a walk down memory lane as she took a few steps back in shock. Not a walk, a fall. A long hard fall that hurt unbelievably as she hit rock bottom. Her head pounded. “I was the bully. I am the bully.”, she told herself a few times but her mind wasn’t really listening to her. She quickly pulled herself together and asked Rohit “What are you doing here? Far from home, yes?” His face seemed to sadden as he heard the coldness in her tone. “Can we speak inside?” Anya walked to the living room without saying anything and Rohit followed, not breaking the silence. She sat down on the sofa and he sat down next to her. “So?” Anya said. “...Anya-” She looked at him. Black hair and brown eyes. The same face she saw as he tried to kill her. She was fourteen and he fifteen and all his life he was at the receiving ends of thousands of insults, bad words, words that made him depressed for being deaf. And many of these words said by her, his best friend. That one rainy day just like the present, she had crossed the line. In all of his teenage rage he had tried to drown her in the family pool. He had pushed her into the pool and held her down by her neck as she screamed. Screamed for help she did, but no one heard her. More water only rushed into her throat as her hot tears mixed in with the shockingly cold water. His hands tightened at her neck. A few family members saw him and pulled him away from the pool and she just floated. Floated to the bottom. “I’m sorry” Rohit began. His eyes darted everywhere other than her as if he was attempting to catch the words from the air. “We were great friends I suppose, you and I-” “Friends?! You thought we were friends then? I was a bully and what you did was-” “Unforgivable.” Rohit sighed and put is face in is hands. “What we both did to each other is unforgivable. But you know what? Each time you called me names, said I was stupid, that I was a fool for not being able to hear people and that I was an animal for not being able to understand what people said. Sign language was my only gateway to understanding other people and that too in your own words made me weak. I fell apart every single day and your words only made me stronger. Each time I fell and each I wished to end it, your words made me get back up again. I live everyday only to prove to you that I can do anything. Only to prove to you!” Rohit sobbed. “Do you forgive me? Do you forgive me for that day?” “Do you forgive me?” Anya said now crying too. “Yes.” They embraced and many tears were wept at that moment. They cried for the friendship that was lost. They cried for the years not seeing each other. And they cried for the friendship that’s was now formed.
author: Janvi  Nair

title: The Tree House
text: Nishant was getting ready for his office. Suddenly, his phone beeped. He saw a few missed call.. It was Ayush, his best friend. Ayush was working in an IT company and very depressed with his job, in spite of his high salary in his company. Nishant quickly took his phone and called him back. '' Hey! I am really sorry Ayush.. I was very busy with a project.'' ''It's fine Nishant. I can understand your situation.'' said Ayush. ''Hmm.. Anyway, what made you call me early in the morning? Everything is good right? asked Nishant. ''Yes! In fact no. Nishant I am not able to cop up with my job. I feel like I am left alone in a dark room. I am not able to sleep nor able to rest comfortably. I tried to make friends but I was not able to. I don't know what to do.'' said Ayush. From the tone of Ayush, Nishant could clearly understand in what situation his very cheerful and calm friend was put into. '' I have the best plan to get rid of your feelings..You will obviously have your Christmas holidays for at least one week right?'' asked Nishant curiously. ''Yes.. For ten days.'' said Ayush in an unpleasant tone. ''Okay.. I have the best spot which we can visit. We will go for camping, trekking and many more adventures. We will leave next week..'' The following Sunday, Nishant and Ayush left for their destination. The place was indeed, very beautiful. It was filled with greenery and a calm and quite river was flowing through the center of the plot. As they reached their destination, they were mesmerized with its beauty. They rest for sometime and went around the whole plot. The next morning, Nishant woke up hearing the sweet chirping of birds and good mornings of the insects. He told Ayush '' Let's go for a walk!'' '' Okay fine..'' said Ayush. He was really fond of photography. He even carried his camera bag with him. They kept on walking for almost half an hour and Nishant was really tired. He turned back towards Ayush to say that it was enough, but he was shocked! Ayush was not there behind him. He searched for him in every nook and corner of the plot but could not find him. Without even wasting a minute he ran back to his cottage and ringed the staff in charge.'' Hello! I am Nishant. Mr. Ayush staying in cottage in cottage number 8 has gone missing.'' Are you sure that he is missing?'' asked the staff! ''Yes..'' said Nishant. '' Then he might have lost himself in the woods. '' said the staff. '' Can we go and check? asked Nishant. '' No! It is very dangerous. I will call the forest officer.'' said the staff. One forest officer came along with his driver. Then the four set for the woods. On their way, Nishant saw giant paw prints and traces of elephant pathways, heard rustling of leaves and saw trees of the height of sky scrapers. He was feeling very guilty because he felt that Ayush went missing because of him. They searched for him till dawn, but could not find him. The forest officer told that they had to return because it was very dangerous to move in the forest at night. As they were returning, the driver stopped the vehicle to wash his face. Suddenly, Nishant noticed a camera bag lying down a tall tree. He ran towards the tree and saw a tree house on one of the branches of the tree. He asked the officer to allow him to check there for the last time. They climbed the tree and reached the branch on which the tree house stood. There, he found Ayush sleeping peacefully. Nishant woke him up and asked him what happened. Ayush was perplexed, he told Nishant that while walking, he by mistake took the opposite turn as he was busy clicking pictures. Then, he lost himself in the woods. After a long time, he saw the tree house and climbed it. He also told Nishant that he heard the cry of many wild animals but with God's grace, he was safe. Nishant noticed that while talking about all his adventures, Ayush was free of tension and very pleasant. Nishant was very happy to get his old college friend, the calm and cheerful one back. Now, Nishant realized that his decision was not wrong..
author: SONA SANTOSH

title: A REALIZING GROWTH
text: I yawned lazily after finishing my assignment. I turned my gaze towards the clock. I was shocked to see that it was already 2:30 am in the morning. “Ah, I won’t be able to have a good sleep today as well. I wish I was an adult like my sister, she can sleep on time, eat on time and do everything on time." I talked to myself. "All she does is go to work in morning and come back in evening and do whatever she wants. I wish I could live her life” as I was thinking to myself, someone from my back said, “ Jennie, its late already, you need to go to sleep.” I turned around to find my sister standing there giving me a soft gaze. “I will, now, but why are you up so late? You are supposed to sleep now Lisa” I said. “I saw the light of your room on, so I came to check” she replied. “Whatever, you can go now” I said to her in a careless tone. As she went, I slept. I rubbed my eyes, yawning the next morning. As I opened my eyes and came to my senses, I screamed at the top of my lungs, as I got up from the bed I realized that I was in Lisa’s body. I panicked and rushed towards the bathroom, after seeing myself in this way. I ran towards the door. I was just about to open it and go when I heard a soft and angelic voice calling my name from behind, “Jennie, hold on, wait a minute." door. I was just about to open it and go when I heard a soft and angelic voice calling my name from behind, “Jennie, hold on, wait a minute." I turned back to find an adult woman with some sparkling clothes standing behind me. “Hi, who are you? and how did you enter my room? and how do you know my name? and do you….” Before I could complete my sentence, the woman said “ Calm down, I know you have a lot of questions in your mind, but hear me out first, we have always noticed you complaining about your current age, so today you and your sister have switched places so that you can experience her life too, you will be normal tomorrow so good luck”. “ But wait! I...” Before I could say anything, he disappeared. Accepting this sudden fact, I got ready and went to work. I was pretty much excited as it was one of my dream to grow up as an adult. As I reached, I went in my cabin while greeting everyone on the way and started to work. After a while, I turned my eye towards someone calling me, “hey Lisa, how are you?” said Jin standing at a distance from me. I stood up and hugged him and replied,“ I am good”. “So, I’ll see you at the meeting about our new project in a while” he said and went away as I nodded. I started completing the work I had got. With every passing minute, I realized how difficult it actually was for me to be an adult. Suddenly my telephone rang and a shrill voice spoke from other side “Hello, Mr. Kim speaking, am I talking to Ms. Lisa" “Yes, you are, please go ahead” I said, “Actually we want our project files for investment to be mailed to us by today evening” “Today evening!?” I gasped, “Yes, is something wrong?" he asked, “No no, everything is okay, the files will be given to you on time.”, “Thank you!” He said and hung up. I started working on those files immediately. I sighed in relief after sending the files to Mr. Kim. I looked at the clock only to find out that it was already 7:00 pm. I immediately started working on other files. I gave out an exhausting sigh as I looked at the clock, only to know that it was 11:00 pm. I went home and freshened up I started thinking that being an adult isn’t as enjoyable as I thought it was. Everything that happened comes with its own responsibility. We need to work on everything, I even have to change myself and my attitude towards approaching things as my age grows and people see me as an entirely new person and expect a lot as an adult. I started thinking that being an adult isn’t s enjoyable as I thought. Everything that happened comes with its own responsibility. Handling so many things at a time, carrying responsibilities, compromising, working long hours, dealing with clients and much more is very difficult. This experience gave a positive impact on me and made me realize my future responsibilities and prepare mindset for it. This also made me realize that things happen to us right when they are supposed to. So we should wait for the right time before doing anything to avoid losses and focus and what we have currently and learn from it as much as possible, I slept with a satisfied mind thanking God for this meaningful and challenging experience.

title: WHAT'S GREATER THAN EIFFEL TOWER?
text: It was a bright and sunny morning. Robert, Stephanie and baby George were getting ready to go on a vacation to France. They were busy running around, grabbing a bite of breakfast and packing their bags. "Get ready fast Stephanie, we are running out of time.", shouted Robert. "Okay, Okay I'm trying. Don't scream and make me tensed.", replied Stephanie with her cute voice. " While I'm getting ready, can you please take care of George? Also add pedigree to Jimmy's bowls. So that he can have it now. I've packed the rest of his bags. Let him have it now. I don't have time to feed it." she continued. "Alright. But get ready fast. We just have one hour left." said Robert picking up 10 month old George who was on all fours exactly like its best friend Jimmy. Robert got busy dressing up George, feeding Jimmy and throwing out the trash. After some time, they bought both got out of the house. Robert locked the door and in a hurry rushed to the taxi which was already parked by the roadside. "Atlast! we are out!" This was exciting. They started planning what they'll do in France and how much fun they will have. Robert, I want a beautiful dress from France and I have heard that their bread is so tasty. "Yes, So I also want to taste that Steph", Stephanie said to Robert, who started calculating about the expenses and plans. They reached the Airport soon. Everything was alright till check-in. As the ground- staff pampered the little kid, they were all laughing. Suddenly Stephanie screamed out at the top of her voice "Robert, Where is Jimmy?" They could not leave Jimmy alone in the Apartment for 10 days. It would be dangerous. Suddenly the joy turned into tension. They couldn't do anything now. Otherwise they would have to go through the whole process again and they thought about the huge monetary loss if they cancel or postpone the trip. "Let's take a risk this time. Anyways I've filled his bowls with Pedigree.", said Robert. They decided to carry on with their journey. France was amazing. Two days they traveled throughout Paris. Even though they were enjoying the trip to Eiffel Tower and Sacre-Coeur, Jimmy was always in their minds. It actually diminished their full joy. On the third day, their came a WhatsApp call. It was Aunt Rori. "Robert, you need to come home fast, there has been a fire in your floor which has been put off, but you need to come and check.", Aunty wasn't sounding well at all. They packed up all their things and rushed back. Their heart was pumping hard. Poor Jimmy. If only they had taken him along. In a few hours they reached home. Robert hurriedly took out the key as they reached down. The guard said, "No need for the key sir, the door has burned down." They ran upstairs, to their sweet home. " Yes the door was partially burned and they could easily squeeze inside. Almost all clothes and papers became ashes. "Jimmy, Jimmy", they called out. He was nowhere to be found. They were disheartened. Stephanie sat down on the floor, with little George. Jimmy was nowhere in the house. Suddenly, a feeble voice came from somewhere. It was so light that they started searching again. Jimmy, Jimmy... and there it came again. They rushed to the window shade outside. There it was, our beautiful Jimmy. He was having burnt marks on him and so tired. But atleast it was safe. They rushed with Jimmy to the Vet Hospital. On the way back they looked at each other and smiled. That smile was brighter and bigger than the Eiffel tower. They were so happy that Jimmy was alive. And they were happy that they were all together again. So, what is bigger than Eiffel Tower? The happy and loving smile of a family.
author: Ansh Lakhera
