title: The Woman
text: I sigh and take a deep breath as I descend the ramp of the asylum. This is the day of my first salary, and I am already exhausted. I still remember the day when my life was changed, the day an angel came to rescue me from the wrath of poverty. I used to live in a slum in Mumbai, and my parents were working in odd jobs like selling flowers and cleaning houses. We found it hard to manage our lives with the meagre wages, but we accomplished leading a decent life without facing any difficulty until I came of age to be sent to school. I was a curious child since birth, and I was always interested in learning new things. We had a few loans provided by the government, but they proved to be ineffective in admitting me to a school, due to my disability. I met with an accident in my childhood, rendering my legs useless and making me needy of a wheelchair, which was provided by the government. All the schools lacked ramps due to the remoteness of our area, and it was very hard for me to find a suitable option for my education. It was then decided that I be home-schooled by my neighbor, who had some basic education. I was disappointed, but there was no room for comfort. Life was bland. It was the same routine every day – helping my parents, going to the neighbor’s house, and coming back home. Until one day. I will never be able to forget her, the angel who came to my doorstep, opening a door that seemed forever closed to me. It seemed to be a normal day when I was in my teens, and I was thinking about what I should cook for my parents when I heard a knock at the door. Realizing both my parents were at work, I washed my hands and rode my wheelchair to answer the door. It was a plump woman with quite a friendly face, smiling at me. ‘Is it Anvi?’ she asked. I nodded, wondering how she knew my name, since by looking at her attire, and her car nearby that she definitely wasn’t from around here. I found it surprising that the car even fit in our narrow streets, and I was thinking why this woman took the trouble to travel all the way here. I welcomed her in, gave her a glass of water, and stared at the way she carefully pulled out an envelope from her expensive pouch, with long, careful fingers. She handed me the envelope, saying that she was from an NGO, a private organization aimed at providing the unprivileged a chance at education. She explained that she had observed my life and aimed to provide the specially abled like me admission at special schools. I remember the joy that followed after she left and the glint of hope in my parents’ eyes as they read the envelope containing information about the special schools. The next few days went in a hurry, as I had to prep for school. The joy I experienced on my first day of school can never be forgotten. They provided me with suitable arrangements for travelling in my wheelchair and fitted special features to make operating it easier. I studied fairly well, earning myself a degree in psychology and becoming a psychiatrist. I call a taxi, breaking from my trail of thoughts, and aid myself to the seat. I still have four appointments left, but I think that I deserve a break. I am dropped at my favourite park, just a few minutes' drive from the asylum. I take a few rounds and ride back to the asylum, a cup of coffee in my hands. My next patient is a man in his late forties, affected by a mild case of Alzheimer’s. Almost immediately after his appointment, I get a phone call from my roommate, Lucy. ‘There’s a parcel for you. You might want to see it since it’s…. strange,’ she says. She sounds dubious as I've rarely had any visitors since the time we lived together the past five years, let alone gifts. I've gotten used to Lucy’s routines, preferences, and tastes. She is sweet and caring and has always aided me with my problems. She is adopted, and her only remaining family is her ailing mother, in an asylum herself, though I never had the opportunity to see her. I promise to return quickly, glad for an excuse to leave work early. I am not lazy, but today has got me feeling really tired. I keep thinking what the gift might be, throughout the ride and feel quite curious to see what it is. I carefully get down from the car, thank my driver, and quickly ride my wheelchair to the escalator, now really curious to see the gift. I knock on the door to get an immediate response, with Lucy, still in her police uniform, frowning at a pouch. I recognize the pouch almost straight away. It is the same pouch the woman from the NGO had, with a big A embroidered on the front. I am taken back immediately, and I smile, taking the pouch in my hands, and recount the story to Lucy. She is about to tell me something when her phone rings. She mumbles an excuse and goes to her room. I fiddle with the pouch, and find a note attached to it. I am about to open it when Lucy comes out of the room, looking grave. ‘She left me’ she says and starts to weep. I am filled with a momentary sense of confusion, and it takes a while for me to recognize that she is talking about her mother. I try to soothe her, and she informs me that she wants to see her for the last time. I feel guilty since I have never seen her, and never made an effort to know about her well-being. She drives me to the asylum, an ancient building very different from the one I work in. The room is on the third floor, and all the wards are situated right opposite each other bearing their ward numbers. We hurry quickly to the ward and open the door. There is a nurse there, standing next to the bed. She informs us that only one visitor is allowed and so I allow Lucy to go first. I sit near the door and start to read the note I found in the bag. It was written in neat handwriting, the font the same as the one in the envelope given to me years ago. Dear Anvi, I hope you remember me and this bag. So much has changed since that day, hasn’t it? Well, how are you now? I've heard that you have become a psychiatrist? I just want to let you know that I am so proud of you. Since the moment our team chose you, I could see your potential. Now you must be wondering how I got to know all of this. I think you will find that out yourself in a few minutes, forgive me for the suspense. Now I will be in the place of the gods, and I have written this letter to convey my last wishes to you. My daughter is a very determined and kind girl, but I think that you alone are fit for this job, being experienced. I want you to take my place in the lives of many children and be the light for them. I want you to be the cause of the smile of each and every unprivileged child and watch them soar. This is my only last wish, and I hope and know that you will fulfil it. Let my daughter know that I love her. Regards, Amy I am almost about to comprehend the letter when the door opens. I think I know what I am about to see. It still shocks me, and I feel tears burning at the back of my eyes. She seems to be in a peaceful slumber, with her eyes closed and her face looking the same since I saw her 21 years ago. ‘You know, she too worked for an NGO’ Lucy says and we both hold each other and cry for the woman who left an everlasting impact in our lives.
author: Sharanya Navuda
illustrator: Gieve Patel; Kripa B; Shivam Choudhary; Sudhir Patwardhan

title: It's A Lovely Day
text: It was a lovely day. Amu and her friends met at the local park. They called themselves Fable Friends. Because they loved reading and creating happy fables! What fable would they create today? Amu began a fable, "One day The Black Smoke Monster told all the people in the world that it would soon cover the beautiful earth with its dark, dirty and dangerous smoke!" Bebu continued, "Everyone was scared." Sur added, "Everywhere, people were talking only about the black smoke monster." It was Peepul's turn next to continue the fable. "Then, grown ups remembered their wise old grandmothers and ancestors. They realized, the more trees they planted, and more they covered their world with greenery, the black smoke monster would grow weaker and weaker." Young Taal added, "And that is exactly what every family in the world started doing. They planted saplings, protected trees, gifted plants and did whatever they could to keep their surroundings green." "And the beautiful greenery saved the beautiful world from the Black Smoke Monster!" Chorused the children happily. "We created a nice fable! It is a lovely day!" smiled Amu. What do you think?
author: Shahin Ashraf Ali

title: Sona Creates Happiness
text: Where ever Sona goes, she creates happiness. Sona smiles and greets people when she meets them. Smiles make people happy. Greeting people make them happy. Sona creates happiness! Sona helps her friends to study. When friends help each other they feel happy. Sona creates happiness. At meal times, Sona tells the family what fun she had during the day. The family enjoys listening to her. Sona creates happiness. Sona tries to think of games that all friends can play together. Children enjoy playing with Sona. Sona creates happiness. Sona is kind towards animals, birds and trees. Kindness makes everyone happy. Sona creates happiness. Sona offers to help whenever she can. Helping others make them happy. Sona creates happiness where ever she goes. How do you create happiness? List down the things you can do to make happiness. When you make happiness, the world becomes that much happier!!!
author: Shahin Ashraf Ali

title: Change in Heart
text: Yes Jordan is a poacher. And he became so because he knew no other job. They were in Jordan's house presently. "Nothing special." Said Jordan in a tired tone. "What happened?" Asked Jay. Jordan said sadly “I am having a near crisis. There have been no calls for poaching. No deals to make. No places to go for poaching." Jay frowned" What are you talking about? There are plenty of place here in Cameroon." "Don't be stupid. All those places are strictly prohibited to go because of increase in poaching here. The Korup National Park has tightened their security. Making it almost impossible for a poacher to hunt down the animals." Said Jordan in a voice where Jay could not understand if he was cool or angry. Okay then just changes your place of hunting. Find a new place where all the most endangered animals are present." Jay said in a cool tone. Now Jordan was totally losing his patience. “Well you might as well know that the Korup National Park has the Red Columbus Monkey. The prizes are rising in the Black marker for it. We could make an eye popping profit if we get it. But as I said it is hard." Jordan said. Now Jay was thinking. He rubbed his head and then said “Okay then. I will fix up a meeting with one of my friends who lives near the national park. Maybe I can make a situation for you to go there and hunt the Red Columbus Monkey. But we will have to pay him. What do you say?" Jordan agreed immediately. The one and only thing he needed now is money and he will do anything for it. Jay said that he will call him when the deal is fixed and then left the house. Jordan sighed and got up and went to the kitchen to make something for him. Jordan lived all alone. He had a very small friend circle but most of them were related to illegal trading of things. He is a poacher. But he didn't wanted to. He is forced to by his father. His mother died when he was 12. His father since then began to do illegal things. And poaching was one of them. He has tried to run away but couldn't. In fact he is a person who is not an animal hater nor an animal lover. Or we can say he does loves animals and while killing them always says sorry in his mind. But what was the use. He made him some noodles and started eating them. While eating he had a sudden thought about himself. a sudden covet of being a different person. But only for a fraction of second. It soon went away when he thought about his father.There is no escaping him. He then went out. It was night already. The starts were shimmering and the moon in center. He didn't know why but today's night was more bright and beautiful than the previous ones. He stared at the sky. He felt good. A cool breeze blew. It relaxed him. That's when he saw a dog. It looked beautiful but dirty. Jordan usually doesn’t give much attention to animals. People think poachers do not give mercy to animals. It is true but to ones that give them profit and Jordan was one of them. A dog cannot do anything. Jordan gave him some food from inside. The dog ate it greedily. The dog looked at him; its eyes were shimmering as if it was saying thank you to him. Sudden warmth spread in him. He smiled back too. He got some more food from the kitchen and gave it. The dog ate and then wiggled its tail happily. Jordan gave it a little pat "Goodnight kiddo” And went inside. In the morning he called Jay but he was not picking the phone. He thought maybe the deal was a fail or Jay is doing it on purpose. The day passed as usual. He went for a walk at night. While walking he felt that something was following him. He looked back but didn't saw anything. As he walked he saw a group of gangsters there. They saw him. Jordan tried to ignore but they pulled him. "Where you going huh?" One of them said in a harsh tone. “Leave me." Jordan said. But they didn't. Soon they started hitting him. Jordan tried to escape but he couldn't. As they hit him he was getting weak. Suddenly a group of dogs came there and started biting the lives out of the gangsters. Jordan looked up and saw the same dog that he gave food to was there with his friends. He noticed one thing, they were not biting him. The dog came to him and licked him at face.He smiled. It wagged it's tail happily. He patted it's head. It looked at his eyes directly as telling him " You are safe." Time passed, and Jordan got out of the grips of his father somehow. And Jordan from a poacher became a protector of animals. He now works in Korup National park and saves animals. He realized that a small act is enough to see the kindness that lies below. He became one of the greatest animal protectors of animals and said his story to millions. Inspired by them many poachers changed. This truly shows that every living thing has kindness in it. And sometimes small acts are enough to unfold the kindness that lies below.

title: The White Elephant
text: The Bodhisattva was born as a white elephant in a remote Himalayan forest when King Brahmadatta was ruling over the kingdom of Varanasi. He grew up in the forest along with other baby elephants. As he grew older, the white elephant realised that he was different from his companions who were often mean and selfish. One day, he left the herd to live on his own. He thought, "i don't really belong here. So i have to leave." The white elephant began to live apart from the herd. He was happy and at peace. All the other animals which lived in the jungle respected him and often came to him seeking his advice. The elephant taught them to live in peace and harmony. One day, a man who was proceeding to Varanasi through the forest, lost his way. The white elephant noticed him and followed behind him. At first, the man was frightened thinking that it would trample him to death. When he realised that the elephant had no intention of harming him, he lost his fear. To his surprise, the elephant spoke to him. It said "You seem to be lost. Can I help you?" The man replied, "Yes, can you help me find the way to Varanasi?" The elephant took the man to its cave and made him rest for a while. It gave him some fruits to eat and water to drink. When the man felt sufficiently rested, the elephant left him on the outskirts of the forest bordering Varanasi and left after telling him not to divulge its haunts to other men. The man made his way to Varanasi. While there, he went to a shop selling ivory artifacts and inquired about the price of ivory. Hearing that ivory from a live elephant would fetch a good price, the man was overcome by greed. He decided to sell the white elephant's tusks and become rich. He had memorized the way to the elephant's cave so he had no difficulty in finding it. On seeing him, the elephant greeted him warmly. Then the man told the elephant, "Please help me, my friend. I need your tusks to pay off my debts." ﻿ The kind animal graciously allowed him to cut off its tusks. The man sold them in Varanasi for a good price but still he was not satisfied. So he went back to the white elephant and said, "I need more money." The elephant told him to take what was left of its tusks. The greedy man cut close to the flesh to get the rest. He left the elephant there in pain and agony but it did not complain at all. He had only walked a few paces when the ground gave way under his feet. The earth was torn asunder and a blazing fire swallowed him up. Then he heard a celestial voice. It said, "Ungrateful man, this is what you get for your greed!" The greedy man perished, punished by the gods for his twin sins of greed and ingratitude. As for the white elephant, he recovered and lived the rest of his life peacefully in the solitude of the Himalayan. Moral Don't let greed consume you.
author: Smaranika Jena

title: Arya's Birthday Gift
text: It was a bright morning. I was really excited because I was going for shopping with my mom. I wanted to buy a remote control car as a birthday gift. But my dad said, "You have to buy girly stuff like a kitchen set. I got confused and asked mom, "Mom what is girly stuff?" "Arya, girly stuffs are things that a girl likes", replied Mom. "So Mom a remote control car is girly stuff?" I asked. "No beta, it is not... But let's discuss this later otherwise the toy shop will close" replied Mom. "Yes, mom! It will be so much fun!" I replied bursting with excitement. We both walked to Ramu Kaka's shop. He was the person who was always in a good mood. I was his great friend. He thought that I would probably buy a kitchen or barbie set. He was quite shocked when I told him that I wanted a remote control car. When he showed it, I was fascinated. The car was more beautiful than I thought. Mom tried to tell me that I would be scolded by Dad, if I buy the car. I didn't listen and still took it. On the way home, I realized that I made a mistake. "Once we were at home, I saw that dad was sitting in the living room which was just in front of the main gate. He asked me about what I bought. "Oh, D- Dad I bought a remote c- control car," I said nervously. "Didn't I tell you to buy a kitchen set?" yelled Dad. My eyes were filled with tears. "You don't go to school like your brother. So, stop comparing. You should know how to cook!" he yelled again. "But dad, why doesn't he learn to cook?" I asked. "He doesn't need to learn cooking! He is a boy! Go to your room now" he replied. I ran to my room and started doing some work. When I was done, I asked Mom if I could go to play. She agreed, so I went to the playground and saw a group of boys playing cricket. I walked up to them. All the boys tried to avoid me when one came forward and said, "You are a girl. Go play with those girls over there". "But I want to play cricket and I am really good at it" I replied. "We don't care just go to those girls," He said. All the boys started screaming and I came back home. I started helping mom in kitchen. She taught me the recipe of curry rice because it was my favorite food. After some time, Dad came out of his room still looking angry. He picked up the remote control car and gave it to Mithun. Mithun is my younger brother and the naughtiest. His hobbies are to play cricket, annoy me and to get me scolded from Mom and Dad. Mithun started playing with the car. I asked him if I could play with him but he denied. Mom came in and told Mithun to leave for a minute. After Mithun left, she told me that she had been saving up. She saw that I p layed Cricket very well and wanted me to learn from a coach. She told me that Dad didn’t know anything so I have to keep this as a secret. She enrolled me in an academy where I went regularly for lessons. I became the captain of the academy’s cricket team. Now, I played much better so I decided to tell Dad. He was unhappy at first but after some days, he encouraged me. After many competitions, I was selected for the Indian women’s cricket team. We played a lot of matches. Later, we played the world cup too. We didn’t win but participating in the world cup. It was a great experience for the whole team. My whole family was really happy and proud of me. My story taught that it doesn’t matter if it is a boy or a girl. They both are human being, so we should not treat them differently. We should encourage girls to come forward.

title: Mr Firesnow
text: It was unusual. I was in a forest – and a dense, dark, damp, dingy one. That was unusual enough. After all, it couldn't be every day I ventured into a forest and forgot the way back, and roamed around aimlessly through the woods. And just then, the most unusual thing of all possibilities happened. A big lump of snow jumped out of the bush ('How's it been able to stay ice and snow in there?' I thought). No, I looked closely at it, and it wasn't, not a snowball, at least, but whatever it was, I didn't know. I bent in closer still, and then I flinched. No – it definitely wasn't a snowball. It was something white, yes, but something furry, something fuzzy, something winged, something small, something very tiny, and something that breathed – breathed fire. Something alive! It was a snow dragon, and it was breathing out hot, fiery fumes. I remembered reading in a newspaper once: ' Snow dragons are furry, white, adorable little creatures who mean no harm to anyone and whose fire affects nothing but snow. They might look like threateningly fire-breathing lumps of snow, but they aren't! ' And I tried to convince myself with that as reasoning. But even newspapers won't seem trustworthy enough when you're face-to-snout with a dragon, whether fiery or snowy or sandy or scaly or mountainous or plateau-ey or of whatever sort. "All right," I said aloud, half addressing myself and half addressing the dragon, "I shall move on now and leave you" – to the dragon – “here, of course; I can't take you along. Um, well, goodbye, little – uh, dragon." And I didn't look back at the dragon as I moved on and left it behind. As dusk drew in, as the sky grew dark, as the creatures of the day fell silently to sleep and as those of the night creeped out while it got dark, I saw a little speck of light in the distance. And no one but me could have told of the pleasure one speck of light gives when one has been in a dark forest all day and when the dusk seems relentless. The next morning, I woke up and looked around in surprise. Then my senses advised me to recall, and when I did, the feeling of sudden surprise vanished. Of course, I was there; I had gone up to that beautiful little cottage, and the kind lady had taken me in for the night. I had been terrified to see the same little baby dragon at her home; she had then told me they really were harmless and she had lost her 'pet'; she had been looking for him and had found him injured, helpless and alone. I had, of course, felt slight guilt, but it wasn't my fault I didn't know dragons could be harmless. Anyway, we were to go to the police station that day, and I was finally to return home! I wonder if I shall ever be able to find a moment in all my life when thinking of either of the words 'adventure' and 'dragon' shall not travel me into the past and plunge me into memories of little Mr Firesnow.

title: A Typical Day in 2040
text: Helena woke up to a rather annoying nerve-clock this morning. She regretted implanting that neural-alarm inside of her, she just wished to be like her mother during the older time and have a collection of destroyed alarm clocks.. "Open the curtains Pixiv", the curtains slowly revealed a skyscraping building with a gorgeous view of the sunrise in front of her. She sighed and proceeded to brush her teeth. Toothbrushes were sadly the same with the exception of better yet softer quality bristles as well as all of them being electrical and toothpastes actually providing dazzling white teeth ever since the "False advertising case" in 2026. She came downstairs to see a scrumptious breakfast awaiting her prepared by the home-cook. "Good morning lady Helena, may I treat you to some nutritious breakfast prepared by me?" said Henry the chef in a monotonous tone. "Thanks Henry and Good Morning to you too" replied Heila as she began eating her breakfast. Meanwhile her mom and dad came downstairs as if they slept way later than they should've, "You both doing okay? Last I saw you both were on your devices with dad watching football and mom typing away at her novel. Don't tell me you both did it aga-". Her mother nodded and Helena quietly resumed her breakfast and asked Henry to prepare 2 more plates. After breakfast, her father left for work and her mother went back to her room working on her novel again. Helena's father was a businessman who dealt in nanotech smart glasses, while her mother was a novelist and a successful writer. She never really got time with both, it has been like this since she's been a small child, her parents were always too busy to give her attention and she grew up all by herself. She received a call from her friend Janiece after a short while, "Did you finish your homework? Clive will call our parents if we don't finish this assignment by tomorrow. Let's not get ourselves killed shall we?" Partners in crime, partners in projects, but separate in rewards, but their friendship has always been prime. They were the best of friends, although they lived in entirely separate countries together, they were classmates of 10th Division R, their teacher Clive was an A.I that taught them all core subjects in a humorous manner. Helena loved Clive, he was a strict teacher but a soft artificial life who cared about his students. Many times he's managed to scare the living daylights out of the nuisances of trespassers in online semesters. joined the semester at 10 AM, it was Geography, Clive made sure by dropping good puns during Geography for which he received amazing feedback by the students. Today's class was about the ocean and how it has increased immensely over the past decade. Kenan, a student who forgot to turn off his mic during class and was arguing with his brother, was heard by the entire class and eventually by Clive. "Kenan, I believe your brother will be the reason you will drown, as your grades are below C-level" The class roared with laughter including Helena who was chuckling behind her screen. After about 4 hours of dragging semesters, Helena decided to work on the project Clive had given her. The topic of the assignment was "Write an essay if you were a boy/girl in the year 2022" Helena saw this, she felt excited as she could finally have a small bonding moment with her mother. At 7:30 PM, she entered her mother's room, her mother was working on the novel she had been writing for the past month. "Mother, can we talk?" "Sure sweet Helena! Come in, just close the door behind as you do" Helena walked in the room, unsure of how to start the conversation but overwhelmed with joy. "What was life like in 2022?" "Hm… I am sure it's about your project. But I was waiting when you'd ask me about my childhood…or well my teenage-hood.. But life as you know it, was vastly different. We attended buildings called schools, we didn't have Mr Clive, Henry or Marc as you do today. We prepared our own food, boy it was surely horrific to taste it. We had plenty of friends as well, we often partied together and visited each other as we lived nearby unlike today where your closest friend is in London while you are in Washington D.C. Honestly I was such a dummy in Mathematics, numbers always blew off my head but I was an ace in English and Social Studies. Oh and if you wanna hear about a nightmare, we didn't have flying cars, but we had a sort-of life savior, Google. I forgot to tell you about an important thing. In 2020, the entire world was affected by a pandemic, named Covid or Corona, but it was a virus, I can't completely recall. During that time, all public places were closed, we could never go anywhere so we had something similar to what you call school nowadays, except instead of an AI we had a human teaching us." "A...human? That's odd, humans rivaling AI in knowledge?" Replied Helena "Sweetie, who made AI?" Helena was speechless and had no answer. Helena asked more and more, she became more curious with each story her mother told. Time flew as they both grew closer, it soon flashed to Helena that she was enjoying a beautiful moment with her mother, something she longed ever since she was a child. It was 10 PM by the time the two finished, Helena entered her room silently and began typing away at her computer that was integrated on the desktop of her table. The table projected a hologram which was the screen of the computer. As she typed her essay, a tear, not of sadness but happiness as she worked on the project. The next day, during semester Clive was talking about an individual's essay, at first Helena was uninterested and was dozing off as she had slept way late last night. As a result she didn't have time to do her hair and it remained frizzy when she woke up and joined class. Clive suddenly called Helena… "Helena!" Helena nearly fell off her chair, "Yes Mr Clive!" "Out of the 567469 essays I received today, I read yours and I must say… For an artificial life with feelings, yours has touched my heart made up of wires" Helena was in awe of the moment, another tear fell from her eyes. She couldn't believe his words. In a soft, kind tone she said "Thank you Mr Clive…" Helena deeply thought the entire day, all about life in the past, she really wished for time travel to be possible. Helena just couldn't help but keep smiling the whole day, later she planned to talk to her father when he returned home. Her mother smiled looking at her daughter, who had changed from a lifeless doll to an energetic human. "I can't wait to talk to Dad" Helena told herself later in the day...

title: Zack and his Robotic Car
text: Zack was a little boy of 11 who was a fast learner. He had just shifted to a new apartment, so he had no friends and was very lonely. Nobody wanted to play with him. One day, the children were playing with RC cars in the playground where they had a racing track. Zack asked them, "Can I play with you?" They replied, "Do you even have a car?" He was sad as he had no RC car. At home he asked his father, "Daddy can you get me an RC car?" His father replied, "Last year I bought you a robotic kit, why don't you use it with Gramps help." Gramps was a great retired engineer. Zack called Gramps and told him about his wish. Gramps started looking at the kit, but it was difficult for Zack, so Gramps taught him the basics about motors, resistors and everything Zack needed to know. They started making the car out of the robotic kit. The robotic kit had some electric and non-electric components. Gramps said that they needed a base to attach the components on. When they took the base out of the robotic kit, it was broken. Now they were thinking what to do and then Zack's mother came in the room with some snacks. She asked, "What're you doing?" "We're making a robotic car, but the base of the car is broken" replied Zack. For that you can use the base of your old toy car. "Mommy that is a great idea!" exclaimed Zack. He brought his first toy car, which was as old as Zack and its wheels were broken. Gramps opened it piece by piece. He took the base and cut some holes in it. They fixed the components on the car base. The components were a microcontroller, a lot of jumper wires, a mini breadboard, a Bluetooth, a motor driver which was attached to the motors. There also was a battery. Now they had to attach the body and wheels. Zack said that he wanted big wheels so his car can go fast! Before attaching the car's body, they painted it blue with red racing stripes. Now, the only thing left was making the robotic hydraulic arm. That was a hard part to do. Voila! The car was completed. Zack named his car RCZ. RCZ was splendid and ready for the test drive. He took RCZ out to the racing track and tested it, but it went too slow. He took it back home and asked Gramps, "What is wrong with my car?" Gramps replied, "We will have to check." They checked the code the car had. It had very less motor movement per second, so they increased the speed and took it out for testing. Yippy! This time it worked just fine. Zack took RCZ to the children, they started bullying him. But he did not care and said, "Now even I have an RC car." They told him, "You can only play with us if you beat us in an obstacle car race." So, they started racing through the track. Zack was using the robotic hand of his car to remove the obstacles on the way. He won the race, and all the children were impressed by RCZ. Its features had stunned them. The robotic arm...fast speed...the racing design...it was just too good!!! And more, Zack made it himself. They all just had to be his friends. Soon they all became his friends. Zack was overwhelmed with joy. This is the moment he had waited for long. He went home after saying bye to his friends. He told his family everything. Mommy, Daddy and Gramps, all were proud of him.
author: Viyaan Agarwal

title: War and Peace
text: Once upon a time, there was a boy who was very creative. He loved to draw and craft weapons from paper. He was very fond of the army and patriotism was in his blood. His father was defeated in the battle of the Indo-Chinese war when he was only four. He was twelve now and all he wanted was to take revenge. It had almost been 4 years since he hadn't come out of his house and had not made any friends All he did was walk to school, and from school back home. He had no friends at all not even in his school. All his classmates called him the 'loner’. He was very fond of art and in his art the class he always used to make weapons, and everything he made was of red colors, and the theme was always war. He spent his childhood thinking about war and weapons. One day when he was taking his dinner his mother asked him why he likes to live alone. In that instance, he left the dinner and went to his bedroom without answering her. His mother was quite worried for him. The very next day when he was in the school washroom, someone poured a bucket full of water on him. He was completely soaked. This raged him. Holding the boy by his color, tore his shirt, boxed him in his face. The boy was injured. His nose was bleeding and one of his front teeth had gone missing. The boy went to the principal office and complained about him. His mother was summoned by the school. As a result, the boy got suspended from school for a week. This turned out to be a great twist in his life. That moment he decided to be the most powerful man in the world and teach these bullies a lesson. After this incident, his ideologies changed. Now, for him army was just for the nation; he wanted to rule the world. He wanted everyone to fear him. He told his mother: "I want to rule the world, want everyone to fear me.” “But why do you want so?” She asked quite amused by his son’s words. “Because this is my aim that every person to be afraid of me.” Scoffing at his words she concluded, "You go and sleep, you're becoming weird day by day.” The boy went to his room and slept. But he could never get a blink of rest. Nor could he get rid of his plan from his mind- Days became weeks and weeks into months and months passed to years. 20 years later, he lost his mother. Now he was 32, a handsome, young man with a great muscular body. As he had dreamt of the people of the town feared him. He indulged into unsocial activities like - Kidnapping, Murder, Extortion. And had earned a new name "Munna Bhau", everyone called him “Bhau” He was now a very dangerous man. But the Kids were fond of him and loved him because of his good looks and style. His habit of indulging in fights. Where ever he went, fights followed him, be it the normal people or the politician every one tried to stay away from him. One day he heard of a man in the news. That man used to motivate people and resolve all their problems. He decided to go to him and check whether it is true or just a rumor. He went to the person the very next morning but there was a long queue before his house. Everyone knew him that's why they gave him the way. But one man didn't move. Bhau held his collar and pushed the person away. Bhau kicked him and told him to go back. That person moved away in fear. Bhau entered the hut and asked the guru how can he be as powerful. The Guru told him to always see the green everywhere. Bhau ordered his people to color everywhere green. The boys agreed and painted the place, cars, and jeeps green - All his clothes were dyed green. This cost him a lot of money. A few weeks passed but his impression among the people had not changed a bit. Bhau was confused and after a month he went to the Guru again. But when the guru woke up early in the morning, he was shocked to see that everything was colored green. Suddenly his eyes moved towards the gate he saw some boys wearing green entering the gate. He asked them what was the problem, and why everywhere was green. The boys replied that Bhau was coming and he told to them to color the whole hut. Guru understood the situation, that moment Bahu entered. He asked Guru why didn't he become the most powerful man in the world. Guru smiled and replied, “Everyman in the world. is Powerful on his own". Bhau was confused and asked, "HOW?” Guru replied that the war is not a wait for getting power. Peace is the way to happiness. War makes people fear but peace can get you respect.” Bhau replied, still confused “ If it was that simple, then why did you ask me to see green everywhere? That cost me a lot of money.” “See how your mind has become,” Guru answered with a smile. “This is how a negative mind works. All you had to do was buy a green glass worth Rs. 100 and the entire world would go green for you, my snorty.” Bhau was quite surprised to be called by this name, a name his father always teased him with when he was a child. That was when he came to know that the Guru was his father’s friend. That day Bhau understood that war and fights were not the only way to power. But Peace is the actual Power. A power you can win over people with love. And live with a happy mind.
author: Piush Jaiswal
illustrator: Anjali Kamat; Bhargavi Rudraraju; Harshika G; Kabini  Amin; Manisha Naskar; Rhea Nandy; Sandhya Prabhat; Shanti Devi; Shivam Choudhary; Shrujana Shridhar

title: Reunion of Friends
text: I couldn't sleep all the way on the flight to Kolkata thinking what will happen tomorrow. After 10 long years, I was finally going to meet my early childhood friends. All that I was feeling was nervousness and excitement. My heart was bursting with happiness. Just waiting for the new day to begin, lost in old memories, I slept as soon as I reached home. It was when my alarm rang that I woke up. I compared this feeling to that when I waited for my PTM to start in school after the exams. I was dancing around, singing songs and I was doing everything that engaged me to remain happy. I was so indulged in my thoughts that I had no time to check out the time. It was already 10:30 AM and I had to meet all of them at 11 AM.I just went to the washroom and freshened up as soon as I could. Soon I am going to reach Kolkata. YAYY!!!!!! I put a little touch of makeup on my face and his send toward the door taking my house and car keys. I quickly started the car and I reached Bombay Shiv Sagar restaurant in a blink of an eye. Although the restaurant was at a distance of 15 minutes from my house, I was so excited that I reached there in a minute. Despite my pounding heart, with a little confidence, I stepped into the lift. Surprisingly, I still remembered the floor. How could I even forget? This was the place where we last met on my birthday before I shifted to Pune. I remembered every moment. Cherishing those memories in my mind, I had tears in my eyes. Zoooooooooooommmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmm!!!!!!! When I entered the restaurant, literally there was no one and all the lights were off. I thought, “Am I early or am I late? What is the time by the way? Oh! It's 11. I am not late. Is it not that the meeting is postponed and I am not aware? I don’t know.” I was really very perplexed. After a few seconds, the lights turned on suddenly and there was a scream, “ HAPPY BIRTHDAY GARGI!” I didn’t remember my own birthday. It was the same place and the same time - my birthday. They pranked me. They informed me the wrong date and the same day and I didn't notice. Instead they were secretly planning all the surprises. I told them wisely,” Now I understand. You all must have informed by parents about the surprise and that is the reason even they didn't wish me till now. How smart you guys are!” Saying this, I laughed. As soon as I was going towards them, they played the same song whose link I sent them during my last birthday with them, instead of the (HAPPY BIRTHDAY SONG). The song said - (YAARON DOSTI BADI HI HASEEN HAI). I couldn’t control my emotions. Immediately, I ran towards them and gave them a big hug. In fact, they booked the whole area in the restaurant so that there is no one else to disturb us and to cast an evil eye on our happiness. Now after so much, we finally sat down to have a conversation after such a long time. Happy Birthday Gargi!! So let me introduce all my friends to you— Avika, Advita, Maaz, Aryan and Janhavi. Janhavi asked, “So Garu (my nickname) how are you feeling??” I answered, “ I……….. I……. cannot express my feelings. I am so happy that I can’t tell you all.” Everybody including me smiled. Then I asked everyone, “Should we discuss our ambitions?” We looked at each other and nodded our heads. So I started, “You all already know that I want to be an IAS officer and a cardiologist. I always had a fixed ambition and this is my dream from my childhood. What about you all?” Maaz excitedly said, “I want to be an enthusiast gamer + a youtuber with millions of subscribers.” Avika continued, "I am preparing to become a NASA scientist.” Advita went on, “Hmm, I want to become the first person to travel the whole world.” “ OOHH! Niceee!” I said.Aryan continued, “I want to become a pilot as I always had great information about planes from my childhood.” Finally Janhavi said,” I have joined classes and I am learning fashion designing." After this discussion, we got to know each other's dreams and ambitions very well. Now we were feeling hungry so we ordered some snacks + some coke (OUR FAVOURITE!!) I noticed that they carried the mug I gifted them. All these moments made me so emotional that I was not able to control myself and I started crying. “ Why are you crying?”asked Avika. “ You all made me so emotional that I had to cry,” I said. Janhavi replied, “ This is just the starting, keep watching now.” We completed eating all our snacks and then Janhavi and Aryan went to the counter and were whispering something to the organizer and came back after a few minutes. Seeing their faces, I felt that they were waiting for something to happen. The staff brought a TV trolley and kept it in front of us. They also had a data projector. He played something using a remote. That was the best thing I had ever seen. It was a slideshow with all my childhood photos including the ones with my friends. It was so awesome that I can’t explain it to you. I was very delighted but this time I didn't cry. I said,” Wow! So many surprises! Are there more?” Avika replied,” No more surprises but yes there are games and gifts. ‘Oh!’, I said surprisingly. So now we started playing a game. In this game, everyone gets a piece of paper and there is a dice that you have to roll until you get 6. As soon as you get 6, you have a pen and you start writing numbers from 1 to 100. But there is only one pen. So the person who will start the game as soon as starts writing, the next one has to grab the dice and when he or she gets 6,they have to snatch the pen and start writing. This is how the game continued. This game tested the speed of writing and your luck on how fast you get 6 on the dice. We had a lot of fun the whole day. We played several games, danced to various songs and enjoyed ourselves a lot. This day was the best day of our lives. We are the six peas in a pod and we will stay together forever and ever. This is why one says, ” True friends are never apart, maybe in distance but never by heart. Also true friends never leave you in the course of life. They are always together in spirit.”
author: Gargi Dokania

title: Magnificent India
text: India, has always been a country of vast richness, heritage and diversity. There are numerous great stories of the bravado, wisdom and courage the people of India have. Yes, we cannot completely prove whether the stories are real or just a writer’s profound imagination but all we need is a little bit of proof and belief. Pedro Alvares Cabral, a Portuguese trader had come to India on 13th September 1500. Apart from being a trader, he was also a tourist. A man who was intrigued by the Indians culture and lifestyle. he set foot in India at a port in Calicut and he was astonished with India’s beauty. He always thought –‘A country with such lavish resources and culture is being hidden from the outside world and it deserves to be brought into light’ but he knew that he alone could never bring India to the light, because at the end of the day, the Portuguese were only interested in capturing this land and all he could do was explore it and admire it in secret. Travelling from place to place, he once arrives at a land in the north named Ajmer, present day Rajasthan. he seeks shelter at the home of a simple, pious farmer named Vasu. Vasu had a family. He had a wife named Avantika and 4 children. Three girls and a boy. All of them were between the ages of 10-15 Ajmer was a state that, at the time, was being ruled by the Chauhan king Hammir Dev. ‘How happy are you with your ruler?’ asks Pedro while eating his dinner with the family on the first day of his visit. He had learnt the Indian language well. Of course, you cannot hope to trade and travel a country without being able to communicate with them. ‘The king is like family to us!’ replies Vasu ‘Like family?’ asks Pedro ‘Yes, because a king who puts his people first is always admired by the people. but a king who treats his people as family and puts them first, is a king who is admired and treated as family by the people!’ ‘And your king is of that sort?’ Askes Pedro Vasu smiles and says ‘None of our rulers have disappointed us, Sire, as far as I remember!’ Pedro is confused now. ‘Vasu, how do you have this blind trust on your king? has he helped you personally in any way?’ ‘No!’ he says ‘But I have heard stories!’ ‘Stories?’ snorts Pedro ‘That is what I call blind belief, my friend. How can you be so sure that he has helped people in those stories?’ ‘Before I answer that, sire, tell me, do you know where milk is usually obtained from?’ asked Vasu ‘A..a cow?’ answers Pedro, hesitantly. ‘Yes, and have you ever milked one?’ Pedro was kind of understanding what Vasu was trying to say but plays along and shook his head. Then, how are you sure that cows give milk?’ asks Vasu, with a small grin on his face. Pedro gives up, not knowing what to say. But this answer had not quite convinced him. Pedro, the next day, seeks a meeting with the king and was not surprised when he received it right away. Even while being a great king, a sense of humbleness was always within most Indian king’s mind. ‘What bring you to my land, friend?’ Asks the king Hammir Dev, seated on his royal throne. The palace hadn’t shocked Pedro as he had seen even larger ones throughout the country but that also did not mean that it disappointed him. the grandeur of the palace was still one of the best he had seen, and of course the mind blowing architecture. I don’t have a specific answer to that. But I guess the I would ask you- why would I not come to this land? it’s a paradise!!’ he replies Hammir Dev smiles in a way befitted for a king and says ‘That it is! but why would you want to meet me?’ ‘To pass on a simple message’ says Pedro, trying to put on a serios face ‘My king wishes to conquer your land. well, not only mine. im sure you have heard of the new Muslim “Emperor” Babur who is trying overthrowing every king in India?’ Hammir just smiles and says ‘I am sure he is powerful’ ‘Who? my king or Babur?’ ‘Both!!’ ‘Aren’t you the least bit worried?’ Askes Pedro. ‘ For me? no! for my people? always! and I am taking precautions.’ says the king ‘For the war?’ ‘No…well, yes. that also! but for my people too!’ now, Pedro was interested. ‘What kind of precautions?’ he asks, straightening his posture. ‘I can’t tell you that my friend, you are an outsider!’ says the king bluntly. ‘Can I then ask you something regarding the upcoming war?’ asks Pedro ‘Sure!’ answers the king ‘What if you win the war?’ ‘I continue ruling!’ ‘And…who becomes the next ruler? You have no heir’ ‘I will find someone. Why can’t it be someone from my kingdom? A commoner…’ Ok…what if you lose the war?’ ‘My people will make sure that the new king does not have an unjust rule’ ‘Your people?’ grunts Pedro ‘Yes, I have prepared them. Not only I but all my ancestors have too. Even if I lose, they will be ready. The new king will have the men from this country in their court and they will be considered jewels of the kingdom’ ‘Are you so sure that whoever the new king is, will take them to be a part of their court?’ ‘Kings are not stupid. A worthy man is a worthy man and a good king will notice them. besides, our country is full of wise men!’ Pedro could not disagree to this and he was amazed at how Hammir Dev had an answer to all of his queries. ‘One last question, you have made preparation for losing? Is that befitted for a king?’ Hammir Dev takes a deep breath. ‘Change is inevitable. I am selfish if I say that my rule will last forever. I also cannot say that this kingdom will remain the way it is forever. But I can guarantee that my people will know peace. rough times will come, they will definitely arise but moving past that and finding a solution is all that matters and my people can do that. the people of this country can do that!’ and he ends with that. Pedro knelt down and bowed before the king and without another word he walked away thinking “A king has to be an ideal for the people and I don’t think the kings in this country have disappointed their people, Exceptions can be made but in general, the Kings of this country deserve to be noticed and praised. I already knew this but I’ll say it again- This land is meant for greatness!!!!’
author: Diya Maranat

title: It Ends as It Begins
text: "You can call me brother Jacob!" I stepped forward, and raised my brown leather hat and slightly bowed to greet the gorgeous lady in front of me. "Greetings to you Milady! I am Jacob Hansler, a traveller from south" I said and gave her my most charming smile."Hansler? like kin to Duke Hansler?" she asked squinting her eyes incredulously " Yes. He is my uncle." I replied confidently and she didn't investigate further. " So Mr.Hansler, What brought you to my mansion on this fine day?" she questioned, "Well, I have this piece of jewellry made out of the brightest Fire Opals." as I spoke the word 'opals' she slightly leaned in."I have heard that Milady is rather fond of gemstones and she possess an esoteric collection of Opals' jewellries, therefore I would like to know if you would spend a fifty million on this dazzling jewellry." I continued as I kept the glamorous necklace in front of her. "Oh my! What a pleasure to eyes!" she expressed her delight as she delicately picked up the necklace and looked at it vigilantly, after smiling with content she asked "Where did you get such a masterpiece?" "It is of my great-grandmother, Lora Deven Hansler" I simply replied. "Antique, however I already have alike necklaces." she said to my dismay. "May I have the permission to say something, Ms.Evelyn?" said a man in a deep and rough voice from behind us, I silently observed as he walked towards us, he was wearing the uniform of a butler and stood straight and firm like a soldier, though what caught my attention were the few scars on his face that looked as if it was burnt. "You may." said Evelyn "Mr.Hansler, I have heard there is an old goldsmith, Kae Dalle,he is a passionate lover of such designs who can deal at your price. He currently lives in Breneze" he said "Thank you, then I will take my leave" I said and extended my hand for a firm handshake to bid him farewell. For a moment I felt his grip tightened and a certain emotion shone in his blue eyes. "Wait." I halted and turned around to face Evelyn," It is nightfall, stay the night here and leave tomorrow morning, Sir Nightwolf will do the arrangements for your stay" I nodded and then followed Mr. Nightwolf. The other day, it was dark, as slowly light illuminated my surroundings as I felt the seat underneath shaking, I yawned and rubbed my eyes to see lucidly when refreshing smell of morning coffee hit my nose. Evelyn was sitting in front of me holding a cup of coffee that almost fell on her at a bump if I didn't heroically. I sat up straight and looked out of the carriage, I could see the town on the hill, Breneze. We had left the mansion in the morning with Evelyn insisting to come along to get some Opals for her recherche gems collection to which I readily agreed. There is just something ineffably comfortable about being with her. Next few days in Breneze were spent searching for Kae's whereabouts however, it turned out that Kae died nearly one and a half years ago during an ambiguous accident. Evelyn suggested to enquire in the town market but we weren't successful, mainly because of my paranoia after one of the sellers gave me a peculiar look, afraid that my identity would be unveiled, I pleaded to Evelyn and Sir Nightwolf to not enquire anymore, convincing them that someone might try to steal this lavish necklace if we keep advertising it. While stressing about my next move I felt a hand on my shoulder, I looked at my side to find Evelyn sitting beside me on the bench, she smiled at me and said, " Everything will be alright. Don't forget, 'luck favors the brave' so, raise your head soldier" Evelyn said to cheer me up. In the past few days we spent together, I did become really close with Evelyn, to a point that I started calling her 'Eve',which was a name I always avoided, it was the name of my beloved deceased baby sister. I was actually terrified of this rapid development of our relationship. After that traumatizing incident eighteen years ago where I lost my everything, after travelling like a nomad, no family, or sense of security; even the thought of being so close to someone, to be dependent; frightened me. Something about Evelyn made me feel as if I was home. I smiled back at her when she gave me a purple Quartz locket," I have made this locket myself for my brother that I once had. He drowned with my mother, five years ago. Dad 's never really been home since then, when you put your hand to protect me from the burning coffee, I felt cared for, I felt I have found my brother again. I have always treasured this necklace, the purple Quartz is one of the twin Quartzes my mother gave me before she went to heaven." she said as tears cascaded down her cheeks. My own eyes glistened with unshed tears and I let out in a broken whisper," Thank you, Eve." Later that night I stood on the balcony of the hotel when Sir Nightwolf came to stand with me. "Water?" he offered me the bottle of water which I accepted. "I see you are wearing Ms.Evelyn's purple Quartz locket." he remarked. I smiled to myself looking at that locket. "I think this is the time; you deserve to know" he said quietly with a serious look while I looked at him with my eyebrows raised, and waited patiently for him to continue "So Mr. Jacob Hansler or, should I call Jack Rallen?" at that moment my heart dropped, I broke out in cold sweat as my eyes widened at the 'oh so familiar name'; I was fearful, stunned and confused all at once, somehow I managed to not run for hills but instead stammered a pitiful "H-How? since when...?" seeing me being seconds away from a panic attack Sir Nightwolf appeared to have some mercy on me, as he strolled closer and put a fatherly hand on my head. He said," Calm down son, it is alright. No one else knows. You can trust me" he gave me a reassuring smile as I looked at him pleadingly, " I knew there was no one named 'Jacob' in Hansler household. Eighteen years ago when that fire broke out in your house, I was one of the soldiers of royal army. How can I forget that eight years old terrified little boy who pleaded me to save his sister at the cost of his life? you have the same green eyes, blonde hair,and the scar on the right palm from stubbornly trying to fight fire flames. I searched for you for months, to take you back to your sister but" " Wait what? Eve is still alive?" I interrupted "Yes" he said and for a moment my heart skipped a beat, the family, the love I always longed for, could it actually be mine? " Where is she?" I asked " Here." I looked bewildered, 'wait he didn't' my eyes widened like a saucer "Evelyn is Eve. "he said and smiled as tears cascaded down my eyes ".Evelyn is my Eve!" I was overjoyed as he nodded and I hugged him " Thank you, thank you so much Sir Nightwolf" finally life was giving me another chance, to actually live and not just exist, but it all took a sharp turn when someone shouted "That 's him, arrest him" I looked down, soldiers, carrying the swords and the emblem of nation, they were the royal guards, and with them was one of the sellers I met in market. "It seems someone else has also found about you, run!" rushed Sir Nightwolf, " What 's the chaos?" said a sleepy Evelyn who was soon shoved to wall violently by one of the guards "Eve!" I shouted and tried to reach for her when Sir Nightwolf held my arm " It is not the time. She will be alright I promise you. But if you don't leave right now you would be sentenced to life imprisonment or capital punishment for stealing from national treasure." he was right, therefore, I ran away, but with the resolution to come back for my Eve. 'Three months later, as I came back to Eve's mansion, I saw her sitting in the veranda with Sir Nightwolf by her side who looked at me pitifully as I clutched the purple locket in my hand. It didn't help at all that Eve was wearing the same locket complementing her pristine white gown. My heart shattered to pieces and I felt suffocation under the brilliant sky "What was your name again?" she asked, "You can call me brother Jack..."

title: Medicine time
text: Amy is bored. She thought to go park and went. but before that she was so irritated that she can't even sit. title: that night!
text: I w as sitting on my bunkbed ready to drop!. my summer vacation had started,At last no more school work!. I was getting ready to binge to our Favourite series with my best friend, Lydia. we were all alone at home with our brothers because my dad and mom went to Hawaii for a detective case, yes they are detectives. When suddenly we heard glass shatter and It was in my backyard.Lydia and i shrieked and yelled in dismay!. Lydia peeped through the window We saw that the glass window of my shed was shattered "Is it Franklyn Damien?, The girl in THE DEAD GIRL IN MY SHED. " said Lydia "Oh could you shush for a minute, my heart is still pounding!". Suddenly Walter and Kayden busted in through the door!, Walter walked in with a wooden spoon and my brother with his old Toy shovel!. " What happened?, where is the robber?". asked Walter! "Who and what?" asked Lydia? what are you talking about". "Then why were you two screaming?" asked Kayden.. " my guesses are, one someone has barged into our shed or two some creep threw stones at our glass window." I said.." anyway we are finding the culprit" whose with me? Chapter - 1 how it all started! chapter - 2 Incognito Heros Finding the culprit we tiptoed down the stairs secretively holding torches and flashlights so we dont wake up my elder brother Rowan. Walter turned on our backyard light and shed's light and as we set foot outside a terrifying shadow came out from our house. We all shrieked and screamed. to be honest the boys screamed worse than the girls,We turned around to see it was my elder brother Rowan!,he was in harry potter pajamas and had a eye mask on his forehead with Hagrid's face on it holding our dog Clover. "what are you guys up to at 12.00 am? Wait how is our window shattered- and why are you guys going outside- i have many questions and one to assure you guys! all of you are dead! get inside!" said Rowan! " wait rio! Let us explain! please? all of us pleaded " fine, you have 5 minutes to explain everything starting from the shattered glass window". after hearing about all the catastrophe my brother finally was curious to know too!" is it Abigail?"asked rowan showing some interest " so, we have to find what is in our shed,right". " exactly, rio. so you in the group with us?" asked Abigail. " Getting in a group with pathetic children would ruin my reputation, but because I care for my Little ones i will join.". " oh, we don't want you to join with any sympathy? you can leave then! " said Abby. " I am just playing,Im in!".So, what's the plan? clover barked with excitement chapter - 3, Rio's in as we all stepped out, We heard something move in our shed,Rowan guided us to the our backyard to the shed and then suddenly the creature in the shed unexpectedly jumped out of the window to the bush (like the last three times) we shrieked and screamed! the creature had golden eyes and red fur. Everyone was flabbergasted and then i realized it was a Red panda. "The Ailurus red panda!, how did this animal come to Ohio?, these animals are only found in eastern Himalayas and parts of China!. chapter 4, how is he here?? everyone was surprised! "how do you know this? rowan asked " days and days of research, this animal is my latest research pal!"I said while everyone was still in surprise and shock Kayden mumbled " this animal looks familiar". " did you think so too Kayden?" said Lydia and suddenly her mouth opened and her eyes looked like they were about to pop!" is thi- oh my God! this is Kimchi, the missing red panda!. He went missing today early morning, his owner Li Yan who came from china with Kimchi for the Inaugration of the New zoo!. His "mom" had told anyone who had seen him should call through her contact numbeer all over internet!. all of us were flabbergasted! we needed this little guy to reach home chapter - 5 -KIMCHI- Rowan quickly dialed the phone number. " h- he-hello" a woman replied in tears " i will not screenshot you an autograph, if you are some crazy fan!" rowan held his breath & bit his tongue trying not to laugh "no ma'am" rowan explained the whole situation the woman said she would come soon!. "poor creature looks hungry! let's get him some fruit" said Abigail. the animal ate the fruit and went for a cozy nap in some hay. within 15 minutes 3 police cars and one Porsche pulled up in front of Abby's house. Kimchi, who was fast asleep got up and jumped into Li Yan's arms. both of them cuddled and sighed as they saw each other. everyone were shedding tears. " thank you so much kids, i missed my Kimchi, are you hungry!,Wait, i smell bananas and blueberries!" kimchi's mom looked at the kids " you fed my baby his favourites!. how sweet you are! thank you for everything!" "not a problem, it was fun having kimchi around!" as the lady and kimchi were about to leave Li yan turned around and said " as a reward you can stay at the Hooloo resort for 1 week starting from April 5! call your friends and all, all expenses are covered by me! everyone hurrayed and cooed. this summer vaccation will be a blast the end. story written by Sarah Mary Samuel
author: Sarah mary

title: Ethereal Garden
text: She walked through a garden, running her hand past soft grass and tender petals of flowers that had a sense of warmth and comfort in them which felt unusual, but welcoming. The garden was enchanting in many ways. It was just the right place to find what she was looking for. She smiled with her amber eyes closed, taking in a deep breath of the gentle wind that brushed past her skin. It felt so good, so relaxing to be away from everything. Away from her job, away from her responsibilities, away from stress and away from a place most people call home, a foreign word that was just a four letter synonym for house to her. Home, where most people find comfort and people to lean on. Home, maybe not a place but just a person or people, or maybe no one but themselves. Home, a refreshing place to be away from all the harsh, sickening things in the world. Ella didn't have a place she could call home. It was always temporary solace like this garden or a never ending spectrum of stress that overwhelmed her. But even a garden was better than her house. Her house, where her family always held disdain for everything she said or did. Her house in which she had to be alert of anything at all. Her house that didn't feel like hers but the world's that hated her. Sometimes Ella believed something was wrong with her for not appreciating things, not showing thankfulness to her parents for keeping a roof over her head and making sure she's happy and healthy. Maybe it's just the way she thought that made her unhappy and not her parents or her life. So she sought out for comfort to satisfy herself. And it did work, because at the moment, the pleasant fragrance of flowers wafting in the air comforted her better than her own parents could ever, which was quite rude to think of but what was she supposed to say? "Oh my parents are so lovely and the best!"? Saying that would be implying she's just like them, a liar. She continued walking around aimlessly, humming a song under her breath about something along the lines of two best friends and cold ice. It was irrelevant and didn't really matter since right then, she was on her pursuit for comfort and the angsty thoughts didn't really mean much comfort. What exactly was comfort? That, she didn't know. It was just a pleasant feeling she needed. A dancing campfire in her heart that didn't bring pain but laughter and a couple of people sharing s'mores around it. Well not literally but it was pleasant that way. It was a calm sea wave, splashing around as sand gets caught up on one's feet and along with it was a beautiful orange sunset completing the picture. It was ironic, comparing comfort to fire and water, two opposites. But it comes to show how everyone has a different perspective on things. Just like how some find comfort in people but she didn't. Comfort wasn't something she found around people so she settled on being by herself and live the hermit life. Except instead of meditation she's most likely going to be roaming around with no absolute destination in mind and occasionally go back to her city to earn money. But at the moment that was the least of her concerns. Her biggest concern would probably be the guilt that festered up over the years of living up to her parent's expectation. While she did say she didn't like them, she won't deny that she had always tried to make them proud of her and hoped that their faces would once, just once, bloom into proud smiles likes the flowers she always loved and knew. Maybe she hoped, even prayed, that her parents would see her for who she is and understand her meaning. If that made any sense at all. Along with guilt was a bit of bitter regret and sorrow for leaving her parents like an ungrateful child. If she was even a bit her past self she'd be trembling from how much she'd cry at the thought of letting go of her parents and she'd hate her present self who did the one thing that would leave her tattered in pieces. Those people who hated her but always knew how to make her go rainbow and brighten up with several emotions. Happiness, joy, excitement, pride, guilt, sadness, anger, regret, anxiety, disappointment and the list goes on. She shivered at this thought that clouded her mind and sighed at how sentimental her past self was. Shaking of all thoughts of her old pitiful, or actually young pitiful self since she was rather young at that time, Ella instead focused on the flower she was trying to find. It's a beautiful flower and she had a gut feeling it would be here. And considering the garden's ethereal and enchanting beauty which lured her in, she could tell it was definitely there. But even if it wasn't it'd be fine since her search for that certain flower would allow her to stumble upon other flowers, some even she wouldn't know. That was certainly an opportunity she wouldn't dream of giving up. Her search was indeed worth it as she ended up not only finding other enamoring flowers but her favorite flower. Hyacinths

title: Autumn Love
text: It felt good to go out after a long time. I had a cup of hot coffee in my hand and I was walking towards my car, stepping on the dry and yellow leaves lying on the ground. It was when I pulled out my car keys from my pocket to unlock the car, my phone buzzed with 2 messages from Ann. Ann: Hey! Ann: Where are you right now? I'm standing outside your house. I quickly texted back. Me: Hi Ann! I'm out grocery shopping and will be back in 5 minutes. I turned on the engine and started driving. Once I reached my house I saw Ann on her phone leaning on her car. I parked my car in the garage and walked over to where she was standing. When I got a closer look at her, I guessed she got back from work as she was wearing pants and a white shirt with her short brown hair resting on her shoulders. She put her phone inside her pocket as soon as she saw me walking towards her. "What brings you here?" I asked "My friends told me about this new place. I wanted to check it out and thought you'd be the best person to go with." Ann said with a smile on her face. "Where is this new place you wanna check out with me?" I said, smirking as I crossed my hands over my chest. "I believe I can't tell you that at the moment. How about you come with me and you can see it for yourself?" She replied. That smile never left her face. "Get in." She said as she pointed at her car and got inside the driver's seat. I obeyed and walked over to the passenger seat. I fastened my seatbelt as she turned on the engine. "It's pretty far away, it'll take at least 45 minutes to get there," Ann said looking at me. "Oh, I don't mind at all." I said as her shoulders relaxed. The sky was getting darker. It was around 7:45 pm so I knew I wouldn't mind a long drive. Long drives late in the night were my favourite. When the city was asleep everything seemed so peaceful and somehow so beautiful. I couldn't think of a more therapeutic thing than driving on the highway at night as the streetlights lit up the sky with soft music playing in my car. "So…" I tried to fill the silence in the car. "Will you give me at least some kind of context regarding this mysterious place you're taking me to." "I want it to be a surprise" "Why are you keeping this a secret? Is it some kind of criminal mission or a haunted house? If yes then I don't want to go." I said sarcastically. "Close." I saw her smiling from the corner of my eye. "I knew I should not have gotten into your car so easily." Ann chuckled at my comment. "Maya," "Hm" "I haven't heard from you in a while, is everything all right?" Ann said with concern in her eyes. I was anything but alright. I felt emotionally exhausted but I was able to hide it from my friends and family. I wasn't good at sharing my emotions so I wanted to go through it alone. Work was already pretty stressful but other things started to stress me out even more and the death of peach - my pet dog - was the last straw. I isolated myself from the world. I avoided social gatherings and never really talked to the ones I loved the most. I even stopped talking to Ann who was my best friend. I had always talked to her about everything but all that had been going on was even difficult to share with her. I smiled but it was lopsided. "Everything is alright. It's just that work has been stressing me out lately." Ann had that smile back on her face but I figured that she knew I was hiding something. The rest of the car ride we talked about work and the weather and made a couple of jokes. We reached our destination on time. When I stepped out of the car cold autumn winds made me shiver and my sweater wasn't providing much warmth. Ann got out of the car and walked over to where I was standing. I saw tons of stalls and tents set up and a crowd of people nearby. Ann caught me staring in that direction. "It's a carnival," I averted my gaze as she started speaking." It takes place once a year for 5 days. I thought you'd enjoy it. "I already seem to enjoy it." I said as Ann and I started to walk towards the carnival. The carnival was huge. It had hundreds of people so it was easy to get lost in the crowd if you weren't paying attention. There were lots of rides and stalls. Everything looked beautiful with all the lights and things people had used to decorate their tents. "This place is beautiful." I said looking at Ann. "I'm glad you like it." She replied with a grin. "Now let's get some food. I'm starving." She said as she grabbed my hand and pulled me towards the stalls. "Maya, let's get fries or maybe nachos or corn dogs. Let's get cotton candy, no let's get hotdogs… Wait, those look so delicious and that too." She pointed at different stalls but couldn't decide what to eat because there were so many things to check out. I chuckled, Ann brought her attention back to me. "Fries sound good. We can check out other stuff later." I said with a smile. We got fries first and then we walked around checking out different stalls. We played games, won prizes and went on different rides. While playing ring toss Ann won a stuffed animal. She told me to keep it because she didn't like stuffed toys. We had ice cream for dessert as it was Ann's favorite. We stayed there for about 2 hours. We took pictures, laughed and tried the food at the carnival. Honestly, it was the best food I had ever had. Ann dropped me at my house. "Thanks for taking me to the carnival. I had so much fun." I said as I wrapped my hands around my seat belt in an attempt to get out of the car. "Don't thank me." Ann said as she waved her hand in front of her face. "I was lucky to have you with me. Because of you I had so much fun." I smiled as I got out of her car. When I got home, I closed the door and went to the living room where I placed all the stuff that Ann and I won from playing games at the carnival. Ann told me to keep all the things that she won even though I told her that I don't want it. I sat on the couch and a big grin was painted on my face.. That day I was the happiest I had been in a long time I used to believe that nobody would think about me if I disappeared for some time or if I stopped talking to everybody. But I was wrong. Ann knew something wasn't right. She took me to the carnival and gave me her stuff too which helped me get my mind off things. … "I had so much fun at that carnival. We should go there again." I said looking at Ann's hand which I was holding between the palms of my hands. I got a nod from her in return. The nurse walked into the room. "Ma'am the visiting hours are over now, you have to leave. She has surgery tomorrow and she needs rest." I pressed my lips together and nodded. Before walking out the door I turned around and smiled at Ann. "I'll be back tomorrow but I might be a little late. I hope you don't mind." She gave me a soft smile but didn't say anything. The next day as soon as I got back from work I rushed to the hospital. When I reached the hospital I went straight to the room where Ann was supposedly waiting but as soon as I opened the door I didn't see her on the bed. My whole world shattered before my eyes. I panicked, my heart skipped a beat and tears started to roll down my cheeks. Guilt washed over me. It was only a few months ago when I found out that Ann had cancer and that she had been going through the trauma of chemotherapy all alone. I knew something was off but I was so caught up with my own problems that I didn't give it a single thought. I never asked her what she had been up to when she asked me if I was alright in the car on our way to the carnival. I tried to reassure myself by thinking that she was in the doctor's room for a checkup but that was not enough for me to calm down. I sat on the floor with my knees rolled up to my chest and my head in the palms of my hands and sobbing uncontrollably wishing that she was alright.
