title: Koni Juj: The Egg Fight
text: On the first day of the Rongali Bihu festival, Mamoni jumps out of bed. “It is koni juj day, Anaideo,” she shouts. “I will fight many egg battles, and break the most number of eggs, just you watch. And then we will eat your famous, delicious egg bhaja!” Mamoni chooses her eggs carefully. “One big egg… “One pointy egg… “One egg with a very thick shell.” Soon, she leaves for the koni juj. First, Mamoni goes to Rontu’s house. “O, Rontu! I challenge you to a koni juj.” Mamoni picks her sharpest egg. Tat! Tat! TAT! Oh no! Mamoni has lost the first battle. Rontu takes Mamoni’s egg. Next, Mamoni goes to meet Sunmi. “O, Sunmi!” she calls. “I challenge you to a koni juj.” This time, Mamoni chooses her biggest egg. Tap! Tap! Tap! Poor Mamoni loses her second battle. Her big egg has broken too! “Yahooo! Your egg is mine now!” says Sunmi. Finally, Mamoni is at Manab’s house. “O, Manab! Will you koni juj with me?” This time, Mamoni uses the egg with the very thick shell. “AAAAA!” Third time lucky, Mamoni has cracked Manab’s egg! But Mamoni’s egg has broken too. “Anaideo, I did not win any battle or eggs,” says Mamoni. “And I also lost all my eggs.” Anaideo gives Mamoni a big hug. “Mamoni,” says Anaideo. “All that matters is that you tried your best and you had fun. Look, your friends are here. They want to share their eggs with you.” Later, Anaideo uses the eggs to make her famous egg bhaja for Mamoni and her friends. What a delicious Bihu lunch it is!
author: Priyadarshini Gogoi

title: The Power of Friendship
text: Katniss was terrified. This was her first time on stage after nearly 8 years. Hearing the noise of the crowd...The lights switching on brightly...And the curtains rising. All these events... Her thoughts wandered and she slipped into the memory of that day. That one day that had changed her life. She was a confident little five year old girl, who was known for the best ballet dances at such a young age, waiting backstage with a group of ballet performers. With all the last minute rush it was a wonder that she was the only performer who stood up straight, without any worry or doubt. Well, she was the lead. She couldn't afford to get nervous. The entire performance was dependent on her. As the curtains rose, they all rushed to take the positions. Young Katniss started twirling and moving effortlessly and gracefully as the first note of the music began. The crowd watched her as she danced and danced, enchanted and mesmerized. All of a sudden, the music stopped. The entire group paused looking out, unsure about what to do. But young Katniss did not care. She was in her own world twirling about even after the music stopped. She twirled on and on. Suddenly, she tripped over her own leg and fell face first on the ground. This was unexpected. All that happened after, Katniss did not know. All she knew was the wailing of sirens, this shouts of fear and lastly, the swish of the curtains. From that day, since Katniss injured her leg really badly, she decided never to dance ever again. The whole town, still in the memory of her beautiful ballet performances, urged her to continue her ballet course but because of her deepest fears and that one memory, she refused. After her refusal, her talent of dancing hid beneath in the dark. It was the power of friendship that brought it back on surface and made her a successful dancer. Back in the present, she looked around and caught her best friend, Masha’s eye. Masha smiled at her and Katniss smiled back. That one smile was enough encouragement for Katniss to forget her previous accident. Masha was the only one who understood her fear and doubt. She was the one who approached Katniss, spoke with her day in and day out, convinced her to continue her ballet lessons. She really hoped this performance would go well. Yet again, she was on the very same stage looking forward to the very same performance that had caused her nothing but misfortune, when she was five years old. Katniss pushed down all her panic, and she muttered under her breath, “I can do this” “I can do this.” A soft music piece began. Katniss glided forward and began her beautiful routine. She danced with the same grace and beauty as she had danced eight years ago. Keeping her mind in the present, she danced at her own will and experienced the joy of dancing yet again. Her solo was the biggest success of the day. Everyone cheered and clapped really well. Masha’s eyes shone and her face glowed with happiness and pride. Katniss had prayed for it to become a really big success, and here, she got it. God had helped her and she thanked everyone from her heart. As she thought she realized how much Masha had helped her over this. If it wasn't for her power and if it wasn't for Katniss’s approval to continue her dance she wouldn't have succeeded in her performance today.From that day on, she vowed to always listen to those who did good for her. Her little sister encouraged her. So did her parents. Just then, Masha walked over. “Well, look who's the best ballerina!” she laughed, playfully. “Masha I can't thank you enough for convincing me to continue my journey!” Katniss exclaimed. “Oh well, come on, it was all your hard work,determination and self-confidence.” said Masha. “Well, I'd rather say it was the power of friendship. It was ballet that brought us together!” said Katniss With this, they both walked off together, laughing and talking over all those lovely memories. Learn That: “We all may have many friends, but the real happiness and satisfaction you get is when you have a best friend by your side” This story is dedicated to all those great best friends out there!
author: Nandika Hiran

title: My Friend With Wings
text: Life felt so boring due to this lockdown. School had closed abruptly. I could not go out to play and I could not play boards with my parents because they were busy with their work. I could not even play games with my grandma as she was unable to travel and come to our place due to the lockdown. I was super bored. One day, while sitting in my room reading a book, I heard a creature yelping in pain. I went out in the balcony and saw that there was a small baby parrot with a broken wing lying on the floor. I felt terribly sorry for the little one. I immediately took it inside my room and bandaged its wing with my first aid kit. It was such a cute little birdie that I decided to nurse it and keep it with me, at least until it had healed and was strong enough to fly again. However, I was not sure how my parents would react to this decision of mine, as I had heard that parrots can get noisy, and my parents have meetings all day long. So, I decided not to tell my parents right now. Since I wanted to keep the parrot, whom I already named Meera, I decided to build it a small cozy nest-type of a place. I got to work immediately and gathered all my cardboard boxes, fluffy blanket, and even some straws and grass from our garden. Once Meera's abode was ready, I was very proud of what I had built. It seemed Meera also liked it instantaneously. Meera was a small parrot, and its food needs were very limited. So, I faced no difficulty in sneaking into the kitchen to get some leftovers for her. I enjoyed the time I spent with Meera - talking to her and listening to the feeble noise that she made. Soon enough, the school decided to conduct online classes due to the pandemic spreading. I was actually happy with that, as I could continue to stay closer to Meera. One day, Meera came out of her nest and in front of the camera. All my classmates were very excited to see a cute little parrot next to me. All my classmates started asking multiple questions to me about how and when did I get this pet. I narrated my tale of how Meera came to be my pet. From that day onward, my classmates demanded that I bring Meera to all the online classes before the teacher joined. All this was going well until one day my mother chanced to enter my room during the class and saw me showing off Meera to my classmates. Immediately after the class she demanded to know the full story, which I had to unfold upon her. To my pleasant surprise, she was not upset with me about my pet. In fact, she encouraged me to discuss this with my father. Mom wanted me to plan for a proper adoption of the parrot. My father agreed to my request, and he even took us to a vet for have the parrot inspected and vaccinated. He took me also to the hospital to ensure that I was also fine as I had been playing with this parrot for the last few days. Fortunately, all turned out well, and I found a great friend with wings.

title: The Master
text: ﻿ “Dum-dum-du..” The sound of Damru could be heard. Ranga was passing by and overheard the sound. He got curious and decided to go in that direction. Upon reaching, he observed that a crowd had gathered and an acrobat was getting applauded for walking on a thin rope, risking her life!! ﻿People were cheering, clapping on the acrobat’s adventurous act and paying money as token of appreciation. Ranga was awestruck watching this. Being poor, he had difficulty meeting his daily needs and was looking for work to win bread. After watching the act, an idea struck him - why can’t he also do something like this for earning? He went home. After thinking for a long, he finally decided, 'let’s do it!!’ Not an original idea, but at the least, he could have a life now and could also make money by arranging such shows and more importantly get praised by people. Ranga was a very hardworking person. He started to work on this idea to bring it into reality. He had some savings which he decided to use as an investment. He went to the market to get the materials required but soon realized that he might have to spend all of his savings. But he was so determined that he decided to do it no matter the consequences. ﻿ Ranga was a very hardworking person. He started to work on this idea to bring it into reality. He had some savings which he decided to use as an investment. He went to the market to get the materials required but soon realized that he might have to spend all of his savings. But he was so determined that he decided to do it no matter the consequences. Now he had all materials he needed, except for the people who will perform the acts. Another problem was that he had no money to pay them either. He thought to himself ‘I should have thought of this earlier and should have borrowed the materials from someone instead of buying it. Now I have no money, no people, and some stupid material that is now basically of no use. I might as well sell them and get my money back with profit.’ To clear his mind he went out and sat under a large tree. Tired of overthinking, the cool shadow and breeze gave comfort to his mind and he fell asleep. Suddenly his eyes opened due to some noise - some monkeys were down on the ground, playing. ﻿ Ranga again came back to his original thought on how he could gain a profit by selling the materials which he had bought foolishly. But as we all know, destiny supports determined people. Suddenly, one of the monkeys came to him and started playing happily around him. Ranga also played with him. That’s when an idea popped into Ranga’s mind, ‘why didn’t I think of this before? I can just use these monkeys for the act. It will take time to train them, but I’m sure it will be worth it.’ He took the monkey who was playing around him to his hut. The first thing he did was to give some food to the monkey he had brought home. He named the monkey, ‘Bali’ - a very classical name. He started training Bali. Days passed and Bali was turning out to be much better than Ranga’s expectations. Bali even learned to speak by observing Ranga. Ranga always used to say to Bali every single day that 'With your help, I’ll be able to earn a lot of money and get a lot of praise and appreciation that I am dying for.’ Bali was always happy to do all the work Ranga told him to do. Bali thought that Ranga loves and cares for him. Months passed and finally, Ranga and Bali were ready to perform. On a market day, they started their first act. Ranga was very excited as he introduced himself, ‘Good morning everyone! First of all, I thank you all for coming to our act. I am going to present things never seen before. Please enjoy the show.” Then Bali came and introduced himself,’ Hi everyone, I am Bali and I would be my dearest friend Ranga’s assistant. Hope you all enjoy.’ The whole crowd was startled and cheered when they realized that the monkey, Bali, could talk. Then the performance continued. The act was huge hit. Ranga received a lot of money. The people had also given money and praise to Bali but Ranga didn’t seem to realize that. Time passed by, and Ranga and Bali together were earning a lot of praise and money. But after several months, Ranga seemed to realize that the crowd was getting less. Once, after their performance, he counted the money he received, and it was a lot less than what he was making earlier. He started getting frustrated. One day got very angry and lashed out at Bali, 'It’s all because of you; you’re the one who has bored all the people. Now that I have more money I am going to hire a real person to do this for me. I will leave you all alone.’ Bali was shocked and furious; he lashed out too, saying ‘I came along with you out of love, but now I’ve realized that you use people and then throw them away like garbage. I’d like to tell you this - everything you have earned from these acts is because of me. I’m the one who attracts people. Your whole life is dependent on me.” Deeply disturbed by this, Bali decided to go back to his original place. The final sentence Bali said before running away was, 'All this time you thought you’re the one playing me. You might be doing that physically, but honestly, you’re the one who got played! Good luck for your future earnings.’ Ranga was unfazed by this. The final sentence Bali said before running away was, 'All this time you thought you’re the one playing me. You might be doing that physically, but honestly, you’re the one who got played! Good luck for your future earnings.’ Ranga was unfazed by this. He hired people to work for him as he had planned. As the days passed he realized that their acts were now failing and the monkey, Bali, was the one who people were more interested in. Ranga soon realized that he was not the master; the monkey Bali was the real Master who played him.

title: Make a difference - Story of Aneri
text: We should remember that there is always a way to change rude behaviour into kindness by showing example and affection towards mute animals. For example, let's take this story about a humble girl named Aneri. Aneri was a very kind and friendly girl. She did not have any siblings, so she spent most of her time with her friends. She was living a perfect life with all of her near ones and dear ones. She had many friends in her apartment and also in her school. Like any other story there is always a twist. Her dad got transferred to Sweden which is another part of the world. She was more shocked than surprised to hear this news. She knew that she would miss her loved people. She was new to everything in that country. From language, place, food to education and most importantly its people. For a few weeks she was missing her friends. She tried to make friends but no one wanted to be her friend, as she was from another country and was different from the others. For some months she was completely alone without anyone whom she thought was her friend. Once she went to a farmhouse in which she had lots of fun. Do you know why? Her parents planned a visit to meet their relatives who lived in a farmhouse far away from hustle and bustle of the city life. She was thrilled to know about this visit. The farmhouse was indeed neat and clean with lots of open green landscape. They all chit-chatted and had tea fresh from the tea-garden. After some time they all decided to take a walk in the beautiful farm in the warm morning breeze. Suddenly, Aneri heard an animal panting. She followed the direction in which she could hear the sound. When she slowly reached there, she saw a well and decided to look inside it. She found out that it was a little puppy that had fallen into it! She really wanted to help it. Her parents gathered some people living next to the well. They quickly found a rope, hanged it into the well and tried to get the puppy out. It took a long time but after all they succeed. Unfortunately, puppy was injured a lot. Aneri didn’t lose hope and tried to find help. She quickly found out that there is an NGO near to her house they help and aid sick / injured animals. She took the pup with her to her house and named it Rex. From that day onwards she went to meet Rex every day in the NGO after coming back from school. She never forgot to bring treats for Rex and played every evening. They both became best friends. In this first trip in new country, Aneri showed kindness to puppy and willingness to rescue puppy and not only that she as well found a home for Rex. The seeds of something special for Aneri were planted. Time passed by and her father planned an overseas trip during summer break. They went to the great Sahara Desert to learn about desert and have fun. Even this time she had fun and adventure. Let's figure out why? As Aneri and her parents lived in a Northern European country, their climatic condition was very cold and that was one on of the reasons for her parents decided to go to the Sahara Desert in Africa. Surely it had to be warmer as it is the largest hot desert in the world. There they were in The Great Sahara Desert, admiring the beauty of nature along the way in the safari which they had booked in advance. The desert was perfect but also extremely hot. All of the animals, plants, people etc. had adapted themself to this region. While they were riding their safari, suddenly they saw an animal behind some cactus. Upon coming closer to the animal, they found out that it was a baby camel. It was fainted from the heat of the Sun. Aneri decided to save it no matter what! Her parents with the help from Safari guide called the rescue team to save baby camel. But, what if it could die before help reaches there. She took the water bottle out from the bag and gave it to baby camel without thinking what they will do without water during the safari and rescue team could take more time! 4 They even picked baby camel from the burning sand and took it inside the safari van to be cooled in the A/C. In some time, rescue van reached there and they provided good care to the baby camel, finally it felt alright. Aneri named it Carmel. Within spam of few months, Aneri saved lives of muted animals and that too in different continents! In next trip, she had similar rescue experience and this time she saved duck from the river. She developed unique relation with the animals that are in dire need. Aneri started to develop more and more love and affection towards needy animals and such act of saving lives was booster to what she really needs in her life. Every time she saves an animal, she names it. She did not only save their lives but also made them her friends. The best friends she had were the animals, they could understand her feelings. As time passed, she grew to be more confident and kinder to living things on the earth. When you do good deed, good fortune follows. The act of saving animals became more popular and there were few articles in newspaper about bravery and kindness of Aneri. Because of her kindness and confidence people started liking her. She was more popular than anyone in her apartment and school. People really wanted to be her friends. At the other hand many of her friends also thought that they wanted to be like her. Not just because she was perfect in everything but she treated animals and humans equally and most importantly in a kind way. They all got inspired to save 5 wildlife like how Aneri was doing. They wanted to be a helping hand as well. It was one person after another person joining her in helping animals in need. She completed her high school and University degree. Now, it was time for Aneri to become professional. She looked back and thought what she wants to become and answer was very obvious. The seeds were planted from the first trip at relative's farmhouse which has grown quite big and significant. She had a mission and many people are already associated with her from her school days but it was in a formal form. She wanted to make her own NGO to help animals who are sick, injured, orphans, abandoned, old... But this is not an easy task for a fresh young graduate. Setting up NGO requires many formalities with government and most importantly finance. Aneri didn't lose hope as she wanted to achieve her noble dream. One day, she was scrolling through old memories with all her rescued animals. She realized that she has many many collection of video, pictures, stories of animals that she helped in the past. She got an idea! Why not make all these memories available for entire world. She sat with her parents and discussed that let us make an own website. This website will have all the data of Aneri and animals she saved, and she inspired others to save. As she had developed interest about animals' lives, she had a huge collection of animal related literature in animation and in book form that from kid to adult all can understand and learn. Her Mother was a web designer, Aneri and her mother developed a fantastic website which they named "humanimal.org" and the mission statement was "Humans and Animals are the best friends and you do anything and everything for a best friend ". They started to advertise this website through different social media platforms. Instantly, it became quite popular among many animal lovers. Within few days, the #humanimal (hash tag – humanimal) became trend on social media and millions of social media users became followers of this campaign. 6 She received some good amount of money from the social media and she spent it to save sick animals. She started to receive donation; she expanded the team. This campaign caught attention of the government and she was invited to deliver a speech in a conference organized by government. She presented the current condition of poor animals and also plan how she can with her campaign make difference. Next day, Government invited her to the office and she proposed her idea of animal NGO to the committee. Within a week, her proposal was approved; NGO was granted and it was established by naming - Humanimal Pal NGO. Within a year they saved more than 1000 animals which was a record in itself. Today, Humanimal Pal NGO has branches across the Europe continent and expanding to other part of the world. Her mission become her life and made change to many animals and people. Like her name Aneri, she made difference to many. You have to trust yourself first to make others trust you. Believe!

title: A Tale Of Regret
text: Sometimes I wish my life was like those fairytales where no harm happens to anyone other than the evil. Real life on the other hand is just depressing and ugly. No matter how much I study I still get bad grades. The constant pressure of being perfect in the class. The worst is the constant nagging of my mom. She keeps scolding me over the smallest things. Sometimes I wish it would have been better to die and be free of this life. I mean there is nothing good in it. Everyone has certain expectations from me. If given a chance I would rather end this life of twelve years and become free. That's the only thing on my mind as I drifted to sleep... Suddenly I feel something pat me. I rub my eyes and speak up "Just 1 more minute, mom". "Are you okay Snow White? You have been sleeping for quite awhile now". Wait, that doesn't sound like my Mom. I throw my eyes open to find a dwarf staring at me with his big eyes and on his face is a long white beard. I also notice a lot of wrinkles on him. I stare at him in shock and try to decide if I should laugh at his looks or be scared and scream at the top of my lungs. I catch myself and try to make sense of the situation around me. I am in a shabby wooden hut and I am lying on a pile of worn out mattresses. I must have been dreaming, to ensure that I pinch myself like a good fifteen times on my hands. But to my utter shock I feel nothing other than pain. Have I lost it or something? Am I in heaven? Is this a prank made by my Mom to wake me up early? Wait, that dwarf called me Snow White right? "Go and fetch me a mirror" I order the dwarf and he quickly goes and brings me a hand mirror. I look at myself in the mirror. I have dark ebony hair, lips as red as blood and skin as fair as snow. Wait, have I reincarnated like those fantasy comics. I must have done some good deed in my past that made God give me this opportunity. My thoughts are immediately stopped by the words of the red hat wearing dwarf! "You had fainted from the poisoned comb of the comb seller. But the dwarfs healed you. We should be more careful from now on ". That comb seller must be the evil step mom of Snow white who tried to kill her with the poisoned comb. Next must be the farmer's wife who brings apples. I know the story which means I can change the future. If I play the right cards. I can live a life of luxury and become a princess, I should start planning for her next visit. Suddenly there is a knock on the door. The gate is opened by a green coloured hat wearing dwarf. There was a young woman carrying a basket full of peaches. She must be a step mother, isn't she? That's the only question swirling in my mind at that moment. Wait, why is the story changed? It should be apples and not peaches. "Would you care to have a fresh pair of peaches, my fair maiden. They are newly hand picked and sweet in taste". "I would love to have some" I replied with a tight lipped smile. I need to come up with a plan before she poisons me. She hands me a peach and I slowly bring it closer to my mouth. I take a small bite and immediately spit it out. "Oh my, they are so bitter. My step mother sent you, didn't she? You wanted to poison me to death. You deserve a punishment. Dwarfs take her away and kill her somewhere in a forest. She attempted to kill me". "There must be a mistake, my fair maiden. These peaches aren't poisoned. I beg you princess please spare this servant". She is dragged by three of the dwarfs and her pleas fall at dead ears. Phew..!! That was intense. It's good that I didn't eat the peach. God knows what would have happened if I did... I doze off for a few hours and when I wake up dwarfs are cooking something in the Kitchen. "This bed is so uncomfortable. Can't have something soft and fluffy?. I am really hungry. Bring me some tasty food quickly". While eating the little dwarf asks me for some food, but I scold him and tell him to get lost. I know we shouldn't behave with people like this but they are not humans are they? They are just side characters of a fairytale. I don't need to be a goody two shoes in front of them. Later at night I call all the five dwarfs in my room and order them to make me a beautiful glass coffin before the morning. They follow me like obedient servants and by the morning the coffin is completed. My plan is going well up till now. it's time to move to the final step. I order all the dwarfs together and give them their roles, "I will go and lay down in that coffin and act like I am dead. You all go and put the coffin outside the hut and after some time a prince will pass from here. If he asks about me, answer him that the farmer's wife sent by the Queen tried to kill me through poisonous peaches. She ate those and now can't be healed. Don't mess this up". I warn them. In the morning I wake up and wear the most beautiful dress I can find before laying inside the glass coffin. After quite a while when I am almost about to lose hope I hear the sound of horse riding. I quickly close my eyes awaiting my prince in shining armor. "What happened to this maiden, is she alright?". That must be the voice prince. Yes, things are going as planned. "She ate a peach given to her by the farmer's wife who was sent by her evil step mom, the Queen. She ate the peach and now can't be healed". Yes!! They followed my orders and now the prince will take me with him to the castle to treat me. I do a happy dance inside but that is caught off guard by someone. "You are lying" I hear a voice slashing through my bubble of excitement. It was that little red hat dwarf, whom I told to get lost during dinner last night. " She told us to say this. She is alive. She asked us to say that she is dead. The peaches which she ate weren't poisoned. The young girl gave it to her because she thought they would make her healthy. She didn't even chew them. I ate those peaches too. She is a lying witch. She even ordered us to go punish the young girl, and that girl is unmarried and no farmer's wife". The next thing I hear is the sound of breaking glass and a sword. slashing my body in two parts. I scream loudly but nobody bothers to save me. Was this the end i was planning for? Why do all my plans always go to waste? Why does everyone keep leaving me? I wake up in panic with my hands around my throat. I look in my surroundings and to my nightmare, I find myself in a stone tower instead of a hut. But the worst part is that I am tangled in long golden hair. I became Rapunzel now, you have got to be kidding me. I somehow untangle myself from the hair. I look for anyone but it looks like I am alone in this tower. I always wondered and thought about what if Rapunzel never let down her hair, what would happen then? Guess I got what I wanted didn't i? I can be away from my nagging mom, annoying sister and the classmates who ignore me and never talk to me... I go looking around everywhere to try and find something sharp. I found a sharp knife in the kitchen and moved it closer to my hair. Without feeling a single ounce of emotion, I cut my hair. It took a few slices. The long golden hair turned brown and fell to the ground, losing its magic. I pack those cutted hair in the bag and throw them away in a packet somewhere in the corner. Nobody can climb up this tower now. I go to the bed and try to sleep. My mom used to wake me up early for school, i used to hate it so much that sometimes I even cursed at her inside my head. After tossing and turning, I thought about painting something. I picked up the brush and dipped it in the paint. My sister and I used to paint a lot during summer holidays. I put the brush back down and move towards the library to distract myself with the books. I picked up a fairytale book and opened it. I still remember how I had a big fight with my best friend and made nasty comments about her choices in books which turned into a fight, and in the end I blamed it all on her. She never talked to me again after that. It was my fault but I was too proud to admit it. I was just pent up with everything and took it out on her. No wonder why everyone stays away from me... I close the book down without even reading a single word and move towards the kitchen. I open the cabinets and find some flour, eggs, sugar, chocolate and milk. my hands start to move on their own as my mind starts remembering the memories of my dad. We used to bake cookies, cakes, bread and many things together all the time. We used to be kitchen buds and competed with each other. but one day he just left me alone and made my whole life upside down. My friends also left me and as each day passed I grew more and more distant from people around me and started living in my own mind. I never wondered or worried about others. I never thought about what my mom and sister went through. They always stuck around me trying to make me happy and I assumed they were fine with dad leaving. I walk towards the window of the tower and look out. I am lonely but why am I not happy? I am free but at what cost? I can do anything but what's stopping me? It's like time has stopped inside the tower while the world outside the window is bright and joyful. The tower and my heart, mind and soul feel empty. Tears are flowing from my eyes as I look outside the window. I can't live alone. I miss my parents, my sister, my friends and everyone who tried to make me feel loved but I never understood them. I want to go back home. I want to be happy and understand others around me to make them happy. I want to leave this hell... Lady Therapist: So this is your third session with me, are you feeling better? Zora: Yeah I feel a bit better after each session. Lady Therapist: So Zora, any new things to report like nightmares or lack of interest? Zora: The nightmares have been less frequent now. They are still there but not as scary as before. Lady Therapist: How are you doing at your school? Zora: I apologised to Olivia about the whole library incident, as you said. I have been doing better at studies. Its still not enough but yeah I am better then before and at least not getting a zero, I guess? Lady Therapist: (smiling) Oh dear, that's great. Well did you initiate a conversation with people like I told you? Zora: Yeah i greeted a few people at school and tried to have a conversation with them. It will take time to become friends with them. Lady Therapist: I see. That aside you know you can tell me if your Mom forces you to study or anything like that. I will give her a good scolding. Zora: (laughing) Well being a older sister of my mom does have many perks. Lady Therapist: Yeah, true. Well do you wanna talk about your Dad? Zora: Well I can talk about him the whole day. He was the best person on the earth. Lady Therapist: I know. He would have loved to see how much older you have gotten. He must be proud of you Zora. Zora: Oh come on aunt, I am just thirteen. Well I am not sure if he is proud of me or not but I hope wherever he is right now, he always keeps guiding me. Lady Therapist: (smiling lovingly) You look like my annoying sister but behave like your Dad, I should thank her for not passing down her annoying habits in you. Zora: (laughing) Thanks for the compliment. Lady Therapist: Do you know your Dad was the one who decided your name? Zora: Yeah, I know he told me. Lady Therapist: Do you know that your name means 'Dawn' in several slavic languages? Zora: No I didn't knew that. Lady Therapist: Always remember Zora 'each dark night will end making way for a new dawn'. So never let yourself down dear and remember each dawn will put end to darkness and your problems making you stronger. The end or shall i say a new dawn...

title: A failure?
text: The alarm has to ring for Vondila to be awake is what her parents thought, but she is already awake, no she was never asleep to be awake. Her alarm rings to make her get ready to go to school, she gets up as she sees the mirror placed right in front of her showing her messy brunette bun, her tired drowsy hazel eyes, a ring of brown freckles around her button nose, bedsheet prints on her beige toned skin, a new headache greets her morning. She hisses as she roams her hand around the table to get her tablet bottle, then remembers that she has to get ready in a good dress because the school is celebrating its 25th anniversary day. She finally dresses and walks downstairs to see her parents. "Good morning?", Her father greeted but in a judgemental tone that made Vondila look up to her father who is already staring at her and her dress back and forth. " I ha-d to w-wear this dress because the school is celebrating its anniversary today ", Vondila stutters as she explains why she wore the dress. Her parents still not believing her give her the cold shoulder as she finally gets her breakfast and hurriedly swallows it. She mumbles a bye to her parents and rushes to go out. Vondila suddenly freezes as her mother asks, " Do you think we have no idea about your exam marks? ", "No i-i had studied but i couldn't write the exam properly b-because…", " Because? What? You had to go out to celebrate some other event?" " N- no-", Vondila gets cut off by a phone call her mom received. Vondila uses this as an opportunity to finally get out from that toxic, suffocating place. Why did she not do the exam properly, even after she studied till her nose bled?. Her mind zones out as she boards the bus. "Oh My God see this freak decked up so much, i wonder for who she is this prepared ", says her bully Stacy as Vondila enters. She sighs as she sits in her seat and her desk is filled with malicious comments and threats written by her bully. She suddenly feels cold as she looks up to see Stacy pouring her drink on her, " Something was missing but now i fixed it ", she goes back to her seat snickering along with other classmates. Vondila chuckles dryly, for her this happens everyday. She changes into another dress and goes to sit in the bleachers seeing everyone playing happily with their friends. " Today is a full games day, games are arranged in the gym area, food is in the canteen, enjoy students" Vondila reads aloud the notice stuck in the bulletin board. Time flies fast, the school rings the bell for dispersal. Students scatter around hallways and gate entrances. Vondila walks to the nearby park to refresh her mind, she is always anxious and maybe depressed?. Vondila suddenly remembers the card in her bag, hurriedly takes it and dials the number to call the person, Who is she calling?. "Hello?, This is Sunshine Counseling speaking, how may I help you ma'am?", a deep voice picks up the call. " I want …" Vondila mutters for a second then realizes what she is doing and quickly hangs up the call. " I almost exposed myself " she cautioned as she got up from the bench and walked her way back to her dungeon. The phone rings, successfully waking up Vondila from her slumber. "Hello? I am Felix from Sunshine counseling. Madam, do you want an appointment to meet the counsellor, please don't hesitate. You can attend one appointment if you dislike then we won't disturb you " a person humbly requests on the phone making Vondila melt for one second. She thinks and replies " One meeting won't hurt right? …. Ok i would like to meet him today whenever he's ready", " Great Von- Sorry Madam your appointment is at 6 pm, you know the address right? ", " Uhmm yes I know and please don't worry you can call me Vondila '', " Ok Vondila I am expecting you, have a nice day ", Vondila hears him chuckle and unknowingly it also brings a smile to her face. The door bangs as it opens with a force making Vondila flinch to death. "Vondila your dad's colleagues are here, can u please dress up and come down stairs and behave properly" her mom snapped as she gritted her teeth before slamming the door shut as she leaves Vondila in silence. " Aww Vondila grew so fast " cooed Mrs. Choi as she saw Vondila. Tick tock tick tock, every minute passes like an hour for Vondila as she sits on the couch zoning out while Mrs. Choi boasts about his son topping every single existing thing, her parents sending glazier glares to her every second. Her parents are one of the most talked about couples in the town because both are attorneys in big law firms but their daughter is the joke of the town because of how low she scores in subjects. Her parents are so conscious about their image resulting in them shouting and pressuring Vondila to score good. Vondila finally goes out and calls an uber to drop her at the counseling centre, scared she covers herself in black from head to heel so no one will recognise her, she didn't want to become the hot news of the town again. As she enters a sweet smell of vanilla invades her, strangely it calms her down better than any other company, she waddles her way to the reception. A blonde Male peeks and asks " Hello this is Felix how may i help you ", " I am Vondila i-i booked an appointment but i still didn't pay how much is it?. Felix recognises her that second as he warmly smiles and internally squeals at how cute she was in a padded jacket and a scarf. " Vondila you're here i expected u and u didn't turn me down", he exclaimed as Vondila chuckles awkwardly. '' Oh sorry I forgot to inform you of the fee, it's 1,500 dollars but we give a 30% discount for highschool students so 1,050 dollars, cash or card?", " Cash of course " she mumbles as she carefully counts her total allowance and gives the amount. " Perfect please wait for a few minutes. I will inform the doc you're here ". He sings out as he walks calmly to the room which Vondila suspects to be the doc's room. " Hi Vondila I am Haru, So how is your life going " Dr. Tanaka Haru greeted warmly as he smiles, Vondila looks up as she gulps and tries to bring her voice out but sweats profusely trying to. " Oh please calm down, you can share it after you settle down " he quickly adds on after seeing Vondila panic. " No umm sorry ", Vondila says as she calms down. " You ok right?" He was concerned about Vondila. "Yeah", she said dryly after correcting her posture. " So Vondila why are you here, what is disturbing you in your life?" Haru asked as gently as possible to avoid Vondila panicking again. " Honestly I don't know me doctor, why am I here, I am sad or maybe depressed, I don't know why but forever, I want to be young ", She said everything in one breath, her Life flashes between her eyes as her eyes swell up, she wipes them and continues. "I was once a topper my parents loved me, i am trying all my best and studying still now but i am not the topper that frustrates my parents as they really care about their no.1 image.'' "Did they abuse you?" Haru inquired, getting a reply from her, " not really but they talk real harsh words that sting a lot ", i understand he continued " Do your parents know about you coming here?", "No", Vondila replies, shaking as she again remembers that her parents don't know she is coming here. " Don't worry i can help you, i understand you for real", Haru says warmly igniting a warmness in Vondila's heart. They speak for some more time and Haru realizes how broken she is by her heart and is hiding it from everyone. " Vondila i want to meet your parents", Haru suddenly said making Vondila nervous. " Why?", "Because i will make them realize what they are doing is wrong ", "but", " No buts Vondila", Haru strictly says leaving no choice for Vondila but to nodd. " How should I say them" Vondila cries helplessly, "You don't have to say them i will meet them-" Haru gets cut off by Vondila's desperate where?. " In your house ", says Haru. "but -", Vondila gets cut off by Haru, " I don't like to repeat myself friend ", "Ok fine " Vondila surrenders hoping nothing will go wrong. Haru meets Vondila's parents and talks to them, surprisingly they understood Vondila's issue and promised Haru to send her to consellings often and they even promised to meet him in his clinic sometime to get proper parenting advice.Vondila was beyond happy. She was living her best life. Her parents were encouraging and motivating her more and turning down anyone who talks bad about her. The encouragement made her score good in school, and they no longer care about 1st Rank. On the other hand Vondila and Felix meet up more in parks as they open up and talk to each other and enjoy every moment. Vondila's parents meet up with Stacy and explain what she is doing is wrong, of course people don't correct it the first time. Stacy apologizes to students she has till now bullied, and tries to change. "Boo!" Felix jumpscares Vondila behind her back, making her flinch and look back. " Felix you scared me " she shouts as she beats him with as much force she can give. " OMG it's paining stop", Felix says sarcastically as he takes Vondila's hands and runs to the lake view spot. " It's so beautiful right?" asks Vondila gazing at the view in front of them. " The moon is beautiful isn't it? '' adds Felix to which Vondila nods in response. Felix rolls his eyes and asks " Are u happy Vondila " For which Vondila exclaimed saying yes. THE END

title: Juno and Ira
text: It was a stormy night. The parents were not at home. In the small cottage by the forest, Juno and Ira huddled close to fire. The wind howled and rattled the windows while the thunder shook their small home. Juno, went to the window and noticed the sky. It was dark. Huge flocks of birds were going one after the other across the sky. A herd of deer ran past their cottage in the same direction. Other animals followed their way. “Animals can sense natural calamities”, he thought. They must be running away to safety. Turning back to Ira, he said, “we have to go now. Something bad is going to happen. We better go outside”. It was pouring cats and dogs and they were soaking wet in no time. The rabbits ran past them. They were scared as leopards and tigers rushed past without even looking at them. And then, they heard a roar. It was a lion and he was coming this way. They ran into the forest and reached the edge of the cliff. There was nowhere to go. In a flash of a second, the ground gave in. Juno and Ira found themselves falling down the steep cliff. They screamed in terror. Instead of dark valley, underneath them was a strange green glow. A vast spaceship was rising up and within moments they found themselves caught by giant mechanical arms and pulled inside the ship. They found themselves standing in what looked like a theme park. There were monkeys riding the swings, horses having fun on the merry go rounds and cats managing ice cream parlors. Hippos played the trumpets while the lions roared and sang songs. Snakes hopped on trampolines and rabbits were busy cleaning the ground. Juno and Ira struggled to understand what was going on. They could hear animals talk, just like humans! They did not have to wait for long. A pelican flew up to them and asked them who they were and how they came inside. Juno told them that they were lost in the forest and Ira explained that they were being hunted by wild animals. The pelican started laughing and asked them to follow him. They walked into a cafeteria where he got them some tea and cakes. Juno and Ira ate hungrily. All the animals now came in to see what was going on. They all looked shocked seeing humans and started making a great fuss. “Silence”, said the mouse. His commanding and booming voice showed his rank and authority in dealing with such matters. The lion came forward and apologized to the mouse saying that it was his roar that led to this issue but he was only calling the animals back to the ship as the earth time had ended. Juno asked what this meant. The mouse explained that long back all the animals along with humans came to earth from a distant paradise on an intergalactic trip but the humans fought with all, believing themselves to be superior and started killing animals as soon as they reached earth. They multiplied by millions and destroyed the nature. They multiplied by millions and destroyed the nature. The humans spoiled the seas, the land and the sky. Now the place was dead and animals are going back leaving the humans here on earth. Ira wept as she realized the truth in these words. Juno, with his eyes down cast and head bent asked the mouse if nothing could be done. The mouse said, “What is done can be undone if only humans can see the reality. We are all but one. No one is big or small. We are all alive and to live for each other is the only thing that needs to be done. Any place where we live deserves our respect and care, be it earth or paradise”. The animals agreed in unison. Juno and Ira wiped their tears and hugged all the animals. The ship rose gently into the night sky and all the animals waved good bye to Juno and Ira as they were beamed back safe and sound to their home at the edge of the forest.

title: A Thirst To Be Quenched
text: Betty woke up instantly, hearing Tea meow fiercely. Numbness in her legs and a dryness in the throat overcame her, but she pushed past the feeling of defeat and rose from the soil drenched in poisonous bay water. Remorsefully, she packed up the tent, regretting not staying up the night as planned. Perhaps she could have found water or bread if luck was on her side, but it seemed luck had abandoned her. As Betty was moving away from the Bureau, Tea was right beside her, like always. She heard the 6 AM announcement from the loudspeakers in each street, which played daily for the past eight months since the floods had gotten worse. She mouthed along mockingly, " Attention to all the residents of the Island of Hawaii. Due to the rise in water levels and extreme acidity of water, the island is cordoned off. Request all residents to stay at home and follow the guidelines. Food and water are available for all in your nearest bureau. If your property lies near the harbour and is facing flooding, report to your nearest bureau for accommodation on higher grounds. Thank you and hope you all have a good morning ahead.” Betty was not having the best morning, devoid of water to quench her parched throat. She urgently needed a plan. Hunting in the woods might yield a mutated animal or two, but little water. Returning to the Bureau to search for overlooked bottles seemed futile. Overwhelmed, she collapsed to the ground, drained of her remaining energy. Tea settled on her lap, offering solace. One man dismissed it as a raccoon causing trouble, relieving Betty. They resumed walking, leading her towards the water, or perhaps a more dangerous location. Finally, she spotted a large container bearing the gang’s symbol in the heart of the forest. She was so pleased that she lost track of her conscience and started walking recklessly towards the water. She felt the guard’s gaze fix on her. The guard hadn't spoken yet, but Betty realized that she wouldn't be able to escape, if caught. She pivoted and ran away. Tea started pacing in front of her. She kept running, not looking back for a second. Tea was way ahead of her now. This was unusual. He was a follower, not quite a leader. He started sprinting at top speed with his short limbs. Betty wasn’t able to keep up with him. She tripped over a tree root. She felt a sharp pain in her ankle. She had fallen down many times before to know well enough to keep her arm over her head to avoid a concussion, but the pain from her leg was ringing in her head. She was lying motionless on the swampy mud about to die of dehydration, and Tea was nowhere to be seen. Betty knew better than to close her eyes, but she gave in. She just wanted to rest forever. Soon everything went black. Betty opened her eyes to a dimly lit room. She was covered in sheets, lying on a comfortable bed. The strangest was the fact that she was not thirsty. After experiencing momentary peace, she came back to her senses. Where was she? How did she get here from the woods? Why was she not thirsty anymore? Had she drunk the poisonous water? In which case she had to be hospitalised immediately. Where was Tea? She felt overwhelmed by all those questions, but as soon as she got up and started looking around, she found the answer to one question. Tea was sleeping on a chair peacefully. title: Beboo The Bird
text: One day a beautiful 9- year old girl named Olivia, and her dad was at the pet shop. “Sweetie, there is no pet bird here.” said dad. “But I always wanted a pet bird” said Olivia. They were about to leave the store, but suddenly Olivia’s pair of eyes met a cute bird in the corner. It was yellow in colour, had soft feathers, yellow crest hair and red coloured cheeks on both sides. It was so cute that anybody could take him. “Dad look!” said Olivia. “oh! It’s a bird!” said dad. “Can we please buy it?” asked Olivia. “Yes!” said dad. Olivia became very happy and excited. Once they got home the bird was looking quite happy. Olivia and her family was sitting in the living room and thinking a name for the bird. “Piku!!” said Olivia. “It’s not a matching name for the bird.” Said the older brother of Olivia. “How about Birdie?” said the younger Twins, Madison and Mason. “Beboo!” said Olivia’s dad. Everyone liked the name and agreed to it. “I like it” said Mason. Olivia was so happy she took care and loved him. One day when Olivia and her family was getting ready to go to their relative’s house, Madison took Beboo out of the cage to play with him. “Hey Beboo! Don’t you want to play with me?” said Madison. She took Beboo in her hands. “Madison stop!” said Olivia. But suddenly The window was open and Beboo flown away. Olivia’s eyes teared up when she saw her bird flown away. “What did you do?” said Olivia. “I am sorry it was an accident.” Said Madison. Hearing all this noise her parents and her brother came to the room. “What happened?” asked her parents. “Mom, Beboo flown away!” said Olivia. They were all shocked. “Oh no! wait Madison Oliva, did you see which direction did he went?” asked Dad. “yes he went that way” Madison pointed where he is gone. Her father immediately went to that place and started searching for him. But there was no sign of him. Olivia’s dad came back to home and said “Olivia dear, I couldn’t search him anywhere”. Olivia was so sad she even cried so much. After some days, when Olivia was coming back home after playing with her friend Wendy, her mother said “Olivia, your grandparents are coming today!!”. Olivia got so happy to meet her grandparents. “Mom, where is dad?” Olivia asked. “your dad has gone to pick up your grandparents” said Mother. She said okay and went to take a shower. After she came back from her shower, her grandmother and her father entered the house. Olivia was so happy she hugged her grandmother. “Oh sweetie, it’s been a long time.” Said grandmother. “Yes, grandma” said Olivia. “I heard that your pet bird flown away.” Said grandmother. “Yes grandma I was so sad that day.” said Olivia “Where is grandpa?” Olivia asked. “There he is!” Said grandma. The moment what Olivia saw was her grandfather coming inside with a yellow bird exactly like her Beboo. “Hey Olivia, look who’s here!” said grandpa. “Whoa, is it Beboo?” Asked Olivia. “No, it’s not Beboo but it’s her sister” said dad. “oh my god!” said Madison and Mason. Olivia became happy and said- “thanks everyone I love it!”. “I’m going to call her Beboo two!” said Olivia. And everyone laughed. THE END. HI THERE!

title: THE PURSUIT OF HAPPINESS
text: Once upon a time, a crow was very unhappy with his life. One day he started crying while sitting on a branch of a tree. A monk was sitting under the tree; just then a drop of the crow’s tears fell on the monk’s cheek. The monk raised his head and saw that a crow was crying. The monk asked him, “What’s the matter, my friend, why are you crying”? The crow said, “Oh wise monk, I am very upset with my life, no one loves me people shoo me away in disgrace, no one gives me anything to eat everyone hates me. Death is better than such life”. Hearing the crow’s words, monk’s heart was filled with compassion. He said to the crow, “my friend, we should learn to be happy in whatever condition we are in. I can make you that with my mantras”. Crow became happy and said, “Oh blessed one, if you want to do me a favour then please make me a swan. The monk said, “ok I will make you a swan but first go to swan and ask him whether he is happy with his life or not and you go and find out till then I wait for you here “. Crow happily flew away to meet swan. He saw a swan swimming in a pond. He went to swan and said how beautiful you are, you are as white as milk everyone loves you; you must be the happiest bird in the world. Swan said to crow with a sad heart that no my friend I am not happy, there so many beautiful colours in the world but I do not have any colour and white is nothing a colour. I think parrot must be the happiest bird in the world, he is so colorful. Hearing this, the crow flew away from there and reached the parrot. He said to parrot, Oh parrot, you are so colorful and beautiful, you must be the happiest bird in the world. The parrot said to crow with a sad heart said, no my friend, I am not happy you see people keep parrots in cage. I am always afraid that someone may hold me and lock me in a cage. I think the peacock is the happiest bird in this world. He is also much more colorful than me. Hearing this crow flew around looking for a peacock. After searching for a long time he finally got a peacock which was in a cage in a zoo. He saw that hundreds of people gathered to see him. After the people left, the crow approached the peacock and said, dear peacock you are so beautiful, everyday thousands of people come to see you and look at me, when people see me, they immediately shoo me away. I think you must be the happiest bird on the planet. The peacock replied sadly, I always thought that I was the most beautiful and happy bird on the planet but because of my beauty I am entrapped in this zoo. When people pluck my colorful feathers to make decorative items it hurts me a lot. The peacock took a deep breath and said, I am not happy my friend. The crow was surprised to hear this from peacock, he asked him, if you are not happy then whom do you think the is the happiest bird in the world? The peacock said, I have examined the zoo very carefully and I have realized that you the crows are only the bird not kept in the cage, people do not try to catch you and entrap you in the cage. So, for the past few days, I was thinking that if I were a crow I could roam everywhere and I would be free. Hearing this, the crow flew way from there and today for the first time he was feeling happy to be a crow. He came back to the sage and said, Oh! Wise man, I do not want to be anything else. I am fine what I am. If you see our lives we will find that this problem too. We make comparison with others and then we become sad and curse ourselves. We do not tell you what we have and this all leads to vicious cycles of unhappiness. You should learn to be happy in what you have instead of looking what you do not have, there will always be someone who will have more or less than you have. If you keep comparing yourself to others you will never be happy. A person who is satisfied with what he or she has is the most happiest person in the world.

title: The Riddle
text: It was a hot summer day and Ranji was sitting underneath the shade of a giant banyan tree with her four closest friends. Actually, her four only friends. They’d met each other just this summer through Ramlal Ji, a trusted former pandit in the town. Everyone adored him- kids and adults alike. They were waiting for Uncle Ramlal to get there. Sameer, lounging comfortably below the tree that Ravi and Sonia were trying to climb and Meera reading her storybook in the cool cover of it. They all seemed content and not too troubled by the wait but Ranji was getting impatient. She kept frantically looking around in all directions waiting for Babu Ramlal to appear. She had nothing to do and not going to school was driving her crazy so the daily riddle that Ramlal gave the five of them had quickly become the highlight of her day. The five of them had been keeping score and seeing who could solve the most amount of riddles in the shortest amount of time. So far, it had been a week of riddles and Ranji was leading the scoreboard with a glorious four. The rest of them had each gotten one point, except Ravi, who was quite disheartened by his constant losing but tried not to let it show. His frustration when he didn’t win even once in the last seven days was evident at first but then carefully hidden, so that no one would know the extent of his disappointment. Ranji knew he was a smart guy and believed in him fully. She was confident that he’d win one day. But the competitive side of her didn’t mind if it wasn’t today. “He’s here!” Sonia shouted from where she had climbed the tree. Ravi was above her by at least three feet. “Last one down is a rotten egg!” she shouted to him to which he replied by shouting, “That’s not fair, you loser!” The two hurried and were down by the time Uncle Ramlal sat well with his legs crossed. They made a circle around him and showered him with their excited greetings. They were always happy to see him. “What do you have for us today, Babu?” Sameer asked. Ramlal Ji gave a genuine smile- the kind that makes wrinkles appear around your eyes- and replied, “This one’s quite tricky.” “You say that everytime!” pointed out Meera. And it was true- he did. He’d say that every time he gave them a mystery. Even on the first day, when the answer came just two minutes later by Sonia. The more there is, the less you see. “Darkness!” she’d replied, excitedly, as soon as the epiphany came to her. And on the second day, when Meera had forced them to gather around barely 45 minutes after they each went back home because she swore she had the answer. One winter day, there was a man standing in the middle of someone’s front yard. The person stayed there for several weeks without moving and the owner of the yard didn’t mind. Eventually the man left. Who was he? “It’s a snowman. It didn’t leave, it just melted!” A pat on Meera’s back by Babu Ramlal told them it was the right answer. The third day, it was Sameer who figured out the answer first. And after three whole days of not winning, Ranji was quite annoyed. She wanted that marvellous moment of realisation, and that pat on the back. She wanted to be the one sporting a smug smile on her face after she had her victory. That day, she went home and researched all she could about solving mysteries. Books, TV shows, riddles on the internet. And thereon started her winning streak. Four days of relentless winning had earn ed her quite a reputation. If she won today as well, it would be the fifth day of the streak. And she was determined to not let her run of luck end “Listen close, then. “Easy to break, but not easy to mend. You wear it as a bracelet sometimes. You keep it close so that it lasts. It gets better with more and more time.” “WINE!” Sonia said without thinking. “No, no. A wine bottle!” she amended, but it didn’t matter when Ravi pointed out, “You can’t wear a wine bottle as a bracelet, you dumbo.” with a roll of his eyes. Ranji started writing the riddle down to decode it better. Sameer got to his feet and started pacing back and forth. Meera sat staring off in the distance, deep in thought. The terms of this mystery solving session was that they’d stay in the group for ten minutes after the riddle had been given. Then they’d go back home and meet whenever one of them had an answer. Use of the internet and reference books was strictly prohibited. Fortunately, none of them were quite such dishonest children and had great guilty consciences. Sameer might seem a bit mischievous but winning through unfair means didn’t sit well with him either. If no one had an answer by 8 o’clock in the night, Uncle Ramlal would reveal the answer. They hadn’t been doing this long enough for that to happen and Ranji was determined to let it not happen at all. Ten minutes passed by and they all dispersed home. What do you wear as a bracelet, if not a bracelet itself? thought Meera. What object gets better with time if not wine? Sonia seemed to be convinced she was on the right path with her original answer. A glass choodee could be the answer to the first half but what about that second half? pondered Ranji. At one point, Sameer ended up becoming so frustrated with the riddle, he almost gave in and looked up the answer but just the thought of Babu Ramlal finding out about it- which Sameer was convinced he would since that old man seemed to know everything somehow- was awful, so he stayed right where he was. It was different with Ravi, though. He was done with these riddles. He already felt inferior to his friends and he was certain that all of this had convinced them that he wasn’t smart enough so why bother trying? Ranji was going to be the one to win anyways. Hours passed by and no one came up with the answer. Ramlal was certainly surprised to find so. Ranji was annoyed at herself. Sameer had given up trying. Sonia, too. Meera was losing her mind wondering what object it could be. And Ravi- who had not been trying at all- was stuck thinking about the absurdity of the situation. This riddle thing had become such an important part of their days. In fact, it was what brought all of them together in the first place. Now, even though not much time had passed, he knew he considered the four his best friends. And suddenly, there was the answer. Suddenly, it struck him that it wasn’t an object at all. He called all four of his companions and Uncle Ramlal to the banyan tree. Once they were there, he spoke. “Friendship.” Context wasn’t needed, Ramal just knew. The smile on his face proved it so. The four kids caught up too and Meera spoke the riddle out loud. “Easy to break, but not easy to mend. You wear it as a bracelet sometimes. You keep it close so that it lasts. It gets better with more and more time.” “Friends are hard to make and easy to lose. A well known fact.” Sameer said, putting the pieces of Ravi’s answer together. “A bracelet refers to the kind we wear on friendship day.” Meera added. “Friendships grow with time and when you actually make an effort to keep those friends. Another thing that ages better with time, apart from wine of course.” That was Sonia’s input. “Wonderful!” spoke Babu Ramlal. “One point for our dear Ravi.” Victory felt sweet. The three of them congratulated him and showered him with compliments. He smiled but there was still someone who hadn’t spoken. And contrary to what Ravi thought, Ranji wasn’t mad at him for winning. How could she be? She was proud of him and fascinated by how he’d gotten the answer. Besides, she’d be a pretty bad friend if she wasn’t happy for him. It would be ironic considering the answer to the day’s riddle. Her pride could take one day of losing if it meant seeing a genuine happy smile on her friends' faces. Ravi’s worries melted away when Ranji turned to him and gave him a challenging smile. “Looks like I’ve found my worthy opponent now.” Victory felt sweeter then.
author: Saanvi Jawa

title: Trip to Badrinath
text: In October me and my family went to Badrinath. We started the trip on first of October. We first went to Haridwar by cab, it was a seven-seater cab. My sister and I were reading the whole journey. The driver was very friendly, he talked with us the whole journey. My mother, aunt, grandmother and my uncle were gossiping with the driver the whole time it was a five-hour route. In between we stooped and were going to a restraunt to eat our lunch the name of the restraunt was shankar ka dhaba. My sister and I ate a cheeseburger. My mother and my grandmother ate Missi ki roti, sambar, dry potato vegetable the non-spicy one and the spicy one. My aunt and my uncle ate Idli Sambar. After exactly one hour thirty-seven minutes and fifty-seven seconds we reached our destination. We played Atlas for that much time. Then we went to see the Har Ki Podi puja in between a sea snake came in the water it's colour was black it went away quickly. After the puja we drank some tea and ate some biscuits (including my sister because she doesn't usually drink tea). We went to where we needed to stay at night, it was an Ashram. we had dinner there we also had a temple inside there was free space so me and my sister played there. Then we slept at nine 'o' clock. The next day we booked a cab and started climbing Badrinath this time the cab was a twelve-seater we were going up while eating and sleeping. It took us fourteen hours to reach our hotel. The hotels name was Eshvar Bhavan it was the worst hotel in India. We stayed there for two days. There was a river behind the hotel. We did puja of Badrinath ji and returned to Haridwar. It took us twelve hours for us to reach to Haridwar we stayed at Hotel King. We ate our dinner there, we ate paneer ki sabji and roti. there was no A/C still it was cold. The next day we got ready and catched a train that led us to our city Delhi. We reached at Delhi railway station at twelve we booked a cab and reached our home.

title: What does Nana do?
text: Tani was very happy. Nani and Nana had come to spend a few days with them. On every visit, Nani bought a new story book for Tani and read to her from it. Tani enjoyed story time with Nani. Nani chose story books with activities. After reading the story, Nani and Tani had fun doing the activities in the book. One page had pictures of grown-ups doing some work. The reader had to write what work each one was doing. While doing the activity, Tani asked, "What does Nana do?" Nani smiled. "He grows fragrance!" "Fragrance? what is fragrance?" Tani asked. "Nice smell." Said Nani. "How does he grow nice smell?" Tani wanted to know. "By growing fragrant flowers, herbs and spices." Nani explained. "Yes Nani! The flowers you and mummy wear in your hair smell so nice! I too want to grow up and grow fragrance like Nana." Said Tani. "You don't have to grow up to do that!" Nani laughed. Nana was very pleased to know Tani wanted to grow fragrance like him. Next day, he took her to the local plant nursery. Tani came to know what things she would need and how she could start growing fragrance! She returned home with some pots of beautiful fragrant flowers. After a few days, Nana and Nani went back to their house. Tani's love for growing fragrance kept growing! Soon she had many nice smelling flowers and herbs growing in pots. She even started gifting her pots of fragrant flowers and herbs. Friends and neighbors were happy to receive Tani's beautiful and sweet smelling gift. Some of them started growing fragrance in a pot like Tani. For New Year, Tani and some of her friends decided to gift their home grown fragrance to all the teachers and principal of the school. Tani made lovely gift tags too. The teachers and principal were very pleased with the gifts. The Principal asked Tani, "How did it all start?" What was her answer? 'It all started with Nani reading to me a story activity book!" Said Tani. "Yes. Stories can make you do wonderful things." Said the Principal.
author: Shahin Ashraf Ali

title: My Passion and My Dreams
text: I am Mandelou Bankole, from Nigeria. I am from a really small town, which most people are not aware of.I also have a sister, Sanrou Bankole. She is three years older than me. Growing up me and my sister were very different from eachother, even though we were sisters. Sanrou was an intelligent nerd, who was always rude to me and was our mom,s favourite. But,I was quite opposite of her, I was an adventurous, boisterous girl who liked to explore new things,and was my dad,s favourite.In my town there was some old tradition, the tradition of marrying daughters in their mid twentys. I totally hated this tradition. Our mother always told us how we will get married when we grow up. These words were unbearable for me, I always used to get angry whenever she told this. Mom always told me to be more “Lady Like”.But my dad was always against it. He always liked me the way I was and loved me unconditionally.One day, I was trying to climb a tree in our backyard, and then I heard mom,s voice, “ Mandelou, stay away from that tree and quickly climb down, trees are not for girls to climb, you look like a monkey!”, mom hissed at me, as I was trying to climb the tree. “It,s okay, let her play” said dad.”She is acting like a boy and is becoming like a one day by day. She doesn,t act like a girl, she acts like a boy. Who will marry her?” mom yelled at dad.”She is just a kid.” said dad. Mom went inside the house furiously.Dad turned to me and said “ Love, I,m sorry that you had to go through this. Always stay the way you are and never change.You are perfect the way you are and don,t let anybody,s words change it, don,t let other people,s opinion affect you”.These words touched my heart and it motivates me to this day. When I turned thirteen, I starting gaining interest in boxing. Dad watched boxing everyday and I also watched with him. I wanted to become a boxing campion.I groveled to my mom to send me to a boxing club, but as always the answer was no.” Boxing is not for girls, Mandelou.”I was devasted by such answer. So, I started practicing in home. And as expected, I broke a lot of things, perhaps this is why people say not practice at home. One time I broke my sister,s favourite vase, and she was not happy about it. Other time I broke an antique, which was very special to mom. “Oh my god! What have you done! This obstinate child, I am tired of her, just take her to a boxing club or she will burn the whole house down.”And there I was in a boxing club, ready to start my journey to achieve my dream.When I entered the boxing club everyone was starring at me in shock,perhaps because I was the only girl there. They didn,t expect a girl to be here. One guy even started mocking me, saying I am too weak or boxing isn,t for girls. I went up to the guy and gave him a tight punch. He fell down to the ground. Everyone was too shocked to speak. They didn,t expect a girl to be that strong (all thanks to the training I did at home). After that nobody ever tried to mess with me.I practiced at the club day and night to achieve my dream.By the time I reached eighteen, I became the strongest in the club, literally, I was invincible. Nobody could defeat in the club.One day when I reached home and heard the most shocking news, Sanrou, my sister was getting married.” Sanrou!, you can,t get married. You are just twentyone, you are very young to get married. You are a young, intelligent and hardworking girl. You can achieve something in your life, don,t get married and waste your life. I reckon, you can be better than this.” I said to my sister, in hopes of stopping her. I don't want to be a useless person like you and by the way my fiance is very rich said my sister in return. I tried stopping her but eventually, I was in despair of stopping her. Then Sanrou sad “If you want to waste your life you can,but don't you dare interfere in my life or else you are going to get in big trouble.” then she went to her room in irritation.I was really hurt by her words so, to lift my mood up I went to the boxing club to practice, and there I found a poster, a poster of a boxing tournament taking place in the city nearby. I hastily submitted my name and guess what, after a week the results came in and I was selected. I was at the cloud nine hearing this. I couldn't believe that this was happening to me. I told my father about it and him and I were dancing in happiness. The tournament was two months later. I practiced day and night for those two months. At the day of the tournament I was really nervous.My dad came to me and said “It doesn't matter if you win or lose, only thing that matters is that you dared to dare, so go and give your best” and just after that my name was called. I went upto the boxing arena but this time I was calm and confident after what my dad said to me. My opponent was Nimal. The match started and my opponent was defeated by me in just just two fists. After that I defeated every opponent very smoothly like butter and won the tournament. My dad was very delighted to hear this news and threw a huge party for my victory. After that tournament, my confidence grew and I started participating in all the tournaments. Next day, after the victory, when I went to the boxing club everyone was applauding for me and was congratulating me. That was the best thing ever happened to me in the boxing club. My sister's wedding was now six months later but,I didn't care, because if she wants to waste her life she can nobody is going to stop her. She will surely come back to her senses and will regret marrying. The tournament that I won was the starting of my career. I won all the tournaments which I participated in and I was now playing at the nationals. In my final match at the nationals I was starting to lose hope but something provoked me, provoked me to not to lose.Perhaps I was thinking about the harsh words which came out of my mother's mouth saying that I can never be anything except a useless piece of garbage. This thought provoked me and I punched my opponent in anger continuously till I won. I won the nationals and now I was going to play at the international level.But at that time after winning the match only one thing was coming into my mind about how I proved my mother wrong.Eventually I was selected to play at the international level and there I was, ready to win.I was representing my country, Nigeria proudly. I fought like I was fighting for my life and I won all the matches and won the internationals. I felt very proud of myself.When I returned to my home town,I heard everybody applauding for me, even my mother and my sister. This was the best feeling in the whole world for me. I felt so special​. I spent my whole life in delve of finding acceptance and love, from my mother and my sister and I finally got it.Also, my mother and my sister apologized to me, about how they treated me in the past and requested for a second chance, and even though they treated me very badly in the past,I still gave them a chance, because everybody deserves a second chance but not a third one.​ Later, I came to know that my sister had a divorce and her marriage broke. My mother then understood, why it is so important to have a career. While my sister was running for getting married,I was running to achieve my boxing dream. Even though many people told me not to be a boxer, I still became a boxer and now, the same people are applauding for me. I became an inspiration for many young girls. I am Mandelou Bankole and I never gave up on my dreams, and neither should you.
author: Fakeha Akhtar
