title: Smart Sundaran
text: This is a cute and a funny story about a small boy who learns about various types of bugs that he sees in his Garden. When you read this story it will kindle your childhood memories. There was a boy named Sundaran who lived in the country of Bulgaria in Europe. He was studying in 1st Std. His home had a beautiful garden with flowers of rainbow colors. He used to admire his garden from his bedroom window before going to school. He played in the garden every Sunday after having his breakfast. One day when he was playing in his garden with his ball, the ball fell near a bush. When he went to take the ball he saw a beautiful bug with round red body and blackspots on it. It was a lady bird Beetle. He did not know what insect was that, so he asked the insect " Who are you? ". It said, "I am a Ladybug". He then asked, " Where is your house?". It said, "The Leaves are my house". Then he asked, "Can't you fly?".It said, "Yes, I can fly". Saying this, Ladybug flew away. After drinking water, he and his mother planned to plant a mango sapling. When he started to dig he saw a reddish pink worm in the soil. He got frightened and showed this to his mother. She told him, it is a Earthworm. Earthworms are called as "Farmer's Friend" as they help the soil to become fertile and thus helps in growing healthy plants. After having his lunch he went to play in the garden, at that time he saw a beautiful insect with colorful wings and asked his mother about it. His mother replied, "It is a Butterfly". She explained him about the life cycle of butterfly. She also said that there are one lakh varieties of butterflies and their wings are covered with tiny scales that make then look beautiful. Then he saw a honey bee sitting on a flower. He asked," Who are you and what are you doing here?".It said, "I am a Honeybee, I have come to suck nectar from the flowers and take it to the Honey comb". It was very beautiful day for Sundaran as he learned about different insects in his beautiful garden and also understood the importance of mother nature.
author: Kavvin krish Vinothkumar

title: Trading Jokes (Part-1)
text: “Mother, there is nothing to do.” said James who was 12 years old. His mother replied, “Why don’t you join your uncle as his apprentice?” “Hmm that’s a good idea. I will ask him about it.” replied James. He went to his uncle John and asked, “Uncle Can I join you as your apprentice in trading?” His uncle answered, “Why not, you could learn to earn a living.” They set off. On the way uncle John said to him, “First I started my business from a little shop and then made many big companies. So, I will first show you that little shop and start from there. “Ok.” When they reached their destination uncle John said, “Here we are, the little shop from where I started my business.” When James got off, he screamed. His uncle asked him “What is the problem, James.” James said, “Dead fishes.” His uncle laughed “Ha ha ha, this is the shop I told you about. I started with this fish shop.” “What, this is the shop! These dead fishes stink. This is so bad that I want to go number two.” “Don’t say like that, this is where my luck started.” “Are you kidding me?” “James you will have to start from here.” James said okay in a not so interesting way. He used a clip to block his nose. He asked “What do I have to do?” “Wash the fishes and then start cutting those fishes. You will have to cut the eyes and other useless parts of the fish.” was the reply. James looked at the dead fishes and said “Yuck!”. His uncle forced him to cut the fishes. “Uncle why is the eye useless to fishes.” asked James. “I didn’t mean that the eyes are useless to the fishes. I mean that when we humans eat fishes we don’t eat their eyes. Understood! You will have to cut out those parts of the fish which we don’t eat.” “Alright.” “I will come after a while. Do as I told you, okay.” “Okay.” After a while Uncle John returned back to the fish shop and was shocked at the sight that lay before him. He asked James “What are you doing?” James replied “Uncle you told me to cut out those parts of the fish which we doesn’t eat. I figured out that all the parts are needed for the fish like you said about the eyes. The fins help to swim. The tail makes a force from the back to go forwards. The body holds the digestive system, heart and so on. The mouth is needed for swallowing its food and the gills for breathing underwater. I couldn’t find a part that was edible, and I also figured out that they don’t have nose. Since, I couldn’t figure out an edible part of the fish I threw every fish away”. Uncle John shouted, "Noooo!"
author: Danyl Antony  Jose

title: WHEN I GOT LOST IN THE INTERNET
text: “RAJ! Why have you not completed your homework? It is your third time this week. Go stand outside the class right NOW” I just got detention from our Maths teacher. But I don’t mind (you see, by now I am used to this). I just want to go home and check my Instagram count. Oh No! In detention, I am even going to miss my Art period. I love Art period, mainly because the Teacher makes it so interactive. Art period starts and I am still standing outside the class. Hahahahehehe I can hear the laughs in the class, my nerves rattling with FOMO like crazy! “Ooh! Rhea, what are you laughing at? Share it with the class. Let us see if others also laugh like a silly parrot. Because you are.” That’s Ms. Gayatri, our Art teacher. She’s very fond of children and really funny. It was just yesterday that she made us all burst into laughter. The thing was that normally, Rohan and Rhea (my enemies) would make funny cartoons on her but yesterday, she made a Literal cartoon of them! The class laughed like crazy. Children in the class call her ‘ Mrs. Funnybones’. Now you know why. After what appears to be 2000 hours in detention, I can finally go home. As I enter, I hear the usual screams by Mommy Dearest- “RAJ! RAJ! COME HERE RIGHT NOW!” I knew it. The not so good Maths teacher has told mommy that I got detention. Here comes the usual- “You know nothing… I told you not to stay glued to the screen all day… Think about your future…” The thing is that Mommy Dearest, Dad, Priya didi and I, Raj Sharma (not that Raj) just shifted here from Ahmedabad a few months ago. I don’t like it here in New Delhi, cars all around and you can always hear people shouting. It smells like rotten food here and everywhere you go, Honk! Honk! is the only thing you hear. I miss my old friends and have not been able to make new friends here. But I am a superstar, I have 6021 followers on Instagram, Just 11 more than Priya Didi. I consider this an achievement. I take off my shoes and lay down on the couch with my tablet. I have to check my Followers count. What about that Netflix series I left last night? I have to find out about the ending. I just unlocked a new map in Clash of Clans. But first, I have to finish mining in Minecraft. I have got so much to do! And mommy Dearest says I am never busy! Huh! “RAJ KUMAR SHARMA! Put that tablet DOWN and complete your homework” “Just a second mommy” “You are going to get your eyes strained. Do you want to wear spectacles?” “No mommy, I will leave it soon” I don’t understand why everyone keeps telling me I will have to wear spectacles soon. I leave the tab and sit down at the dinner table. Mom’s new friend Anu Aunty is also here for dinner, but with her son, Mr. Encyclopedia. Could this day get any worse? “Did you know that Flies taste their food with their feet and mice are the kings of pooping” Mr. Encyclopedia blurted out to me. The day just got worse. I tried to control myself from vomiting all the food on the aunties, and sad as it is, I did control myself. I can’t tolerate being around this Mr. Encyclopedia. That’s not his real name of course, but just something I made up, because I don’t know his real name and never bothered to ask. So after finishing the nasty conversation with Mr. Encyclopedia about why a cockroach can live for a month without its head and can be pregnant its entire life and the long talk with Anu aunty about my future, I go to my couch and lay down again. Time to watch some reels! After about two hours of scrolling, in one of the reels I see something fishy… After about two hours of scrolling, in one of the reels I see something fishy… Is that figure coming out of the phone? Is mommy’s pasta acting up on me? Am I being delusional? What…in the…world…I am falling…. Falling….AAAAAAAAAA AAAAAAH! DUM! DUM! BANG! THUD! I open my eyes. What is this in front of me? It’s a whole new world… It smells like… um..Metal? ZOOM! ZOOM! Are those robots? There are screens all around me. Is that Whatsapp? Raj, get hold of yourself, this can’t be real. Wait, there’s Facebook, and Twitter and Discord? What is this place? It feels like I just stepped into the future. “This IS the future! It’s the world of INTERNET!” Beep Boop Beep Boop… comes a robot looking figure, with a big floating body and eyes on a screen that change expressions. Woah! It’s fascinating! Looks like a future version of the Alexa. It has not been 5 minutes since I am here and I already LOVE this place. It’s the place of my dreams- Now I can go and check what the INTERNET is like. “Can you take me to the INSTAGRAM corner please?” “Yes sir” I am still fascinated by this Robot looking figure. But that is till I see there are more of him all around me. “So what do you do here?” “We work! So that people like you can have the best experience using the Internet” “WOW” my eyes gaze as he walks THROUGH people “Here we are” What I see in front of me is unexplainable. There are screens all around and in those screens I can see flashes of The world of INSTAGRAM. I have to show this to my 6021 followers. “You can even see your account here” The Guide said. “I would love it!” He swipes through the accounts and I see my own, WOW, I just gained 4 more followers. I love this place. There are apps and robot guides walking. There are screens and trains all around. “What are the trains for?” I asked the Robot guide “They are used to travel the information and social data all around” “Social data?” Just as he is about to answer my question, he is cut off by a rather weird looking figure. I can’t see him clearly but he looks like one of those weirdos on Instagram who wear flashy clothes just for the sake of reels. He is rather short, I see the legs which are covered by flashy shoes and loose pants. As he comes closer, I see… wait what? No, it can’t be… The person has an actual square body with a face. He has the LOGO of Instagram on his body and is wearing a cape. The figure is freaking INSTAGRAM! Guide confirmed the fact by introducing me to him. “I - I - I don’t have words, I am so happy to meet you, My entire life is based on you” “Well…. That’s what the 3 billion of my users say” I can’t believe it, It feels literally like a dream to me… After some time, he says “Well I have to go right now, but Guide, take him to the lab as soon as possible” The lab? We have our goodbyes and come back to the place with trains all around. I notice that there are other apps there too and some people like me. The guide then starts with the real work- “So Raj, now I will take you to the place you have been called here for.” “Ok” He took me to a place different from the rest, It had a flashy entrance saying ‘THE TEST’. As we went in, the passage became darker and darker, quite ironical to the entrance. The room looks as white as milk and that somehow seems odd. There I find another figure, this time a bald headed, human-like figure but with robot-like characteristics. “Welcome, Raj! I was waiting to meet you. You can call me Rob.” I look back, Guide isn’t there, I am alone in the room with this Mr. Rob. “Come, have a seat” I sit down and then Rob begins “So you love the internet, right?” I nod. “What do you love more- Using the internet or Outdoor activities?” “Of course- Using the Internet” “That’s our goal, we here want to make everyone LOVE the internet! Why will you want to play basketball on the ground when you can just play it on your phone sitting at home? Why will you want to go to school when you can just study online sitting at home? Why will you want to make friends when you can just spend time with our Artificial Intelligence?” No, that’s not right. There are others things except the internet too. We can’t be glued to the screens all day. This is cruel. Then Rob continues “ There’s no use of anything except the internet, so we want to make screen time 100% for everyone. That’s why you are here. We are conducting a special test on humans to record their social data and use that to make them leave everything and use the internet for all things. I am telling you this because looking at your internet activity, you look like the perfect first candidate for this” And before I know it, I am wrapped with wires and a special helmet recording my social data. “NO, I AM NOT doing this! There is a whole world outside of the internet to explore and you can’t just snatch that from us. The internet is of no use without basic knowledge and you can get that by exploring THE REAL WORLD. I can’t believe that for once, I was also a part of this. Now I understand that this world is so cruel! I AM OUT!” I take out all the wires and throw the helmet away. Rob is red with anger. Time to RUN! I run so fast and Rob calls the Robos after me. I throw whatever I find back at them. But, wait, this can’t be true. The WORLD OF INTERNET? Am I? I am definitely… AAH! I open my eyes. I am still laying down on the couch at my home and it’s morning. It was a dream for sure. A dream I will never forget. “Raj! Wake up, You used your phone ALL NIGHT! I will take it from you today and you are NOT getting it back!” I was so happy to hear Mommy’s voice after a long time. “Mum! I will not use it! The Internet is of no use and I want to see the real world. I think I was just scared to make any friends in this new place and so I was using the internet to escape, but now I will make friends and not touch this little evil machine!” “I am so glad you learnt your lesson, come let’s have breakfast” I know mommy won't believe that I got LOST IN THE WORLD OF INTERNET! 1 month later. It’s been a month and I have learnt something new, I go cycling, I complete my homework and not get scolded, Maths has become my favourite subject and I have made new friends. Rohan and Rhea were not so bad after all! And Mr. Encyclopedia has a name! His name is Samarth, I finally asked him! Now we are good friends and do group studies together. Sometimes, you just have to keep reminding yourself that your family and friends are your greatest support, not the internet! The phone’s battery will die down but your family and friends will never leave you. Even when darkness is waiting for you, You just have to LIVE IN THE PRESENT!
author: KESHAV GARG
illustrator: Diya Ullas; Gaurav Wakankar; KESHAV GARG; Tanvi Bhat

title: The deadly fishy holidays
text: Lucy went to Queensland in Australia on 21st June 2009 to spend their holidays. After reaching in the morning they quickly changed their clothes, grabbed their surfboards, and dashed towards the rainbow beach. Many waves came and they enjoyed it very much. Then they decided to swim in one of the most famous seas in Australia, the Coral Sea. After surfing in the sea, Lucy saw a big wave and started surfing towards it while the others followed her. Suddenly, a man appeared, rowing a boat, and was just about to say something, when a shark jumped out of the sea, grabbed him by his stomach, and went back into the sea. The children were horrified after seeing this terrifying scene. A cold shiver ran down their backs. They saw why sharks were circling that area, a dead whale was floating on the sea. They quickly climbed up the dead whale to escape from the sharks. They could see the sharks circling them. After a while, they disappeared, then James, Harry, and Victor went down to take their surfboards. After some time, Lucy started getting impatient, she was just about to go down to get her surfboard and try to get away, when Jane stopped her. Jane and Lucy rushed towards them and gave them first aid. They noticed a rock everyone started surfing toward the rock. when they reached their destination, they found a box of matches and a few pieces of wood. Meanwhile, Lucy and her friends created a fire. James Victor and Harry caught a few fish. When he reached it, he saw that the boat was carrying cylinders and cans of oil add many guns. The boat was empty. An idea came to him. He called everyone and when everyone reached James said to them that they need to climb up the cruise, everyone was able to climb up except James after a few seconds Jane noticed that a shark was coming towards James at a very high speed and she took a rope and gave it to James, then she told her plan. They rubbed oil onto the oxygen cylinder and somehow put it in the first shark’s mouth, grabbed the laser gun, and aimed. After some time they shot many bullets They rubbed oil onto the oxygen cylinder and somehow put it in the first shark’s mouth, grabbed the laser gun, and aimed. After some time they shot many bullets., but the Shark always escaped when all the bullets had finished Lucy found a single gun with one bullet. Lucy aimed at the shark and shot. The shark was covered with flames. Everyone sat and saw the shark being burnt alive.. the second shark went into the ocean and got saved Harry and Victor jumped into the sea and of course, the sharks followed them but this time two sharks were there they moved towards sharpened rocks and Harry and Victor changed their way. One shark was killed but the other one was left. Then Jane remembered the matchstick box she took a drop of oil and then fired the match stick and this time the shark got killed. The next morning, they went back home. The moral is –Never lose hope, even in the most adverse of situations leads

title: A Day When Fiction Come True !...
text: This place looks quite like our planet. Let us have landing. "Thrusters" On, "Place for landing" confirm. With a sigh, "We've landed successfully". Let's go to our mission! Tick-Tock, the common sound of clock was buzzing. "Wake Up, look at the time", said mom, you'll get late. "Few more minutes please mom", I said. Then I looked into the clock and I was transfixed in tension. "Hurry, hurry Rishikesh." I said to myself while being fresh. "Bye Mom" I said and left home running to school. And I was late. Sir taking presenty, "Newt", "Yes sir", "Gaurav", "Yes sir", "Rishikesh, Rishikesh!" and I came running by and said, "Present Sir". Exhaling very fast, I was literally sweating. "Get Out!" said sir. 20 Minute later, "Come in", said sir to me. It was now time for result. Sir gave papers to everyone to check marks. Newt and Gaurav both had got 89 and Niara got 96. Looking at my paper, I was feeling so... so... bad. I've got 100 marks but the thing was that mostly hundred is a good number but in this case I got 100 out of 350. After school me and my friends were discussing about a fiction film based on a adventure of 5 friends, just like our, to a new planet. "I want to do the same.", I said, "It's my dream since childhood". They started laughing at my sentence. They laughed so loud that the whole school was looking just at me. "Do you still believe in this?" asked Gaurav, "It looks like you are still a child." added Newt. I, without thinking anything promised them that I would take you to another planet. I even added that if I'd lose then I would eat spaghetti with my nose. I rushed home quickly and in an anger to meet my bro. "I want to meet aliens", I asked to my bro who was actually a taskmaster and solved my all problems. He was the first to tell that there is multiverse and also he was the one who discovered the complete map of univere of universe. But the concept of alien was not yet found so I thought if he could do this. "No", said my bro, "It is not possible". He looked a bit scared at that time as if he might know something. Just then, I with my brother, went in the garden to tell everyone that aliens doesn't exist. But then when we reached there, there was a huge object coming from space. And it landed without making any sound. Everywhere there was a silence, a pin-drop silence. Then a sudden ghushing sound came and the door opened. There came the aliens from it. They looked a bit-like humans but had wings and rat-like ears. They were literally speaking in English and were so fluently speaking that even I might get loosed from them in a competition. "Hello there, I'm Luca and she's my sister Luna." We looking at each other were confused and were completely unmovable except my brother who was as normal as if he saw me being scare at night under the cupboard. They called themselves trumans. When we asked them about why they came to our planet, Luca said, "We are in a great trouble". "What!?", asked all of us. But they didn't replied but asked us to come with them. The flying saucer was too small from outside but when we entered inside there was 17 rooms and a control center which was as huge as our whole house. When we were lifted up we got teleported or moved with a great speed, the speed of light. Soon we entered a new cosmos which was cosmos-1856. It was found by a man named, Steven Bronio in 1856th century as Luna said. We soon reached at our destination which was a planet like Earth or I may say it was Earth but small in size, approx. nearly the size of moon. It was feeling so light because the gravity here was so less. The ghushing sound came again when we were about to land and then we landed. I was feeling just like the hero in the new fiction movie. There were trees and water and the air was so fresh that I was feeling as if I could live just by eating the air. "Here we go, This small but nice house is home of ours". "Mom we are back with new friends of outer verse.", said Luca. "Welcome all of you", said his mother gladly. Since it was a long journey, we were frustrated so we were served with nice looking lunch. There were two sun in the sky so it was difficult to tell whether it is day or evening. "Aha", I said with cheerfullness and with a sweet flavor in my mouth. Very soon we finished it and went to play. Luna and Luca were quiet and called to my brother aside. They talked to him something that they didn't told us. Soon we were gonna play baseball and because there was less gravity we would jump as high as 50 feet and were able to lift a stone as heavy as 1 ton but in their measures. Just after a few moments some people with gun came who were behind Luca's father's car attacking on him. "My father is a reporter and leaks there information so they are behind him", said Luca. Eventually they went off but the car was not in a good condition. We repaired the car but the men will still be behind him. Next day, morning they came again but instead of attacking to Luca's father they were behind us. Boom, a pistol released a bullet which directly to me. The bullet hit me but didn't hurt me. It felt as if I'm immortal but the truth was that it was very different for us as we were from another planet. We then, with our both hands lifted their car and threw it on their other members. But the doesn't end here. They took Luna with them and were asking for money. We went to chief to ask help but he was unable to. Then suddenly he went off. (In the headquarters of bad guys) "Leave me, Leave me!", said Luna to the guards. Soon she was pushed into the control center where the boss was sitting. The boss was non other than the chief. She cried for help but it was useless. "Luna?, Luna?", all of us were calling her but it was of no use. After some time my bro got her location. She was in the headquarter of the bad guys. We went there and broke the wall by our punch and eventually went up to Luna. The boss was gonna destruct the whole country by a missile which was about to launch but when we entered there we fainted him but by mistake we pulled the leaver of the missile and boom. The missile was launched. We somehow managed to get on the missile and gradually fell it in the sea. No one was hurt and the reality of chief was in front of everyone. We were cheered up by the public and were feeling like heroes. But suddenly one bright light came and we were....at home. I was sleeping on the bed. "Was it a dream or not!?", I said to myself, "But my hands have got hurt which was done by the missile in my dream". I left the concept but ran to garden to check whether the hole is there or not made by the spaceship. And no it wasn't there but not that much huge. It looked as if someone had filled the place with soil. I saw my bro at a corner with his hands dirty. Soon my friends too came there to check. They too got the same dream. We then went to our home. But from that day my brother would not used to talk to me if I would ask him anything extraterrestrial people. There are some question still unanswered but I'll find the answer very soon. Since the time went but I knew that it wasn't a dream but a day when the fiction come true!

title: The White Lion
text: Once three friends Keerthi, Maya and Archana were returning home from school, when they heard a noise from Mr. Madrigal's old house. There was a silence and then Maya spoke what was that? Isn't Mr. Madrigal’s house closed for years, how come I heard a noise coming from there” they thought it was an animal but Keerthi said “That’s impossible Mr. Madrigal locked every window from the inside and the main door has also been, wait a second look at the main door, the lock it’s looks new.” The three went near the main door and examined the lock and yes it was new. All three looked puzzled, and started door has also been, wait a second look at the main door, the lock it’s looks new.” The three went near the main door and examined the lock and yes it was new. All three looked puzzled, and started thinking “maybe Mr. Madrigal changed it," said Keerthi the three agreed but they were still curious about the noise. The three of them tried peeping in through the window but all they could see was a dark room. Then, suddenly they heard a loud crash, and many people came out of their houses. They asked the three what was the sound Archana who was quiet till now said “It was nothing just my physics project got a little broken so I was throwing it in the bin but, it fell on the ground I am so sorry for disturbing you all." After everyone left the three girls saw a little creature rolling on the ground, they did not know what it was but they knew they had to get it out of there before it broke any other property. So, the three of them started looking through the windows, to see if there were any holes or gaps. Maya found one in the side of the house and quickly called the other two, it was big and seemed like someone had thrown a stone and broke the window. It was big enough for a kitten to get inside. Then they spot something moving around the room. It was white in color, with something red in its leg. “It must be an animal which has wounded itself,” said Archana Keerthi and Maya nodded their heads and Maya said “poor thing, how do we get it out of there?” “We can maybe call it, or maybe we could keep food as a bait to make it come near,” said Keerthi So first they tried different tricks to call it near but it did not work. Then, Maya took some food of her lunch box and Archana found a stick and kept the food at one end of the stick and held it by the other end. This time it worked, the animal came closer and tried to take the food, as soon as they felt the animal pulling the stick, Keerthi, Maya and Archana pulled the stick out and in the other end they found a little white lion cub. They had learnt that white lions were exceedingly rare and they just saw a cub. They took it to Maya’s house as her parents were vets, they bandaged the little cub and ensured the three girls that they would leave the cub in a safe place. The next morning, in the news they saw a pack of hunters had been arrested and that those hunters had also smuggled many rare animals, but the police would find the animals and send them to a safer place.
author: Esha Jain

title: Joyful life of kids
text: Introduction Vivaan’s Family moved to a new apartment called Aadya apartments. His family was one of the first family to move in. Vivaan was first unacquainted with the place as it was under construction and he was constrained to his own flat. Many months passed, Vivaan was only playing games and watching TV in his flat due to Covid restrictions. Once the facilities were ready, Vivaan took his basketball and started playing by himself in the basketball court. Friends & Foes A group of kids came to the basketball court and started playing dodgeball on the other half of the court. Vivaan wanted to join them, He asked them and they allowed him. Everybody was new to each other in the society; a group of elder kids were making fun of the younger kids, they banded together and formed two groups the elder girls and the elder boys. The smaller kids, sick of the elder kids, became friends. There were three people namely Vivaan, Rushal, and Anirudh. They all became very close friends. One day, Vivaan Brought a Nerf Gun to the court. Anirudh and Rushal followed. This became their favourite sport. During nerf wars, Vivaan and Anirudh camped the lift and fired at the enemy. They all wanted revenge on the tyrants so, when the elder kids arrived at the basketball court and wanted the younger ones to vacate the court, that’s when Vivaan screamed “Vengeance!!!” and all of them fired at the bullies using Nerf darts. The bullies, who were shocked and angry, took their dodgeballs and threw the dodgeballs them. They all fought (in fact they all enjoyed) until the leader of the band, Aaryan, said that they could have a truce. Vivaan agreed and said that they should never torment them and that the elder kids should always let the younger kids play in the same basketball court. Then Aaryan said that the younger kids should not annoy the elder kids and that was their end of the treaty. Obviously, there was a violation of the truce from both sides and wars continued. One day a boy named Arnav joined the younger kids’ troop. They all played hide and seek and dark room. One time Vivaan challenged all the elder kids to a game of chess. He defeated them all. There were many funny incidents that happened in the clan. One such incident happened in September. It was a nice evening and Rushal offered them Chocolates. As they were about to play indoor games, they took a glance at the party hall and noticed that it was Nitara’s birthday and that they were not invited. They all asked each other if they were invited then Arnav said that he was invited to the birthday party. Everybody told him to rush home and get ready and bring food for them from the birthday party. First Arnav gave Nitara the gift and then Arnav took three sticks of cotton candy and then he took six pieces of pakora’s and shared them with his friends. They all ran away and played hide and seek. The next day the bullies again wanted to roast the younger kids. Akhil, more of the actor leader, said “Quality over Quantity”. Vivaan replied “Quantity has a quality on its own”. Anirudh whispered to Rushal “Damn, Vivaan just burnt Akhil”. And sure enough, Vivaan’s team won. This time they made an actual truce. The elder kids had to be in the badminton court only. The younger kids can be anywhere. Navratri Activities All the kids participated in talent show and other activities. At night, the talent show started. Vivaan played Aigiri nandini on keyboard and he received tremendous applause from the audience. Many of the aunties and uncles patted him for his performance. Anirudh and Rushal did group dance. Anirudh, Rushal, Vivaan and Arnav put up a stall. They sold corn, Coca Cola and Maaza. They also made huge profits by selling cups as the free cups for drinking water were missing, there was a water filter right next to their stall. So, what they did was sell their own cups for drinking water. Basically, people paid to get water. When Rushal left, Vivaan and Anirudh spent 80 rupees on veg momos. Then Anirudh learnt to wave board and taught Vivaan. He wave boarded for half an hour. Then just when everything seemed as if it couldn’t get better a new member joined the younger kids’ squadron, his name was Kush. They made teams and played nerf wars, dark room, hide and seek daily. Coming to Older kids……poor them they have to spend so much time on their studies and hardly come out to play daily. It’s not the End, more fun days to come. -

title: A PURE SOUL
text: Once upon a younger year, there was a small girl her name was Kattie and she was very courteous. she always came first in her class and had a brilliant mind but she was half-blind. she lived in a small village upon the crest of a hill. she was very determined towards her work and was very attached to her family. The people in her neighborhood were like a family. They celebrated different festivals together, were part of each one's happy times as well as in times of hardship. Kattie's father was a small peasant. He was successful in satisfying the needs of his family but in times of dry season he hardly arranges to feed his family but still they all were satisfied with what they have in their life. This small family was happy and never regretted the life they had. All were pure souls. They villagers work hard during day time to feed their families and in night time there was a small get together of all. They dance, sing and enjoy their nights. One day, Kattie was returning home from school, then suddenly she met a poor man lying on the stairs of a temple. The poor man was yelling "Please help me and donate something, I have no money to feed my family, my daughter is suffering from hay fever and she is half blind, if I haven't collected money then she would die from starvation and hay fever''. Kattie looked at the poor man and tried to speak with him. She asked him, "how old is your daughter", dear uncle?" He replied that "oh my dear, she is just of your age. Kattie stared him suspiciously, and answered that " Can you please tell me her name?" after listening to Kattie the man got in trouble as he was lieing and he didn't got any name so he fumbled a little and said " her name is Anne". Kattie caught the man's lie and she round up all the matter. She said the man that she wanted to meet his daughter. After listening to Kattie the man started escaping from her. Kattie understood that the man was a cheat. She secretly followed the man without being noticed by him. The man reached a bar and he started drinking there. Kattie looked at him, while hiding behind the doors of the bar. She decided to teach the man a lesson. when she reached home in the evening her father was working in the fields and he asked her "where were you all day long? your school overs at 2 p.m. but look at the time its 4 p.m. now." She thought something in her mind and replied that " I was stuck in a project at school. the teacher had assigned me some work so, I was busy in that." Her father agreed and told her to wash her hand and then to have meal. But she was still thinking about the man. She had decided to teach the man a lesson, so she started to build a plan. After having the meal, She ran towards her father in the field. She was a small girl of nine years but still her intelligence was like an adult. Next day when she reached school her teacher taught them about Mahatma Gandhi. She derived her plan from that lesson. After the school was over, she went to that bar with one of her friend named Jennie. She was as brave as Kattie. They arrived the bar and were waiting at the door for the man to come. Finally, the man reached the bar and he ordered a drink. Kattie entered the bar slowly with an anxious face. She looked at the man angrily, the man was surprised to see her. She asked him "where is your daughter, dear uncle? I want to meet her, I'm also half blind like her, but you know what I don't feel like that I can't see from one eye as I have a family which supports me and care for me. I don't have to cheat people to get money and drink at the bar as a also do care about my family and whenever I thought something bad I just get remind of them''. The man's heart get melted and he promised Kattie to not to cheat anyone from that day onwards. He also said that he would hand over himself to the police for his cruelty towards innocent people. MORAL: our kindness and generosity can melt anyone's heart.

title: A Silent Dream
text: “Mamma, please wake me up early! Every night I dream of a huge lizard. It captures my heart and walks on me. It crawls and slithers, trots and rests. Even though I want to shout, it stares at me from the kitchen wall. I tell it to stop if it has something to tell me. But it waits for something, pulls its enormous tongue out and slips under the curry tree as if nothing happened. Mamma, I am scared. I don’t want to sleep any more”! Such was the complaint of eight-year old Dinesh after returning from school. Flinging the worn- out bag on the chair, he hurried off to play with his kitten Capcha. Running about in frolicking gestures, he was waiting anxiously for his mother’s reply. He trusted his mother regarding every problem in his life and he was sure that this dream could as easily be handled by her, if she took him seriously. Even though he was not that scared of the lizard, he wished to obtain an honest answer from his mom. So, he chose not to reveal to her that he received the first-prize in his School Drawing Competition, painting the ‘Most Colourful Chameleon’ in the entire class. His mother came out of the kitchen with a plate of Rajma-Chawal and a half-boiled egg. Sitting down, she slowly started to peel off the onion and asked, “Dinu, do you know what lizards eat?” Dinesh looked at her inquiring eyes and shook his head vigorously, slouching with interest. “Some lizards — like young geckos — are carnivores and they need to be fed daily. But Papa Geckos can skip one day and eat the next day. Others like veiled chameleons are omnivores. They can eat both mealworms and crickets, along with mustard greens, collards and dandelions. But they cannot digest dragonflies as they enter the lizards’ stomachs and poison them. It is similar to how we avoid Gila Monsters or Poisonous Lizards for our dinners”. Saying thus his mother took a pause. Dinesh was teeming with questions. He decided to ask them one at a time. Needless to say, he found this class far more interesting than the mathematics problems that were given as homework. He gulped down a mouthful and questioned, “Mamma, do they also get sick like us?” Mother smiled a little and nodded in agreement, “Yes, my dear. Lizards are just like our little Capcha. They need fresh water every single day, with multivitamin and calcium. If you wish to take care of them, you should only offer them insects that they can eat for 20 minutes. Bigger meals make them grow a paunch on the stomach like my little dearie’s here”. She swiftly tickled Dinu’s belly that made him squeak with laughter. He jumped up and was about to run away when he realized that he still had not received a satisfying analysis of his dream. Mamma could read his mind instantly. She brought out a huge poster from her cupboard and spread it on the table. Capcha jumped on it and was captivated by the giant eyes bulging out of the paper. She ran around the whole table but kept quiet, as if also awaiting the revelation of the mystery. She interrogated, “Do you know what this is?” Dinesh searched for an answer in his mind but could not locate this animal. It was a giant, black, slimy creature with no arms or legs, with a long yellow neck and grey-orange spots all over its body. Mamma read his expression and smiled, “Time’s up! This is a King Cobra. It is a distant relative of the lizard that gives us company in the living room. As you can see, it is very big and will not fit in our little garden. So it lives in the jungles of South and Southeast Asia.” “But mamma, doesn’t it look different than our house-lizard?” “Yes Dinu. They come from the same family but have different shapes. Just like you come from me. But do you look exactly like me?” Glancing at Dinu’s shy face, she continued, “But the problem lies elsewhere. Humans like you and I, have taken away their habitats by cutting down their homes, making space for growing our crops and encouraging large-scale urban housing. Our houses have grabbed and destroyed theirs. So they are made to live with us. They are endangered in Nature’s Red List”. Dinu was confused with these bunch of new words. Momma was a teacher of Zoology and knew far more about animals in their house than he or Pappa did. Without wasting any more time, he quickly opened his school-bag and pulled out his pocket dictionary. When he was in doubt and Momma was out of reach, this book helped him every time to solve his query. But reading out the meaning of extinction made Dinu sad. He looked back up at his mother, at a loss for words. Gulping down his tears, he asked, “Momma, I do take care of our lizards, right?” His Mom sat right beside him and caressed him in a motion of comfort, “Yes, we all try our best Dinu. But when I tell you to switch off the AC or not use more water than you need, it is for their preservation and life. Taking care of our own lizards implies taking care of its family too — far far away, but right from here”. Dinu was now thoroughly relieved. He promised never to repeat his mistakes again. As if in a trance, he saw the pet lizard slide past him — one with no tail and still very small. Momma took his hand and let him go near it, “Don’t worry Dinu. The lizards don’t need doctors like us. Their tails often fall off when running away from their enemies. Releasing the stored energy helps it to flee faster and thus, it saves its own life”. Dinesh was surprised knowing so much about the innocent creature. It seemed to him till now that the little body with the brown scales was incapable of so much that he could do. However, after he learned that they did not have Mommas and Pappas to protect and feed them, Dinu automatically respected them more. It was as if a new world opened up for him —that of fellow beings who couldn’t speak — acting only through their gestures and knowing so much about Nature. Dinesh had come across stories about the Indian Hero Lizard, the iguana and the opossum. But it is only today that he got to know that Nature has made everyone equal. Only their languages and food habits are different. Just like he loves his chocolate, the lizards like to have its meals of grasshoppers. He can only taste with his tongue. Whereas, lizards can catch the spiders and caterpillars that come through his window in the evening. Thinking about the distribution of these functions amused Dinu. However, Momma had not forgotten his complaint. She turned towards him and said, “Now do you understand why I keep telling you that Native American tribes have their own Lizard-God Pomo? He is the God of Healing and Creation. They can cure themselves and help to generate new species of animals. Horn-toads, a brother of jungle lizards, also have medicinal properties. They are sacred, generous and very well-built. This also makes them one of our best silent friends”. Dinesh was extremely delighted. He understood that the dream was only an indication for a new friendship. It was a message from the lizard who could not speak in life and so had to bond during his sleep. Dinu did not feel that it was a limitation because he loved his silent friends. The cat, the mice, the crow and the goldfish — all were his best friends. Now that the lizard was added to the long list, he was neither upset nor scared. Thinking thus, he turned out the lights, bid goodbye to Momma, and fell flat on the bed, just like a lizard.
author: Pritha Banerjee

title: Raju and his dog
text: Today Raju is very happy because he is going to have a pet dog. As he has secured first position in class and as his reward he is going to have a pet dog. He has also decided his name. Rex, he finds this name different but meaningless. There is one problem. He went to school. He had a wonderful day there school with his friends and with his teacher but there is a boy named Baljit who dislikes him every minute. He is the second in in the class and because most of the teachers liked Raju so they gave some extra marks to him. This is not fair. And that is the main reason Raju came first and he came second. At the evening his parents has bought the dog but they wanted to surprise him in the morning so they handed the pet dog to their neighbor Mrs. Sunita. It's six in the morning and the perfect time for surprise. His parents have left the dog in his room, closed all the windows, shut the door, and have gone from the room. Raju wakes up and sees that the dog is in his room. He gets up and get ready for an another exiting day of school. He ate his breakfast and left for school his mother and his dog. He thought every thing would be amazing but perhaps while he was going with the dog an uncle scared the dog and it ran away. The dog was first and behind it Raju and his mother were running to catch him. F inally they were successful. But it was around 8 and the gate of school was about to close. Oh no its late for him because of his pet and now he is going to get scolding. When he reached the school principal was standing there and the gate was completely closed. He was very pleased at that time and he had to go back home. But he got entry and he went to class. He was been scolded by his teacher.. Nothing was going nice and as his punishment he had to sit in the library for the whole day. He was very embarrassed.

title: EDUCATION IS EVERYTHING
text: Sanjana's parents made her marry a man who was ten years older than her. She was twenty two years old then. Her family was of four members: her in-laws and her husband. During the first year of her marriage, her in-laws scoffed her in various issues. Gradually the problem increased and she got severely insulted day by day by her in-laws and husband too. She was insulted as she was not educated and belonged to a poor family. Soon she became frustrated and depressed. One day she thought that, "all these arguements that I have to face daily is mainly because I am not educated." And then she decided to get educated. She started her studies by her own, collected books from the neighbours and studied when she had a bit of free time. In this way she completed studying the books upto 12th standard in two years. In this period of the learning she realized many things, the reason for a chaotic family, the path of justice and many more. Mostly she preferred subjects related to Humanities. Her mindset and behavior totally changed. She acted like a free woman, though she had family problems. She started raising voice against the ill-treatmets and stopped to tolerate them. She felt that the way of her living was not at all good and healthy for her, indeed she must stand against it and do something about it. So, she decided to divorce her husband and get rid of these abuses and so she did. She wanted to become independent woman from her childhood and therefore became a confident and independent woman at last. She started her own business of home delivery of food and earned sufficient for herself as well as her parents. Moral: education is the only weapon by which a person can change his or her attitude, mindset and stand against the unfair treatment that he or she needs to tolerate. Written By: ANUSHREE DUTTA Class:VIII School: THE LITTLE STARS SR. SEC. SCHOOL. School Code: 35101 Affiliation No. 230012
author: Anushree Dutta

title: The Weird Dream
text: After a long tiring day, I was eagerly waiting for my bed. My final exams just got over. I was exhausted both physically and mentally. As soon as I climbed my bed I grabbed my pillow. I was fast asleep. Then I found myself in a time machine where I went into past. I saw dinosaurs moving here and there, as I moved behind I saw a big creature larger than me, none other than Titanosaur. I fainted, as I opened my eyes I found myself on leaves where the big creature was looking at me. I was afraid that the big creature was going to eat me but as soon as he came closer to me, he said “Hey friend, this is Titan, are you okay?” seeing the creature talking I was shocked. He continued “Let’s go on a ride to the jungle”. He offered me a seat on his back with a friendly smile. I accepted the offer and he gave a ride. On the way, I saw different animals, s ome were finding their food and spending time with their family. But there were two animals who were fighting. Me and my new friend asked them why they were fighting? One of them replied “I was eating my food but the monkey said that we both look like a donkey. Then we asked the monkey not to repeat this but he didn’t listen to us. Suddenly we all felt an earthquake and here the king of the jungle entered ‘Mr. Lion’. The animals ran away. But me and Titan stood there. Mr. Lion came to us and said “Are you not afraid of me?” Titan whispered to me “Friend we should run away, I am scared that the king will punish us." I said bravely to Mr. Lion “Why should we be afraid of you? What if I ask you, are you afraid of us or not?” Titan was shocked. Mr. Lion said “This girl is very courageous to talk to the king of jungle like this”. I replied “Thank you for the compliment but I just wanted to let you know that you are not a successful king”. Mr. Lion was shocked. All the other animals were standing behind the tree and were listening. Mr. Lion said “Hey girl, you don’t know who am I. You should mind your words”. I replied “I will keep saying these words as you are not capable to be the king of this jungle”. Mr. Lion was angry but kept himself cool and said “Why do you think so?" I said “the reason is in front of you, animals are afraid of you and you feel that they are respecting you? Everyone is fearful. Do you know what animals really want from you? They want a king that makes them comfortable in this jungle, because of you they will go to cities and end up their life. Stop creating fear amongst animals. I know it took a long time to develop a kingdom, so use your power in a good way." Mr. Lion looked angry at first but realised his mistake. So he went to the animals standing behind the tree, gave them a friendly smile and said- “Sorry for being bad to you, now I’ll try to be a king you all want”. Mr. Lion thanked me and suddenly I heard a voice of someone saying- “Hey! Get up it’s morning, don’t you want to go to school?" I opened my eyes, all my dream world disappeared. It was none other than my mother. I sat on my bed thinking that what would have happened next? Did the king change his nature? Were the animals happy about king’s decision? On the way to school, my mind was juggling with hundreds of thoughts. I recollected how Titan asked me for a ride. I wondered, Will I ever have a friend like Titan? With this small dreamy encounter, I realized that a change of heart can be at any point of time. We all have a power to lead. I’ll surely tell my friends about this!

title: The rebirth of the setting sun
text: Monday was the day. What else might it be, then? Many people begin their days worrying about having to work a whole week toiling and working their bodies to the limit while worrying about the thought of feeding their family due to their low wage due to the warm weather being slightly favourable making work easier. By all means, this is the sad reality for a select few. They all assert that there is really no end to your working days, and Khepran, a village between Punjab and Himachal, is proof positive of this. There are no truly elderly people in the hamlet, as even the oldest residents, who are in their 80s, are healthy and active. The usual chatter starts with tea and kids who rush to play at the Chaupal the moment their eyes open from a deep sleep. They are reprimanded from that point on until they get to their beds at night to sleep because they are exhausted after a long day of doing only what they find important and showing no concern for anything but fun. The men go to their fields while the ladies take care of their homes and livestock in this patriarchal society. Some people make their living from their lovely gardens, while others manage confectioneries. And a few have sons who are employed across oceans and visit them after significant periods of earning money. Due to the pandemic becoming known and forcing them into the lock-down, work has not ceased, but education has. For as long as anyone can remember, a sizable house that is directly in front of the Chaupal has doors that are always open. The previous 20 years have seen Kamalawati, a 78-year-old woman, live alone with her husband and her partially deaf sister-in-law. Before this, she had a bustling home and a heart that was content to the brim. She was incredibly close to her seven children. They were made up of three unmarried daughters and four unmarried sons. She managed the livestock, the farm, and her house while her days whizzed by busy. When emptiness knocks on the loneliest of afternoons, those are the moments she eventually learns to miss the most. Like any Indian mother, her only goal in life was to have her daughter-in-law’s live with her while her sons were away working. Of course, one cannot simply do as one pleases. Parents typically become more of a responsibility or burden as they get older. Her daughter-in-law’s all moved out of the house and into the city as a result. She is a single mother of seven, and fate can be a tricky thing. Although her feet no longer seem to be able to carry her over vast distances and her hands frequently tremble, she nevertheless does practically everything with the same vigour as when she was younger. Krishan, her husband, who was a farmer and a man of pure brawn and whose power was unmatched in his days, is now primarily restrained to the cotton cot because he suffers from knee discomfort and is unable to keep himself upright for too long. According to the physicians, he can only support himself with a cane by mentally being firm. At the age of 13, she married into one of the wealthiest landowner families, and when she turned 16 her husband sent her to live with him. She was unfortunate to not inherit the family's wealth because her husband, Krishan, was expelled by his strict father for being unable to support his family. He made every effort to find employment, working as a driver in Bihar and a vegetable vendor in Punjab, but in vain. He either didn't get paid for his work or his coworkers lied to him. Despite his powerful build, he had a kind and generous. When nothing worked out, he returned and ended up working as a meagerly paid farmer on his father's property. He gave up and accepted his fate without protest. She had lunch with her husband as the day wore on and then went to meet the village ladies. She did what she wanted to do that day. She donned crimson bangles and coloured her hair with henna, a leaf paste. She was happy that day as she thought back on the past, whether they had been good or bad. She has always relied on those recollections to keep her going. When night fell and everyone had finished their supper, she peacefully collapsed into the arms of her husband and breathed her last, proving that she was truly at peace. She had recovered from a disease that should have killed her long ago, therefore there was no discomfort. She was unable to understand what was happening, thus dread was no longer present. With each restricted breath that her lungs refused to take, she noticed the colours become paler. She was able to feel everything but nothing. She was in a state of unfathomable shock, as was everyone else around her, at the uniqueness of the moment. And shortly after that, she vanished. She had transformed into another world, another reality. What was left was a dead body in an old man's arms, who was left to face the truth alone for the rest of his life with a tear-smeared face. The person who lived life to the fullest and left a legacy for everyone was no longer here. The sun was in her. She was a round ball of fire, like the sun, whose existence was woven into the web of possibilities. She was always there, even while the clouds were in charge of her. I was familiar with the cosmos and the world.. She never gave up, no matter how many times she was knocked to the ground. I got up again with the conviction that she is still watching over us. Like the biggest star in our cosmos, she had enough influence on people around her just by being there. I firmly think that every living thing on this world has the potential to be the same sun that she was. Another rises as one sets. And I look forward to the day when people will look at me and exclaim, "Here comes the sun!"

title: Working for others is not by chance but by choice
text: Do you know? In our country many people works for the whole day and even at nights just for our security purpose. They give their blood and soul in to their work. There are many such people like Doctor, firemen, policemen and many others but todays highlighted character is one of these - "POLICEMEN" who works day and night for our security, betterment, peace and to solve our problems But have you ever thought that if they are sacrificing so much for us but in return instead of helping them we create problems for them. Now let us see one such incident of a little girl - SANYA. Sanya was with her friend, she was deciding what to do and suddenly she got an idea. She said, ' Hey Swara! how about making prank calls to our friends?' Swara replied,' No Sanya, I don't think calling like this and disturbing others will be a good decision ' but Sanya didn't listen to her instead she forced and convinced her. They dialed random phone numbers and spoke with the people in different voices. While doing this sanya remembered that she had once read in newspaper that if someone dials the phone number - '100' police will approach on the location and then she decided to do so. They dialed '100' and waited for the response, there was no voice from the other end yet she kept acting and shouting as if she was kidnapped. As she got no response from other end, she disconnected the call. after some time, police men-'Mr Sharma' along with his team rushed to Sanya's home from where the call has been made. Sanya saw him approaching towards her location. Now she was really worried and scared that she will get scolding from her parents and therefore she ran out of the house from the backdoor before the police enters her home. Mr Sharma entered the house and talked with her parents. Now her parents also got tensed. They thought that she made a call like this because she is in a difficult situation, but here she was hiding at her friend's house. In the same evening, Sanya thought that the police might have left till now and her parents might also be relaxed so she can go home, But here in Sanya's home the situation was worst, everyone was worried for her and searching her. When she came home, she found that her mother was crying and Mr Sharma and his team were working had to locate her. She realised her mistake. She told the truth to everyone that she had made the call purposely to have fun. She apologised to Mr Sharma for her behaviour. Mr Sharma instructed her that: 'I am glad that you realised your mistake and felt sorry for it. We work hard for your safety so that if anyone is in bad situation we can trace the victims location and help them. So please dont make such calls just for fun.' She replied in a soft voice that she won't repeat such pranks ever again in her life. so, friends, this is a situation in our country. We don't respect such heroes with cape rather we create problems for them. From this story, I hope we understood the importance of such special heroes, who sacrifices their personal life for us. let's salute and respect them.

title: THE TWO FRIENDS
text: Once upon a time two boys of same age lived in the same society. They were The Best Friends and classmates too. They studied in the same school. They did everything which was possible just together. They were THE BROTHERS FROM ANOTHER MOTHERS. Aaarav belonged to an upper middle class family. Basically he was not so rich but had more comforts than Atharva. Atharva was a 13 years old middle class boy. They did not fight at any cost. But one fine day they were having football match in their school. Aaarav was not a good sportsperson but Atharva was a brilliant sportsperson. But this time both were giving a very tough competition to each other.. Aarav did the first goal in his lifetime. But with hands according to Atharva. “HE CHEATED.” Atharva screamed in front of the coach. “I did not” Aarav exclaimed. “Hey!why are you lying bro Atharva said. “I am not lying. You are putting wrong allegations on me.”Aarav replied. Coach asked them to calm down. Then the coach gave his decision. “Both the teams played very well but the chaos that happened at last was not a good thing. Aarav, well played boy. Atharva moved out from the place and he decided not to talk to Aarav again. When Atharva returned home he locked himself in a room.. He was not able to accept the fact that his friend cheated on him. Aarav was also regretting but after receiving appreciations from his parents, teachers and even relatives he was not. Atharva ignored Aarav for the next two days, but on the third day something amazing happened. His grandfather arrived after his trip from Chennai. Atharva was very happy to see his grandfather after a long time. “Dada ji what is in your suitcase for me any toy or sweets?” He asked. “Oh my boy! I forgot.” grandfather replied scatching his head. “This is not done. You promised me then why have not you brought something for me and Aarav? Oh!sorry only me.” oh! I forgot!! But you promised me!! “I knew it,that is why I have brought a lot of idlis and the special sweets from Chennai for you and Aarav. But why did you say only me?” grandfather said. “I am not going to talk to Aarav for my whole lifetime. He is the biggest cheater I have ever seen in my life.”Atharva replied. Haha! Your life has not even started yet. By the way why are you saying so?” then Atharva narrated the whole story to Dada ji. Grandfather was some what angry on Aarav but he advised his grandson to start talking to his best friend but Atharva was not ready to do so. But grandfather really wanted that to happen. Then he told him his experience. Grandfather said “When I studied in class third I was also the best friend of someone named Rajesh. He was my friend just like you and Aarav. But one day we also fought just like you and I was also very angry on Rajesh and I told him not to meet me again. He left and till date I am regretting. I want you not to repeat the same mistake.” “Dadaji I understood but I want Aarav to realize his mistake.” Atharva said. “But talk to him politely.” grandfather replied.“OKAY my favorite grandpa!”!” Atharva hugged and said to his grandfather. “Oh please do not do this I know you are grandmother’s boy.”Atharvalaughed and went to Aarav’s home. “I am not here to taunt you say you something that would hurt you but I just want to say that I don’t want to lose my best friend just because of a single goal.” Atharva said. Aarav said sorry to Atharva and they hugged each other. MORAL: GOOD FRIENDS ARE LIKE TREASURE, NEVER LOSE THEM.

title: THE STOLEN COMIC
text: Niko was really into making comics and writing stories. She had made up her mind to be a writer. Her life was great she has an extraordinary mom, who would support her no matter what.Apart from being a mom, she was an Army officer and so was Nico’s father. Her father was an avid sportsman and made Niko and her brother Jack play all kind of different sports. Niko was good in badminton and Jack was passionate about Tennis. Her father was a simple man with a bright smile her mom was extremely beautiful who loved to give worm hugs. Her relationship with her brother was like a bond of Maggie and its masala. Without masala Maggie is nothing. She had a pet dog a black Labrador Ash,she loved him to bits.He was the most adorable living thing... So basically, she had a perfect family they would go out for dinners, movies, shopping, picnics, trekking, visiting many places but the best was on Saturdays they would order food and have a family movie night which she would wait for the whole week. Apart from her family she had amazing friends some were good and some were not that good. But her best friend was Keijo. Keijo was a grade elder to Niko. They really enjoyed each other’s company when they met at a park both wearing the same headphones. They would talk and hang out together. Niko showed her comics and stories only to Keijo. They were mostly about things which people did not really understand. Like once she wrote a story about zodiac signs and how they are connected to stars. She had recently drawn and written a comic about a dog cop and how he fights crimes and brings peace to the city. She wrote this comic thinking about her dog Ash. The comic had everything jokes, dog puns, action, wonderful cartoons, and drawings the only thing left was to publish it. During school break she gave her comic to Keijo to read. Keijo was so impressed by her comic and the talent she holds. After reading the comic he said “Dude why don’t you tell your dad to help you publish this this is the funniest thing he has ever read. it is so good.! believe me” “What if no one likes it? I will be a laughing stalk at school”, Niko replied. ‘How will you know if you do not give it a try? ‘Keijo said. Even after a lot of persuasion, Niko did not agree. Disappointed Keijo said.” Fine. But one day when you decide to publish it and become famous, do not forget me.” He said. ‘How will you know if you do not give it a try? ‘Keijo said. Even after a lot of persuasion, Niko did not agree. Disappointed Keijo said.” Fine. But one day when you decide to publish it and become famous, do not forget me.” He said. Erin was in the same class as Niko. Sometimes, Erin used to hang out with Niko and Keijo. Erin wanted to be famous and recently he started hanging out with the mean crowd. Her behaviour started changing. Keijo and Niko noticed it … One day at school, after the tiffin break, Niko kept her comic book under her desk and went for games period. Erin saw the comic and read it then showed it to her friends. Her friends suggested her that she should change the name of writers name as her own and publish it. Just because she wanted to be the centre of the crowd, she said she would think about it, she took Niko’s comic. WHERE IS IT? NOO THIS CANT HAPPEN TO ME! cries Nico after coming back from the games. During the school break, Niko tells about the stolen comic to Keijo. WHAT!!! Keijo exclaimed how can it be? I saw you keeping your comic under your desk. “What am I going to do now? It was so dear to me.” Niko said. “Do not worry now, we will figure it out.” Keijo said comforting Nico. Meanwhile Erin with the help of her father published Niko’s book. The people went crazy after the comic. As soon as the news broke to Niko, angry Niko went straight to Erin to confront her. “ I thought we were friends; friends do not hurt each other. You took my credit without my permission. How dare you touch my comic?”. Said Niko. Erin “You must be hallucinating, because I wrote this book. and I am not going to be friends with someone who accuses me for something I have not done. “First, it’s a comic, not a book and it’s my handwriting.” Said Nico,” UGH fine, whatever. its your comic but how are you going to prove it? OH, by the way, there is an interview by news channels tomorrow of MY BOOK. Make sure to come.” Erin leaves after saying this. Niko was devastated thinking that there is nothing that she can do. Just then she got a bright idea. She told the plan to Keijo and he was excited to help her. Night before the interview, Nico with the help of Keijo sneaked into Erin’s house and stuck a picture of her and ash at the back of original copy, and wrote “inspired by my dog Ash and the way he wags his tail” with her signature. Next day, Nico sat in the front row with Keijo by her side, during the interview. As the interview was coming to an end, the interviewer asked the audience if they have any question about Erin’s book Nico stood up to ask,” What inspired you to write this comic?” She asked. “It j-just came to my mind.” Erin replied. Oh, really cause at the end of the book its written “inspired by my dog Ash and the way he wags his tail.” Nico continued, “and there is a picture of a dog and its owner.” Erin panicked, “It was not there when I took the comic. You did something.” and her secret was out. Everybody was shocked and finally, Keijo told everyone what had happened and how Erin stole Nico’s comic and her credit. Niko was happy that her comic was getting such good reviews and she got the fame which was rightfully hers …… In the end everything was perfect. Erin got a big scolding for what she did and was not allowed to go out for a month. Niko kept writing more comics and now with a new set of confidence and ideas.

title: A Spanish Friend
text: I was so excited the day when I was going to meet my new friend from far away, whom I had never seen before. Yes, he was a stranger to me. We had a foreign exchange programme in our school according to which few students were selected to be sent to other countries to learn their culture and customs and study there for a few months. In the same programme Master John Smith, who was as old as me- 12 years, from Spain was coming to my place for the next 30 days. I was very excited and curious to meet my new friend. So I got up early that morning and my Mom didn’t have to push me for getting ready. I finished all my routine work and was ready to go with my father to receive my new friend, who was supposed to arrive at 9:30. Soon my curiosity came to an end when he was in front of me. He looked exactly as I expected; a smart, tall, good looking english boy. We greeted each other and got in the car and then geared towards our home. My mom was waiting for us with some yummilicious breakfast which included both Indian and Spanish cuisine. She asked John to freshen up and then she served breakfast. John was very happy to taste all Indian delicacies and he praised my mom for preparing such food. I was already told that I will have to share my room with John. I was very happy for that, because I was an only child and now I will have one friend/brother with me for 24 hours. After we finished our breakfast, I gave him a tour of our house and garden He was exhausted after the long journey so, I asked him to take a nap. In the evening, we had to discuss and plan the schedule for the next 30 days, though it was all pre-planned, we discussed it all in detail. Next morning, we were quite excited, as for him it was a new country; ready to unravel. For me it was having a new friend and learning from his experience here. Next morning we both got ready on time and reached the school together. I introduced him to my friends and teachers. They were all excited to welcome him to our school. John was very good in academics as well as in sports. I got to learn many new things from him especially a new language and he too got to learn a lot of things from me. He was an excellent basketball player though I was always interested in cricket. He played so good that I kind of was mesmerised and impressed and started gaining interest in basketball. He was very good in mathematics and my concepts were very clear in science. So whenever we needed each others’ help, our skills in each subject made it very easy for both of us. Since it was December John didn’t have much problem adjusting to the Indian climate. He did enjoy the pleasant weather. Also there were many extra-curricular activities held in our school viz. Quiz competition, story writing, sports tournaments, singing and dancing. John also took active participation in some of them and received appreciation too. With John time flew it seemed too short. Now it was time for us to bid goodbye. With a heavy heart and lots of good memories we promised to meet again in the future. It has been 7 days since his return though all thanks to our developing country and easy access to internet we kept in contact through chats and video calls. Finally, we are glad and thankful to such organisers, who give us an opportunity to explore ourselves and get connected with people across globe....
author: Madhav Agrawal

title: TWO BUDDIES
text: There were once two boys who were very good friends. Their names were Arv and Atharva They would always play together after school in the football court close to where they lived. They liked to pretend that they were famous football players. One day, two bullies came stomping onto the football ground and started calling the boys names. This belongs to us now,’ said the nasty bully. ‘And you are never getting it back,’ said his nasty friend. Then the bullies started pushing the two boys and Arman fell down and suddenly became very scared. Without thinking, the young boy jumped to his feet and ran home without once looking back to see if his friend Batoor was also able to escape. Athrv was not so fortunate, and anyway, he did not like being bullied and refused to run away from the boys just because they thought that they could push people around. But the boys were bigger and stronger than Athrv and they hit him and kicked him until he was badly bruised. His clothes were also torn and one of his eyes became swollen." Atharv mother bought him a new football and because the boy was determined not to have his life ruled over by bullies, he returned to the football groundthe following day and played alone. It was not nearly as much fun as when he played with Arv but Atharv was still angry with his friend and could not find it in his heart to forgive him so easily.
