title: NO PLACE LIKE HOME
text: NO PLACE LIKE HOME " Good life is full of challenges, but for me it seems like challenges without a good life "I am 14 years old girl. I have an interesting personality and striking features/traits. I have long blonde long hair, deep brown eyes and a round face. A Cheeky but adorable smile that seemed lost for the past few months. It's 2022 and last year during COVID pandemic.I lost my parents and since then I'm having an awful time at "Jade apartments" with my uncle and aunt.They are disgusting and just in tolerable which makes it nearly impossible for me to put up with them. My uncle is one of the crossest person you could ever come across. He is gifted to find flaws in everything And everything is the only correct word for it. My Aunt is also pathetic and is always bragging about the thing or the other But in this small apartment besides two exasperating and frustrating people there is someone who has a soft to corner for me, Its Daisy uncle and aunt's me child to only child. • Daisy is opposite of her parents, she is sweet and kind towards me and always finds a way to make me happy.With all the scolding and Daisy I'm living my life.But all this was about to change for me.I woke up at 6 a.m. as I always do and started with my daily chores. Washing and cleaning the house before aunt Jessy comes to make breakfast. Aunt Jessy came around 8 a.m. rubbing eyes vigorously. She washed her face and went straight towards kitchen.Few minutes later I heard a cry that me jump off my feet. Aunt Jessy shouted on the top of her voice "you come here,now" I tried to remember what I did that I was supposed to be scolded and then it a occurred to me. I had not washed the dishes Last night " I'm done". Stuttering and Shivering I went towards the kitchen. When I reached Aunt Jessy furiously stared at me and I was as pale as a Ghost already.She grabbed my hand took me to the other ∙end of the kitchen. But here, New she is not taking to the sink but directly towards Backdoor of kitchen. ﻿ I looked at her but with but resentful gaze I couldn't look into her and lowered mine. And my eyes fell on the garbage next to the door and I suddenly understood why I was called. "Oh no, she will kill me for I did'nt throw. the garbage"I didn't dare meet her eyes. And she started shouting. Well, I don't really mind her Scolding and shouting but today it had a great impact on me. I went straight to my room and slammed the door..I started crying. Half an hour later when I was a little sober, someone knocked at my door. It was Daisy, she was here to console me but its fine, I told her and asked her to leave. She was reluctant but walked out as I pleaded.After I fully recovered I went down stairs straight to the kitchen where Aunt Jessy was doing dishes. I quietly sat on on my chair.Uncle Jeff who was sitting by the fireplace now near her and he was scary. He yelled at me "You are useless, nothing but useless, always lazy and trying to find an excuse or the other to avoid work" Today, his words were rather harsh. I was strong but today I couldn't hold my tears and ran from there. Daisy was watching all this from the stair case but didn't say anything or it would have made matters worse. But she came to me and put her hand around my shoulder and squeezed it. I couldn't control myself and didn't mind here setting beside me either. Today was really bad, I cried for nearly an hour and I was having a terrible headache.I headed back to my room and told Daisy not to worry about me I sat there and didn't have dinner. Daisy came in my room and served me some food. And she left. A while later she came to see weather I had eaten or not but the plate was there untouched. "You don't want to eat, don't be bad to yourself, It won't be like that forever" She continue for a while but I seemed to take no notice.But then suddenly I stood up and asked her to leave me alone. "I'm not leaving, You have to eat first." But I shouted at here and pushed her out I sat there on my bed thinking for long if what I did was right.Then the most terrible thought came to my mind "I should run away if I want to lead a better and respectable life. I was a fool to think so But I stood up and packed my clothes. Then I glanced at the food Daisy left for me and packed it too. Then I gathered all my pocket money. It was enough to last for four days. It was mid night when I sneaked out, every one was asleep and it was the best moment to get away.I ran to the bus stand and took a bus to the Subway station. I went and took a train ticket to Ayelsbury. The train was at 7 a.m. in the morning. I waited near a shop on the bench. I took out the food I packed. I had'nt eaten for a whole day and gobbled up the food in just 10 minutes. Then I decided to take a small nap.I sat there calmly. It was then when I realized that some one was staring at me. I felt a bit uneasy.I looked sideways and suddenly turned back but found none. May be it was just a delusion. But the feeling of someone staring at me was still there and I didn't sleep all night. • Next morning I washed my face, took some buscuits and a chocolate bar and waited for my train. I had no plans but a lot of fears. And on top of that I still felt someone was watching me. I glanced at my watch, It was 5 minutes past 7 a.m. And then a train arrived the moment I looked up from the watch. It must be the train toAnd then the train arrived the moment I looked up from my watch. It must be the train to Aylesbury, I was to start a new chapter of my life and I was awfully scared. I stepped on the train. At. 1:05 the train left the station and as I did'nt sleep at night I decided to take a small nap. This time I was too tired to be distracted by anything or anyone. I woke up after an hour or so and my destination was to come soon. I sat alarmed for the challanges coming forward. I felt two eyes watching me again..... But I focussed on myself for a bit. I ran my fingers through my hair and pulled up my socks. I was so self-concious that I did'nt even hear the announcement. The train had arrived and the gates opened. I stepped out of it with a whole new imagination. ﻿ • I kept my bags on the nearest beach and went to a shop to buy water.My eyes suddenly met the Big Black Board that hung to the back-wall of shop but the name on the board wasn't "Ayelsbury. But something else, I didn't read it, the owner came back with a bottle. I hesitantly asked the shopkeeper if the place was "Adyeslbury! The shopkeeper gave an awkward look. He told me that it wasn't. My heart sank. I took the bottle and returned to my seat. My life is getting worse. It's getting complicated. "I hate myself for being this irresponsible for leaving the house. I thought. I put my head on my Knees and cried.Someone kept a hand on my shoulder, I looked up, it was Daisy.Oh, Now, it must be a dream, Daisy sat next to me I touched her and was utter surprised to see it was not a dream. I screamed. "Daisy what are you doing here? Did you follow me? Are you here alone? Am I dreaming?, I didn't give her a chance to speak. I stopped for a second to have breath.Daisy started " Are you crazy? Why are you crying again. Why did you come here? Where are we?•We looked at each other with a hundred. unanswered questions in mind.I narrated her how we here and how I sat in the wrong train.Then Daisy explained that the saw me climbing up the wall and escaping and followed me all this while. They sat there for a while. No one spoke a thing.The Daisy broke the silence. "What do we do now?" "We should walk out of here first and think way of a to return cause I haven't got much money to buy us both ticket" I told in an affirmative way.• We walked out of the station and very utterly disappointed to see that we had landed in an village. It had big green farms with flowers, fruits and what not... ﻿ ﻿W e looked around and saw a mini van with corns loaded in it. A person was standing just beside the van was talking to someone. Assuming him to be the driver of the van we waited till he finished his conversation and decided to ask him for help. The driver looked serene and calm.The conversation didn't go long It was short so as the other person lift wee decided to break in front of the driver for help.We told him that we mistakenly sat in the wrong train and ended up here. He was kind and asked if we would go to his home until we got back to our home.He was a farmer. He had a hard working wife who was also very sweet, they both welcomed us and gave us food that we are hastily because we were extremely hungry.They gave us a small but cosy room to sleep and we slept for hours. When we woke up Mrs. Blake the farmer's wife gave us sweetcorn for breakfast. We had the breakfast and were allured by its taste.Then I went for a bath, I also gave one pair of my clothes to Daisy cause she didn't bring any. We had a nice talk with Mr. and Mrs. Blake. Then we told them that we didn't know our way back home. They told us that they will do their best to help us I was really touched by their behaviour.In the Evening we asked Mr Blake if could help and he was just too glad, he asked if we would like to go with him to the Store to sell these corns.We agreed. We helped him pack his corns is to take to the shop. We kept the last stock in the carback and seated ourselves as well.We drove to the shop, it was'nt far away. Mr. Blake kept the stock inside the shop, we helped him.Mr. Blake had a short talk to the shop owner while we good outsideWhen Daisy shook me throughly, I gave her a stern look "What happened? Did you see some ghost?• She pointed towards the right. A few metres away a car was parked and I remembered. that I have seen that car before but could'nt figure where exactly did I see it. Tried my best but couldn't possibly get anything when I suddenly remembered that it belonged to our neighbors in the Jade apartments.We suddenly looked at each other and started jumping holding each others hand.Tears ran down our cheek when Mr Blake came out of the shop.He was astonished to see us two laughing and jumping.Mr. Blake also joined in the Happiness when he came to know the reason of happiness. Then he went to the owner of the car and told about us.They came and gave us each a chocolate bar and asked if we would like to go with them Back Home. He nodded our heads in Harmony. Daisy and I sat in the car. Wondering "Will Uncle Jeff and Aunt Jessy be worried or angry". Will they change their attitude towards me. BY- VEDIKA CHOUDHARY
author: VEDIKA CHOUDHARY

title: Rosie  the  Caterpillar
text: Once, there was a caterpillar called Rosie. All her friends and family were grown into beautiful butterflies. A nd she was ugly. As she was ugly, the animals and plants took advantage of it and teased her. Rosie was very sad and started crying. Just then, her elder sister Rose came rushing to her. She asked why Rosie was crying and tried to comfort her. Rosie explained the situation and Rose said "when I was a caterpillar, animals and plants were teasing me. I felt bad but fought with them. Rosie went to the crowd and told everyone ''I may be ugly but I am strong. I don't care what you call me but I will grow up to be the most beautiful butterfly ever.'' ALL the animals were very ashamed and they apologised to Rosie. She accepted it and said ''NEVER TEASE ANYONE''. ﻿ One day, Rosie was gone! were was she? ﻿SHE IS A BUTTERFLY!
author: Saanvi  Sivakumar
illustrator: Aanya Monika singh; Huynh  Vu Tuong; Ounla  Santi; Vongsavanh Damlongsouk

title: The Family Night
text: It was the month of January. I was very jubilant because it was Sunday and me and my family was enjoying it at its fullest. My father’s aunt with her son and her grandson came to visit us on the weekend. We all were having fun. Mummy, papa, uncle, and aunt all were gossiping in the big room of the house, for which they all gathered. I and my brother were in another room next to the hall playing with our little cousin brother. He is such a charming and handsome boy. He was about just 3 years old. I wonder how someone could be so cute and handsome at the same time. His broken words with his little hand gestures were making me fall in love with that little person. I could stare at his cuteness the whole night but that couldn’t be possible as they had to leave before it gets dark. My uncle’s house is very far from our place and it takes almost 2 hours to reach. And that’s what made them leave earlier. Mummy even asked aunt and others to get dinner with us but they denied it by saying, “We won’t able to reach on time.” The next day they also had to join their work again so we too didn’t force them. Then next we took them to my cousin sister’s house where they were invited to pay their visit. My mama decided to stay back at home. We also decided not to disturb his solemnity. We are five members in the house. We live in a rented house with the owners. We are on the first floor of the house and the landowners on the ground floor. My mama was sleeping in his room so we did not think of bothering him so we left him alone. At my sisters’ home, they are seven members and they have their own house. My aunt offered her guests and us some tasty snacks for what I and my brother’s eyes are always searching for. But we tried to hide our desires as we can’t ask for them directly because that would be so embarrassing. We acted like we’d not seen it coming. Aunt asked both of us to have some cookies that were kept on the table and we kept denying it as good children. We both were waiting for our mummy’s command to take it. And then finally she told us to take some cookies and go upstairs to enjoy ourselves with our sisters. We obeyed her command and went upstairs. We have a group, the Quad. The name is because we are four members of it, me, my two cousin sisters, and our only brother. We often get giggles when we all four sit together and spend time in our unnecessary talks. We all four are crackheads that can laugh at anything that makes no sense. But on that day, we were discussing something serious and it was the topic of our future selves. We started with an argument about how our lives would be in the next ten years. We discussed our future goals and debated carrier options. The elder member of the Quad is an experienced person. She helps us whenever we need her. And we rest of the three are the help takers. After the discussion was over, we felt hungry, so one of us went down and brought some snacks for all. But that wasn’t enough to satisfy the craving of the four of us. Now, it was someone else turn to go down and bring some more snacks as we thought if the same person would go again then elders would scold that member so, we thought of sending another person this time. Another went and brought some more than the previous time. But our appetite was that express train which was not getting ready to stop at any platform. One by one each one of us was going downstairs and brought snacks more than the previous person. At the turn of the last person, something crazy happened. When the last one returned with the whole bucket of snacks, we died laughing at seeing it. We all understood that our elders must have gotten tired of seeing us coming one by one so they understood the assignment and gave the whole bucket so that kids do not have to come again and again for it and disturb them talking. Then the time came when my uncle and his family with the sleeping little boy had to leave for their home. Before they went, we all were called off to come down and see them off. So, we touched their feet and took blessings. All the elders of the house went together up to the main street to see them off. They reached there and were waiting for the cab to arrive. We four were still in the house laughing at our senseless imaginations. I can’t get rid of the fact that when we will grow up, none of us would be able to laugh the same like now we can. These all are the precious moments of our life that we would never want to forget. Out of sudden something weird happened. People on the streets started running in chaos. Shutters of the shops were getting shut one by one in a row. People in vehicles were rushing to reach their homes. The Cab also hadn’t reached. Mummy, papa, uncle, aunt, and all were astonished as they could not understand what was going on over there. But they were apparent of the fact that something was wrong. After some time, a person in his three-wheeler was coming on that way. He shrieked in fright and screamed, “Leave the place as soon as possible, they are coming this way.” He was howling asking every other person he could see on the street to leave the place and return home. They all were amazed and couldn’t understand what to do. Unaware of what was going on, they all were still standing there surprised until someone cried, “Danga!! Danga!!” Everyone was stunned. They felt like their senses were not working. They all rushed towards the home as fast as they could. We four were totally unconscious of the scene. It was the moment of fun until we heard them screaming. It was strange, we did not get why it was sounded like that? Everything was fine then, what's the matter? Mummy came panting, she was so panicky and breathless. She entered the gate calling others to come quickly. We asked, "What's the matter? Why are you so terrified?" She replied, "Danga has taken place in our locality. And they are coming this way." We all were shocked. We didn't even utter a single word and went straight upto the balcony. I looked down the street, it was total dark. Street lights were cut off. Everyone had switched off the lights of their houses. All were frightened like us. Then, I saw others coming. They were coming slowly because my father's uncle who is an old person can't walk fast. And, even a little boy with them who was sleeping but woke up after the Thus, they were behind. I was afraid too. I had never experienced something like that before. I didn't understand what should I do. I behaved like others and stood silent. Mummy came to me asked to call Mama who was left in home. I didn't ask anything and did as she said. I made a call and gave the phone to her. She took the phone and said to Mama, "Don't go out now. The condition is extremely bad. There has been a riot outside which is violent and causing trouble to the people." He was about to leave for an evening walk but fortunately he didn't go after hearing the news. The whole family and the relatives were isolated in the house. No one thought of going out until the condition became better. Mami went to kitchen and made tea for all. Everyone got some relief from a cup of tea. Then, we switched on the T.V to know the situation. But, to our amazement we got to know that it was actually a rumour that was spread in the locality and many other localities too. The scene was created just to put people in harassment by some devil. After sometime we came out of the house and decided to go back to our house. Our relatives who were about to leave couldn't go anymore and decided to stay back the night and to leave the next day morning. It was terrified experience for all. Many of us even cried. But, now when we remember this incident we just get laughs that how stupidly we reacted. And, it is obvious that anyone would laugh at us when they would get to know about it...
author: Ridheeshree Nayak

title: Croaky's Adventure To a Big City
text: Croaky's Adventure To a Big City. Once upon a time, there lived a frog named, Tira. She had a baby named Croaky, she was new born. One day her mom Tira and dad Tom advised Croaky not to go anywhere. The next day Croaky asked her mother that she wished to visit the big city. But her mom warned Croaky that "You are too young to go to the big city. So you wait till you grow up." The next day Croak Croak... Croaky woke up and while her mother and father were sleeping, she went out. She saw a big forest. This was the first time Croaky came out, she was little scared. Instead of going back to her home, she started to walk inside the forest. Croaky saw some ants marching away, some birds, some insects and so on.. After walking for sometime, Croaky saw the king of the forest who was big, strong and bold and can you guess who it is? "The Lion". The big lion told, " I am going to eat you roar rrrr "...... The lion gave a big roar. Croaky ran away with fear and it suddenly fell into a puddle. Croaky was covered in mud and the lion couldn't see her anywhere. The lion went back saying, "I am never going to find a prey. Ooh! I am starving roarrr r r r r r r...." Croaky said, "phew", and started to walk but she was covered in mud. Do you think Croaky will survive in this big forest? Croaky was scared and she thought to go back but she didn't know the way.. After walking for sometime, Croaky saw a big snake. She was really scared seeing its big fangs, tongue and so on. This time as Croaky was in green colour she camouflaged and jumped into the greeny bushes to conceal her identity. Meanwhile, Tira and Tom were searching for her everywhere. But Croaky has reached the city. There were so many buildings and so many people. Croaky looked so confused. Croaky would have been stamped by people but luckily she escaped. Croaky went into a hotel. Looking at her, the girls working in the hotel screamed. "Oh! Look at this green ugly froggy". Hearing this Croaky got shocked and thought "Do I look ugly? But my mom always says, that I look pretty and beautiful ". Now with great sigh, Croaky badly wanted to go back to her home. A sweeper at the stairs, had a big broom in his hand. Seeing the big broom, Croaky's eyes popped. With the big broom the sweeper pushed Croaky down the stairs. As the hotel floor tiles were very slippery. Croaky fell into the sink and went down the drain - down - down and down. Somehow it managed to find the way out. There she met a bird. The bird carried away Croaky and put it on the middle of the road. The wild animals who were Croaky's enemies came on the left side. Seeing that Croaky got scared. At that time, she heard some croaks sound on the right side. Her mother, father and all her froggy family members crowded there. She leaped fast and joined them. Croaky hugged her parents firmly and said " I will never be disobedient again". Croaky apologised to her parents and lived happily ever after. Moral: DisObedience Lands One In Trouble.
author: Kaitlyn P  Spencer
illustrator: Jane Taylor; Malvika Tewari; Marco Tibasima; Rob Owen

title: Teen Turns Twenty-Two
text: "Woof Woof", As I open my eyes, My dog, Fidel who usually reaches out to pounce over me, has today run away. It was a bit weird, but I ignore that situation and hear mom calling. "Char! Time for breakfast" "Coming mom!", I reply. I go down to the breakfast table and visit a bustled scene in the kitchen which is now somewhat a part of our daily routine. My one-year-old brother, Oliver throwing webs out of his food, Dad is totally stressed about his promotion meeting and my mom is trying to convince my younger sister, Camila to attend school. Sometimes, a girl named Charlotte Ainsley who likes pineapple on pizza, who is me, seems to be the only normal member of the family. Except for today. Something was different, I felt rather taller and a dissimilar change in my voice had occurred. "Mom, The milk!" I did what I do everyday to seek attention and it did work, today a little far more than usual days. Everyone turns about, catches my sight, and starts looking up and down at me. "Ahem? Is there something wrong with me?" I question being agitated. "I..I..s t...that you Char?" "Who else would it be guys?!" I gasp, as I see my reflection in the mirror above the dishwashing area. I contemplated myself in the mirror with an incredulous look on my face believing it might be a delusion. I was taken aback. I had grown about eight years older! I rushed back up to my room. I rubbed my eyes, washed my face and then sat in front of my dresser. Looking at the twenty-two-year old me, all sorts of thoughts were approaching my mind. "How did this happen?" "Why did this happen?" "Do I continue to live like a fourteen-year-old or...?" And one question that was obvious but worried me the most was, "What do I do?". Even Fidel, my dog was running away from me. Of course, he was scared, I was a total stranger to him. I got even more exasperated, but I knew I had to do something to break out of this adversity. I grasped straws and went down to my parents who patently looked immensely edgy. They had made a list of things that could help me get back to my fourteen-year-old self or at least they thought it could. I was nonplussed hearing about it. They read out the whole list, "Plastic surgery?" "What? No!" "Anti-aging foods?" "Huh?" "Keeping hydrated makes you look younger." "Gosh" They were still unacquainted with the incident. "Mom, Dad, Do you realize I have grown out eight years of my life? I don't just have to look younger." My case was a secret mystery with a question mark at the end, and I perceived that only I could be the one to get rid of it. I left to find the answers to this conundrum. En route, I heard a noise, as if someone yelped in pain. As I looked towards where the sound was coming from, I saw an injured man. I forthwith went to him and questioned him about how he had gotten hurt and I got to know that he had met with an accident. I was surprised I would have ever done that. It was like my actions and ideology too were turning similar to a twenty-two- year-old. Then he requested me to take him to any hospital and I had no desire to turn him down, but how do I help him get there? Suddenly, I had an intuition as if I could drive. So I did. I could officially drive. Yes! I whooped in triumph. Talking about law, since I was theoretically above eighteen so it was legal for me to drive. I took the man to a nearby hospital in his car. It was the greatest feeling ever! This was the first time in my life I felt, I had lent a helping hand to someone. Moreover, I could drive too! This incident made me think, "What if I can do all that what I was supposed to be doing in the future, now in the present? I have to test my abilities. Since childhood, I have had this dream to float in the air and finally, today was the time I could! I sought my parents' permission and decided to skydive! I took my father's bicycle as clearly my actual bicycle was too small for me and left for the neighborhood adventure sports center. As soon as I was about to reach, it became quite difficult for me to balance the bicycle and I had to quite stretch out my feet to pedal. It was like I was short again. "Wait, What?!" I was back to being a fourteen-year-old. " Ugh! Why did this have to happen just as I had started to enjoy being an adult? " My heart sank. I went back home with a face as long as a fiddle, though I was happy to see that my parents were relieved. They were delighted to have seen their old daughter again. I learned a key lesson today. When I turned twenty- two I was discomposed then, when I turned back to fourteen, I was down in the dumps then too. No one is ever contented with what they have. From that day onwards, I decided to be happy with what I gained. "Happiness will never come to those who fail to appreciate what they already have...."
author: Shambhvi Chandna
illustrator: Clyde   Beech; Shambhvi Chandna; Simóne van der Spuy

title: The Fellowship Between The Two Good Friends
text: I paced around the room, lost in thought, wondering how to make my code work. I was trying to develop an app for a hackathon organized by our school. This app of mine had such potential that it could change the world and could turn everybody’s lives upside down, if only I knew how to code. I would have been better off if I had teamed up with someone, but I was so bad that no one would have even thought about teaming up with me. I tried a million combinations, and ended up with a billion error messages. Here and there, I tried and tried, without any luck. After two hours of doing this, it felt like somebody was thumping my head with a rock. “This is just too much for my little brain”, I thought, and I was right. After a short snooze, when my head felt a little better, I thought to get back to work. Just then, the doorbell rang, my mom told me to go open the door. I was a little angry, but did as she said. I opened the door. It was my friend, Peter. He had come to play. You should know, he is a real “pro-grammer”. He has won hundreds of competitions and hackathons. Also, he is quite a kind and helpful fellow. Seeing my face, Peter instantly gave up on the idea of playing and said, “You look quite worn out. What happened?”. I told him about my app and explained my bad programming skills. Hearing this, he asked me to team up with him. I was astonished by the kindness of my friend, considering my bad coding skills. He was risking losing the hackathon just to help me learn. I simply answered, “Alright”. We went upstairs and started working. Peter didn’t have any problems in part that I was struggling massively with. Our work went smoothly. He actually gave me some tips and told me some stuff about programming. Sadly, coder talk is like gibberish to me and I understood very little. Developing the app was quite an extensive task and we both knew that it was going to take a few weeks, but bearing in mind what it could do and that we had a month to submit it, we didn’t complain. And if you are curious what the app was about, it would help kids learn using Artificial Intelligence and Augmented Reality. The next day, Peter and I worked on the design and framework of the app. I learned quite a few tips and tricks about app design from Peter. Designing the app wasn’t very hefty and we pulled it off in a few hours. In the evening, we started working on the login sequence of the app and completed that as well. Day by day, I learned more and more from Peter. He told me about the Fundamentals of Coding which included many things like, Sequencing, Data Storage, Arithmetic, Branching and Iteration. On the seventh day, we completed the Artificial Intelligence part, which was by far the heftiest part in the app. The next day, we started designing graphics for Augmented Reality and completed it in about two days. Finally, after about 3 weeks of continuous work, we were over and done with the app. We tested it a few times and fixed some bugs. It was magnificent and the design was fabulous, and all that was thanks to Peter. The next day, we checked the app for any more bugs and made some more changes. When we were completely satisfied, we finally submitted it on the school portal. The result was to come in one more month. A few days went by... Finally, it was the day of the result. Peter and I rushed to my room and I opened the school portal straight away, and there it was, “Winner: AR Learn by Peter and Sam, Class 7 th D.”, and it was all thanks to my best friend, Peter. The End New Words 1. paced - walk at a steady speed, especially without a particular destination and as an expression of anxiety or annoyance 2. potential - having or showing the capacity to develop into something in the future 3. thumping - pounding or throbbing in a heavy, continuous way 4. snooze - nap 5. worn out - extremely tired; exhausted 6. hefty - large and heavy 7. fundamental - a central or primary rule or principle on which something is based 8. Augmented Reality - a technology that superimposes a computer-generated image on a user's view of the real world, thus providing a composite view By Dhritil Thapar
author: Dhritil Thapar
illustrator: Aaral  Parmar; Abhimanyu Ghimiray; Aditya Gupta; Ajay Hembron; Ann Maria; Godwin  Chipenya; Nan Hom Noon; Ouk  Ratha; Rishita Mahajan; Sahil Shaikh; Taanirika Sharma

title: The Holiday Trip
text: THE HOLIDAY TRIP It was a bright morning at Maldives when Peter was ready with his swimming suit, glasses and sail board to dive in the misty waters of The Atlanto Ocean. The sun was bright. The sky was clear, just with a little cottony clouds sitting over there.The mild air sighed him to take a dive. But this was not something he was good at and so he decided to sail.This was a moment of great relaxation after doing a lot of hard work in the winter’s.And the first time of being alone on a really long holiday.That too without any tensions. This was something that he had eagerly wished off. He dipped his toe thumb to check the water, it was perfectly temperated. And waves were calm.Everything seemed to be perfect. The breeze, the silence, the splashing sound of water and the Vibe. This was something that made him believe that it was really very very important to have this kind of holidays between works. He was happy, relaxed and stress-free after a long spam of time. This was the best day of his life he thought, when Mr. and Mrs. Calan along with their sixteen hyper notorious kids entered the dice to prove him wrong.Those were some of the so many kids whom he hated. From this sixteen four were small kids, six were teen freshers and the rest six were about to join the youth range.The youth was okk, the fresher’s were somewhat tolerable but the kids were enough to make him wrath. His heart beated faster and faster. This kid phobia was something more dangerous than a dinosaur to him after the Calan family had came to his life. This were the people who disturbed him the most then anybody else, he thought and realized that how wrong he was to consider his family as the most irritating and go against them and take a flat in cilia besides the Calan’s.Peter was someone who always used to search happiness in materialistic aspects, beauty of intangible and natural things was not known to him. Emotions, love and playfulness of life was all imaginary and exists in fantasies he believed. And so found all the children and his loving ones irritative.Children, because they are always joyous. That was the reason he disliked the children. But to surprise, all of them were so happy to see him unlike him. And then he could not be that cruel to skip the smile back and so there was his outlined fake smile back to them. He tried to ignore them and continued sailing. Mrs. Calan found some of her friends there and left with them shaking her hand towards her family. Mr. Calan then got ready to tolerate all those sixteen creatures and passed their time playing with ball and some other toys, looking at Peter again and again and expecting him to join them but he ignored.Then after sometime when all of them were enjoying coconut water, he grabbed the chance and landed off his sail board and started moving towards the green room where to his bad luck three of the children catched him and took him to the coconut water stall. All the young ones where so happy to see him and hugged him tightly to form a clutch.They all loved him so much because it was there nature to love and care everyone and some extra to someone they know, as for them someone they know was someone their own. But Peter was not so… After a very long hug Peter’s muscles got relaxed and he kinda liked it as he was now tired after sailing for so long and their hug worked as a massage to him.Then they sat together and talked about a bundle of stupid things, which was quit boring but he was helpless as he was not successful enough in being vulgar to him and escape from there for some time. The next was to make sand forts, everybody excluding him geared up enthusiastically to make those forts. He unwantedly had to join them. The kids sat there chitchatting, the fresher’s collected some accessories and material to decorate the fort and rest of us prepared rest of the things such as water bucket, mug, scrapers and a Shaw. It seemed like the island was their home at a time! They all so easily found all the things we needed within seconds. I was really surprised to see this. And to top this they had a three inch thick catalogue which consisted of only fort patterns and designs. All of them crowded over a single piece of catalogue, with me at the front. They all overloaded on him. My skeleton was about to crush. And that pain, OOO MY GOD. Hush… the condition was horrible. After so many disputes the conclusion was took out that Mr. Calan will all alone with me will decide the look but this disappointed the kids and anyway I was not at all interested to do that. So he thought to add some kids, But what of the teens and the youth, they rose against it and the decision was changed and finally finalized with every bodies agreement that everybody chance by chance will personally have a glance of it. Now it was the time to quarrel for the first, second, third ………. Positions. It took about the whole day for them to look at the catalogue. I was fed up with these guys. After the whole day was passed and catalogue watching session got over, my paitions also touched the bottom line. I planned to join the beach party whose advertisement and invitation boards were hung in the city. He told them that he was going to have a night shower and went to the party. He enjoyed a lot at the party. He also had new friends now. All his friends along with him enjoyed having drinks playing casino and dancing there. A special friend was henry.He borrowed all the money he need from Peter and some for his friends too. Poor Peter was not that mature here. He went with his friends and booked a room in the same hotel where all of them lived.All of them were so tired that they slept immediately. They were more than 2 dozens of people and had booked only five double bed rooms. In which four were quantried by everyone and one was his own. His friends occupied as much space as much could be consumed on the beds till he was back from the bathroom in his room. Other rooms were full too. He had no space to sleep on the beds. This made him little angry but he adjusted and slept on a mattress below. The next morning everybody forwarded to visit a famous concert by terrace wall, but peter was not with them there. He was sleeping and nobody bothered to woke him or inform him. They all went straight alone. When Peter woke, he got that the room was empty; nobody was there in any of the room. Nor his “so called” best friend Henry was there. Just the next minute a staff member knocked the door, he was there to inform Peter that his room slot was over and has to leave soon. He packed up his luggage and emotions and went down. At the counter when he was returning the keys, the manager handed him the bill of rest four rooms and the breakfast and cocktail his friends had in morning before leaving. His emotions scattered. he was completely broken now. He felt bitter. He realized that the homefullness is so important. All the care and importance we need is given by our loving ones.And so understands that family is important as it is the only one which provides us with security coupled with unconditional love and offer support.
author: Nidhi  Agrawal

title: Loving Souls
text: Once upon a time in Austin, a famous place within USA, there used to live a kind woman named Lily. Lily was a simple lady, with long curly hair and was someone who liked dressing. Being a bus driver of "SAINT PRE PRIMARY SCHOOL", she used to enjoy kids' company while picking and dropping them off the school. Since the school was so big, there were multiple buses and each bus had its own 2 digit number. Lily's bus was "88". Lily was kids' favorite too. Everything was going well until something horrifying happened one day. It was a foggy morning with thunderstorms. The visibility on the road was almost zero. Lily picked up the kids and was on her way to school. She had to cross a train track as there was a construction going on along the daily road route. As the luck could have it, unfortunately a train was approaching at the same time. Lily couldn't react to the situation and Alas!! The train terribly crashed the bus. There were 24 kids in the bus and they all died on the spot!!.... but somehow Lily survived. She was taken to the hospital by the rescue team. She was in coma for quite a long time. But slowly slowly she regained her senses and one day she recovered and sadly recollected the bad episode happened to her. She felt horrible at that moment and she started blaming herself for the lives of the innocent kids. The remorse was too dark for her to handle and one day she decided to go on the same track and finish her life. She drove down her bus on the same track and was waiting for the train to approach. But she experienced something unbelievable!! She felt as if some force was pulling her bus backwards. The bus actually moved in the backward direction as the train crossed the track. Before she could understand what just happened, she saw something magical!! She saw many small small handprints on the front glass of the bus. The lovely innocent spirits of those dead kids saved Lily...The loving souls did not want what happened to them happen to anyone else. Since then it is so believed that those spirits are still there at that place and people actually experience magical force by those tiny hands on the vehicles once they get struck. Few people even saw the handprints on the glass on foggy days!!! Moral: Give a second chance.. We all make mistakes!!

title: For The People
text: I recollect my blurry memory... We were all sitting in the living room having our evening tea. That is when someone knocked at the door “Open the door lord Heistings! We are the king’s men.” My father looked into my mother’s eyes, and it was as if they had both understood what the other was trying to say without a single word. I guess that is what happens when u have stayed with someone for your whole life. Father got up and approached my sister Maree, he whispered something into her ears ‘khusur phusur’ *something that made her eyes light up with fire. She looked up at father as though she was about to say something, but the words didn’t quite come out. Father was like a leaf unaffected by the harsh winds. He walked up to the table and grabbed a family photo amongst his other belongings. The men still at the door shouted “Lord if you don’t come out in the next few minutes, we will break the door open “and a countdown started. Father walked down the corridor towards the gate……. And while he stood with his back to the gate with the widest grin on his face, he said, “My girls, take care.”and so he kissed my mum on the forehead. He opened the gate, and then he was gone……… CHAPTER ONE 6 years have passed since father has been away from us and I don’t remember my sister or mum taking a single break. Maree has been training me for quite some time now. She is 6 feet tall, has the perfect tan skin colour complementing her beautiful emerald eyes with a hint of yellow and caramel brown hair. She is one of the finest swordswomen the world has ever seen, because she was taught by the best teacher, and that is what made a difference. Father had taught Maree all of what he knew, horse-riding, swordsmanship, statistics, politics, blacksmithing…absolutely everything. She was 13 when dad had been taken, the same as I am now. But she trains me harsher than father trained her, and I hate her for that, she thinks as though she is the one responsible for what happened to father. She keeps telling me “Haley what we are fighting for is way bigger than father, it is for our kingdom, it is for the world! There is nothing wrong father could ever do, his only so-called ‘mistake’ was going against the system and opposing the HIGH KING”. I remember there were whispers about how corrupt the system had become and what father had come to know. Father wasn’t really the type who would sit quietly and observe from the shadows. His friend and the king’s advisor Mr Lee was also informed about what was happening. Both tried bringing the king’s true intentions in front of the people, but their voices were suppressed and they were stripped away from us. CHAPTER 2 Mum and Mrs Lee are amazing partners both stood by their husbands then and are now constantly finding ways to free them from the dark dungeons. Both women are well known to the people and banned by the court, so they had started a secret society, ‘The Discreet Circle’ and the soul purpose of this society is to unmask the wrong doer. Me and Maree were also a part of it. Maree is the head of the protection front, as much as I want to be a part of it, my mum won’t allow me to be in a battlefield with a knife to my throat. Well, that does not mean that I am not a part of it. I am a part of the circle but my I don’t fight on the battlefield. In school I have made some friends, the kind who are offsprings of known individuals, and one of them might just be the successor to the throne, pale skin veins running all through his neck, dark brown eyes which reflect the lights as though they have never seen it before, jet black curly hair and royalty in all his ways, Prince Dalton Mehras. Well now I am sure you might be wondering, Okay so u are friends with the prince so what? Well he is the kind of prince who loathes his father, he holds his father responsible for his mother’s and unborn sibling’s death. About a few years ago when I was just a little lad a war had broken out between our kingdom and The Satel empire, the Satel empire played dirty tricks once they started losing, at last they killed the queen, in cold blood! He fools around going through his father’s things passing rude comments and I tag along, well but for me it is not fooling around, it is the time I become the most observant, military tactics, financial plans, secret folders with names of a selected group I memorise everything and give first-hand information to The Discreet Circle At this point we have already trying executing our plans but every time the oppose party seems to be aware. We will be trying again to make our plan work …. CHAPTER 3 I wonder how they had come to know, well we executed our plan and agin the opposite party seemed warned about our doing, I just cannot put two and two together. I tell Maree that maybe we should look for a bug in our system and without hesitation she said “ you know, we should give the all the leaders different plans and let’s see which one gets leaked, in this way we will know who is loyal to us and who is the bug “ I mean that is smart I never thought of it, and so Maree gave out different plans to everyone. Now all we have to do I s wait and play our final move Today is the day when everything is going to change As I am getting ready I seem my mum and Maree discussing something but I don’t pay much attention to it. All I am doing is keeping every single strand of my hair out of my face, I am not dressed up in an armour like them. I am going to play the part I always play and act like an innocent kid dressed pretty. But with being pretty I carry two daggers with me, if I am to need them at any point…. I have one fastened with a leather belt at my thigh and the other in my long boots and although it has a cover I can feel how cold the knife is against my skin. I try shaking off the feeling of nervousness, and the thought which hits me is, if we are to free father today he will see me after such a long time, I look like a different person and I wonder if he will recognise me? I hear the carriage approach. I enter “ good evening my lady” he greets me and I nod, “ a long way to the palace, is it not?” And I can tell, he puts on his fake smile and starts riding. Everything seems in place till now. It is planned that the armed force will surround ‘The Great Court Gathering’ and I am in the crowd signalling the team of weather the coast is clear or not. I stand with my friends listening to the philosophical people,so I don’t seem out of order, but Dalton seems to notice my different behaviour and it feels as though the blood in my veins isn’t moving anymore, my brain doesn’t have enough oxygen! Then he says “ Hay-leeh you seem blue” he bursts out laughing and so do I..I pretend to be confident in front of the person whose future I am about to ruin in a few hours I feel pity for him, he will be punished for something he didn’t do. So I try to the Change the topic and get the information which is most valuable to us right now “when is the high King going to give his speech?” He looks at me puzzled but he answers me” after the Daisies ask for my first cousin’s hand in marriage “ well the marriage proposal at such a big event is for sure a shocker, at first I thought he is joking, but then is his expressions made it clear that he is nothing but dead serious. I take my leave from the group,Dalton and come near the food counter, the chef there is the man who will send my messages to Maree. Casually taking a cheese ball I whispered, as if to the air “the flowers are being given to the royal sister after which he will come”. Now I hope someone can decode the message. And so my message reaches the protection front. This is the time when the protection front will be divided, half will disguise themselves as the kings knights and the other half with mum leading them will go free every innocent in the dark dungeon. I have no idea what happened but half hour had passed by, and out of the blue I see my father in the crowd, with a longer beard and dressed in old rags beneath a royal shall over his shoulders. My eyes filled up with tears, tears I could not let loose and I could see my sister at the gate too, I feel like running to her and tell her that I saw father however she is focused on her work and I think she would have shoo me away if I were to approach her. Now I know, exactly,what is about to happen! The Daisies asked for princess Aprine’s hand in marriage and the king had started his speech, a scripted one at that. And from here I had a view of almost everyone. Slowly I saw all the members of The Discreet Circle encircling the crowd and one of our knight was standing next to the king a single passed on and all the knights brought their swords out mid speech. The crowd panicked, that is what human nature is, every one tried to escape but the circle kept them from escaping, the knight near the king put one of her knifes to the King’s throat and the other to the minister’s throat. “What is this! Huh? “Shouted the King, that is when father and Mr lee appear in front of the crowd. I had not recognised Mr lee before he had started looking different, More like old I would say. “Brothers and sisters do not panic!” My fathers voiced echoed some were Astonished seeing him there but that was only the thirty percent of the whole population and all of them aristocrats. CHAPTER FOUR While the king was forced to shut his trap the whole crowd paid attention to Kol Heistings “ I know you think me a criminal, but no. Myself and Advisor lee were kept in the dark dungeons so that this man, our king could keep the people from the truth! The system has been taking taxes and using it wrong, actual criminals are let loose and worst of all the crisis of water in our kingdom is because of these corrupt men, they sell the common people’s water off to the neighbouring desert empire at nine times the price, so dear all I say we leave aristocracy! Let us treat everyone equal, give all the justice and face actual problems. we don’t require a throne to run things we need the people, we need each one of you “ a silence sents a shuddered up my spine …but then The crowd shouted in agreement and the people in the crowd started throwing the food in their at the king and his minister. I was curious and so my eyes searched for Dalton, I saw him not worried,but he had a smirk on his face as though he likes this scene and it is amusing! I was stunned! And from the corner of my eyes I see my Maree coming to words me.”F-father, did u see him? “a single tear came rolling down those green eyes of hers….and behind her I see see my parents approaching us my heart is already flying…. Father is already crying he says “ Maree, Haley” Maree turned a full 180 degrees and ran towards father like the 12 year old girl I remember, father has gotten weaker but he spins Maree around and both hug each other, then father opens his arms for me I give him a tight hug and he rubs on my head “ my little butterfly “……………………….. And this is where the new system comes in, a government of the people, by the people, for the people. THE BEGINNING….
author: Urvi Prakash

title: The Curious Incident
text: I asked. "She couldn't finish her Maths homework", Shreyanshu said giggling. "Look, there's nothing to laugh about it, okay?" retorted Pari coming forward to slap him. Mathematics was the only subject whose homework we either left out or did it only at the eleventh hour. I love science and arts most, while my friend Lansi likes fashion and dresses, Pari likes only arts, Niru is same as me, Shreyanshu's favourites are science and coding while Satya likes inventing things. Yesterday, our Maths teacher gave us three huge worksheets on Algebra, Geometry and Mensuration. It almost seemed like it would take a year to finish them. We had to really work hard to finish it. "Listen Pari, let me write those last few sums for you, I can write very fast", Lansi offered. "You are an angel Lansi" Pari jumped and hugged Lansi. "That isn't a very good idea you know," Niru chirped in looking up from the drawing book on which she was trying to paint the Mona Lisa. Lansi and Pari stuck their tongues out at her and went on with their plan. Two of them worked quickly and after some time shouted together, "Finished!" "Awesome", said Satya, not really interested. He was busy designing his Time Machine in one corner. It looked like an ordinary water barrel with colourful buttons and knobs on it. It was nearly complete and Satya was checking the buttons and knobs. The recess was almost over and we were gearing up for the Mathematics class when Satya exclaimed, "Done! My Time Machine is completed." Saying that, he drank some light green gooey substance from a tiny bottle and jumped inside his Time Machine. After a few minutes, the machine rumbled and out came Satya, dressed as a king, carrying a basket-full of clothes. "Well, look Lansi I've brought you some fashionable royal clothes from 1800s, which you wanted so badly", he said smiling broadly. "Does that mean, your Time Machine actually worked?" we all shouted with joy. "Yess!" cried Satya in delight. The bell rang. "Oh, noooo", we wailed, and rushed back to our seats. "Good morning, students!" roared our Maths teacher. "Well,well, well, looks like Pari..HAS NOT FINISHED HER HOMEWORK", she looked down at Pari doubtfully. "N-n-no, ma'am, today I have finished the homework", said Pari nervously, holding out her notebook. with her trembling hands. The Maths teacher snatched the notebook from her hands."Hmmm...", she said to herself adjusting her spectacles and looking at the notebook carefully. Suddenly there was a strange rumbling sound, it kept getting louder and louder and then there was a BOOM! and CRASH!! With that a purple smoke started coming out from Satya's Time Machine. "What the heck is that?" cried Shreyanshu falling flat on the floor, "Satya, you left the machine on!" As we were coughing and sneezing in the dense smoke, a strange yet cute looking creature came out of it. It is quite difficult to describe it's shape. It had only one big eye, which was focused at our Maths teacher, who had turned pale with fear. The creature took a good look at our teacher, then opened its mouth revealing five candy-coloured tongues. The tongues shot out at the teacher and wrapped itself around her and gobbled her up at once, like a gulab-jamun! "It..it..it ate her, " Niru mumbled. We were all too shocked and gaped at the alien with our mouths wide open. The alien smiled at us sweetly and said in an echoing voice, "Don't worry friends, I am just borrowing your teacher to teach mathematics in our planet, only for a hundred years. Children in our planet are rather weak in that subject. Hope you don't mind." With that it bowed gracefully and vanished inside Satya's Time Machine. We cheered loudly with joy that our Maths teacher was no longer with us.

title: My Pal
text: "I’m sure you’ve all had your endeavors as a kid. Well even if you did not this was just an icebreaker, I certainly enjoyed my childhood with just a hint of trauma.” I spoke as if I stepped on the pedestal, “I’m sure some of you are acquainted with me, I’m professor Noah Kanashii and my friends here are practically coercing me to tell you about my astounding past that they find so fun.” I say glaring at them. “This is about the time I was about thirteen and my parents were getting divorced and so they relocated me to my maternal grandmother’s home in a small town in Japan. I spent the best times of my life there. I’ll be translating the story in English for you guys. My grandma lived alone in the most comfortable yet the most mysterious house, where I would find new things almost every day. She was a very religious woman and made me wear amulets and totems and talismans and what not. It was as if she never got tired of making me like her giving me a singular and pathetic excuse of the town being ominous. I was frustrated at times but I also love her so I didn’t pay much attention. Pardon me, the hormones were just starting to kick in. Anyways, I was admitted into Horikoshi High, a high school, being the only one in the town, it was huge, giant even. I got admitted into this school because my family wasn’t sure how long it was going to take them to ‘figure things out’. I was genuinely flabbergasted at the fact that they were being so utterly ridiculous. I mean think about it, they literally changed my location, my house, my school, I lost my old friends and it was certainly going to take time to get some new ones there. Everybody there was so remarkably eerie and morbid. Nobody got me, neither did I get them. It was like I always felt cornered and so I chose to isolate myself and you wouldn’t believe what happened. Let me start from the start. As I walked abruptly into the school, in the midst of the academic year, everybody was staring at me, scrutinising my every move, it was like they had never seen a human before. Anyhow, I entered my classroom and found an empty bench at the extreme back of the room, I perched onto the seat like a bird – shy and cheerful – I greeted my fellow bench-mate beside me, “HEY, I’m Noah, I I’m new here. What class is it?” with a smile on my face. I waited for his response but there wasn’t any. I asked again. Silence again. I turned to another girl and asked about the class, she too didn’t answer, I was weirded out. She spoke almost as I was about to resign,"Math. It’s Math class. Mr. Minamoto will be teaching.” She continued as she offered me her hand greeting, “HI, I’m Satsuki. Nice to meet you. Where are you fr..” There was a massive, thwacking sound and loud scream following after. I lost it and the bigger part of me that was so dumbstruck that nobody seemed to take note and simply carried on their work as though the surroundings were completely, absolutely, perfectly fine. I asked Satsuki what in the world just happened. She was soundless and I was the complete opposite. I was hysterical. I ran down the floor giving in instinct and found myself standing in the front of the ‘cursed’ bathroom. Now, into the future, I found out that the bathroom was haunted. In fact, the entire school apparently was. I learned that the school was built on a cemetery and there were rumours about some children taking their lives by jumping off the roof from the same building I was studying in. In fact, it was prohibited to enter the premises after nightfall and the faculty was so superstitious that they performed an exorcising ritual every few weeks. Many students drawed their names out based on these beliefs. This, people, this right here was preposterous or that’s what I thought. Anyways, coming back, as I was outside the toilets, contemplating whether I should enter, I heard a screech from inside and I don’t know what got the best of me in the moment but I somehow decided to go in. It was pitch dark, grave silence flourishing over as a ray of light entered. It was like a lucid dream. Like mesmerising-just not in a good way. When my eyes wandered around, I found no one but this girl, this girl who looked just a little older than me even with a bob haircut. When I caught her gaze, her expression changed, almost like she was surprised by me. “What happened here? I heard some noise” Her expression still not changing. She didn’t make a sound. These people here were getting on my nerves. What was wrong with them. “Am I invisible?” I mumbled carelessly. “No, I am” “What?” “Kidding” She grinned like she really meant it, not like Satsuki. “Don’t you want to get to class? Oh, sorry my name is Ito Mei. You can call me Mei. And uhh what noise?” “Nothing. It must have been my mistake. Nevermind, I’m Noah, nice to meet you.” We went to class and I had no idea what was going to be divulged to me in a few weeks. It had been a couple of days and I felt that whatever I did, nobody cared. My classmates wouldn’t turn behind if there was a ghost in the room. The environment here was intense. They dedicated their lives to their studies. I couldn’t imagine what they would do if they get vanquished. It had been a few days since my first day and it was like I knew these people from ages, all thanks to Mei. She was the wallflower of the class. She never talked to anyone but me, at least I didn’t see her talking to anyone. She was overlooked in so many ways and yet she knew everything as though she did nothing but just exist as if, she was telling me, she was my best guide, which she could not be for herself. One day, something peculiar happened, the recess had just started and I took my lunch with me to my spot under the oak tree, as usual, when Mei just suddenly popped up out of the blue and desperately asked me to remove my locket. I was almost about to do it, but I noticed how restless she became, I never saw her like this for all the time I knew her and something clicked I remembered how Granny said to never remove it, it was a sort of juju. I normally would have, but it just didn’t feel right. And that feeling, ladies and gentlemen, saved me from my demise. I went home that day and interpreted the story to my grandma. She turned perilous, her expression as deep as the void. She explained to me after that Mei was a yokai commonly found in schools, a spirit who haunts school toilets. She said, “She was originally named as Hanako-San. She plays with kids she likes or drags them to hell if they refuse, she must’ve wanted to do so with you too after spending time with you but my dear boy, you saved yourself, that amulet saved you. Tell me now, just to clarify, Does the school have any pink cherry blossom trees? “So, you’re telling me that I have been hanging out with a ghost all this time!?” "Basically, yes.” she said bluntly. “Now that I think about it, there were so many signs, I have been so ignorant about these minor details” I say as I had an epiphany. “Now, child, did you or did you not see any Sakura trees. This is crucial.” “Yeah, there were some” “You are never stepping your foot in there. Your school has bodies buried under it. I thought it was just a rumour but cherry blossom trees signify presence of blood in the soil. Your school is built on a cemetery. It is surrounded with ghosts. Kids kill themselves because of dreadful things. I know these unmentionable terrors these little souls drown themselves in nowadays. Please Noah if anything awful like bullying happens to you or you feel pressurized by me, your parents or your classmates, promise me you will tell me. You need not hide anything from me, I will always look for the best for you.” She said, reduced to tears. “I love you Grandma.” I say embracing her. “I love you too, honey” I will always cherish these words. Thank you so much for being such a lovely audience and listening so diligently. I shall wish you good night.” Coming back reminiscing, I see people in the room smiling at me, I approached my friends awkwardly and they all were commending my way of storytelling, because to them it was just a story but for me and the ‘other’, it was not………………

title: Clever fox
text: Once upon a time,there was a fox with his family. One day, he was going with his family in the jungle. A bloody tiger was chasing them everyday, fox was knowing that thing. So, he make a idea. One day, he went to jungle alone, tiger get chance to kill fox. He run slow! slow! and then fast! fast!. The fox was very clever, he ran at his full speed. But tiger was also very fast,he came nearer to fox. But in front was a well.Fox was knowing that thing,so he jumped over the well. But tiger was unknown of that thing,the tiger will come out with the help of stairs.By hardly the tiger come out.Tiger think to take revenge from fox.But fox also make a plan to kill tiger.He challenged the tiger to a race. Before the day of race the fox make a trap of a big spine for the tiger. At the day of race fox ran very fast,tiger was angry he came nearer to fox and want to kill him[fox]. Fox came near to the trap,at a distance of the trap he took left turn and tiger was killed by the big spine. MORAL: Brain is better than strength.
author: Reshma Bhitade

title: WHAT PICS ME HERE!!
text: Kerala, known as “God's Own Country” just has a mesmerizing scene. My father work in Indian Navy and was transferred there. I must thank my father because were ever he was transferred we went and actually had an intoxicating time. And there was again a new place to collect memories. The train had reached the station and it was raining heavily. Ohh... finally we got a taxi to go to Navy campus. It was known Rameshwaram and Kerala famous for its coconut trees becomes a why Rameshwaram had uncountable number of coconut trees. Well, everything aside I got a new school to study. I was not worried about my studies instead was thinking about my new friends. Some thoughts that prevailed in my mind were, “will I be able to cope up with them?”, “when will I meet them?”, “will I get new friends?” and many more. The day The we reached there was the day to rest and capture everything that surrounded my flat. I actually admired what I saw that day. Next morning I had to go to school and the bus stop was mere distance from my building. Once I reach the bus stop to my astonishment the people were speaking a different language. The best thing was I did not thought of the culture and started thinking that everyone here is abnormal. What wondered in my mind was that are the mental or what? The conductor ask me “Malyali?” I was like what is this, she fortunately understood what I was wondering and again spoke “Are you from Kerala?” I said “nahi” and this time understood her confused mind and tried to speak English but nevertheless I tried and “I not Kerala my father coming so I coming to school no Kerala, Hindi.” She gave a miserable laugh and said “come dear on bus, we will go to school”. I could not understand whole sentence but understood bus and went on. That day was an unpredictable drop. The students in bus had a fluent English which helped me flow into my dreams where I was same as them speaking English. I even have a drastic laugh when I think about those days. I was proud about myself that I could speak English that time but suddenly my dream vanished and conductor asked me to come down, we have reached the school. The school was not that big but the atmosphere was like a Buddhist shrine where everything happened like a busy street but still was a quite and come place. We came down from bus and entered the gate. It had a board saying, “Welcome The Little Champs, we care for you”. This made me feel little comfortable and fresh. Never mind I could only read the word care, rest all flew from my head. A teddy stood near the gate, said “I awaited for you to come my girl.” I was not a special one, she welcomed everyone at her possible level. Now, I went in thinking I deserve the speaking Teddy. Today I will ask my father for this speaking toy. Entrance had a marvellous fragrance of flowers which blossomed to welcome me in my new school and offered its fragrance. Well... it had a magnificent garden which attracted me to pluck some of the flowers, but sadly I could not. Now I was directly towards my class. My classroom had customized walls to attract the ones like me, who were the cocoons and wanted to turn a butterfly and fly away as soon as possible. Hmm.... I was attracted. I was curious to make my new friends but sadly none of them were interested in talking to me and the funniest thing is again they were talking in English or Malayali. Both were out of my syllabus. Now comes my teacher she has an intoxicating look with brown eyes, crispy black hair, cute cheeks blushing after seeing her dear ones that is we, waiting for her. “Smile students it's rainy season, season when frogs speak, worms curl on ground and making a relaxing scene, peacocks dance". With this she started teaching as about rainy season but again after every line I could only catch the the keywords. Every class went like this and the school timing was over. Dispersal of small kids is a task of febrile confusion and sadly I was not even a part of this because I stood still as I even didn’t know where to run. We where asked to hold the shoulders of the friends standing in front. Pushing was a common disease we all had and we even did not try to cure. Some fell, some got up, some helped in falling, some helped in getting up. I was the one who enjoyed seeing them. Finally, we all say on bus and we’re dropped to our respective bus stops to our parents. I was the one who enjoyed seeing them. Finally we all sat on bus and were dropped at our respective bus stops to our parents. Everything is aside, now my mother was late actually it was not her fault, she did not knew the exact time the bus would come. It was all the situation where the conductor said everything in Malayali and I still today don’t know if she was annoyed and that was the way of expressing annoyance. My mother came finally and was very sorry for the delay. She was so scared that she held my hand from conductor’s hand said thank you and stood still. The bus started, my mother was very excited to know what all happened in school, I said that my teachers spoke hundred words I understood ten words, I did not got any friend but rest aside the school was a sign of serenity, calmness and peace. We reached home, everything was kept as a chaos. I was so tired that I had my lunch and slept. The day was actually thrilling and I had a tour in the campus. It had a beautiful park for children named “ dream”. That park was not only a sign of greenery but had enormous number of slides, marigo-rounds, swings and many more to enjoy. While enjoying, a plan not to study this evening was bouncing in my mind. As I reached home my mother received a message from school, a grand celebration of Onam is being plan the message some what said this students are going to be the most important part of this function since this will build a strong faith and belief on God and teacher run about the religion and culture the instructions where to wear set mundu for girls and shirt and dhoti for boys we did not new what this actually was an again it became miserable task in that are known area we went to many shops but could not find the last option was to call a teacher and arrange it and so did my mother. finally we had a dinner and slept. Morning was cool and and my mother made me up to the expectations of my teacher and lastly in school itself I won’t be said no the celebration with awesome and now time was to speak on Onam whatever you knew again in English everyone did exactly and now was my turn I could not speak anything the darkness surrounded, everyone was laughing like a devil, my mind was blank and I was blank. I was brought down by the teachers. I had no words to express my first experience. Things were bouncing out of my mind and this was like a horror and worst dream I went through. Well... things did not stop, function continued and beautiful dances were performed, sweet songs were sung and many things happened. That day I was offered yummy foods like dhosa, idli, bara on banana leaf to fulfill the ritual but I had no wish to eat. It was a day which brought fear in my life. My heart badly shakes when I think of the moment I went through. But it's always said until you become a sufferer you might not achieve something big. Such a beautiful place, a cool and satisfactory environment gave me a goal, a destination to reach that was to be a fluent expresser. I worked very hard to improve my English and speaking skills and so I did. Since that day, I have achieved many prices and today people say “you will rule the world by words”. I never knew that beautiful place will become a reason why I changed myself drastically. “The moment I faced, Really made me raced, I thank the time, To change my mind, I am the speaker ruler, Rest are the hearer trol ler" Kerala is actually a staggering place. It looks awesome and I got many new friends and they were the ones who motivated me at every stage of my learning. They just said that if you have thought you can do and told me that nothing is hard until you make it hard. The best place I visited in Kerala was Fort Kochi. Astonishing beach with cool air and the sunset looks vulnerable. Ships are frequently seeing things there and sometimes fishermen do come to show their talent. Their talent flashed and even crabs came out of the sand on beach. We had a competition to build a castle using sand, enormous things to eat and enjoy the weather there. Kerala has given me adorable memories to friends and a lesson in life. "NEVER STOP LEARNING BECAUSE LIFE NEVER STOPS TEACHING'' ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ Life teaches you continuously, every second. Collect the life lessons and experiences to be the perfect at the end. Keep smiling and learning.
author: Riya .

title: The Lazy Girl
text: Once upon a time there was a lazy girl named Lily. She was so lazy that she do not gets up to drink water even if she is thirsty. One day she told her mother, " Mom! I want to pet a rabbit.". Her mother thought that if she will get a pet for Lily, she might get little active. The mother agreed and brought her a rabbit. Guess what! It was a talking rabbit! The Lazy Girl Author Nia Patel Lily named her rabbit Fluffy. Lily's mom was taking good care of Fluffy, but she was unhappy because Lily was not talking to her. She used to sleep all day, so Fluffy decided to teach her a lesson. One day Fluffy went to Lily with a doll and said that," This doll is my best friend!". Lily cried, No! I am your best friend!" Fluffy said that, " you don't talk to me! you don't play with me! you don't take care of me! I don't want a lazy friend." Lily realized her mistake and she said sorry to Fluffy and her mom. She started taking care of Fluffy and helping her mom. She became very active and they all lived happily and energetically.
author: NiaiZ Patel

title: Adjectives in English
text: An adjective is a word that describes a noun. Example: Sharmila is wearing a beautiful dress. Here the adjective 'beautiful' describes the noun 'dress'. Let us see few more examples of adjectives. Brinda cooks tasty food. The thief had an evil plan. Jacob had a part-time job. Kashmir has a cold weather. The pillows were soft. Saira was a friendly girl. Prem was taller than Dev. Ballet is a Russian dance. These are pink flowers. Activity 1: Identify the adjectives in the following sentences. 1. Preetha is a courageous girl. 2. Shyam is a well-behaved boy. 3. Margaret has thick hair. 4. The juice is sweet. 5. The rock was hard. Activity 1 - Answers - Adjectives
