title: Ron's Terrible Experience
text: Ron's Terrible Experience This story was told by a rich old and intelligent man named Ron Weasley to his grand children telling them the importance of family. Ron Weasley was the founder of a famous TV company. He told a story to his grand children telling them about the worst experience he had during early year of company. we can't judge a book by its cover.. Grandpa, please explain us. Ron started the story by saying that he was the only son of his rich father and had a sister named Hermione. They both went to school but as Hermione was 1 year older than Ron, she was in the upper class while Ron was in lower class. Ron said that he had best friend in class named Aston. Aston was a smart, young and intelligent boy but belonged to poor family. Ron continued that, both of them trusted each other a lot, spent a lot of time together and shared strong bond of friendship. They both graduated from same college, but Aston didn't get a job as he couldn't pass the interview but Ron got a job on the basis of his wealth and money. One day Ron went to visit his best friend and was shocked to see his best friend leaving in misery and debt. So he decided to help his best friend. Ron continued that he trusted his friend so much that he had left his job on his advice and also invested all money in business. Ron and his best friend Aston set up a company. They earned a lot of profit initially and everything was going smoothly. Ron became wealthier and Aston earned wealth as well. Ron now began saying in deep voice and said that, he trusted Aston a lot and so he wouldn't care a lot as his best friend Aston was there and so left company in his best friend's hand and went on a trip. When he came back, he saw that the company was going in loss and debt was increasing. So he consulted Aston and on his advice invested all his wealth and even sold his property and used this money to aid the company. Here Aston left Ron alone by saying that he had no wealth left and is going to village. Now Ron was alone holding the debts of company which were in increasing constantly. So he consulted his family members and specially his sister Hermione. She sold all her jewellery to aid Ron. But this couldn't change anything. As a result burden on Ron was increasing and he became depressed and tensed. He began feeling himself as a burden on his family. He was on verge of suicide. Seeing this Hermione felt very sad and decided to help his younger brother. She was very intelligent and kind hearted. With help of her friends she came to know about stock market. She began to study stock market and invested slowly. After sometime she earned a lot of money and gave it to Ron. This money helped to survive. Ron now continues that, his sister began helping him in company and also tried to find the cause of losses, the company had to bear. She found that it was Ron's best friend Aston who brought company in losses and secretly moved to a big city and started a new and big business. Ron then said slowly that, after hearing this he started crying and hugged his sister and had begun saying sorry for misbehaviour he had done. This incident according to Ron had told him the importance of family and also that we should g ive first preference to family and then friends. He then gave some part of his share to every member of his family and broke partnership with Aston, the best friend who had betrayed him. Then he lived happily with this conclusion Ron ended the story and helped his grand children realize the importance of family. Moral - we can't judge a book by its cover. Family is the only one who supports us during hardship of life. Story by - Name – Atharva S. Alone Class IX {A} School –Yavatmal Public School, School Affiliation No 1130137

title: PATHETIC
text: I opened my lost treasure yesterday, the collection of diaries I so preciously kept. Old habits can be so beautiful sometimes that you often regret leaving them. This particular entry is quite close to my heart.. 15th September 2019 College can be so tiring sometimes. Here I am, sitting in this chilly wind in this creepy railway station waiting for my delayed train which will take me home. Home, for me, I never found my home, if you call buildings home? Then yes, I have many homes! But home is somewhere I find peace and let’s face it, after so many degrees and awards I still haven’t found my home. Back to the present, apart from my haunting thoughts. In that chilly, cruel wind suddenly came a ghostly sound, a soft cry! I was spooked. Sweat ran down my face as I approached the voice. It was not what I expected. There in some ragged clothes was a mat-furred dog! He was shivering with cold. I was cold-hearted and turned my head opposite side and kept sitting on that same bench. People might say I’m cruel, but I was showing him what the world would be like. Pathetic. Yes, I was pathetic, and I always will be, people made me so! Scrolling my phone unnecessarily when I was. The dog came and sat right in front of me! Desperation can be very cowardly. I thought the dog was not strong, but it turned out otherwise. The dog cooed again this time pleading with me to at least spare him a look. I looked around and there was no one. No kind soul. Were there any kind souls even left? That is when I decided to look into his eyes. That is when I broke apart. I saw in his eyes what I feel, loneliness and worst of all pathetic. I know many of you will humor me because I compared myself with a dog but one day or another you will realize that they are much more capable of love than we are. The dog was strong because it did not lose hope, it was I that was weak and lost the hope of encountering kindness in this world. There were no jackets or blankets around me, I did not know what to do! So I hugged him. I am seriously still contemplating what came over me, but I just hugged him. We were both abused by humans. The shops started opening by then. I bought a few biscuits and gave them to him. It was around 7:00 am when I found the shopkeepers opening their stores. As the mist of the incense stick and the ringing sound of the bells from the nearby temple surrounded us he was still sitting there. Watching me, as if he knew how I felt as if he was me, he knew everything about me and my life. He was comforting me. Again I know you must be thinking what a fool I am for seeking comfort in dogs but that is what happened. Those who touched my heart and truly saw what was inside were his eyes! Without caring for what I looked like if I was fat, dark-skinned, ugly, or disabled he loved me. I truly know now. When I saw his tail wag I knew this is what I want. This is what I was craving for-love. Maybe not as deep as the ocean, maybe not beautiful but just love. I came out of my trance as he licked my hand. Now that my thoughts were away his worry washed over me “Where will he stay?” “Will he be alright?” “What will happen to him once I am gone?” “Will he die in an accident?” “Will he starve?” And these questions brought me back to reality about the uncertainty of his life. But keeping those thoughts aside I got up and watched around I walked to the shop nearby where a kind-looking old man was selling some stuff like chips, soft drinks, biscuits, and snacks this was the man who let me buy those biscuits so early for the dog even before he opened the shop. I approached him the dog followed, and asked him,” Sir I really want this dog to be fed even when am gone. I will go via Rajdhani train in about 15 minutes but if I pay you will you feed him regularly?” “Surely son I will feed him but I cannot accept this payment I will feed him for free!” and he smiled and EUREKA! I found kindness! The hope came fluttering back on that tree of despair of mine. Despite his many protests, I gave the man some money which is likely to sustain the dog for like a year at least. I saw some little kids selling some keychains. They were quite small and cute I bought one and I decided to put it around his neck. It was very convenient as he already had a collar on. At least he had someone who abandoned him. What should I write on the keychain? As I was still thinking about his name the loud whistle of the train rang loudly. I quickly scribbled “DOG” on that keychain and gave him a quick pat “I will come back for you!” I whispered in his ear and ran to the train. All the ride home I thought that how a small incident can change one’s perspective on life. I came back for him a year later which was about a month from now I found out he died a painless death the man I paid returned all my money and his keychain he was quite surprised I even came for him He was in a better place. A tear escaped my eye as I smiled. He was a home that found a wanderer like me. Today I am starting a street animals’ charitable organization named “SUKANT” I found my home. Yours truly
author: Riddhima Garg

title: UNITY IS A BOON
text: Once upon a time in a forest there lived many animals. There lived monkey, lion, deer, rabbit and many more. There was no king in that jungle. They all were very friendly with each other and lived like a family. Whenever any hunter came and tried to hunt any animal, the other animals used to help him to escape from the hunter's trap. So, animals never got trapped in the hunter's trap. This was all due to their love and unity. But one day, a new animal came to the forest. His name was Bholu, the gorilla and he was very selfish and greedy. All the animals welcomed gorilla very lovingly and warmly not aware of the fact that he was greedy. Gorilla pretended to be very friendly and simple. Gorilla asked monkey who the king of that forest was. The monkey replied that no one was the king of that jungle. They were all friends and family. Gorilla was astonished. He said "What?". Then he thought that if he could become the king of that forest and rule them, it would be great. To execute the same, he made a plan. He called a meeting and invited all the animals to the meeting. When everyone gathered in the forest, gorilla told everyone that they should make someone the king of the jungle.He said that they needed a head.All animals refused to agree to gorilla's advice and asked him why they needed the king as they all lived together like a family. Gorilla tried to convince them saying that if they would make a king, he would always help the other animals when they were in danger. They all denied again but the little rabbit agreed to his decision, then rabbit convinced his parents. Slowly and gradually, one by one all the animals of the forest agreed and said "Okay!!". But now, there was one question in everyone's minds. All the animals were confused whom to make the king so, they asked Bholu about the same. Then Bholu replied, "The animal who is the strongest, the cleverest and the most powerful animal will be declared as the king". All the animals became selfish and started arguing by saying "Me - Me - Me and Me".The lion said" I am the stongest one,so I should be the king. " The elephant said," No, I am the most powerful one,I will be the one." The fox said " See, due to my cleverness, I have saved the life of animals so many times. So, I should be the king." All the animals started fighting with each other. Now, they stopped talking with each other. They were blaming each other for every small thing. Meanwhile Bholu, the gorilla wanted wanted to take the advantage. He was trying to increase the misunderstanding between all the animals as well as he was trying to be the loved one of every animal. Gorilla was trying to provoke all the animals. Once who we're friends had become enemies now.One day a hunter came, he saw that animals didn't live together.So, he thought it to be a great opportunity. He caught and hunted all the animals one by one. All the animals realized their mistakes but it was too late. All of them were killed one by one by the hunter. MORAL: Unity is boon and don't trust others blindly.
author: Punya Goyal
illustrator: Brian Wambi; Huynh  Vu Tuong; Punya Goyal; Sanjay Sarkar; Suresh  Mohli

title: GIRLS CAN DO IT TOO
text: It was Deepa’s thirteenth birthday and she had invited her friends to a party at home. Her brother Deepak too had invited some friends from his cricket team. Celebrations were in full swing and the children had a scrumptious meal and a gala evening. After the guests left, Deepa and her brother retired to the bedroom to watch a movie. It was family time and they waited for their parents to join them after clearing the dishes. Deepa asked Deepak, “Bhaiya, would you let younger kids join your cricket team?” “Of course. Who do you have in mind?’ Deepak asked. “Someone, you have known all your life” replied Deepa. “Who, Papa and Mummy”, Deepak laughed heartily. “No Bhaiya, Its me. I want to play Cricket” Deepa replied. “Don’t joke Deepu. Girls don’t play cricket and you are far too young”, Deepak told her firmly. “But I have been practicing and I am confident of playing better than some of your friends” Deepa replied. “Yes, with a rubber ball! But, playing with a regulation ball is different. You may get hurt. I don’t want to break your heart, but girls can’t play the game." Deepak was adamant. “You are judgmental. I have been watching your game” Deepa replied. “Stop arguing. There is no place for girls in my team.” Deepak interjected firmly. At this moment, parents joined in and the conversation stopped. Next morning, being Sunday, Deepak went away to the cricket ground and Deepa left for Anjali’s house. Anjali was Deepa’s friend for over a decade and she confided in her about her conversation with Deepak the previous night. After listening to her, Anjali said, “I have a plan. My mother and I are going for haircut. Ask your mom if you could have a bob cut. It will look nice on you. Also, seek her permission for a sleepover at my house for three days. That’s part of my plan, which I will explain later.” Deepa ran back to her home and after obtaining permission from her mother to have a bob cut, she went to the parlor with Anjali and her mother. Next day, Deepak was approached by two young boys, wearing hats, to play in his team. After ascertaining that the boys, Anjan and Chetan had played cricket, he admitted them.. When the match ended, Deepak realized that, had it not been for the good batting by Anjan and excellent bowling by Chetan, his team would have lost the match. He complimented the newcomers and told them to have a nice sleep, so they could perform better for the match next day. During the next match, Anjan again proved valuable and single handedly brought up the score, after their batting order had collapsed. They ended with a respectable score and Deepak was confident of winning the match, if Chetan repeated his form. Chetan, proved to be a dependable bowler and sent back the opening batsmen without a single run. The match was getting interesting. It was in the tenth over that the batsman lofted the ball. Anjan was quick to react and took five quick steps, jumped up and caught the ball in midair. While doing so, his hat fell off, exposing Deepa. Her disguise had been blown. Watching her, Deepak rushed towards her and said, “It was you all this while! Weren’t you at Anjali’s house. How could I not see through your disguise?” Deepa laughed and told him, “Yes, I was at Anjali’s house and Chetan is actually Anjali.” Deepak felt embarrassed and ashamed. “I am so sorry Deepa to have misjudged you. We boys always typecast girls but now I know that girls can match boys in every field.”
author: Lakshanya Mishra

title: From Dawn to Dusk and Back Again
text: Somewhere in the middle of the night... “Stop, leave me alone!” I suddenly felt a hand grabbing me from behind. They seemed to have returned. I tried to run, to hide and never be seen again. But I fell, and here I am, back to my void….. Darkness and silence across, with me wanting to live here alone, forever. I just can’t move; my head hurts and my eyes refuse to cope. I don’t think I’ll ever get out of this! 8 a.m. May 10, Present day... I’m sitting in my room, anxious and apprehensive. What if I trip on my way to class, or just turn cold as a stone when someone asks my name? Hello friends, I am Avery Miller, an average 14-year-old who’s moving to a new school today. Of course I’ve never wanted to go; I miss my old friends, but then, what could I have done when I have been left up the creek without a paddle by my own mother who suddenly decided to change jobs! I reach school. There are many kids around and I can hear the familiar chattering, giggling and whispering. I am wondering who from these checkered uniform clad girls & boys will I become friends with. But then, I feel the oddity. They are all staring at me without batting an eyelid as I walk past. I brush it off; After all, I’m the new kid on the block! Upon reaching the classroom, the teacher’s warm smile and cheerful “Good morning”, just helped me clear the air and I was all set to introduce myself. With a joyous face and a twinkle in my eye, I waved at everyone and said, “Hey! I am Avery. It’d be awesome to get to know you all.” It was finally lunchtime and while I was trying to ignore all the stares since morning, I decided to walk up to the twins. “Hey both, I’m Avery; you can call me Av. Would you like to be friends?” Suddenly, they gave me a weird, disgusted look and left. I went back to my seat flabbergasted. Over the next few days, the stares continued. It was almost as if someone was playing a challenge of who would blink first. Finally, I decided to confront a girl called Elana. “Hey Elana, how are you?” I said. As expected, I got the look again. This time, I asked her, “What’s wrong, why won’t you talk to me? Why do all of you give me the same disgusted look?” She got up irately and said, Don’t you know, you ugly Avery - with all those weird spots on your skin, you look like you’re some white patchy weirdo. We can’t stand looking at you, let alone talking to you.” I froze. My heart stopped, and I felt numb. They hated me because of my vitiligo. My worst nightmare was a reality! With a heavy heart, I walked back to my seat. That day, I spent hours locked away in my room, weeping and staring at myself in the mirror, thinking ‘I am back to my void’. Self – doubt was a cloud that had cast its shadow on my true self. It had never been so hard. All my old friends, teachers and family had always told me that I was beautiful. This was another world. Days passed and the cloud became darker with the stares being taken over by insults, cat calls and conversations behind my back. I was falling into depression and was certainly not myself anymore. 29 th of October... It was like any other day until Sarah joined our school. Strangely, she too, got the same stares as I had got when I had come in; I just couldn’t place a finger on it. What was going on? And then I overheard two girls talk about it in the cafeteria. “It was her color”. I gasped and ran back to the class, saw Sarah sitting quietly in a corner, staring out of the window. I walked up, sat beside her and squeezed her hand gently with mine. She smiled back and I suddenly could see a shadow pass by, leaving behind the warm glow of the bright sun - smiling away, looking down at us through the window. The next few days were like a whirlwind. I felt happy with Sarah as my new BFF. Class activities, tests and games, and then everyone started getting ready for Halloween. One day, Elana came up to us and said, “Hey Avery, I bet you’re excited for Halloween. It must be so easy for you. Simply dress up as yourself without any make up on and everyone will think you played monster!” She walked away laughing. I was devastated. Sarah was shocked and furious as a favored child. “ How dare they? “Just don’t pay heed, Avery. Your inner beauty is precious and yours forever, don’t let them ruin it. And now, let’s do it! Let them see the real you, dress up your soul with a worthy, studded robe made of compassion, empathy and patience. We will be just US!” And from that day onwards, we became the unstoppable ‘Aoife’s’ – princess warriors who always managed to get back to the dawn from dusk as we fight our way through, with dignity, pride and a peaceful heart!
author: Shivangi Talwar
illustrator: Abin  Shrestha; Avishek Sen; Debasmita Dasgupta; Jacob Kono; Lavanya  Naidu; Madhuvanti Anantharajan; Offei Tettey  Eugene; Proiti Roy

title: The not so circus trip
text: Memorial Trust Why are families such a mess? And why does everybody freak out on the most minute inconvenience? Though I am fed up with all the drama, it’s usual so I can handle it. Anyways, everyone needed a break so we decided to go to a Circus show. Mom and Dad have been to many of them in their childhood but for us, it's our first, so I and my brother are really excited. However, there’s one thing, it’ll take us 5 hours to reach there. I guess we are going on a road trip everybody!! It wasn't off to a great start which really wasn't unexpected in our family. It has been an hour since we took off and we are still fighting over why we got late. ﻿ “It won't work like this anymore”, dad said, “You need to be disciplined”. “We know dad, we know”. I said. “We are growing up and we need to be more responsible, I get it”. “I don't think you do”, he said. “Let's not talk about it on a road trip dad”, I said. “Let's play some music”. “Fine, but remember, if you both continue being like this then I’ll take a big step and you sure won't like it”. Luckily the music worked. Eventually the atmosphere changed and everyone was finally ready to enjoy the journey. Mom cut some fruits for us and passed us the sandwiches she made. We were all singing the old and nostalgic [well, only for my parents] songs together when I felt something wasn't right. I started feeling queasy, clammy and nauseous. Suddenly I threw up in the car. Apparently I forgot my medicine of motion sickness on the table and thought I took it. It took us at least half an hour to clean it all up. “Irresponsible”, dad said. Once again, we started our journey. Sure enough, no one was in a mood to talk but then finally mom broke the silence, “Does anyone want to play a game?” she said. Silence was the answer except my little brother. He always gets excited and it’s pretty adamant to live his childhood to the fullest. “Okay, so guess the number of cars you may see a passing by and then count them in a low voice. If your guess is right, you will get a surprise at the end”, dad said. Now your sister is going to check if you cheat”. I was resistant but afraid that another lecture was coming my way so I did it anyway. He started counting hoping he will get a new toy as a surprise but I wasn't going to let that happen. Dad’s phone chimed,”Oh, a Facebook notification, today is Jack’s birthday!!” dad exclaimed. “He was a former friend of mine”. “Do we know him dad?” I asked, “there was a teacher in our school whose name was Jack but he only stayed for a month”. “No you don't know him but I wish you both could meet him, I think you will like him”. An hour passed. We were all starving but mom still won't let us eat. She has been here before and her friends and said she knew a place. We looked everywhere for it but it was so crowded, we could barely see. I was just about to doze off when she screamed with excitement “there it is, that's the place!”, she exclaimed. I sighed with relief. Finally we can feed ourselves now. We got there and ordered.. It was a really nice place and the food was also delicious. Worth the wait. It was a really nice place and the food was also delicious. Worth the wait. “I want to use the restroom”, my brother said, “but I am not sure where it is”. “It's right there, on your left” mom replied. He stood up and tried to leave but he had a napkin attached to his t-shirt and that napkin got stuck with the plate somehow. His plate fell off the table and broke into a hundred pieces. “ I want to use the restroom”, my brother said, “but I am not sure where it is”. “It's right there, on your left” mom replied. He stood up and tried to leave but he had a napkin attached to his t-shirt and that napkin got stuck with the plate somehow. His plate fell off the table and broke into a hundred pieces. To my astonishment, mom and dad did not scold him and just paid for the loss. There was something strange about them today, something unfamiliar. They were a lot more patient, calmer and Happier but also sad at the same time. It was beyond my understanding so I just tried not to notice it again and enjoy the day because it seamed to mean a lot to them. To my astonishment, mom and dad did not scold him and just paid for the loss. There was something strange about them today, something unfamiliar. They were a lot more patient, calmer and Happier but also sad at the same time. It was beyond my understanding so I just tried not to notice it again and enjoy the day because it seamed to mean a lot to them. “I ate so much, it's going to be hard to drive”. Dad said. “The food was so good, I hope your mom takes some notes”. Mom punched him on his arms. “Are you saying I don’t cook good?”. Absolutely not dear, you are the best chef I know”, dad said and winked at us. “Let’s go now. We don't want to waste time, do we?” mom said “we will miss the Circus showed we booked”. We quickly got into the car and took off. My brother’s focus was more on the surprise he wanted now. “Count properly Marvin. Don't skip numbers, I’m watching you”. “I did not skip” “Yes you did” “No I did not” And this went on and on until because of that little display of our maturity, mom and dad had to pull over and give us a huge lecture on how to behave while someone is driving. “Do not test my patience kids. More blunders and I am not going to tolerate it anymore”. “We’re here kids”. Dad said. “Let’s go”. “We’re here kids”. Dad said. “Let’s go”. We got out the car but it didn't look like a circus. Though I haven't seen a circus before, I still know how the environment is and this was not it. It wasn't crowded, only some families were there. Children were crying and so were some parents. I asked my mother where we were but she didn't respond. “This is your surprise dear” dad said. “We are not here to see a Circus show. I looked around and saw a board. It… It was a boarding school! Then it hit me, meeting Jack [the teacher], the mist of sadness on their faces, rather than usual anger the calm reaction after the incident during lunch. I had no clue that would be our last lunch together for a long time. “The surprise isn't so exciting now, is it?”

title: My New Family
text: "Ahha, my daughter looks brave". My dad said when I was born. He gave me my name, Amy. My dad is a government teacher and my mom is a housewife. I had a happy life with them until I was 7 years. after 7 years, everything went sideways. "Mom, today is my birthday, please buy me a cake..please...please..." I said to my mom, excitingly. Being their only child, my mom and dad loved me dearly. So she agreed and before going to buy the cake, she said, "Sweetheart, you stay with Jonah until we caome back, Okay. We will come back soon". After saying so, they went away and left me behind. Jonah is my neighbour. he's 3 years older than me. We play together frequently. His mother is a kind hearted woman and considered me as her own daughter. After a while, Jonah's father came home and whispered something to his wife. She was shocked. "What is it Aunty?" I asked. I was curious. She replied, "It's... nothing Amy". Her voice was trembling. "But.." she went on "Your mom and dad travelled farther to buy your present, but don't worry they will be back soon". I was so happy that mom and dad were going to buy me a birthday present. That evening, Jonah's father bought a gift for me and said, "From today onwards you don't have to call me uncle but daddy, Okay, and your aunty, mommy and Jonah, brother". After saying that, he showed me the room I will spent the night. The next day, I was waiting for my parents. But they didn't come. After sometime, Jonah's mother came and sat beside me. I asked her "Why haven't they come yet?" She was shocked that I called her mom. She changed the topic of our conversation. "From today, you can start going to school. I registered your name in the best school". She said happily. The next day, I started going to school. Time passed alot. I became one. My dream job became a reality. I got many cases in court and won them one after another. Years passed by and one day I got a serious case. It was an old case, many years ago. it was an accident case of a husband and wife. When my parents came to know of this they said, "Amy, you don't have to do this. Just leave it and please don't do this case. But I can't reject the crime and just leave it behind. S So, I reasoned to them. "Mom, Dad, Jonah, I have to do this. It's my duty. This is a serious case". After saying that, I stood up and went to court. My parents acted so strange and seemed so worried. After a while, the court sessioned. A girl handed me a paper and said, "Maam, here's the list, there is everything about the case". I thanked her and started reading the list. While reading so, tears fell from my eyes and I rushed to my house and cried. My mom and my dad met an accident when they were going to buy my birthday gift. I was angry and disappointed that I was not told. They came to me. Aunty said, "Amy, I'm really sorry. Please don't think us wrong. PLease, think us as your real family". Jonah didn't know much about it. My aunt and uncle were crying so hard. But for reason, I just went to my room and cried for a good long time. After sometime, I realised something. 'I am the luckiest girl'. Even though I lost my parents, I am not sitting in the corner of a street and begging to survive. I feel fortunate to have such a great and loving family. No favouritism between me and Jonah. I thank my stars. I stood up and went to hug my aunt and cried out. "Mom, I thank God for giving me such a wonderful family". And my uncle said, " Amy, you are a thoughtful girl, we love you so much". He went on, "From the day your parents left you, we don't have anything to give you. But, all we can give you is love, Amy". "I'm grateful to have you all and I think that I'm staying with my real family". I replied happily. From then on, we lived together happily like a real family ever after. 'A good family is a great blessing'.
author: Nengneiem Haokip

title: LUCAS
text: LUCAS This story is about a boy named Lucas who was 14 years old and he lived in Texas with his parents ever since he was a baby. Lucas had a tough time growing up. In school, he was always picked on for being a little fat and short and always kept quiet. He never talked to anyone in his school and never made any efforts to make friends. He was a top student in all his classes so he thought he never needed any friends and all he wanted was to make his parents proud. One day it was raining very heavily, Lucas and his parents went out for a drive, everything was fine until a black shady car started following them. Lucas’s father started driving really fast and all of a sudden his father lost control of the car as the brakes had failed, when suddenly the car stopped and the black car behind them crashed into their car and they all met with an awful accident. Unfortunately Lucas’s parents had died and he was the only one alive. Because of loosing his parents at such a young ageLucas never got attached to anyone except for his Grandfather who took care of him after the death of his parents. After his parents had died in that tragic accident his personality had completely changed over the years. He was not the same sweet and innocent child he was but he was not a rebel either. He became this sturdy and strong minded boy who was not afraid of anything now and he was still one of the top student of his class even without his parents’ guidance and support.Lucas did not care much about being the first in class anymore as the only two people who he wanted to be proud of him were not with him anymore. One fine day another boy had moved into the house which was right next door to Lucas’s. His name was Zay. Zay had a overfriendly and cheerful personality.He made friends very easily on the first day of school. He then spotted Lucas sitting on the last bench and went up to him. Lucas completely ignored him when he tried to talk to him. Zay was not a person who gave up so easily. Lucas was always interested in Horse riding. Every year there was a horse riding competition and he always took part in it. This year Zay decided to take part in it too. Lucas started to see that Zay was trying very hard to be friends with him. Zay started doing all the things Lucas liked to do specially horse riding. So when Lucas saw Zay practicing for the competition he decided to talk to him. After that they both talked for hours and Lucas finally considered Zay as a friend. They both started meeting often and found they both had many similar interests. They would do all sorts of things together be it horse riding or studying or exploring new places,etc. It was finally that time of the year, when the most awaited Horse riding competition was going to take place. Lucas and Zay both were extremely excited for it. They both decided that no matter who wins they will be happy for each other. But both were competitive and deep down wanted to win. They both practiced rigorously for it. And on the day of the competition Lucas’s grandfather called him and told him that no matter who wins he will proud of him.But Lucas was determined to win. When the race started Lucas was in the lead but soon the other participants caught up and Zay was one of them. The race was coming to an end and just near the finish line, Zay’s horse got out of control and bumped into Lucas’s horse making him fall off his horse. At that moment Lucas’s grandfather ran towards him and picked him up. Lucas was unconscious then he suddenly got flashbacks of the accident in which he had lost his parents. His grandfather took him to the hospital. After a few hours when Lucas got up he was very confused and was feeling dizzy. Then he asked his grandfather about the race and if Zay had come to meet him while he was in the hospital. His grandfather then told him that Zay had won the race. He did not stop to help Lucas as he was a few inches away from the finish line. On hearing that, Lucas told his grandfather that he felt betrayed by his own best friend, the only friend he trusted and he cared for. His grandfather then told him that Zay had come to meet him with the trophy and said that he did not stop to help Lucas because he did not want any other person to win except Lucas or himself. Zay also said that he immediately came to the hospital as soon as the race had ended. Lucas got up and ran out of the hospital to meet his best friend. But he saw that Zay was sitting right outside of the hospital on a bench.Zay started apologizing frantically as he thought that Lucas would be angry at him for leaving him, but to his surprise Lucas hugged him and told him that he deserved the trophy. After that they promised each other that they would not let any misunderstanding or anything else get between their friendship and would always do what’s best for the both of them.
author: Samaira Tomar

title: A story of a lonely girl
text: This is a story of a lonely girl which does not have any family, friends or anyone with whom she can talk. She is very lonely in her small hut. No one plays with her and no one talks with her. She watch children playing in the garden from her window, but she cannot go with them to play.. She have a daily routine of every day. She wakes up at 7 in the morning. Then she take her breakfast. She makes her breakfast by her own. Then she takes bath and sits near the window or outside to the house alone for the rest of the day. Then she go to sleep at nearly 10 pm. She only know to make dal and rice and nothing else.. There are so many people living near her society but no one talks with her and no one cares what she is doing inside the house. She thinks "I will be the luckiest if someone comes with me and talk with me." ﻿Then a lonely boy comes to her home and knocks at the door. The lonely girl open the door. She was very excited to know who came to meet her.Then the boy ask, "May I come in?" The girl was a little bit scared was happy. She said,"YES, you can.". then the boy explained that he is also lonely in her apartment and want to be a friend of the girl. Then they both became friends and lived happily their whole life.... The moral we get is- You should never be partial to people...
author: Mansi Yadav

title: About Spinosaurus
text: Spinosaurus is the biggest carnivorous dinosaur of all of the dinosaurs! Spinosaurus is the biggest predator to ever walk the earth. It was a gigantic 60 foot in length and weighed a humongous 9.9 tons. This is the same as about 3 large elephants. The meaning of Spinosaurus is 'Spine Lizard'. They lived in the Cretaceous Period. Their length was up to 18 metres (59 feet), The gender of the Spinosaurus is male. Cretaceous period and could exert a force of 4,200 lbs per square inch
author: shri shadhak

title: THE MASK GIRL
text: Shyla was a little girl. She was adopted by an old man who needed a daughter. Shyla had a hard life, Shyla’s parents gave her for adoption when she was born. Her parents made her way to the adoption because they thought she was ugly girl and foolish too, her parents were embarrassed looking at her face. Shyla lived in the center for quite a long time but she was intelligent inside. She was broken when she did not have a family as her friends did. Everytime a couple passed by her she was neglected because of her ugly face. But one day an old man came to adopt a girl. He saw that Shyla stayed there for too long as nobody wanted her,but the old man knew that she would make-up for her someday and did not mind her ugliness a bit thinking she should have a family. She then went to the old man’s house. The house was big and beautiful. she had a new life with her father. she also help him with the chores and in many things. After few days her father enrolled her in a reputed school. But it went all wrong when she first entered into her classroom. Everybody was staring at her as if she was a ghost! Her day went awful as the bullies had a great opportunity to treat her as miserable as they could. Other girls from her classroom make-up stories about her which was complete opposite of her life. Like she was born in a dumpstar and so on but one of the girls said that that she was so ugly, nobody even wanted her.How did she even manage to come to this school? This line struck her mind- out. it was true that she was ugly but what was ugly but what was said by that girl made her heartbroken. After the classes she went home crying and her father wanted to the reason of crying. she told him everything what had happened at school and how the bullies miserable bullied her. The old man was angry. He tried to calm down but she didn’t. she was so heartbroken that finally decided not to show her face to anyone and told her father about it. At first he was shocked and more over he did not say anything knowing that one day she would get justice. she continued to wear mask hiding from others. Still the bullies made fun of her. Her favourite place was the library. She mostly spent her time alone at library.She became smarter and smarter but no one knew about it and at last she made a very brilliant result and hence receive a scholarship too. she was called-out to the principal’s office to enroll her name in a better reputed collage, as she was smarter and intelligent in studies so she got a scholarship, her father was called-out and told about it, her father was pleased but sad too. He said to her that people should know her who she was, her identity, her personality. “ you have to stand-out with your full confidence, don’t mind the things other say because they are jealous as you are better than them ‘’ This conversation was a memorable one for her.She finally decided to remove the face mask. Shyla was surprised to discover that she was not as ugly as she was! Yes she was beautiful! It was the beauty of knowledge! It was the beauty of success!And when she became older or an adult she made her own company, and headed it. Later the girls and the bullies realized what they had done and went to her company to ask for forgiveness. At first she refused to forgive them but then she thought of giving them a second change wish might change them as she gave second chance to her life.
author: TANAYA BARUAH

title: A BOY'S DREAM
text: He was depressed. There lived two witches who loved to see others in pain. They would capture their victim and lure them into drinking various drugs by promising them that all their problems will get solved.One day the boy became their next victim knowing that how badly he wanted to see his father.. They captured him. the boy was on his way back from school when suddenly a big black door appeared in front of him. The boy out of curiosity opened the door and stepped inside. One of the witches appered as soon as the boy entered the room. She laughed wickedly. the boy got very scared. The boy asked her " why am I here? who are you?!!!". The witch laughed again then replied " I heard you wanted to see your father, I can help, I have a medicine which can help you see your father. The boy became very happy when he heard that the witch can help her. The boy asked the witch for the medicine. She grabbed a bottle, it was green in colour.It contained a drug.It will make you unconscious for a few hours. But little did the boy know he grabbed the bottle and drank the whole bottle. The boy suddenly started to felt weird, his head felt really heavy, he started feel dizzy. The boy fell unconscious to the ground. The witch got scared and she ran away from the scene. The boy woke up he was lying in the middle of the road. He wondered what had happened. His head still felt dizzy. He came out of his room. Supper was being cooked by his mother, she noticed him come out his room. She asked him what had happened, the boy didn't reply and he jus walked away. His mother got worried and said " what has happened to my boy, he used to be a very happy kid but nowadays he is still sad, who can help him now, what has happened to him? " the boys sister walked out of the room and said " ha... he probably got bullied by his classmates for some lame reason, let him be, he will be okay after some time " The boy went back to his room then he realized that is was just a dream and the medicine he got was just a drug that one of his peer pressured him to try. He realized that there was no witch and that he was just unconscious because of the drug. the boy learnt an important lesson that day that you should never fall prey for drugs and you should never try anything because of peer pressure. ﻿ A BOYS DREAM written by:Sarang P Bijeesh

title: Counselling
text: Once upon a time there was boy named Dhuruvwan. He was really Ill-mannered and corrupted. He was not exposed to the calamities of the world. The only friend he had was, Rithesh. He was a really well-mannered and uncorrupted child. He was basically the opposite of him. Dhuruvwan did all of his work with the help of Rithesh. Lucky, for Dhuruvwan, Rithesh wanted to help him change and not get scoldings frequently. So, Rithesh took Dhuruvwan to a counselor, Mr. Pradyuth Senthilkumar. Mr. Pradyuth was a really well-experienced man. He could handle all types of children with behavioural issues. So when Rithesh brought Dhuruvwan to Mr. Pradyuth, he thought he could change Dhuruvwan easily but he was wrong. Dhuruvwan was affected by the past tragic incidentsin which he lost his parents a couple of months back in a car incident. Since then, he was living with his foster parents as his relatives did not accept him. So Dhuruvwan was emotionally damaged. So he could not control his emotions and turned into a ill-mannered and corrupted boy. After, Mr. Pradyuth heard all this he took Dhuruvwan's case up and was determined to change him and wanted make him the most well- mannered and disciplined boy of his grade.So, Mr. Pradyuth took him places like orphanaghes to make him see the life of kids like him.There he met children with various talents. He saw one of the boy of his age helping other children in their activities. He spoke to that boy and realised his mistakes. He decided to change his character. He had become the best and the most nurtured boy of his grade. He took an oath that he would help the future generations in their difficulties. Thank you
