title: Ephemeral
text: “Eternity apparently had conditions, but sadly I was not aware of them,” said Kang Jun Seo. “Forever doesn't exist; only someone as obtuse as you could believe it did,” shouted Lee Ha Jun. “Well, maybe I am obtuse, but at least I care about my friends and don't betray them the moment things go haywire,” said Kang Jun Seo. “Care about friends? What would you know about that? You couldn't even proffer your scholarship to me when you know equally well that you don’t need it and can afford it.” “Well, so can you.” “You know my situation. You know that my parents expect me to get that scholarship no matter what. They don't care if I end up killing myself while trying to get it.” “You know my situation. You know that my parents expect me to get that scholarship no matter what. They don't care if I end up killing myself while trying to get it.” “Maybe you could have explained this to me instead of insulting me every time you got the chance. I would have helped you, Ha Jun. I could have talked to your parents. You know they think of me as their son.” “Don't I know that? And even if I had told you, what would’ve you done, given me the scholarship?” “No, I wouldn't have. ‘Cause I’m certain that you would have regretted taking your friends' scholarship if you actually ended up going to that UNIVERSITY.” “I wouldn't have, Jun. I wouldn't have.” “You've changed a lot, Lee Ha Jun. You're not the same person I once knew.” “People change with time!” “Not this much. Remember how we once were…” “Yo, what's up?” “I'm good, Jun. How ‘bout you?” “Great”. The best way to probably describe Lee Ha Jun would be to call him a jock. His black windswept hair, his sense of fashion that could only be described as cool, his height that was already ranging to about 5’8 and his good build. Yet the term wouldn't exactly apply as he didn't play sports and instead was skilled in arts. On the other hand, Kang Jun Seo looked like a typical nerd with his hazel hair and fashion sense which consisted of only V-necks and jeans. Surprisingly he actually was good at sports. These two were polar opposites and no one in Busan Dong High School or for that matter no one in the South Gyeongsang province would have expected their friendship. These two who had been the best of friends were now fighting over a scholarship, the one that had started this whole mess. “Everyone, over here,” shouted Mrs Jane, the homeroom teacher. “I want everyone's attention now. This is important. The school board has received a large donation, and thus has decided to offer a full scholarship to Dong -A- University “Now, the criteria for the scholarship is that you'll have to have a GPA of at least 4 but. We will be giving those with a low GPA the chance to improve it through extra credits. For further inquiries, you can come and meet me in Class 12C. Thank you now, please disperse.” Ha Jun and Jun Seo glanced at each other. They both knew they would fight for that scholarship and they wouldn't require any extra credit having a GPA of 4.6. They both wanted the scholarships so badly -even though they both could afford to go there- for different reasons. For Ha Jun his family was a typical aristocratic family and expected him to make their name shine; while on the other hand, Jun Seo just wanted to do something on his own without his parents’ money. They both spent many sleepless nights working and perfecting their homework and projects. Until the day came when the recipient of the scholarship would be announced. “Good morning, everyone! The day you've all been waiting for has arrived. The one bestowed with a full scholarship to DONG-A UNIVERSITY is… Kang Jun Seo! Everyone put your hands together for him.” Jun Seo bowed but he noticed that Ha Jun had left. He was surprised because he expected his best friend to stay and congratulate him. Oh well, I would talk to him later. “Congratulations on the scholarship, Jun Seo.” “Thanks, Ha Jun.” “Hey, I want to talk to you about something personal. Can you stay back for a bit today?” “Sure, I'll meet you at the school grounds around 5. Is that alright?” “Perfect.” ※ “Hey, so what did you want to talk about?” “I'm gonna be very straightforward, ok? I need that scholarship and I'll do anything you want, but please let me have it.” “Are you joking?” “I'm not joking, Jun. Please, give me that scholarship. You know what my parents are gonna say if I don't get it, even though we can afford it. They're gonna call me a failure and probably send me away to my grandma’s as they swore they would when I said that I might not get the scholarship.” “I'm sorry but I can't.” “If you were a good friend, you would,” said Ha Jun walking away. For the next few days, Ha Jun ignored and insulted Jun Seo at every chance he got, until Jun Seo confronted him. That was when the fight had started. ※ “You know what? If you're gonna be this way, WE DON’T NEED TO BE FRIENDS ANYMORE, Jun Seo.” “Maybe you're right, maybe we shouldn't, Ha Jun. Because I feel that you're not that special person I once met and I was with. Goodbye…”
author: Shreya Srinivasa Ragavan

title: Fly Like A Bird
text: It was a fine sunny day. Amira was looking out from her window. She saw a beautiful bird passing by. Suddenly, a thought struck her mind. She ran towards her mother. She asked her mother, "why do the birds fly amma?" "The birds are small in size, so they can't walk like us." chuckled her mother. "Can I fly like the bird amma?" asked Amira "No you can't silly!" said her mother. "But you can fly in your studies." continued her mother. "How? amma how?" Amira asked eagerly. "You can fly in your studies, be brave and courageous like the bird. There are so many things we can learn from them." added her mother. "Amma, I didn't think about this. You're so creative!" said little curious Amira. "Thank You putta!" said her mother. After a wholesome of years, Amira flew high and bravely like a bird. She also helped others to fly high in their life too. She became a role model for other curious Amira's in this universe. "Be like the bird, live like the bird and enjoy like the bird." this phrase became her motto.
author: Dhanvi Shetty
illustrator: Krishnagopal Shreshtha; Shamim Ahmed; Tawfiq Ahmed  Anwar; Vridhhi  Chaudhry

title: The night when the moon went missing
text: Once, in a far land near a big sea, there was a big city where a little girl lived named Maisha. Maisha liked to spend her time near the sea coast and spend her time talking to her ‘friends’. Maisha had more friends in the sea, more than she had on the land. She loved to talk with them, as her house was nearer the coast, she could come anytime she wanted. One night she heard a lot of splashing in the water and saw Dabby the dolphin calling her name “Maisha, Maisha do come here I have to show you something!” Maisha got out of bed and put on her night gown. She quietly went to her parent’s room and checked if they were sleeping or not, and luckily, they were fast asleep. Maisha got to her room as fast as she could, then opened her window quietly, before she left, she checked the clock it was 12 o’clock. Then she sneaked out very quietly, without any noise she went direct to Dabby. When she reached Dabby, he pointed in the sky and said “Maisha, Look the moon is missing, where did it go?” Now Maisha was very confused she looked at the sky and was left stunned and then she turned to Dabby and said “Dabby the moon really is missing, and I believe it must have fallen into the sea.” In reply Dabby said “Let’s look for the moon, shall we?” “I would go to look for the moon but Dabby, how will I go, today in school I learnt that the oxygen level in the water is very low, so I won’t be able to live long in the water.” And Dabby as always was again full of ideas “I know what we need, wait here till I return” Dabby dove in the sea and after a few minutes Dabby brought a big green and yellow submarine, Maisha shrieked out and then thanked Dabby she then quickly got into the submarine. “Oh no!” wined out Misha “I don’t know how to drive a submarine” Luckily the old crab was there sitting in front of the handle “Hello little Maisha how are you doing?” “Hello Mr. Old crab I am here to go look for the moon if you know how to drive the submarine, please do tell me.” The old crab was very wise and knew how to drive the submarine he gave the instructions to Maisha and then said “Maisha, if you want to get out of the submarine then don’t forget the suit kept in the back, it is very important for you to remember it.” “Yes Sir!” Maisha cheerfully thanked the crab and then started the engine. It took almost two hours to reach deep in the sea. Maisha was very excited to get out of the submarine and she did not forget what the crab told her she fastly got into the suit and then got out of the submarine. Dabby as a good friend let Maisha sit on his back as they swam deeper Maisha saw a big white round object lit bit deeper. “Dabby, can we go a bit deeper, please I see something that looks like the moon” But Dabby refused and said “Sorry, Maisha I can’t swim deeper with you on my back, but no need to worry I’ll call out for, Kita (the shark) to take you deeper, I’ll be side by side just in case you guys need help.” “Maisha thanked Dabby and then waited till Dabby called out for Kita “Kita, Kita, do come fast as you can we need help!” Maisha waited until she saw a big white shark coming towards them. “Hello little Dabby, need any help?” Dabby then started to describe everything that happened till that Maisha got off Dabby’s back and adjusted herself on Kita’s back. “Thanks Kita!” Kita and Dabby swam towards the white thing that’s when they stopped and let Maisha get off and see if it’s the moon. She touched the rock and then flipped it, but as she had studied in her school, it did not have holes in it, she then turned to Dabby and Kita and said “This is not the moon but just an ordinary white rock.” Then as a piece of advice Dabby told Maisha to take a bit of the rock in case it is the moon who knows? Maisha nodded and then got off Kita’s back and then took a little tool which was in the swimming suit and then took a bit of the rock and kept in in her small compartment that was in the swimming suit. Before she climbed onto Kita’s back, she thought it would be better if she took the submarine with her as it would be faster and then swam towards the submarine and then started the engine and then followed Dabby and Kita as they swam. When the reached, Maisha attached another oxygen cylinder and before she got out, she saw a big black shark staring at the submarine and her friends. “Oh no! Kita, Dabby please watch out!” Maisha was very scared of sharks especially when they are very big just like the big shark, Maisha shrieked and almost fainted away when she saw the shark bite Dabby but luckily Dabby was a fast swimmer. They didn’t have much of an idea at the current state of time. The big shark opened it mouth wide that it could fit 5 whole sharks in it, just as the shark was about to chew up the three of them, a big blue whale knocked out the shark, and in the next minute Kita and Dabby hugged the whale, So Misha decided to join them. “See Maisha, this is Gablin who I used to tell you about, He is our childhood best friend” “Hello, Nice to meet you Gablin, Thank you so much!” The whale then moved aside and then hugged Maisha and said “This was nothing, I love helping people, just like Dabby and Kita.” They all had a little conversation when Gablin turned and said “Maisha, it was a pleasure to meet you, hope we meet again” and then swam away. That’s when Dabby gave Maisha a little pat and said “Maisha that looks like the moon, let’s go and check!” Maisha turned around and then swam toward the big white object. This one really looked like the moon Guys! I think we did it, we found the moon!” Kita then gave a happy squeal and then helped to keep the ‘moon’ in the submarine, and to surprise the ‘moon’ was very heavy! They kept the moon in the submarine and then Maisha started the engine. By the time Maisha reached home it was time for a school. Maisha took the ‘moon’ into her room by the window and jumped into her room. Maisha hid the ‘moon’ beside the bed and then took a bath. When she got out of the Washroom she thought to find out if it really was the moon. She then saw that the moon could open and then she opened it and to her surprise she found a lot of jewels and money in the ‘moon’. She fastly closed the moon and kept in under her bed once again.. Then her mother called out for her “Maisha, dear take a bath and come for breakfast, or otherwise you will be late.” “Yes Mom, I am coming in just 10 minutes.” Maisha took her uniform and went to dress up. She then took her bag pack and went to have breakfast. That day in school she learned that the moon changes its shape every day and when they see the whole moon it is called ‘ Poornima ’ and when the moon is not visible it is called ‘ Amavasya ’. “Oh so it was Amavasya and I thought that the moon is now missing!” Maisha laughed to herself and instead of the moon, she got a nice big treasure! What a surprise and adventure it was!
author: Nivedya Nivedya

title: RAHUL AND HIS FRIEND
text: Rahul was very happy as his father got a transfer and he was going to a new place. He was very happy after reaching to his new house. People there believe that there is a ghost in that house and it is dangerous to live in that house but Seema and Kunal parents of Rahul didn't believe in these things so thay ignored what people are saying. After some days, Rahul was playing football,he found a boy was staring him while playing football he asked the boy to join him and they both started playing football after sometime Rahul got tired so he sat down Rahul asked the boy his name the boy replied," My name is Vicky and yours ". My name is Rahul. Then suddenly Rahul's servant came and told Rahul that his mother is calling him for lunch. Rahul went home and had his lunch and then went to his room for studies. The Servant Rama told Seema a strange thing when Rahul had gone that he was talking to himself while playing football alone. She said that there must be a ghost the people are right there is a ghost in this house Seema scolded Rama to not to talk rubbish and went to her room. Now Rahul and Vicky used to play football every evening and became close friends. One day Rahul asked Vicky to come with him in his room to play video game and then they both went to his room talking with each other. Seema saw it and got confused that there is no one, then Rahul is talking with whom then she remembered what Rama told her. She got scared and told everything to Kunal. They went to a church and there they met father of that church Mr. William. Mr. William told them that some years ago an accident happened in that house, it caught fire and a child whose name is Vicky and his grandmother died and his parents got injured after this incident his parents got shifted to Delhi.The soul of that child is still in that house.What to do now asked Kunal ans Seema. Mr. William replied that the child who died was very innocent and greatly attached to his parents so if you call his parents so, in their presence the soul might got relief and salvation. After two days Vicky's parents came to Rahul's house. The soul of Vicky after watching his parents got a sudden relief started disappearing and got vanished in front of Rahul in the sky.

title: NOONI
text: CHAPTER 1 n ooni is still asleep unaware of the happenings around her.Her mother tells her to wake up since its time for her school. Nooni wakes up and quickly gets ready,when she reaches downstairs,she hears the bus horn and rushes out of the house while stuffing a bread down her throat.Nooni notices another girl get on the bus. "who's she","must be new" wonders nooni to herself.nooni sits next to the new girl. As she notices the ruckus made in bus by the other students."Hi,I'm new here "said the new girl. i'm AMBALIKA. "Hey, i'm nooni" replied Nooni.Which class are you in? asked nooni.I'm in fifth,what about you?? Oh i'm also in fifth. CHAPTER 2 After reaching the school,nooni notices Ambalika going to the principal's office." wonder what class she'll be in" thinks nooni as she enters her class,5th B. just as she's about to sit their class teacher enters along with Ambalika."Good morning class,hope you all enjoyed the weekend" there's a "yes mam" from the class. A new student is joining us today, AMBALIKA. There's a sudden uprise of whisper in the class. " hi, everyone i'm Ambalika. I was in banglore before coming to RANCHI. After the excitement dies down the class finally starts to focus on the chapter going on in class. CHAPTER 3 Nooni reached home and told her mother about the new friend that she made at school.'' OH! Ambalika? nice name" said nooni's mom. ''They shifted here just last week,shall we go and meet them today?" okay,replied nooni smiling broadly. IN THE EVENING Nooni and her mother went to their apartment the evening and just as ambalika sees nooni she runs up to her and takes her to her room to play teacher-teacher. Both the mother smile at the two girls feeling that this was the start of a great friendship. CHAPTER 4 It has been almost 2 months since Ambalika and nooni became friends. One day,Mrs ritu their class teacher called them to the staff room.''There's a inter class competion soon and since you both are my top students, i have chosen you to represent our class.Both of you would have to work together to create a play in english on the theme,''WORLD HEALTH DAY'' we have only 1 or 2 weeks more. Nooni and Ambalika were both too stunned to speak. CHAPTER 5 Ambalika and Nooni were very excited to create the play but there was more than just writing a story........ The hard part was to find students to act in the play with the help of thier classmates,Ambalika and nooni were able to find actors for the play but most of the students in the play had stage fright. So, Ambalika had a plan she told everyone to practise in front of family members and in front of the mirror. Nooni was afraid to narrate the story but Ambalika never failed to encourage her friends. They practised day and night until they were ready. CHAPTER 6 The day of the competion finally came. Ambalika and Nooni were up all night practising the play. It was time for some motivational speech. So Ambalika and Nooni both encouraged thier friends by saying" no matter if we dont win there today we all learnt a very great lesson today which was to never give up" and remember to do your best and HAVE FUN! ALL THE BEST CHAPTER 7 Ambalika and Nooni won the competion. they had a total of 115 points. Both Nooni and Ambalika were very happy so was thier class teacher. THUS started the journey of two great writers......

title: BEST FRIENDSHIP
text: Best Friendship Once upon a time, there were two best friends - girls. Their name was Sanjana and Kiran, they were best friends but not less than best sisters. Once night their grandma \ grandmother was telling them a story of a bad snow fairy, she told that if the bad snow fairy caught anyone who is kind, hearty, happy and friendly she will freeze him\her and she will make that person of snow, so that's why live far from the bad snow fairy. For 1 minute both were surprised. After some times Sanjana went outside to play, she loved snow and that night snow was falling. After sometimes Kiran also came outside to play with Sanjana, but she didn't saw Sanjana anywhere. Kiran searched her everywhere but she can't find her, she understood that the bad snow fairy caught Sanjana. Kiran started crying, she went to grandma by crying and saying'' Grandma, the bad fairy caught Sanjana.'' Grandma told, don't worry about it dear, you can find her. Kiran asked, how? grandma said, did you know the Kesam forest? Kiran said, yes, I know it is very far from our house, there is living a very big and strong Tiger. grandma said, correct!, In the cave of that tiger, there's one magical powder, when we are sparkling that powder on any piece of ice, it will start melting. Now Kiran was always ready to save Sanjana. Her grandma gave her a red cloth. She said that, If you will put this cloth under tiger's leg so he will be all over statue in the sense not able to move anywhere. Kiran took the cloth and moved to the Kesam forest, when she reached there she saw the cave of the tiger. She went inside, she saw that tiger sleeping there. Suddenly, she put that cloth under his leg, so he was not able to move anywhere, now she tried to find the magical powder in the cave. After finding a lots she got the magical powder in a hole. happily, she took her red cloth and went to her grandma exited. She saw grandma and said, yes grandma, I got the powder. Grandma said, Wonderful!, Now I will tell you where the bad snow fairy is living. Kiran was exited. Grandma told, Behind the Kesam forest, there is one place where every time the snow was falling and there was a palace made of ice, that palace was of a fairy, yes, you are right, that fairy was known as the Bad Snow Fairy. Kiran said, now I will go there. when she reached at that place, she saw a ice palace as grandma told, when she opened the door of palace, she saw Sanjana - freeze in-front her eyes, Sanjana was all covered by snow. Kiran started crying, but then she took the magical powder and she sparkled some powder on Sanjana. Slowly-Slowly the ice on Sanjana was melting down. Later 2-3 mins she was free and able to move. Kiran told to Sanjana everything that happened. Till that the bad snow fairy also came their from her room. But now Kiran and Sanjana were brave. Sanjana took the magical powder, ran fast to the bad snow fairy and sparkled all the magical powder on the bad snow fairy. Suddenly! the bad snow fairy felt down and her look [ avatar] ﻿ was totally changed, she was looking like an angel [god of heaven]. She told them that, many years later I was a good fairy of snow but their was an enemy of me-bad god of heat because he loved heat and I cold so that's why he made me a bad snow fairy by his magic. But I am so thankful to you that you made me once again a good snow fairy. Kiran and Sanjana said that's our pleasure and walked on the way of their home. When they reached in their home first of all they hug their grandma lovely, by saying thank you Grandma because of you we won and we also helped 1 good fairy. HAPPY ENDING MORAL: A best friend is a person who can help yourself in a problem. If you will help people so definately you will get blessings and happiness from them.

title: Starvation of Food for the Monkeys
text: It was the second week of lockdown in Sudan due to the increasing impact of Ebola virus. Martin and his family lived in a community which was near a reserve park. Before the pandemic, almost 50 people visited the park to feed the troops of monkeys everyday. But due to lockdown no one visited the park. One evening, while Martin was looking through a window he saw almost twenty monkeys roaming in his community. The next day the same thing happened but this time he saw a monkey dead too. During dinner Martin's dad (John) told the family that he lost his job due to lockdown. Marti his mother, grandpa and sister were worried. That night Martin couldn't sleep because he can't bare to see the poor creatures starving in hunger and now as his dad lost his job, the family will start lacking money. Thus they will have no money to perform their daily tasks one day. So, Martin thought about it for the whole night and figured out an idea. The next day he said about it to his dad, "Daddy, I wanna say something to you. For the past two days I saw troops of monkeys starving in hunger and some dead too. And you lost your job. So, I came up with an idea." Martin said. "Yes Martin, tell me your idea" said dad. "I will post an E-mail to the government regarding the lack of food for monkeys, and will request them to give you the job of feeding the monkeys. If this this idea worked the monkeys would be fed and you will also get a job" said Martin. John was so glad that his son was so creative. He said "Proceed Martin, I guess you will succeed." Martin started typing the letter and mailed it to the government. The whole family were looking forward for the government's reply. And after days of waiting, there was a reply it said, Mr. John, We thank you for informing us about the hungry monkeys. We promise you that measurements would be taken to feed the monkeys and as per your wish the higher officials have planned to hire you Mr. John. Congrats! Everyone were very happy and excited. Finally one day all monkeys were fed with enough food and John got his first salary for this job. Mom made sweets to celebrate.

title: A Typical Day in 2030
text: Hello! And welcome to a day in my life in the most advanced year of 2030! My name is Alexa and I come from a very sophisticated family which is pretty affluent. I'm doing my Post Graduation studies at the Delhi University, which is very prestigious, and to be studying here, I should be smart and consistent with that smartness. And, voila! Our family is smart, loaded, and whatnot. Now, I live alone by myself in an apartment, as my parents live in Visakhapatnam. And Delhi is a pretty cool place -- very advanced and always upgraded. So as a young adult, I always have the urge to keep all my house decor new and advanced. Now, as a med student, I have quite a busy schedule. Starting off with when I wake up. I am woken up every day at around five in the morning by my closest and dearest robot, Phineas. He's a dog robot who basically wakes me up every day and keeps me company when I'm studying. He's a great support and he doesn't have to be taken care of much because, of course, he's a robot and all he needs is three hours of charging a day. After waking up, I go on a run and come back to a clean home, which is only possible with the help of Kris, my trusty ol' cleaning robot. These robots have been around for a few years, so it's nothing too special because they exist in everyone's house at this point. Next, I freshen up and get ready with the help of my reliable fashion advisor, Teresa! She's an automated feature in my flat and she's always a great help. She knows all my clothes, top to bottom, and gives me the perfect combinations to wear. We are first asked to feed into their database our body structure, our tastes, and the kind of fashion we are interested in. With the help of all this, Teresa comes up with beautiful outfits and I don't even have to stress myself and take a long time just to decide on what to wear for the day. Tiffany helps me with my food. Tiffany is another automated voice in my flat, who takes my cravings the previous night, just to fetch the perfect recipe with the ingredients I have at home. She also knows her way around my kitchen and what I have to cook. My fridge is connected to Tiffany, which basically gives it more exposure to my groceries. After having all the ingredients ready, most of the work is done by other machines that come along with her. There are some very rare times when I have to help the gadgets because they either run out of battery, or they spoil themselves because of oil and other hazardous items in the kitchen. These robots start cooking after being given a sign by me, and I usually do this before I shower, so that my food is prepared by the time I'm ready for school. I eat with my hand, and thankfully, there is no robot for this, because we are proud Indians and we find our pride in eating with our hands, so, we're always quite reminded of our beautiful culture. Then! I go to university, which is a twenty minute drive. Usually in the car, I have the ability to read the notes of the upcoming class because now, self-driving cars exist. These started growing popular around five or so years ago, and even now, not everyone's used to them. It first surprised me how man could come up with the idea of cars, then electric cars, and then self driving cars, and now, self driving electric cars, where the electricity is gained from the solar radiation. It is all quite funny because at one point, none of this used to exist, but now, everybody thinks of this as the norm. After getting to university, we have this small machine where we have to scan our identity cards, which mark our attendance for the day. When it's almost time for all the classes to end, it gets kind of crowded there because some people come then, just to mark their attendance, but let me tell you a small secret. An hour after the class which starts last, attendance isn't counted! So everyone just gets fooled, and it is actually quite funny to see. After attendance, we get into our classes and are taught by six-foot-tall robots which seem funny while teaching, but God, they are so lucky they just have a chip that has like twenty terabytes worth of information capacity, so we can never l ook down on them because they're so smart and neither can we break them because their repair costs a lot of money! After my day classes, I usually go to the vending machine and get a drink and go to the canteen for late lunch. The canteen food compared to the food in canteens in 2020 and around is way way way better! Good quality of food is used, sanitation is respected and there is always a vast variety to pick from. After all my other classes, I go back home at around 5:30 in the evening and sleep on the way home. I love my car.. it's the best thing ever. Offers me so much comfort and peace. Plus, it lets me sleep when it's working, so that is very considerate of it. After going home, I take a shower and sit down to watch something, just to entertain myself. Although Rebecca, my study partner (also a robot), keeps patting me and asking me to study, I always ignore her and spend at least forty-five minutes a day, trying to relax myself, because school is tough. I always have a bowl of fruit offered by Tiff. It keeps my health in check and reads my pulse to make sure I'm eating well and getting enough energy every day. After studying for a few hours, I have dinner served by Tiff again and talk to my mother over video with the help of Teresa's twin, Tiara, who keeps my relationship with my social group intact. Having a good social life is definitely important because already, the whole world depends upon technology and artificial intelligence so there isn't much of an option where you can actually interact with people, because no one is ever interested in "social interaction" now. Everybody is always invested in themselves and their own small worlds and nobody cares about others anymore. This becomes a problem when man completely depends on artificial intelligence to solve his problems and doesn't keep his brain active. His ability to think slowly starts to deteriorate and he loses the enthusiasm and happiness he feels when he meets someone he likes, or when something he likes happens, or when he eats something he likes, or anything of this sort! Man has lost all such emotions, and he cannot be called a "social animal" ever, if the current cases continue to be the same. If only we could turn back time and realize where it all went downhill and try to stop letting it go downhill. If only that was possible -- it might be! You, being from 2022, where life is slowly starting to advance, appreciate that change and encourage it! But don't let it take over the world and over you. Man created artificial intelligence, and the same man can think more than artificial intelligence. He can do many things it can't! The same man is capable of thinking the best way possible to make life more comfortable, but without hurting himself or anything around him. If only we can find out where it all went wrong and try to rectify that mistake and not let it happen ever again. Maybe then, things will be better.
author: Aparajitha Peddibhotla

title: MY BESTFREIND
text: Introduction - Friendship is a really good relationship between two humans. We all have friends and we understand the importance of friendship very well. We need to respect this relationship and need to work making our friendship better with our friends. But in most of the case, we have a special friend who is totally different from the others, who are so much similar to me and who understand me very well. Yes, we all have that friend. We call him ‘best friend’. My Best Friend: My best friend is Rajib, he is my classmate. We are studying together in primary school. We are childhood friends and spend most of our time together. After school, we meet and play in the nearest playground or spend time in the house. Rajib’s father is an Engineer and his mother is a housewife. He has been raised in a really good family with a good manner. He presents himself very politely in the school with everyone. He respects every single teacher and all the teachers like him a lot. Not only the teacher but also the students love him a lot. Rajib’s hobby is gardening. He has a very small garden in front of his house. Actually one of her elder cousins suggested he start gardening, from that time we together worked hard to make that plan true. Finally, now his garden is full of several flower trees. to seed some vegetables in the garden. I think he will be able to make the garden larger. His family is really supportive. They care about him and give support to his works. His mother attends the class in every project or exam time. She is very aware of his study. As a result, he has been the top student in this class. I hope he will keep his performance continue in the near future. His Special Skill: Rajib has a really amazing singing skill. We didn’t know anything about this. But in an annual function, he planned to sing a song. I was thinking to listen to something ordinary. But in the day, he sang ‘Amaro Porano Jaha Chay’, a Rabindranath song with amazing tune and voice. The entire school was silent while he was singing. I was really impressed. I loved his skill. Our Common Interests: We have so many common things, especially in hobbies and general interests. As I said before he has got a garden and it’s his hobby, I am also the same. Gardening is also my hobby. I am thinking to start my own garden. Except for gardening, he loves reading books like me. He has a family library in their house. When I visit their house I spend lots of time in the library. Sometimes I borrow a few books and send them back after reading. Our Different Career Thinking: Besides singing he wants to become a doctor. And he is studying really hard for this. We have so much difference in thinking in this case. I always wanted to become a school teacher. I love teaching and I enjoy that profession. That’s the only and biggest difference between our interests.
author: HEMANT YADAV
illustrator: Prabha  Mallya; SEEDLING MODERN; Shruti Shruti

title: Chhotu-Lambu
text: Chhotu Rabbit was running very fast. He wanted to feed a carrot to his friend, Lambu the giraffe. As soon as he reached Lambu, Chhotu said “Eat this Carrot Lambu’’. Lambu’s mouth watered looking at the red carrot. He quickly bowed his neck to eat the carrot. But Alas! He couldn’t reach it. Chhotu Rabbit tried to jump up and down to feed the carrot to Lambu. Even then the carrot could not reach Lambu’s mouth. Now, both friends felt disappointed. At the same time, Grandpa Elephant passed by. He said, “What happened Chhotu dear, why do the both of you look so down?” Chhotu said, “Grandpa, I want to feed this carrot to Lambu. But neither Lambu’s mouth can reach the carrot nor am I able to take the carrot to his mouth”. Grandpa Elephant said, “No worries”. He picked Chhotu up in his trunk and after making him sit down on a high branch of the tree, he said, “Here, go ahead and feed the carrot with your own hands to your friend”. Now, Chhotu felt happy and started to feed the red and sweet carrot to his friend Lambu.
author: Harshita pal

title: The king's war
text: Once upon a time, there were a group of animals in a forest. There was a lion, who was the king of other animals. All animals such as monkeys, bears, horses, zebra, etc. don't like the king except the 2 foxes. One day, the monkey and the zebra were talking about the lion. They both talked about the lion that, "the king of the forest, the lion was a bad fellow, we should be very careful because why I am telling is he killed our old good king the tiger"... Before 20 years, there was a tiger who was the old king before the lion. He died in a way of helping others. That is when the lion (the present king) came to the forest that time tiger was the king. He thought," If we are the king all will do what we are saying". That night the lion made a master plan, soon he started his work. First step he killed five animals. When the tiger king came to know about it, he decided to kill the lion on the same night. They both fought each other, some animals which fought with the tiger against lion lost their life. So, the tiger decided to get surrendered, as he thought many lives of animals will be lost. The lion told him that he have to give charge the lion as the new king. Soon, the lion killed the tiger. The lion said victory and celebrated the 1st day of being a new king. During the time of the fight, the tiger killed some foxes who supported the lion. The son of the foxes were the 2 foxes who were supporting the lion. Now in the present, the Zebra and the Monkey continues their conversation. Zebra: There is one more tiger who is very honest, soft in nature, and knows to fight very well. Monkey: Who was it? Zebra: Son of our old king OUR NEW KING WILL BE THE SON OF OUR OLD TIGER KING... These two animal's conversation was heard by the foxes and they went to lion said about this thing. He replied good job you both foxes, now you both have to follow them continuously and tell the information. Fox told OK BOSS!. The Zebra and the monkey started talking. Monkey told we have a idea, we can ask someone who is very close to the old tiger king. The Zebra replied, I know, there was a old vulture behind the lion's den. They started moving to the Vulture's nest inside a small cave. While the fox is coming outside, he saw the both of them crossing the den. They both went to the Vulture's house. Inside they heard the sound KR! KR! KR! KR! They both saw the vulture and said," I know that you know where the son of the old tiger king is". vulture replied yes I know. Both said: Go and tell the information about the lion. The lion roared, RA RA TATAK! RA RA TATAK! The vulture flew away and went to inform to the tiger, who was the son of the old king. The Zebra and the monkey was killed by the lion. He felt sad because he don't want tiger to get the information. The vulture entered the house. He saw the tiger and told about this information. He told "Yes, for 30 years I am a fight master of animals." Ok, we will do war about this. The vulture told the lion's plan to every animals. When the news went to the king lion, he accepted the war. When the war started, the lion told "Yes, I want to kill you but I can't able to kill. No problem, now I will kill you". The war started. All the animals ran to the animal and lost their life. The only one is the tiger. Now they both started fighting. The tiger gave a nice beat to the lion. The lion died. Then, the tiger took the charge as the new king after the lion. The old king tiger as a god felt proud of his son. I FEEL PROUD OF MY CHILD...
author: Gowtham G
illustrator: Abraham Muzee; André Kieswetter; Angie & Upesh; Deepa Balsavar; Eshita Munshi; Gerhard Van Wyk; Huynh  Vu Tuong; Kavita Singh Kale; Ketan Raut; Michael  Sagikwa; Rob Owen; Rohan Chakravarty; Rohan Dahotre; Ruchi Shah; Samidha Gunjal; Wiehan de Jager

title: WASIM AND HIS FRIENDS
text: Once upon a time, there was a boy who lived in a village. His name was Wasim. He lived in a small hut with her mother and sister. He had four rich friends- Mohan, Sam, Sahil and Sonu. They were good friends. His friends were rich and lived in big house and led a life full of luxuries. They met daily at 5:00 pm. Wasim likes games and a good student also. He couldn't afford private School fees but the government school condition was very poor. None of the teachers were teaching well. But Wasim wants to go to school and attend classes daily. Wasim's mother was a house-maid. She was working in Sahil's house. She had blood cancer. One day Sahil's mother got sick. Sahil's father called his personal doctor. The doctor came and checked her and informs that she won’t live any longer maximum 10 minutes only. One day Sahil's mother got sick. Sahil's father called his personal doctor. The doctor came and checked her and informs that she won’t live any longer maximum 10 minutes only. Wasim heard that and ran to a person who had so much knowledge of medical science. He said him to wait only for five minutes. He went to a hill and collected some leaves of special plants and made powder and mixed it with water and gave Sahil's mother to drink. After five minutes she got well. The Doctor was shocked but all were happy. A few days later Wasim's mother got sick and her condition was very serious. They went to a private hospital. The doctor says that the treatment will cost much. Wasim got upset and thought how I can manage such amount of money. After a few minutes father of Sonu, Sahil, Mohan and Sam came and said to Waism, “we will give you money and your mother will be fine soon.” After the operation Wasim's mother got completely well. Everyone thought how to help Wasim and send him a school for good education. After some days they took him to a school and he got admission there. He is now happy and educated both. MORAL: If you help others, other will help you too.

title: The Missing Cinnamon Rolls.
text: Winston’s tiny legs trickled along the crosswalk. Late for his first case as an official, he rushed across the Christmas crowd and into Purramid to get his regular Bunmousse for good luck. He went up to the counter and ruffled through his wallet, “Hi, I’d like one Bunmouse. 45 Pawllers, here-” He looked at the dumfound owner. “-Sir?” A slight touch of Teki’s elbow sent the tip jar tumbling. He sunk to his knees in despair, and as any simpleton could’ve guessed by now the recipe had gone missing, the same formula that- Boltie [Pushing up her glasses, frustrated]: Wait-wait–wait. What cinnamon rolls? What recipe? We have to start from the beginning. Sniff Sniff The aroma of freshly baked goods filled the air. It swayed around Teki, the peppy siamese cat, who held the tray of scones he had baked. What a good batch!; He thought. Tring! The bell rang and the door of the cafe opened. “Hey, Boltie!” Teki waved at Boltie, the border collie, who was a regular at the Purramid cafe (previously owned by Teki's Grandpa Whiskers) since she started her college semester. “How’s the photography going?” asked Teki as he placed an espresso and a grilled sandwich on her table. “Oh, same old, same old, haven’t gotten much time since my exams started.” She replied She was an exceptional photographer, so much so that her photos were featured in The Beagle Times, which is a big deal for a novice such as Boltie. Teki even helped her out by displaying her pictures in the cafe. Tring! The bell rang and the door of the cafe opened. “Hey, Boltie!” Teki waved at Boltie, the border collie, who was a regular at the Purramid cafe (previously owned by Teki's Grandpa Whiskers) since she started her college semester. “How’s the photography going?” asked Teki as he placed an espresso and a grilled sandwich on her table. “Oh, same old, same old, haven’t gotten much time since my exams started.” She replied, she was an exceptional photographer, so much so that her photos were featured in The Beagle Times, which is a big deal for a novice such as Boltie. Teki even helped her out by displaying her pictures in the cafe. Tring! “Teki! Sorry I am late today.” Yuki, Teki’s snowshoe best friend helped him with the cafe. With the passing of Grandpa Whiskers, Yuki’s customers have reverted to Purriamid, and a handful of them who were left behind started complaining that Eumsig wasn’t the same as before. And that’s why in return, Teki served at her ramen shop, ' Until now, they had kept it a surprise, which meant not working on banners in public or even talking about them outside the cafe. Teki glared at the safe behind the counter, it had the secret recipe they were going to reveal. It was like a sting operation. Boltie however, was an accomplice. Her marvelous photography skills in addition to Yuki’s exceptional calligraphy made for amazing posters. Boltie pushed down her thin-rimmed glasses and raised her paw, “No, I wasn’t able to complete it. I took extra shifts at the library,” she tried to explain, "I am… a bit behind on rent.” Yuki gave her an understanding smile and offered to help with her projects. CLANK! CLANK! “Good lord! ” Teki grumbled under his breath. Everyone else tried to ignore it as this had become a frequent affair. About a year ago, a new cafe started across the street. At first, they gathered quite a bit of a crowd but soon the people realized that they were nowhere close to Purramid. Ever since then, each day they try to pull off a new stunt to steal Teki’s customers. “Today is their last day on this block!” Teki threw his apron on the floor and stormed out of the cafe. Boltie and Yuki tried to ignore everything, thinking Teki would clear his head and forget about it as always but Teki was taking a long time to come back. “Teki, no!” Yuki yelled. “Ms. Yuki…” the vexed store manager asked Yuki to take care of the situation. Boltie bolted to apologize to the cafe owner Mochie, the old turtle, who had run her cafe for 85 years in Shelloise, her hometown. But due to the pandemic, she had to close down. Finally, all these years later her grandson had opened ‘Hardback’, a library cum cafe. A vast, scary storm brewed in the cafe and there they stood without an umbrella. Yuki dragged Teki and the big thundering cloud outside. Boltie bowed quickly to apologize and followed Yuki out. “Hey! You left this!” a euphonious voice reached Boltie. “You left this in there.” He repeated. “Oh, thank you.” She replied restlessly. Winds blew, carrying the blossom leaves away. The air around them twinkled. At that moment, for Armi, only the two existed. Armi handed her the pen. “So, say….tomorrow evening would you like to hang out with me? We could perfect our bakery skills, talk about every book there is-” At this point, Boltie once again, felt like living up to her name. “-we could file a thesis about every single book in binders, alphabetically and oh! “ He kept going on, “Even color-code them! I could even help you with the banners and poster or we could just watch a documentary about humans!” Boltie stood there with red cheeks, longing to say yes, but blurted a rather alarming ‘NO SORRY!’ and booked it back to Purramid, leaving Armi dazed. Mochie shuffled to the wide glass window and watched everything unfold. She thought, “That recipe isn’t safe... Our hard-working trio decided to call it a day and spent the night back at Eumsig. At this point, it was either losing their sanity or messing up and forfeiting credibility with their customers. The quadrupeds awoke from their slumber with a frisson of excitement. Still, in their night suits, they groggily dragged themselves back to Purramid. Wake up. Wake up. Boltie slapped herself as Teki opened the safe for a routine check. I can’t believe this. How- A slight touch of Teki’s elbow sent the tip jar tumbling. He sunk to his knees in despair, and as any simpleton could’ve guessed by now the recipe had gone missing, the same formula that Teki worked hard on, the same formula which was passed on from generation and was a culmination of all the different procedures of making the PERFECT CINNAMON ROLLS had vanished! POOF! Just like a student in a magic school with an invisibility cloak… gone. Winston stared in confusion, “Are you, alright sir?” Teki’s eyes went soulless. Light focused on Winston as he promptly kept the box on a nearby table and spoke with cadence, “Hello, Mr. Teki. I am Winston and I am probably the youngest detective of all time.” Boltie and Yuki tugged him by his paw and explained everything that took place. He asked, “Let me get this clear. You check the safe every day and today it was gone?”. Teki nodded in response. “After the fight?” he counter-questioned and threw the stack of papers on the table. “Miss Boltie? Can I ask you some questions,” Winston turned to Boltie, “alone.” Boltie quietly followed the detective into the kitchen. “Tell me about the people across the street.” Hardback which had a brown aesthetic looked like a dark grungy haunted house in Boltie’s eyes. The lights in the kitchen focused on Boltie’s face creating a distracting glare in her glasses. Winston sat in front of her, legs crossed, writing down something in his ominous beige diary. “Don’t be fooled by Mochie’s hardcover, she’s the sweetest turtle you’ll ever meet. She helped me write my practicals in sophomore year.” The detective took notes as she continued. “Sheldon, her grandson, don’t know much about him but he opened the cafe as a gift for Mochie on her 151st birthday.” “Hmm.” “and….Armi. We have some classes together. I think.” “You think?” “I never paid that much attention…We became friends (might that be the correct word for it?) After all, this started happening.” He said tapping the back of his pen on the worn-down wooden table which made the lights go back to normal. “Interesting. I believe we are done here.” ”She rushed back outside. Winston followed. “I did it,” Armi confessed, tears flowing down his eyes. “I-I wanted to make Mochie proud. I am sorry Boltie, I never intended to hurt you.” He clasped her paws, “I wanted-” he was cut off by the detective.“ your attention.” Winston looked at dewy-eyed Boltie and cleared his throat, “But there’s more.” He slid back 180 degrees. “He couldn’t do it. Of course, he wanted Boltie’s attention because she didn’t even notice you in class.” He turned to Armi, “but even his love for Boltie couldn’t justify him defying his morals.” “Then who did it?” The rheumy-eyed cafe owner asked. "Yuki." The room gasped like a broadway audience. But Yuki? How could it be her? She was Teki’s best friend. UNLESS- “For the same reason as Armi.” The room looked back and forth almost telepathically “With all her customers gone, no attention and revenue totaling up to,” he calculated in his mind “Zero. I wouldn’t be shocked that Grandpa Whiskers' passing pushed her off the edge.” He hit his pen on the door frame for emphasis. Teki looked at his best friend just like Julius at Brutus. Boltie and Armi offered Teki composure with warmness in their hearts and eyes And that is how, just like the sweetness of cinnamon rolls on the day of their reveal to the happy citizens, Christmas magic spread across town.
author: Mahee Puri

title: The Magic of Kindness
text: Once upon a time, in a village, there was a ten year old girl called Amy. She lived with her grandmother in a small broken-down cottage. She had beautiful eyes and short, curly hair. She was admired by the whole village, not only because of her beauty but also because of her kindness. Her grandmother narrated stories about magic, princesses, fairies and witches to her every night. One quiet night, Amy asked, “Grandma, does magic really exist?” Grandma replied, “Of course, my dear little princess! There can be many types of magic, but kindness is the spell which has its own magic and has the power of changing people's lives.” Amy thanked her Grandma and went to sleep. The next day, she took a bath, sat on her bed and started reading her favourite book about unicorns. She got very interested and went to her Grandma. “I want to own a pink coloured unicorn with rainbow hair and a bright yellow horn,” she said. “Unicorns are just imaginary creatures. They don't exist in the real world, darling,” replied her Grandma. Hearing these words, Amy started feeling sad about not being able to get a unicorn. She kept staring at the picture of a unicorn and thought, “There must be a way to get a unicorn!” Suddenly, the picture of the unicorn started glowing very brightly. Amy couldn't open her eyes as it was too bright. Then, the light faded. When she opened her eyes, she saw a pink coloured unicorn with rainbow hair! “Huh!?” she exclaimed. She couldn't believe what she saw in front of her eyes. She rubbed her eyes in disbelief. “Wow, this is amazing!” exclaimed Amy. “Hi, I am Uno the great unicorn. I have come here to stay with you. I have the power to give you anything you want,” said the unicorn. Amy felt very happy and thought of asking for a big, beautiful house and some clothes for herself and grandma. But she realized that there were more needy people than her in the village, who didn't have clothes to wear and food to eat. She quickly changed her mind and asked for them. “I want some food and clothes for the poor people in my village,” said Amy. Uno was impressed with Amy. He understood how kind and caring Amy was as she did not ask anything for herself when she herself was in need too. The next day Amy went to give clothes and food to the poor. They all were very happy and blessed Amy. While Amy was distributing the food and clothes, her friend Tina who was watching her, was surprised to see how Amy managed to get so many things for the poor. “Amy is so poor. How can she get these clothes and food for the poor. Something is fishy and I need to find it,” Tina thought and followed Amy when she was going back home. When Amy went inside, Tina watched her secretly from the window. She was surprised to see Amy talking to the unicorn. “Amy is so poor. How can she get these clothes and food for the poor. Something is fishy and I need to find it,” Tina thought and followed Amy when she was going back home. When Amy went inside, Tina watched her secretly from the window. She was surprised to see Amy talking to the unicorn. “Thank you, Uno, for giving me food and clothes for the poor. They all were very happy,” Amy told Uno while Tina was looking through the window. “Oh..so this unicorn is fulfilling the wishes of Amy. I need to have this Unicorn and then he will fulfil my wishes too,” Tina thought slyly. She decided to take the unicorn away from Amy. Next day when Amy was not at home, Tina stole the unicorn and brought it to her home. "Hey Unicorn!!! Now I am your owner, and you need to fulfil my wishes," ordered Tina. She said, “I want a big, beautiful bungalow to live in.” Uno created a bungalow for Tina. Tina was excited to see it. She quickly went inside the bungalow. But as soon as she entered, all doors got locked and she got trapped inside the bungalow. She screamed for help. Then Uno came and said “You stole me from Amy’s house and you were selfish while asking to fulfil your wishes, that’s why I have punished you." When Amy came to know about this, she went to Tina's house and requested Uno to free Tina. “Please free Tina. My dear Uno, she is my friend,” pleaded Amy to Uno. “Look at Amy, you stole me from her house yet she has come to rescue you. This is the kindness everyone should have in their heart,” said Uno and freed Tina. Tina was sorry for her deed and promised Amy that she will support her. Amy and the Unicorn went back home and continued to help the poor along with Tina.

title: Rahul and his friend
text: ﻿ Rahul was very happy as his father got a transfer and he was going to a new place. He was very happy after reaching to his new house. He was excited to make new friends. People there believe that there is a ghost in that house so they to Rahul's parents Seema and Kunal that it is dangerous to live there but Seema and Kunal didn't believe in these things so they ignored it and laughed. ﻿ After some days, when Rahul was playing football he found that a boy was staring him while he was playing football he asked the boy to join him and then both started playing football after sometime Rahul asked the boy his name the boy replied, "My name is Vicky and yours ".My name is Rahul and then Rahul's servant came and told Rahul that his mother is calling him. So, Rahul went home. The Servant Rama told Seema a strange thing that Rahul was talking to himself while playing football alone. there is a ghost people are right there is a ghost. Seema scolded Rama to not to talk rubbish and went to her room. Rahul and Vicky used to play football every evening and became close friends.one day Rahul asked Vicky to come with him in his room to play video game and then they both went to his room talking with each other. Seema saw it and got confused that there no one then Rahul is talking with whom?. Then she remembered what Rama told her. Seema got scared and told everything to Kunal. They both went to church there they Mr. William who told them that some years ago that house caught fire and the child Vicky and grandfather died and parents got injured after this incident his parents got shifted to Delhi. Now what to do asked Rahul's parents. Mr.William replied that the child was very innocent and greatly attached to his parents so if you call his parents his soul will get a relief and salvation After two days when Vicky parents reached Rahul's house the soul of Vicky got a sudden relief and disappearing after watching his parents and got vanished in front of Rahul who was playing with him.

title: Life's Greatest Lesson
text: " 3,2,1.", " I'm coming to catch you now!" Sehna used to shout in joy and then start moving here and there, trying her best to find me. On the other hand, I used to somehow always be able to find a pretty hard place to be found in. Eight-year-old me knew only two things to do. One was to memorize answers properly, just before my exams arrived and the other and most important thing was to get ready on time in the afternoon and be able to go out and play with my best buddy, Sehna. I remember one game we used to play in which we sat down on the society park's grass and then make strings out of whatever flowers we found near us. I used to make them fast and despite losing every single time, Sehna would always smile at me and clap for my work while I used to give her the best Flower string that I was able to make. It wasn't always about playing games together but that game will forever hold a special place in my heart because whenever I try to think of my childhood, I remember the moments spent with my best friend in winter evenings, while the winter's slightly-warm, evening sunlight used to reflect through her hazel eyes and she used to somehow put in all her efforts to make the most beautiful flower string. slowly, only and only to be gifted to me. As a child, I never understood why Sehna was Slower at understanding and doing the same things that I, as a child of the same age as her, did with ease. She was my best friend. Her imperfections in doing things used to be hidden through the innocence that she possessed and concealed in the way she spoke slow and steadily, with all the kindness of her heart's content. She used to do things with the most effort. I remember how she wrote a long letter for my nineth birthday. As she was my neighbor, sometimes it was also about reading and studying together, which I, as a kid, didn't enjoy very much. My birthday was arriving but life had planned to teach the nine year old me a few lessons that i am saddened but also grateful to be taught to. Sometimes, when my mother used to scold me for not doing my work properly, I used to quietly sneak out of my home through the back door of our kitchen and run straight to Sehna. I used to do it so often that even my mother got used to it and knew that whenever I was not at home after my school hours, it was Sehna's home that she'd find me in. Sehna had become my comfort, savior, and somehow my happiness too... Everything I came across went straight to her ears and nobody else's. She would understand me and my feelings very well. November was soon to arrive and Sehna would keep asking me what I wanted as a gift and I would say that her presence would be enough for me. I remember seeing her sad for the first time. It was her mother's birthday and she had invited me along with my mother over to their house for lunch. Her mother was mocking at her repeatedly while the four of us were having dinner. I could see the sad look on her face, that day and it broke my heart. I realized how important she was to me. I wasn't ready to see her sad. On reaching home, I talked about it to my mother. And then she told me that, Sehna was ' not of the same bloo d' as her parents. ﻿ These words were too twisted for me to understand. Finally, November arrived and slowly the weather started getting colder as the days passed. Dew drops could be seen on leaves and flower petals in the morning. Sehna had stopped playing much with me by telling me that the weather was getting colder and she didn't want to catch a fever. I told her that it was totally fine. I turned nine years old on the second week of the month and as expected, the first friend to wish me was, Sehna. My mother had arranged a small party for my birthday, after school hours. So as soon as I reached home, I got ready and sat on a chair in the living room, waiting for my friends to arrive. Father was busy with the decorations and mother was busy cooking delicacies in the kitchen. Soon, Sehna arrived with her mother. "Happy birthday, once again!", she said with a soft smile while handing me a pretty, pink and blue sweater with matching pair of matching pair of gloves. After a while, my other friends arrived too, along with gifts in their hands. I remember Sehna acting abnormally that day. Abnormal in the sense, that she was not feeling well at all and it was visible in her expressions and gestures. She told her mother that she was 'not feeling well'. On hearing this, her mother called for a doctor's visit but before the doctor could arrive, Sehna fainted. The doctor's visit for ' not feeling well ' had then had then turned into emergency surgery. She was rushed to the hospital in an ambulance with the doctor and her mother. Everything happened in just a blink of my eyes. I didn't know what was happening. Leaving everyone and the party behind, my parents and I, drove off to the hospital in our car. We waited outside with Sehna's mother for a few moments until the surgeon came out of the operation theatre and with the reports in his hands, he proceeded, "It's a complicated surgery. We still can't figure out how Her low-grade tumor has turned into a high-grade one. This doesn't normally happen." The doctor then turned around to face Sehna's mother and asked her if she had been regular with Sehna's checkups. I had almost forgotten that it was my birthday. I knew what a tumor was and what it can cause to a person. I was shocked. Sehna never told me about her tumor. she was kept in the hospital and the next few days had been about me reaching home from school and then immediately changing my clothes and going to the hospital with my mother to visit Sehna. Her treatment continued for about a week or so. Her condition was getting critical but the surgeons and doctors used to tell me that She'd get well very soon and we'll be able to play like before. I thought it to be the sweet truth. One day, Her mother said to the doctor's face that she can't keep investing more money into Sehna's treatment because the expenses the next surgery will surely cause her bankruptcy. Her mother stated that Sehna was not was not even her real daughter. She was adopted. She stated that the fault is all of the orphanage to gift her a child with genetic abnormality! She burst into tears. I was so shaken when heard her say those words. She was never a woman like that, but I knew she said those words only because she was mad. The next day, my Sehna passed away. I still remember the day. It was the fifteenth of November. My days went blurred out since then and I believed that my days would stay like that for ever. Her mother was also shaken by Sehna's death. She just couldn't keep her calm and was out of her mind, the other day. Soon, Sehna's parents shifted their house. I felt lonelier than ever. Her death was painful for me. I was not prepared for something like that. I had always prayed that we grow up together and stay friends forever but then my world had turned upside down. I remember not eating anything for the one or two days and staring at Sehna's house from time to time. The park we used to play in, seemed lonely now. My life lost all its colour. My parents were speechless too. The month of December then arrived, and it started getting colder and a little bit better. I remember the first snowfall. I was wearing the pair of gloves that Sehna had gifted me. I think some of my life's greatest lessons were was to never be dependent on others for your happiness, to keep your calm even in hard times, which Sehna's mother sadly couldn't do. And the most important of all was that sometimes you don't have choices and you have to let go of a few things. Life goes on anyways and so will you have to. Thank you. " And then the personality development class brightened up with applauds for my speech on ' life's greatest lesson '.

title: The Symphony of Friendship
text: “Abigail?" I turn to see my best friend, Kaitlyn Leilani with her ruby hair sweeping of her shoulders, sea-green eyes contrasting it. "Hmm" "What are you thinking?" "I was hoping the class would go quiet so I can finish my assignment." "You know that's impossible unless there's a teacher to tame these... howling wolves " I let out a chuckle. Just then our class teacher, Miss Lewis came into our class. The whole class fell silent. "There has been a change in our time table." "I'll be assigning the teams then their chores" she said. "Rhea, Marie and Adam, 'canteen helping' and 'wall painting'. Miss Lewis continued, then my name was called. "Abigail Black, Kaitlyn Leilani..." I was happy for a moment until I heard his name. “...and Alan Carter, 'music hall' and 'library cleaning' Alan Carter. Why? Just why? Alan, Katie and I were once best friends but then he broke a promise that I’ll not talk of. Katie forgave him easily but I'm not the forgiving type. "Now children, try your best to finish the chores" The whole class dispersed with their groups for their chores. Just then Kate approaches me. Beside her a boy with brunette hair and sapphire eyes. "He comes under a truce" Kate assures. "Which doesn't mean I'm your friend." he scowls. "Same here" "You really haven't changed, have you?” he grimaces. " Neither have you" "Would you guys stop it?" Katie shouts. She calms down and asks. "The Library?" We both nod in agreement. We both make our way to the library. Katie follows us from behind, making sure we don't start world war III. The library had genres badly arranged. About a thousand books lay on the table to be stacked. We start working like mechanical machines. After what seemed to be hours I heard Alan's perplexed voice masked with euphoria. "Would you guys mind coming here a sec? I've got something to show. We both reached Alan, whose hand held a paper. "Did you tear a book?" I ask accusingly. "No, I did not. Geez, where do you get your assumptions?" "Well, you don't rea-" " THE POINT?" Katie interrupted. Alan shows us the paper. More than a paper it was a map. " A map" he says "More like a map of our school" I point out. "It leads us to the music hall" Katie says, bewildered. "Are you guys up for an adventure?" Alan asks hopefully. "Hell yeah!" I say. "No one asked you." "I thought you sa-" "IF we do this adventure of yours would you guys stop quarreling like a pair of toddlers? "We are not tod-" "YES OR NO?" Katie demands. I hesitate but then… "Fine." "Alan?" "You guys are unbelievable...fine." he scoffs. We then all run towards the music hall, breathlessly. Then we search until I ask "What exactly are we searching for?". "Umm...wait, there's a riddle on the map" he answers. I have a scroll but no quill. I have a bridge with no water beneath. Play me a melodious tune of 2 but 3, hidden in a music sheet. "Umm...uh...A violin! I know you'll have to play something on a violin but I don't know what!" I say. " Apparently, It seems to be hidden in a sheet" Katie adds. "A sheet...hmm...That's it! Sheet music!" I scream. We rummage through a pile of sheet music until we find a book called ' melodious tune '. "Is this it?" I ask. "I hope so" Kate says, tired from searching. I open the book to find pieces '2' and 'But 3'. I look carefully. Then Alan peers at it and says " 'But 3' is a piano piece...I thought you said violin. " "I honestly have no idea what to do." I sigh, panic floods my voice. " '2' seems to be a violin piece" He says, trying to calm me down. He's seen those. Those stuff I have when I panic. I put my hand to my chest. " Are you fine? " Katie asks, alarmed. She too had seen those. "Abby, '2' seems to be a mirror duet..." Alan says, astonished. "Why don't you guys play the violin part? I'm no good at that. I'll play the piano piece." Kate suggests. " Sure." I say, my voice cracking. Katie hands us the violins while she sits on the dusty stool of the piano. Then we play. A euphonious melody filled the room. My panic flood was already drying up. Just then something eerie happened. A portal had formed. We stopped playing. "Do we enter?" Katie asks " Maybe..." Alan says, puzzled. We enter and then the portal closes. I find myself in a land which seemed foreign to me. Greenery seemed to wrap around the land like warm blankets. A pond showed my reflection, a girl with caramel hair and amber eyes. Trees were bordering a path. Overall it seemed stupendous. Just then it struck me,the portal closed... We were trapped in here, probably forever. Panic floods my heart and I drop to my knees. "Oh no." I gasp. Katie crouches, trying to comfort me but none of it seemed to work. Alan kneels beside me and says "Abby, never get discouraged. Thousands discouraged Beethoven but did he listen? No, probably cause he was deaf..." I let out a chuckle...It seemed to get better. "Thank you" I whisper "Isn't that what friends are for?" he grinned. I stand up slowly, thinking what adventure awaits us...
author: Aashirya pandiaraj

title: A Terrible Trip In a Dream
text: It was a working day. People were all busy. Sudenly the door bell ranged. My mother opened the door. "Diya, it's your friend. Yes, it was my friend Paari. After eating I washed my hands, rechecked my bag and went to school with her. My school was near to my house. We reached school at time and started learning as usual. It was the last month of the academic year. So our annual exams were coming. After the annual exams our school closed for summer vacations. Me and Paari started to think about the vacations. We are planning a family tour. "I think my parents will agree". Paari told. "Yeah mine too". I said. "But where we shall go?". She asked. "No idea, we can ask to our parents. They will decide it". I told. Then we both returned home and as we said, our parents agreed. We were planning about the place we need to go. After sometimes my dad said, "We can go to anywhere. But only in next month." So we decided to next month. Next day, me and Paari were went to a park near to our home. Paari told " Hey, can we go to paul's house? He had so many travel books in his library ". Then we both went to his house and asked about travel books and he gave us one book. I took it to my house and read it. After a month, we decided to go an adventurous trip, the book had so many places, we chosen a place from it. A jungle. In that book there was lot of pictures and information about the place. We was very eager to go there. So, we packed our things and get inside our car. After many hours, we reached the spot. It was a very beautiful forest. i can't express it in words. Literally, I can't take off my eyes of them. It was really a wonderful forest. The fresh and green trees and plants, the beautiful flowers, the magical voice of the birds, various wonderful animals made the Jungle so beautiful. After a long walk we came beside a beautiful stream, and we made a tent there and took rest. Later me and Paari stood up from there and started to play variety of games. After sometimes we saw a beautiful butterfly and we decided to play a new game. The game was the one who catch will win. So we both started playing. Both of us ran fast as we could. And suddenly it sat on a leaf and both of us jump towards it, but the butterfly flew away. At that time we realized that we were lost. Both of us became very scared. Paari cried out of fear and asked " What will we do now?". I didn't know what to do. We forgot the way we came. We stayed there until the sun went down. " I want to go back". I cried. "Please help us!!!". Both of us shouted. But no one responded. Our parents started searching for us. My mother even cried. " Diya, Paari were are you dears". Our parents were tensed. After long search they couldn't find us. ﻿The sun has set. no one slept that day. "I want my child ". My mother weeps and prayed to god. Our father and siblings were searching for us. My father was exhausted and gently weeps. Both of us were too scared and can't close our eyes. We both were tired and we were on hunger. We decided to go forward and find any shelter and food. We slowly started walking. After walking we couldn't find any shelter. We both sat near a big tree. It was very cold there. We hugged each other to get warm. Suddenly a voice behind from us," Do you need any help?". We looked back. It was a jungle boy. Both of us were shocked. "W-Who are you?". I asked. "I am Falco. Don't need to scare. I think you need help, Right?". "Yes we need. Actually we came here for a trip but we have lost.we need to go back to our parents, can help us?". I asked. " Yes I an help you. Not now, now we can go to my house and tomorrow we can definitely go to your parents". He said. We relaxed and went to his home. His mother gave us delicious food and they gave us a room. In the next morning we thanked his mother and went with him. After sometime Falco called a cuckoo and asked him about us. They both got into an conversation and falco said," Okay, he had saw you running here. So we are just going to reach to the spot". We all continue walking and soon reached the spot. Our parents were tired and still searching for us. We reached there and ran towards our parents. We explained everything to them. And we introduced Falco. "Thank you very much Falco". We all thanked him and he returned his home. "Diya, Diya wake up". My mother called me. "What mom, where we are now? where is Falco?". "What are you saying child?. My mother confused. Then I realized it was just my dream. " oh it was a horrible dream". I whispered. "Hey, Diya. I have chosen a place". My brother said holding the book given by Paul. " Where?". I asked. "It will be a adventurous trip, we have decided to go to a Jungle!". He said delightfully but the my face was filled with fear and shouted " I don't want to experience the terrible trip anymore".
