He said as he turned to face her to see her look at him in utter confusion making him chuckle. "Excuse me?" she quacked. "That was Spanish. I will tell you what it meant if you could tell your name seeing you know mine," he said cocking his head knowing he had opened the door of her curiosity. She stood taken aback and thought for a minute before answering, "I am Anne. It's nice to meet you" and stretched her arm out for a handshake. "Well Anne, let's see where this path leads us," he said smirking cockily at his victory, before shaking her hand "What I said before meant you can't hold onto anything for so long. " he said as he let go of her hand. Care to elaborate?" Anne asked as she took back her hand. "You can't hold onto anything, let it be an emotion, people, or things. Everything changes with time, meaning you would be holding onto something already gone." "So we have to just forget the value and the place it held in our hearts and just let it go?" "No, I am not asking you to forget but to accept that it is gone. The oyster gobbles up the raindrop to make pearls. We don't care about the gobbled-up raindrop, do we?" "No..." she stated and turned to face the sea as she hugged herself and stared at the head of the sun that was peeping out of the sea. The sky looked as if an artist had mixed gray and blue paint with black paint on her pallet. She turned her head from the fleeting albatross to take a look at the boy talking to her. Feeling her eyes on him he turned his head and raised a brow "What?" He questioned her. "Nothing." "You can ask me whatever you want." He stated facing her and giving her a reassuring smile. "It's just- I mean it was even hard to imagine my life without him, but now he is just....gone." She started with a shaky breath. "I had watched him grow and he was there with me through my highest and lowest point of life. I just am having a hard time comprehending the fact that he is no longer in my life. It annoys me to the death that I just can't bring him back to me." "You can just talk to him?" "You can't talk to someone dead Carlos," she muttered looking away with a rigid look on her face. "Oh Anne! Uh, I am umm…. sorry for your loss." he stuttered wide-eyed as he was a bit flustered by the sudden revelation. "It's okay." Anne sighed and looked down and started drawing patterns on the sand. Carlos still embarrassed looked at the moon welcoming the night. After a few minutes of awkward silence, he pulled himself back together and said "Must have been pretty rough huh? Losing someone dear to you." Mmm yea. But everyone says it's stupid that I am still missing him considering he has been gone for months. My family and friends are tired of seeing me down in the dumps. But I just can't help it, I am trying to get over it. It's not easy to accept that you can't see that person that you saw every day is just gone and you can never see them again." she said back to see the stars waking up to join the moon in welcoming the night. "Well...remember what I said? The raindrop becomes the pearl. I am sure that he is in a much better place and misses you very much. Think of it as a transformation rather than thinking that the person is just gone. And I am sure wherever he is he doesn't want you to sit and mop around for him." he replied to her after trying his best to empathize with her. " I know...I know that he wouldn't want me to sit around like this. That makes me feel like an idiot." she said sighing. " You are not an idiot just cause you miss him, Anne." He said his voice serious. He looked at the sky and said " When you miss him look at the stars. That would be him staring at you and watching over you." Anne looked up as she stared at the night sky. The two strangers stood there in comfortable silence letting the night sink in. Many people had left as it got dark. The night had sunk in and it had become dark. The sea looked a bit spooked out trying to match the sky but the stars decorated the sky and were scattered everywhere so that it could shine a bit for everyone. The moon had been awoken fully and shone with all its might brightening the night. Anne looked up at this sky with new hope and wondered how many found a new reason to look up the sky that night. She found herself smiling as she saw fishes leap out of the water to get a glimpse of the night, wishing the stars goodnight before disappearing underwater again. She turned and eyed the stranger she met. His hair was being messed up softly by the wind as he stared at the shrieking seagulls fighting for their dinner with a hint of amusement in his eyes with his arms crossed. "Thank you." She said softly to him that he almost missed what she said. "What?" he asked her. "I said thank you." She said and gave him a small smile. He just smiled back at her. "May I know who this person is? That is if you don't mind." He asked. "Oh! Well, you see it's my pet cat caramel. I have had him for over 14 years. Want to see a picture of him?" she questioned him. Before he could reply they saw a boy and girl coming towards them. "Carlos! We have to head back dude." The black-haired guy with tan skin yelled at him. "You coming or are you planning to walk all the way home Carly boy?" Said the girl with brown hair and blonde highlights as she waved at him to hurry. "As much as I would love to continue our chat. I have to get going. Or I would probably reach my house at dawn after breaking my knees." He joked as he jogged toward his friend waving to her after yelling "You should also get home,it's getting late. Have a good night Anne. It was nice meeting you. Goodbye!" "Hope to see you around Carlos. Goodbye." She said waving back at him. ~END~
author: Bersheba  Anointus

title: Best friends forever
text: Once upon a time in a big city there lived two friends. Their names were Jill and Jade Jade is 10 years old. She loves to play outside and read books. Her favorite animal was a cat. She has two cats and kittens at home. She is also very good at curing animals. But Jade was very different. She loves to sleep in on holidays. She loves to play with toys. She is a very good story teller. She has a huge collection of comic books that she wrote herself.Lets find out how they became friends. It all started on the first day of school.Jill was a new student in class,while Jade was there since kindergarten. She trembled as she walked in class and said hi Just then the bell rang,everyone shouted BREAK TIME.Jill got so scared she also most ran out of class,but Jade stoped her just in time. She said hi,and asked if we could meet in their flat. Just then the class came rushing towards the door. Jade wanted to introduce the class, but Jill ran away into the corridor. In the evening Jill came to Jade house they had so much fun. They finished their homework,played with dolls,and even ate dinner together The next day in recess the big bad bully came.Jill wanted to make friends with him,but Jade suggested not to and stayed in class. The big bad bully was throwing stones at a dog. The dog whimpered in fear. Jill couldn’t bear to see this and rushed towards it exactly when he left.Jade was relieved and went with her. Jill immediately took some plants around her and made a Band-Aid and put it on the dog. Jade was surprised to see her do this, just then Jill told her that her mother was a veterinarian so she knew how to take care of animals. Jade told that she also likes animals They had so much fun with the dog,they played fetch with her,they even Fed the dog, and just like that they became best friends.

title: The Labourer Family
text: Once upon a time in a small village, there lived a loving husband and wife. They were labourers and indigent. they had two daughters The elder sister was 20 years old but the younger sister was just 12 years old. the two sisters spent their life with lots of love and care from the people Since they were poor their parents could not pay their tuition fees properly. One day the teacher told the two sisters to pay their fee or else they won't be allowed to write their exam. After they came back from school they cried to their parents saying that their teaccher told them to pay the fees or else they won't be allowed to sit inside the exam hall. Hearing this, the mother got worried. She told her husband how they were going to pay when there is not a single money left. But her husband told her not to worry because God had planned everything. He told his wife that hardwork is the key to success. So, the husband and wife worked all day long with little rest. Seeing this the elder sister felt so bad. She told her sister to study hard so that that they could make their parents proud one day. Years passed, the two sisters worked hard in their studies. They succeeded due to their hardwork and the hardwork of their parents in supporting their studies. They were so happy. They gave their thanks to God. Now the two sisters feed the family and looked after their parents. 'Put God first then Hardwork'

title: A Hardworking Parrot
text: A HARD WORKING PARROT Far away in a forest there lived a parrot called Rani. She was a hardworking and beautiful parrot in a forest. She earned a lot. After two months she laid two eggs. When they hatched one was beautiful and another one was ugly. Rani named them Motu and Patlu. Motu was lazy but Patlu was hardworking like his mother. Patlu learned to fly in one week but Motu learned it in one month. Patlu learned to cook and started a hotel. He gave his earnings to his mom. Motu got up nine ‘o’clock and ate breakfast then he went to play. Rani was worried of her beautiful son Motu but not ugly son Patlu. Rani died after two months due to her age. Patlu got a offer to cook in a another forest. There he earned three times more than his native forest,so he lived there and didn’t think about Motu. Motu didn’t earn so he was in hunger. After three weeks Patlu came to see Motu. He was in dying stage due to hunger. Motu gave him food and then they both worked together and Motu realized the importance of hard work and impact of laziness Moral: Just laziness does not help,we should get up and work.

title: THE FOUR FRIENDS
text: Once there lived four friends in a village, named Hari,Suri,Varun and Sundar.They were best friends and they were studying in the same grade and school and whose parents were also friends. All of them knew well about each other. As their final exams got over, they planned to visit a lake on one day, for swimming. On one fine day they went to lake. They were enjoying by swimming, playing in the mud and cracking jokes on each other. Three of them came out of the lake but Suri was still swimming. As he was swimming, a crocodile approached him. His friends were saw the crocodile near him and were trying to communicate with Suri about this. But it was too late the crocodile caught his him with his leg. They were screaming for help but they could not find anyone. Later, Hari got an idea, he found a dead bird near the lake. He immediately took that and placed it near the crocodile’s mouth, then crocodile saw that and left his leg. He rushed out from the lake. Suri got a wound on his leg and he was very much scared of what happened. Suri did not show that to their parents after going his home. At night while sleeping he suddenly he got fever. Then their parents saw him and called the doctor, then doctor gave him a treatment for wound and fever. Then the doctor said that, because of getting scared he got fever. Next day, Suri’s parents had called all his friends and asked them what was the reason to get an wound for him, when his parents forced to tell at last they told clearly. His parents strictly told them that they would never send Suri to play with them. After all his friends requested his parents, we will never go to that lake and any other inhabited places. At last his parents were convinced, now all four friends happily played near the houses and lived together.

title: Monkey in the lockdown on the society building
text: The day starts with a beautiful sunrise. There was silence all around because no one could even come in there balcony to see the sunrise. Because there was a deadly virus spreading so fast. The name of the virus was corona virus. The government had made a law named lockdown. In lockdown, people were not allowed to go anywhere specially children and senior. They all had to stay at home and could only watch TV, mobile, laptop etc. In lockdown every house used as smart phone laptop etc to do online work or take a classes from home. Only elders of the houses could go outside for emergencies like for milk for grocery. That two only with a mask and the shield that could cover their face. Police personally move around to remind people to wear a mask and the shield. All the parks were lonely and silent only. Birds werw seen on the trees, on the Balcony. Only the chirping of bird could be heard. Some sound could be also her like the sound of ambulance, siren, dog happy sounds beautiful sounds of rustling leaves, sound of rain etc. In the silent situation, suddenly I saw monkey in the building. Very few children you that there was a monkey. But when there was no lockdown all the children know that was a monkey. Then the ran behind the monkey and shouted. They also teased it. But during the lockdown no one could even gave him food, fruits etc. To eat. Some of the people gave him fruit and some of them also beat him a lot with their sticks and sometimes even a iron rod. In the villages when someone seen a monkey they put it into cage and give to the circus people, they also used animals to entertainment of people and to sell them. In cities monkeys are only seen in zoo or sometimes the free monkey can wander here and there. That's why the cities children were always excited about it. But when some people saw the monkey they complain about any animals to the forest department, they came and took the animals into their buses and left them in the thick forest. I feel very sad about it. I thought that the monkey had lost its way to go into the forest. That's why he was wandering here and there. The monkey's family came and went to take the monkey away from the crowd but it they couldn't. In that time someone call to the Forest Department people and they came. In no time. And taking away the monkey. I requested the person who had came to trap the monkey had not to be the monkey but live it in its natural habitat. The person who is very kind hearted. So he agreed to do I was happy to see that I could save the monkey we should understand that animal has also right to live freely. It is not right to keep them in case or in circus.

text: Nature Once upon a time, a girl named Lisa lived with her parents. She loved nature very much. But she lived in city. She always dreamt of living with nature One day, her granny and grandparents went to their village to take care of grandparents ‘s garden, pets and meet granny ‘s old friends and they settled there. One day when Lisa returned from school she was very happy because her vacations starts so she was very happy. Her mom asked why you are very happy? She replied my vacations starts so shall we go to village to meet granny and Grandpa? She told OK! Now she was very very happy. Next day they went to village. She saw her grandpa’s garden that was very beautiful. It was filled with many trees, plants, flowers and tiny creatures. title: The Food Phantom
text: Arnav and Shyama were going to school that day, in their mother’s car for the first time. They had missed their school bus. Looking out of the window, Shyama pondered, “What makes the leaves green?” “They have a pigment called chlorophyll.” Arnav shook his head. “You should have known that, being the sister of the greatest science buff!” “Momma!” “Arnav,” Mother warned, flashing her supercilious boy a murderous stare from the car’s rearview mirror. “Don’t tease your little sister.” Arnav was addled by Mother’s endearing support for Shyama. Arnav and Shyama were brother and sister. Arnav was twelve years old while Shyama was nine years old. Although they never gave up a chance to tease each other, they were best friends. They loved each other more than anyone in the world. Their car stopped on the red signal. Suddenly, there was a knock on Arnav’s window. “There’s someone at the window,” Shyama whispered. A girl, almost of Shyama’s age, pounded at the glass. She had hollow cheeks and scrawny arms. Her hair was disheveled and her eyes bloodshot. “Don't look at her,” Mother instructed. “We can’t give her anything.” Arnav and Shyama’s hearts broke. A plea escaped from the poor girl’s shriveled lips, “Please g-give me something to eat.” Arnav and Shyama tried to look ahead and ignore her. knock-knock wham Don't look at her. But distress gave in; they could not help but cast a few quick glances over her. Thankfully, the lights turned green and their car advanced forward. The girl ran back to the sidewalk. Barefoot. Arnav turned and craned his neck to see that she was joined by a boy who looked a little older than her. In seconds, the girl and boy were just dots behind them. Arnav and Shyama had reached the school. Unbuckling her seat belt to escort the two, Mother said, “Pay attention in classes, okay? All the best!” Arnav and Shyama joined their respective classes but were hardly able to concentrate. The plight of the girl was stuck in the back of their brains. She had just asked for something to eat. During lunch break that day, Shyama was, oddly, not feeling very happy. She completed her lunch and did not waste a single grain. On the other hand, she saw her friends comparing their lunches. Harshita had brought pasta. “I wish I could have your lunch!” Gowri blabbered to Harshita, displeased. “Ditto. I can’t stand vegetables,” Rita grunted. “I won’t eat my lunch today.” “Me neither. My mom loves to torture me with broccoli!” Gowri complained. They both dumped their lunchboxes back in their bags and headed out of the class. Shyama had been watching curiously. She went to her elder brother’s class and confessed to him, “I saw my friends refusing to eat their lunch because they did not like vegetables. We are never grateful for what we get.” Arnav nodded. “That poor girl at the window gets nothing to eat while we enjoy our freedom to waste food.” Shyama climbed on her toes and whispered in Arnav’s ear, “Imagine how happy that girl would be if we gave her lunch!” Arnav was perplexed. “I know! But how will we do that?” “I have a plan!” Shyama giggled at that. For the first time, she was taking initiative. One day, Rita could not find her lunchbox in her bag. The next day, she found it back inside, clean and empty. Then Gowri’s lunch went missing. In the school, there were a couple of students who kept complaining about the “lack of taste” in their food. Many threw the food in the dustbin to avoid getting scolded by their parents. Over the next week, the lunchboxes of these children started disappearing. Strangely, the lunchbox would appear back in their bag the next day, without the food. Thus began the rumor of the Food Phantom. It was believed that the Food Phantom gobbled the students’ food. He would not eat the lunchbox because it choked his icky, spiky throat! “I had just gone to the toilet for a minute. When I came back, my lunchbox was no more!” Gowri squealed. “Ditto!” Rita exclaimed. "The Food Phantom is here!" Arnav and Shyama were the Food Phantoms. They stole a student’s lunchbox, and during the break, crossed the school road to give it to the poor girl and the boy. The first day Arnav and Shyama had brought them food, the poor ones were awe-struck. At the sight of food, they laughed with pure joy and danced happily. Arnav and Shyama loved to see their wholesome smiles and gave them food everyday in the break. The next day, Arnav and Shyama returned the lunch boxes back to their owners. The poor boy and girl they had been stealing for were brother and sister too. Their names were Ram and Shanti. They had three young brothers and two little sisters. Their parents were sick and slept all day. In the past, Ram and Shanti had been employed as laborers many times but it mostly landed them ill. They took to begging for food and money. Until Arnav and Shyama started feeding them, the poor family’s health improved. The elders and the littles started looking for work in selling newspapers or garlands. After a week, a parent got to know about the disappearance of lunch and the Food Phantom. He filed a complaint to Ms. Garima, the principal. Halfway through the lunch break, Ms. Garima stormed into classes and ordered that no one leave their seat. She inspected and invigilated each grade. A boy named Matthew’s lunch box had been stolen. “What did you bring for lunch, Matthew?” Ms. Garima inquired. “Ma’am, cheese sandwich. I did not want to eat it so I kept it back in my bag. The next moment, it was not there!” Suddenly, Harshita noticed that Shyama was not in the class. She realized that Shyama, throughout the week, had rarely been in class during the break. Bothered, she informed Ms. Garima. The same information was passed to Ms. Garima about Arnav. “Something is up,” Ms. Garima briefed all the teachers. “We all know that there’s no Food Phantom. Students keep saying that Arnav and Shyama are not in the class ever during the break. And they both are siblings. Please keep a vigilant eye on your classes and help find Arnav and Shyama!” After a few minutes, a peon spotted Arnav and Shyama leaving the school with a lunchbox in their hands. Ms. Garima connected the dots and figured that Arnav and Shyama had been stealing food all this time! They had also left the school premises without a teacher’s permission. Arnav and Shyama were sent to the principal’s office immediately after they returned. Ms. Garima said angrily. “I am calling your parents. You will be suspended for three months, if you don’t state why you stole students’ lunch! ” Arnav and Shyama were frightened. They had been obnoxious. They realized they had created a mess. They had been thieves. “We’re sorry ma’am,” Shyama sobbed. “We saw poor children of our age on the nearby road and felt bad because they had nothing to eat. They were so thin.” “We do not realize how lucky we are to have something to eat. So Shyama and I, foolishly, stole from others’ lunchboxes to feed the children. We also fed them our lunch,” Arnav cried. “It made us so happy to see their big family feast. It quenched our hunger too." Ms. Garima asked, “How are the children now?” Arnav and Shyama’s eyes lit up with love. “They are so healthy now,” Shyama smiled despite her tears. “So beautiful.” “The poor girl was just like Shyama.” Tears escaped the big brother’s eyes. Shyama had never seen him cry. Ms. Garima’s heart was touched by the spirit of these students. She knew she must not punish them harshly. “Arnav and Shyama, you have done a good job. But actions have their consequences. Stealing was not the correct way to help. For your punishment, you will help the peon clean the rooms for a week. Understood?” Arnav and Shyama’s heads hung low in shame. “Yes ma’am.” “No more Food Phantom.” Ms. Garima smiled and continued, “I want you to ask the poor children if they'd like to attend this school as a subsidiary. The fees can be forgiven for their first and second years.” Arnav and Shyama’s happiness knew no bounds. Ms. Garima rose to embrace both of them in a tight hug. When Mother and Father came to know, they scolded the two but also gave them each a pat on the back. The children felt proud. Ram, Shanti and some of their siblings joined the school the very next month. Studying and eating together, they became Arnav and Shyama’s best friends. It was a lovely day at the sidewalk.
author: SUHANI CHADHA

title: A man with red coat
text: A man With Red Coat In the city of London there lived a girl who was in her teens. She was named Areum. She loves to paint, but she hasn't shown much interest in studying. She loved being lonely and painting her imaginary creature, which doesn't even exist. She was not like other girls, but she was really unique. Her parents were in Denmark, but she lived in Lancashire with her aunt. One day she went to the nearby riverside valley to paint. While she was painting, suddenly the brush fell down, and she was going to take it, but a little dog took her special brush in her mouth, and it started running so fast. She was chasing behind it. Then, the dog stopped and threw the special brush into the river. She was worried, and she started to tear up because it was gifted by her lost grandfather before his death. She tried to pick up the brush that was floating on the water, and she was on the edge of the ground. Unfortunately, she was tripped and was about to fall into the water, but a man with blue ocean eyes who was wearing a red blazer pulled her before she could fall into the water. After she was pulled away by the man with the red coat, her eyes got blurry and she could only notice that he had blue oceanic eyes and that he was wearing a red coat. After a while, it was getting dark over there. She woke up and she saw the special brush near her. She found that the man took it for her. She returned home and was only thinking about the man who saved her. One night she had a dream about him in which he was revealing his face, but she couldn't see it clearly, even in her dream. Then she started going to the place where she saw him every day. She never stopped looking for him. One year later, Areum went to her hometown in Denmark. She was now living in her hometown. But one night she had a dream that she saw him in the valley, and she found his facial features. Two months later, Areum is now in Lancashire with her aunt. She started to go to the riverside valley, and it also had a park near it. When she went there, she found a guy who was wearing a red coat, so she rushed to him. Then she found it wasn't him. She became sad and went home. And then the next day she decided to draw him in near the valley where she met him. One week later, she regularly visited to see him but never found him. Areum is now studying at the University of Arts. Her university announced that they were going to have an art museum opening. So, they informed university students that they must join and show their artwork to the best artists and painters in the world. It was a big and gracious opening so that the historical painters would be there. Areum then thought about the drawing of the man she had fallen in love with that was in her bedroom. The next day, she took the art to the museum. All eyes caught her art. Media reporters started to take pictures of it. And the best artists wanted to buy her art, but she wasn't willing to give it to anyone. She replied, "no." Soon, she started becoming popular because of her imaginary creatures and her young, handsome man. Later, she became one of the best artists in the world. one day on an interview of her art with a handsome young man. She told all about her story, from the beginning, and then how the friendship turned into love. After a week, a young man in his 20s came to her studio and told the receptionist that he was the one in the art. Then, Areum told the receptionist to take him to her studio. At the moment when her eyes met his, her heart started beating so fast. He told her everything and asked how she painted him. She told all of her story from the beginning. and confessed her feelings to him. Later, after a week, he fell for her and proposed to her. She accepted, and then they got married. and lived happily ever after. Moral of the story: “ We do believe in ourselves. Should not lose hope no matter what”
author: Mariyam Zainab  S M M

title: Lilith's Life At The Green's
text: Lilith was a little girl of 12 who had just been adopted by the Greens Family. She came from a very poor background before being adopted, and being adopted by a wealthy family was like a dream come true for her. However, being adopted meant being introduced to a totally different world, especially since her new parents were wealthy people. Even as she was just a little girl, stepping foot inside her new home was a big challenge for her. Lilith’s new parents, Miss and Mister Greens welcomed her rather affectionately. As they had never had a child in their life, Lilith was like a little ray of sunshine to them. There new pride and joy. “Come in, dear.” Miss Green said warmly to Lilith as she walked towards the main door. Lilith awkwardly followed Miss Greens and tried to match up with her pace as they walked across the humongous house. Lilith’s new home was as big as a castle to her. She had never seen a house THAT big in her whole life. As she was looking around, Miss Greens stopped and started shouting for someone. “Samantha!, Come on down!” Down from the stairs came a brunette haired lady wearing a maid’s outfit. “Yes, miss.” She said as she made her way down. “This is Lilith, the new little miss of this house. As of today, you shall mend her and be there in all her needs.” Miss Greens said. Lilith could feel her face burning with embarrassment, as she heard the title “Little Miss Greens”. The brunette maid tilted her head as she slowly looked down towards Lilith. “Yes, miss.” She replied politely. After the introductions, the maid took Lilith to her new room. “This room is huge too!” Lilith said excitedly as she looked around. The brunette maid could see how all of this was so new to Lilith and suddenly sighed and gave out a small chuckle. Lilith heard it and immediately flushed over with embarrassment, and blurted out- “Oh! Uh- I’m- just new so-“ the maid laughed a little over Lilith’s weird talk and said, “You resemble her all too well!” Lilith stopped and asked “Sorry..who?” the maid smiled again and said “My daughter. You resemble her a lot.” Lilith didn’t know what exactly to say, so she just gave out a silly smile. The following day, Lilith came to know that the brunette maid was named “Marie”. And so, her and Marie grew close in a short period of time. They talked about all sorts of things, and Marie helped her a lot to fit in to the environment. Lilith was so happy, as she had finally found herself someone who she could be comfortable around with, other than her new parents. She found herself a friend. Along with her time with Marie, she heard many stories of her daughter and how she loved and adored her so much. Lilith was happy that Marie had someone she finds happiness in, and listened to her stories with immense attention. In the next month, Lilith was at the dinner table with both of her parents and they were all chattering merrily. They mentioned about Lilith going to a new school, which was famous, prestigious. However, Lilith couldn’t get her mind off what Marie said to her the previous day. The previous day, Lilith was just talking to Marie like any other day until Marie said “Oh, I wish you could meet my daughter, I’m sure both of you would make splendid friends.” That was what Lilith couldn’t shake off her mind. “Can I really meet her?” she thought curiously. So, she decided to ask her parents. But not straight forwardly- of course. “father, mother.” She said in a low voice. Mister and Miss Greens looked at her. “U-uh, what do you think- about visiting- uh- down the countryside- you know? At the homes of the people living down there?” she stuttered. Mister Greens simply gave out a light cough and looked away and Miss Greens looked at Lilith with a not-so-happy expression. “Dear, why do you ask?”Miss Greens asked. “O-oh, just curious.” Lilith said as she avoided Miss Greens stern gaze upon her. “Those people down there, they are not like us- Lilith. We are from a completely different world, and they are in their own worlds. We cannot mingle with them.” Miss Greens said. Lilith could hear her heart beating tremendously when she heard that. “But I come from down there too, no?” she blurted out. Miss Greens was surely irritated at this point. “Yes, but dear- you abandoned that life down there, this is the new path for you.” Miss Greens said. Lilith’s heart stopped. She could not believe that Miss Greens was a person like this. People that discriminated. That was what Lilith despised the most. She quietly ate up the rest of her food, which she was not sure whether she even digested, and went up in a silence. That night, Lilith had many thoughts in her head. She didn’t like the way Miss Greens talked about the commoners, but she didn’t want to her lose her mother’s love for her either. The next morning, as she awkwardly ate her breakfast with her parents she was just taking a stroll around the house when she saw Marie quietly sobbing near the bushes. Lilith was astonished, but it hurt her to see Marie crying. She went towards her and patted her. “Why are you crying..?” Lilith said softly. Marie quickly got up and wiped her tears in a rush as she said “O-oh, no- not a matter for you-“ Lilith knew for sure that something was wrong. “It’s alright, you can tell me.” She said reassuringly. Marie sniffed and explained the situation to her. It seemed that her daughter, Luna had fallen tremendously ill and needed immediate medication. However, she could not purchase the medicine due to insufficient money, and now she had gotten worse. Lilith’s heart ached as she heard Marie’s suffering, and she knew it was not right to just leave her be. So, she decided to help her. But even if she told her parent’s about it, they would surely refuse to her. So, in any case- it had to be a secret. The past few days, Lilith specifically asked her father for her pocket money, and she collected it for a week. After she had been done with her collection, she had to find a chance to escape- and the opportunity fell right into her hands. One Saturday evening, she saw her parent’s dressed up all fancy. When she asked why they wore such clothes, they mentioned that they were attending a party hosted by one of their relatives. And apparently- Lilith was ‘too young’ to attend such parties. It was almost like god was on her side too that day, and just after her parents left, Lilith went up to her room in a rush and wore her robe to be avoided to be seen. Then she ran up quietly to the front gate where the guards stood. Nervously she went towards them just to see they were fast asleep. On their duty! “What lazy locks!” she wondered as she went out of her house successfully. Lilith could hear herself laughing her head out, not because she escaped-but because she felt free. For the first time in all her suffocating life in the Greens house. As she happily strolled down, she was so happy she almost forgot the purpose she ran away. “Oops!” she thought suddenly and went towards the night market, for the medicine. Getting the medicine was a complete disaster for her. Among the huge crowd, she struggled to even get to the stores. But slowly but steadily, she managed to get her hands on it. As she got a hold of the medicine, she remembered how Marie mentioned her house looked like, and where it was. She sighed and ran towards the house, trying to recover her memories on which specific path it lied, and finally found it. It was an okay house. Not so big, not so small. But what mattered most was that she found it. She noticed that the front door was locked, and was in a deep thought of how she would go inside. “I don’t want Marie to think that someone unknown barged in as well”, so the only option she could think was to climb. “Uh yes, just like Flynn Rider from Rapunzel.” She thought sarcastically. As she struggled her way on to the top, when she finally made it up- she saw Luna lying sick on her bed. The guilt Lilith felt for being too late was immeasurable. But anyhow she had to give the medicine to her. As she entered the room quietly, she slowly opened up the medicine and gave it to Luna, who was fast asleep. After her duty was done, Lilith was just on her way back when she heard Luna murmur something. “who are you?”she asked softly. Lilith gave out a small smile and went towards the window, where she came from. “Oh, me? I’m your savior.” Lilith said dramatically and went down, to her home. Just to find her parents standing in the front gate. Who were they waiting for? Oh. Lilith of course. Lilith knew it was over for her. She not only escaped her home in the middle of the night, she also visited a commoner’s home! What would she do if they disowned her? She thought worriedly. But to her surprise... They were not mad at all, rather- Miss Greens ran over to Lilith and hugged her tight. “Oh, we were so worried about you!” she shouted as she began to sob. Mister Greens too, sobbed along with her. “But aren’t you mad at me? For.. uh-“ Miss Greens sniffled and said “Of course we are! But what matters more is your condition, anyway.. don’t do this ever again! If you want to go out, remember to always ask me or your father.” Lilith could feel the knots in her heart untangling. No matter what it was, whether they didn’t like the idea of mingling with commoners or being “high class”, everyone has a reason for what they do, whether it is evil or good. So, Lilith hugged her parents and headed inside her room. The next morning, when Marie was combing Lilith’s hair, Marie suddenly mentioned “Little miss Lilith, You would not pry to believe this, but today when I woke up and visited Luna, She was in much better health! And oh- she mentioned something about ‘her saviour’” Lilith gave out a small laugh and said, “Oh yes, maybe a really cool saviour came to her service, no?” THE END

title: BOLDNESS
text: Once upon a time there lived a Girl named Chisty. She was living in a middle class family in which Chisty's father was a farmer and her mother was was House wife. Chisty's aim was to become a Fashion Designer but, she changed her aim for her father, how hard her father works. All the people have different point of view on High posts and low posts. So that,Chisty decided to bring Justice towards Farmers and also they should be treated equally. author: VARSHA  K

title: Gift From Daughter
text: The story goes that some time ago, a man punished his 3-year-old daughter for wasting a roll of gold wrapping Money was tight and he became infuriated when the child tried to decorate a box to put under the Christmas tree. Nevertheless, the little girl brought the gift to her father the next morning and said, "This is for you, Daddy." ﻿ The man was embarrassed by his earlier overreaction, but his anger flared again when he found out the box was empty. He yelled at her, stating, "Don't you know, when you give someone a present, there is supposed to be something inside? The little girl looked up at him with tears in her eyes and cried, "Oh, Daddy, it's not empty at all. I blew kisses into the box. They're all for you, Daddy." The father was crushed. He put his arms around his little girl, and he begged for her forgiveness. Only a short time later, an accident took the life of the child. It is also told that her father kept that gold box by his bed for many years and, whenever he was discouraged, he would take out an imaginary kiss and remember the love of the child who had put it there. Moral: In a very real sense, each one of us, as humans beings, have been given a gold container filled with unconditional love from our children, family members, friends, and God. There is simply no other possession, anyone could hold, more precious than this.

title: FEAR
text: Once upon a time there lived a boy named Rohit in a village. He used to go to the mango orchards after school to play with his grandfather. He loved to go there. Once his grandfather had gone out of the village. So he went for a walk alone in the mango orchard. Rohit was playing there when while playing he saw a snake sitting under the tree. He ran to a hut nearby and called a man from there. He told the man that there was a snake near the mango tree. The man asked Rohit to stay behind and he himself took the stick and went to drive the snake away. After some time the man told Rohit that the snake is gone, he did not need be afraid anymore. He asked Rohit what he was doing there all alone. Rohit said that he used to come here everyday with his grandfather but grandfather was not there that day, so he had himself came alone. The man said to Rohit, "You should not roam alone, come, now I will drop you to your home." Rohit was still scared and said fearfully, "Mother had told me not to come alone but still I insisted and now I am feeling very bad." When both reached Rohit's house, Rohit ran and hugged his mother. Rohit started crying loudly and seeing that his mother got very scared. She kept asking again and again what had happened, "Why are you crying so much." Rohit tearfully told the whole incident to his mother and his mother thanked the man. Rohit's mother tried hard to calm him down but Rohit was still scared. He was so scared he didn't even want to leave his room. When his father came home in the evening, he tried hard to talk to Rohit, but Rohit still did not open the door of his room. He couldn't get the incident off his mind. On repeated requests from his father, Rohit opened the door and hugged him. Then they both had dinner together and his father told him many things about snakes which he had read in the library books. His father said that the next morning he would take him to the library so that he could read more about the snakes. Next morning Rohit was playing outside his house when he saw a long rope and he screamed in fear and ran to his house. His mother came ranning of the house and saw that Rohit had screamed in fear after seeing a piece of rope. His mother told him not to be afraid because it was just a piece of rope and not a snake. Seeing Rohit's growing fear, Rohit's father took him to the library. where they both read a lot of books on snakes. In the library he got a lot of information about snakes like not all types of snakes are poisonous. And snakes bite only to protect themselves and to get their food. After reading so many books, Rohit's fear went away and now he wanted to know more about snakes. Moral: Knowledge overcomes your fear.

title: Grandma's Pie
text: It should have been a great summer, it would have with my older brother Rodrick at boot camp and my mom in London on a business trip. Only me and papa were home. "Ding dong" the doorbell rang that saturday morning I was brushing my teeth and papa went to get the door. I rushed down stairs to see who was at the door, and to my surprise it was Nana the best grandma i could ever ask for! Saturday afternoon me and papa had built a treehouse in our backyard and I was really, really looking forward to a great summer. Until Rich, Rich Thompson moved in next door! He was my first enemy. I've never had an enemy before but now things had changed. He had backyard trampoline party were he invited everyone on the block except me! He came over to my house and almost destroyed my turboflex drone I got for christmas. He even tried to light my treehouse on fire. I surely have had enough, I marched over to my grandma and dad who were sipping hot coffee on the porch. Just as I whinnied about Rich my grandma pulled out an old dusty recipe from her bag, and said it was the only way to get rid of all enemies....... "ENEMY PIE" she said with excitement, it worked for her mom and her grandma. I was flabbergasted, we started to prepare it right away. I brought snail goo, rat fur, expired tuna fish and every nasty thing I could think of and while Nana needed, and tossed and turned the dough I waited in my treehouse thinking about revenge! Finally it was ready, I set the table and was just about ready to invite Rich when something was off. "Did the pie smell good?", nah its probably just the flowers. And I was of on my way to Rich's house. By the time me and Rich hurried back the ENEMY PIE was served. Me, Rich, papa and Nana all sat at the table, Rich took the first bite of the pie and to my surprise he said " mmmm this is the most scrumptious pie I've ever had". I was furious and also confused at the same time! Later that day I had asked Nana why she had made the pie delicious instead of disgusting! And she simply said "Enemy pie was never meant to be disgusting, it was to show your so called enemy that you wanted to be friend, that way like I said all your enemies would disappear. Now I had finally understood, I took Rich to my treehouse, and we soon became the bestest of friends!

title: End: A New Start
text: My ears throbbing by the sound of raindrops hitting the outside world. I hear them but don't see them. I'm not exactly sure where I am. My head is groaning from this unbelievable pain. I cannot move I can only feel what is beneath my perspiring fingers. The bleeding is course, layered with my dry blood and probably of many others. The buzzing surrounds my insane state, voices are muffled and foreign. I have been attempting to move my broken body for so long, but it will not obey. The date and time mean nothing to me; they are irrelevant when all hope is gone. Bodies float and sway regularly around me. As the nurse arrives to complete her hourly routine; all I have is the comfort of her footsteps, the only familiar sound that I know of. But It's this all my sub conscience deceiving me? My brain tricking me in believing that I could actually still survive this pain. Survive what though exactly? I don't remember it anymore- the accident that is, thoughts keep flashing into my mind but none of them piece together. Vivid images of my random memory keep coming back to haunt me. Sometimes I see a small child with no face; just a torn red coat, that reminds the of fairytales, which I could once believe in. When I attempt to remember my past, she appears. She seems so happy, like an innocent child should be. But what use is this when I feel like i will never live again? what happened, how did I get to this stage? Was I taken prisoner shot in the street or maybe it was all the effect of my own stupidity? I can feel I've been foolish. My mind is getting closer to this horrific event.... the Nurse came along snapping me out of my thoughts. She dressed my wounds and was about to leave while I asked her to hold on for some time she patiently waited for me to speak something and I finally uttered out, "what happened to me?" to which the nurse calmly replied, “you have been rescued from the Warfield.”.” Saying this, she left out her words were now echoing in my ears. “WARFIELD" and I gradually remembered everything… screams and screams everywhere, each one trying their best to make it out of this, so was I and my family. Wait....where are my parents? My siblings? My Friends? Where are they? Along with these questions another flashback came to my senses. The godown we were hiding in was set on fire by the soldiers. Everyone was trapped... me Along with my family. No way to get out of the place. Luckily my mother found a window open. She held my hand and ran towards it. I struggled to get through it but was successful. Then she passed my brother out but before she could make it, BOOOM!!! The whole godown blasted. In a fragment of second I lost my everything, it was like a cruel joke from the universe, I had nothing left, dizziness clouded my mind. Simultaneously my tears made their way out of my eyes, soaking my cheeks as I stared blankly on my burns. Everything was over and I had nothing to hold back, nothing to live for, infact no one to live for. Days passed, everyday the nurse used to come and I just simply sat on my bed, thinking why am still alive. I regretted that I am alive while my mother is no more… but-but brother! He made it out of the fire! Where is he? How could I even miss him out? it made sense, he was the reason I am here. The next day when the nurse came, I asked if I could walk around as I wanted to find my brother, she provided me with a support stick and allowed me to go around short distance. I decided to start my search from tomorrow. The next day I went out of my tent for the first time. After inquiring with some people I got to know that there were 4 tents for the recovering patient, another 4 for the critical ones, and a last big open area for the dead bodies. I slowly made my way towards the tents, with a firm mind but a nervous heart. As I was walking many thoughts came across my mind, what if he couldn't make it up? What if I won't find him? What if- what if I found him but, not alive…lost in my thoughts I bumped into a person.I lost my balance and landed on floor. The person immediately came over to help me. "I am so sorry about this." I bowed to man in front of me. “be careful. You don’t seem to be in the state anyways.” “ya, am a lil hurt as I have been rescued from a burning godown” I replied as I dusted off my dress. “where are u heading to?” “actually I am looking for my brother, while the incident he was with me but now I don’t have any clue about where he is.” “would you like some company?” “well, I won’t mind some.” As we headed together to the rescue camps. “alas! I forgot my introduction, I am Dr. Arjun shah” “myself ahanaa roy.” We were about to shake hands but I let it slid off. We were quick enough to pass through 8 camps where patients were being treated. Hard luck we didn’t found Sarthak, my brother anywhere. Exhausted I found a near bench and sat over it to get some rest. Arjun took his seat next to me. Now we just have to check the last hall, of dead bodies. I was already shivering by the thought of finding Sarthak dead. I wasn’t in a condition to go through any painful, heavy emotions. The loss of my mother was already too much. My old grief wasn’t over how could I handle more, new, fresh wounds. My inner voice screamed inside me while I was dead silent. Arjun gently called my name and I didn’t respond, I couldn’t actually. He sighed out and held my hand, I teared up. He adjusted his stare at a rear point and started with his words, “there’s never a ‘the end’ for anything, especially for life. Life is a journey which has to flow, just like a river. Life can’t stop, it can take a pause but it can’t be standstill on a single point. Harsh twists and turns are expected, Big rocks and other obstacles as well. In the whole journey the river changes it’s form, from fresh and clean water to salty saline water. But still it never stops. The river may loose the organisms living in it, so can we. The way river flows and never stops we need to do the same. Just keep moving aahana, we all loose some or the other person in our life, but just because of their absence you can’t stop your journey. YOU HAVE TO LIVE YOUR OWN LIFE.” And arjun went silent with this. It felt as if he blew life in my dead body. And that was when I realized I can still continue to live with or without my brother being alive. “but what will I do now?” I questioned arjun because of the hesitation I wasn’t able to get over. “help people, people like you. Help them get over their problems, the way I helped you.”……And today, here I am, in front of you all, sharing my little story so that with may help someone among you.”The crowd broke in an applause and I silently left the auditorium.
author: Apoorwa Deshmukh

title: TIM - THE LIGHTNING BOLT PROBLEM
text: CHAPTER 1 There was a boy named Tim. It was two days before his birthday when a bolt of lightning struck his coconut tree, making it to fall on all the cables, other plants, electricity wires and the antenna. Tim's house was very dark for almost eleven hours and there was a screeching noise for a minute. Tim and his family went outside to see what had happened, after the rain stopped. CHAPTER 2 Tim saw that his coconut tree had fallen on all his electricity cables destroying them and cutting the electricity supply to his house. Tim was wondering whether he would be able to celebrate his birthday. There was only 48 hours left for his birthday. Tim was hopeless with a destroyed garden, dark house and no signal, when suddenly the doorbell rang. ﻿Tim went to see who was at the door to meet his friend Gary who told "Tim, your house is an elephant sized mess. I am worried ﻿ ﻿about what you are going to do, especially when are two days away from your 16 ﻿th ﻿ birthday". Tim replied "Can you help me to fix everything in this short window of forty eight hours?". Gary immediately took his smartphone out of his pocket and called three of his friends as Tim had three problems with his house. Tim and Gary were waiting at Tim's house when suddenly the door was kicked open. Tim and Gary did not even have to move. Gary's friend Paul, the electrician came inside and said "Tim I will fix your electrical problems". Paul took Gary and Tim outside to show them a mountain of electrical wires. Both Gary and Tim fainted and in that time Paul replaced all the defunct wires with the new wires. After Paul fixed the problem, Gary and Tim woke ufrom their fainted state to see another mountain of old defunct wires. After seeing this sight Gary and Tim immedietly knew that Paul had fixed the wire problem and started jumping happily and thanked Paul. Soon after Paul moved out, Gagarin the signal manager moved in and said, " Tim, I will fix your signal problem and replace your antenna." He did just the same and the all the devices in Tim's house including the television started working again. Tim and Gary were very happy ang thanked Gagarin As Gagarin moved out, Steve the chef moved in and said, " Tim I will cook all the desserts, delicious food and cake for your birthday within the time slot you give me". Tim replied, " Can you cook all the delicious food, desserts and the cake in five hours?" Steve replied, " Sure, five hours is more than enough time". Steve quickly started cooking and finished it less than thirty minutes. Tim and Gary thanked Steve who left a birthday gift for Tim and moved out of Tim's House. Tim was very happy as his birthday which seemed like impossible was going to be a fun blast. Tim thanked Gary for his big help by giving him a box of candy and an invitation to his birthday party. Tim also decided to thank Paul, Gagarin and Steve by inviting them to his birthday party. CHAPTER-4 When Tim woke up on hos birthday morning, he was surprised to see Gary, Steve, Gagarin, Paul and his parents holding sixteen gifts for Tim and wishing him a ' Happy Birthday'. Tim was very happy and thanked everybody. Immediately he ran down stairs to open the gift left by Steve the previous day. Tim as amazed to see that Steve's seventeenth gift was his favourite T Rex action figure. Tim immediately thanked Steve. Later Tim was taken to the hotel where his parents arranged Tim's birthday party along with his Steve, Gagarin, Paul and Gary. This was the best birthday Tim has experienced in his life. By Nithilan V M grade 5A

title: An Irreparable Loss
text: An Irreparable loss The sun was setting. There was a chill in the air. Darkness was starting to creep. I was in my room, sitting on my desk, doing my homework but then I began to feel restless and thirsty so I decided to take a break. I got up, went to the kitchen and fetched myself a glass of cold pumpkin juice. Then I went to the living room to check on my dog Biscuit."Biscoo?" I asked." "Woof!" replied Biscuit. I saw her drinking water on the rug so I went near her, got on my knees and started to pat Biscuit. Suddenly, Biscuit started getting playful. She looked towards her toy Panda so I dragged it towards her. I played with Biscuit for a long time. I felt like I needed to go and finish my homework so I went back to my room.I sat back down on my desk. It was really dark now. I looked through my window only to find the bright, elegant and charming moon. I stared at it for sometime and then started to do my homework.It was around 10 pm now. I was tired after doing so much Math equations. I put away all my stuff and started getting ready for bed. I was just about to sink on my bed when suddenly I started feeling sick in the stomach. I glanced at the window. The moon was nowhere to be found. There was only black, rigid clouds. Something was not right. I went to the living room. It was dark there. No light was switched on. I called out "Biscoo? Biscoo? BISCUIT! BISCUIT REPLY TO ME!" But there was no reply. Normally, Biscuit would always reply to me with a bark even if she was sleeping. I walked quietly on my tiptoe so that my parents won't wake up and switched on the lights. To my horror I found Biscuit Laying on the floor. At first I thought she was sleeping so i knelt and started to touch her. But all I could feel was coldness. I screamed, " BISCUIT! BISCUIT!" I started sobbing badly. I called out for my parents, " MA! PA! AMMA!". They rushed towards to me thinking that I was hurt, " What? Are you hurt? asked amma. I was lost of words.I wasn't able to open my mouth so I pointed towards Biscuit. My father sat beside him touched his paw. " I am sorry" father said. " Sorry for what?" asked my mother. "Biscuit's gone." Said father. "WHAT?" said ma and started sobbing terribly. It has been 1 year after my dear Biscoo's death. I still haven't recovered. Not a day goes by thinking that my best friend, my companion, partner was gone. My head starts to ache by just thinking that i will never get to talk to my Biscoo and gossip with her,(even though she wouldn't understand a thing) or ever hear her bark in her sweet voice EVER AGAIN! But deep down I know she must be enjoying while she lives her after life in HEAVEN. Today was my birthday. I turned 12 today. I woke up expecting Biscuit to be on top of me, but she was not there. I knew I lost my biscuit but that doesn't mean that i could forget her. My mother called me from downstairs, "Valarie, come on! Tricia's here!" Tricia was my best friend. I went downstairs " I got you a present Val." Tricia said.. Scratching noises were coming from the box. I opened the present. Suddenly a puppy with golden fur hopped out."I know that it's been an year after you lost Biscuit and I know that you still haven't recovered but I got you this pup to help you cut out your loneliness. I hope you don't mind." said Tricia. " Hope I don't MIND? Are you serious Tricia? This is the best gift ever! Thank you so much Trichu! I have finally recovered Biscuits absence after 3 years. No. I have not forgotten her but i have accepted that she's gone. With Bisoo by my side, (the pup Tricia gifted me) I can spend my time and keep my mind off Biscuit. I just hope that Biscuit might be happy with her friends in heaven. Even though I won't be by her side. Biscuit will always be in my heart. No one can and will ever be able to replace her.......But i have learnt to cope up with loss...AN IRREPARABLE LOSS. By Parvati Ashok

title: THE STORY OF BACKBITING
text: In the school of Anjelia Emory, Anna, Elina, Amy and Elsa used to study. It was the day of school which was again as usual studying and etc... So the first character Emory had two best friends Anna and Elina, still she used to feel not included, left out she just had a weird feeling that Anna and Elina are thinking her as a puppet on a string. Anna and Elina don’t have a feeling of left out unlike Emory. it’s just that they are having each other for literally anything. Coming to Amy and Elsa they weren't nerd type at all. There comes Emory Anna and Elina, talking about a real bestie kind of game which is available in play store.And in the same way comes Amy and Elina fetching coffee and talking about their, parties.... When Amy was about to dash onto Emory, Anna pulled out Emory’s shirt but still Amy spilled her coffee on Emory and there you go, again A FIGHT which literally calls the staff of Angelia. So, in the class after the lecture, both the groups didn’t even make eye contact. So, Amy and Elsa caught up Emory and starting telling her that she is a puppet playing on a string by Anna and Elina. And started to tell her that she is always left out and not included and what not. And as per their plan Emory was slowly starting to BELIEVE THEM.... so they did have an alternate arrangement to the issue of fighting with the other group. But still Emory couldn’t believe things made of thin air. So, Amy told that “I will prove it to you, in fact you will prove to yourself “, So then what Emory thought to give it a try. And Amy tells to Emory that “Now you see the truth, just act like you’ve fainted,and call your so called friends “, Emory was shocked that why will her friends not come to help her when they are just talking to a friend. Emory was like “ Let me just call out for them anyway “ and there she goes “ ANNAAA ElINAA I CAN’T STAND OUT NOW HELP ME I’M GETTING DIZZINESS “, to her surprise they didn’t turn up. Then Emory is puzzled with a big question on her head JUST WHYY?????? Actually this was a part of the evil plan of Amy and Elsa, when Emory called out for her friends they were desperate cuz the girl with whom they were talking wasn’t an ordinary girl she was a puppet of Amy and Elsa. Blackmailing Elina and Anna about something which wasn’t even done by them. Using this as a proof, Amy and Elsa made Emory an actual puppet on a string. At first they made Emory to do small things like doing their homework, completing their assignments and projects and etc... But actually the dark part of the story starts now Amy and Elsa tells Emory that there are two girls who are very mean and also blackmailing other girls when they aren’t doing but,false accusation.. Then Emory was so furious and asks Amy that who are they then Amy was like “ None of your business “, “Until you stop the girls from doing these nonsense things”, Emory was ready “ Tell me Amy who are they and how i can stop them from doing these things “, Amy was very happy she was in her enlightenment zone that everything is going as per she planned So, Amy says that “Complain to the principal about this and put an end to all of these “, and Emory says OK and then what, Emory goes and complains to principal about the two girls Then what, principal gets furious and comes to the children’s block and asks Emory who are they;the two girls, then Emory asks who are they to Amy and she says “ANNA AND ELINA “, Emory was so so shocked that why would Amy complain against her friends and did her friends really do such works.. Then, Anna and Elina asked why to all the false accusation then Emory was speechless,and Emory told all the truth and also told that how she is feeling about not feeling included. And finally all three became friends and told the principal that the names were Amy and Elsa... They were happy friends for life.......

title: In The Dreamland
text: One day, after coming back and taking leave Srisha came to meet her best friend in California. His name was Rajbir and he wanted to show Srisha his new invention, and surprise! It was a robot! Srisha was amazed to see his new creation. Srisha said, "Oh my God, Rajbir! its such a wonderful robot." Rajbir said, " Its name is Lea 00.2." "Will it obey everything we say?" asked Srisha "Yes" answered Srisha "I have an idea" said Srisha 'What is your idea?" exclaimed Rajbir. Until then Rajbir's mother call ed him. She shouted, Rajbir! come here" Rajbir said,'Yes I am coming" his mother was standing furiously. Rajbir asked his mother, " What happened? Why are you shouting like an idiot? " his mother replied "Who has broken the new set of glasses?" Rajbir replied" Srisha did had not come yet and I was playing with the ball that hit the set. His mother asked, " Do you even know how expensive it was! " " No" Rajbir went to his room and sat down grumpily. Srisha asked 'what has happened?" Rajbir answered "I want to get rid of these parents!" "we can do that with your robot" Srisha said Rajbir said it's a great idea." after sometime, Rajbir's father came and gave them bubble gum. After dinner,they went into their room and turned on the robot and shouted, "Get rid of everything!" After that they both went to sleep. In the morning they noticed that nothing was around them. Rajbir and Srisha got worried. Everything had turned white. Srisha said " uh oh, we are in huge trouble!" "what do we do now?" both of them thought for a while. Suddenly they saw a big monster with one eye who was as huge as a giant. They both ran away from there and saw Rajbir's cousion sister on the swing without a nose and a chin. Then they saw an old man singing, 'ding dong'. "I know you can hear me; open up the door; I only want to play a little bit." they ran from there as they realised that grandpa was behind them. Srisha screamed and left Rajbir alone. Rajbir saw pennywise and was scared at this scary sight. Srisha was looking for Rajbir and they both bumped into each other and both of them said, "You are here!" shouted Srish. "I wish, we could go back." said Rajbir. They both were in tears suddenly, they came back to their beds in California. In the morning they both were confused. Rajbir said, "How can it happen?" They both thought that they must have been dreaming. They both got up and ate their breakfast. Rajbir and Srisha went to a park later, their they saw Rubani. They were terrified and saw blood all over Rubani's face, she stared at both of their faces and laughed. After sometime, everybody shouted, " The end of the world has come!" Rajbir asked Srisha " Now what will we do?" Suddenly they went to the Pacific Ocean. The Aqualad was chasing them but everything was nice. So, they went back to their home and Srisha said," We must have been dreaming."

title: OUT IN THE WOODS
text: Valerie, an eighteen-year-old girl with curly brown hair and a height of 160cm was a student majoring in topography. She lived alone in an apartment given by her mother, Mrs.Scott which was amidst the busy city streets of Nuhui in Laong. She was captivated by wild creatures and the atmosphere of their innate home.' Ichi', her pet dog was a very notorious being who'd never take in its food if not served with pedigree and was afraid of the dark. Unlike every classmate of hers, she was the only one with no aspirations in life to chase even after majoring in topography. This made her mother, Mrs.Scott concerned. They would have often quarreled on this, and Valerie would end up weeping her tears in the corner of her room. She could stay calm only when Ichi was around her. It was spring and Valerie wanted to take some time out for herself."I must visit somewhere serene and adventurous this week", said Valerie. She browsed for several spots, and a while after she found a place named "Cosmos Wildlife reservation", a place 12 miles away from the busy city of San Francisco. She then packed her backpack for the trip, taking in first aid kit, canned food, and extra clothes. The following day she got ready for her expedition and most importantly, she was accompanied by her dog 'Ichi'." We got this, Ichi. I hope we'll have a good day today", said Valerie. She took a metro from the city with which she covered 9 miles. For the next 3 miles, she rode a bicycle, and her dog was kept in the dog basket. After a journey of 6 hours, Valerie and Ichi finally reached the Reservation camp. There she was introduced to the tour guide. "What's your name?", asked the guide. Valerie replied, "I'm Valerie and this is my dog, Ichi". She then asked what his name was. " I'm Tom, Tom Holland", the tour guide replied. Sooner they started to discuss their events for the day and the places they were going to visit. Everything was planned and she and the other trekkers were given a trekking stick by their guide, Mr. Tom. " Ready for the adventure, trekkers?", asked Mr. Tom. "Yes, commander", the trekkers replied. All of a sudden Ichi stood on his legs and joined his paws, in a reply to his question. As they moved forward, they began singing, "Laong...for the world, we live to make it better". On their way, they could see the vast expansion of mountains with a vivid range of flowers blooming everywhere. They could see deer with their young ones, bear behind the woods, and notorious Ichi, hiding. So, Valerie, is this your first-time trekking with your dog?", Asked Mr. Tom. "Yeah, it is my first time", replied to Valerie. "How long have you been keeping Ichi with you?", asked Mr. Tom. "It has been almost 3 years now, Ichi has been a very important part of my life, my one and only friend, whom I can share with my cries and laughter", said Valerie. "Life is a really adventurous journey where we meet many people we get attached to forever and some part away from us, sometimes it's difficult for us to decide and think for our future but being a Suddenly, a bear came moving towards them. "The....the...re.... there’s a....bear behind us", said Valerie. To their surprise, they all started running." Run fast, trekkers", said Mr. Tom. Valerie and Ichi ran as fast as they could but then they lost track of the others. Now, it became dark, the stars and the moon were the only sources of light for them. "We can't stay out long in the woods, Ichi. Let's go find a place to spend the night", said Valerie. "A cave! let's spend the night here, Ichi", said Valerie. Ichi unable to eat the food which were fruits, it started rolling above the ground. "Eat this ", said Valerie giving ichi some canned tuna. Ichi sniffed and ate it all. They placed some leaves on the ground and lit up a fire. As they both fell asleep, Valerie could hear some sounds coming from the corner of the cave. When she woke up, she saw that it was the same bear that was chasing them. She stood still and couldn't move an inch. The bear started to come towards her and her dog, afraid of darkness, was still in its sleep. The bear touched her face, but she didn't feel scared. Instead, she felt warm and safe around the bear. As a keen observer of wild creatures, she realized that she didn't feel unsafe around animals. She too padded the bear and made it feel safe. "Oh dear, you got hurt, let me treat you ", said Valerie in sorrow. The next day, the bear carried them both on their back and took them into the woods to show the world of the wild. Into the world of the wild, was a new experience for Valerie. The bears welcomed her as if she was one of them. Suddenly two bears came and lifted her, she was then made to sit on a flat stone which was decorated with all sorts of flowers and fruit, laid in Infront of her. Valerie was confused about whatever was happening, and one of the bears, whose wound she treated came up. To her surprise, she could understand what the bear was saying. "Thank you so much for helping me out yesterday by treating my wound. You are the only one who treated the animals with such kindness. Before, when one of us or any other creatures of the wild got hurt the people who found them would always assassinate them. For your act yesterday, this is a small token of love from us", said the bear Valerie and her dog were crowned with garlands made of poppies, roses, lilies, baby blue eyes, and showy penstemon. The bears danced out their heart for Valerie. While the bears were dancing, Valerie suddenly heard a voice coming from the woods towards the lake. Valerie was a black belt achiever in Taekwondo, she ran towards the man and gave a hook kick. " What are you going here, Dude?", she asked. " None of your business", replied to the man in blue denim. "Really none of my business", said Valerie in disappointment." Well let's who's this business is about". Without the notice of the bears and Ichi, she went to see what was happening out there. Some people were trying to destroy the forest and seeing this Valerie couldn't stop herself from acting to save the precious land of the wild With a single whistle, the bears came to her. Seeing this too, the man didn't hesitate to destroy the forest. The whole group of bears and Valerie started to fight against the man and his group. One went high up in the sky and fell to the ground, and the other was played off by the bears, Valerie fought with the man in the blue denim whom she knocked off with her hook kick. After a while of fighting, they could hear the voice of other people which sound familiar. " Valerie, Valerie, are you there?", a man from a distance shouted. Valerie followed the voice and found that it was Mr. Tom. "Mr. Tom, I'm here, Mr. Tom, Ichi and I are here", Valerie shouted as loud as she could. " Valerie, we finally found you", said Mr. Tom with happiness. "What's going on here?", asked Mr. Tom. "These men were trying to destroy the forest, so we knocked them off", said Valerie. " We?", asked Mr. Tom in confusion. " Yeah, we. These bears, Ichi, and I ", said Valerie. As she turned back, she found that no bear was behind them." Just now, we...were. wi..wit..with the bears where did they go?", said Valerie in confusion. "Valerie, you must have been really tired. You're imagining things", said Mr. Tom. "B...but..bu..but I fought these guys with the help of the bears, believe me", said Valerie with a cry. "We believe in you, Valerie. Now let's go back to the camp, it's getting dark", said Mr. Tom. As they headed back to the camp, Valerie turned back and saw the bears behind the woods, moving their paws and bidding farewell to her. Seeing this Valerie wanted to go back to them, but she gave a smile to them and moved forward. On reaching the camp, Valerie said,"How did you come this far, Mr. Tom?."We found traces left behind by Ichi, it left pieces of the trekking stick cover behind which made helped us to come to you", replied Mr. Tom. Valerie took Ichi in her arms and said, "Ichi, thank you so much for always being by my side. I'll always cherish you my dear". After the trip when she reached home and unpacked her bag, she found that there was a crown that was made by the bears for her. She teared up on seeing it, she kept Ichi beside her and said,"Ichi, I have decided to be a member of the animal welfare, it's a great idea. I'll tell mom about she'll really be happy".

title: War and Peace
text: It’s when Artificial Intelligence (AI) was on the peak everything was done with the help of machines and robots. On one fine evening of chilling January in Himachal Pradesh, One family was seen struggling with its robot. Robot which used to follow them had started attacking them. Mr. Yadav, the father of two sons, Harsh Yadav and Dev Yadav was lying dead on the floor. His both sons who were not even eighteen were clueless as what they could do. Harsh some how managed to shut the main power switch of the robot but unfortunately he got his left hand injured. This situation was not just with them but was spread in the whole world. Robots and machines with the help of AI started dominating humans. These robots disconnected themselves from servers operated by humans. Now, they were on their own. They were doing what they wanted. These so called loyal and useful robots suddenly turned into demons which were ready to kill each and every human that existed. As once Stephen Hawking said, “This earth will be ruled by Robots in future” and that’s what exactly happening. The people all over the world were clueless. Scientists were latterly doomed, their brain stopped working as they never imagined such a situation earlier. They were just devastated with the thought of people who were alive because robots were destroying every human they saw. The situation was tense for everyone. Everyone was scared whether they would be living a usual life as earlier. Mr Gupta was a brilliant technology expert who was rewarded for his achievements. He was reading about the blunder, that’s when he heard a knock at the main entrance of his lab. As being all alone in his lab, he got scared and was shivering and thought that it might be robots. Even then, he opened the door with his trembling hands and saw two teen boys standing in front of him in miserable condition. He immediately let them in, they were bursting into tears and Mr Gupta consoled them and asked how they got stuck here. A boy finally spoke, “His name is Harsh Yadav and the other boy is his younger brother Dev Yadav”. They told Mr Gupta everything what happened earlier. They also told him that robots were becoming more violent with each passing time. They were destroying everything that came their way. Even they had formed their army. title: Humanity in Animals
text: A four year old dog was brought in a family, but a question might arrive in your mind, why a 4 YEAR OLD and not a new born? well, read the story and find it out. Twitter, a golden retriever was adopted in a family which resided in the state of Himachal Pradesh. He was not a new-born but a fully-grown. This family had always wanted a dog, but, due to certain circumstances, they couldn't do so. Twitter, when born, was a weak dog and was not adopted by anyone. later, he got adopted by a rich family which took care of it just like a son! His ears were brushed regularly and he had a closet for his clothes, shoes and even ear-covers. His ears were the prettiest and the most attractive feature. But, his life changed after his parents left him and flew to Canada. It's not like as if they didn’t want to take him with them, but, they were unable to do so even after several tries. Twitter was left to one of his parent's relative who couldn't take much care of him as she was so much engaged in her work. Due to lack of attention, he was a bit depressed, but still carried on and loved her new care-taker (she wasn’t a parent in twitter's eyes as he had already given his heart to Mr. and Mrs. Kumar)The new owner tried her best to give twitter the required attention, but couldn’t achieve it. So, after trying for six months, she posted an advertisement on social media which was for adoption of twitter. The family, in Himachal Pradesh, saw this post and made a call to the care-taker and adopted this dog. They took well care of him and loved him as much as they could. Obviously the love wasn’t equivalent to that of Mr. and Mrs. Kumar, but wasn’t less either! He was taken good care of, unless, the new owner's daughter had told them that it was harmful for their(owner's) health if they maintained such close contact with the dog and suggested them to keep him outside the rooms and the house! (Can you imagine how difficult it would be for a dog, who had always lived a luxurious life, to now live in a totally different one?) After this, the owner's love didn’t decrease but they maintained a bit distance. After a year or two, they decided to get a new dog, but, then had a thought about Twitter. They thought that Twitter may not accept the dog, which was correct to think of. After waiting and discussing for a month they decided to finally get a dog which will make Twitter play and enjoy a little more. The family got a dog and named him Insta. Since, he was little and a new-born, he was taken more care of. He was cuddled more, played with more and more time was spent with him than that of Twitter. This made Twitter insecure and he remained upset. When, Insta used to go near to interact with Twitter, he would run away. He didn’t like to go near the little one. He hated him so much that as soon as he felt his presence near him,he would change his location. One day, Insta was outside, playing in the lawn when monkeys suddenly arrived and were about to attack. The owners were not nearby. In the lawn there was Monkeys, Insta and Twitter. As, insta was still a baby, He couldn’t protect himself. Now, Twitter had two options,either to allow the monkeys to hurt Insta or to protect him. Even after all this hatred in Twitter's heart, he chose the second option and protected Insta just like a father would protect his child. After this incident, Twitter was applauded and appreciated and they lived happily ever after. Name- Riddhima Class-10
