title: Christmas
text: On the Christmas tree, there hung a shiny silver bauble. Mary bought it for just a few dollars. She was ecstatic, running down the stairs carrying her 5 year old daughter on her hip. It was finally Christmas, a day she had waited for most eagerly. Her husband Joseph was to return home from the war today. The war begun almost 3 years ago, when the King of the North invaded the Southern Land. Their king announced that all men above the age of 18 must come and “protect their homeland from the nasty northerners”. Naturally, Joseph was ripped away from his wife and 2 year old daughter, and had to serve in the war. He made many fond memories there with his fellow soldiers. His comrades were valiant and fought to the very end. They came from all walks of life, some settled men, and some solitary wanderers. They all had something or someone to fight for, and when times got rough, Joseph was always there to cheer them up, remind them why they were taking part in the war, and to keep their head high. The Southern Land won the war eventually. They celebrated Christmas in the second year of the war. Albeit being undercover and huddled up in tiny camps, they made the most of what they had. Joseph made a golden bauble from scrap aluminium foil and paint, and hung it proudly on the Christmas tree. He thought of his beloved Mary and their child as he scraped away at the aluminium, smoothening it mindlessly for hours on end. He promised himself that he would keep it safe, and when he finally returned, he would give it to his daughter and help her hang it on the tree. Then he would help her put the star on top, and laugh childishly as they opened the presents Santa left for them. He’d help her make cookies and keep them near the chimney for Mr Claus to come and gobble them up. On the front lines, Joseph had a gut feeling that he wouldn’t make it out alive. He clutched the golden bauble in his pocket, pulled out the grenade next to it and fired at the enemy. A burly man, at least six foot four, towered over him as he knocked his gun away. Joseph held on tight to the bauble as the man swung at him repeatedly. Joseph played dead and made it back to the camp. He put the bauble in a safe spot near his bed, and wrote on a piece of paper: “Dear Mary and Charlotte, I’m sorry I couldn’t make it back to you both in time. I made a bauble for you, Charlotte. Daddy will always be with you in your heart. Mary, I am thankful for all that you have done for me, and I will love you forever. Please never forget that. Love you both, Joseph” The paper smudged slightly as tears splashed onto it. His hand shook as he wrote the letter, and he tucked it away with the bauble. Mary’s doorbell rang. She was ecstatic, running down the stairs carrying her 5 year old daughter on her hip. It was finally Christmas, a day she had waited for most eagerly. Her heart dropped as the soldier began to apologise for being the bearer of bad news. She put Charlotte down and took the box he was holding gently. She thanked him and shut the door, walking towards the sofa. It seemed impossible. Her husband, who was always smiling and doing whatever he could to help out was never coming back. Charlotte ran over to her mama, not understanding why she was crying. She wiped her tears away and consoled her the best she could in her broken english. Not knowing what else to do, tears began to fall from Charlotte’s eyes. She didn’t know her papa wouldn’t come back again. She’d almost forgotten him. On the Christmas tree, there hung a shiny golden bauble.
author: Aaradhana Prabakaran
illustrator: Aaradhana Prabakaran; Kalp Sanghvi; Nompumelelo  Mdluli

title: Determination Wins Over Evil
text: Today I am going to tell you a compelling story about a young boy. So, let’s unveil the curtains. The boy’s name is John, diminutive, gorgeously fair skinned and glinting blue eyed, pink lipped boy. He was very reticent, very quiet and his serene behaviour used to change the face of the house. How so very well groomed he was!! He fought with none, spoke to none. How tranquil he was! He quietly came an went unnoticed. But with all those bright suns, there were dark clouds. Every single person in the class used to mock at him, intentionally agitate him knowing he wouldn’t say anything. They hid away his belongings as there would be no repercussions. His parents used to feel dejected as they knew that behind that quiet boy, there was a sad heart. One day, John went into his room. His room was a cozy, warm and comfortable one. It had alluring curtains and an eye-catching bed. His room had little windows which gave a beautiful look of the garden which was blooming and smiling with rainbow flowers and lush green trees and as soon as the window opens and if there was a rain last night, the petrichor used to enter and Ah! What a smell. When he was bitter and he was fretting about something, he used to go and stand peering outside the window, merely adoring the nature stole away his negative feeling and replaced with a positive one. He measured the length of the sky with the flight of the birds and wished to be like one. One day, John was very upset and frowns reigned on his face As he had to overcome his fears and terminate them. What he saw outside the window changed his LIFE!! He saw a petite chick fell of the nest and a cat was growling at it with her mean eyes. Questions unfurled in his mind. “ Would the cat prey on her or pounce on her? “. “ Would the chick survive? “. His mind to race like a cheetah. The little one had to escape. It had to fly. He started muttering “ Unleash your power, your wings, fly and escape “. The wings started to flutter as the cat moved nearer and nearer and when the cat was about to jump, there the bird took its flight. WHOOSH!! It flew away. John was blooming more than the flowers. He thought “ Yes, one has to have faith in oneself and then the hero in you will come. I am a hero! Everyone is a hero! “ He thought “ I will unleash the hero hidden in me “. It turns out his parents were listening to what John said and they thought it was their duty to support and stand beside him. Let us help him and plan something through which he will end his fears and the commotion of the negative feelings in his mind. Mom and Dad teamed up and they hatched a plan. One evening, their plan set in motion. John was doing his homework when his father switched off the power generator. Darkness loomed over. He was shuddering and was transfixed to the ground when all of a sudden, the power returned and John resumed his work only to find that his bag wasn’t there. Yes, you are right, his mother took the bag but this secret is unknown to John. He was scared out of his living daylights, he ran and hid in the blanket. Then a thought blinked in his mind “ I need to overcome my fears. I can’t be scared of every little thing. Somebody is playing a prank with me “. He went outside and asked his mother “ Mother have you seen my bag? “. She replied “ There “ pointing to their sparkling pure white sofa. He took it and said “ Mom you were a playing a prank, right “ and his mother replied no. A shiver went down John’s spine. He thought, is it a ghost? This happened every day. So, one day, again the power went out spreading inky darkness. John mustered up his courage and hid behind the curtains. Suddenly he saw his mother taking his bag thinking that John is on his table. John thought “ Why mom why “. John screamed boisterously “ Mummy “ that almost bursted the ear drums. He came out and said “ I saw every thing and what were you doing? “. Mother called out John’s father and he came at a lightning bolt speed and stopped to catch his breath. They both explained him everything and said that they wanted him to get rid of his fear. John certainly aced his goal. He gave a tight hug to Mom and Dad and he learned that you just need to believe in yourself and you shall sail smooth.

title: friendship is the sweetest thing ever
text: Hey every one! I'm pearl and I had a topsy turvy friendship! Wanna hear? Friendship is the Sweetest Thing Ever Hey, I’m Pearl, and here's my story. I was born to extremely rich parents in America. We had a huge house in Beverly Hills. My parents spoiled me as a kid. I would get all the latest toys and gadgets. My father, Jack Diamond, was the owner of a chain of tech companies, and my mother Ruby was a famous supermodel. My parents believed that pearls were lucky and hence, named me Pearl. Even as a child, I was immensely beautiful and studious. Everywhere I went people complimented me and told me I had my mom’s beauty and my dad’s brains. When I was a kid, mom and dad used to go on business trips for days leaving me at home with my aunt Jade. Aunt Jade was my dad’s sister and was a famous microbiologist. She taught me to read, write, sing, dance, play the violin, and developed a special passion for virology in me. Her favourite words were:” Friendship is the most beautiful thing in the world. When I was six, I was enrolled into one of the most expensive schools in the Beverly Hills. It was called Harvard-Westlake school. I was a topper and immensely popular at school due to both my wealth, my mom’s influence and my knowledge and good manners. When I was in third, my principal, Mrs. Parks, called me to the office. When I reached, she pointed to a pretty girl in the corner and told me that her name was Amber. She was a new student and was in my class. The principal wanted me to show her around. As we walked, I found out that Amber was a great violinist, just like me. She also came from a super-rich and influential family. Her father was my dad’s business partner, and her mom was my mom’s modelling friend. As we were walking, Chelsea, the most arrogant girl in the whole school who always tried to be my friend came up to me with her gang and said: “Hey Pearl, why are you hanging out with that girl when you can come with us? She is not even insta famous, only her sister is.”. I said:” Buzz off Chelsea! Not everybody is a snob like you. She is much nicer, and I am sure that if your followers knew how much of a jerk you were, they would definitely unfollow you!”. Amber was immensely grateful and the next day, got me a beautiful pair of amber earrings to thank me. She said that it would show how close I was with her. I gave her some pearl earrings back. From that day on me and her were the best friends, which made Chelsea jealous. She often tried to sabotage our friendship, embarrassing herself at times. One day in ninth grade, Amber came running up to me with tears in her eyes and said:” How could you tear my notebooks? I saw a note in your handwriting saying that you thought I was good for nothing! I thought we were friends!” she ran away before I even realised what was happening. Amber did not come to school for days after that. I decided to get down to the root of it and went home feeling like a detective. A few hours later there was a knock on the door, and I answered. It was Amber. She was wearing the pearl earrings I had gifted her and apologized. Turns out it was all Chelsea’s fault. As I hugged her, our earrings clashed, and we smiled. Truly, friendship is the most beautiful thing in the world.
author: Hiranmayi Chandrasekaran

title: Friendship and hardwork
text: Once upon a time there were two best friends, named Seema and Gayatri. Their bond of friendship was very strong. They were friends since their childhood. They met each other at school. Seema belonged to a very rich family, her father was a lawyer, while Gayatri was from a poor family. Her father was labourer who earned a small amount of money, which goes away in her education fees. Even they both belonged to a different background they did not think so much about it. Seema always bought new things for Gayatri because she understood her tough and hard situation. However, Seema's father did not liked Gayatri because of her background and so always used to say Seema to stop taking things for her. Many days past and Seema's father brain washed Seema about Gayatri and her Background. Now Seema used to quarrel with Gayatri and also show off to her. And then one day Seema left the town and went to the city as her father was transferred to the city court. After that day Seema and Gayatri were never seen again together. After that Gayatri concentrated on her studies and studied hard. Until one day she became a doctor same like Seema, they both were appointed in the same hospital. When after a long time, they met each other Seema apologized, for what she did with her best friend and as expected Gayatri also forgives her, and so after a long time they became best friends again. MORAL: Hard work is the key to success even you belong to a different background; friendship is always the strong bond in the universe.

title: The Sweepy Stroms
text: Lydia was living in Paris, a terrible storm seemed to be appear after a couple of days.Red alerts twinkled on weather detectors,and people were preparing to face the storm.It was 4 am in morning. Lydia usually never got up this time but sleep was already bundled into a heap. She stretched her limbs and put her foot, feeling for the slippers.But it felt as if she was in pool. She leaned to look down but a warm pool showed. She walked to the sitting room,pushing water with her legs.He mother, Anna was on a high chair, looking bewildered.Her father, Allen was sitting beside on a musty stool calling an emergency number explaining the situation in their home. Sacks of rice were soaked and submerged. 'What's up?' asked Lydia looking around for a chair. 'Storms have come last night.The whole city is soaked said Anna. 'Oh ', she said collapsing herself in a pale, green chair bought at woodland furniture, Anna 's favorite shop. She fondly recalled how her mother stood very stubborn to buy at only woodland furniture.Allen put his phone on the table,angry. These people are not helping at all! he said. I have an idea said Lydia. Whats it? asked Anna. It is... Oh no! the rest of the story will come in part 2! Bye!

title: What's Science, Didi? Part 1 : Learning Science = Chatting with the Nature
text: Little Piyu's neighbour, Teju Didi, had come to Piyu's house. She said, "Piyu, I have heard that you have been cribbing about studies of Science since morning.... Don't you like studying science?" Piyu: Teju Didi, Science is so boring...it is just a collection of formulae and definitions. Tanu also feels the same Teju: Who is Tanu? Piyu: My best friend. You know something, when she newly joined our school, no one used to talk to her as we imagined her to be snobbish but after we got to know each other well, I realized what a wonderful person she is... Teju: hmm....Piyu, I think the situation is similar when it comes to Science. How about us having regular Science chats - to get acquainted with science... Who knows, that may result into developing a similar bond with science... Piyu: Can that really happen? Teju: Why not? Science is not mere formulae and definitions. Science is all around us. In fact, Science is a means of communicating or chatting with nature! Just like we can talk to each other in English as well as in our mother tongue Marathi, we can communicate with nature in different languages ​​like Physics, Chemistry, Biology... And just like how you mix Marathi words in an English sentence and hence speak in 'Minglish', we can speak with the Nature in Biophysics, Biochemistry etc.' (Piyu imagining....) Piyu: Really? Although, I do not like Science, this was fun to listen to. I will definitely visit you for Science Chats and get acquainted with Science and befriend Nature... Teju: That would be lovely Piyu, do come!:)

title: Growing up Rich
text: Once upon a time, there was a boy named Rich. His friends used to joke and call him “Richie, Rich, Rich” because he was really very rich. Rich was not a very hard worker, so he didn’t do very well on tests. Since Rich didn’t get good grades, he envied his fellow classmate, Ryan, who did. Rich was so jealous of Ryan that he started bullying him since he was doing better. He used to put paint and glue on Ryan’s seat in class to embarrass him in front of everyone. Ryan knew Rich was behind these dirty pranks, but he never let these pranks affect him because he knew he was better than Rich. On the other hand, the fact that Ryan never showed emotion after the pranks made Rich even more angry. One day Rich got so angry he came up with a plan to harm Ryan. The next day at recess he told everybody “Guys lets play marco-polo.” Rich made sure Ryan was it for the game, and he carefully placed the blindfold on Ryan’s eyes so he couldn’t see anything at all. When everyone started running away, Rich secretly crawled up behind Ryan and gave him such a big push that Ryan ran into a pole and started wincing in pain. Even the nurse came out and took Ryan straight to the hospital because his forehead was bleeding. Rich felt a little guilty because he hadn’t imagined it would go this far, but he was thankful no one saw him do it. Later that day when Rich went home, his mom told him how bad she felt for Ryan because she heard he was a very hard worker. She also said she hoped whoever did this gets caught and punished for doing something so horrible. Then his mother sat down next to him and told him, “Rich, your grades have not been the best this year, but I want you to know I’m here to help you, okay honey.” This made Rich feel so guilty now. On the other hand, Ryan was at the hospital. The doctor said he had a severe concussion that would last at least 2 months. The school principal then came to meet Ryan and asked him what happened. He told the principal, someone shoved him really hard while playing Marco Polo. The principal told him he would find whoever did this. That night Rich felt so guilty and stupid for pulling such a stunt that the next morning he told his mom the truth. At first his mom got very angry and said, “Goodness I cannot believe my son was capable of such acts.” She finally calmed down and asked her son why he did such a thing. Richie replied, “I was… I was…jealous of how good Ryan is at everything: he’s always getting good grades and all the teachers love him.” His mother said, “honey…just because you’re jealous of somebody does not mean you have the right to bully them. You always have to try to do your best and respect the others around you who do well too. Jealousy never makes a good human.” The next time Ryan came to school Rich apologized to him in front of everybody and things between them became better. They told each other that even though they may not be friends, they’ll always respect each other. After that day Rich started working harder on academics and slowly his grades got better too! His mom was very proud of him!

title: Maushi's Magic
text: "Aai! Teacher will give us a test tomorrow!" Gannu told his mother as soon as he came home from school. "Okay. Food is ready. Change your clothes, eat and then sit to study." Said his mother. Gannu studied well. But he feared he would forget all that he had learnt during the test! "You will not forget! Maushi is coming to visit us. She knows some magic. I will ask her and do some magic for you!" Aai told Gannu. Gannu was very happy when Maushi came. Aai told Gannu to leave them alone for some time. Aai and Maushi chatted and had tea. When Maushi left. Aai told Gannu, "The magic is a secret for now. Don't tell anyone about it. I will do the magic at night. And y ou will not forget anything that you have studied!" Gannu was very happy. "I will not forget what I have studied!" He told aai, before he left for school the next day. "You don't look nervous for the test today Gannu!" Said his classmate Khushi when she met him on the way to school. Gannu smiled. "The Magic is working!" Gannu said to himself during the test. He wrote all the answers. He did not forget anything that he had studied. After checking the test papers, teacher called Gannu to her. Then she told the class, "Gannu has topped the class in this test!" "Very good! Keep it up!" said the teacher. Gannu could not wait to go home and give this news to aai! "Aai I topped the class! Maushi's magic worked!" Gannu said on coming home. Aai laughed. "Maushi or I did not do any magic! Your thought did the magic! You kept thinking you will not forget what you have studied. And you did not forget!" Now whenever Gannu fears he will forget what he has studied during the test, he thinks of Maushi's Magic! And he thinks, "I will remember all that I have studied for the test." He does. So can you. Try it the next time you have fears of forgetting like Gannu had.
author: Shahin Ashraf Ali

title: Goal!
text: Girls like me? Girls my age? Girls from my Mumbra? Every Sunday, Bhai plays cricket there with his friends. Every Sunday, I help Ammi in the kitchen after I finish my homework. It’s Sunday again. I tiptoe out of home and run to the playground. “Ummm… do you play football every Sunday?” I ask Didi. “Yes, we play here every Sunday. Would you like to play with us?” Didi smiles. I shake my head. “Heena!” Bhai roars. “What are you doing here? Go home.” I run home. Another Sunday. The same team of girls. The same football. The same energy. The same passion. Oh, is that Inayat? “Inayat!” I call out. “Talk to my mother?” “To let you play football?” Inayat asks, as she kicks the ball. A few days later. It’s Inayat! She’s come home with her mother, and the same Didi. “We teach girls football,” Saba Didi says. “How does that help?” Ammi is surprised. They talk. They listen. They talk and listen for one hour. And finally… Ammi and Abbu agree. I can play football! Sunday again. My heart — it is happy, it is scared. Can everyone hear it? Today is the day, I am finally going to play. I will run. I will kick. But I am also scared. So many people will be watching me. What if I fall and break my bones? Or if I don’t know how to play football? Ammi and I are at the playground. Bhai and his friends are playing cricket on the other side. “Heena, just focus on the ball,” Coach says. “Pass it to someone the second it comes to you. Or kick it towards the goalpost.” I am quiet. The rest of the team is shouting out to each other. “Here, here!” “Ball!” “Ayesha, here! Pass the ball to me, come on.” “Nazo, here, pass, pass.” Suddenly — The ball is in front of me. I forget everything. Everyone. Now, it is just me. And the football. I kick it hard… Everyone claps, even Ammi. “Wow, Heena!” “Amazing, Heena!” Bhai? His jaw has dropped to the ground. The ball is out of the ground, but I am in. Oh yes! I am now part of this dream-team. The times are changing. Can you feel that? People used to say, “How can girls play football?” Now, the same people — friends, neighbours, family members, even strangers — support us. They whistle and cheer for us at our matches. Now, it feels like there’s a future beyond the kitchen, home and family. Our future, full of possibilities. Our dreams, limitless like the sky. Simran If not for Parcham, a lot of girls from Mumbra would be at home, preparing for their weddings. Madina When I talk to Abbu, I am motivated because he understands me. He is the best Abbu. Kulsum Earlier, I wanted to be like Ammi. Now, I want to be myself. Mantasha The word I love the most is "to soar". Jhuveriya I want to tell girls that struggles are a constant. But you must decide what you want to do, what you want to be. Shabnam When I go to the field, I think that today I will learn something and also teach something. Fatima If I were Prime Minister for a day, I would erase hate from the country. Sonali For me, Parcham means joy and freedom. Is this a true story? In a way Heena's story is true for the girls at Parcham Collective, a non-profit feminist collective in Mumbra, Thane. In 2012, a group of teenage girls and women came together to form the collective and break stereotypes based on religion, caste, class and gender. The collective's name, Parcham, is inspired by Majaz’s Urdu poem and means flag or banner. Parcham Collective wishes to empower young girls to dream of a financially independent future.
author: Radhika Shenoy

text: She flied her plane to many kinds of wonderful places all around India and Asia then she created sketch and colored it for collecting on her album and brought it back home. Proppeller Prop-pell-er ﻿A plane has singular proppeller machine on the front. attracted At-tract-ed ﻿She feels historical place is so mysterious and attracted. Maria took off and landed in a mosque. The mosque was very wonderful, it had square shape and it had golden yellow stone. It had zig-zag pattern on the stairs and hidden walkway. Because of the bigger mosque, it is like a maze. The arch of the dome looks like a giant entrance and there was a large room for praying in the bottom side. She continued walking up to the mosque minaret. Maria next destination is lagi field, but this field was located in a city. She found entrance gate which built by bricks and one heigh pole in the middle which iron fence surrounded for protection. The pole appeared a big shadow from the sun that used for time sign. Maria did not find the place for landing in the next stopped. Therefore, She flied around on a pyramid. invisible of an entrance gate in a pyramid, She imagined a treasure which how it looked like which it can find in the inside. Around the pyramid there were curved walls and sloping roofs, then there was palm tree and shrub around every corner. The place looked strange, as if it looked like a giant triangular prism had just appeared out of nowhere. Maria wanted to land perfectly, so she made the roof of a large building as her landing spot. Maria straightened her plane with a tile, flying slowly, and landing smoothly. Maria did not damage the roof of the building at all, then she photographed the result of her landing! However, she had to rush off to take off again while she did not land on an ancient site - but on the roof of the mayor's house! Maria went back home from an exploring adventure her region. She painted all the places that she landed, started from an ancient temple until castle, mosque, wreckage, mayor's house, pyramid and other ancient buildings. Now, Maria has an album that fulfilled of pictures for showing to her family who was proud of her because she was brave to do an adventure. For the next travel, She planned to fly to go another country. Post-reading Questions How many propellers on a plane that Maria will make? Where does Maria fly her plane? Where does Maria first stopped-place? What does an ancient pyramid look like? Why does Maria have to rush off to take off from building's roof? If you can fly anywhere, where do you want to go?
author: KHUSNUL KHOTIMAH

title: Looking At The Moon
text: Radhika is very excited today. Her father is bringing home a telescope! She eagerly waits for her father by the door. At last, he can be seen walking down the lane with a long box in his hand. She runs to him and takes the box. On the box there are pictures of a telescope, stars, sky, planets, etc. As soon as father freshens up and finishes his coffee, they open the box and take out the long telescope and its three legs. Radhika wanted to immediately go and look at the sky with it. "Not now", says father. "Let the sun set and grow dark. Why don't you go to the terrace and see if the sun has set. You can call me once the sky is dark." She quickly runs to the terrace and waits there for the sun to go down. Normally, Radhika does not like when it gets dark but today, she’s looking forward to the dark sky. At last, it is dark! Radhika eagerly yells out to her father. Soon, father fixes the telescope, adjusts it and says, "Come, you can see the moon." Radhika eagerly peeped through it. The moon looked so huge! Not at all like the small butter ball that is seen normally. Radhika kept staring through the telescope for a long time. Finally, she ran downstairs to her grandmother and said, “Grandma, I looked at the moon with my new telescope but there is no old lady grinding wheat there!” Her grandmother chuckled and replied, "The old lady is in the moon of my imagination. Not on this moon!"

title: Kalpana's cycle
text: It was a long day at school. Kalpana came home feeling tired. She opened the door and called, “mummaaa.. I am hungry!” And suddenly, Kalpana saw a big box lying in her room. “Oh wow, what is this?” She went closer and closer. “This is such a big box", she said. What could be inside it? Who kept it here? I want to open it and see.” Kalpana jumped to open the box. "I can't wait any longer", shouted Kalpana. She removed the lid. “ Woww, a cycle!” she clapped, feeling excited like never before. She climbed on the cycle. “You have to learn to ride it", said Prabhu, her brother, laughing. "Yes, yes, I will and I can learn it, will you help me?" said Kalpana. On day one of riding her cycle, Kalpana could not balance the cycle. All the kids laughed and made fun of her. “Let them laugh. I will keep trying", said Kalpana. Kalpana was all pumped up to try again. Bamm.. “Oh no, help!!” Kalpana cried as she fell on the ground and hurt her knees again. At night, Kalpana asked Amma for a glass of milk. I will become strong, and I will keep trying till one day I can ride. On day three, Kalpana sat on her cycle yet again. As she was about to fall, her brother, Prabhu, came from behind and helped her. Prabhu said, "You are very hardworking, I will help you ride the cycle. Prabhu and Kalpana practiced for weeks. Kalpana could finally ride the cycle all by herself.
author: Dhvani Jhawar

title: Once Upon A Christmas
text: Meanveryverymean was a monster. He was mean, very very mean. Just like his name, Meanveryverymean! Wherever and whenever, he saw children having fun........he gave them a fright. Children were very scared of Meanveryverymean. Then, one day, the village school got a new teacher. Sister Fatima spoke softly. She walked gently. And she was very kind. Everyone loved her. Even the flowers, butterflies, trees, insects, birds and animals loved her. The flowers told the leaves, "We love her!" The bird told the tree, "I love her!" Meanveryverymean heard the word, 'love,' each time he saw Sister Fatima. Christmas was just a few days away. In some houses, children were happily preparing for Christmas. Meanveryverymean did not go to frighten them! The word 'love,' had changed him! He wished everyone loved him like they loved Sister Fatima. So he decided to meet Sister Fatima and ask her, "How to make my wish come true?" Sister Fatima was in the garden, telling her students a Christmas story. Meanveryverymean hid behind the bushes, heard the story and got the answer! "OkkkkaaaY! Santa can make my wish come true!" He went to Santa. Santa was busy in his workshop with the elves. It was few days to Christmas and so many gifts still to make! Meanveryverymean asked Santa to make him loveable! Santa laughed, "Ho! Ho! Ho! It's a gift I can't refuse. But first, you must help my elves make the gifts." Meanveryverymean started making toys and other gifts. The little elves were happy with his help. "We love you!" Said a little elf. On Christmas Eve the gifts were all ready and piled upon the sledge. Santa was very pleased. "Just look at you! You are not a monster now! You are the most loveable elf of my workshop. And everyone will love you."

title: The apple, The boy and The Giraffe
text: Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Kendrew. His mom told him to pick some apples to make some apple caramel. However, he did not even have any ladders to climb the apple tree. Eventually, he saw a very tall giraffe walking and eating some leaves in Kendrew’s backyard. It was such a rare event for him to witness a rare animal eating some leaves in his backyard, thus he had an idea, yet the terrible one. Kendrew was scared of any big animals, but without he knew, his mom forced his dad to buy a giraffe for her Christmas gift, because she loved giraffes. He really wanted to scream and run away, yet he was thinking about the apples his mom asked him to pick. The giraffe saw how the boy was panicking and scared of the giraffe, so it went up to him slowly and tried to help Kendrew by persuading him to go up into his long neck to pick up the apples. To contrast, Kendrew was thinking that the giraffe wanted to attack him when he was getting closer. Panickly, he took a huge rock around him and threw it to the giraffe. The giraffe quickly caught the huge rock by his mouth and stopped Kendrew from being scared, he did a brilliant idea. It stopped its steps and looking at Kendrew, who was still shaking due to his fear. The giraffe slowly picked one of the apples from the apple tree and gave it to Kendrew. Finally, Kendrew wasn’t scared of the giraffe anymore, the giraffe helped Kendrew again by giving his neck to Kendrew to climb and pick the apples for the apple caramel that his mom told him to. Since then, they became best friends.

title: Waste To Wow!  Book 1
text: "Ma, teacher said to think before throwing anything into the waste paper basket. Because, we may get an idea to make something nice out of it." Said Geet. "Yes. That is true." Said Ma. "Hmm!" Baba spoke, "Make something from waste that will make me say,'Wow!' Geet really wanted to make something nice out of waste. She also wanted Baba to like it and say, "Wow!" Geet enjoyed doing craft. She went to her craft corner in the house. And thought and thought! Across the room, she saw her uncle. He was clearing his drawer. "Chachu! Please give me whatever you want to throw away," Geet pleaded. "Sure my waste paper basket!" uncle teased her. He gave her things that he no longer needed. There were so many old and torn things made of paper. There were old note books, greeting cards, paper bags, envelopes and more. Geet carefully cut out pieces of paper she could use from this waste. She made some pretty paper flowers from the colorful pieces of paper. Dadi was very good at many different kinds of crafts. She was very very happy whenever she saw Geet doing crafts. Dadi sat down by Geet. Dadi also made some pretty paper flowers! Ma tried to make some paper flowers. "Oh! I think I am making more of a mess," she laughed and left. Geet glued the paper flowers on pieces of stiff paper. She drew and colored other shapes and fun- figures on it. Geet folded and trimmed the pieces of waste paper she had decorated. And what did she make? B eautiful greeting cards and book marks! Dadi saw and clapped. Her younger brother, Chotu clapped and sang, "Baba will say wow oh wow! wow oh wow! Waste to wow!!" And Baba did!

text: Today is a very busy day! Mommy and I will be doing so many things. We walk to the station. There, we meet a lot of people who are waiting in line. People, both old and young, are talking. title: the man and the bull
text: Once upon a time, In the city, a certain calf was born and was bought by a high-class rich man. The calf was well-bred for strength. The rich man got very fond of gentle animals and took good care of them and fed them only the best. When Bull grew up, he thought to himself, “I was bought up this generous man. He gave me such good care and love. Now, I am a big grown-up bull and there is no other bull who can pull as heavy a load as I can. Therefore, I would like to use my strength to give something in return to my master.” the man decided to announce a contest in which he would compete with his bull and another bull also. There was a rich man who had also a powerful bull. He went to the village and said, "My bull will participate in this contest." Listening that the man said that ok. Done. You can participate in this contest...while the contest was about to start in the backroom where the bulls were being ready the man said to the bull, "that you can win. otherwise, I have to give 1000 gold coins. So, both the bulls were ready. so it was first the bull of the man. but the man was so greedy that he said some bad words to the bull. The bull was not happy. so he refused to pull the carts... when they reached home the man was sad. the bull asked the man what was the reason. The bull said that you said bad words. But since I was one to ask for the challenge and I feel sorry for today. You again go to the merchant and make the same bet for two thousand gold coins. This time remember to use only respectful words.” The rich man realized his mistake and went back to the merchant and made bet for two thousand. the merchant who had already won thought it would be easy money so agreed. Again same preparations were made at same place. the rich man fed and bathed a bull and hung a garland of flowers around his neck. When all was ready and carts were attached. This time a rich man touched the bull’s head with his hands and patted him gently and said, “My son, please do me the honor of pulling these one hundred bullock carts and show them your strength.” Listening to this, Bull pulled load with all his might and dragged heavy carts until the finish line. The merchant was in disbelief and had to pay two thousand gold coins. Onlookers were so impressed that they honored bull with gifts. But the more important Rich man had won much more than gold coins, it was his valuable lesson in humility and respect.

title: My Village
text: I had so many memories from my village and I want to share them which everyone. Currently, right now, I am living in a big city, so I wanted to look back on the many memories I had from my village. I hope everyone enjoys this book. Everyday, in my village, me and my parents would go to the market, and get some food. I also got some chips that I would eat to the market and back from the market. I also went to my grandpa’s farm to feed his cows and goats. We also had a garden so that we could get fruits and vegetables if the market was closed. There was also a river that was near my village, and I never went swimming in there, because I was afraid I would drown, and also because there were a lot of crocodiles in that river. However, my grandpa would go to the river and go fishing and get fish to eat. I just saw him sitting on the banks of the river, and not minding that there were crocodiles in the river. I also had a dog that my parents got me, and the dog was very nice, it was licking me, eating dog food out of my hand, and it followed me everywhere. My dog’s name is Charlie, and he is a golden retriever. He loves me so much that he only lets me comb his hair and bathe him. In the Summer, my family and I went to the beach, but I was always at the shore, because I thought I would drown. Eventually, I stopped being scared and swam right by them. The waves were so big, but I got past them. The beach was my favorite place besides home. Ever year, My family would celebrate a holiday called Diwali, it is a holiday about fireworks. I would be told to light up some fireworks using the candle on the ground. I was really scared to do this, because I thought I would get burned. But when I was older, I was not afraid of lighting fireworks anymore, and it was actually not scary at all. I also had 2 cousins, 1 boy and 1 girl, and they would annoy me so much!!! They would disturb me, when I was studying, and when I was playing video games, and they would ask me to give the controller to them. I said no because they would break the controller. Then they started crying, and telling my uncle to give the controller to them. Then I got scolded. I also went to school and made many friends. The teachers were also very nice to me. The teachers said that I was a good dancer. On my first day of school when I was 4 years old, my mom had to be with me for the whole day, because I was scared of the school, people, and the teachers. Every Sunday, I went to Church with my family and my 2 cousins were always annoying me. After Church was over, Me and my family would go to the priest’s house to go talk with him. But sometimes, I don’t know why, but I would be excused from the priest’s house by my family, and go play with my friends or go see my cousins in Sunday School. This book was all about my village and my memories about my village. Hopefully, this book was not only interesting but quite funny to everybody. I hope everyone enjoyed this book.

illustrator: Avishek Sen; Deepa Balsavar; Huynh Thi  Kim Lien; Jenifer Deng Wendy Huang; Marco Tibasima; Nguyễn  Minh Hải; Ouk  Ratha; Pankaj Saikia; Pratham Content Group; Shadrach Munene; 개비 유배다

title: The magical rooster
text: Once upon a time, there was a rooster. The rooster was very special. Not only did it lay eggs but it laid golden eggs in which many precious rubies, emeralds, and sapphires could be found. One day a man called Richard bought the rooster. Richard belonged to a very rich family. He took good care of the rooster. He was a very generous man. One day Richard had to go somewhere but he thought that if he left his precious rooster in the care of his servants then one of the servants could steal the rooster. Thinking so, he left his rooster in the care of his friend, William. William asked Richard '' Friend, Why are you leaving this rooster in my care and not in the care of your servants?'' Richard replied '' William, this is a very special rooster. It lays golden eggs containing rubies, emeralds, and sapphires. All my servants know this so they could steal the rooster, That's why I am leaving the rooster in your care''. '' Don't worry friend I will take good care of the rooster'' said William. But after Richard had gone, William thought '' If I cut this magical rooster in 2 halves then I may get some golden eggs.'' Overwhelmed by this thought William cut the rooster only to find nothing, but blood in the rooster's stomach. William now regretted. But how could he tell the truth to Richard??? Suddenly, he came up with an idea!!! He could replace the magical rooster with an ordinary one!! When Richard returned, William handed him an ordinary rooster. Richard returned home without a doubt. But, when after 18 days the rooster did not lay even a single egg a doubt crept into Richard's mind - Had William replaced the rooster? Thinking so Richard drove straight to William's house. William was greedy but, he always spoke the truth. So, when Richard asked him about the rooster he confessed that he had cut the rooster to take some golden eggs. Richard warmed William and said '' My friend, You should have told me the truth earlier. William apologized. They all lived happily ever after

title: THE REAL MOTHER
text: Two women were fighting over a child. “He is my child, leave him alone,” cried the lady in the red sari. The poor child was too young to speak. “No, he is mine,” cried the woman in the green sari. Soon a crowd gathered. The village elders took the quarreling women to a wise man. The village wise man asked the lady in the red sari, “What do you have to say?” “He is my child, Sir. I was bathing in the river and had left my son on the bank. The wise man asked the other woman to explain. “She is a liar, Sir. I was the one bathing in the river. He is my only child. She came there, picked him up and ran. Luckily I could catch her,” said the other woman. Villagers who were watching this drama did not know whom to believe. The wise man got up. Using a twig, he drew a line on the ground. He asked the two women to stand on either side of the line, and placed the child in the middle. As instructed by the wise man, one woman held the child’s left hand and the other, his right hand. Now listen to me carefully,” said the wise man, “ Both of you need to pull the child to your side. The child belongs to whoever drags him over to her side.” The woman in red sari pulled the child hard with all her might. As the child cried in pain, the other woman, let him go. “ He is mine,” the woman in the red sari shouted n triumph, even as the other woman broke down in tears. “Wait,” said the wise man turning to the villagers, “ Who do you think loves the child more? She who pulled the child to her side or the one who let the child go?” The villagers answered, “She who let go loves the child more.” The wise man took the child away from the woman in the red sari. “Only a mother can have a tender heart for her child,” he said. He handed the child over to the real mother who hugged the child. The child lifter was given a strict warning and allowed to go.

title: Waste To Wow - Book 2
text: Geet's family was very proud of her. "Our young girl does magic with her art and craft talent." Said dadi. "Yes! Yes! she changes things we throw away into something nice." Chotu agreed. What is Geet making now? Geet has pulled out unused pages from old note books. She gathered these pages together into a neat pile. She borrowed the stapler from Baba and carefully stapled the pile of pages. "A new note book!!" Geet said aloud happily. Geet took an old and torn paper bag made of stiff paper. "Ma! Please help me measure and cut out a cover for my book from this." Her mother cut out a proper size cover for her book from the old paper bag. Geet enjoyed designing a cover for her hand-made note book. She cut out pieces of waste color paper in shapes she liked. She placed the pieces upon the cover and moved these pieces around. title: Alia's birthday surprise and her bad day
text: This is Alia, she loves to watch her mother do housework and help too, but sometimes her want to help is too much specially when her mother is trying to give her a surprise on her birthday. Alia has a horrible day just the day before her birthday. Alia is in a very bad mood today, her mother has told her not to help in the kitchen. She tried to tell her mother that she is big enough and she can manage the kitchen on her own but her mother still doesn't allow her. Suddenly Alia had an idea, she called her mom in her room and said 'Mother, look outside the flowers are withering! I think you should go and check on them!', her mother peaked out of the window and said 'Alia, none of the flowers are withering stop trying to peak into the kitchen!'. 'Hmph, this isn't fair at all!' Alia screeched. Alia wept herself to sleep..... THE NEXT DAY! ﻿ ﻿ The next day Alia was woken by her mother's call, as soon as Alia opened her eyes she saw herself wearing a birthday cap. ' HAPPY BIRTHDAY! ' her mother called. She got up feeling very excited her mother told her to get ready fast as there was a surprise which awaited her. Ten minutes later when her mum came in her mother was shocked to see the condition of the room and she then asked Alia 'Maybe I could help the birthday girl a little by showing her some dress choices?', 'YES' exclaimed an excited Alia. 'How about this one?' her mother asked, 'No mother, I don't want to wear this dress...' replied Alia. 'Then how about this lovely pink dress?' asked her mother, 'No mother, I wore that on my previous birthday!' replied Alia. 'This sky blue one is going to look lovely on you' said mother, 'No mom, I wear this dress everyday!' replied Alia. 'How about this glamourous dress which will make you shine like the sun!' asked mom, 'Yes! I love this dress it has a very pretty colour and it's new! Let me wear it and show you! title: Frosty The Snowman
text: Once upon a time, there was a group of children who were best friends. It’s easy to be friends when you all love doing the same thing, and these friends all loved to explore, especially in the winter, One winter morning the friends met to go for a walk along the fields at the edge of town. As they walked beside a particularly snowy field, they came across an old silk hat sitting atop a fencepost. The friends examined the hat, and although it was a little shabby around the edges, it was a truly the perfect hat! For what you ask? Well for building a snowman of course! Since the friends weren’t sure who the hat belonged to, they did not want to take the hat too far from its fencepost home. Instead, they decided to build a snowman in the particularly snowy field. They started to roll large balls of snow and stack them. It was hard work, and it took the effort of the whole group to get the third and final snowball on top of the tower. There was a firepit nearby where they found lots of coal, which they used to give their snowman eyes and a mouth. Luckily, someone found a carrot in their lunchbox, which was perfect for the nose, and two large sticks in the forest made excellent arms. Together, the friends gently placed the old silk hat on their snowman’s head and smiled around at each other for this was, after all, the most magnificent snowman they had ever created! And they had built many a snowperson together… Luckily, someone found a carrot in their lunchbox, which was perfect for the nose, and two large sticks in the forest made excellent arms. Together, the friends gently placed the old silk hat on their snowman’s head and smiled around at each other for this was, after all, the most magnificent snowman they had ever created! And they had built many a snowperson together… And at that very moment, with the friends smiling and hugging and laughing, something truly magical happened. All of a sudden, their snowman began to laugh and smile too! His eyes glimmered (even though they were made of coal) and he seemed very happy, downright jolly even! “Wow!” exclaimed one friend. “ It’s magic!” cried another. “Actually, I prefer to be called Frosty,” said the snowman as he took each child’s hand in his twig fingers and shook, “it is lovely to meet you all!” Frosty and his new friends spent hours playing in the particularly snowy field together. When the friends asked Frosty what he most wanted to do, he requested a dance party, so the group began to dance around the snowy field. Dancing soon became a snowball battle! Frosty wasn’t very good at forming snowballs with his stick arms, so his friends helped him out by making extra snowballs and scattering them around the field. After their snowball fight, the group decided to play an epic game of tag all the way through town! Frosty was very fast on the snowy paths so it was difficult for the children to catch up with him as he dashed into town. Frosty ran through the streets of the town, here and there and all around the town square! And as he ran Frosty shouted to his friends, “catch me if you can!” The children laughed and ran even faster to keep up with the playful snowman. Frosty and the children were running so fast that as they passed people their jet stream caused toques and scarves to fly away. As they passed a traffic cop, her speedometer lit up—the group was going 200 kilometers an hour! The traffic cop had never seen anything like it. A living snowman and a group of the fastest children she had ever seen… She really wanted an autograph! The traffic cop reached into her bag for a pen and paper but before she could holler for them to stop, she realized they were long gone. Frosty reached the other end of town and the group of friends quickly caught up with him, all panting and all smiling the biggest smiles ever. One of the friends said, “Frosty you’re really sweaty after all of that running.” Frosty felt his forehead and realized he was actually melting. He looked up in the sky and saw that the afternoon sun was very bright and that if he stayed in it for much longer he might melt completely! He asked his new friends for a solution and a little girl responded, “There is a forest just over those hills. The trees stretch all the way up to the sky and block out the sun! Maybe you can hide from the sun in there?” Frosty thought this was a brilliant idea, but the group of children felt sad that Frosty would have to leave them. Frosty smiled, “Don’t cry, I’ll be back again in no time. Maybe next time we can play another game!” “Like kickball?” asked one of the children. “Or marbles!” suggested another. “Let’s play all of those games,” replied Frosty. Then he took off his old silk hat, handed it to the little girl, and asked her to return it to the fencepost. She nodded and just like that he was off over the hills of snow towards the forest. But at the top of the last hill, he turned around and waved goodbye to his new friends. The group of children waved goodbye back and began to make their way back through town and to the particularly snowy field with the fencepost. It was quite easy to make their way back because Frosty had left an obvious trail in the snow—like the trail that a snowball leaves as it is being rolled up. They reached the particularly snowy field at the edge of town in no time and found the fencepost that was home to the old silk hat. “This hat must be magic,” explained one of the children as they returned the hat to its place atop the fencepost. “But Frosty was still alive as he could be even when he took the hat off,” one of the friends wondered aloud. The little girl who had told Frosty about the forest paused for a moment, very confused, before realizing that it wasn’t the hat that was magic. “Maybe it’s our friendship that’s magic,” she suggested. Her friends looked at her and smiled, all nodding and gathering together into a big bear hug! Then they set off towards their different homes, talking about the amazing adventure they had had on that wonderful winter day and thinking about how they could explore again tomorrow. The End.

title: Mystery of Lakshmi { Part 1 }
text: There was a time, there lived an elderly lady named Devi. She resided in the region of Nadukkaveri. She was the village's oldest and wisest woman. So, whenever somebody had an issue, they would call Devi. People used to call her " Amma" meaning mother. Lakshmi was also on the panchayat. She resided in a big mansion. She got a letter one day that was sent by her daughter. Her joy had no boundaries. Because her daughter was from Hyderabad. The letter stated that she will be in Nadukavveri on Saturday. Devi was overjoyed. She, too, sent a letter. She went to the market the next day. People were surprised because Devi barely left her residence. She purchased a large number of dresses and a make-up kit for her daughter. She was thinking about what sweets to prepare in the evening because her daughter enjoyed the sweets she made. She made many sweets that night, 1. Laddo 2. Gulab Jamun 3. Payasam 4. Kozhukkattai. 5. Rava Laddu 6. Adhirasam and a lot more. [If you don't know what the sweets means, go to the last page once you finish reading.] I forgot to tell you the name of Devi's daughter. Preethi is her name. Preethi's visit to Nadukkaveri was quickly approaching. She was reading the newspaper to see if there was any news on the flight Preethi was taking. Devi made all arrangements for Preethi. Preethi arrived at the local airport. She looked around but couldn't find her mother. So she called a taxi. She was exhausted after 2 hours in the air and 3 hours in the cab. When she arrived at her residence, she discovered a large crowd gathering there. She inquired as to what had occurred. Amma is missing, yelled a tiny child. Preethi couldn't understand at first, but then the kid told her your mother was missing. Preethi fainted and fell. She awoke after a few minutes. She was discouraged. But she won't whine. She began an inquiry. In Hyderabad, Preethi worked as an investigator. She suddenly remembered she had a buddy who worked at a police station. Rohan was the name of her friend. Rohan was the local police station's inspector. Rohan agreed to assist Preethi in her investigation. They both began the inquiry. Preethi put 1. Newspaper boy 2. Neighbour 3. Milkman in the suspects book. They went to the Newspaper Boy first. "I kept the newspaper around the front step," he explained. Then I heard a noise and peered out the window, but there was nothing strange there. So I assumed the cat appeared since the neighbor's cat frequently appeared. They proceeded to the houses of their neighbours. "We returned from our trip to Paris," they said. This is our ticket. Our cat was also taken to the vet. The receipt is attached. Preethi cut the names of the newspaper boy and the neighbor from the Suspect's book. They went to meet the Milkman at the Dairy Farm. "I brought 5 litres of milk to Amma yesterday since she said she would be busy today," the milkman explained. Okay, thanks, said Preethi. They visited Amma's house. They noticed a poor kid standing there. He informed " Akka I must inform you of something. I was resting near Amma's house the night before. I heard a noise and looked out the window, but nothing strange was there, so I fell asleep. Then I noticed a guy leaping out of Amma's house. It appeared to be Mohan. Rohan was taken aback because Mohan was the chief's son. Preethi thanked the poor kid and proceeded to the chief's residence. When they arrived at the home. Everyone was anxious. The chief rushed towards Rohan, pleading for pardon. Where is Mohan, Rohan demanded angrily? For a brief period, there was silence. Rohan inquired, "Where?" Chief suggested the Basement. They noticed Mohan counting gold coins. Rohan raised his hands. What shop did you acquire them from? "The day before yesterday, Amma asked me to adjust her lamp, she was gardening," Mohan explained. She eventually discovered a jug full of gold money. When I saw it, I grew greedy. I decided to rob it yesterday, but Amma was awake, so she got a stick and was going to strike me, but I fled. I then took Her stick smashed on her head, took the gold pot and ran away. The Question was who kidnapped Amma and why? Part 2 will be released on 12th February 2023. Meanings 1. Resided - to have your home in or at a particular place 2. Payasam- is a sweet dish and a type of wet pudding popular in the Indian subcontinent, usually made by boiling milk, sugar or jaggery, and rice, although rice may be substituted with one of the following: dals, bulgur wheat, millet, tapioca, vermicelli, or sweet corn. 3. Kozhukkattai- is a popular South Indian dumpling made from rice flour, with a filling of grated coconut, jaggery, or chakkavaratti. 4. Rava laddu- semolina (suji), ghee (clarified butter), sugar, coconut (optional in some recipes), nuts and ground cardamom. 5. Adhirasam- is a type of Indian sweet from Tamil cuisine, Karnataka cuisine, Telugu cuisine, Chhattisgarhi cuisine, Marathi cuisine and Odia cuisine. 6. Peered- to look closely or carefully at somebody/something, 7. Assumed- to pretend to have or be somebody/something 8. Akka - Sister 9. Leaping - to jump high or a long way

title: Lebo and Gogo's Tea Party
text: Lebo is at Gogo’s farm. She is bored with chasing the animals. ‘Now you chase me, Gogo!’ Lebo shouts as she races past. ‘Slow down, Lebo,’ Gogo says, hurrying to catch up. Gogo trips over a rock while chasing Lebo. ‘Ouch!’ she screams. Gogo has hurt her ankle. She comes back from the doctor with a special boot and crutches. ‘Gogo, come back to the city with us so that we can take care of you,’ says Lebo’s mom. ‘I won’t leave my farm. I will manage on my own,’ Gogo replies, stubbornly. ‘Gogo, you must come. We will have so much fun!’ Lebo says, excitedly. During the drive, Lebo bounces on her seat. She thinks of all the wild adventures she and Gogo will have in the city. When they arrive at the house, Gogo rests on the sofa. Lebo dashes into the lounge. ‘Gogo, Gogo, I know what we can do today! We can go to the mall. There are lots of shops with nice toys and ice cream!’ ‘I’m afraid I can’t. The mall is too big, and I will get so tired.’ ‘Gogo, Gogo, I know what we can do today! We can go to the park!’ ‘I’m afraid that won’t work. The dogs in the park will run around and could make me fall again.’ A second later, Lebo’s eyes are wide with excitement. ‘Gogo, Gogo, I know what else we can do today. Let’s go to the beach.’ ‘I’m sorry, Lebo. I’m afraid my crutches will sink into the soft sand.’ Lebo is quiet while Gogo knits. Suddenly she has an idea! ‘Gogo, Gogo, I know what we can do today! Let’s have a tea party. Gogo, you can sit here. I will bring everything to you because you are hurt.’
author: Siphosethu Zantsi

title: Who Took My Shoe?
text: “Come, Jabulani,” Ma says. “Why aren’t you ready? You’ll be late for school.” “I can’t find my shoe,” says Jabulani. “Did you look under your bed?” says Ma. “It’s not under my bed,” Jabulani says. “Did you look in the wardrobe?” Ma asks. “Yes, it’s not in the wardrobe.” “I know where your shoe is,” giggles Jabulani’s sister Lungi. “Where?” Jabulani asks. “I’m not telling you!” says Lungi “Somebody’s taken it,” Jabulani says. “Why would someone take one shoe when they’ve got two feet?” says Lungi. “I don’t know. Maybe they’ve hidden it to make me cross.” “Did you take my shoe?” he asks Lungi. “No,” says Lungi, “your shoes are too big for me.” “Did you take my shoe?” Jabulani asks Fruit Juice the Dog. She smiles her big dog smile at him and wags her tail. “Maybe a bird picked it up and flew away with your shoe,” laughs Lungi. “Maybe a monkey took it and left it up in a tree,” says Jabulani. “Don’t worry, we’ll find your shoe,” says Ma. “Everyone look for Jabulani’s shoe.” But the shoe is nowhere to be found. “It’s all right,” says Ma. “You can wear your takkies to school today.” Lungi comes rushing into the kitchen with a big smile on her face. “I know where your shoe is,” she shouts. “Come and see.”
author: Elana  Bregin

title: Shoo Shoo Dukshu!!
text: Duksha is a happy child. If you ever meet her, she will either be laughing or smiling! "Duksha! Will you dry the dishes for me?" Ba (Mother) asks. Duksha is reading. She puts her book aside. "Shooo! Shooo!" She whispers to herself. "Haan (yes) ba! Comming," she answers her mother. Duksha dries the dishes cheerfully. Later, bhai (brother) asked Duksha, "You are always looking happy. Don't you feel sad, angry, worried or fearful ever?!" Duksha laughed, "Haan bhai, I do feel sad, angry, worried, fearful and annoyed many times. But I learnt from Pawan (Wind) how to get rid of unhappy feelings and be happy! "One day, I was sad. I wished to be happy. I heard, 'Breathe in... shooo! Breathe out... shooo!' I felt drowsy and closed my eyes. And I saw pawan! It was happy. It floated on a cloud, played with the flowers and tickled the water in the puddle!! Pawan shook the tree and the flowers fell on me. I laughed. Then it whispered, "Take deep breaths. Breathe in...Shoo! Breathe out...Shoo! Say, 'Shoo! Shoo! Don't need you' to unhappy thoughts!" I did. When I opened my eyes, I was feeling happy! "I have heard you whispering "Shoo! Shooo!" sometimes." Bhai laughed. He playfully teased her and ran out, "Shoo! Shooo! Dukshu! I don't need you" Duksha too ran out shouting, "Bhai oh Bhai! Shooo! Shoo! Dukshu! Needs you! Needs you!" Pawan whispered, "Shoo! Shoo! Dukshu! More happiness to you!"
author: Shahin Ashraf Ali

title: Fifi and Teddy

title: The Sausage Dog
text: Mama and Thembsie go shopping. ‘Mama, that dog looks like a sausage. A sausage with legs and a head.’ ‘And a tail!’ ‘Mama, can we have that sausage dog?’ ‘No, sorry Thembsie. We can’t have a dog.’ Mama and Thembsie go home. ‘Mama, those balloons look like sausages. ‘Can I play with them?’ ‘Yes Thembsie!’ Thembsie twists and shapes the balloons this way. And Thembsie twists and shapes the balloons that way. POP! POP! POP! ‘Papa, can you make this balloon into a sausage dog?’ ‘Yes, Thembsie.’ Papa and Thembsie go inside. Papa twists and shapes the balloon this way. And Papa twists and shapes the balloon that way. LEGS! TAIL! HEAD! Thembsie and her sausage dog go for a walk. HOP! BOUNCE! BOP! ‘Thembsie, dinner time!’ calls Mama. ‘Mama, Papa, this is my sausage dog. Can he have some dinner?’ ‘Yes, Thembsie!’

title: My Bestfriend the cat (Remix)
text: I had a sweet kitty. Lucy was her name. She was my closest companion. My Grandma arrived one day with a puppy. When the dog arrived at my place, it was furious. It began to follow Lucy. title: the golden fish

title: Happy Playing - A tale for the young and old
text: Raj's Uniqueness There was once a boy named Raj. He was very unique than the other children. He knew many arts like sports, pottery, marshal arts, drawing and painting, board games, cooking, etc. At times he mastered those arts, he could even beat experts of those arts, and sometimes, HE WAS EVEN ON TV! Raj even had a shelf which he called, ‘’Collection of Awards’’. Obviously, he would hang and keep his medals, certificates and trophies. Oh, and he was also dubbed, ‘’The Divine Genius’’. WHEN HE STOPS PLAYING WITH HIS FRIENDS…. One day, as Raj was writing poems and articles, his little sister, Rani, and big brother, Aamir, asked him to play Hide-and-Seek. But Raj replied, ‘’No. Iam busy. I have no time to play with you guys. Once Iam done with my work, then I can do anything I want’’. ‘’OK, we will go to play with the others.’’ said Aamir, winking at Rani, for he knew what was going to happen. AT THE AGE OF SIXTEEN... Raj is 16. But, he still isn’t fine! Physically and mentally, he was inactive, and his inner power shutting down. Do you know why? Did I hear ‘’because he stopped playing’’? That’s correct! Its because he stopped PLAYING! Raj was also very bored, and all the people AROUND THE WORLD wondered, “Why isn’t the Divine Genius doing anything?’’ A SENSATION OF JOY AND HAPPINESS After years and years and years, he finally asked all of his friends,"Can I play with all of you?” They said, “Of course! It was no fun without you, Raj!” He was elated. They all played a game called dodgeball. At dinner time, he said to Aamir, “Bhai, I learnt 2 lessons. We do not stop playing because we grow old, we grow old because we stop playing. Also, in life, no matter how old we grow, we are still children.” Aamir said, “Iam glad that you realized, Raj. Anyways, you are a champion in all arts.” They both sat together for dinner and talked as they ate. It was a new beginning for Raj!! THE END….. Now, my story is done… Red is the settling sun, Flowers and their petals close, The wind comes as a gliding. The moon is waxing in the night sky, Stars twinkle as blinking eyes…

title: The Spicy Spat
text: In the kitchen one day, there was a spicy spat. (Spat means petty quarrel or an unimportant argument.) Some spices quarreled with one another. Each one felt it was the queen or king of the spices! Cardamom, the spice that gives a pleasing flavor to tea, was very angry. "Read books on spices! You may see the words: CARDAMOM IS THE QUEEN OF SPICES!" It shouted. Pepper shouted back, "Yes! Yes! I agree with you! But in those books it is also written that pepper is known as the king of spices! Why don't you say this?!" Ginger tried to speak softly. It could not speak softly. It yelled, "Since the vedic times, that means, since many hundred years ago, I am used as the 'MAHA AUSHADHI' in India. Do you know, the meaning of maha aushadhi?! It means the great medicine!!" Garlic was quick to yell back! "Keep quiet! Since long long ago, all over the world, I am known for health building qualities. The father of modern medicine, Hippocrates, treated infectious and other diseases by using me! "May I have your attention please!" Turmeric, the spice used in many religious and festive ceremonies in India announced. "Why am I called the spice of life? Some call me the Golden Spice! Go find out. And please stop shouting!" "Excuse me please!" Cinnamon cried. "I also give nice fragrance and flavor to food. I am also known to be a super medicine. Some very old religious texts in the world have mentioned me." It said. And it is true. The spicy spat could go on and on.... It ended when the tasty tamarind, amma's favorite spice for making 'rasam,' spoke sensibly. "Each and everyone of us is a wonderful medicine from Nauture's pharmacy (a place where medicine is made.) Each of us can cure many different kinds of illnesses. Each one of us can make different kinds of meals tasty. So, please stop this unimportant argument!" "I agree!" Mustard seed that looks like a tiny black bead, said happily. It started making up a rhyme. A spicy rhyme! "Each and every spice Is very very nice!......" "Each can make some food Taste very very good!.........." The Cumin seeds made up the next lines of the rhyme. "And when you fall sick We can do a healing trick!" The cloves sang. All the spices joined in singing the rhyme. And the spicy spat ended.

title: Lovely Angelina and her baby brother

title: The Peacock's Dance
text: Ashraf Ali Hina went to the farm with her father. She danced all the way to the farm. Yes. Hina loved to dance. She always took part in the dancing competitions in the school. When they reached the farm.......her father got busy with his work. Hina started walking in the farm. She was looking for a nice place to practice her dance steps. Her father told her to go to the other side of the vegetable patch. "There is a good clear spot there." He said. As Hina was going to that spot, she saw a peacock in the farm. She started walking towards the peacock. The beautiful bird did not notice her. Hina saw how it walked, moved its head, body and feet. "It looks as if it is doing some dance steps!" Hina thought. Suddenly, it started raining lightly. Hina Laughed. She tried to catch the rain drops. Then she again saw the peacock at a distance. Hina stood still. She just kept looking at the peacock. Seeing the rain, the peacock started dancing. It had spread its colorful pretty tail like a fan. It looked so beautiful dancing in the rain. Standing at a distance, Hina saw the dance of the peacock. After some moments, seeing the peacock, Hina also started dancing. She copied the peacock. Hina moved her body in such a way that it looked like she was doing the peacock's dance! The peacock forgot to dance! Because, while dancing, it suddenly saw Hina dancing at a distance. It got startled. And forgot to dance! It just stood there watching Hina dance! How well Hina danced! Then she folded her hands, bowed her head and said, "Thank you dear bird for teaching me such nice dance moves." Guess the peacock understood. For it spread its tail and started dancing again. Hina too danced. Wow! What a peacock dance it was!
author: Shahin Ashraf Ali

title: What is a Company?
text: A company is a business organization that produces and sells goods or services. A car company manufactures and sells cars, which are goods. A beauty parlour provides services that enhance the looks of a person. Garments, biscuits, and mobile phones are examples of goods. Software, training, and medical consultations are examples of services. A company is started by one or more owners who are also called founders. The founders decide and plan what the company will achieve over the next 5 to 10 years. The Chief Executive Officer (CEO) is the head of all the business operations in a company. The CEO may be one of the founders or someone else. A company has many employees who help to produce the goods or services. A company has many departments, such as finance, software development, sales, marketing, research and development, customer service, and human resources. The employees of a company belong to any one of these departments. Every month, the employees get a salary from the company for performing their duties. The people who buy the goods or services of a company are called customers. “Customer is the King,” is a popular saying. A company aims to make profits by selling its goods or services. A company usually has a physical building as its office. But, these days, companies can exist even without an office space, as employees can work virtually from anywhere. Activity 1: Which of the following can be services of a company? 1. Computers 2. Counselling 3. Drones 4. Toothbrushes Activity 1: Answer Which of the following can be services of a company? 2. Counselling Computers, drones, and toothbrushes are goods. Activity 2: Who buys the products of a company? 1. Entrepreneur. 2. Seller. 3. Employees. 4. Customer. Activity 2: Answer Who buys the products of a company? 4. Customer.
